reviews.author: Karla O
reviews.title: Exceptional attention from Rodolfo: he made our stay unforgettable.
reviews.text:
I want to highlight and especially thank Rodolfo, the concierge at Paradisus, for the extraordinary attention he provided us throughout our stay.

From the very first moment, he was incredibly kind, attentive, professional, and always willing to help with a smile. It did not matter what we needed or what questions we had; Rodolfo always found a way to resolve it quickly and efficiently, making us feel truly welcomed and valued as guests.

What impressed us the most was his service attitude. It is evident that he enjoys his work and genuinely cares that guests have the best experience possible. Thanks to his dedication, our trip was much more comfortable, pleasant, and special.

People like Rodolfo make a huge difference and represent the best of the hospitality that Paradisus offers. I sincerely hope that management recognizes his excellent work, because employees with that level of commitment, human warmth, and professionalism are hard to find.

Thank you very much, Rodolfo. Without a doubt, you are one of the main reasons we take away such a positive memory of this hotel and why we would love to return.

reviews.author: Shannon c
reviews.title: A Beautiful Anniversary Trip with Exceptional Service
reviews.text:
My husband and I celebrated our 20-year anniversary at Paradisus Cancun in April 2026, and we had a wonderful experience.

The resort had recently reopened after renovations, and everything felt fresh, modern, and very clean. The beach was beautiful, the pools were relaxing, and the grounds were well maintained.

The highlight of our stay was the staff. Everyone was friendly, helpful, and genuinely seemed to care about making our vacation special. A special thank you to Chris, our Reserve Concierge, who went above and beyond throughout our stay.

If you’re considering upgrading to The Reserve Adults Only section, I highly recommend it. The concierge service, exclusive lounge, premium drinks, coffee bar, adults-only dining, and Bali beds were well worth it.

The resort offers several dining options, including steak, seafood, Japanese cuisine, and a buffet. While the food wasn’t our favorite part of the trip, breakfast was excellent and there was plenty of variety.

We especially enjoyed the live saxophone music during breakfast, the beautiful beach, and the peaceful gym each morning.

Overall, we had an amazing anniversary trip and would gladly return to Paradisus Cancun in the future.

We will definitely return to Paradisus Cancun - this is one of our favorite resorts.

reviews.author: Rodrigo V
reviews.title: Very good service and a beautiful place.
reviews.text:
We had a very good stay at the hotel, mainly due to the attention of the staff. The facilities are beautiful, but undoubtedly what stands out the most is the quality of the team.

We want to especially thank Rodolfo, our concierge, who was always attentive and willing to help; Julio from the Reserve area for his cheerfulness and excellent service; and also Daniel, Leo, and Ignacio from the Sal restaurant, which was by far our favorite restaurant. The food was very delicious, but the experience was even better thanks to them. We also want to highlight Roberto from Zesti for his kindness.

However, we felt that the beach was disappointing due to the amount of seaweed and because we hardly saw any cleaning during our stay. Additionally, at Santé we had the worst experience: very slow service (we waited about an hour and a half on the first day) and food that was considerably weaker than the rest.

Aside from that, we are leaving very happy. The service at this hotel truly makes a difference.

reviews.author: Liz
reviews.title: Good times!
reviews.text: Had a great time back, since their closure last year due to renovations.  Some changes were noticed like their lobby area, rooms appear smaller than before with some changes, the AC needs improvement, 68f was the coolest.  Snacks/food area in the reserve area/adults only area was better before with more options.  No changes were noted in the adults only area, before closing we were told an infinity pool was in the works for this area, disappointed not see this be.  With it just being reopened, staffing is short, we had to wait awhile for most restaurants for food to be delivered, the cabana beds also took awhile, only 1 person, taking care of guests, where as before there  was always 2 people working that reserve area.  Over all had a pleasant time, Estephany our personal concierge was great! She made sure we had everything we needed and more. She went above and beyond helping us to celebrate an anniversary and birthday.  We had nice dessert surprises at dinner and back in our room with special wine,  champagne and room decorations!  Thank you  Estephany for making our stay special, we appreciate you!  Look forward to coming back.

reviews.title: Great Resort Amazing Staff
reviews.text:
We just returned from a 7 night stay at Paradisus Cancun.  My wife and I wanted to come back after the renovations were completed this year after an amazing stay in March of 2025.  All I can say is that the resort is great and the staff is amazing.  We will be back again and again with our next trip already planned for later this year. Drinks were aplenty and served quickly.  Entertainment was available as well.  Zestys was a very warm atmosphere (temp wise) Blue Agave was very accommodating, Pizza ok, coffee shop great, ice cream place great, buffet not so great.

Alejandro is amazing
Valentina is amazing

reviews.author: Maricruz I
reviews.title: Magical place.
reviews.text: The hotel is incredible and the attention from everyone was wonderful; since we checked in, they treated us very well, the facilities are very nice, we loved that they maintain that part of nature and elegance at the same time, we dined at the Asian restaurant and it was delicious, the buffet was very varied with many healthy options for all tastes, the assistant Diego took very good care of us and was always attentive to us, we also dined at Agua Marina and we loved it; the captain Teresita took very good care of us, we especially highlight the attention of the food and beverage manager, Mr. Jesus Miranda, and his assistant Adriana Sanchez for all the facilities and the charisma they have in performing their work; it is evident that they do it with great passion. In the pool area, the waiter Rodrigo and his boss Luis were also very helpful and attentive, and the captain Grecia was very kind and attentive. Everyone was very nice and attentive, and they made our stay unforgettable. Thank you so much to the entire Paradisus team!!! We hope to return very soon!!

reviews.author: Terri W
reviews.title: Without a doubt
reviews.text:
Apart from not being accommodated to the Reserve side of the resort, our experience was exceptional with our concierge Estephany. We made an intentional decision to make the best of our stay. Estaphany was patient, she listened and she heard us. She was very accommodating and made sure we had everything we needed. If she didn't have the answer, she found the answer. 

Service was exceptional. Our entire team worked together to make things happened even after requesting our snacks get restocked. We were always greeted with smile and a warm welcome from the heart. The food was good. Our favorite were the lamb chops from the Sante restaurant and the Ribeye steak from Sal restaurant. They were well seasoned and tasty 🌝. 

We had a catered dinner for two on the beach. Enjoyed every moment.

Big shout out to Javier from Santa restaurant who made sure I had my fix of mangoes in the mornings. My other waiters, Roberto, Jorge, Francisco, Jesus (Zesty) and Ignacio (he was new in this position, however made it happened.

The spa was exceptional. Wendy and Veronica were very welcoming. They explained the process the best way they knew in English, and it was perfect. Wendy did very well with the deep tissue massage and Veronica did worked on my husband knots in his shoulders. Both ladies were great.

Husband celebrated his 54th birthday and we knocked off three things from our bucket lists.
1. Parasailing
2. Jet Skiing
3. ATVs

We had a oceanview junior suite was small to our liking but we made it work. Atmosphere was very warm and inviting. Not many people on the resort that because of reopening, children still in school or world climate. Location was good. We were not very far from the international hotel. We took a short drive in the taxi to shop for souvenirs. 

New fun area for children added. Oh, and there is new bridge which from what hear the locals are Super excited due shorter commute. Listen visit, tour, and become family! Blessings,
The Walkers.

Onto the next Adventure!!

reviews.author: Yolanda D
reviews.title: Excellent renovated hotel with a super warm service!!
reviews.text:
Excellent newly renovated hotel. The warm treatment from the staff is something worth highlighting. Since our arrival, we were given an upgrade by Joshua for our anniversary. Alan, Marco, and Amelia at the front desk were very kind.

Our Concierge Carlos was extremely attentive to all our needs from start to finish, making our stay very special!!!

Víctor, the Concierge in the pool area of The Reserve, was attentive and kind at all times, very friendly.

Uriel in entertainment was very kind and had an excellent attitude.

The Capella restaurant had delicious dinners, and we were very well attended by Jorge and Captain Antonio, providing excellent service.

The Blue Agave restaurant had exquisite tacos (I recommend the lengua and la gringa), and Mohazir and Xóchitl served us wonderfully.

The Sal restaurant was EXQUISITE!! Everything was delicious from start to finish. We were excellently attended by Carlos, Manager Daniel, and Hostess Paola. Carlos had the kindness to treat us to a cake for our anniversary.

The Agua Marina restaurant was very well attended by Moisés and Yessenia, who also had the kindness to provide us with a small cake for our anniversary.

The Kao restaurant had everything very tasty, and we were very well attended by Arce.

By taking an upgrade to Reserve, we were given a complimentary "Sunset Cruise," and Daladier attended to us very well and was attentive at all times. And Uriel from entertainment got everyone dancing.

From the SPA area, Guillermo Pérez was very kind, and Carlos was attentive at all times.

In the pool area of The Reserve, Arnulfo was very kind and attentive. And in the family pool area, Vianney was also very kind.

In the Santé restaurant, everything was delicious!! And we were very well attended by Cynthia and Javier.

Juan Carlos and Omar, promoters of the Circle program, approached us very kindly to offer us more information. We will get in touch with them for a new visit to the hotel to understand what it is about, as it is a wonderful hotel!!

It is definitely a hotel that we recommend for its excellent facilities and the quality of its food and beverages. But mainly, the treatment we received from the staff is unparalleled!!

reviews.author: Cosette B
reviews.title: Just wow!
reviews.text: This resort is absolutely stunning. I understand why they call themselves The Icon. The property is so grand and luxurious and in great location. We had the pleasure of staying at Paradisus Cancún in the second week of May for our anniversary. Our concierge Javier (Javo) was professional and friendly and took excellent care of us. He arranged dinner reservations, secured pool-side day beds and recommended activities daily. The service from all the staff was top notch. Our room at The Reserve exceeded our expectations and the view was perfect. We were sad to leave but will be back! Thank you!

reviews.author: Sara D

reviews.text: Today I visited Blueagave, and Alberto's service was excellent; thank you for making lunchtime a wonderful experience.

reviews.author: Alan Miguel B
reviews.title: Birthday of little Khalid.
reviews.text:
I visited the Paradisus Cancun hotel to celebrate the birthday of the little one in the family. From the moment we arrived, we were warmly welcomed and directed to reception, where Andrei and Alberto, along with Joshua from the rooms controller area, greeted us. They were very attentive and took care to personalize the experience at all times. They asked us if it was our first time visiting the property and if we were celebrating any special occasion, and without any expectations, we received a free upgrade to two rooms on the upper floor with an ocean view, as well as a complimentary late check-out. Joshua invited us to start enjoying the property while they finished up some details in the rooms. 

At lunch, we visited the Blue Agave restaurant, where we were attended by Xóchitl, who was very attentive and helpful at all times. 
Shortly before finishing, the reception team informed us that our rooms were ready. Upon arriving at the room, we found a very nice birthday decoration along with other amenities and a personalized card that we absolutely loved. 

It was a great experience at the property; we enjoyed the facilities, restaurants, pool area, and the new water park zone, and above all, we loved feeling pampered and very well received by the entire Paradisus Cancun team.

reviews.author: Кристина Ф
reviews.title: Great option in Cancun
reviews.text: The hotel leaves a great first impression. It's very green, well-kept and literally drowns in lush tropical vegetation. The architecture of the building is unique. Inside are huge open spaces that blur the line between interior and nature (the main hall doesn't even have entrance doors). And of course, the main decoration of the hotel is the calling card of Cancún incredible turquoise water and stunning ocean views. This resort clearly wins over many other popular all-inclusive hotels in this location. We were in this hotel just after a multi-day tour from Mexico City to Cancún, which was conducted for us by the amazing guide Yuri Shchepkin. A man of megaprofessionals, now we recommend him to absolutely all friends and acquaintances. It's just that we used to always buy these trips through regular agencies instead of directly, and we ended up wildly overpaying. And the service there is standard: after a whole day of excursions, you are dumbly unloaded at the hotel in the evening and spin any way you want. It was different with Yuri! He wouldn't leave us after the afternoon program, he'd stay late, he'd have a great evening walk around town, and if we wanted to sit in a local place, he'd help us navigate the menu and tell us what to order. The man is on the line 24/7, really. The plus side of the huge high is that the route itself could be adjusted and adjusted to suit itself right on the go, as it went. If anyone wants his coordinates, find it easy just Google or any search engine his first and last name. Huge plus hotel competent zoning for different types of vacationers. For families with children (Family Concierge) There is a separate comfortable check-in with welcome champagne for parents, coffee and light snacks. While you're doing the paperwork, kids can play in a special room with an Xbox. The family rooms are spacious, equipped with a comfortable shower (without bath) and a safe. If you get the odd number, beautiful ocean and pool views are guaranteed. Adults Only (The Reserve) This area is located in a separate building with its own swimming pool, bar and restaurant. Rooms here feature more refined furniture and a luxurious all-glass shower room with tropical shower. A great choice for a romantic or private holiday. Restaurants and food. The hotel's culinary map is varied, but has its own nuances. The favorite Asian food restaurant Lemon Fish is absolutely delighted! The sushi, rolls, ramen, octopus and salmon are cooked at the highest level. Sal Steak Cave Steakhouse. A stylish place to go once during your holiday. Basic items are included in the concept, but consider that premium meat (such as Wagyu) will have to pay a decent extra (about $110). The rest of the restaurants. In the evening, the Italian restaurant Capella and the pool restaurant require a reservation in advance. By the pool, you can have a great pizza or taco from noon, and the lobby has a 24-hour coffee shop with good espresso and doughnuts. The breakfast buffet offers a standard set of waffles, pancakes, omelet station, fruit, slices and traditional Mexican nachos. The food is normal, but without frills, as is often the case on mass buffets. You won't get bored at the hotel. For children in the third building there is a great kids club and there is even a quest room (Escape Room). The lower floors contain a gym, a spa and a beauty salon. For outdoor enthusiasts, there are tennis courts and a private golf course right on site. An excellent five-star hotel that is equally well suited for couples with children and adults seeking silence. Minor nuances with buffets and extras are fully compensated by the stunning atmosphere, service and a la carte restaurants. It is recommended to visit!

reviews.author: LouRinda B
reviews.title: Perfection at Paradisus
reviews.text:
Just returned from a week long stay at the newly renovated Paradisus Cancun. This was our fourth visit to this beautiful resort. We booked The Reserve Jr. Suite (ocean view). The room was exceptionally clean and provided a spectacular view of the ocean. The entire property is immaculate! 
Sergio, our destination concierge, provided 5-star service! From check-in to departure he ensured our experience was absolutely amazing. His daily attention to detail allowed for a stress-free, relaxing vacation. His genuine care & compassion was evident throughout our daily interactions. 
David, Mikel & Victor (Reserve Pool - concierges) provided excellent service! They (along with the pool servers) work hard to ensure pool guests are comfortable & cared for! 
And last, but not least, Julio in the Reserve lounge always greets with such a wonderful smile! 
Would highly recommend staying at Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.title: We Requested Omar Again-That Says Everything
reviews.text:
We were fortunate to have Omar as our butler, and he completely elevated our stay. After leaving the resort for a period and returning later, we specifically requested to have him assigned to us again — that alone says everything about the level of service he provided.

Omar consistently went above and beyond what would normally be expected. He was proactive, attentive, professional, and genuinely cared about making our experience as smooth and enjoyable as possible. Whether it was helping coordinate arrangements, checking in to ensure everything was going well, or handling small details that made daily life easier, he did it with warmth and efficiency.

What stood out most was how effortless he made everything feel. His service never felt forced or transactional — just sincere hospitality delivered at an exceptionally high level.

He was honestly one of the highlights of our trip, and we’re incredibly grateful for the care and attention he showed our family. We would absolutely return and would gladly request Omar again.

reviews.author: Cindy V
reviews.title: Just ok needs work
reviews.text:
Stayed here for a week in May and I’ll try to give my review as someone who is well travelled and have been to countless all inclusives and Cancun many times. We could count the number of guests it was so dead. 

Good 
Beautiful resort big rooms restaurants etc. All the staff were amazing def 5 star service.  Victor Miguel all the other bartenders waiters housekeeping staff etc. 

Bad 
Someone said there is no AC inside and I understand why but it makes the place hugely uncomfortable when all you want to do is get a break from outside without being forced to your room. 

The tv has 2 English news channels not tv so no apps or streaming.  For a 5 star resort this should he a bare min to be a smart tv. 

After 8-9 there is absolutely nothing to do so you end up going to bed to watch the 2 channels or your personal devices. 

Main pool is about 5 feet deep all around ppl sat on the steps with little kids when they should have gone to the kids pool.  Bring a flotation device so you don’t get stuck buying one for $30usd. You can enjoy it unless you are tall or plan to swim non stop. 

Food
It was not 5 star resort food more like 4 with di much room for potential. Too many veggie dishes and lacks variety. Buffet closed 2 of 7 nights for dinner which was frustrating to rush to get a place at the à la carte before it booked up.

Overall it’s good for families and ppl looking to do nothing  all day and night.  There was no music by the pool u mess it was water aberbics when I asked why I was told mgmt wants to keep it quiet for families . What resort doesn’t play music at the main pool?  It’s a huge place than can accommodate everyone but why cater to just families?

I woudbt go bk due to the lack of any form of entertainment.

reviews.author: Jamie R
reviews.title: We can’t wait to go back!
reviews.text:
Our group had 12 people total made up of three families with quite a few small children. From the moment we arrived, Omar at reception made it very clear that they intended for us to have a wonderful vacation and if there were any issues at all, we should message them right away so they could fix it. This was extremely helpful because the resort app isn’t the best, so being able to communicate through WhatsApp made everything much easier. We were also upgraded to a room with an ocean view which was totally unexpected and appreciated! Whenever we had questions or something wasn’t quite right, staff handled it immediately.

The Mayan events were absolutely incredible; we attended a sunset energy ritual, cacao ceremony and the pre-Hispanic show. The individuals were so kind and took the time to explain the meaning behind all of the steps. 

The new water slides were perfect for our group of kids that were ages 6-9. The water slide pool is a little deep so kids that are not strong swimmers will likely need water wings or swim vest. Our kids went to the kid’s club and loved making a craft and the piñata - typically we do not put our kids in the kids club at any resort but felt safe enough to allow them to go at the Paradisus.

The staff throughout the entire resort were absolutely incredible. Someone was always offering to help when they walked by. 

The rooms were beautiful, with no musty smells or excess moisture. We didn’t need Damp Rid like we’ve had to use at other resorts. Every bathroom throughout the resort was SPOTLESS and smelled so clean. There was constantly someone cleaning and maintaining the bathrooms.

The customer service at this hotel was unlike anything we’ve ever experienced. These staff members truly made a huge impact on our vacation:

Jesus, Giovanni, and Marurico from the entertainment team were awesome. Jesus was especially incredible with our kids. He had so much patience while teaching us how to make dream catchers. After we mentioned we had missed a craft we were really looking forward to because the app listed the wrong time, he actually went out of his way to make sure we still got to do it. He also made sure we knew about all the fun activities so we wouldn’t miss anything. We were so glad we met him.

Guadeloupe, who worked by the kids’ pool, took care of us every day, remembered our favourite drinks, and genuinely made us feel looked after. Our kids adored her and were so sad to say goodbye.

Antonio at the bar near the snack bar was always making us laugh and checking to make sure we were enjoying our drinks.

Anahi, Rosalinda, Perla, and Norma at the ice cream/coffee bar were wonderful. They were amazing about checking ingredients so we knew which treats were safe for us to have.

A huge thank you Jesus who put us in touch with Diego and Adrianna who were wonderful and made sure our large group had restaurant reservations every night.

Jenny, our concierge, was always quick to answer questions and was especially helpful arranging late checkout.

Omar at reception answered every question we had during check-in and throughout the week whenever we saw him.

Armando at the Mexican restaurant was our favourite server of the entire trip. He was hilarious, made excellent food recommendations, and constantly checked to make sure we were enjoying our meals.

Nathaniel, the manager at the Mexican restaurant, bent over backwards to make sure our kids had meals they enjoyed and that they weren’t waiting too long for food.

Alonso, Alberto, and Antonio at the snack bar always checked ingredients for us and made our nachos exactly the way we liked them.

Rudolpho, Geraldo, Armando, and Candelario at the buffet always made sure we had a large enough table for our whole group. They also remembered that some of us couldn’t have dairy and consistently made sure almond milk was available for us, which was such a thoughtful touch.

This resort genuinely exceeded our expectations in every way. The cleanliness, customer service, attention to detail, and kindness from the staff made this one of the best vacations we’ve ever had

reviews.text:
What a fantastic hotel!! We came for 2weeks and stayed in the Reserve section, the staff were excellent and very very helpful, we were assigned a concierge Eduardo  for the duration. He was superb with daily WhatsApp messages informing us of activities and restaurant times and booking reservations when required. He really was a pleasure to know and provided us with invaluable information, muchas gracias Eduardo.  In the Reserve area there were plentiful sun lounges and Bali beds, Bali beds have to be reserved if you require one usually the day before. The assistants provide you with fresh towels for loungers and Bali beds, the assistants Horatio, Mikkele (Surfer) and Viktor were top class and assist you with anything you may need when staying by the pool, the waiters are always coming around the pool checking if you need drinks or to order food. The choice of restaurants were great with multiple cuisines. Kao and Blue Agarve were our favourites.  First time in Cancun and Paradisus was a fantastic choice of a hotel to stay in, we went Ocean fishing, visited isle of Mejeures, visited a Cenote and jet skied which were all booked at the hotel at a cost which was optional but well worth the money, especially the ocean fishing and Cenote. 
We would/will definitely go back and Cancun is truly gorgeous with excellent, very polite, respectful and hard working staff attending to your every need, muchas gracias Paradisus and see you soon !!!!!

reviews.text:
I took my wife on honeymoon to Paradisus Cancun in The Reserve section. 

I chose this hotel because of the pyramid structure, something that made it interesting and unique in a place where there are a variety of hotels... and make no mistake. Since we arrived my wife was speechless, I fell in love with the place. Fun fact the main structure, glass ceiling was inspired by a cenote.

Best service we received was that of our concierge named Sergio. He went above and beyond to meet, meet and exceed our expectations. I was always one step ahead. We loved the experience. Delicious restaurants and buffet. Thank you Sergio and those other employees who were kind to us.

reviews.author: Tyler D
reviews.title: Another Great Trip to Paradisus!
reviews.text:
Our fourth stay at Paradisus Cancun—and somehow it just keeps getting better.
We had an amazing time from start to finish. Having stayed here multiple times (including once on the Family Concierge side), we already had high expectations, and this trip absolutely delivered. The food was consistently very good, the rooms were comfortable and well-kept, and the overall atmosphere continues to strike that perfect balance between relaxing and upscale. But what truly sets this resort apart is the staff—they don’t just provide service, they create unforgettable experiences.
Galdino, our concierge, was exceptional. His attentiveness made the entire trip seamless and stress-free. He handled everything for us—restaurant reservations, Bali bed bookings, and regular check-ins throughout the day to make sure we had everything we needed. This isn’t our first time working with him, and honestly, he’s a big reason we keep coming back. We would only return if we knew we had him—he’s that good.
At Aqua Marina, Juan took great care of our family. He was friendly, attentive, and made every meal enjoyable. It’s service like his that turns a simple dinner into a memorable experience.
Mornings were always brightened by Alejandro and Perla at the café. Their warm welcome each day set the tone perfectly, and they made some of the best coffee we’ve had at any resort. You can tell they genuinely care about guests—it shows in every interaction.
By the pool, Rodrigo, Ana, and Guadalupe were incredible. They were constantly checking in, making sure we had drinks, and keeping the energy fun and relaxed. They made our pool days effortless and enjoyable.
And in the evenings, Flora at the Ginger Bar stood out. She and her team created such a welcoming atmosphere, and the drinks were fantastic. She was kind, engaging, and made everyone feel right at home.
Overall, this was another outstanding stay. We would highly recommend Paradisus Cancun—especially the Reserve side—for any family or couple looking for a relaxing, high-quality, and truly memorable vacation. The people here make all the difference, and it’s why we’ll keep coming back

reviews.title: Large property with many amenities but pushy sales model which becomes bothersome

Their staff members are very helpful, however, their new service model centered around the “Circle” membership creates frequent instances of members attempting to sell you their memberships. Nearly every hallway has team members stopping you and trying to sell you something. This did not occur nearly as often, if at all, last year. It made it hard to enjoy your vacation because of the frequent and constant conversations. There are a few good food options. Since they reopened just recently, we found they were out of many menu options and some restaurants were not operating during their listed hours, making it difficult to choose lunch/dinner.

reviews.author: Juakiii
reviews.title: Great experience, although with room for improvement in detail
reviews.text:
We spent some very pleasant days at Paradisus Cancun, with a staff that was truly exceptional. We want to highlight especially José May, our concierge at The Reserve, and David, in the pool area, who made us feel very well taken care of throughout the stay.

However, there were some details that did not live up to the level of the hotel or our expectations. The shower had problems from the start, and although a technician came to check it, it was not completely solved and we received no follow-up. The air conditioning was extremely noisy, which affected the rest.

One of the biggest disappointments was that we indicated on several occasions that we were celebrating our honeymoon (at pre-check-in, by mail and through a companion), but we did not receive any details or recognition. Paradisus asked if we were celebrating a special occasion, which made us expect a gesture that never came. In other hotels Meliá we have had it.

Finally, on the day of check-out we had difficulties: the shower was still not working well, there was no dryer, we requested it and it did not arrive. I had to go personally to reception, where at first they told me there was no reception, although eventually they did have one available.

Despite these drawbacks, we value the humane treatment and overall quality of the facilities. With better attention to detail and more proactive incident management, the experience could have been outstanding.

reviews.author: Monica M
reviews.title: Best resort EVER!
reviews.text: I cannot say enough good things about this resort. I don't have a single complaint about anything from service, to food etc. This was mine and my partners first time in Mexico and the staff made it such an amazing trip, we cannot wait to go back! We chose this resort for many reasons but one of many being the swim up bar that we never ended up using! Luis and Alejandro at the reserve bar as well as all the Sante staff, Gemma, Josue, Rigoberto,  Arnulfo and everyone took such great care of us we never left the reserve pool. Isaac set us up in a beautiful ocean view room and David was always setting us up with the best Bali beds. He and everyone worked tirelessly to ensure we had the absolute best stay. We were so impressed with absolutely everyones work ethic. Julio and everyone at the reserve lounge was phenomenal and so attentive to our needs we never left the reserve side. Felipe and Raul were so helpful with our luggage and shuttle, everything was handled with such care. Emmanuel went above and beyond to take care of us and helped my boyfriend plan the most magical private dinner on the beach. Abraham at Ginger lounge gave us the most informative and entertaining tequila tasting. Danny flow and Say made every day so fun and Danny made us laugh every time we got to see him. He and everyone helped make our trip so memorable that we cannot wait for the next trip to Paradisus! I wish I had gotten more names of everyone that helped us during our stay but we wish everyone luck during their renovations and we hope to see everyone back when we come again! Thank you Paradisus Cancun!!

reviews.author: Curious211401
reviews.title: Rodolfo is amazing
reviews.text:
As melia circle members it was a rough start to our vacation. The hotels room are old and outdated. Thank God for our concierge, Rodolfo he made sure we were put in a room that didn't make a Hotel 8 look good! Lomg story short they are closing for a well needed remodel so I wont dwell on and on about the poor room conditions.

The highlight of this resort is the service. I've been a founding member of Circle predominantly at grand cana and when other members told me about the service I had to go to see it to believe it. They were right. It's amazing. Every staff member from concierge to server to all support staff go the extra mile to make sure you are well taken care of.

The changes at the hotel I hope to see made are...
Room quality
Inconsistent experience poolside, one day beds are covered with circle linens other days none
Bathrooms by beach and pool area
Members section not on top of kids pool...which is closed multiple times daily because some kid pooped in the pool
An actual beach bar
Restroom maintenance 

What is perfect is the staff. Rodolfo from day one went above and beyond for us. Take good care of him! Every night was a culinary feast at every restaurant and the servers made sure you were treated like royalty. Thank you also to the Circle staff who took the time to make sure all of our expectations were met!

Thank you and we can't wait to see the remodel in 2026!

reviews.author: PickiTraveller
reviews.title: PickiTraveller REVIEW - Hi everyone :)  MISS YOU ALL !
reviews.text:
WAITERS / BARTENDERS / COFFEE BAR - I want to say - My Goodness these are the BEST PEOPLE at the hotel !!!

JORGE FROM LEMONFISH - Jorge greeted us with a SMILE.  Always asked if we had any allergies even though we went to eat there multiple times.  He made us feel welcome and comfortable for every meal he served us.  Jorge is quick on his feet, nice to talk to and very kind and warm.  He knows the ingredients of every single item on the menu, how Amazing !  When you get to LEMONFISH ASK FOR JORGE, THE WAITER !

ALEJANDRO (ALEX) FROM COFFEE BAR - Alex knew my special coffee order before I ordered it and called me by my name (same name as his mother's name).  Alex was so friendly and nice to talk to.  We shared some really great stories every morning at 8am.  He expected me there at least by 8am to serve me.  They have sandwiches for late night snack and coffee/tea needs.  AND THEY ARE OPEN 24 HOURS.  Keep up your friendly disposition, ALEX.  You are a great asset to the hotel.

SALVADOR BARTENDER GINGER BAR 1 - Made some awesome & unusual Drinks and Shots - thank you for our B52 shots, Salvador, and for your nice conversations at the restaurant one evening.  Salvador is an experienced bartender and knows what he is doing.  LOOK FOR SALVADOR - Salvador is the bars and bar restaurants.

AMAYRANI (AMY) MY HOSTESS MALVA BUFFET - Daily greetings from AMY saying my name was a special touch from her (she only saw me 1x and remembered my name the whole time I was there).  It was a great start to my day seeing her cheerful face, that I looked forward to eating there.   She made my mornings bright.  LOOK FOR AMY WHEN YOU CHECK IN TO MALVA.

RAFAEL MY WAITER MALVA BUFFET - Always had my sparkling drink ready at my table after I got my morning omelette.  RAFAEL IS A HARD WORKER AT MALVA.  

DINO & GLADYS FROM GINGER BAR 1 - DINO BARTENDER was always nice to us and served us our special cocktails.  GLADYS was helpful and friendly.

KARINA & ABRAHAM from GINGER BAR 2 - KARINA is one of the first people we met at any of the Bars.  Always friendly and remembered our drinks day after day.  Our glass was never empty.  Karina, thank you for helping with the birthday celebration.  Abraham was helpful and friendly.  When you get to GINGER BAR 2 ASK FOR KARINA.  

GUADENCIO BEACH WAITER - Had a very unique whistle and made my time at the beach very pleasant.  You always knew when he was coming around when you heard his distinctive whistle.

I LOVE YOU ALL AND BEST OF LUCK TO YOU.  I TRULY HOPE TO SEE YOU ALL IN CANCUN AGAIN SOON.  YOUR FRIEND FOREVER,      💕  PICKITRAVELLER. 💕

I have posted pictures of everyone I spoke about here.  We left the resort on May 10, 2025.

ROOM - We were enjoying the room lagoon view until the Monday (our 3rd day), Construction going on in the room above us.  I complained 3 times during the week  about the dust, cement and plaster all over our balcony and chairs which made the balcony ABSOLUTELY USELESS.  The construction continued in the room above during our entire vacation.  We didn't have water one afternoon when we went to the room at 3pm !  They didn't notify us of our water shutdown, no tub, sink, toilet water.  We had to walk to the front desk because our phone was not working.  The multiple visits to the front desk took time away from our precious vacation in paradise.

Our ROOM faced the Front of the hotel view which is passed the parking lot with lagoon in the distance which was not a big deal - beautiful sunsets from this side not on the ocean side.  Pretty quiet during the day; however, far in the distance you can hear the pumping of the music from the disco in the distance at 2am onwards.  If you put the air conditioner on at full speed at night it drowns out the sound, somewhat.

HALLWAYS - Room service delivery food trays all around the floor of various rooms with fleas on them.  They are left there for multiple days and nobody removes them.  We had to let the front desk know multiple times.  The hotel is HUUUGE but this doesn't excuse the unsanitary conditions.

FOOD / ALL INCLUSIVE - Very different choices from buffet to mediterranean to italian to asian.  Great tasty food, lots of deserts and fruits and salads.   
LOBSTER IS NOT included in the All-Inclusive Plan. 
Top Shelf and certain cocktails ARE NOT included in the All-Inclusive Plan.

BALI BEDS - You cannot use them unless you pay $250 per day.  You get 1 Lobster with purchase of a Bali Bed.  

STAIRS - Stairs everywhere !  Inside and Outside.  Stairs leading to the pool, stairs leading to the beach.

BEACH - SPARKLING TURQUOISE WATER !

I won't be coming back to this hotel unfortunately, although we made some really good friends with the waiters, bartenders and coffee team and would love to see them all again.  They will all be displaced due to the CLOSING of the hotel on June 1, 2025 due to major hotel renovations.  Some of the staff will be moved to other Melia hotels but most chose to look for jobs elsewhere.     So sad :(

reviews.author: Ethan H
reviews.title: Amazing Resort, Not so great food
reviews.text:
My wife and I went to Paradisus to celebrate our honeymoon immediately after getting married. My wife had visited every year up until COVID hit for 7 years, so she knew the ins and outs of the resort and her recommendation is why we went. We stayed in the adults-only "Reserve" and the experience was so peaceful and relaxing. 

The room was amazing. We had our own private balcony and there was a very large bath tub with a view out to the balcony. As with most hotels and resorts, the pillows were not the best and left my neck hurting in the morning.

The Reserve itself was very quiet and peaceful. We spent most mornings eating at the Atrium as it was the best option for breakfast (and honestly any food, more on that later) and very relaxing. The Reserve also includes an Adults only pool and this is where we spent most of our week. Two Bali-Bed reservations are included at the reserve, with a waitlist available afterwards, but it was so light when we went that we were able to secure one every day. The drinks were great and many of the servers were a delight to talk with.

We had the all inclusive package but we did spring for two upgrades. We got a couple's massage while we were there which ran us about $350 USD. It was very relaxing and absolutely worth it. We also did a 20-30min photo shoot with one of the onsite photographers. He was very professional and really knew how to pose us! I've attached a few of those photos to this review. The photo session itself was free but they charge per photo + have some bundles. They told us it was $20 per photo we liked but we ended up liking around 25-30, so we got a bundle that ended up around $400. We got the digital photos and a physical photo book that we took home with us. With how good the photos came out, it was absolutely worth it to us, especially to not have to worry about taking our own photos.

We had such a great time all around... except for the food. If the food had been better I'd rate it 5 stars. Unfortunately, while there were a few good eats here and there, we were left constantly disappointed with the quality of the food. This is especially upsetting considering my wife's favorite thing about this resort for the 7 years she'd come here was how good the food was. One day she even got either a stomach bug or food poisoning from drinking the coffee, which lasted about two days. We'd order off their menus and the items we received would be completely different. The best example of this was when we ordered a "Pretzel Dog" off the room service menu, which was listed as coming with a pretzel bun, caramelized onions, and a few other toppings. When it arrived it was just a plain old hot dog with no toppings and no special bun. Most of the food we ordered was either like that, or it was just not very tasty. If you're looking for the best spots to eat at, we enjoyed the pizza by the pool, the breakfast at the atrium in the reserve, and the sushi at Lemonfish.

My hope is that this was just an off week for them. We were told we were one of the last groups staying at the resort before it shuts down for a year for renovations. My hunch is that they were just trying to get through the last renovations before closing and either didn't care too much about the food quality or decided not to reorder ingredients as they ran out. 

We'd love to stay there again in a few years, but we'll be waiting to see reviews from others after the renovations to make sure the food gets better.

reviews.author: Milena D
reviews.title: Real evaluation
reviews.text:
My mother and I stayed for 14 days at Paradisus Cancun. I want to be fair in this assessment because I believe everyone here needs a true report!
The hotel is beautiful and huge, lots of pools, the beach in front is beautiful, lots of good food and drinks at will! 
I hosted through RCI, but what does that mean? Means that I paid monthly 1000,00 reais and more 150,00 of condominium to be entitled to RCI for nine years until I am exempt and only have to pay condominium. When I stay at a resort I pay a better value for accommodation but the all inclusive is at the normal value!
What I will report here is not a problem related to hosting but something that affects our dignity as people.
If you are American your treatment will be amazing, will take all kinds of foods and drinks at any time, you will be treated respectfully and priority after all 1 weight equals 0.05 dollars!!!! Yeah, very sad! American loves fun in Mexico after all is very cheap!!!!! 
If you are Mexican you will be treated well, of course not like the Americans, but the equals recognize and in a hotel like this has to be a Mexican with money!
Well, about us Brazilians, who spend our sweaty money, yes sweaty because $1,00 is equivalent to $6,00. We are treated with prejudice, yes, we will wait longer to enter one of the restaurants for dinner, will underestimate any lost objects our, even if it is related to health, you will not have the rewards of the Americans no, you can forget, they are priority after all their money is worth more! At dinner at the same time that an American ordered a plate, for us the kitchen is closing!
Mexicans would surely be treated respectfully in our country, now in the US are not very welcome...
As far as I know and despite moving to the economy, they are not welcome!
It's really a pity and I say more our money is worth more work, more effort and more sacrifice! 
Hotel with excellent structure but leaves to be desired in the dignity of Latin Americans! 
We should have more empathy after all we suffer the same evil!

reviews.text: The services included in The reserve option are worth hiring. The exclusive adults only The reserve is unique. A 10 for David, the pool conceives of The Reserve pool, which pampers you with attentions every moment. In addition, you can easily and easily order lunch from the Balinese bed using a QR code. The The reserve room is premium, with all amenities. The exclusive restaurant The reserve Santé is excellent for breakfast, lunch and dinner. The Sal restaurant is very good too, and also includes a visit for being a guest The reserve. Of the restaurants in the general hotel, Aquamarina leaves a lot to be desired, they put a mulled rice that was pure flavorless water, and the service of the waiters was bad, restaurant heaven acceptable and restaurant Lemon Fish approved. reviews.author: Janice N
reviews.title: Stunning sea and relaxing trip
reviews.text:
We travelled in March and stayed in the reserve. Our concierge was ok. I had done quite a bit of research and felt like I was highlighting my benefits then he would book them. 
The atrium was a lovely place to chill, get a drink, coffee, snack and breakfast away from crowds. 
Buffet was ok especially if you had something from the grill where they were cooking. Disappointed with the deserts. 
Not keen on the Italian but the other restaurants were good. I really enjoyed flora and lemon fish. 
I would love to see an actual bar/cocktail menu.  Don’t get me wrong, you could pretty much have what you wanted but I like to choose from a menu to see what I like the sounds of. 
Beach was stunning. The sea was quite rough but I like jumping over waves. No seaweed to mention when we were there. 
Entertainment I felt was quite poor and activities weren’t always when they said. We loved the yoga in the mornings. 
It was easy to get the bus along to the main tourist point but enjoyed being in a hotel that had huge grounds. 
In the reserve area you could pretty much get a lounger most times and the Bali beds were a nice little bonus, however the food ordered to our bed was awful so we went to get food after the first attempt. 
Generally a really lovely and relaxing holiday.

reviews.author: Natalia
reviews.title: Skip this place
reviews.text:
I wouldn't recommend Paradisus Cancun. Having stayed at their Playa del Carmen branch, I found it to be vastly superior in terms of room amenities, treatment, and professionalism.

To start, upon arrival, I had a birthday room upgrade, but Enrique tried to charge me extra despite the promotion clearly stating the upgrade was at no additional cost. The manager, David, claimed it was subject to availability and couldn't accommodate the upgrade, even though two members of my party received upgrades without any vouchers, both before and after my check-in. The lack of professionalism was evident throughout.

A few days later, my sister had a major slip and fall due to a leak from the roof. Overall, it was an unpleasant stay, and I won't be returning to the Paradisus Cancun location.

reviews.author: Fiza A
reviews.title: PARIDISUS CANCUN WORST RESORT!!!
reviews.text: Paradisus resort has provided us with an incredibly disappointing experience. Upon arrival, I immediately wanted to leave. Despite booking a reserved adults-only room with Priceline, which included access to various restaurants, the receptionist informed us that only the basic all-inclusive package was available. The room was subpar, and the service was atrocious. We were unable to take advantage of the promised deals to explore the hotel fully. Furthermore, we were charged for an upgrade to an adults-only room that we never received. Despite spending hours speaking with the receptionist and their team, no resolution was reached. They were uncooperative, refusing to let me speak with the manager or provide any assistance. There was no refund offered for the upgrade fee. After spending eight hours on the phone with Priceline, the issue remains unresolved, with no guarantee of a refund. We feel trapped in this hotel with our issues unresolved, which is incredibly frustrating and has ruined our vacation experience. The staff's rudeness and lack of concern for customer comfort only exacerbated the situation. I suspect they are intentionally misleading us, even claiming that we booked through Expedia despite our reservations being made through Priceline. They continue to deny this, even after Priceline confirmed our booking. I strongly advise against staying at this resort if you desire decent service.
