Knowing that everything was taken care of allowed us to  be present and enjoy our day to the fullest. We were very pleasantly surprised t come back to several little wedding surprises in our room throughout our stay.

We spent the rest of the time ("our honeymoon") relaxing at the resort. We booked an oceanfront room in the Reserve. The resort itself is beautiful and has such a unique and calming look with all the indoor plants and the gentle music playing everywhere.  The food and drink selection is beyond anything we have seen at any other resorts. We loved the steakhouse. It is definitely a cuisinary experience and we thank Roger for his wonderful service. We loved that there were so many pools both in the quiet area of the Reserve and also in the main area where it was a more lively atmosphere.  We also loved relaxing in our cabana for the day in the Reserve area and wanted to give a special shoutout to Miguel for taking care of us and bringing us water/drinks without us even having to ask. 

Overall, it was the perfect stay and we can't wait to come back!

reviews.author: wendy96boop
reviews.title: Excellent team and the hotel is beautiful, all the staff very friendly and the food very delicious. I was very satisfied
reviews.text: I recommend spending an unforgettable vacation there, everything is very beautiful and excellent service from all the staff.

reviews.author: Jonathan N
reviews.title: Pleasant experience
reviews.text: Francisco, the waiter at Lemon Fish, very attentive and pleasant, super efficient, the food was delicious, gourmet and well cooked, I would return again to have this new experience, all the food was exquisite, thank you for the good service and your kindness

reviews.author: Climber54467246993
reviews.title: Francisco the best
reviews.text: Francisco from Lemon Fish was very attentive to us from the moment we arrived, he made us feel very good, in the same way his energy was very good since he was always available for us and everything was very fast ñ, the experience was unique, I would return for the

reviews.author: Alejandro C
reviews.title: Excellent dinner
reviews.text: The best thanks to Francisco, he did a great job with the photos and. Videos and he was always taking care of us, he is a good Appe, he will know what I am talking about. Thank you for that fun night, he is a crack......see you next year, gentlemen, greetings

reviews.author: Yessica X
reviews.title: Good experience. 🤩
reviews.text:
It was a good experience in the restaurant, the waiter Francisco has been very friendly and attentive in everything. 
10/10 to the dishes. 
The dish of the night was the green shrimp aguachile, a delight on the menu. 
Good dinner at Lemon Fish restaurant, I highly recommend it

reviews.author: ashley m
reviews.title: Amazing family vacay
reviews.text: We booked a family trip here for a week! To our surprise we were upgraded at check in and Rocio was our concierge she was amazing! Very attentive and helpful! 10/10 recommend this hotel. They surprised our room with a gesture for my niece and champagne for us! I will definitely return

reviews.author: miguelfajita
reviews.title: Paradisus Family Vacation
reviews.text: Our trip to Paradisus Cancun was splendid, thanks to the excellent service of our concierge Rocio! She was always very attentive and cordial with our family. We went for my father-in-law's birthday and we all had a great time. Thank you Rocio for everything!! Super recommended!

reviews.author: Dan A
reviews.title: Another good vacation
reviews.text: As returning customers, we were once again pleased with the excellent service provided by Paradisus's staff. Our concierge, Stelian Sandu, was extremely helpful and assisted us with all our needs during the stay. We were not very impressed by the Mediterranean restaurant. Sal, the stake house, was exceptional and the staff there extremely professional. Excellent choice of superior drinks at all the bars across the property. The adult only area is very quiet and relaxing.

reviews.author: Robert A
reviews.title: MELIÁ Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: I so very much wanted to write a good review but my conscious dictated otherwise. The flight there and back was almost perfect, including customs. When we arrived at the hotel, we were greeted and escorted to registration.  That’s when the nightmare began, 2+ hours registering 3 couples in 3 different rooms. The registration person and her manager has zero customer service skills and have poor English skills. Once you get to your room, you can see the resort is old and needs updating/repairs.  The highlight of each was our server, Martine, in the Malva buffet. The buffet was okay but continuously ran out of different offerings. Onto the pool for a few hours, we stayed in the same area most days and our server was Didi, who was awesome. The only issue we had was they would run out of different alcohols and nothing was top shelf, unless you paid extra.  Once it was time for dinner, that was the disturbing part of the day. Each restaurant we visited, no matter what time, always had a 30 - 90 minute wait, unless of course you pulled out a $20 bill and then you had the next table, we did that twice. The food at the restaurants was typical buffet food, absolutely nothing special. The best 2 restaurants being Lemon Fish and Blue Agave. Capella was a close 3rd choice. We did go off property to eat 1 night at Harry’s Steakhouse, which was awesome, $1,185 plus a 20% tip for a family of 8, including drinks and dessert. Highly recommend Harry’s Steakhouse. The nightly entertainment was cute for the kids and we enjoyed the positivity of the entertainers. As fir cocktails, unless you gave the bartender a $50 tip to start out, you waited for drinks and couldn’t get top shelf alcohol, plus there is such inconsistency between the bars in how drinks were made. I can honestly say the best part of our stay at Paradisus is when we left. This is not a 5 star resort but charge as if they are a 5 star resort. They’re more like a 3 star resort. Will we ever go back to Paradisus, no we will not. All 3 couple felt the same way. Sorry MELIÁ Paradisus  Cancún, but you are losing customers for life. Instead will will stay at a hotel over on Isla Mujeres.

reviews.author: monica v
reviews.title: The best: the KIDSDOM
reviews.text:
The KIDSDOM is my children's favorite place!! We love the activities but above all the team that is in charge of our children🫶🏻 

We had the opportunity to share with all the KIDSDOM staff and we want to congratulate them for such a beautiful work, my children have grown up with them:

Bruno 
Blue
Nabi
Yamileth
monse
Gove
Ireland 

Thank you for so much laughter and fun, you are one of the reasons why we choose to visit this hotel every time ♥️

reviews.author: Marianne Grace G
reviews.title: Unforgettable relaxing experience
reviews.text: Loved the resort especially after being spoiled by our concierge Juan, the view in our room was spectacular. Definitely enjoyed our time at this resort. The food and service were all good. All the staff were very accommodating and friendly. They kept our room always clean. They even surprised us with champagne and desserts for our anniversary. I highly recommend this place.

reviews.author: Lisbeth N
reviews.title: The best resort I’ve ever been to.
reviews.text:
My fiancé and I have the pleasure of having our honeymoon in Paradisus resort, and it was the best decision we made. From the moment you walk in the beautiful smell and scenery is breathtaking. The staff is extremely welcoming from the beginning. We got to meet our amazing concierge Rocio, who helped us out so much throughout everything. 

The entire week we were there the food was incredibly phenomenal. Even the room service. All of the drinks were amazing. 

The beach is one of the most beautiful I’ve ever seen. Clear blue water and fun waves. Even at the beach they are servers who bring you your favorite snacks and drinks. At the beach we got to meet the amazing Guadencio who we became friends with quickly. Such An amazing person who helped us out a lot at the beach. 

We did have a small problem with the air conditioning leaking water in our room, but as soon as we informed them, they immediately tried to fix it and since they couldn’t they then transferred us to a better room. I can’t emphasize how nice all of the stuff is. When we checked in, our room was running a couple of minutes behind and because of that, they granted as an additional hour for check out. That was so sweet and not even needed. 

The resort has so many delicious restaurants with amazing servers. 

Since it is the very hot month of May, the rooms/ resort isn’t as cool as we prefer, but we requested a fan and they immediately brought one to us which helped keep the room extra cool at night. 

Please don’t hesitate on booking. Can’t wait to visit again.

reviews.author: Shiv Panda
reviews.title: Extremely Disappointing!
reviews.text:
I’m writing this review in the middle of my vacation at Cancun and at Paradisus Cancun. It’s been disappointing so far. 

1) They really need to find a solution to the extreme heat and sweat one encounters in their lobby. There are NO air conditioners there and honestly it makes it really difficult to even wait in the lobby beyond 15-20 minutes. The only areas where you would see the air conditioners working are the small area wherein you “check in”. Again, this place is very crowded most of the time and small.

2) The folks at the checkin/guest desk need to be sensitized in terms of how to deal with hotel guests who do not speak Spanish. I’m not saying they are rude but then there were many issues when we checked in. We were not told which floor are our rooms. The entire hotel map is very confusing. The rooms elevators are very slow and few and it took us almost 30 plus minutes to find our room with all of our bags. Remember, one cannot use the elevators to go to our rooms (rooms are 30xx series for us). 

3) The mens restroom near the checkin was broken and there was no water. I had to complain to couple of folks and I’m not sure if it was repaired or not?

4) Food - Overall, we have found the food to be very average. There are hardly any options for folks who don’t eat meat. Also, no Asian or Indian food selections in Malva (their buffet restaurant) makes it very difficult for folks like us. I’m sincerely hoping the hotel management takes this feedback into consideration and plans a really diverse cuisine experience.

5) The rooms are outdated in my opinion and I was probably given the worst rooms they had. Remember, I had booked 3 junior suites and there is no resort view or anything from these rooms. The AC stops and starts every 15-20 minutes and it is very annoying and does not allow for a peaceful sleep at night. I even told them that I’m a returning a customer having stayed at their sister property at Punta Cana but to no avail. 

Advice to management - please really start implementing the feedback that travelers share with you.

reviews.author: Battler V
reviews.title: Vacation fatigue
reviews.text: "Vacationing" in this hotel was an agony for us. The hotel itself and its view from inside is impressive at first, but its enormity completely destroys convenience. You must go down and up the floors to get to the restaurants. Only one floor has a through passageway. All others are confined to their "pyramid." The hotel looks powerful, but it is very outdated regarding equipment and technical support: ventilation is noisy, the refrigerator whistles, ventilation in the toilet is broken and does not work, ventilation is not adjusted and in one room is cold, in the other hot. As for service, everything is according to Mexican traditions, which is not a superclass. Restaurants are quite normal. Swimming in the sea was impossible: waves and loose sand. But the pool is really beautiful. The general impression is as follows: we "struggled" with the circumstances of the enormity of the hotel, and departure from the hotel was the most desirable event.

reviews.author: Pratyush S
reviews.title: Excellent resort for a getaway with friends or family
reviews.text: Great hotel and great service. Loved the beach views and the excellent food and drinks. Our concierge Lili was excellent and very helpful and accommodating. The pool side cabanas were excellent and the staff was very friendly. Would visit again 10/10

reviews.author: Heather M
reviews.title: Can't wait for next time!!!! 😀 🌴  ⛱️
reviews.text:
My husband and I celebrated our anniversary for 5 nights at the Paradisus Cancun in the Reserve adults only area.  

Our stay was absolutely amazing!  From the moment we stepped off our transportation bus we were greeted by friendly staff and offered a ice cold drink.  We walked inside and were in ahhh at the beauty of all the greenery draped and hanging throughout the entire resort.  It was absolutely stunning at every turn!   This place was meticulously maintained and well kept.  I took so many pictures of the beauty.  

Lily Morales our concierge:
We were then introduced to Lily Morales, our concierge.  She immediately gave us a warm welcoming and made us feel like family.  Lily was always very responsive through the WhatsApp and would also check in with us regularly, even when she was off work.  My husband and I felt our trip wouldn't have been the same without her.  Lily made our time special by creating beautiful surprises in our room to make our anniversary wonderful and romantic with rose petals, balloons, champagne, wine and delcious snacks throughout our stay.  She also, helped plan our days so we were able to get the most out of our stay.  Thank you Lily for everything!  You were incredible and we hope to see you again next time!  :) 

Spa:
We also had the absolute best couples massage by the talented Lenore and Gabriela (I may have the names wrong,  sorry! ).  

Pool Bar and Sante Staff:
The bar tender at the Reserve pool bar was also so friendly, funny and just awesome with our drinks and made our stay so fun (I wish I remembered his name, I'm sorry!).  Josue and Luis at the Reserve pool area were also so nice and always on top of everything to make us feel welcome, comfortable and never without drinks or food.  

Reserve Cafe:
All the workers inside the Reserve Nespresso cafe/ restaurant were the best as well!  Next time I'll collect names!  Again, we apologize for not remembering all the wonderful staff names!  

Food:
Food was delcious at all restaurants for the most part especially the room service!  Occasionally we would get a meal or something we didn't quite like but we were impressed with all the food for the majority of our stay.

Next trip:
We are already looking forward to our next stay at the Paradisus Cancun.  If you are traveling with only adults, we highly recommend the Reserve (there VIP/upgraded room section)!  It's totally worth the extra cost! 

Recommendations:
Stay in the Reserve, ocean view!  Be sure you book your cabanas and excursions as soon as your arrive.  We definitely recommend the Chichen Itza/cenote/lunch tour!  Food was delcious, the experience was amazing!  The tacos at the Blue Agave were on point!  Similar to tacos in california 😋.  Book the Sals Restaurant right when you arrive, it's free for one dinner for Reserve customers which was awesome!  Oh and the entertainment was spectacular and awesome!  Don't forget to get a list of all the performers and events!  So cool! 

Cons: 
We could hardly think of a con besides when we would request towels and water.  Sometimes they wouldn't replenish our water which we went through quickly between brushing our teeth and staying hydrated.  We would always need more towels since we are always showering after beach and pool time.  The towels sometimes took hours or didn't come until we called again.  Also, we could never seem to find an available pool lounge chair.  Now we know that they must be reserved for the day early in the morning but Lily, our concierge assisted us with this.  

These cons will not deter us from returning, just something that can be improved.  
We loved this vacation and didn't want to leave!  See you soon Paradisus Cancun!!! 😊 

Below is a photo of the view from our room.

reviews.author: Lakshmi P
reviews.title: Awesome experience
reviews.text: This is our second time to stay in Paradisus Cancun. Kids were so excoted to viait thos place again. Service in Paradisus cancun is exceptional. Kids loved the activities in kidsdom. Gorgeous view from room. Delicious  food and beverages. Awesome amenities. What else do we need for a perfect vacation. 👌

reviews.author: brunonn2024
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: It's not even close to being 5 stars. Deplorable quality of service, food, rooms and opening hours.

reviews.author: Andrés W
reviews.title: First Disappointment in the Melia service
reviews.text:
I'll start with the positive things, the very good treatment and attention received by my son at Kidsdom, especially by Yami, Monse and Gove, thanks to that my son had a good stay at the hotel. In the Sport bar the attention of Cristian, Karina and Gladys and in the Malva restaurant the attention of Ramiro.
The negative ones 
With the exception of the good attention received mentioned above, in general the attention of the other hotel collaborators was not good.
Little variety of food at the Malva buffet where also at breakfast it took them a while to replenish the breads, fruits, cheeses and so on, only one island worked for the preparation of omelettes and eggs so one could lose 15 minutes in line .
 In the area of the beach where the lounge chairs are near the Kanna, there was never a waiter to serve us, since the times I went to the bar there were a large number but they only served the kamastros.
First hotel I've been to that can offer alcoholic beverages until 11am, I don't know the reason.

reviews.author: Laura D
reviews.title: Simply the best
reviews.text: This has become “our place” to go. Great food, drinks and entertainment. We love everything about this place!! Special shout out to Oscar!! He was so amazing and accommodating. He even got the bartender to make us pineapple monkeys. Moises was also so good to us. I cannot say enough good things about these two men and the rest of the staff at this resort. All so great! This is our go to place. We are going back next month for my husbands retirement and will be there again next year for my sons High School graduation trip.

reviews.author: arassonia
reviews.title: Room reservation and accommodation
reviews.text: I suggest you comply with the reservation contract. And, do not try to exempt yourself from responsibility. In other words, if when making a reservation I chose 1 room with 2 double beds, I want the room with these accommodations. There is no coffee maker in the room.

reviews.author: Francisco Israe... G
reviews.title: Family holidays
reviews.text: Excellent treatment from the Beach service in the lounge area of Mr. Javier and on the last day of our Mallavirous stay the attention of Mitchel was also very attentive and helpful. Congratulations to both of us. If we return we want to be attended to by them. Thank you for everything. See you soon.

reviews.author: Leslie E
reviews.title: Highly recommend! Great birthday getaway!
reviews.text:
We had a great time staying at the Paradisus Cancun! We booked a room at The Reserve, which is for adults only. The lobby/lounge is colder and definitely relaxing. Our room was turned down every night and the mini bar was always replenished. The check in was easy, we arrived around 9am and we were starving, but the lady who checked us in made it quick, nice and informative. 

We had breakfast at Malve every morning and it was such a nice spread! This buffet restaurant was complete and the servers were all kind and attentive. We also got to experience Lemonfish and SAL, which were all great restaurants too! Service was impeccable and the food was delicious! Ignacio from SAL was so kind and welcoming. The espresso martini at the SAL was amazing! 

The pool attendant Nicole made sure we had a reservation for our own cabana! Its free for Reserve guests, but booking in advanced is recommended and if you don’t have a booking its first come first served (which we tried on our first day and failed. So TIP: book it in advance!) 

As a Reserve guest you also get your own concierge! Violeta was beyond amazing! She is responsive and made sure we were having a great time! She was constantly checking on us to see if we need anything else. She booked our complimentary destination inclusive boat ride. It was a relaxing ride around the lagoon and mangroves. Other than that, Violeta was our go to person for almost everything! 

There was entertainment at the resort, which my husband and I enjoyed watching! The live band on May 19th were great! Also the African show were so fun to watch! It was like a circus but funnier. 

The only comment we have is that the lobby and some hallways were a bit hot, like there was no or limited ventilation. But all in all - We really enjoyed our stay and we recommend this resort!

reviews.author: javeirasmin
reviews.title: oustanding stay at the resevre
reviews.text:
We are incredibly grateful for the exceptional service we received. The staff truly went above and beyond to ensure we have a great experience, and it was ruly unforgettable
A special shoutout to Victor and Nicole, who were absolutely phenomenal at the pool. Luis, Axel, and Nataniel were also outstanding, providing top-notch service and always greeting us with smiles, Moises, thank you for the dance moves.

We were also thrilled to meet Ataury, what a champ. It’s clear that everyone at The Reserve area loves what they do, and their enthusiasm truly enhanced our stay. The entire team was exceptional.
The facilities were superb. The sunset view from our room was breathtaking and a highlight of our trip.

While our overall experience was fantastic, there were a couple of minor hiccups. The heat was intense at some of the restaurants, making it a bit uncomfortable at times. Additionally, we had some difficulty getting the temperature in our room to our preferred level.

reviews.author: Ron B
reviews.title: Paradisus experience
reviews.text: The hotel was great we loved the view, our pool side service (DIDIER) was excellent with his customer service. He displayed good positive vive and made our stay even better thank you. And also Daniel pizza was very good. We love the shows and the beach

reviews.author: Maicon Felipe R
reviews.title: Photos at Hotel Paradisus
reviews.text: Outdoors Photo Family's photography services are of very good quality. Excellent service from Oscar Longoria and Daniel, and the photographer Elvia. I highly recommend it.  Very good quality, they were attentive and didn't help during the photo shoot. Thank you all.

reviews.author: Paula J
reviews.title: Nice hotel but could use some updating in the rooms
reviews.text: The resort is quite nice. I do love the vines hanging in the interior. I know they have been renovating the hotel and the rooms. Unfortunately we were in a room that wasn't renovated. Most of the plugs didn't work so it was difficult to charge our devices (we had to do some work while at the resort so devices were vital). Having said that the wifi worked well enough to run Zoom meetings so that was great! They were willing to move us but we decided to stay given the proximity to the pool. The staff were excellent - most were very friendly and genuinely wanted to make your stay memorable. I wish I wrote down the names of some of my favourites. There was one woman who seemed to be hosting at whatever restaurant we went to. She remembered that I was vegan which I honestly appreciated. Also, the server at lemon fish brought us our wine in an ice bucket and included two Coors Light as he remembered one of our party of four liked to drink it. He was great! He also brought us fries even though they weren't on the menu...so fun! The food I ate there (vegan sushi) was excellent! The food was was very good overall. I found something I could eat at every restaurant we tried. There was a separate vegan/ vegetarian menu at each place. There were a few times when the menu item was mislabelled as vegan when it contained cheese but overall I think they did a great job of catering to vegans. My only "complaint" was the buffet. I really wish there were some more options. The food I ate was good but a bit repetitive. Maybe a vegan burger for the grill or vegan cheese for the pizza bar (by the pool)? That would be amazing! I know we are in the minority and I really appreciate the effort made to include my preferences. I can't believe how deep the pools are and how warm. I loved it! I have found at other resorts that the pools are shallow and on the cold side. These were anything but! The property was under capacity but I still found that there were not enough loungers and not enough shade. Many of the loungers were also not working entirely - they did not allow for various settings - sitting upright or partially down etc. I do wish there were more swim up bars. I like to be in the quieter area and found that getting a drink was a bit cumbersome. The servers were great but sometimes I like to go up to the bar itself and check out what they have but I didn't like going into the restaurant to do so.

reviews.author: Kathy L
reviews.title: Love Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: 2nd time to Paradisus Cancún.  Always love it.  We enjoyed the Reserve with LALO as our concierge.  He is GREAT!!!   Our favorite restaurants were Malva with the buffet.  Always plenty of great choices for all 3 meals.  Eat breakfast on the terrace with the guys who help you out there.  We love them.  Also Blue Agave is our other favorite with. the best tacos.  Beware not all restaurants are open every day. However there are plenty of places to eat.  Pools are fabulous and the pool bartenders are great.  My mom is in an electric scooter and we can get all over the property.  We will go again

reviews.author: Jenna G
reviews.title: I just don’t know.. I’m speechless
reviews.text:
I contemplated writing a review but I wouldn’t want anybody to experience what I did.
Pros - Lily, she is one of the most accommodating and responsive associates I came across here. She is the reason why I didn’t leave on my second day here.
The food is okay, it’s not terrible.
The beach area is beyond kept and beautiful, the waves are rough here though so if you like to swim at the beach then this isn’t for you.
Amenities are good
The smell of the reserve area was everything
The sunset cruise was included free of charge
This hotel is aesthetically gorgeous.
Cons -
We arrived early to check in (11a) and were told to wait 4 hours for our room…… requested a Manager and never talked to one, I practically had to get up and find one… never found one, I then met Lily and expressed my concern.
The quality of food and food options.
There are up charges all throughout the hotel which negatively impacted my experience. We were incorrectly charged for 2 drinks at Cielo, which was about $55. (Picture below)
The staff basically ignored us at the pool area
The pool is very WARM and low in elevation
The drinks are not top shelf, just full of sugar. They have bars with top shelf but will charge you about $20 per shot. They have coconuts at the Beach and charge you $10 for these and only have coconut water????
My room was so HOT (80°F precisely), we called on maintenance 4 times throughout our stay and had to request fans. We couldn’t even leave our window open.
The property could use updating
The adults steakhouse has minimal options with subpar food, the best food was honestly the pool restaurant and Mexican.
There is no beach attendant??
They advertised cabanas to be included with The Reserve but this solely means pool cabanas and They must be reserved 24 hours in advance, the beach view are $160 and you have to buy a food package… at a resort?? ALSO they have 6 whole chairs that lay flat for tanning, the rest are permanently adjusted at an angle.
The towels in the bathroom are ROUGH
Oh, also transportation is not included as advertised on their website so expect $100+
There was an issue also with my room upgrade, I requested and paid for an ocean view with 2 beds. I was then emailed and quoted a lower price by their in house reservation team and they did not offer a refund or credit for the difference I paid.. instead I was charged for the upgrade a second time upon checking Out and They practically held us and held our transportation until this was resolved. I showed the emails, receipts, and conversation but was treated less than human.
I mean I could go on for days.
Overall, I would not stay here again or recommend it. There are hotels that check boxes of all necessities needed to enjoy your stay. (This is coming from someone who’s traveled to Mexico over 20 times). Expect a bill at check out… even though this is a all inclusive resort.

reviews.author: srbmbenito
reviews.title: Excellent hotel
reviews.text: Excellent hotel, good facilities, impeccable restaurants and excellent seasoning, very friendly waiters.

reviews.author: tomasrollan
reviews.title: A heavenly place to return to!!
reviews.text:
Incredible ten nights. From Violeta and the entire team at The Reserve who helped me make the marriage proposal to my girlfriend unforgettable. I was initially going to do it with them but two days before arriving they told me that they had stopped working with the supplier. Luckily I was able to find external suppliers but the hotel wanted to charge me but Violeta recognized that they had failed and made things easier for me so as not to pay any extra charge. Thanks Violeta!
Santi, Yamileth and Ireland as entertainment, the Mexican food restaurants with Chef David at the helm, the waiters Lucas (Blue Agave), Bernardo and Jony from the buffet always so cordial. We will definitely go back!! The attention, facilities and food are of the highest level!!!
I would also like to highlight the catamaran experience and the extraordinary attention of the ENTIRE Santé team. Diego, Javier, Lucas, Cesar, Moises, Oscar, Saul, Luis, Joel and the kitchen team that we couldn't meet, thank you all! They were always very careful with my partner's food allergy.
The only criticism would be that we had included a hydrotherapy circuit and halfway through our stay we went to do it and they told us that they had started renovations the day before. It is also incredible that a hotel of this quality does not have a space dedicated to shows, which were already very good.

reviews.author: Devin H
reviews.title: Restaurant experience
reviews.text: Moises served us at Cielo restaurant at paradisus cancun, amazing service, such a great experience, unreal food. His explanation of the food, the taste of the food, his personable experience, they surprised with desert for our honey moon. Explained the ingredients of the food

reviews.author: meshellatl
reviews.title: Good for a work conference but wouldn’t pay for a personal vacation
reviews.text:
Mixed feelings about this all-inclusive but glad I didn’t have to pay since it was a work trip. The good: nice private beach area, a couple of good restaurants (Lemon Fish was definitely the best… Flora and Blue Agave were decent… Malva, the buffet, was average) and the overall grounds were nice and well kept. The air conditioning in the conference area was great and they did a good job accommodating all of us (almost 500 people) during lunch.

The reason I wouldn’t pay…. 1) Made sense that the communal areas didn’t have a/c bc it’s a big lobby - would be a nightmare to keep cool. But the room a/c was minimal at best. Luckily, I requested a floor fan and they brought me one so that saved the trip… not sure how I would’ve been able to sleep without it as the room temp with a/c at the lowest setting felt like 75-80 the whole time. 2) Request to get more bottled water took 2 hours and 2 calls to get 3) it just didn’t have the 5 star feeling. The room was dated, there was duct tape holding one of the elevator panels on… for $450/night for their basic room (I extended my stay) it also seemed tacky to charge $5/usd for each room service delivery (and you had to call them to pick up the dishes after). 

Recommendation to the hotel: get Melia to update your app so customers can order through it and stop charging room service delivery. Invest in updating rooms so there isn’t rust around the faucets, better lighting and air conditioning

reviews.author: José N
reviews.title: Unforgettable vacations
reviews.text: Very well preserved facilities despite the fact that it has been built for a few years, it is super beautiful and impressive with its 5 pyramids, the super exquisite gastronomy, the attention of the super staff, especially that of Josemay our butler, who since we arrived was attentive From the smallest detail, we truly had a great time and we recommend it 100%. If you plan to go to Cancun, I assure you that you will not regret choosing this resort at all. reviews.author: Katie K
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel With Impeccable Service To Match!
reviews.text:
Where do I begin? Paradises Cancun has something for everyone looking for a relaxing getaway. As an adult, staying at the Reserve is a must. Our arrival for my birthday trip began with a greeting from our stellar concierge, Rocio . Rocio truly cares about her guests and enriching their experiences at the resort. She went above and beyond what is to be expected. So kind and friendly, she made all of our reservations for us at our desired restaurants during the 4 days we were staying at the resort. She helped arrange my massage which was amazing at the Yhi spa and she alerted us to the complimentary hydrotherapy sessions we received as Reserve guests. Think an aqua massage before the massage! Highly recommend Cecilia who gave me the best massage I've ever had--deep tissue with aromatherapy. Cecilia provided a professional and tranquil spa morning! Do yourself a favor and treat yourself to the spa and the resort-- I spoke to several guests who all agreed that the massages they had by Cecilia were the best they had ever had in their lives. 

Back to Rocio--she was available to us the entire time we were at the resort and checked in with us often to make sure all was well and we had everything we needed. She told us about everything the resort had to offer! And even booked a complimentary boat cruise for us! It was a delightful sail into the lagoon to watch the sunset that exceeded expectations. Being at the resort for such a brief time, this sunset cruise was a definite highlight-- complete with a live saxophonist. Rocio really tipped the scales as my favorite concierge of all time when she decorated the room for my birthday and left me a personalized card!!! This was beyond my expectations and made my birthday truly special and one I will never forget. From the bottom of my heart, thank you Rocio! You would be an asset to any employer lucky enough to have you and I will never forget our time at the Paradisus because of you! It's people like Rocio that make vacations memorable!

The family side of the resort has a ton to offer to the Reserve guests as well as the relaxing Reserve as an FYI in terms of activities and restaurants. Rocio made sure we were aware of all of the daily activities each day and she even made dinner recommendations. We never had to worry about what to do or where to go with Rocio as our concierge. Rocio also arranged 2 days of cabanas for us where we got served food and drinks and could relax throughout the day. Big shout out to Victor who escorted us to our cabanas and got us on the wait list for the third day! Thank you, Victor!!! Tropical paradise was had every day by the pool everyday under the shade of those cabanas. Can I just mention how friendly everyone is at the resort again!?!? Lai made us special bracelets as souvenirs and conducted an energetic water aerobics class and helped out with the hotel foam party which was an absolute blast! If I had a suggestion for the hotel, it would be to keep the activities coming. While, it was nice to have a relaxing stay in the Reserve, night time activities and additional daytime activities would also be welcome. Moises and Gabriella were our pool servers every day and I cannot speak highly enough of them. Always smiling, friendly and never an empty glass! Quick service with a smile, always! It would be nice to have a swim up bar on the adult side of the resort however bartenders like Alejandro were only a few feet from the pool. Alejandro served up delicious libations all day with pizzazz!

Moving on to the Reserve specialties--so many to mention! I wish they would bottle up the essential oils piped into the Reserve side and sell them! The greenery and vines throughout the resort combined with the substantial pools and cabanas enhanced the hotel. Walking from the other family side of the resort into the Reserve felt like you were entering a tropical oasis every time you returned to your room! Speaking of, we stayed in pyramid 5 overlooking the ocean. The room was exactly what we ordered: a nice mini bar with soda, beer and water plus snacks all included. There was never a shortage of bottled water which was very nice and if we needed anything extra we just asked Rocio and she made sure we got it! The balcony was large and the view of the ombre teal surf was breathtaking. A lot of guests complained about room temperatures and the property temperatures in their reviews. I did not find this to be the case on the Reserve side at all. Our room was always cool, but if you like it totally icy it might not have been cool enough, I suppose. The common areas in the Reserve were much cooler than the rest of the resort. I love the fact that there was a cafe right in our building that offered coffee drinks, water, soda and alcoholic drinks along with grab-and-go food items, little salads, fruits and charcuterie. Even artisanal chocolates!!! You also had the option of sitting down and having a server at breakfast and lunch. If you wanted a hot sandwich to go for your room they would heat them in the little oven for you. You'll find most of the restaurants located on the family side of the resort. If you want entirely kid free, you will have two restaurants to choose from, one of which is the cafe, and the other a lovely outdoor restaurant overlooking the beach called Sante that does not disappoint! Breakfast and lunch were had at Sante several times and were delicious. All servers were spectacular and if they didn't have what you wanted on the menu they asked you to tell them what you wanted and they would have the chef make it. You must try the seafood at this resort, we had shrimp, fish tacos, sushi, sea bass and whole fish. Never a disappointment. The view, food, and service at Sante were fabulouso!  The gazpacho was the best I've ever had!

A few other notes of mention about the food. We had breakfast at the buffet once which was okay and decided we preferred Sante. We also ate at Lemon Fish which was my favorite, Sal's and Aquamarina. Shout out to Francisco who worked at Lemon Fish and Aquamarina! Wonderful server! Also Ignacio at Sal's who helped the birthday celebration continue. Small plates at Lemon Fish were delicious and I felt like I was dining in a beautiful rainforest. The options offered at all restaurants were more upscale and right up my gourmet alley, but they did have something for everyone. The up charges were a little outrageous on some food items like lobster tails and steaks at the restaurants. For example, the included steak at Sal's was lower quality and if you wanted a better steak, it was a significant upcharge. The side dishes at Sal's were better than the steak! Best creamed spinach of my life!If I had one suggestion, it would be to offer an inclusive package of these items. If I had to go back to one restaurant at the resort it would be a time between Lemon Fish and Sante, for the food, views and service.

The Cancun beach is the most beautiful beach if I've ever seen and we had the opportunity to go in the ocean when it was calmer than the other red flag days. The beach was clean and beautiful with limited seaweed. There were also thatched umbrellas over chaises on the beach with beach drink service offered which was very nice. 

The last note of mention would be the entertainment at the resort. My advice would be to keep it coming and we enjoyed all of it, especially the live music! Mougel music played great covers and some original tunes on our last night while Erick happily served us thirst quenching cocktails at the Ginger Bar! He served us Mexico's favorite beer--Sol with a lime and was so cheerful all night long! We also did a paint and pour session which was a total stitch! The before mentioned foam party was the highlight entertainment wise! More pool entertainment is always welcome. 

In conclusion, I must say I would definitely return back to the Paradisus. The luxury I felt for the value was unmatched. The flawless service we received right from the beginning of the trip with Rocio, completely transformed our stay into one of the memorable all inclusive resorts we have stayed at.  Thank you, Rocio, and thank you Paradisus staff for your care and attention to detail. I can't wait to return!

reviews.author: LauraBeth360
reviews.title: Can’t wait to go back
reviews.text:
Travelled with my 2 daughters, 9 and 10 years of age. We have travelled many times to various resorts in Cancun, Mayan Riviera and Puerto Vallarta. Some more upscale and some less. The 3 of us thoroughly enjoyed our vacation to Paradisus and this is the first time I’d consider returning to the same resort as typically I prefer to try new resorts each time I visit. 

Food: I found it to be extremely flavourful, good variety and of ample supply. My kids preferred the buffet, so this is where we typically ate breakfast and dinner. However, we did go to Agua Marina for lunch, and lemon fish and the Italian restaurants for dinner. Both were amazing and I wish we had tried more of the restaurants, but the buffet was the easiest option for my kids. No reservations are needed at the a la cartes. We also ate at the pizza place, had poolside food (chicken nuggets, burger, fries, nachos, quesadillas, etc.) and frequently visited the ice cream shop. Oh and the coffee bar, started every morning with an iced caramel latte. Kids enjoyed the pastries and sandwiches from the coffee bar. Overall we were very pleased with the food and quality. Not sure how or why anyone could/would complain. I overheard one lady by the pool talking about there being no guacamole… not sure how that’s possible as there was always lots whenever we went. But as in typical buffet style, there’s always folks who take more than they will eat, so perhaps that was where some of it was going?! One thing that could improve the dining would be if the a la cartes had a kids menu… this could have made taking my kids to try the various restaurants much easier! But they always found something to enjoy off the menu regardless. 

Pool: We really enjoyed it. Nothing special but lots of room to swim, float, etc. The little kids pool had 2 foam parties in the 8 days we were there. And the main pool area had the inflatable obstacle course 3 times. 

Beach: red flags everyday, but we still went for a few swims. Seaweed situation changed daily but was never bad. Definitely not a deterrent from enjoying the beautiful turquoise water! 

Staff: Amazing. Kind. Helpful. Polite. Hardworking. They often placed their hand over their heart when they greeted us, which made us feel very special and welcome! 

Hotel: absolutely beautiful. The greenery inside is well maintained, abundant and stunning. Very unique from other hotels we’ve stayed. We were in room 3820 in the main tower (8th floor, lagoon view). The view was fantastic as even though we couldn’t see the ocean, we still had a “water view” which was enough for us! The bathroom tub appeared to be painted to cover up flaws and the door to the room was a bit damaged. Certainly didn’t bother us, but some minor details like this were noted in the room specifically. AC worked great though and we always felt comfortable in our room. The beds were comfy and we all slept great throughout our stay! Being in the main building the shows were quite loud, so I’d say avoid the main tower if you are coming with small children as the shows lasted until 9/9:30pm I’d say. The grounds were immaculate and well maintained. The staff worked so hard each day to keep everything looking great! 

Entertainment: The shows were very different from other Mexican hotels. No classic Micheal Jackson show lol. Unique shows and performances. We especially enjoyed the Mexican show outside, which included dancing, mariachi band, storytelling, a horse and traditional Mayan dressed performers. On the same night there were Mexican carnival games for the kids, and they won prizes. During the day, there were many adult activities such as macrame class, pottery painting, sound bath, tequila tasting, chocolate making, etc. I only attended the chocolate class, but it is a must for anyone visiting. We learned about the process of growing cacao and then used roasted cacao to make our own chocolate! So cool! The lady who ran the class was awesome and we all learned so much. Such a nice touch to our overall experience at Paradisus! 

Kids club: This was the icing on the cake. I have nothing but positive reviews about the club, the staff, the activities and the adventures that came along! Typically my kids have no interest in going to kids club and we’ve stayed at some resorts with some pretty awesome facilities (ball pits, slides, indoor play structures, etc.). We have found most resorts don’t follow the schedule posted for the kids club, but at Paradisus, this certainly was not the case! They did everything and MORE! They even brought in a local company to do science experiments with the kids one evening! Such a cool and unique touch! My kids made bracelets, key chains, stuffed animals, dream catchers, went digging for dinosaurs on the beach, made sandcastles, pool parties, played games, watched movies, listened to music, played trivia games, had a Mario cart race in a ride on Mario car (with a 1st, 2nd and 3rd place podium/awards ceremony), made piñatas, and broke a huge piñata with loads of candy. My 9 year old was hooked on the kids club by day 2 or 3, and she planned her day around spending as much time there as possible. A huge shout out to the staff that became like family to us: Azul, Gove,
Monse, Nabila, Yolanda, Yami and Bruno. We all shed a few tears when we had to say goodbye. The staff truly made our stay so much more memorable and special. We will never forgot them and all the fun that was had. They will be one of the main reasons for us to return to Paradisus (hopefully soon)!! 

If you are thinking of visiting Cancun on a midrange budget, this is your place! It’s a gem and worth every penny! Better quality overall than many of the more upscale resorts we’ve stayed!! We will be back and plan to bring more family to enjoy with us!! We miss you all so much!!

reviews.author: Juan A

reviews.author: Seaside19697105212
reviews.title: Trip
reviews.text: Amazing resort. Great food. Had great experience with our concierge Daniela Sosa who gave great recommendations. The resort is in a great central location. Easy to get around resort. Wonderful staff at all restaurants and bars. Couldn’t have asked for better!

reviews.author: guest25000
reviews.title: May 2024
reviews.text:
We spent 7 days at this hotel. It’s a huge hotel and has growing vines/plants coming down from each level- like a luxury jungle. It’s an amazing design… I wish I could stay longer, I really loved it. So much light from the glass ceiling!!
On the negative side is a bit too warm inside the hotel on the hallways, specially on the last floor (8), not much ventilation. Also, water leaks on hallways (warning signs are in place), ocean is rough (red flag is up) and we had some weeds which I don’t know if anybody remove them from the beach. Swimming pools are clean, towels are available, crew members are very polite and helpful, food is fresh and good ( not much avocado available though). Pizza baked fresh was amazing. Ice cream available by the swimming pool was awesome. Our room was at the second level, didn’t have cutleries or microwave but we had plates and cups, no coffee maker available in the room, but we were close enough to the coffee shop by the buffet. 
Overall I had a good experience and I would happily return

reviews.author: Nelson C
reviews.title: Nice hotel. Bad management decisions.
reviews.text: Bars close at 10:45pm. And when you want to watch the playoff hockey game the response is "we don't get that channel" or "we lost the remote" even though everyone was watching hockey a few nights ago. BTW, some rooms don't have air conditioning. Don't blame the staff, they do their best.

reviews.author: Zai M
reviews.title: We would return without a doubt
reviews.text: The place is very nice, the food excellent...we traveled as a family and personally the room was very spacious to stay with children. The stay and attention were first class, especially from Mr. Alberto, who supported us enormously during breakfast, excellent human quality.

reviews.author: Marcy R
reviews.title: Reserve experience a must!
reviews.text:
First I would like to start by thanking Rocio! She went above and beyond and made our trip extremely special. She was amazing, attentive, so kind, answered all of our questions.  We were on vacation for a birthday and she surprised us by coming up and decorating the room. It looked lovely!
She is truly wonderful person and the hotel should be honored she works for you! Thank you so much Rocio!! The bartender Alejandro at the reserve bar was fabulous, always put a smile on my face. Lai by the reserve pool made me a beautiful bracelet.  Moises at the reserve pool was our waiter. Very impressed and nice! The staff at the reserve really made you feel special. 

For the rooms, we had an ocean front view at the reserve, nothing to complain about, view was fabulous and exactly what I was expecting. 

Take advantage of the water hydrotherapy if you are staying in the reserve, it's free and it will not disappoint! After you can get a massage which is an extra fee but definitely worth it!!

If you're staying at the reserve, and they offer a sunset boat side, take it! Again it's included in the reserve, double Decker boat with live saxophone music, entertainment, drinks and a snack. It's only about an hour and a half commitment, I really recommend it! 

A few things the hotel could improve on, don't make the staff wear pants and long sleeve shirts, looking at them made me hot!! Agree they need a uniform but a cooler option for them is definitely needed. 
If you leave the reserve to go to any other bars on the resort the drinks are lacking and you can't order the premium liquor on the family side, even though there is a way to identify the reserve members from others.
There are also additional charges for things, some are just outrageous. A lobster tail one evening was a extra charge of $86usd! 

The steakhouse sal is for reserve adult members only. All the good USDA steaks, tomahawk and wagyu we're additionally outrageous prices for what you are getting, the sides were delicious. Definitely recommend lemon fish if you like small plates like sushi and Japanese style food. Agua Marina was a seafood, the outdoor experience was lovely the seafood dishes were okay. Sante on the reserve side was were we at most of our breakfast and lunches. Must try the fish tacos! 

The day activities need some improvement, Saturday was a foam party on the reserve side and everyone was loving it. Other than that a few staff came around during the day and offered to make some bracelets. Which we gladly accepted and had a fun time making. The wine and canvas is a must if you are in for a good laugh realizing you are not a professional painter. Would of like a little more entertainment throughout the day, but if you are going there just to relax and do nothing this is the place for you. The evening entertainment at the ginger bar every night is worth going to see.

Thank you Rocio for making our trip something to remember!

reviews.author: Reyna H
reviews.title: All good ❤️‍🩹
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun is the best, its facilities are super from the outside and inside it is beautiful, the staff is very friendly, the waiter Juan from the Italian restaurant, very helpful, thank you for your patience Juan and our butler Eduardo made everything easy for us, of course we will return if God allows us, this hotel is luxury but the most important thing is the people, their kindness, their respect
My delighted family and I supposedly
