reviews.author: Cynthia D
reviews.title: Perfect weekend
reviews.text: Everything wonderful. Excellent weekend. I went to celebrate my birthday with friends and we loved it. Thanks for the young Alonso guest service impeccable service always attentive to needs. Likewise, Iran concierge. We will be back

reviews.author: OnAir68135793129
reviews.text:
The staff were very friendly and helpful including our concierge Juan. He made our vacation more relaxed since he handled all reservations. 
The Sal steakhouse was a good experience as well as the bars around the resort. Bring small bills for tips!

reviews.author: Nicole B
reviews.title: Fantastic Trip
reviews.text: Service, food, accommodations... cabanas included, and so much more! Adults only - the Reserve is well worth it!

reviews.author: Lgaytan
reviews.title: Great stay- loud on lagoon side
reviews.text:
The hotel is beautiful, clean and service is exceptional. Food was fantastic especially Sante and Blue Agave. 
Since we stayed at the Reserve, check in was quick and  it came with concierge service which isn't really my thing, but  Im sure many people appreciate it.  
However I think it would be helpful for people to know if you stay on the lagoon side, there is a club on the other side of the street that will most likely keep you up til around 4 am. This isn't the hotel’s fault, but I wished we had been warned. The rooms also feel warm and ac cannot keep up. After my husband spoke to the front desk, we were moved to a somewhat quieter floor, but room was still kind of hot.

reviews.author: Ariadna glez
reviews.title: excellent value for money / good family vacation
reviews.text:
I will always choose Paradisus if I want to eat delicious food and have all the good quality services, beautiful, relaxing, a super experience! I especially want to thank Cristian who saved our Vacation because at first no concierge had contacted us and I met him in the buffet area, the truth is I complained a little to him because they have always made me feel spoiled and valued in this hotel, from that moment on he guided us and looked after us throughout our stay.
My family and guests thank him and we recognize that when you enjoy his work, it shows! Thanks Cristian!!

reviews.author: Jenny
reviews.title: The Reserve, Worth It
reviews.text:
The Reserve, pure bliss. If you are looking for a place to reset, you can escape. Take advantage of the spin classes, stretching and then a respite in a cabana. Enjoy a massage in the well-appointed accommodations. Take in the nightly show and cap off how you like.

Most importantly, you will connect with a concierge that is vested in your interests. Rocio welcomed me to Paradise and made sure I was taken care of during the stay. It’s personal touches like these that will make me return.

reviews.author: Lyubomir L
reviews.title: Dream vacation in Paradisus
reviews.text: Very nice hotel, I can only recommend it. The Reserve by Paradisus is a dream. The food and drinks are even better than in the main building. Daniel, our concierge, was always available and fulfilled our wishes 1000%. Thanks to the whole team

reviews.author: MaryAnn R
reviews.title: GREAT PEOPLE, beware of CLUB membership.  Research the reviews on it.
reviews.text: Couldn't get the little  things right... replenishing water,minibar, snacks or even a pen.  Everything shuts down at 11:00.   DON'T go to hear about the hotel unless you're looking for a different twist on a time share, BUT ALL STAFF WERE AWESOME PEOPLE.

reviews.author: Daydream31830234970
reviews.title: Loved Paradisus Cancun!
reviews.text:
My family loved the Paradisus Cancun! We had the Nikte Ocean view, our wonderful Concierge was Lalo. Upon arrival greeted with refreshments and popsicles which the kids loved. Check in was fast and our Concierge Lalo walked us to our room and spoke to us about our weeks plans. Lalo was so helpful, helped us with dinner reservations, daily updates on hotel activities and anything else we needed to make our stay special at Paradisus. Nikte includes steakhouse dinner at Sal, adults only. Highly recommended.
Rooms - ocean view was incredible, mini bar and snacks refilled daily. Room was nice and clean.
Hotel grounds- such a beautiful hotel, staff is friendly, professional. They treat their guest well. Coffee bar had many selections of pastries. Seaweed cleaned every morning
Pool - cabanas were comfortable! Adult pool was clean and pool service was great. Kids pool was nice for little kids and relaxing for parents. (Away from the music)
Kids Club - staff was friendly and had awesome activities for the kids. Highly recommend! Kid Foam Party was so much fun.
Restaurants - we had delicious meals at, Agua Marina (seafood) and Capella (Italian) and Blur Agave (tacos spot) We enjoyed the Room Service food as well since sometimes that was easier with little kids. We loved Lemon Fish - thank you Chef Marcos and our waiter Jorge for a fantastic dinner. Lemon fish was our favorite restaurant, Japanese food with a flare and unique touches.
We loved our stay at Paradisus Cancún. Paradisus is a truly special place that transports you to another world. Thank you Lalo and team! Five stars!

reviews.author: Quemiller40
reviews.title: Roaches, nats and loud music
reviews.text: There is a gap in the doors and I saw a roach run into our room. I killed it and thought that was just a one off. A couple days in we found more running around. Nasty! There were nats all in the room and hotel. The toilet stop flushing on day 3 and our concierge wasn’t too helpful when it came to booking reservations.

reviews.author: Teresa P
reviews.title: lemon fish
reviews.text:
We had dinner at Lemon Fish and, in addition to the excellent sushi, the attention of the waiter Francisco stood out. He advised us and guided the dinner with his experience, which turned out to be a magnificent dinner. I recommend living the experience. We will surely repeat!
Thanks Francisco!

reviews.author: Courtney M
reviews.title: Absolutely amazing experience!!!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus Cancún for our anniversary and we had an amazing time. We stayed on the reserve side and our concierge, Stelian, was wonderful! He helped with all of our needs and really ensured we were comfortable and happy during our stay. We would definitely come back for another visit. The room was really clean and nice and the resort is absolutely beautiful. 10/10 for our stay!!!!

reviews.author: karina t
reviews.title: Excellent attention
reviews.text: My husband and I really enjoyed our dinner as we had an excellent experience mainly due to the kind, warm and helpful attention of Moisés Morales at dinner at the Cielo restaurant, the food was delicious, a very good experience in general.

reviews.author: Cassie N
reviews.title: Amazing experience, great staff!
reviews.text: This resort has good amenities, delicious food, and most importantly amazing staff. Gaudencio at the beach was fantastic and service was fast.  Didier at the pool also provided great service. Well certainly come back as staff at the resort treated us well and the food and drink options were to die for.

reviews.author: Marlyp1234
reviews.title: Loved it
reviews.text: I truly enjoyed my time at Paradisus, it was such a beautiful hotel. Even more breathtaking in person! It’s a short distance from the airport, my only issue was when I was checking in we had to wait in a line outside the door for upwards to two hours. Which was a little frustrating after coming from a long travel  day. But it made all worth it when we seen our beautiful room. We had two balconies facing the lagoon and we pleasantly enjoyed seeing the sun set every evening. I would recommend this hotel to anyone!

reviews.author: Rocio R
reviews.title: Best staff & crew
reviews.text:
We stay at Melia Paradisus when in Cancun. We continue to stay because of the exceptional customer service from our concierge, Violeta. Thank you for setting up our anniversary photography session, our dinners, and always being available to answer our never ending questions.  The quick and speedy service of Cesar & Moises at the Reserve, who go above and beyond to make our vacation fun and relaxing.  We also like to thank Gaby & Valeria at Sante for always providing top notch service as well and Luis at the bar! Thank you for the delicious drinks and a variety of liquor to choose from in the Reserve. We continue coming back because their service is like no other. 
On this trip, we dined at the their new restaurant Flora. When we heard it was Organic, we were hesitant to try but thank God we did, that we went twice for dinner. The salmon was cooked perfectly and the presentation was nicely done thanks to Chef Jose and the tomato soup,(my husband got it twice) it was the chefs kiss. We got to meet the chef Jose as well and give him our praises.   The manager Tere and hostess Fanny made us feel so welcomed and special as we were celebrating our anniversary. They brought us a cake with a firework candle. We can't thank them enough and our wonderful waiter Alex.  He was quick and caring and checked on us often if we needed anything else or more wine.  We hope Flora stays as a main  restaurant in the hotel.  
We always enjoy the atmosphere and food at Sal, the staff was great as well!  Our reservation was at 8pm for a group of 8 and got served at 10pm so I thought the timing was to long by the time we got our main course. I didn't expect to eat that late but might of been the group setting but in the future we will schedule a 6 or 7pm time for dinner. I would highly recommend staying on the reserve -adults only side at Paradisus.  We will continue to stay and keep inviting our friends with us. Thank you all again! Xoxo Rocio & Daniel

reviews.author: Paul P
reviews.title: Great time
reviews.text: Rocío was my concierge and she was the highlight of my trip. She was extremely attentive and helpful with every little request I had. I travelled with a rather larger group and she was able to set up all of my reservation needs. My trip would definitely not have been as fun if it wasn't for her help and scheduling.

reviews.author: Maryam A
reviews.title: Beautiful resort with fantastic staff and great amenities
reviews.text: The beds are very comfortable, amenities are great, staff are helpful and welcoming. So much choice with the restaurants at the resort. Highly recommend and will definitely stay here again when returning to cancun. Jose, our concierge was extremely helpful and nice, assisted with everything we reached out to him for. Thank you for making our stay extra special!

reviews.author: Jennifer C
reviews.title: Restaurant
reviews.text: Just ate at the Authentic Mexican restaurant Cielo! By far my favorite so far. Moises and  Oscar are fantastic and some of the friendlies people we have had the pleasure of meeting so far. The food was fabulous 👌🏼 and the service was the best. Definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Diego M
reviews.title: Dissapointed
reviews.text:
I`m very disappointed with all experience and how the employees managed problems on their side. I was also thinking about becoming a Circle Melia member but give up after the whole experience.
I booked 2 rooms (one for my family with 2 kids and another for my parents). The check-in was supposed to be at 3pm but my parent`s room were not ready – only 4 pm. So I invite my parents to take a shower and drop all they luggage in my room in the meantime. At 4 pm their room had NO drinks and snacks (we paid for them) and they only dropped drinks and snacks the following day at nighttime. Same happened to my room regarding snacks. 
After me calling DAILY to ask to restock the drinks and snacks we spent 2 days with 1 less towel as I was sharing the same towel with my wife. I called twice but they only brought an extra towel 48 hours later after me complaining with the Guest Center at the Hotel.
Besides that, my rooms were not clean and was full of dust on the floor + a super noisy air conditioner making our sleep nights more difficult. My parents’ rooms had a clothing drawer completely broken and falling apart and they also killed two little roaches in their bathroom.
Talking about bathroom. My parents’ bathroom was leaking water since the first day and my mom hurt her feet at first day as she didn’t see the water on the floor. I called Guest Service and they said they fixed but the issue was still all days during our stay so my mother just left a huge towel on the floor to avoid her falling again.
After ALL those issues on both rooms I went to the guest service and the employee wrote down everything and did NOTHING else. “Thank you Sir. We`ll use this to improve ourselves”.
That was unbelievable for me so I spoke with the Concierge Manager about all above. After that she asked me to go back and talk to the Guest Service Manager again and believe me due to all the situation, he offered me a plain cabana to spend the day. I told him that we don’t use cabana as the kids uses the pool all the time.. So he tried to convince me adding one side of “Chicken with Nachos” for my cabana. I thought that he was joking as this plate is offered for free for all guests.  
I did not accept his offer and following day he texted me saying that was TRYING to get approval to get tickets for “Escape Room”. I gently replied him saying: I`m not coming to Cancun to spend hours in a Escape Room with 2 little kids + 2 senior people" BAD TEAM ..BAD HOTEL.

reviews.author: Roam00076272294
reviews.title: Highly recommended for a honeymoon!
reviews.text: I stayed 3 out of 6 nights in Cancun and it was a very satisfying trip!! It was the best service in such a beautiful sea. Concierge Joan kindly explained all reservations and information about the facility, and a new email program was launched within the hotel, so there was no time to get bored. LA - I went on a honeymoon to Cancun, and I spent the last 3 nights at Paradisus and had a comfortable stay! If you want to heal comfortably, I highly recommend Paradisus and I highly recommend making a reservation at Reserve, which is a no-kids zone.

reviews.author: Andre
reviews.title: Don’t stay here and waste your money.
reviews.text:
Don’t come and stay here. 
Zero maintenance.
Terrible customer service.
No good food at any of the restaurants. 
Problems with A/C and no working showers amongst many problems with our group. 
Way way subpar customer service.
I’m sure none of the staff has gone through training.

reviews.author: Alex F
reviews.title: Italy in Cancun
reviews.text: Excellent gastronomic variety with a great sense of hospitality, we visited cappella, a little piece of Italy in Cancun, Christopher, a young man dedicated to his profession, prepared our dinner for us. Congratulations to everyone who makes cappella a good recommendation.

reviews.author: Cristina R
reviews.title: Large family wedding anniversary celebration trip
reviews.text: Excellent location, infrastructure, beautiful beach and good service. Variety of restaurants and good quality of food. The staff is very attentive in all environments. We were 14 members of a family celebrating our wedding anniversary and we were all very well cared for in our different needs. The amenities made us feel special.

reviews.author: adolforamirezalejo
reviews.title: Is very good
reviews.text: Highly recommended, excellent service and attention. Clean facilities and very friendly service staff

reviews.author: Ariel
reviews.title: Overall great vacation
reviews.text:
The paradisus cancun is such a beautiful hotel. The space is filled with gorgeous vines and lighting. The downfall of this tropical atmosphere is the lobby is extremely humid and hot. I have not stayed at an all inclusive where everything wasn't included either. Ie; restaurants and different food options at these restaurants. All of the dining options were basically the same at every restaurant location. We found ourselves eating at the buffet most nights. The quality of food definitely isn't the best, but you won't go hungry.
What this place lacks in cuisine it makes up for in hospitality though for sure! Abraham was our bartender for most of our stay and he is absolutely fantastic! Always keeping our kids entertained with fun tricks and great drinks! He truly made our trip a memorable one.
All and all this was a fun time. Could you find a better resort? Yes, but, for the price this isn't a bad selection.

reviews.author: Matthew M
reviews.title: Great, fun and classy environment
reviews.text:
Ginger Bar. 
Very clean bar. Fun and festive drinks with a professional atmosphere. Artemio, Ian, and burnt all help to make our experience truly one to remember. Will be coming back next year. Would recommend this bar to anyone looking to getaway with a partner and enjoy and evening together.

reviews.author: Emma P
reviews.title: Capillo Jesus
reviews.text: Capillo restaurant is amazing! Jesus was a great waiter, Italian food so good! Variety of desserts and appetizers! Outside restaurant so you get the nice breeze in the evenings and coconut water in a coconut! Can’t get better then that right?!

reviews.author: ebarrera2019
reviews.title: The hotel is very well located, I loved that it is very familiar and has excellent food and good service from the staff
reviews.text: I loved my stay at the Paradisus Cancún hotel, among many other things, that you don't need a key to enter the room, that there are bathrobes, that they are not obsessive about towels, that you don't have to schedule dinners, that there is always coffee and pastries and they always welcome you with fresh water. There is a variety of food and it is sufficient, pleasing nationals and foreigners and there is good nightly entertainment. I highlight that every morning I started the day with a good breakfast and receiving the attention of Alfredo and Alberto, excellent service and attention. I will definitely return to that hotel and I hope that by then I can use my points and try a welcome coconut.

reviews.author: Sandy O
reviews.title: Pleasant work experience
reviews.text: The hotel is very nice, well-kept beaches as well as the facilities. Excellent food and drink. Very good service, especially from Omar from the Peruvian restaurant, excellent food recommendations. Cleanliness and everything very good and tidy

reviews.author: Colette P
reviews.title: Circle Club Melia
reviews.text: Manuel at The Circle Club Melia presented a very nice offer for travelers who enjoy all inclusive travel experiences. While this package is not for me per se, the presentation was clearly explained and not high pressure sales. Our stay here is covered under a different plan which is no longer available, but the services, especially Raul, our concierge is excellent. The restaurants are superb and the food is delicious.

reviews.author: Manosith
reviews.title: Big Meh
reviews.text:
Despite booking directly through their website it took 1-1.5hrs to check in (not counting queue time)
No concierge were assigned to us so we had to figure out everything on our own on our first day which is terrible after our long flight and being our first time in Cancun. Hotel does show its age and the hotel was mostly humid most of our stay. Buffet was decent but the surrounding was beautiful. Few workers went above and beyond that was what saved the stay.
Overall one of the worst 5 stars hotel we ever stayed felt like a 3.5-4 star hotel.

reviews.author: lindamfnp
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun Vacation
reviews.text: Although the resort is beautiful, I believe for the price, there are other resorts to choose from. We had ocean view reserve room. There’s hardly any entertainment/activities. If there was, it wasn’t posted and app not updated

reviews.author: Alan B
reviews.title: Great for business and vacation
reviews.text:
From check in to check out, the staff and experience were wonderful. The facilities are in great shape and the choice of restaurants is very good. The only thing I would have liked is for the A/C in my room to get colder.

We had a conference there, as well, and the room and A/V were top notch. 

I was very impressed that at every restaurant they asked about food allergies and restrictions when you check in or ask to be seated. At the buffet, someone walked it with me, showing me which items had no gluten. There are symbols on many of the items (although I didn’t see a legend to know which is which - some were more obvious that others).

They made me gluten free pancakes the first morning, which was nice, but they were small and had that gummy texture which is common. There was a section of the buffet with gluten free bread (which was a little crusty) and a muffin (I couldn’t really tell what kind, but it was fine for breakfast).

At the fish restaurant, they brought me gluten free soy sauce for my sushi and there were gluten free dessert options. The staff is very attentive to our GF needs, better than most restaurants in the US.

reviews.author: Nadine M
reviews.title: The Reserve. Hmmm
reviews.text: We have been at least 5 Times at this hôtel. Great staff, great beach. But….we come here to relax and so disapointed about the new bubble theme and loud music at the pool. We were not the only ones unhappy. We want classy clientele. Also so annoyed with people talking on their phones on speaker??? No class. I dont want to hear your conversations. So their should be a policy and also a restricted  area of no personnal music. Yes we are there …policys for stupid people.

reviews.author: Giorgia
reviews.title: Paradisus????????
reviews.text: Don't waste your money with the Reserve much better Paradisus Cancun. The only positive thing about the Reserve is Sante restaurant for lunch ( Cesar and Moses are amazing).

reviews.author: Departure65408960147
reviews.title: Great experience!
reviews.text: We had a lovely time at the resort! Rocio was extremely helpful and checked in with us until we returned home. It was a fantastic experience and we look forward to returning next time.

reviews.author: Fernanda Z
reviews.title: Best vacation ever!!
reviews.text:
I have been coming for 10 years and I return because of the quality and warmth of the people they have.
The service is excellent in food and attention. They have a new restaurant, FLORA that is worth trying, great service from Tere the captain.
CIELO is quite a culinary experience, chef David, apart from the delicious food he prepares, gives us classes on Mexican culture and traditions and captain Adriana is always attentive to everyone's needs (including children) taking care of birthday or anniversary celebrations.
Captain Guillermo in MALVA is always on the lookout for any needs or special food that is needed. There the attention of Amairani, Fernanda, Atilano, Armando, Martín and in general everyone makes you have a pleasant time.
The AGUA MARINA restaurant serves food at noon and at dinner, all delicious, both Captain Rafa and Captain Fernando always attentive to the special needs that are required, whether it is porridge or prioritizing the feeding of the little ones.
And last but not least, the attention of Mrs. Lety and Asunción in the food and drink service at the pool, always serving with a smile and good disposition! Endless thanks to everyone for all your attention always!!
I will definitely return to this dream place! As they say, to my second home in the Caribbean!!

reviews.author: jeny j
reviews.title: Excellent experience!!
reviews.text: Great all around!! My first time in Cancun and I loved it!! The all inclusive package is the way to go, Lemon Fish in particular (a restaurant in the hotel) was amazing!! Our server was Jorge and he beyond delivered !! A chef’s kiss to chef Marcos for making our foodie dreams come true!! :)

reviews.author: Carmen O
reviews.title: Paradise’s Cancun. Italian restaurant
reviews.text: The food is amazing, I super recommend the Capella restaurant and the waitress José, he suggested the plate call Pesque Giorgio and it was the best I ever had. All the staff is very friendly. The appetizer was great (calamari), the wine is very good, i told him (Jose) that i like sweet wine and he right away suggested the Cabernet de La Casa. Then the dessert came and we suggested Tiramisu and I’m assuring you it’s very delicious, it tastes like homemade tiramisu. I strongly recommend the resort and all of their restaurants. Thank you Meliá (Paradisus resort).

reviews.author: Brandi R
reviews.title: Loved our stay at Paradisus Cancún!
reviews.text:
What an amazing adventure! The ambiance was incredible and the food…well, damn, just exquisite! 

Joorge and Chef Marcos at LemonFish gave us the most amazing dining experience. We ate there multiple times on our trip. Do not miss this spot!!

reviews.author: Nancy Z
reviews.title: ONCE AGAIN, A WONDERFUL STAY AT OUR CANCUN BEACH HOUSE
reviews.text:
Dear Sr. Jorge Martinez,

We want to thank you, your management team, and your staff for a wonderful week's visit, our 62nd Melia stay at our Cancun "Beach House".

A special thanks to Auric Hernandez for assisting us with the final plans for our arrival in Cancun.  She greeted us with open arms and gave us a nice warm welcome home.  She had flowers for Nancy that were beautiful and her favorite color.  It was a very nice touch.

Iliane Medina and her Reserve Team are very friendly, kind, and courteous.  Ceci took the time and helped us with some Melia Rewards questions which we were very thankful for.  Fernando coordinated the arrival of our compadres and ahijado for dinner one evening.  We want to recognize all of the behind-the-scenes efforts of Diogo De Carvalho who made the family dinner happen at Cielo with Chef David, Captain, Adriana, and our waiter Jose.  Of course, Sommelier Iran is always ready with a wine recommendation.  The food, service, and experience were perfect and we thank you very much for this accommodation.

A very special shout-out to George Topalovic, our concierge.  It was great to work with George.  He was friendly, kind, and above all just a wonderful human being.  He followed up on every detail to ensure our stay was very enjoyable.  We hope to work with him on our next visit.

We spent all of our days at The Reserve Pool and Sante, including two dinners.  We want to acknowledge Diego and his truly amazing team at Sante/Reserve area.  They all work well together and we have known many of them for years, some going back to Melia Turquesa days.  We are proud to call them our friends/family.  

We want to thank each of them: (we hope we didn't miss anyone) 🤗

Cesar, Javier, Moises, Luis, Lorena, Miguel, Victor, Nicole, Oscar, Yamil, Joel, Valeria, Arnuifo, Axel, Natanael, Gabriela, Julio and Jose.  The bartenders:  Luis and Alejandro and the team members that make our hearts and stomaches happy:  Maria del Carmen, Esaul, Dulce, Delia, Angel, and Carlos.  

We love the new look of Sante and appreciate having it open for dinner.

We enjoy returning to our Cancun "Beach House" just to be among family.

The Reserve Pyramid 5 looks wonderful with all of the new upgrades.  The food presentations are beautiful and very inviting.  It is a very nice addition to The Reserve area.

We had wonderful dinners at:  Agua Marina, Capella, SAL, Lemon Fish and Sante (twice), and of course Cielo.  All of the staff were friendly, pleasant, and professional.  They would even seat us in a quieter area away from children which we appreciated. ❤️

At SAL, we enjoyed the service of Rodger and Daniel, the manager.  We like the atmosphere and the dining experience at SAL.  The food and service were excellent.

Our dining experience at Lemon Fish was also very pleasant with Daniel as our waiter and Boris, the manager.  Boris made a great recommendation of a sample platter and it was excellent.  We have had Daniel as our waiter on past trips to our "Beach House".

Each evening we had a nice visit from either Ricardo or Paulina from the Food and Beverage Team.  They checked in to see how we were doing and how we were enjoying the various venues.

Every evening after dinner, we would stop at The Reserve Lounge and have a nightcap and dessert.  The food display is amazing.  We just wished that the desserts weren't taken away so early...8:00 p.m.  We enjoyed them so much that we would look at our watch and rush from dinner to be on time.  Julio would always take care of us.

During each visit, we like to acknowledge an individual who works very hard every day to make the guests' stay enjoyable without any or little public recognition.  This trip our unsung hero is Victor.  Victor ensures that the pools are kept very clean.  What would guests do if the pools weren't clean?  We have known Victor for many years and he takes a lot of pride in his work.

As you can tell, we love our Cancun "Beach House" because of all the amazing people.  We hope to meet you on our next visit, July 22nd to July 29th, 2024.

Gracias para todos and we will see you soon.

Robert and Nancy Zimmerman

reviews.author: TravelerPerson
reviews.title: Stay at the one in Playa del Carmen
reviews.text: Stayed in the exclusive adults section which is well worth the up charge.  Couldn't have asked for a better view, we were on the fifth floor and all we could see was the ocean.  Better view from our balcony than the cabana.  Staff was friendly.  However, food was meh which was disappointing because when I stayed at the Paradisus in Playa del Carmen it was amazing.  The lack of reservations didn't really bother us, but we'd show up for activities on time or even a little early and there wouldn't be any space left.  Also I hate that everything is done through their app (that doesn't even work well).  I do not want to have to carry my phone around all the time when I'm looking to disconnect.  Overall, it was nice but I had a much better experience at the sister hotel in Playa del Carmen, don't know if it's due to new management practices or jus that different but it is what it is.

reviews.author: Francisco Gonzalez
reviews.title: SPEECHLESS
reviews.text:
It is a disappointment of a hotel, rooms from the 80s, mediocre facilities, old furniture, who takes the risk? will check it.!!!

I have a Master Suite and nothing to do with what they offer in other hotels. $12 thousand pesos a night

MEXICANS, please do not come to this pseudo place (hotel), the discrimination is very noticeable, the restaurant was empty and they get you up from the restaurant to wait in line.

Mockery and discrimination, anyway, unfortunately I have to stay a few more days, but I must be honest, not everything is bad, there are very kind and simple people who treat you well.

But in life, I would return!!! I recommend Hard Rock!!!

reviews.author: j w
reviews.title: Wonderful resort but lacking some entertainment options
reviews.text: The check-in process was confusing. One for standard guests and another for The Reserve guests. However, The Reserve guests are not informed of the different location until reaching the main front desk clerk. Entertainment is lacking, especially in the evening for adults, but the food and service provided by the staff is excellent, particularly the Malva buffet. The multiple pool areas are beautiful and well maintained. Food and bar quality was quite good. Staff and waiters were very helpful and polite. Our 'Reserve' concierge Victor M did a fantastic job and handled all of our needs. I would recommend avoiding the sales presentation if you have no interest in becoming a Melia Rewards member. The presentation interrupted our day and served no benefit to us. Overall, I would recommend the resort however some improvements could be made.

reviews.author: Trip61939795019
reviews.title: Lunch Box at Paracisus Cancun is worth the visit!
reviews.text: Unique and exceptional food at Lunch Box in paradises Cancun. I would describe it as Latin/Mexican fusion. The manager, Geilloth, greeted us, waiter, Juan, was outstanding, hostess, Libertad, friendly and accommodating, and Chef Ventura knows what he’s doing! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Paul
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun Enjoyment
reviews.text:
My wife and I visited Paradisus Cancun for the first time in ten years.  We have been there many times.  We are TS owners in the Melia/Paradisus program.  There are good things about our stay and there are some not so good.   Our room was a 1BR suite in the members section.  Our room was very nice with an ocean/pool view.  The facilities were quite adequate and comfortable.  The view was spectacular as always.  The food and restaurants were somewhat subpar.  The restaurants were certainly subpar.  The buffet was fine for breakfast, but hit and miss for dinner.  We had good food at poolside.   From a members perspective, 

I felt as I have always, there is no special section at poolside.  The members section is at the end of the long pool and amidst the family area where there are many children.  It is annoying that members have no special pool area.  Overall I would consider that members are considered secondary.  

We had massages and the spa and massage were excellent.  It was a great treat and very comfortable and relaxing.  There was nightly entertainment and we saw and listened to Bianka / Giancarlo and The Jersey Boys.  Both were terrific.  Their music was fantastic.  Excellent performers.  The addition of nightly entertainment at this resort is a great addition to the overall stay.  

We booked an excursion through Otium.  Ricardo was our rep.  He was fantastic.  We talked to him for quite a while and he provided thorough knowledge of various excursions, as well as much information about each.  He suggested an island call Holbox and it was fantastic.  

The resort facilities are, as always, fantastic.  It is quite beautiful and well kept.  Some of the folks who cared for us are Josue, Eliot, Alejandra and Yesenia.  They did not disappoint.  Their service and care were excellent.  All were very friendly, courteous and helpful.  Anywhere we go, the people can make or break and they helped to very much MAKE it.  

One suggestion is an adults only pool.  There is a fairly large pool and pool area right out the main oceanside doors to the left.  This could easily be converted to an adults only section.  It would certainly make the resort much better.  They could section off an area for members there too.  

Overall we had a nice stay, but the food, particularly the restaurants, needs an upgrade.  We did not go hungry, but for what is a high-class establishment, the food did not measure up.  Also, the provisions, room bar/refreshments and snacks did not measure up to other Paradisus standards and/or other brand resorts that we have visited.  

They certainly provide high level / high quality drinks and the bartenders at the poolside bar(s) are superb.  The bartenders are courteous, friendly and very hard working.  

The members only section of the hotel is not utilized fully.  There is a large area on the main floor of the section that could be used to provide quite a bit of added enjoyment for members.  It is virtually unused.   The Melia brand projects a high-class image.  This Paradisus maintains that standard in most ways, but can get better.   

There is some recent concern for safety in the area.  We did not feel any trepidation whatsoever.  We spent time on the beach and in the sea and felt comfortable the whole time.

reviews.author: Maria P
reviews.title: All inclusive Resort
reviews.text: Food are all amazing and top of my favorite is the Cielo! Their food is so flavorful thanks to Moises who helped us introduce the mexican food!  Next to our list is the lunch box where you can eat and watch different variety of the hotel shows! And lastly, Lemon Fish, amazing view of the hotel garden! We will definitely come back. Had a great all inclusive experience!

reviews.author: Austin M
reviews.title: All fun inclusive
reviews.text: Karina at Kanna was  one of the best staff. She made our vacation a VACATION!! Also shout out to the manager at Agave and Jorge at Kanna. They are the reasons the hotel is amazing. I can’t remember all names but I must say that we were well taken care of always!

reviews.author: 639pedro
reviews.title: King Treatment experience
reviews.text:
Best ever hotel experience.
We were on a suite on the reserve, which is the adults only all inclusive part of the hotel, and the attention to details was out of this world.
Hotel location Is superb!
It is a must for a VIP stay in Cancun

reviews.author: magedandraous
reviews.title: Great in some, needs to improve in others
reviews.text:
I have mixed feelings towards this hotel.
I loved the beach, the pool, the food and the kidsdom which the kids service they provide.
I hated the room service and they made me mad several time for their lack of action. Also I hated the check in process. 
They don’t tell you that your room is ready, and you have to go into a big line just to ask if your room is ready or not yet.
Overall I rated it as 4 , if they have better check in and better room service I could have given them 5.
Not to forget to praise the kidsdom team “ Tessa, Ivon, Rubi and Brenda, they are amazing.

reviews.author: Tom H
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, excellent staff, serious corporate issues
reviews.text: The resort is impressive, it is beautiful and it feels safe. The beach was beautiful despite significant amounts of seaweed. The local staff were extremely kind, hard working, and went above and beyond almost everytime. Every issue we had was with the hotel itself, mainly being that it EXTREMELY underpays their staff. About 8-12 USD per day. There was even an entire STRIKE where guests had to shelter in their rooms all because Melia refuses to pay their employees fair wages. This is unacceptable. Melia also did not communicate this information to any guests which is extremely concerning. Finding water was almost a constant battle when we were there.

reviews.author: Dyena H
reviews.title: Nice first dinner!
reviews.text: Decent food, very friendly staff! Everyone was super nice, and our server Nathanial was super helpful in taking our order and suggesting a non-alcohol drink for us. His humor in calling my boyfriend "papito" cracked me up and was sweet to bring two desserts for us even though I was hesitant to want only one.

reviews.author: dpman2023
reviews.title: Vacation Cancun
reviews.text: Beautiful resort ..  had a lovely time there with family and friends. Would recommend to friends for sure. Choice of food was great but Malwa was our top place for food. Pool experience was good but couldn’t find chairs or huts always

reviews.author: Anele V
reviews.title: Kids love Kidsdom!
reviews.text:
We were at the Paradisus the week of May 20th. I can mention many things about the hotel but what made these days amazing was the kidsdom. It's not the first time we've stayed at this hotel, but it's the first time we go  with children.
 Kidsdom was the best part because the little ones did many activities and we as parents were able to have some time for us. My kids will miss the Kidsdom teachers. THANK YOU Tessa, Ivon, Rubí, Brenda and Itcel!

reviews.author: Sunshine45041187586
reviews.title: BEWARE - Hotel's pest cockroach pesticide Spray could be unsafe to guests.
reviews.text: There seem to be a cockroach infestation. we observed the hotel maintenance crew with gas gas masks on were spraying pesticide to rooms. This seem to be a protocol to control, but the sprays seem to be high volume, and without guests awareness. On one incident, a maintenance crew with gas mask on, entered our room without knocking the door. my startled wife was asked if they could spray the pesticide, and ofcourse, she rejected the pesticide fumigation offer.  Throughout our stay, we've noticed the hotel's pesticide spray is quite common. The sprays looks to be in between guest checkouts, during daily house keeping, and even while guests are in their rooms. The sprays seem to be around the room's wall/floor perimeter. All guests, especially ones with young children should be mindful of the hotel's pesticide  spray practice.

reviews.author: C L
reviews.title: DO NOT BOOK HERE!!!  BE WARNED!
reviews.text: Booked reservations for 4 premium master rooms for our extended family vacation.  Upon arrival, we were informed that we actual have 4 studio junior suites— NOT WHAT WE HAD BOOKED.  They pulled the ol’ bait and switch on us, folks.  Additionally, check in process takes over an hour and any dinners require setting up reservations through a “concierge” and you may or may not get the time and restaurant that you are wanting.  DO NOT BOTHER COMING HERE.  Not relaxing, not welcoming, just a real pain and hassle.

reviews.author: Paradise822483
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Jesus and Brian from activities is awesome and loved the tequila tasting. Love the hotel and activities and always something to do. Would highly recommend playing volleyball, and other Rec sports on the beach.

reviews.author: mmbj
reviews.title: Almost a 5
reviews.text:
This resort is very large…5 pyramids, with pyramid 3 housing most of the speciality restaurants and the buffet.  We were in pyramid 1….you can walk inside through all the pyramids on level 1 or you can walk outside using stairs and/or ramps.  Lots and lots of walking!
We were in a mini suite, 1301….pyramid 1, level 3, room 01 (very close to elevator).  The room was lovely, very large, complete with a kitchen area and table, comfy bed and ocean front.  Housekeeping was timely and efficient.  Contact Guest Services for beer, soda and water refills.
Unless you book a Reserve Room, an up charge, you will have to make dinner reservations on your own. The desk is close to the buffet and opens at 9. You can book 3 days at one time.
The pool is meandering with a walk up bar on one end.  The water seemed to be deeper than what we are used to but still able to walk with your drink (I’m 5’6”).
Every resort asks that you don’t place a towel on a chair and not return for hours….and we have always respected that. At 7 am when my husband went to get our coffee, every chair had a towel, shoes or whatever on it, to claim the space and yet not a soul was in the pool or on a lounge.  Maybe it was just the crowd that week??? Just be aware.
All staff was extremely friendly and helpful. Staff is constantly cleaning and making any needed repairs.  Lots of foliage in the pyramids…inside can get pretty warm…dress accordingly.  Bathing suit coverups permitted only in the buffet.  Shorts are permitted in all restaurants.
The resort provides a great vacation….we used Otium transportation, from airport.  Excellent, and they have a desk right in pyramid 3 by the shops.

reviews.author: Jessica S
reviews.title: Great couples trip!
reviews.text:
Stayed here for 5 nights and it was a great trip! 

Pros: Blown away by this beautiful resort with many picture-worthy spots in and out of the pyramids. Large pool is perfect temperature for day-time with a smaller heated pool that is nice at night. Many, sturdy straw umbrellas on the beach with view of the ocean. We had a hot tub on our balcony (Junior Suite Lagoon View room); the room was clean and came with a stocked fridge and snacks included. The food was pretty decent for an all inclusive, besides the buffet which was really only good for breakfast. Large majority of the staff were amazing and wanting to give us the best experience. Lemon fish and Cielo were our favorite, waiters were amazing. We finished our night with some drinks at the Ginger bar almost every night, as they had a wonderful space and amazing bartender service, special thanks to Dania who went above and beyond for us, remembering what drinks we liked and making sure we had everything we needed!

Cons: The poolside chairs fill up fairly early, 7am the ocean-side of the pool is filled. Drinks fairly watered down (but we ordered a shot separate with every drink and that fixed it). Seaweed may be present, but there were workers removing it. We had a hard time getting food/drink service while on the beach, although others seemed to be getting their drinks and food so idk about that.

reviews.author: Norma O
reviews.title: To be honest 2021 the instalaciones in the hotel were so much better
reviews.text:
Bad pillow, showers not in good position, please check room 5208
Excelent.  jog for all waiters, males and females, miss Luz at the ginger bar 2 and all the waiters around pool, Baltazar, Sergio, Victor, Cahuich,

reviews.author: Ellie B
reviews.title: We loved the Paradisus!
reviews.text: Our stay at Paradisus was excellent! We spent most of our time at the Reserve pool! The service was amazing and always timely! Our favorite dinners were at Cielo & Capella, the waiters/staff were great and so friendly!

reviews.author: K & K Smith
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
My husband and I had the best anniversary trip! Everyone was so friendly and truly amazing! Ruben, Moises, Miguel, Valeria and Oscar were awesome! They were polite and professional, they were like family! Our butler Mauricio was outstanding, he was very responsive, professional and friendly he went out of his way to give us a great vacation! He made all of our reservations and met us everyday to check in with us to make sure we were having a great time! Our time at the pool with Nicole and Jenny was awesome! They always made sure we had towels and a friendly welcome! We visited the spa for a couples massage Anna and Isabel were beyond amazing so much so we went back for a second couples massage a few days later! William the manager was very friendly and helpful! 
My husband and I absolutely love Paradisus Cancun, the day we arrived home we booked our trip back for this year!

reviews.author: Rusty L
reviews.title: Fantastic, Relaxing Beach Getaway
reviews.text:
Amazing, loved the beach (of course), the pools (very clean with no harsh or smelly chemicals) the staff, the food, the natural cenote style decor inside and sustainable practices throughout.

The restaurants offered fantastic variety and were far above our expectations. Even the Malva buffet was surprisingly great. The staff is all very friendly and accommodating. We were treated fantastically by our servers in Melva each morning, where we would sit and read for hours. Atilano and Gerardo made sure to take care of us and made sure our coffees and teas were always hot and full. Would definitely visit again 😊.

reviews.author: Isaac O
reviews.title: Great holiday plus massive shout out to Julián ortega for his great service made my holiday 1000x better
reviews.text: This is great hotel, service was great especially Julián ortega who was the nicest and most helpful man I’ve met made my experience much 1000x better. Buffet in morning and lunch was good dinner was mediocre. Do recommend.

reviews.author: trishruiz7441
reviews.title: Overall great experience
reviews.text: First time in Cancun, referred by a few people.  We stayed in Reserve and i was very glad as for most part it was very peaceful.  The only issue was some of other guests that couldnt seem to respect the tranquil setting.  Our concierge George was the absolute BEST, very on the ball about helping with everything we needed almost before we even knew we needed something.  We do look forward to returning, as we did become members of the vacation club.

reviews.author: JeraldLacey
reviews.title: RESERVE your room now!
reviews.text: We upgraded to Reserve--money very well spent!!! Excellent staff and product. Excellent service, friendly and accommodating staff; especially the espresso and drink bar, pool bar and Sante restaurant. The only issue, was how the pool cabanas are reserved. It would be great if they could be reserved when booking or limiting reservations per room. For us this wasn't a deal breaker but for pool users it could be.

reviews.author: Alma H
reviews.title: Best Resort in Cancun!
reviews.text:
First of all I want to congratulate they employees and say how excellent treatment my son and I had this trip we did on May 18 through the 21st I want to specially mention the names of the personal who were very kind and met all our needs and  treated us like family their names are Gaby,Moisés , Cesar , Oscar , Luis,Valeria, Jennifer ,Miguel,Ivonn and Diego supervisor for Palapas / Resturaunt outside the resort. They are incredibly respectful very attentive and met all our needs with such a passion to doing their work with so much care to making us have a wonderful stay. I highly recommend Paradysus Resort in Cancun. Paradysus is very fortunate to have them they take their work with so much enthusiasm and passion to meet their guests with so much care and make us feel at home. This is the best of the best !!!! My family and I have membership there we don’t regret having it as we have stayed at other resorts before never we had this kind of special treatment. I also want to mention the reception at the reserve CECI, Jose among the other reception staff. I am very blessed and want to congratulate Paradysus for having such a wonderful staff!!❤️🙏💕I also had my massage done with Angeles she is the best!!
