                                       Mrs. Alma Haman

reviews.author: Karen R
reviews.title: Not as good as it used to be
reviews.text:
This was my 4th time in paradisus cancun and probably my last one .
I used to love coming here because of the great stuff and good food, this time i can’t say the same.
Food isn’t as good as it used to be, staff are not very friendly anymore and it was hard to get a reservation for dinner to the restaurants we wanted to try. and at dinner time It took us more than 20 min to finally be greater. We even convinced some friends to come with us and i know their experience wasn’t what they were expecting.
I’m glad we upgraded to reserve because the only good part about this trip is that we got to see Rene from Kanna area and always makes sure we are having a good time and always so happy to see us. We got to meet Moises and Miguel that took such a good care of us at the reserve area. 
I hope this place goes back to what it used to be because I would love  to come back to see Moises Miguel and Rene.
Thank you guys for been the past part of our trip

reviews.author: Ramses J R
reviews.title: Relaxing, Fun, Simply Amazing
reviews.text: I love the environment there. It was a beautiful and relaxing experience the moment I walked inside. The sleep was wonderful, very comfortable pillows, and there was not much noise during the night. The events they host throughout the week bring a lot of fun and entertainment to balance out the relaxing environment. Would do it again, 10/10.

reviews.author: Amy T
reviews.title: Rodrigo at pool
reviews.text: Rodrigo at the pool was a superstar. He took very good care of us for our whole trip. Went out of his way to bring us more water, ice, drinks before even being asked. Very sweet and great at his job.

reviews.author: Janet R
reviews.title: Wonderful experience
reviews.text: Wow, wow, y wow. What a beautiful resort and what beautiful people they have as staff. My friend and I just got back from staying here a few days and we received the best customer service from everyone working at this resort. Very attentive to all of our needs from the moment we arrived. Rodrigo at the pool took care of us the entire time and went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed and wanted. He was just amazing. We will definitely visit again soon. The food here was great as well. My favorite thing about staying here was all the greenery and smell of essential oils throughout the entire place. It feels like you’re in a spa the entire time!!!

reviews.author: Evandro L
reviews.title: A great resort, but could be better if they stop focusing on business meetings.
reviews.text:
First of all, I would like to say I had a great time and I do recommend the hotel.
However, there are some things they definitely need to re-visit.

The good points: 
Drinks were great
Staff was great
Sea is amazing
Hotel is gorgeous
Ice cream 

The points to improve:
Restaurants: some of them were good, some not quite good. But none of them were excellent. I've been to 4 and 3 star hotels which the food was better.

Kids areas: I booked this hotel because of some pictures I've seen of the indoor soft play areas for my kids. They took that out to make a escape room, which is just nonsense for a resort (but probably is a thing for business meetings, that seems to be their focus now). They have now a small area, where you can only leave your kids with the staff (you can not play with them yourself), which is not what we were looking for.

Concierge: It's very cool to have a concierge service. But my concierge was not very good. She did not sort anything I asked and could not get the reservations I wanted for the restaurants. She just wanted me to waste 2h on a Melia Circle meeting that I did not want to attend. To book restaurants, the hotel could create an app that would be easier for us than having to rely on the concierge.

Swimming Pool area: Probably my biggest disappointment. They are putting the Balinese beds all around the pool and charging $250 usd per day to use it. If you do not want to pay this, there are some very limited chairs, that usually gets taken very early.  I got down to breakfast at 8.30AM and all the chairs were taken, which was annoying as I have 2 babies with me.

It feels that the hotel started to focus only on making money and forgot about the comfort and quality for the clients.
That lead to a focus on Business meetings and the stupid Bali beds all around.
It's still a good resort, but management should revisit their focus/strategy.

reviews.author: Maria Cruz L
reviews.title: Cancun Family Trip
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful and has amazing service. Food was delicious with lots of restaurants and many food options. Staff is  helpful and professional. Gabriela at Sante restaurant and Reserve pool was friendly, efficient, kind and helpful. Pool staff ladies were accommodating.

reviews.author: jeremyT309
reviews.title: Great place but need a couple tweaks...
reviews.text:
So me and my wife have been coming to Cancun for about 20 years now. We even got married at a resort down here and brought 50+ people with us, so we're quite familiar with what to expect and what not to expect with all inclusives on the CUN strip. We went with 1 other couple and we are all around 40 years old. As always when traveling to Cancun, we had a great time. 
The rooms are fine, the air is cold and the showers are hot and there is low noise at night time. There's even a ton of English speaking channels on the TV which is a rarity... Honestly the room and amenities in the room mentioned above were probably the best out of the many all-inclusive hotels we've stayed at on the strip.The grounds are well kept, we had a great time at the pool and there's enough outside activities to keep this resort on par with other ones.  

Back home we produce maple syrup as a hobby so we decided to bring a few bottles down with us to hand out to employees that really stood out from the rest. We figured they would get a kick out of tasting something authentic to our area of the world. 
Three people really made our vacation enjoyable: Samuel and Aldhair at Kanna bar with the swing seats were really fun to be around. Two guys that just love to smile!
Last but not least was Wendy at the Ginger bar on the second floor. She really took pride in making handcrafted cocktails and her service was exceptional and very attentive.

Now let's talk about things they need to improve. Keep in mind we always have a good time when we're on vacation in Cancun, and this was no exception.. Some resorts are better than others and these are just small things that they should change to be on par with other resorts that are at the same price point...

- The small cafe where you can get coffee and tea is small and there's only one person ever working it. This resort has so much wasted space all over the place. I mean you can get lost in some of these hallways that branch off... Put in 2 cafes for early birds like me who want to have their coffee and a Danish and don't want to have a line 25ft long going down the stairs...  And please start carrying green tea. It is probably the most popular type of tea in America and these resorts never carry it. No idea why.

- The restaurants were probably the biggest surprise for us. The portions were tiny, but the biggest issue was the ambiance. There really isn't any. Sure they have the Lemon Fish restaurant in the middle of the hotel with a bunch of bamboo wood slats all over the place but there's no music to make you feel like you are eating Central American, Italian, Asian or whatever cuisine... the workers all have the same uniforms on, from one restaurant to the next, they don't decorate enough as well. You wouldn't think themes or ambience really matter, but it does once you've had it at other resorts

- I would highly recommend changing the signage for items at the buffet. Many items didn't even have a sign so we didn't know what they were in the local flavor section. Just stick them up on the glass barrier and they'll never go missing or get food on them...- Please go back to paper menus and not digital. COVID is over... You wouldn't think you'd care until you go to the Blue agave restaurant and they have them there!

- Night time entertainment needs to get better. Everything is crammed on the second floor at the Ginger bar. Everybody just crams up there and the rest of the hotel is dark and quiet. If they just moved the Lemon Fish restaurant (center) and moved it to one of the hotel wings that are totally desolate, they would have tons of room for nighttime entertainment, shows, etc. right in the middle of the hotel.

reviews.author: stephanieweather2023
reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.text: We stayed in the reserve section for adults and had a fabulous experience. Our concierge was Freda, and she was delightful and very helpful! The food was amazing and I’ve never stayed anywhere or everyone was so friendly and helpful. Some amazing people to note were Frida, Islat and Anna from the spa, Julio at the reserve, and Eddie at Malva. I wish I could remember everyone’s names because everyone worked to ensure the experience was magical.

reviews.author: Alex F
reviews.title: Always is good
reviews.text: I want to congratulate the Paradisus Cancun staff for their passion, commitment and dedication. I am a regular guest at this hotel and I will always return to it. My trip was excellent and the team that attended me deserves my recognition. Here you go guys, Carlos (cappella) , Christopher and Carlos (The lunch box), Víctor (pool's service), Guillermo( the lunch box), in general to all those who failed to mention because there are many, thank you and keep making paradisus a great hotel.

reviews.author: erwinespi1026
reviews.title: Needs maintenance
reviews.text: Rooms needed an update. Staff are nice except the people at front desk. I booked 2 nikte rooms but they treat it as a standard room. They were even going to put us on separate floors even though I requested 4 months ago at the time of booking to put us close together since we have kids and elderly. Complete disregard for our safety as a family! I got so upset and eventually they put us on the same floor. Concierge is non existent as they don’t reply to you. Will definitely NOT book here again.

reviews.author: Caitlyn B
reviews.title: Our honeymoon experience
reviews.text: The service was very good and everyone was very kind and helpful. The activities workers were very fun especially Axel! We did water polo and Zumba with him. The food was over all pretty good, unfortunately the taco place was closed most of the time we were here and that was something we were really looking forward to, but the buffet generally had a lot of options and was very good. House keeping was great and kept all our towels and sheets fresh! Overall we had a great time.

reviews.author: Matthew A
reviews.title: Worth your money
reviews.text: Paradisus was very hospitable from the start. We had the junior suite with ocean view and is the perfect option for any couple. You get a true ocean view which is spectacular. Had a good time with Axel from activities doing water polo, Zumba, and magic. The food was also very good as well as the servers at the restaurants and pool side. Overall a great experience.

reviews.author: Jessica B
reviews.title: Poor service
reviews.text: This resort was just not what I expected and was by far the worst vacation we have been on. The service was subpar, our rooms were dirty, the food was terrible, and our mini fridge was only stocked after we asked a few times. One of our friends rooms bathroom was flooding when using the shower and it took 2 days to move them. Please check out a different resort.

reviews.author: JoefromNYCarea
reviews.title: Truly a relaxing, wonderful way to celebrate a milestone moment or just to get away!!
reviews.text: We've been going for 12+years, having incredible times but this trip some special shout outs for EXCEPTIONAL services- first Violeta our concierge looking over our 4 rooms of or friends, unbelievable food by chef David Tovar, Jenny&Nicole at the Pool, Moses (!!!!), Javier, and Joel at the Pool Cabana with Diego always checking in, and for our delicious breakfast buffet service with Rafael & Ramiro and nights with Dania and Valentin at the Ginger Bar.  Such a wonderful, relaxing and damn good time where all the staff just go above and beyond.  We'll be back soon enough!!  We have gone so often we always feel like we're at home when we walk in to that main pyramid.  Breathtaking!

reviews.author: DLBinne2
reviews.title: I always wanted to try this hotel
reviews.text: I have stayed in many of the hotels in the hotel zone and though I always wanted to try Paradisus I left unsatisfied. It is expensive and it gave me no reason to want to come back or recommend. There wasn't any entertainment to speak of, other than the escape room that we had to pay for, which we did enjoy. The property is very large and hard to find your way around. We were skeptical of the front desk check in that offered us a $92 "upgrade" when we had booked an upgrade with the travel company. The buffet wasn't anything special to speak of and is setup terrible as you are constantly trying to avoid people walking in all kinds of directions. The room wasn't cleaned properly as we found previous tenants earplugs on the floor and I don't know what in the corner, and not cleaned during our stay. The beds were made and was tided up, but those earplugs and I don't know what still in the corner when we left. It was such a production to try to get our 12 year old son his own wrist band to be able to open the room door, which I still don't understand. We were told to go back to the check in desk 3 times in order to check into our room. I had received an email a day or two before that had me check in which I thought was great, but then when I get there that was useless, why even send that email when it doesn't do anything. There isn't any area other than an off track bathroom to change when we get there, why don't you have an area for early arriving guests with lockers or something where you can comfortably change and lock up some valuables prior to checkin? there is certainly enough space for it. When I asked if there is a place where we can change, it seemed like it was the first time anyone asked. Seat saving by the pool and the beach is way too much. We had to walk and walk to try to find something that wasn't saved by 7am. I also don't recall having to pay $15 "tax" before either when I arrive. I am going back to Cancun again in a few weeks and I will definitely see if it is something new or something that Paradisus just decides to charge. Sargassum, wow the Sargassum, so much of it, and no one cleaning it up. On our 3rd day there was a tractor driving back and forth, but wasn't doing anything. We only brought backpacks, so when it was time to get our room they insisted to deliver our bags to our room even though I said no, not a problem we'll take them, then we sit in our room, waiting and waiting for deliverly. So I call down to the desk, and then someone finally comes with our bags. Guess what, they delivered them to the wrong room! The mexican restaurant had taco night, and the tacos were terrible, none of us ate them, and we left. Because the property is so large, you need to have someone that should give you a quick tour because you end up walking and walking around in circles trying to find a place to eat after a long day of traveling. You have to walk through the one outdoor restaurant to get from one side of the pool to the other for some reason, while people are sitting and eating, who thought of that great design, that was uncomfortable. Since there wasn't any other entertainment, why charge for the escape room which was the highlight of the hotel? As I mentioned I have been traveling to Cancun since the late 90's and get there often, but hadn't before had the "Pleasure" to stay at Paradisus, and I was so disappointed. Our stay gave me no reason to go back or recommend in any way. And unfortunately I will have to explain to people that they can find less expensive options with better amenities in the Cancun hotel zone.

reviews.author: cajarktop1127
reviews.title: Solid Choice
reviews.text: While not as it was pre-pandemic I would still recommend. Our concierge, Abel was amazing. Very proactive and genuinely does everything he can to make your experience the best possible. Cesar at the pool is also very good. Sleep quality and rooms rated lower due to AC issues and an unidentified noise that prevented us from sleeping. We had to move rooms twice.  Staff were very quick to offer options and help us out.

reviews.author: marifaria80
reviews.title: Very good Experience!!
reviews.text:
I really appreciate and recommend the great service from the staff!! 
Ramiro in Malva buffet
Javier and Gaudencio at the beach 
Omar in Capella Italian restaurant
Rosanna Zanino from Guest service!
Thank you Paradisus for the great vacation!

reviews.author: Arman_szh
reviews.title: Arman
reviews.text:
The overall experience was very good, Lemon fish and Capella restaurant were perfect. The room cleaness was satisfying but the staff didn’t clarify the way we could use the hotel shuttle so we missed it.
Generally, I would recommend this hotel to everyone as We had one of the most enjoyable and chilling time together there.

reviews.author: jamesV8732NO
reviews.title: 3-star, not a 5 star property
reviews.text: Needs a renovation. Property calls itself a 5-star; it is three star at best. All areas including guestrooms need a renovation. Very worn looking. AC was LOUD in the guestrooms. Some of my associates had rooms that would not cool down. No AC in open lobby areas - very hot and humid. And this is not open air - these areas are separated by doors to the exterior. Staff was very friendly and food was ok. Lemon Fish (Paid restaurant) the food was great.

reviews.author: Piranave C
reviews.title: Amazing would recommend!
reviews.text:
My sis and I had an amazing vacation where we stayed at the beach and pool everyday for hours. 

Guandencio from Kanna was an absolute pleasure and made our stay at the beach more fun and enjoyable. He knew our drink order very quickly and was fun to talk with. 

Martin from Melva made our breakfast and lunch times that much more enjoyable!! He knew our drink order and was very personable. 

It was easy to book excursions. We got to explore around the resort and off the resort. It was a very comfortable stay. Would recommend!

reviews.author: RonH80
reviews.title: What changed?
reviews.text:
In 2020 we stayed here and had an excellent experience.  Services, food, and amenities were great! This resort was actually recommended by our friends, So we had to try it. After our visit, COVID hit and the world shut down. 3 years later, this was the first choice to come back because we had such a good experience. However this time the experience was far from what we originally enjoyed. I can only describe this experience with a single term: "Inconsistent".

I read some of the recent reviews and compared the experience people had. The commonality I have found is that if you didn't have a more "enhanced" reservation, your quality and consistency of experience would differ (Yes, you do get what you pay for).  As an non "enhanced" example, no one wished us farewell on our last day, no one wished us a happy anniversary when every day that we went to a restaurant (even on the day of the anniversary) they would ask "Are you celebrating anything special this evening", we would tell them. Not a word. So I am not entirely sure what the point of asking if you really have no intentions of making a special day more special.

** The positives **: These member's/restaurants is what gave us the positive experiences

Baggage to the room - Sorry forgot his name. But he was very friendly and helpful

Carlo's @ Malva on May 6 evening. He was very nice, friendly, and attentive

Rogelio - Not sure of his position, but he showed genuine interest in our concerns at the front of house. He actually remembered us two days after and asked if we resolved everything.

Antonio @ Agua Marina on May 7. Very good service and friendly.

Miguel @ Lemon Fish on May 9. Very friendly, no questions asked. great service.

Raphael @ Lemon Fish on May 10.  Very friendly, Good service

Ivon, Rubi, Tessa, Itzel, Brenda @ Kidsdom for all the days we had our kids there. They by far get our biggest praise. Our kids couldn't get enough of them. We had to drag our kids out of the kids club because they enjoyed it so much. Thank you!!!  This service and team have always been consistent in quality and care! 

Agua Marina - Great food if you like seafood. The taste, consistency, and quality of food were great here. Hit and miss on service when it gets busy. 

Lemon Fish - If you like Japanese sushi, this is not bad. We ate here twice. Both food quality and service were consistent. I am always hesitant to have raw fish in a foreign country. But the quality was good.

Blue Agave - tacos were good. 

Malva (Buffet) - I am mixed about this place. Inconsistent on quality and variety.  My kids loved coming to the buffet due to the wide range of foods they can select from.  

Overall, no one got sick from the food. That's always a positive. Other than the buffet, all the restaurants we went to were good.

The facility grounds appeared to have been well-kept in terms of the greenery and plants. The hotel tried to clear some of those seaweeds, but honestly. Having 5 people with satchels going back and forth hand-picking them is not productive and not doing any damage to the never-ending seaweed. You need some sort of industrial vacuum to siphon the seaweed out.

Live Music - The live music was good. When they did have them, they were great. The trio at Augua Marina, the Mariachi band one night, and the stage music with singer by the lunch box pool one night. They were good. The music selection and energy were good.

**The Negatives **

As much as I would like to name every person who didn't provide us with a positive experience, I do recognize that most of these staff don't get paid much and rely on this job to support their families. So I would provide this portion of our review as feedback and the reason why we would not be coming back to Paradisus Cancun on next trip to Mexico.

Guest services -  On the first day we were there. we had requested "new" soaps, lotions, body washes, etc. For anything that required a pump and refillable, we requested brand new ones. Our kids had skin sensitivities and would cause serious reactions if the contents of the pumps were in any way contaminated.  We requested this the evening we arrived. We didn't get what we needed till the next day after lunch. But what made the wait for a relatively simple request was not so simple. In between this time, we had called guest services multiple times requesting "new" items, no one showed. Then we went to the front desk and made the same request multiple times. At one point we got ready for the beach before lunch, walked to the front counter and requested again. At that time, the front desk tells me they have already placed it in our room. I said, "its not possible, we just walked down from our room from". So the staff turns his screen to face me to show me it has been done as if I am accusing him of making it up.  I told the staff that we never left the room until now. How could they have replaced all the handpumps when we are in the room? So I caved, and I walked back to my room took a look at the same room we left a few minutes before, and walked back to the front counter to tell him. No, it has not been replaced. This time I had physically removed all the pump soaps and lotions and placed them in the closet so that they understand we need "new" products.  When I told the person at the front desk I had done this, he did not seem pleased. I even called him out saying "Look, I not wanting to take these products home, I just want new ones".  Not sure what clicked in this person's head to understand what I needed. But finally, the person understood I didn't want to re-fill my pumps and I wanted "new" unused ones.  To add insult to injury, he then demanded that I take him to our room and collect the pumps I had removed.  So I walked him to our room, grabbed all of them, and placed it in his hands. Not impressed. We walked back down and I then asked if they can deliver the pumps to the front desk so I can grab it from them. The staff said ok and I went off for the day.  When the day was coming to an end and our family was ready to come back, I went to the front desk to collect the items.  They didn't have it there. They told me a supervisor had sent up the new products. I went up and checked and they appeared to be new.  This process started at around 8 pm May 6 till around May 7, 3 pm.  Wow! That was the first 24 hours

In addition, we had been requesting basic amenities in our room for the first 5 days. each time guest services would either bring partial items requested or not show up at all. This trip really tested our patience to the point I had an argument with my spouse. My spouse is very humble and understanding. But the breaking point for us both is when we showed up in the afternoon around 3 pm, our room was not even made. Then when we came back again just before getting ready for dinner, we realized we were missing towels. Not enough for our family. They just didn't replenish it.  So my spouse called and complained not only about the lack of attention, but one of the towels had a stain on it, as if someone wiped their butt with it. My spouse was very upset and when we tried to convey our displeasure with the guest services, they said "You had a fight because of towels?". There were no apologies for the deficiencies and when we said we threatened to write a review, this person tells us to "Go write a review". As if he didn't care. So here it is.  Customer service was one of the highlights we looked forward to coming back to. But this time, it was below the standard of care and attention by the guest services.  They were insulting, condescending, and not helpful.

Oh, but there is more.  two days before we were about to leave, we get a call from guest services telling us how they valued our business and return to Paradisus, So they'd like to offer us some specials for spas or services.  So you insult us, anger us, discard our requests for 5 days during our stay, then come back and tell us how you value our business.  Really?!?!?!

strangely two days before we leave they also started to deliver full sets of towels in addition to what was provided. Trying to make up for the poor customer service? Nice try but the damage was done. If I operated a luxury resort, regardless of staffing shortages, renovations, or customer requests...Customer Service should NEVER be sacrificed. People can get over delays and shortfalls.... but never customer service.

Cleanliness:
The rooms were ok. There are some obvious TCL needed for the rooms but were in satisfactory condition. We had the lagoon view room with two twin beds.

Pool side was ok. In the morning, if you didn't notice, many of the chairs had some sort of poop on the chairs and towels. That was gross. Probably from the birds or rodents? I dunno.  Watch for it. Looked like little drops of green Hershey kisses. Yuck

Beach side. Service was inconsistent. You have one day where the person was on the ball and tended to all your needs, and check on you.  The other times, you had to go get your own drinks or had to approach them standing in the back.

Food and Hygiene:
The one thing that really grossed us out was the buffet. It wasn't that long ago that the world shut down because of COVID and the spread of this virus.  I guess we haven't learned about sanitation and food handling.  PLEASE have enough tongs or serving utensils!!!!!!! and a place to put them back. We saw serving utensils and tongs handled by people and then place the tongs right into the food.  Staff needs to monitor this. During the 7 nights we were here, every day I have seen guests go to the bathroom and walk straight out without washing their hands. Can you imagine those people handling the tongs and then placing the tongs right on top of the food? OMG.

Pest control.  Need to do something about the fruit flies at the buffet. People don't realize how many of those fruit flies have landed on literally every piece of fruit. Once I saw this, I stopped my kids from eating pre-cut fruits.

Amenities:
One noticeable difference was the lack of amenities for guests.   We sense a significant budget restraint on some things that we thought would have been available. My spouse liked the spin classes, variety of poolside food, and certain giveaways. Non-existent this time. 

Reservations:
We had booked directly through Melia this time versus a third-party travel provider. Although it appears there were more perks and attention being a rewards member, most of the "perks" were not really a perk other than to tempt you to upgrade. One thing I had an issue with was that we were offered an ocean-view room upgrade for a certain rate prior to checking in/confirming our booking.  But once we checked in, they stopped communicating with us. We attempted to get the rate that was offered to us when we got there, but they said this was through reservations and not them.  It made no sense, so we didn't upgrade for that reason. Pretty cut and dry when it comes to cents and dollars.

Exchanging to Pesos:
You can do it at the front desk. But be careful.  We approached the check-in staff about exchange rates from USD to Pesos. The staff made up a rate that was not the hotel's rate.  We checked online and the rate is not even close. Then I approached the supervisor what the hotel rate was. This was not the same rate as what the staff member quoted us.  So we went back to the check-in counter a few hours later and asked again. "How much is the exchange from USD to Pesos". He gave us a rate that was not what the supervisor quoted from the hotel computer. I then asked him directly. "What is your hotel rate?". Then he punches the numbers in the computer and gives us the appropriate value. That is very dishonest, and unprofessional. All I could say was WOW. I didn't expect that.

So how does this all sum up for us?  We won't return.  We are truly disappointed that we feel this way. There were some positives out of this trip. But the negatives have really left us with a bad taste. Some of the staff you have on hand right now need to bring their level of customer service back up to the quality and care of what your resort is claiming to have and what we experienced a few years back.  There was more staff on hand to draw in income services than there are for those who would provide the proper customer service and attention for EVERY guest regardless of how much you pay, what room you stay at, or how much you tip. A few years ago your staff set the bar for service and quality very high. This past week, it has shown that this bar has diminished. If you are short-staffed, say you are short-staffed and will be slower. Honesty comes a long way. I am optimistic that we would return and give it another try. But based on how things went this time around, I don't believe our review would be taken seriously just like how the staff didn't care that we would write a review or consider how the impact of our experience would cause me to write such a detailed and lengthy review.  These reviews seem to be the driving force for a lot of employees at the hotel more than tips. It's a thing now I guess.  I gave credit to those who earned it. Good Luck Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: Tanya T
reviews.title: FOOD REVIEW! You know there’s a problem when the churros are a huge FAIL!
reviews.text:
I’ll start with the positive. There have been a few hits- sea bass, squash soup, coconut creme brûlée. Alcoholic drinks have been pleasantly strong for the most part.
However, when a Mexican restaurant can’t get Mexican food right…that needs to be addressed! Our visit to their Cielo Mexican restaurant was almost a complete disaster of an experience.
 First, The tortilla chips were completely inedible. Literally speaking!
They were so thick and hard you could not break them with your teeth! Extremely greasy as well. 
The main dishes were mostly pork based and the lamb main dish was actually a broth. 
The starters were extremely tasteless and the soup served cold. 
The desserts included a tasteless very chewy, eggy flan. 
 The biggest disappointment? The soggy, noodle-like churros! They were literally dripping with grease. This is no joke. 

We left and decided to check out the buffet for dessert. Every cheap cafeteria that I have ever been to has excelled compared to this one. We took one of each type of dessert and could not find even one that was passable! They may look pretty but they are poor, poor quality food. Extremely bland. 
Picture a hard, dried out cake-like brownie with the least amount of chocolate possible. I even question if brown food coloring was added to make it appear to have more chocolate content.
We ended up with gelato which was better than ice milk, at least.
Milkshakes and smoothies are an option for breakfast (but not lunch and dinner!) 
No pancakes, French toast, etc. for breakfast. 
Lattes can only have whole milk- no skim, oat, etc.
Breakfast menu and especially the dessert menus need to be seriously re-examined. Seriously…they need to hire a neutral third party to come in and revamp.
 It would be well worth the investment. Why, oh why, would they skimp on the food experience!?
Because the resort is gorgeous! Bali beds and pools are amazing and the staff are helpful. It has the potential to be very worth the $$ and the food is something that with a minimal investment they can make a great guest experience.

No access to the menus before you make your reservations is another big miss. Our concierge has been great but he was only provided old, out of date completely different menus.

This is our third day and I’ll update the rest of the trip accordingly. We are hoping that we have not yet seen the best of Paridisus and the food experience will improve dramatically as we visit their more popular restaurants!

reviews.author: randomguest12016
reviews.title: mostly wonderful people, few exceptions
reviews.text: went for my 58th birthday, had a great time.  reservations at Sal on my actual birthday and they would not let me in because they could see my toes, asked them to show were it says I can't wear dress sandals, they couldn't but sure as hell tried to find sometime....  the it was just, well it's our rule, make it up as you I guess, yet there was plenty trash in there in flip flops tank tops and hats at their supposedly finest restaurant.  they were not apologetic but argumentative.  so if you decide to go to that restaurant, be wary, they pick and chose, are discriminatory and sexist.  otherwise, the rest of the staff was great and very accommodating, can't say enough, but you don't argue with a reserve guest who has stayed with you 6 times because you can see his toes... ridiculous, no apologies, nothing, makes you consider not going back.  there's a lot to choose from in cancun.

reviews.author: Cynthia F
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Gabriela is so nice she serves you at the pool at the reserve. She’s very attentive never gives me an attitude always smiling and sweet thank you Gabriela! Thank you thank you thank you!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Dennis T
reviews.title: Please read, 2nd time to this hotel
reviews.text:
The experience my family (2 kids, 12 and 6 and my mom and dad) had last year was so good we decided to come back again to the same hotel this year. Everything from food to activities was amazing and the staff that runs them makes it enjoyable. Everyone that works here is always friendly and caring. 
It was great seeing same people from last year. Thank you again Edier for providing me with best coffee in the morning before our early trips, you are truly a great person and I wish to see you again when we come back. Dede thank you for taking care of my family pool side with anything we needed to drink or eat. 
Special thank you to manager Rosanna for making my kids stay best possible experience. Thank you for the tent in our room, the kids enjoyed and slept in that night. You have great staff beside you, Chris in guest service was professional and helpful anytime we needed anything.
The hotel is beautiful and clean, the pool bars are always ready to take your drink orders. All restaurants on property have fresh food and was one of the bigger reasons we came back. The food was amazing in every restaurant. The buffet Malva was my favorite.  They have so much food selection that it took us 7 days to try it all. I was looking forward every morning to come here.
Thank you all so much for everything you do for us and we will see you again next year!

reviews.author: julie s
reviews.title: Wonderful service at Santé restaurant.
reviews.text: Wonderful experience as always in Paradisus. I specifically want to give acknowledgment to Gabriela Flores and all the staff at the Santé restaurant. They took such a good care of us the whole week. Went above and beyond with service and food selection, even providing  custom food substitutions for us and always with a smile. We can’t wait to come back the this resort again. Thank you for making our vacation experience so luxurious.

reviews.author: Global60103711129
reviews.title: Great Vacation!
reviews.text: My mom and I truly enjoyed our stay here. All of the staff was friendly and accommodating and the resort itself is a lot of fun and relaxing. They really make you feel special, especially Armando at Malva! He remembered my mom and I every time and always made sure to greet us and offer seats in his section.

reviews.author: farshinz
reviews.title: Do not Disturb…. But was disturbed by staff multiple times
reviews.text: Overall an okay experience, I probably would choose a non all inclusive resort because they staff has better quality service. And you feel less obligated to tip everyone all the time. For me, the worst part was having staff walk into our room when our do not disturb sign was on the door. That was a first for me and a reason I would not return.

reviews.author: Omar B
reviews.title: Best vacation
reviews.text: Brenda and Rubi at the kids club made my 5 year old daughter had the best vacation with all the activities in the hotel we really appreciate the time they took taking care of her and that gave my wife and I have some alone time in cancun , I would definitely recommend this hotel to anyone, thank you again.!!!

reviews.author: Alejandro O
reviews.title: EMPLOYEES ARE THE BEST
reviews.text: In my honest opinion. I think the workers are what make this place so great. Don’t get me wrong. I love all the amenities/ restaurants/ location. But if I were to say “what’s the best part about this hotel” I would definitely say the employees. The EMPLOYEES are what made me come back. Time and time again.

reviews.author: Erika C
reviews.title: Cecilia y Dania en El Ginger bar! 😁
reviews.text: Cecilia and dania were absolute wonders of this resort! They danced , they refilled our drinks without asking and always made sure we felt like we’re at home. I love them. I and would totally come to just see them. All workers in the hotel were immaculate!

reviews.author: magescobedo
reviews.title: Great time in Cancun
reviews.text: great family trip really enjoyed the kids club. The butler service was also great.  Really enjoyed nobody wanted to hard sell vacation time share on us during our stay.  I think that was the best thing of our trip.

reviews.author: Carlos J
reviews.title: Masterful April Vacation with enviable service!
reviews.text: Our family just visited this piece of paradise.  We went with toddlers and had the best vacation experience.  We did not know that the Kids Club was paramount to our experience as we were nervous parents in international territories.  We later found out that the service was outstanding and we wished we could've left the kids there more time.  A big thank you to the staff there especially Tessa, Ivonne, Brenda, Rubi, Itzel & Cristel.  Oh, and by the way, not to mention the great service from our pool server Didi, that kid has talent!

reviews.author: Anna S
reviews.title: Do recommend
reviews.text:
It’s a large place but don’t be intimidated. The pyramids and floors are clearly marked. Lots of food options and I’m gluten-free so that is really saying something. 
Asucion was our poolside server and she was a pleasure, very professional. She also had to of had a million steps in a day!

reviews.author: Sabrina B
reviews.title: Lemon Fish: great service from Angel, Rafael, and Carlos
reviews.text: We had a great visit to Lemon Fish! The ramen was delicious and our host, Angel, and waiters Rafael and Carlos, were wonderful! We would highly recommend making sure to visit this restaurant when staying at Paradisus. Thank you for a great experience!

reviews.author: Drita S
reviews.title: Great time
reviews.text: We had excellent service! Everyone was very nice! Atilano Jannett was extremely nice and friendly! On our last day he even placed a board that said “have a safe flight” on the table! Would definitely recommend this resort!

reviews.author: Ron M
reviews.title: Great Holiday
reviews.text: For our first time in Cancún, we had a wonderful trip of 11 days after 3 years with no travel.  Our concierge, Raúl, worked very hard behind the scenes to arrange restaurant bookings and other excursions.  We felt very special and some extra perks from the resort were a nice surprise!  Thank you to Raúl and all the staff!

reviews.author: christopher z
reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text:
Dear Hotel
I am writing to express my deep disappointment and frustration with my recent stay at your hotel for my honeymoon. Unfortunately, my experience was far from satisfactory, and I feel compelled to share my grievances with you.

To start with, the presence of mold in the bathroom was appalling and unacceptable. The fact that the hotel has not taken proper care of its facilities and cleanliness is a cause for concern, and it poses a severe health hazard to your guests. Furthermore, the inconvenience of having to switch rooms twice due to clogged showers was a significant disruption to our experience.

To make matters worse, we encountered roaches in our room, which was incredibly distressing and uncomfortable. This is simply unacceptable, and it reflects poorly on the hotel's hygiene standards.

Moreover, the customer service we received was nothing short of abysmal. The lack of empathy and responsiveness from the hotel staff was frustrating and only added to our already negative experience. As newlyweds, we were hoping for a memorable and comfortable honeymoon experience, but unfortunately, that was not the case.

I would like to request a refund for my stay, as it did not meet the standards we were promised. I would also like to urge you to take immediate action to address these issues and ensure that they do not happen to any other guests in the future. It is crucial for a hotel to provide exceptional customer service, cleanliness, and maintenance to ensure a positive and memorable experience for its guests

reviews.author: Steve C
reviews.title: 5 stars for Pool concierge and staff
reviews.text:
We stayed at the resort for Paradise Blue music festival. We also attended Ember Shores music festival there a few months ago.
Just want to compliment the entire staff on their hospitality and kindness, as well as doing the best they could to keep up with cleanliness and the demands of a sold out resort.
Particularly wanted to highlight the pool team, and pool concierge Luis. He was always present, working hard, was VERY helpful in accommodating us and everyone else. There were many people having issues with umbrellas, cabanas, etc. and Luis and the pool staff really tried to help us understand that the hotel does its best to accommodate everyone, and ensured that we all felt like VIP's
Thanks again, see you next year!
-Steven and Gina Costello

reviews.author: Salvador C
reviews.title: So so
reviews.text: I ‘ d been coming to this great hotel for over 30 years . Great hotel , great team work except this person  named Ricky at the jhi spa . Arrived 10 minutes before they close the entry , he said it was closed on a very un profesional manner , I stated and showed him my cell phone to at least prove him that there were 10 minutes prior closing , he stated it was closed regardless. I argued that if a restaurant closes at certain hour , a client whom goes in would have full access to the menu ; that the spa after it closes should have at least one hour laid work . He stated that wasn’t a restaurant. I stated to him that he had an attitude that needed to change if he was in the hotel business. This person Ricky is in the wrong business , perhaps should apply to be a detention officer at downtown jail .

reviews.author: Kayleigh D
reviews.title: Food was not great and drinks were very watered down
reviews.text: The food left a lot to be desired and the drinks were just sugar. We drank consistently all weekend and never felt drunk. The staff was great. Upbeat, hardworking and friendly. The rooms weren't bad but they were really hard to find and there should have been way more signage/maps posted. Restaurants had small menus. Beds were very uncomfortable and the pillows almost made us MORE uncomfortable than not. They did keep the place very clean throughout the weekend. Worth noting we went for the Paradise Blue Music Festival, although the food/drinks and level of service should be the same.

reviews.author: Raiinbaby
reviews.title: What a scam.
reviews.text: The hotel room had no A/C and we had to sleep outside due to how hot the room got. The laundry staff took $30 from us for laundry and then the front desk extorted us for that same “payment” under the excuse that the staff doesn’t speak English and took it as a tip even tho we clearly asked how much we owed and they said $30. Once I questioned it- they told me not only did I have to pay it again, it was now $60 for a few pants and bathing suits. The staff was walking around charging $300 for cabanas and then later we were told that they were supposed to be free and not to give them that money because they are just asking and are considering it a tip. When questioned about that, the front desk used the excuse that they don’t understand English well and probably just assumed it was a tip for their service. My entire group left feeling like the hotel runs a very scammy business and uses the fact that they speak Spanish as a way to take more money from you.

reviews.author: VVal12
reviews.title: Cockroaches infestation BEWARE!!!
reviews.text:
Nightmare experience! 
Booked this hotel for my family for 1 night because our flight was canceled.  
Check in took more than 1 hour in a line.
We were given an extremely old room in building 1. Room number 1401
AC was blowing in the face non stop, so it was impossible to sleep. At 3am I went to the barroom and turn on the light. 1 cockroach was sitting on the ceiling, another one was on the floor. I stepped back, and could not believe my eyes. One more was running near the trashcan. I went back to the bedroom, turn on the light, yelled at my husband that we need to pack bags - cockroaches in the barroom. I put my clothes on and noticing another cockroach crawling up the curtains.
I scream and move a suitcase - 2 more roaches running, they were sitting under the suitcase, one more under baby stroller. I screamed on the top of my lungs… I videotaped what I could and was out of the room in 10 seconds. 
They gave us another room with sea view. Who needs sea view when your luggage could be infested with roaches?   We spent 3 hours checking our luggage and backpacks, washing and throwing away things roaches could crawl on. It was the worst night ever! I was mentally and physically exhausted. We left in 4 hours to catch up with a new flight. 
My family should be compensated for the real horror night we went through and for our belongings we had to throw away.
I’ll file a complaint with local health and safety organization asap.

reviews.author: jimyerenee
reviews.title: Paradise Blue Round 2
reviews.text: last year when i visited cancun for this music festival we stayed at the marriott but spent majority of our time here at paradisus. i’m happy to say this year was way more accommodating and overall a better experience staying w paradisus. nothing against marriott, but anytime we needed anything there was always someone readily available and happy to help 24/7. definitely will be back again next year and hopefully sometime sooner :)

reviews.author: Xxrxnvxxnzxn
reviews.title: Great first All inclusive experience!
reviews.text: Indoor jungle! Just a beautiful resort. Food options for everyone, definitely a foodie paradise. Alcohol was available everywhere. The Reserve was well worth it, top shelf alcohol, separate tower with no kids running around, private pool and cabana. Concierge was included, they will help you setup dinner reservations, if you have any requests or questions they are there for you. I am telling all my friends and family to stay here, we will be back soon!

reviews.author: Jeremy D
reviews.title: Top Tier Experience
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus Cancun for three nights during Paradise Blue festival. I've never seen workers at a hotel more hospitable and hard-working.  They earned and deserved every tip they received. From the welcoming doormen to the waiters to those quickly squeegeeing the water off the floor by the pool to keep the walkways safe, the consistency of high-quality customer service was unreal. Not one rude or unhelpful interaction the entire stay.  Rooms were cleaned and towels restocked almost within an hour or two of putting up the doorknob sign. Food buffet was tasty and varied enough to not be bored for a few days. The hotel layout can appear maze-like at times due to the similar looks of the towers so navigation can be a bit confusing for the directionally challenged as myself. No fault of the hotel. I would recommend bringing insulated tumblers to pour water bottles into as the bottles are not large.

reviews.author: Brooke D
reviews.title: AMAZING STAFF
reviews.text: The service at this resort was incredible. Anytime we had an issue with anything, the staff was prompt to remedy the issue and never took longer than 5 minutes to have someone at our room. Didi from the pool bar was EXCEPTIONAL. He remembered all of our names and what we liked to drink , regardless of how many people were around. He always made sure to check on us frequently and see if we needed anything else. Jesus at Agua Marina was also another wonderful person and made me laugh so hard. Both of those men will be the main reason that I return to this resort, not only for the experience, but for the hope that I’ll get to see them again.

reviews.author: Stefanie V
reviews.title: Exceeded my expectations!
reviews.text: We have been Meliá Members for many years and for some reason never visited Cancun. I made reservations late this year and when everywhere we usually visit Punta Cana, Playa del Carmen, Los Cabos was booked we decided to go to Cancun. As this property does not yet have the Circle Experience I wasn't expecting much but was very very happily surprised with this hotel. The service was excellent, consistent and on point no matter where we went. Everyone was so so friendly and eager to make each experience positive. Our concierge Jose went above and beyond to make sure we had anything we needed. Eliot and Josue at the beach were excellent always had everything prepared for us. We prefer the beach to the pool which was gorgeous. The beach is clean white sand blue water very little if any seaweed and the waves were a lot of fun. The buffet had a lot of choices and the quality was fantastic! We love Mexican food and went to the blue agave for Mexican style breakfast (chilaquiles, huevos rancheros) café de olla every day! Marco and Ángel were amazing super friendly always welcoming and had our coffee before we asked! At night we met Lugo manager of the Mexican restaurant who gave us some amazing history about the dishes being served and I have to say food was excellent! We also enjoyed Lemon fish for Japanese, beautiful setting in wood style in the lobby surrounded by greens! Agua Marina was outside with live entertainment and Mediterranean seafood which was also fabulous. Our room was newly renovated and very nicely decorated. We had ocean view and listened to the waves every night as we slept. I never expected this vacation to be as good as it was but I highly recommend Paradisus Cancun!!! We will be back for sure!!!

reviews.author: Daniel S
reviews.title: Lemon fish restaurant
reviews.text:
The staff at Lemon Fish, especially: 
Jorge (waiter), Daniel (Host), Alejandro (bartender) made me feel at home. Could not say enough about their service. 10/10. Love these guys. Stoked. These guys are simply the best to do it.

reviews.author: Mason L
reviews.title: Paradise Blue Experience
reviews.text: Every staff member I have met has been exceptionally helpful and so very kind. Being able to come down to Mexico the first time gave me the most amazing service. At the pool bar Alberto, Daniel, Melin, Chan, and Luis, Gomes all were very kind at the main pool bar and they made sure to take care of us on our extra day here. The staff not just at the pool bar but all over the hotel was so friendly and helpful and was able to help us exceptionally quickly and efficiently. The rooms and the view I got to experience was a the perfect vibe on top of the festival my friends and I were attending. I definitely plan on returning to experience this hotel as long and as often as I can with my friends. The house keeping staff also made it a point to take care of our room and clean it despite the amount of sand and dirt that was tracked in from the beach. I plan to keep coming back on long as I can to the amazing staff and beautiful facilities at least once a year if not more. The only downside was the constant construction work going on around the hotel, however that didn’t impact our experience in any way as they made it a point to keep respectfully out of the way. The only complaint I would have is the slow elevators, especially because on the one side of the main lobby the elevator ended up breaking. Nothing else gives me a reason to complain otherwise. Thank you everyone who took care of us!!

reviews.author: Nicolas P
reviews.title: I will absolutely be coming back and hoping to es all the same servers!! Jessenia and Asunción were my absolute favorite
reviews.text: I had the absolute best experience almost solely due to the attentiveness and consideration of the waiting staff! They went above and beyond to make sure our time was spent completely relaxed and taken care of.

reviews.author: Kali
reviews.title: Paradise Blue 2023
reviews.text: Joel from Sante is the real OG. Always smiling and having a great time. Service is great and the hospitality is unmatched. Tip your service staff please they work very hard and are very accommodating to your needs. Until next year ⚡️❤️

reviews.author: Kelli C
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun -YES!!!
reviews.text: We had an amazing time! Food service at the Buffet  was fantastic and Ignacio /Nacho will take amazing care of you! I have been to this resort five times and he is always there and always with a smile on his face! His team of Martin, Pascual and Jerry are very attentive,, pleasant and great fun to be around! Five stars for this team!

reviews.author: Katheryn S
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: All employees were wonderful and made us all feel welcome & at home! Beautiful hotel, amazing food & awesome environment. Really enjoyed the spa! Angles and Lendor did amazing! Really overall recommend this hotel. Will definitely be back soon!

reviews.author: Jaime A
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: This restaurant was awesome service was great!  Especially the waiters Jhony Didier and Alfredo Aluala. They went beyond to make our breakfast and lunch experience the best !! A+ service very clean friendly .

reviews.author: Breanne
reviews.title: Not what it used to be that’s for sure
reviews.text: Do not book with MVC. The customer service was TERRIBLE! You will feel like a 3rd rate customer. They only cater to the resorts circle club members and have obvious preferential treatment. The resort gets quiet at 6pm, no outdoor bars remain open, there is one buffet with very average food and no variety throughout the week. Sergio at the hooka bar outside was the only fantastic aspect of this resort. Rooms need to be updated, we stayed in building 2, and maid service needs to step up their game. Sadly we would never book here again due to the average food, terrible MVC checkin service, and dirty beach. If you’re looking for entertainment on site and an upbeat vibe this resort isn’t for you.

reviews.author: Alice S
reviews.title: Great place to vacation
reviews.text: We came in on a Friday. George was our butler throughout our stay and was amazing. He made everything smooth. It was our anniversary, and he made sure we were treated extra special . Also,we had massages at the beautiful spa, and David made everything just perfect. He let the sweet ladies that did our massage know that it was our anniversary,and they had a card waiting for us in the room. David was so helpful. The ladies that did our massages were amazing. We have never had a bad experience here. This will be our 8th year coming to this resort. The ladies names that gave us our massages were Itzel and Maria Isabel. Outstanding!!!! We had the aromatherapy.  There are soooo many names that I’m sorry if I can’t remember them all. Valeria who works at the Reserve bar took great care of us each night,  and she makes the best drinks. Plus she is so very sweet. We love having breakfast and lunch  at LaPalapa outside by the ocean. The food is top notch. Their omelets are amazing and that comes with bacon, sausage and a hash brown. For lunch I would get the tenderloin skewers and a plate of fruit. I’m still thinking about it. Their coffee is pretty amazing too . Luis has taken care of us there many times and does a great job. We always try to tip them each time. They are so appreciative. The only cons I have, was that when it rains, there are way too many leaks in the ceilings . We almost slipped several times. It’s time to fix the roof guys. Another, is that the US is still making us have negative COVID test before we return home. Melina now charges for this. Before, it was part of our stay. Anyway, this is a beautiful property with amazing employees that make it what it is .

reviews.author: Raine V
reviews.title: Lemonfish
reviews.text: Jorge and Miguel were our wonderful servers and they went above and beyond making our experience here amazing. The food was prepared by Karen and Salma and it was so impressive. Pansa llena y corazón contenta!

reviews.author: Co B
reviews.title: Capella restaurant
reviews.text: Jesus is the best!!!! So kind and friendly.. very attentive and on top of service.. favorite restaurant on the resort. He made the stay much better. We went back two nights in a row and specifically asked for him. The food and drinks were great especially the drinks!! Thank you Jesus!!!!!

reviews.author: Sylvia K
reviews.title: Paradisus is wonderful
reviews.text: Miguel Marcan at guest services was so helpful and kind. He called to confirm our airport shuttle for us and we are so grateful for his assistance. You could not ask for any better customer service. He is the best.

reviews.author: Ken F
reviews.title: Paradisus experience
reviews.text: Wonderful experience despite ugly weather. Miguel of guest service and Luz at the bar was EXCEPTIONALLY PHENOMENAL!! Overall wonderful experience and everyone was very friendly! Definitely recommend !!!

reviews.author: Amandeep S
reviews.title: Amazing service provided by Atilano, Fernando and Alberto. Thank you for looking after us
reviews.text: Amazing service provided by Atilano, Fernando and Alberto. Thank you for looking after us. We enjoyed our breakfast with amazing views at the lunch box, The staff at Paradisus cancun are very helpful and very friendly.

reviews.author: Sylvie-Anne T
reviews.title: Lemon fish
reviews.text:
Rafael my server was  so nice with everything, great place great staff I will come back again loved it. The decor is outstanding, the atmosphere is relaxing and the food was delicious, perfect evening 
Thanks Rafael for making my evening to remember

reviews.author: Griffin D
reviews.title: Waiter jose Luis aqula
reviews.text: Most excellent waiter Ive ever had. He is the most professional courteous man in the restaurant. He does a fantastic job and I highly recommend. 10/10 experience! Luis is a waiter at Cappella  under captain Carlos chay and I highly recommend his service! Excellente!

reviews.author: Omar
reviews.title: The best hotel.
reviews.text: Best experience i've ever had. Thanks to the guest service team. They've helped me a lot. Special thanks to Rosanna, Miguel, Christian, Monica, Raul, Daniel and Faby. Also thanks to the security team, especially Yuramis. Their kindness was heartwarming.

reviews.author: Grande Gonzalez
reviews.title: Very sad. No more "Royal Service" no more "Adults Only"
reviews.text: My wife and I go to Melia Paradisus in Cancun twice a year normally in February & October. They use to offer what was called "Royal Service" which has since been replaced with "The Reserve" Removing "Royal Service" was a BIG MISTAKE for the Melia brand. There are five buildings. Building number five use to be for adults only. Now they allow children. Where you use to be able to relax in serenity there are now screaming children. When you have four other buildings for families and children WHY would you take away relaxation for adults? For the past ten years we always went in February but since they were booked we tried March. NEVER AGAIN! There were a bunch of rowdy drunk underage spring breakers. The pool side bathrooms were always dirty and out of paper. They were short on lounge chairs by the pool and when we asked why they said that a private school had a big party of which fights broke out and they destroyed a lot of the chairs. Our first day of five days we had to lay on a towel on the concrete by the pool. Kids in private school are wealthy. Their parents are wealthy. The kids should have been arrested and their parents should have paid to replace the new chairs! It is so sad to see what was once a 5 star luxury resort turn into a 2 star hotel. There use to be a manager by the name of Lazaro. He was an asset to Melia. He understood customer service and trained his staff with that same mentality. Now that I have voiced my concerns on the resort itself I must mention THE GOOD that is still present. It is the staff. Even with all the bad changes that have been made to the resort ALL of the staff always try their very best to accommodate the guests. If your name is not mentioned here it is because there are so many of you that do an amazing job and it would take pages to list. But I do need to mention a few. It is always a pleasure to see Moises and Valerie poolside. They are always smiling and happy and they always go above and beyond to please. It was also great to see my old friend Djordje (George) The three of them have been there many years and have always helped to make our stay special. Our past two visits October 2021 and March 2022 we met Janick a concierge and Diego a manager. Both of them also go above and beyond with all the guests providing top notch customer service. I am a business owner who understands and appreciates hard workers. Diego is a great manager. He is never standing around he's constantly moving. I watched him manage both staff and guests and his level of service is impeccable. In closing I hope that the corporate office of Melia reads this review and reconsiders their removal of "Royal Service" At the very least they should return building five to adults only. I have children but need a break every once and a while. Every adult needs a getaway to relax without hearing screaming kids.

reviews.author: Alyssa G
reviews.title: Amazing service with amazing waiters
reviews.text:
This was a very amazing Luxury  experience. The hotel is beautiful and the service in each of the restaurants was amazing. The attend to every need and are always incredibly friendly. And people tip your servers !

 Our favorite breakfast server in the main buffet was gauldencio. He was funny, super friendly and an amazing waiter 💜 we plan on going back and soon! We wanted to stay longer!

reviews.author: Trail221150
reviews.title: NICE SERVICE
reviews.text:
We been here Paradius Cancun 2nd time. 
1st time we been here on Octorber, 2021.
These gentlemen treat us really nice.
We will come back soon!
Alfredo Arcos
Alex
Cruz

reviews.author: AlyssaGonzalez
reviews.title: Yellow Fish - 5 Stars !!!
reviews.text: Our dining experience at yellow fish was nothing short of amazing. Our server jorge went above and beyond, recommending different dishes and cocktails . The food was delicious ! Our favorite restaurant at paradisus cancun . Antonio & Karen are amazing chefs .

reviews.author: Tatiana Rua
reviews.title: Babymoon
reviews.text: Amazing hotel & service. GABY took great care of us by the pool everyday, her service was amazing and super attentive with us. LEONOR & DANIELA gave us a great couples massage. We were very pleased by how clean everything was.

reviews.author: Dina P
reviews.title: Beautiful Scenery and excellent service
reviews.text: The staff was top notch! Especially Joni, Toni, Atilano in the Buffet restaurant. The trip started out a bit challenging with having to change our room 3 times but the staff helped us push through for what turned out to be a great vacation! Thank you

reviews.author: TMON2014
reviews.title: Lemon Fish!
reviews.text: We had a great dinner at Lemon Fish! Rafael you as a very attentive and friendly server! He was very knowledgeable and accommodating for a gluten allergy/sensitivity - much more than my average server at a restaurant back home in North Carolina. He kept the drinks flowing and was all around fantastic! Thank you for a great dinner!

reviews.author: Mogenta
reviews.title: Large and beautiful resort
reviews.text: This resort is beautiful.  We had reserve service so had a butler who set up all of our ala carte dinners.  Pools and kids club were great.  Service and people were amazing.  The Mexican restaurant is a must!  We would definitely go back.

reviews.author: Amanda K
reviews.title: Amazing!!!!!!!!!! Best resort in Cancun!
reviews.text:
Overall we truly enjoyed our stay and had an incredible vacation and experience. This is the best resort in Cancun! I was highly impressed and would not only love to return but would love to stay at another Melia property.

We upgraded to Reserve level and it was well worth it! They assign you your own concierge and Frida took such good care of us, making everything so easy and smooth- from booking our dinner reservations and any other request we had. We had access to an adults-only pool and amazing restaurant Sante that’s exclusive for Reserve only. We also had the ability to book Bali beds at the pool, which was our favorite part, plus room service was included.

I am a huge foodie and that’s probably the most important thing for me. In this area Paradisus Cancun is much better than any other all inclusive I have been to. Room service was pretty good, which is rare. They do a great job with authentic Mexican food- blue agave is sooo good for tacos. But our favorite was Cielo- we had an absolutely amazing experience not once but twice! This restaurant and its incredible food made our vacation unforgettable. The first time our server Jose was just wonderful in every way and so sweet. We loved the food so much we came back again and our server this time, Noe, was beyond incredible. He went above and beyond to give us a memorable experience. Everything from the guacamole, margaritas, the amazing appetizers to entrees and desserts. The tlayuda is an authentic dish from Oaxaca and it’s a fusion of flavor that’s mind blowing! I’ll remember it for the rest of my life. Be sure to ask for the habanero sauce for a yummy kick! Chef David is a genius!

Some other highlights:
The staff is by far the best part. They really take care of you and are ALL so genuinely sweet, especially at restaurants. I will never forget them. Especially Cesar who serves the Bali beds and Sante restaurant, and took such good care of us. Every single person throughout the property greets you and checks in on you. This is top notch service!!!!
Beautiful design and aesthetic everywhere, loved the boho look and the plants everywhere in the lobby. It also smells soooo amazing and fresh everywhere!
Impeccably clean in rooms and throughout the property.
Our room was beautiful and had everything we needed. No issues whatsoever.
The beach is gorgeous! Stunning views of the Caribbean Sea .
Spa is A1. We had amazing massages and wonderful experience.
They do a great job with covid protocols. All staff wear masks religiously, which is very reassuring. They sanitize luggage and have bleach pads for your shoes. They make you wear masks at the buffet which is definitely necessary. And all paperless menus everywhere with bar codes. 
Drinks are stronger than most all inclusive resorts, which is nice!
Guest services was great anytime we needed something sent to the room and even call to follow up and ensure you received what you need.
Loved their bracelets that are used for room keys and to display your level. Much better than the ugly wrist bands most resorts make you wear.
Covid tests are required for travel back to US and they offer covid tests in house in the resort for $25 USD which is very convenient and also cheaper than external to the hotel.
I also appreciated that the resort wasn’t catered to only Americans, which is refreshing compared to most places. I loved that guests were from all over the world and that you’re able to experience some culture.

The only complaint I have is that it’s extremely hot throughout the inside of the lobby and main areas, which makes it uncomfortable at times.

I highly recommend the Paradisus Cancun for an upscale experience that delivers in very way. This place is highly impressive and they do a wonderful job in every way. Out of all the many resorts in Cancun, I did a ton of research and am so happy I chose this one for an unforgettable experience.

reviews.author: CNC1980
reviews.title: Amazing views and staff!
reviews.text:
This is my 2nd time to Paradisus Cancun. The beach views are the best on hotel zone. The water is very blue and lots of waves. You can just listen to the waves crashing. The pools are long, beautiful and really perfect. No hot tubs on this property which they do need for Nov Dec Jan or when its cooler or rains. 

Food has always been great. Funny thing we prefer the Malva buffet for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Went to Cielo and Lunchbox for dinner but would have preferred Malva buffet as their buffet foods have such a great variety and soo good. Agave is a good place too.

Big shoutout to Malva staff Marteen Ku, on our first night he brought us the best margaritas.  DD was so amazing with so much energy and love as well as Armando and the fellow staff (sorry didn't get all the names but I do know their faces). Malva staff works extremely well so don't forget to tip them before you leave! Muchas gracias mi amigos!!!!

Rooms are great, love the lotions soaps etc. Order a robe from Melia app. No cost.

Entertainment is sparse but have limited day and night activities/shows.  Would like to request more dancing and singing shows. All shows are intimate and in Ginger Bar area. Check Melia app for schedule. 

Wonderful pool and beach staff always there for you. Little seaweed but got more seaweed when storm was coming. I stayed May 15-20. 

Easy check in and check out. Staff is top notch in all areas. 

Antigen covid tests available but not free anymore. 

Loved our stay and highly recommend Paradisus Cancun!

Ps I always get Ocean View Balcony but haven't tried Reserve side yet 

Side note when I came first time in Nov 2021, there is 1 heated pool, rest of then ice cold but grateful for that 1! 

Muchas gracias Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: Sarah S
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, great staff who really love what they do
reviews.text: From the first day of checking in, to the last day of checking out, all staff members have been super friendly and polite. The food was pretty good for an all inclusive, and the restaurants were great. At Malva, Martin was our server all week and he always remembered me and my boyfriend, and offered the daily juices of the day which were all delicious. He was always attentive and very friendly. I ate at all the restaurants- seafood, Latin, Mexican, Italian, and Japanese. Moises at Ciello (Mexican restaurant) was excellent and explained the menu items in detail. Everything he recommended was so delicious that we came back a second time. We were helped by Melvin the second time around who was also pleasant. The head chef also came around asking for feedback but I had nothing but positive things to say. Jesus at Capella (Italian) was also great and the food was amazing, especially the risotto! Saul and Axcel made the activities very fun. I participated in beach volleyball daily, did water aerobics, and jump fitness. They really tried their best to engage all guests and they participated in the activities as well. The servers by the pool and beach were great as well, constantly checking up on us if we wanted more drinks. Also, cannot forget to mention the main center area of the resort is absolutely gorgeous. I also liked how there was some kind of event every night. Was recommended this resort by many friends, and will definitely return!

reviews.author: Arman G
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: We love paradisus Melia. We ate at Marva every night for dinner , Samuel Sosa was our waiter ever night. Dude went out of his to serve our needs. Very friendly, professional, plyful with our kids. We love Mexico, we will come back. Ty Mexico and Samuel.

reviews.author: Usman B
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: After visiting 6 resorts and numerous restaurants I can honestly say Lemon Fish has been the best experience ever and special thanks to Jorge & Miguel who were our servers along with Mario & Karen the chefs! I can not emphasize enough how amazing they all were and making our dinner the best night so far! Hands down they deserve a 10/10!!!!!

reviews.author: Omarski2001
reviews.title: Anniversary vacation
reviews.text:
My wife and I came to visit 3rd week of May for anniversary. We were both very happy to see the hotel after seeing pictures and vlogs of the beautiful atrium garden layout. It was so much more beautiful in reality.  The Malva restaurant buffet was extremely good and does not hold back from the variety and/or quality of food At all.  We definitely want to thank Alfredo at the Malva for taking care of us during breakfast and lunches. The made to order tacos and omelets as well as the fresh options were all excellent.  
  At the reserve pool our server Yamil and the one man crew Roque at the Bartender station of Sante were very excellent in taking care of my wife and I at the Bali beds with our drink and food orders. 
  Setting up the Bali beds was Max and Jennifer who were very friendly. 
  Miguel at the Reserve bar in pyramid 5 was very knowledgeable in premium spirits and great to conversate with on a variety of things.
   The gourmet reservation only restaurants were all very  Exquisite. The portions are smaller but the attention to detail and ingredients used are things that you will not find  in Other run of the mill restaurants at most other resorts or of this star rating. 
Of course you are always free to revisit or order a second serving of something that you really liked and the Servers will take care of you with pleasure.
  Definitely would come again to visit Cancun.

reviews.author: Dave P
reviews.title: Cappella restaurant at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Wonderful experience for dinner. Our server was Fernando and he made our evening even better. Great food, great service all around. We will definitely visit Cappella’s again! Looking forward to our next time here.

reviews.author: Dianie C
reviews.title: DO NOT Recommend!!!
reviews.text:
Worst experience ever! What a rude environment! We spent almost 2 hours to check in. During that time we asked 3 different customers service reps to help us check in perhaps at a different counter, and they all said that we needed to wait for assistance at the counter we were at, because that was the only one available at that time. After it was finally our turn the girl at the counter told us we needed to go to a different counter because we were part of a group that were there for a convention and the other counter had all of our information and she didn't (but all counters have the same system, so how come she wouldn't be able to see our info?). I refused to go to another counter to start another line after waiting almost 2 hrs for them to tell me that, and after 3 people from their staff had assured us that's where we needed to check in at. After I firmly told her a few times I was not going anywhere else, she decided to check us in.
Also, when I was making the reservation online their system refused my card 3 times telling it declined. I checked with my bank and they confirmed the hotel never ran it through, therefore the bank never declined the transaction, so their system was acting up. I then decided to use the PayPal option they had available at their site. The transaction went finally through. Going back to the day we checked in, the girl at the counter decided to tell me that she was going to have to reverse the transaction because I used PayPal and it was under my business name and not my personal name (so why take the payment in the first place?) What the heck is wrong with this people??? After arguing for a while we were finally able to get our room keys... THE ROOM: Hot as hell! The entire hotel is hot. There is no way to get the AC pumping in your room, they control it. There is not enough lighting either. The phone didn't work. And the wall outlets have all been closed so you can hardly find where to plug your phone or even your flat iron!!! Some of our friends had problems also from lights not working AT ALL to even being getting someone else's room! Imagine being changed from room to room 3X and going into one and finding someone else already there. SHM!
We went into one of their restaurants and when one of my friends went to go serve herself she was told in a very rude way to put the serving spoon back, wait 5 min and come back, because they weren't ready and they were doing us a favor by opening a few minutes earlier. Ahh! And be ready for only bottom-shelf spirits. I mean, we supposedly are at a 5 Star Hotel (not cheap at all!!!), so you would expect some sort of better customer service and come on!
