Better maintenance too! I DO NOT recommend this place to nooo one! Cancún is beautiful and their people are nice, except for that inhospitable place!!! Very disappointed.

reviews.author: Láiza M
reviews.title: NOT VEGAN FRIENDLY
reviews.text: If you are vegan, has allergies to cow milk protein just DO NOT COME to this hotel. The website says “there are vegan options in all restaurants”it’s a lie. I mean if you are willing to spend money to eat salads then you go. There are very little few people that knows what vegan is, everything and I mean EVERYTHING has butter on it. Guest service is a joke, they solve absolutely nothing. We still have some days ahead of us here and EVERY meal is stressful.

reviews.author: Teri T
reviews.title: May 2022 Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: We loved the Paradisus Cancun!If you are looking for a relaxing place this hotel is for you.  The hotel was beautiful and very well manicured.  We paid extra for the Reserve and I felt it was definitely worth it.  We had a special reserve section adults only pool with beautiful Bali beds that we reserved and are included .  It was very quiet on that side.  Shout out to Jennifer at the Reserve section- she was amazing with the Bali bed reservations and she went out of her way to answer our questions and to make our stay memorable thank you!  Also at the Reserve we had a concierge , Alexandre- he was professional , courteous and also provided outstanding service!  He made all of our dinner reservations , suggested activities and also went the extra mile to help us especially when we had a problem with one of our activities .  Thank you Alexandre!  One more shout out to Oscar from activities - he kept us engaged and was so friendly and nice -great job !  We painted a bag , finger painted and canvas painted , did a mixology class amongst other activities.  Also the wait staff was very attentive at the pools they were always asking if you needed something .  Check in was awesome we were greeted with a welcome drink and the room was clean with snacks and a fully loaded refrigerator.  We also booked several massages which were excellent!  If you plan to go for a massage take advantage of the pre- book offer for the savings .  The spa was beautiful and we felt it was worth it.  They also have a nice gym and tennis courts that we took advantage of.  The food was ok- we went to a different restaurant every day and the Reserve section included another restaurant called Sante which had a nice selection of menu items.  The buffet breakfast had a good variety including an omelet station.  We also ordered room service a few times which was good .  We took advantage of booking a family photo shoot where you received 3 photos free if you are staying at the reserve and you pay $20 for an additional one.   We gave the hotel a 4 because it lacked in entertainment.  They did not have the shows and entertainment that they used to have and it seemed like it was the same thing every night.  There would be a dj at the bar and I believe they stopped the dj at 12pm. Also they did away with giving free Covid tests.  The testing also did not go well because we made appointments but for some reason still had to wait 30-45 minutes to have the test administered which was aggravating.  In general we had a great relaxing stay.  We loved the hotel and they definitely were amazing when it came to service.

reviews.author: C Eichten
reviews.title: Blue Agave us the Best!
reviews.text: I have been to Paradisus Cancun many times, but never bothered to stop at Blue Agave for dinner.  Skip the nightly buffet and go here instead, authentic Mexican and absolutely outstanding.  The pazole soup, and any and all of the tacos and quesidillas are amazing.  Go check this place out, worth the stop and take your time!  Jose and Vicente will take care of you!

reviews.author: Tim
reviews.title: Trip with friends, 2nd time here, will not be back~!
reviews.text:
The resort is beautiful. My 2nd time here, but unfortunately I will not be back. The rooms are dated and only 1 electrical outlet to use in the whole room for your devices. Trip hazard to the bathroom. Don't stay on the 3rd level facing the adult pool, the exhaust from the restaurant below came into the room even with the crappy sliders closed. The slider was beat up and in poor condition. So our room smelled like burned oil all the time. Housekeeping took our un opened bottle of bubbly after the 1st day! WHY? We were saving it. Why take away an unopened bottle? Not cool! 
Could not book the Italian Restaurant, no openings were available. The other food was descent. If you are thinking about the Reserve upgrade, it's not worth it at all. Total rip off to charge so much more and not get the added value you think you will get. Trust me, I have been to Cancun 6 times, did the VIP upgrades before at other resorts and this resort is terrible for the upgrade. Save your $. Will never return here unfortunately.

reviews.author: Latisha J
reviews.title: Enjoying some me time!!
reviews.text: The Paradisus Cancun resort is fabulous!! The service and amenities are excellent!! Axcel with activities made sure I had an enjoyable experience!! If you are looking for a relaxing experience I definitely recommend 👌🏾

reviews.author: JohnnyPortugal
reviews.title: Not so Great Hotel. Bad reservation services.
reviews.text:
I`ll try to make the most honest review.

GOOD
Consierge service excelent. Juan made our week so much easier, making all the reservations to the restaurants, responding to every request we made very quickly. 

Jennifer and Max (pool bali beds)
I didn´t enjoy paying the reserve and having to wait until 11:00am to see if i could have a bali bed. We pay extra and dont appreciate have to beg for somtehing I`m supposed to have in the first place.  
If it wasnt for Jennifer and Max being so kind and going the extra mile i´ve would have given up ando go to the other pools. Thanks to both, especially jennifer (she is super friendly to everyone)

All the staff at the restaurant SANTE. They work very hard and are very friendly.

The room was nice and updated.

CONS:
Reception - It was made in the building 5 (The reserve). The reception in the main building feels more luxury than this one, that seems outdated.
We had a major problem with our reservation canceled, and till now the hotel didnt show us (What they told us) the email from our travel agency cancelling the reservation. After a 10 hour flight, we had to call our agent (almost 01:00 am in our country) to talk to the hotel resevations services to clarify things. It was nerve wrecking. We had poor help from Luis at the reception desk. He was more interested in charging 2 nights extra on our credit card, more than in making us more calm and trying to solve the problem (was fixed by our travel agent).
He even try to put us in the building 3, only after we complain a lot (and his co-worker intervention) he moved us to a room in the reserve building. 
In the last day, we couldnt open our room door since the hotel (again) antecipated our check-out onde day earlier (another call to our agent again).
It shows poor competence from the hotel sadlly.

Restaurants
Sante, Lemon fish and capella are good restaurants.
Buffet restaurant only good at breakfast. poor variety in other meals.
The food was not that great. i Have to say i ate better and more spicy food at cancun airport.

Beach
What a disappointment. First I was going to Playa del Carmen, but with the "Sargazo" situation i moved to Cancun. It`s not the same. The sea is always rough and not enjoyable, even with little seaweed.

Shows
There is no good place to watch shows. Didnt like ginger bar at all. If you want to watch seated, forget. There was always someone standing up in front of us. The type of entertainment wasnt that good also.
If you are young and only want DJ parties maybe thats the place for you.
My 2 cents advice. The Hotel should have a place for shows like other Hotels have, with a stage and chairs. There is enough room for that in the Hotel.
Outside entertainment the same. Only a few spots to seat and listen to live music.

GENERAL EVALUATION
I feel bad for the staff (they were great) and made the hotel more enjoyable, but I must be honest and say if i could go back in time i`ve would have stayed in the RIU Hotels in Cancun. I prefer their approach to entertainment and all in general. Its really sad that the Hotel doesnt play music from mexico by the pools. 
The hotel is also somewhat far from the hotel zone (Coco Bongo, malls etc).

reviews.author: Ms. Young
reviews.title: Attended a business event at Paradsisus Resort
reviews.text:
The    Paradisus is a beautiful, all inclusive resort in Cancun. The staff in all areas of the hotel were #1. They were sweet, easy spoken, helpful and polite. They took the time to take care of all of your needs. I ate at the Malva Restaurant most days there. I came in the next night and the waiter remembered me and told me that I had lost an earring there the night before. I couldn't believe it. The guest services rep, Raul was really nice and held conversation with me while I waited for security to bring my earring. 
The room is large but a little dated. The junior suite does not have enough electrical outlets and some of the lights did not work. The property it self is absolutely beautiful and I would highly recommend it to anyone traveling to Cancun.

reviews.author: Nicole C
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: incredible food, wonderful service. Lemon Fish is right in the middle of the resort, it’s a beautiful location. Sushi, beef tips, rice, panela cheese, everything's delicious. Thank you Rafael Cime for your attention! Beautiful experience 💯

reviews.author: corrinarg
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Great time at Lemon Fish! We received excellent service from Rafael! We enjoyed delicious sushi and received special treatment for our gluten frèe friend. And Randy made the best "Liz" Cosmo! Would rcommend! 💗💗

reviews.author: Brittany L
reviews.title: Lemon fish
reviews.text: Rafael Cime was a awesome server. He was very attentive to what I wanted. He made great menu suggestions and was overall very welcoming. He even recommended a new drink that is now my favorite. I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Jan G
reviews.title: Very good stay!!
reviews.text:
To start with, the hotel is huge! Inside of the hotel is like a rainforest oasis, loads of greenery and pods…has a very peaceful resort feel…

We booked the RESERVE room and the reception there is beautiful with seating area, a pod with koi and green plants everywhere. We really enjoyed our week long stay at the Reserve side of the hotel. Our concierge, Janick was amazing! He came to greet us on arrival, showed us around and he helped plan the week for us! Janick organised all our dinner reservations, booked our cabana beds and gave great advice on day trips and tours! Thankyou Janick! 

Our room was spacious and nice, it was always clean and able to order unlimited room service was great!

We were at the Reserve Adult pool almost everyday, Jennifer and Max are so great! Always able to organise cabana beds for us! Axcel and Nicole, the activities team always so friendly and really good energy, we enjoyed the variety of activities… the silent disco and the Latin street night was loads of fun

We booked a couples massage at YHI SPA before checking in and it was soo good! One of the best massages, highly recommend booking that…

There are so many different type of restaurants (9 restaurants I think) and big selection on the menu that you will never go hungry… We had most of our breakfasts and lunches at SANTE, the food and service was so good. Yamil was our favourite server and he always bring our drinks and food quick and with positive attitude. We also liked LEMON FISH and CIELO. Moises in CIELO makes really good food recommendations and they sang happy birthday to my husband which was really nice! The other restaurant we loved for lunch was AQUA MARINA, the food was good and servers are great! Buffet had good variety and different food everyday. At the Reserve area there are always snacks and my husband loves their coffee and cocktails. Overall we thought the food at Paradisus was pretty good, all the food is nicely presented but it is not always to our taste but that is just us…

The greatest thing about Paradisus is the staff at the hotel and service. We definitely recommend upgrading to the RESERVE, it definitely made our trip a lot better. Thankyou again for the wonderful week and we will be back!

reviews.author: J7558AKstephaniec
reviews.title: Great property - not the best food
reviews.text:
This is such a Beautiful modern resort but unfortunately the food is not the best. We were not impressed during any meal and tried all the restaurants. The best meal we had was at capella. 

We loved the property and the reserve perks and activities. They cleaned the beach everyday and The service was great the whole week ( special shout out to our server at blue agave , Paola ). We didn’t love the reservation system - you basically had to book 2 days in advance for dinner anywhere that wasn’t the buffet. 
We did enjoy the nightly entertainment. Better than at other resorts we’ve stayed at.

reviews.author: Kevin G
reviews.title: Awesome spot!
reviews.text: Lemonfish is a beautiful restaurant at the center of Paradisus Punta Cana. The food and service can't get much better than this. Rafael was fantastic, he attended a large group of 9 without issue. Very attentive, helpful, and easy to talk to. Food was great!

reviews.author: Tefiabreu
reviews.title: Thank you Rafael at Lemon Fish
reviews.text:
Our stay at Paradisus was perfect! 
Rafael at Lemon Fish was amazing!! Great attention to detail & treated us extra special while celebrating my dads birthday. Highly recommend trying this restaurant when you stay at Paradisus Cancun!! Thank you Rafael!!

reviews.author: S R
reviews.title: Gorgeous surroundings, amazing ocean, swimming pools galore, good food and service
reviews.text:
Loved the beautiful atrium, Ginger Bar, and many restaurants that are part of the all inclusive package.  Very good service... no staffing shortages in Mexico unlike the US where all the resorts are still playing the "Covd card" to justify bad service
Easy fast check in and check out, very nice attentive staff.  Loved the drinks - especially the daquiris.
The only reason I didn't give 5 stars is all three of us got "the runs" the last two days (we never left the resort)...not sure where that came from, too hard to track down, but we didn't let it ruin our vacation, we just had  to stay close by.
The only other thing is the lagoon facing rooms (west) get really hot in the afternoon and the air conditioning has a hard time keeping up.  but I will say, the lagoon view is still pretty great!  Loved the patio, it was wonderful to put all of our wet swimsuits, etc.
The hotel requires masks in restaurants (probably some local ordinance) and they offer Covid tests to get back to US, although we brought our own and used a proctered service which we purchased through Southwest Airlines.
Overall great experience.

reviews.author: William S
reviews.title: The Lunch Box, one of the best in place.
reviews.text: Great food, great service and a great environment. I would like to give a shout out to Jose Cahun. This guy is now family to us. Great service, excellent and treated us with such a great attention. Overall a great experience.

reviews.author: Jordan H
reviews.title: Must try!!!
reviews.text:
Best food & experience in Paradisus Cancun & Cancun as a whole!! Must try. Salmon roll was definitely my favorite entre & mango sorbet was a very tasty dessert!! If you like sparkling wine, try their new cocktail: sparkling white wine, lemon juice, gin (you don’t taste the gin) and sugar.

Jorge was a very personal & top notch waiter!

reviews.author: Josh R.
reviews.title: Hotel Paradisus is the way to go. You won’t be disappointed.
reviews.text: This is our third time staying in Cancun, each at a different resort. Our stay at the Hotel Paradisus was absolutely wonderful. We were very impressed with the scenery, our room, the food was delicious, the pools are huge! Our Concierge Juan definitely made our trip the better. Anything we wanted, he was just a text away and always willing to help by reserving our beds by the pools, making reservations to the restaurants, and making sure we were taken care of. I’m glad I booked the Reserve section, definitely the way to go. We felt like V.I. P’s! Most definitely will return.

reviews.author: Kevin L
reviews.title: Memories 2 Last a Lifetime
reviews.text:
This was the best experience! 
There are no words to describe how beautiful. 
Dinner overlooking the beach with a personal chef and a gazebo w/ lights & romantic music. 
Strawberries rose petals in the room. 
Breakfast the next day. 
This was the highlight of our trip. 
If you want the most elegant beautiful dinner you have ever had this is your opportunity to secure that.
Very accommodating perfect evening. 
I cannot speak more highly about this experience. 
Thank you for the most wonderful night ever!

reviews.author: doanhilary
reviews.title: Paradise Blue; amazing service and assistance!
reviews.text: My partner and I stayed at the Paradisus for one week for vacation and Paradise Blue Music Festival! Everything was amazing, the beach was beautiful, food delicious and rooms were clean and well taken care of! Special thank you to Rafael Juarez, for making our trip so seamless and enjoyable! He was very helpful prior to our trip, arranging our dinner reservations for us and checked in with us many times throughout our stay to make sure everything was up to standard. I recommend anyone looking to stay in Cancun to choose Paradisus Resort and contact Rafael for reservation needs and other inquiries; he was so helpful and friendly! Until next year, Paradise Blue.

reviews.author: Lorena J
reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text: Rafael Juarez was the best concierge we’ve ever had! He made everything possible for us and he made sure we had fun during our stay. Thank you Rafael for everything!!! We cannot wait to go back next year!

reviews.author: meesh81611
reviews.title: YhiSpa
reviews.text:
Just cannot reccomend Gemma enough. Had 2. Massages  with her and she is truly a healer. 
Try the Balinese, something different and truly customized to your individual needs. So good i offered to name my unborn child after her. My 2nd massage, a hot stone, loosened up the rest of those winter frozen muscles and lengthened them
Even relaxing my stomach tension and finding those missing vertebrae i had lost.
Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Lilian L
reviews.title: Highly recommend Paradisus Cancun!
reviews.text: This is our second time in Cancun, and I'm so glad we chose paradisus as our choice of resort this time. I cannot express enough how good the service is no matter where you go in the resort. Not one complaint during our 5 night stay! Our room was clean and in great condition, our view was absolutely perfect, the food was actually pretty decent for a resort (and this is coming from New Yorkers), and the friendliness of all of the staff made our stay absolutely amazing. Janick, our concierge checked in with us each day to make sure we were satisfied with our stay and if we needed any help from planning excursions to booking restaurants and restocking our room (definitely ask for him if you can!). Also Jorge Ramos at Lemon Fish provided the best service we could ever ask for while dining at the resort - he made recommendations from the menu, and even introduced me to my new favorite espresso cocktail! If you make it to the restaurant, make sure you ask for him! You won't be disappointed. These two guys in particular deserve a raise! :) Definitely will choose paradisus/melia for any future resort stays!

reviews.author: Kristina S
reviews.title: Lunch Box Dinner
reviews.text: Our dinner was delicious! Our server Juan, was awesome and had great recommendations with excellent service. He took care of us as if we were family. Highly recommend Juan to serve you and to eat at lunch box!

reviews.author: Victorson J
reviews.title: Exceptional service
reviews.text: Paradises is one of our favorite resorts we come often to. The service is exceptional they go above and beyond to do everything and anything for you. The attention you get from servers is awesome. Thank you Eduardo who works in buffet he was amazing especially with my kids who he went above and beyond to make certain foods that weren’t on the menu just for them. Thank you so

reviews.author: Sal P
reviews.title: The best experience I’ve ever had in my life.
reviews.text: Frida from the reserve is the absolute best employee in the entire building … every single person we rn toured was kind, accommodating, compassionate, hard working. They CARE here at Paradisus. Our Concierge Frida from the reserve made this one of the most special vacations of my life. I will never stay anywhere but there because of her amazing service!! Dinner .. shows .. whatever you need she is on TOP of it. Thank you so much for everything and we can’t wait to see you again Frida and everyone at Paradisus - Joel in the reserve pool, Cesar in the reserve pool, Valeria, Jennifer and Max. You were all the best service we have ever had!!!! This isn’t good bye - it’s see you SOON! ❤️

reviews.author: Destinee B
reviews.title: Rafael Juarez
reviews.text:
Rafael was amazing. He made sure we had a good time from beginning to end. We were visiting to celebrate a bachelorette party and he made it worth it ! Will definitely be back and requesting Rafael. Rosanegra was so great as well as Mamacita . 

We stayed at the Paridisus Cancun and everything was prestige !

reviews.author: Katarzyna B
reviews.title: Paradisus Malva restaurant
reviews.text: Family of 4 ate at Malva restaurant and the staff , as I call them the dream team were all very pleasant and welcoming every day. Fast and polite service,  honest smiles . Some of the outstanding staff are Didi, Pascual,  Eddie, Alfredo, Edier and Atilano. Can't forget the upbeat energy of Orlando at the coffee bar. Pure class. Thank you all for welcoming us to your home and treating us so great. We will be back

reviews.author: Somer O
reviews.title: Not a 5 star hotel and sadly poor representation of Melia
reviews.text: We chose this resort initially for the all inclusive offering and rating. Upgraded our room to the "reserve" for the extra "perks". The moment we got off the plane is when everything went downhill. We had an arranged transportation from the airport (arranged by a member of the hotel) and they didn't show up. Ended up having to pay extra for a cab. When arriving, our room was not ready. The room ended up having ants, and many issues. Initially complained to the hotel manager ZANNINO, ROSANNA, but she was of no help and did not care. Throughout the week i complained MANY times to staff and asked for a manager in which no one came to check up on me. We did not receive the extra perks that was included in the upgraded "reserve". NOT worth it at all. The all inclusive food is the same everyday.  Many issues throughout the week and was very stressful. Service was HORRIBLE, SLOW and at the end of the trip i was FINALLY approached by the manager who said she would do ANYTHING to make this up to us. 2 days after we left, i received an email providing us a voucher for $50. This was the most waste of a trip and working with a large community, i ensure that we will not be returning. There were a FEW people that were pleasant and were MADE for hospitality, but this was completely unprofessional, not clean and the worst service i've ever had. The Reserve comes with a "butler" who did NOTHING for us. There was a A LOT of seaweed (Which is NOT the hotel's fault or under their control) so looking at making the most of the resort and enjoying our time was disappointing that the hotel couldn't come through. Mexico as a beautiful Country and beautiful people was definitely let down by this hotel. The representation of Cancun and Melia was very poor. The manager should not be in hospitality and was just the most unempathetic and unserviceable person.  I would advise to stay away from this hotel completely.

reviews.author: Aaron B
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Rafael is a great server and the food is delicious! The sushi is really good and the ambiance is nice with a very pleasant temperature. I would recommend the ceviche as well as the skewers. And I would recommend Paradisus in general!

reviews.author: Kingklick91
reviews.title: Simply AMAZING!!!
reviews.text:
Words can only help to describe what an absolutely amazing time we had at the Paradisus! I was SO thankful to have the help of our amaizng concierge, Rafael Juarez who locked us in with our reservations for dinner and guided us through the entire resort from back to front! Rafael made our stay feel like we where truly in paradise, and was always free to help us if we needed anything at all. This man deserves a HUGE promotion and a raise after the white glove service he gave us both before and during our stay. If you are debating on which hotel to stay at for your cancun visit, this is the SPOT! 

Thank you Paradisus and thank you again Rafael (Rafi) for your top tier service and support with our stay.:-)

reviews.author: Valentina G
reviews.title: The best time ever at Paradise Blue
reviews.text: I went to the festival Paradise Blue at Paradisus. And I have to say this was the best vacation I have ever taken. Especially with the help of my now friend Rafael Juarez! He made sure any questions or concerned were met, I had no worries the whole week knowing he was there! I would 100% be back next year thanks to him!

reviews.author: Joss Arriaga
reviews.title: Best Vacation
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful and the staff is very friendly and always making sure you have everything you need. Rafael Juarez part of the staff of the hotel went out of his way to make sure our stay was nothing but amazing. From the moment we checked in until we checked out, he made sure we had a great time, always checking in with us and providing us everything we needed. If you go there please ask for him and don’t forget to tip staff.

reviews.author: Shaddy1x
reviews.title: Big shoutout to Carlos
reviews.text: Carlos made our trip amazing. Easily he had the most amazing hospitality . He will be located by the ginger bar on the first floor and he treated us like family. He was a big part of our Cancun trip. His associate Gualmer was also great to us and we really appreciate them. Hopefully we see them soon. All love.

reviews.author: Christian Ojeda
reviews.title: Best Dinner in Paradisus
reviews.text: Best experience on Paradisus Hotel! Jorge Ramos offer us an amazing experience in Lemon Fish! The full experience of different flavors , awesome atmosphere, food was awesome. I recommend to be in shorts as the place is a little hot. Ask for the sampler in order to try the full menu.

reviews.author: Taylor A
reviews.title: Lemon fish
reviews.text: Rafael was amazing at lemon fish! So attentive and sweet - went out of his way to accommodate my dietary request and brought us out a celebratory drink at the end! Such a sweet, genuine man, 10/10 service by Rafael

reviews.author: Fearless767354
reviews.title: Lemon fish. Super bien
reviews.text: Daniel was an amazing waiter. He knows a lot about the meals in the menu. Great personality and perfect service. God bless him. I would’ve never have asked for a better server. Thank you again 🙏🏻🙏🏻🙏🏻🙏🏻🙏🏻

reviews.author: Tommy M
reviews.title: Thomas Morgan
reviews.text: Fernando Santillan at Restaurante Capella is amazing! Very kind and very fast service. He went out of his way to get cake and champagne for a birthday. The entire ambiance of the restaurant was great.

reviews.author: Moriya C
reviews.title: Christian Sanchez is awesome !
reviews.text: Great service and brought a variety of dishes for us to try. The service was great ! He brought all sorts of fish and appetizers . Very prompt service ! And he kept us laughing as well! Great food at the lemonfish definitely recommend .

reviews.author: Milen L
reviews.title: Great Service
reviews.text:
Daniel was amazing! Food was fantastic, highly recommend! Great drinks (better than some of the pool bars) and service, Daniel and the kitchen offered special dishes based on what we ordered. 

Some of our favourite food we had on our visit to Paradisus Meliá Cancun

reviews.author: Rocio R
reviews.title: Sante reserve Area
reviews.text: Since April 2021 we have stayed at this resort 3x and every time it has been more than excellent.   Thank you, Muchas Gracias, a Cesar, Yamiel, Ruben, Jennifer/Max at the restaurant/pool area. Our concierge, Violeta who was the best both times we came and have all treated us like family and given us the best experiences staying here.  The lunch was delicious at Sante and the drinks were always flowing.  We also enjoyed the daily activities like the morning yoga & stretching, hat painting, and pinata making.  Gracias Saul-activities guru, Lizzie for the keychain making and hat painting,  Thank you to all the staff and others like Julio, Oscar, Josue, Moises. Paradisus, we will be back again.  -Daniel y Rocio de Tejas

reviews.author: Dheki W
reviews.title: Amazing Hotel
reviews.text: Service was amazing. Server Atilano made sure we hade everything we needed while serving up. Will recommend. Food and atmosphere were incredible. Will be coming back here in the future. 10 stars out of 5!

reviews.author: Els S Walsall
reviews.title: Family holiday
reviews.text: Family holiday. The resort is a very friendly and helpful place.  Very nice staff. The experience was great. We are very happy for this experience at Paradisus Cancun!! We went as a family to the resort and this is great.

reviews.author: Andaleeb K
reviews.title: Lemon fish
reviews.text: Raphael is amazing so attentive and very friendly. His service was a1. Will definitely come back if there is availability.  Sushi was great along s side salmon as main dish couldn't stay for dessert still have to try the chocolate cake

reviews.author: Joshua N
reviews.title: Nice, but not that impressed for the price paid
reviews.text:
Overall, a 3/5 experience. Don't get me wrong - the resort is beautiful and the staff is generally great. What lacks though is the food quality, watered down drinks at restaurants, a lack of available reservations at their restaurants, wait staff attentiveness, inability to get ahold of the property and no welcome amenities as promised when I booked this reservation via Expedia.

Individually these are small things, but all-in-all left me with a very mediocre impression of a highly-rated (and expensive) all-inclusive resort. I will be looking elsewhere to stay the next time I'm in Cancún. 

Pro tip: if you decide to stay here, make all your dinner reservations for your entire stay the second you get to the resort. Unless you're happy eating at the buffet every dinner, that is.

reviews.author: Maxine T
reviews.title: Amazing experience! Will definitely be back!
reviews.text: Orlando Bello and Atilano were extremely friendly and helpful. We had no issues with any of the staff. The experience was smooth the whole 5 days we were here. We are extremely grateful for this experience at Paradisus Cancun!!

reviews.author: nics2125
reviews.title: Amazing stay while at Paradise Blue!
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed here for a music festival, Paradise Blue. The hotel staff were outstanding! Everyone was very helpful, kind and made our stay one of the most memorable. The bartenders at the beach bar with the swings were the best! They made the best drinks and always had a smile on their faces. And the Nespresso guys made my mornings! I know it must have been hard to keep up with so many people at the festival but they did an amazing job and all facilities were kept up with. The grounds were well taken care of during the entire stay. We stayed in room 4204 and housekeeping did a great job with our room and our fridge and snack bar were always kept full. My only complaint would be that the air conditioning had a hard time keeping up with the hot morning sun. But very minor problem! Thank you Paradisus for making our vacation such a great experience! I hope that you'll host us again next year :)

reviews.author: Lyndsay M
reviews.title: Was nice!
reviews.text: We were very much looking forward to an easy vacay and this hotel was super nice! Food was excellent, beach was amazing and the hotel cleanliness, layout and decor was awesome.  Reason for not leaving five stars was we paid more for VIP experience and there were never enough pool chairs, the service was hit or miss (although we loved Pedro, and Alberto). Would go back but not sure I’d pay for the upgraded experience.  Also note there is no disco on site and everything shuts down at midnight.

reviews.author: Sydney B
reviews.title: Bartenders
reviews.text: We came here for Paradise Blue music festival and went to one bar all weekend all for Esteban and Elisio they were so great to us the whole time and really made our experience even better, thank you to all the staff and everyone who helped make the weekend great! I will say though for the mass quantity of people for food please please cook everything through. A lot of people got sick because food wasn’t  cooked all the way through.

reviews.author: Jason T
reviews.title: Lemon Fish Restaurant
reviews.text: Jorge Ramos is amazing in Lemon Fish! If you go here, you MUST ask for him!!! Jorge is the best!!!  Service is excellent !! He brought me everything i asked for and kept checking on us. Brought more refills when we were all low. HIGHLY RECOMMEND

reviews.author: Ariane T
reviews.title: Lemon Fish,  Jorje Ramos
reviews.text: Very efficient and super nice waiter. Made us feel really comfortable and amazing food! Best of the best, I really loved it and had an amazing time. Can’t wait to come again thank you again Jorge. !!!

reviews.author: Amy H
reviews.title: Amazing resort
reviews.text: Absolutely loved this place so much. Would love to give a shout out to one of the bellhops Emil. He was so nice and helped us get into our room a little earlier so we didn't have to leave our bags somewhere.

reviews.author: Dennis T
reviews.title: Capella restaurant
reviews.text: Amazing place, atmosphere is very pleasant. Service was a highlight . Thank you Gerardo Cocoletzi and Carlos Chay.  We went to many restaurants in all inclusive hotels this spot put it over all others. Serivxe is number 1

reviews.author: Alex Yamamoto-Castillo
reviews.title: You guys made me feel like o was at home, thank you everyone ❤️
reviews.text:
Had an amazing time so great ful for Manuel at the cabanas on the beach for saving our bottle of wine!! That was amazing of him great worker as well, Frida was our personal helper she did fantastic and answered all questions we had couldn’t ask for better service. Special shout out to Josue at the reserve restaurante by the pool. I hope you got your jersey!! 
Miguel at the lunch box was so good to us, he made sure we had a seat every morning and helped with all our hunger needs so did this other man that was at host table with him close to the bar outside! I think his name was guanardo. I apologize for not remembering all name I’ll write them down next year!! We also had another amazing server named Ignacio Vasquez who was appended to spend our last breakfast with. We made such an amazing connection with the staff thank you all so much ❤️😭🌺 We will be back next year (:

reviews.author: Tristin H
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Alfredo, Alvaro, Manuel, Henry, Carlos, Francisco made this an amazing trip for me and my friends we can not wait to come back. The whole resort was awesome and respectful it was the best experience I have had.

reviews.author: Kabir R
reviews.title: Lemon fish restaurant
reviews.text: The food was unique and delicious. The service was friendly and accommodating. Cristian Sánchez was our server. He was very friendly and attentive and helped us with all of our special requests. The chef Mario Contreras is a talented chef who prepared an amazing menu. We tasted multiple dishes on the menu and all were delicious. The ambiance was open and lightly lit. Not too loud and spacious.

reviews.author: amber g
reviews.title: BEST PLACE EVER!
reviews.text: Had the absolute, most incredible time here. Everyone who works at this resort is amazing and kind. The food is delicious. Drinks are generous. Service is unmatched. Beach is exactly what you'd picture coming here. We will be return customers for life!

reviews.author: Am G
reviews.title: Don't delay - Book right away!
reviews.text:
This resort should have 10 stars. For starters, the ambience set throughout the entire resort is beautiful. The food and drinks from both the various restaurants and room service are exquisite. Everything is flawlessly clean and the little details provided in the rooms bring all of the comforts of home. The beach is exactly what you'd imagine when you think about going on a tropical vacation.

All of these things are true and wonderful, but...
THE SERVICE IS INCOMPARABLE!
Every single member of the staff is incredibly kind and personable. They will go out of their way to make your stay as pleasant as they possibly can.

During my stay, I became very ill and the measures that the staff went to to help me brought me to tears multiple times. From making special meals (off-menu) to accommodate my illness, to the hotel manager, Rosanna, calling the room multiple times to check on me and ask if I needed anything. They went to the extent to decorate the room with balloons and bring champagne and gifts on my last day when I'd finally started to feel better. These people treated me like I was a close, beloved family member and I am forever grateful to everyone there, truly.

If you had any reservations about staying here, don't. It is everything you could ask for and so much more. BOOK NOW! I promise you'll be so glad that you did.

reviews.author: Stephany Foster
reviews.title: Ignacio Vasquez
reviews.text: This employee made my stay here SO SPECIAL. For him, I will be back next year. I was treated with so much kindness and respect, no resort can compare to how perfect this stay was for us. Very grateful for this employee and hope to see him next year.Estoy muy feliz.

reviews.author: Morgan J
reviews.title: Paradise Blue
reviews.text: Can not thank or appreciate the staff here enough! Paradise Blue was an absolute dream and it wouldn’t have been the most spectacular experience without the incredible staff here. We had Ada for pool service and she was especially amazing!!!

reviews.author: Kate O
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Alfredo Alvaro has been excellent at accommodating guests at the buffet. He is very attentive to all your needs while dining & very polite too. The food has been a great selection during breakfast, lunch, & dinner. Thanks for all the love!

reviews.author: Carlitos M
reviews.title: Restaurante Cappella El mejor
reviews.text:
Enserio, el servicio fue excelente. Nurstro mesero Fernando Santillan nos trajo un ambiente spectacular. Y la comida era bien dilicioso. Lo recomiendo a todos lo que visitan.

Seriously, best customer service I received. The ambience was relaxing and and the food was spot on. Our waiter, Fernando Santillan exceeded my expectations and definitely brought the mood to the scene. I 100% recommend this restaurant to anyone who visits.

reviews.author: Ethan H
reviews.title: Beach Bar with the swings
reviews.text: We met Balta when we came down to the bar with swings on the first night of Paradise Blue. He served us with speed and efficiency and quickly became a friend to us!! Balta recognized my friends and I every single day and made us feel at home at the Paradisus. He is the best, and we will be back to paradise!!

reviews.author: Alec
reviews.title: Balta is the man!
reviews.text: Balta, a worker at a bar in Paradisus Cancun, provided us with excellent service and kindness. He made this trip all that much better. And thank you Excision for throwing Paradise Blue! Go find Balta at the beach bar with the swings. He is the best!

reviews.author: tuyet l nguyen
reviews.title: ***Please read before you book!***
reviews.text:
My family and I stayed here during 05/23/21-05/28/21. While checking in, one of the front desk clerk offered an upgrade for premium services with an oceanview for $320. Upon arrival to our room, we noticed that the "oceanview" room that we were told is actually the lagoon room to which we initially had. We immediately realized that the extra payment was actually for premium services being offered specifically to people in the reserve class. Right away, we went to front desk to retract the upgrade, however, they refused. With such false advertising, this instantly left a bitter taste to the start of our vacation. 

The positive note of our stay is the attentiveness of several staffs around the hotel. We are quite the large group and it's nice to see that they are willing to accommodate everyone's needs. Booking reservations for restaurants is nearly impossible as most are hardly ever available. The melia app is complete trash as it gives an error for booking reservations every time. After reading some reviews through TripAdvisor which dates back to a few years ago, it seems as though this problem isn't new. We did get to try enso which has the same rotating menu between lunch and dinner and thought both meals offered very delicious food. Sunset grill and mole were also delicious and should not be missed. I did not try bana but I was told by family members that it's quite tasty. 

Pools are closed daily at 7:00pm (19:00) central time. Most bars are also closed around that same time. Be mindful that the buffet and some restaurants are closed by 7:00pm (19:00) while most are closed at 11:00pm (23:00). If you must order room service, it is free for reserves but an additional $5 each time for the regular guests. People in reserves are entitled to premium drinks, a poolside cabana, and a butler. 

Our family's butler/maid seemed helpful during the first couple of days but was later missing in action towards the last few days. We have never ordered any premium drinks with reserves as most bars had my preference of liquor. If this is important to you, I suggest finding out which premium brands of liquor the reserves has to offer.There is a daily and nightly schedule for some activities but most of us did not partake. 

The air conditioning in the reserves room 5701 and 5704, regular lagoon view 3537 and luxury oceanview 3564 seemed nonexistent. We had the thermostat down to 64.0F and even slept with sheets but rooms were just unbearable to sleep in. If you're a person who could sleep in 79-80F at home, you should be fine. Otherwise, I suggest asking for another room or look elsewhere. 

During our stay, we booked a three set excursion with Aquaworld located inside of the resort for $163-$230 with taxes included. Everything was available except for the underwater scooter due to a large booking made by another group. Some of us settled for the subsee, isla mujeres, and jetski while some chose the speed boat, scuba diving with lessons (+$45 totaling to $230), and jet ski. The subsee was meh, we did not see that many fishes as expected and being at the bottom of the boat can be quite nauseous. Isla mujeres felt more like a tour at the beginning but was self paced during our stop in the northern part of the island. Speed boat was fun but nothing memorable. 

On Friday, May 28, 2021, we noticed that $300 USD from one of our wallets and $220 USD from another wallet went missing. Prior to this realization, we ran into problems with opening the safe earlier in the morning. With such issue, we reached out to guest services to send someone to fix the safe. After our third attempt in the span of two hours, someone finally came to reset our safe. Not thinking much about it, we did not check our belongings. It wasn't until we ate at the buffet where we wanted to tip that I realized my money went missing. I immediately walked over to guest services to report theft. The two ladies at guest services noted everything down, even had security to go back to the room where the crime took place to inspect. After hours of inspection and filing a report, we were told that Paradisus would contact us after the decision of the pending investigation. 

As of May 29, 2021, the Paradisus personnel reached out to us with the decision that they will not refund or compensate money stolen as they did not inspect all rooms of our family. Prior to the pending investigation, we demanded proof of logs when staffs accessed the safe and room but they were so adamant with not providing them. This shows me that the staffs at the hotel are crooks and cannot be trusted. Theft is completely unacceptable and I have never felt so violated with someone going through my belongings. 

Management needs serious professional training. We had several questions regarding the safety of our belongings in the reserves and the person in charge along with guest services had zero answers for them. Management, if you are reading this, the community and myself will need answers regarding the missing cash.

reviews.author: SamMit2022
reviews.title: Great Experience at Paradisus Cancun (melia)
reviews.text:
We took a much needed vacation and stayed at Paradisus Cancun (Melia). 
Pros in our experience:
- Beautiful resort, very clean, all staff maintaining strict covid protocols. 
- Staff are fantastic.  Antonio and Abel at ENSO restaurant went out of their way to make my spouse's birthday a very memorable one. They bought special cake with candle lit and the staff sang happy birthday to her.  Thank you to the Staff at Enso :-) 
- Miguel at BANA restaurant was awesome.  Great attention to detail and took very good care of us.
- Angeles (massage therapist) is highly recommended. Special shout out to all the servers at the beach cabanas who kept us hydrated with drinks and food.
-  Every staff was very courteous and helpful and went out of their way to take care of guests. 
- Food at Fuego and Bana restaurants were great. 
- Antigen testing was done for free and testing was easy but had to be scheduled in advance.

CONS in our Experience: 
- Water was stopped for one day for repairs.  A prior heads-up would have helped. Hot was stopped occasionally.
- Do not stay in rooms 3361 to 3365 if you like to sleep early and wake up early.  It is right above the Fuego terrace where the partying continues till late and there is live band music.

reviews.author: Eamon B
reviews.title: Great resort, mediocre brand
reviews.text:
I’ll start with saying that my fiancée had a wonderful time at Paradisus Cancun. The actual resort and the core hospitality staff were excellent. Iran the sommelier was incredible. The gentlemen running the margarita class were top notch. Max at the pool made us feel like movie stars. The amenities were fantastic.

And then there’s Meliá. The brand the owns the resort.

My fiancée and I booked our trip directly through Meliá. Or so we thought. While we booked directly through the website, once you “package” anything (travel etc), you’re apparently on Expedia’s dime, disentitling you to anything typically offered by Melia. A week before our trip we called and emailed the given numbers attempting to confirm our transpo from the airport and update our reservation to the more exclusive “The Reserve,” side of the resort. Nothing. An hour on hold each time. Eventually we just tossed our hands to the sky as we ran out of time. Cut to us stranded at the Cancun airport, Melia’s staff incredulous and unaware. This became a recurring theme.

When we arrived we began our upgrade process- the process we had attempted a week before. The gentlemen at the front desk had no problem upselling us to their most expensive rooms. Given our airport trauma we were excited to know all guests at The Reserve have transport to the airport included ............unless you upgrade. Strategically omitted was the information that PAID upgrades are not entitled to the same amenities that those who originally booked The Reserve, never mind the fact we just paid an additional hundreds of dollars. Seems like something you’d present up front, right? Spoke to the transpo folks and they said we were all good, a young woman who was just trying her best confirmed our Reserve status would grant us transpo, and asked who our butler was. Our butler? The person assigned to you at check in to help you with these issues. It had been hours and no one had assigned such a person. At this point I could no longer believe anything I heard. I asked no less than 5 different check in / reception folks about confirming our travel and assigning a butler. Each person deferred to someone else. That was a constant with the Melia team. No one seems empowered to make a decision. When I finally got someone to talk to me like a person, she still called some mysterious voice on the other end of the phone, who confirmed we were wrong, upgrades don’t get anything, and “Melia packages” is actually Expedia which means we didn’t get the perks promised on the website. I still haven’t even got the points assigned from the trip in my Melia account!

They said it would be $50 to arrange our transport. $50. Despite all of the mislabeling, passing the buck, and general BS we went through, they couldn’t meet us in the middle over the cost of $50.

So what happened here? What did I just experience? We spent thousands on this trip. We were treated well by the rank and file staff, but the administration seemed ready to screw us over at every turn.

So, dear traveler, I highly encourage you enjoying the amenities Paradisus Cancun has to offer. The food and drinks are wonderful, the activities are great, the amenities are fantastic. The process, however, and the pass-the-buck attitude of the administration is enough that I’ll likely choose other resort groups in the future. I cannot understand why we were systematically screwed over at every turn, and that no one in administration seemed to understand that superior guest services just means meeting someone where they are. It was made clear to me that $50 was too expensive a price to pay to keep me as a customer.

reviews.author: Oscar N
reviews.title: Wonderful time in Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
El servicio de Jesús del restaurante Malva en el desayuno fue espectacular 5 stars

The service of Jesus in the restaurant Malva during breakfast was spectacular, 5 stars. This guy made our trip special with his treatment and was very aware of what we needed.

reviews.author: carmen c
reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: I had an awesome experience, we upgraded when we arrived thank stayed around the reserved which the staff was extraordinary, great attentive people. Diego’s team were great, Cesar, Jamil, Lucas, Maxcimiliano all of them. The people at the Spa were awesome as well. Our butter Soni was great. The food was delicious I mean I loved it and I would definitely go back and will recommend the resort to my friends and family.

reviews.author: Kimi H
reviews.title: Got rob!
reviews.text: Stay was horrible. Upgraded to the reserve for the amenities and a butler. Butler took forever to respond. It was faster for us to book and do everything ourselves. Our safe got hacked into while we was out on excursions. They showed us the time sheet of when it was open and close and on the day the family was out from 8-6. Someone open it at 12:40 pm. We notice the next morning that we was missing cash in two wallet. Made a report and even went to the local police. In the end they try to say that we took the money!!! The nerves!! I came for a vacation w my family. I didn’t come to waste my time and money!  Food was bland.  Pool closed at 6:30-7 every night. Pool had no music unless you brought your own speaker. We’ll  never come back and wouldn’t recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: StashM17
reviews.title: Unfortunately will not be coming back
reviews.text:
I wanted to write this review while it was still fresh in my mind. Thus said, we left Cancun today and it’s truly a bittersweet moment. This is our 4th time in Mexico and our first time in Paradisus. From the moment we checked in to the moment we checked out we felt welcomed. The atmosphere was great. The staff are some of the most hardworking people we met. I haven’t encountered a single rude person. Everyone tried their best and went above and beyond to assist you. We arrived early and our room was not ready. We were given a different room in the mean time to simply change and get ready for the beach since we had little kids with us. We upgraded to ocean view and it was totally worth it!! The beach and pool area was very clean. The beach had seaweed which is a problem in most of Mexico but the resort tried their best to clean it every morning. My daughter loved KIDS CLUB. The staff was super friendly and very interactive with the children. There was a special area for kids pool. I have to mention... the staff by the kids pool was SO attentive and constantly brought us drinks and food. 
Now...I do have to say one negative thing about the resort and that is the FOOD. We have been to many many resorts and this is the first resort to give us an upset stomach. It’s unfortunate that we had to watch very carefully what we ate for the rest of our trip in fear we might get sick again. In this case alone, I do not see us returning back to this resort. 
Entertainment was great!! Every night they had a show. Kids loved it! 
We took a day trip to swim with the dolphins in Aquaworld and it’s definitely worth it if you have kids!! There is a little shopping center, and it was fun to walk around and be outside the resort for a change. 
We didn’t have the Reserve. But we heard  from many many families while we were there that it’s not worth it. 
The app was a hit or miss. All reservations and spa bookings were made through there. I found it very easy to navigate but the app itself did have some glitches. The staff was willing to help make reservations for us.

reviews.author: zuleica m
reviews.title: Loved Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
This was my first time in Cancun and I was not disappointed! The hotel was beautiful, had amazing staff, and was clean! Our group booked the reserve which was the best. Our concierges were Aaron and Violeta who were so amazingly helpful during our stay. They helped us book our dinner reservations, transportation, covid tests, and much more. We had big group and we had very little issues throughout our stay. A great thank you to them for handling our requests! I thought the hotel was Covid friendly, everyone wore masks, the buffets had people serve you and for lunch gave you gloves to serve yourself. I would definitely stay here again, can't wait until next time!!

We loved all of the restaurants, my favorite being Capella, formerly known as Bento. We were the first table to try the new menu and it was delicious! We had mussels, calamari, wine, and we were so pleased with our dinner it was my favorite restaurant overall. Bana, Fuego, and Mole were good as well. I liked the breakfast buffet, but I absolutely loved La Palapa breakfast! The cappuccino and latte were so good. If you want a healthier option I would go for the buffet as you can choose what to eat there. I loved their selections! La Palapa is only for the reserve and it's right next to the private reserve pool area. The servers were great, we had Moises and Cesar who were very attentive. At the breakfast buffet we had Alfredo and Victor serving us and they were wonderful as well! Very friendly!

We used USA Transfers for transportation and it was great! They picked us up from the airport with no issues and our flight was delayed half an hour. When you exit the airport you just need to go straight, not turns, past Margaritaville and they have a rep waiting in the crowd for you. It is very busy there so just keep going past the first crowd. We paid online and we tipped the driver. They were on time to pick us up from the hotel too. 

We went to Xcaret and we had purchased Xcaret Plus 21 days before our visit so we got a discount! Xcaret was fun, we did the lazy river and walked around. It's essentially a zoo which I don't enjoy personally, seeing animals in small habitats. If that's not your thing I would do another extension of Xcaret like Xplor or Xplor Fuego the night time option. Lines were long and we waited around an hour to just get in. Employee said that even at 8am when they open it's busy and it's worse during July and August. We ate at a buffet which was really good! Masks were not being worn that much since it is a water park, so if you're not vaccinated and are cautious with covid I wouldn't go.

Overall Cancun was a great place to have fun and relax!!

reviews.author: Pathfinder751032
reviews.title: Francisco is the best
reviews.text: Francisco at the Paradisus Cancun is the most amazing server I’ve had. He is great at what he does. He remembered me after the first day and said hello to me every day. I spent my time on the beach just to be in his area. Thank you for everything Francisco. You are a great and amazing person and you took care of us so well. Thank you so much. I will be back because of you.

reviews.author: sunnileo
reviews.title: Paradisus is the place to be! Relax and have fun :)
reviews.text:
Thank you Paradisus! We were able to travel for a real vacation for the first time since 2019 and decided to visit Paradisus Cancun (which was our last trip we took before Covid). The Safe protocols put in place made our trip absolutely wonderful. Paradisus by Meliá is exceptional and highly recommended to anyone who would like to take a trip. 

We got to reconnect with a wonderful servers that we had met on our past travels, Sergio Gonzalez Cano and Karina, which was super awesome!  To all the staff at Paradisus from the housekeeping to the room service, to the waitstaff service, bartenders and front lobby, thank you from the bottom of our hearts. Our stay was awesome and we appreciate everything. We can’t  wait to come back! 

PS to everyone Elvis show, you are amazing!! Wow!

reviews.author: Kristyn F
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation
reviews.text:
Overall this was a great place. There was an element of crazy spring break to it. We always book the reserve to avoid the college scene. The reserve pool with the Bali beds, omg, awesome. La palapa, awful. I’m a healthy eater, not many options. 
Not many activities, no real entertainment. The staff was amazing! Always someone there and friendly. Transportation was awful! Never showed up and took us 4 days and too much time of our vacation to get a refund. 
The hotel was so clean! Enso was the best place to eat! Fernando was awesome!

reviews.author: Kamila Perez
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun never disappoints!
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus 2 years ago in a Family Concierge Suite, now known as Reserve. I have to give props to this resort and all the employees. From the guy that opens the door of your car when you arrive to the guy that makes coffee at the Nespresso station. Everyone was extremely pleasant, nice and very helpful staring with our concierge Soni, who did a terrific job making our dinner reservations, Bali beds every day, scheduling my kids activities, adults reserve activities, registering us for our Covid tests, answering all my questions even on her day off. She was just wonderfully to me and my family, we had an amazing time and I didn’t have to worry about anything else other than to put sunscreen on my face. Another amazing person was Armando at the Malva Restaurant, I have never met a server more pleasant and attentive than him. One day I told him I was dying to eat some fresh chilaquiles and he told that he would ask the chef to make some for me and my dad the following morning, Malva is a buffet so he was definitely going the extra mile for us. We love this resort and that’s why we came back. Our family time was amazing and my kids had a terrific time with all the girls at the kids club, they made piñatas, bracelets, went shell hunting and a bunch of activities. This place and all the employees are just amazing. We will definitely come back again, this is turning into a family thing once a year! Thank you Soni and Armando, you were wonderful.

reviews.author: Michael R
reviews.title: Great place to vacation!!!
reviews.text:
First I would like to say that the service was one of the best that I have ever had. The staff is very attentive and always ready to serve. When ever any of the staff members pass you my they greet you with their hand over their heart. As a sign of gratitude. The manager ( Diego) of La Palpas was outstanding. His service and staff were always ready to provide you with excellent service. The food was amazing. 
The resort was in terrific condition. Rooms were clean and beds always made when you leave for the day and return later..I would recommend this resort to anyone looking to feel special because they really make you feel that way.. I'm ready to book another stay with them..

reviews.author: Jen H
reviews.title: Wonderful stay thanks to incredible staff and a beautiful hotel
reviews.text:
Myself and my sister stayed in for 15 days in May. We were of course a little nervous travelling with Covid and restrictions but from the moment we entered Paradisus we felt safe. All the Covid protocols in place made us feel very secure yet they were not over the top - masks worn indoors by everyone & outdoors also by staff, temperature checks coming in and when entering restaurants and every part of the hotel was shining! 

The hotel itself, the setting, the decor, the rooms, the pools, the beach were all beautiful and absolutely 5 star but the fantastic food and the incredible staff is what made the holiday so wonderful for us. Every meal we had was delicious and every staff member we met were fantastic. Everyone went above and beyond. 

My sister has some challenging food allergies (vegan and allergic to garlic and onion) but the staff were incredible looking after her and making her delicious food every time! Mario the chef in the Malva restaurant at lunch time was exceptional in the food he prepared! My sister is still talking about the delicious quesadillas she had so often! 

At breakfast and lunch we always had Martin Arsenal and Orlando Bello looking after us and they were both brilliant. Always checking in to see if we needed anything and no ask was too big! 

For dinner we dined a lot between Vento the Italian and Malva the buffet. Carlos the manager in Malva looked after us so well and always ensured my sister had a delicious meal! 
In Vento we saw Hugo the manager almost every night! He took such good care of us and we loved arriving to Vento to tell Hugo about some of the funny adventures we got up to each day! Most nights we ordered Italian food but not from the menu and Hugo made sure it was no problem. Cristian the chef in Vento made sure whatever food we wanted was always delicious and always greeted us with the biggest smile (behind his mask) and a big wave! 
There were two more people we saw almost daily that made our stay so special! Agustin in the activities who we loved to chat with and got to learn multiple card tricks from - he got us involved in lots of activities going on! Agustin checked in on us every day and helped involve us in any activities going on and was always sure to have a chat and make us laugh. Through all the activities he became a really friend to us! 
Alejandro was our butler who looked after us for the two weeks and he helped with everything from restaurant reservations and Bali bed reservations to general questions we had on the hotel, the area etc and was such a friendly face to check in on us everyday! 

Thank you all for making our stay so wonderful! We look forward to returning very very soon!

reviews.author: Sondi H
reviews.title: Not for us, and we won't be back - read my review for details so you can decide for yourself
reviews.text:
We stayed at this hotel from 5/11 – 5/19 and we purchased the “Reserve”.  We had a mixed experience, but I will detail everything out to you so you can make your own decision.  Bottom line for us, I would not stay here again.  
Here are some reasons you might not like this establishment:
•	If you expect management to be responsive and provide you with what you requested (type of room or special request), a fast check-in, a fast checkout?
•	If you are a foodie
•	If you like wine
•	If you don’t want to be around a bunch of drunk 20 somethings
•	If you are a family with young children
We have been to all-inclusives with butlers before and also all-adult all-inclusives.  The biggest thing we got out of our butler was dinner reservations.  We have had a much more personal experience from butlers in the past.  But, they are handling 30+ families per butler.  That’s really impossible to give anything but the basics to each one.  I blame this on the company not the butler. He was trying hard, but handcuffed by the amount of families he had to help.
I think something this resort is struggling with an identity crisis.  Do you want to be a party resort for 18 - 20 somethings, or a family resort, or a resort for couples.  You cannot do all three well.  For example, the 20 somethings partying at the main pool bar will drive off most couples and families with children.  Imagine a bunch of young women with butt implants standing up on the seats at the pool swim up bar and letting every man in the pool slap their butts. This is the environment at the main pool.  We normally love a swim up bar but this is not the kind of behavior we want to be around.  We are older and we like it fun, but not out of control.  We spent our whole vacation at the beach under a palapa.  We love it there, so it’s not torture, but options were limited based on the environment.  The resort also looks a bit old fashioned in how it is designed.  Lots of ivy hanging everywhere, pyramid type design, and zen type design around the spa area (think raked sand).  It seems cobbled together… For example, if you start out in floor 2 in the reserve and walk to the main building you are on floor 1. 
Rooms - The room situation is not being handled well at all.  The check-in process was horrible, the check-out process was horrible.  They pay no attention to things customers have requested before they arrive.  They put us in a room outside the Reserve area and tried to call it reserve. It was right over the main pool when I had requested a quiet room.  I saw so many people checking in and not getting the type of room they requested.  It seemed like this was being done on purpose.  Check-in took about 45 minutes to an hour and then longer to switch to a room in the reserve. I am very un-impressed with how they are running this facility. They are using paper forms to check you in and out. We had to go 4 places to check out and it took over 30 minutes.  We went to reserve and were sent to the main desk, then back to reserve, then into the other desk beside reserve where we finally got checked out.  Overall, there was just a lack of concern for what they putting the customer through.  We got an apology from some manager, but that is not enough to make up for the terrible experience they put us through.
Reserve experience – Here I have a mixed opinion.  If you are going to stay here, I suggest you get the reserve.  Otherwise, I fear you would have a very difficult time.  Don’t expect any kind of super personalized service.  You are not going to get that.  But, you will get your dinner reservations made and some help with other things like covid testing.  You will get a specific appointment time and it’s very quick.  If you are not in reserve you have to wait in a cattle line to get a test. You will get a shuttle appointment to go to the airport (we took a cab because they wanted us to go one hour earlier than we wanted to go). Make the shuttle appointment for the airport right when you get there so you get the time you want. Cabs are only $28 to go to the airport. 
The Reserve is actually in Building 5. There is a sign right above the entry to the building that says Reserve.  They are putting people in other buildings and calling it Reserve.  I insisted we be moved to the Reserve section and it was very quiet there (which we love).  But, there is a down-side to this. This is a bit far from the main building and the restaurants.  It is very close to the Reserve pool, beach, Reserve restaurant at the beach.  If you are in Reserve you will have a bit of a hike to the main building.  We didn’t mind it at all, but I guess you need to think about where you are going to spend most of your time. They also have a buffet/bar area in the Reserve building.  They serve a small breakfast there and they have the bar and a small buffet from 12 – 7 every day.  We utilized this Reserve bar every day and really liked going down before dinner for drinks and appetizers.  They have premium alcohol and on the food buffet they have several kinds of cured meats, cheeses, breads and just a few sweets. There were very few people using this bar/buffet.  We would see maybe 2 or 3 groups come through and they didn’t stay long.  You did get some conflicting rules here. Our butler told us 11 – 7 and I went over at 11:45 one day.  They refused to give me a drink even though the bar was all setup and ready to go. So, somewhere along the way they changed the time to eliminate an hour of service without telling the butlers. Some servers wanted you to wear a mask near the food and bar and others didn’t care.  They refused to give a young lady a peach because she only had a bikini top on.  I got her a peach, but still this shouldn’t have happened. They are just making up their own rules.  I’ve never been told “NO” so much at any all- inclusive where we have stayed.  
Reserve Restaurant and Beach/Pool – The Reserve restaurant is outside by the beach.  It’s very nice, but a limited menu. They have eggs benedict for breakfast and I enjoyed that.  Most mornings we ate at the main buffet but we did eat here, more for lunch than breakfast.  They also have a menu they serve on the beach but it’s more limited than the Reserve menu.  They had nice fish and chips, but it was a bit greasy.  I still had it a few times.  You can get a salad and one day I just asked for grilled shrimp.  Yes, there is one restaurant that can cook grilled shrimp perfectly.  I had the carbonara pasta one day and it was not that great.  The sauce was more like an alfredo but not even that good. The camembert cheese was a little odd to me, but others loved it.  Hamburger was just okay.  The service is very good and they bring you drinks from the Reserve bar (outside one by the beach) so you get good drinks.  It is a bit windy because it’s right by the beach.  But, it’s also okay to come up to eat in your bathing suit and bare feet.  The service at the beach is very good as well.  We tipped every day and I think that gets around but they were being good with everyone, not just us.  They bring you buckets of water which you will need.  They bring you drinks and if you are there regularly they will learn your drink and bring it automatically.  I have only compliments for the service we received from the staff at the restaurant and beach.  They also have a Reserve pool, but there is no where to get out of the sun unless you want to reserve a palapa.  You have to pay for this, and I wasn’t willing to do that.  It’s really a bed with a canopy on it.  I don’t want to lay down, I want to sit up and see.  Many people were sitting cross-legged, but if you have kids and want to be at the pool you will need one of these.  If you are people without kids and you want to be by the pool, you will need one of these if you want any shade at all. But, these were booked every day.  I think it was $40 or $50/day, but we never reserved one so I’m not 100% on that. The pool is very nice and big.  Service is very good there as well. 
They are not cleaning rooms unless you call every day or demand it be done.  I finally got it in our record somewhere that they were to clean our room every day.  They are using Covid as the excuse, but it’s just them trying to save money by not cleaning rooms.  
The only liquor in the room is some beer and hard seltzer.  No wine, no prosecco, no liquor.  I asked for wine and prosecco in the room.  It took 2 days but I finally got a bottle of each. They were so bad I had to tell them I did not want it any more.  All the house wine is bad.  The prosecco in the clear bottle was okay, but not the one in the black bottle.  They are trying to up-sell you all the time on the wine, but here's my take on this.  If you cannot pick a decent house wine, then I’m not trusting that if I buy your wine offering it will be any better.  I’ve never been to an all-inclusive that had such bad wine.  Boxed wine is MUCH better.  There is a Costco and we heard from another couple that they went there and bought wine to bring to the hotel.  I really don’t think I should have to do that, but if wine’s important to you (it is to me), and you really want to stay here… go to Costco.  
Drinks - When we first arrived, they were watering down drinks in the club.  I asked them for a shot of the Grey Goose I was supposedly getting in my Martini, and it was at least 50% water.  I could never drink a whole shot of Vodka and I was able to just drink the whole thing.  I told them I was going to report them to the Mexican Tourisim board and any other regulatory bodies I could find. The next time we went back the drinks were not watered down, but believe me it’s not Grey Goose.  The drinks at the Reserve Bar and the Reserve beach were good.  All the frozen type drinks are super sweet and they don’t really taste like they have alcohol in them.  The service in the Reserve area is much better than elsewhere.  
The show all these different restaurants on the web page for the hotel and there are basically four where you can get reservations.  Vento (Italian), Bana (Japanese), Mole (Mexican), and Enzo (International).  And, they all have small menus.  I saw a menu on trip advisor for some of these.  They are offering maybe a third of the items. The restaurants were just okay… nothing to write home about.  This is why I say if you are a foodie you will be disappointed in this resort. You are just not going to get anything that is really exceptional.
Buffet – We only ate here for breakfast, but we ate here most days.  The service is exceptional and you will be doted on from the minute you arrive to the minute you leave.  Try the iced coffee with cream it’s so delicious.  They will bring you anything you ask for that they can get.  Some of the hardest working people in the resort. I only have compliments for the staff and the food.  But, you cannot get eggs benedict here. 
Vento (Italian) - We ate at there the first night we were there.  The sauces were so bad.  There wasn’t any depth of flavor to any of it and they were drowning the food in the sauce.  I sent back the shrimp pasta because the sauce was bad and the shrimp were completely overcooked (this is a theme you will experience over and over).  I ordered the fish after and it was cooked very well.  It was again drowning in a bland green sauce, but at least I could eat the fish.  My husband had the shells and meatballs and he liked that one.  I was not a fan, but at least one of us had a meal we liked.  The arancini appetizer was just a bit odd to me.  It was a huge ball and it was described as Osso Bucco which I love.  But, it just came off as super heavy and nothing like arancini I’ve had before.  It has a brown gravy in the bottom… just odd.  Also I saw menus on trip advisor and they are really pared down.  It was not even half the items the picture showed.  The best thing they brought us was the bread, cheese, and meat at the beginning of the meal. 
Mole (Mexican) – We ate here a few times.  The pork leg is really good but you need to have them cut it off the bone for you.  It’s very hard to cut off yourself without making a mess.  They tried to tell us they wouldn’t cut it off the bone because of Covid, but I insisted and they got it done.  They try to use Covid as an excuse for anything they don’t want to do.  Tortillas were really good.  Nachos and guacamole were good.  I got the shrimp dish one night and the shrimp were as tough as the rubber on a tire.  It wasn’t even busy.  We eat very early and there may have been 2 other tables in the restaurant.  
Bana (Japanese) – This was a really good meal, but we were only able to get in once.  Have the fried rice, it’s amazing.  We had the beef but someone else said the chicken was exceptional too.  They fully season the rice and it’s just delicious.  We only ordered cooked sushi, and it was all really good.  Not too authentic, but good.  For example, one of our kinds of sushi had slices of cheese on top.  It was still good, but I know that any good sushi restaurant would probably freak out if they saw it.  We liked it, but I heard someone else say they hated it.  If you are looking for really authentic Japanese food you will probably be disappointed. I was really irritated on only being able to get in once.  None of these restaurants is busy early when we want to eat.  They really limit the number of reservations too much.   
Enzo (International) – This one is a mixed bag too.  We ate here for dinner and it was just okay.  Hit and miss on the dishes.  And, I got sick after eating here.  The wife of another couple we sat by on the beach got sick as well after eating there for dinner.  At lunch they turn in to a seafood shack.  No reservations are required.  The coconut shrimp was my favorite thing.  Not too sweet and they have a chipotle sauce to go with them that’s amazing.  I had the whole fried fish and it was super greasy and didn’t have very much meat.  I would not recommend it.  We got the salmon appetizer and it was a salmon salad that was very fishy.  We sent it back but he brought us some shrimp tacos that were delicious.  There is also beach food shack by the main pool right next to Enzo where you can get food.  There are shrimp tacos, hamburgers… smelled good but we never ate there. 
Sal (Very expensive paid steak house) – We ate here our last night and ended up walking out.  Filets were so tough we were having to saw on them. Our mashed potatoes had big chunks of un-mashed potatoes.  I agreed to pay for the crab legs and shrimp appetizer and it was $119 just for those 2 things.  The manager never should have even let me agree to this based on the experience we had.  Again, another example of bad management. This is a huge waste of money and you can do much better at a steak restaurant back home.  If you want to see more, I’ll leave a detailed review directly for this restaurant in trip advisor.  Just give it a pass. 

I'll add pictures later.

reviews.author: Ahna P
reviews.title: The Reserve at Paradisus is worth it!
reviews.text: Paradisus will not disappoint.  The Reserve is worth the money.  Ruben, Yamil, and Cesar on the Reserve side are top notch!  Also the margarita class/cocktail classes were great, along with the adult finger painting.  These are worth the break from the pool to attend.  Strongly recommend staying here.
