reviews.author: Amanda D
reviews.title: Senior Trip
reviews.text:
This review is non reserve,  group of 27 high school seniors and parent (s). We had a total of 13 rooms all in tower 3. Most of us had lagoon view, which for our needs was perfect, we were rarely in the room. The rooms were nice, beds comfy and housekeeping was very good. We did have problems with our safe several times and finally gave up using it.

We had teen boys who consume massive amounts of food and they never lacked for food. The drinks were good, but could be inconsistent, so had to find our favorite bar tenders and tip them well. The staff here is absolutely fabulous.

The Nespresso bar was amazing and the barista went above and beyond. The gelato shop was also a hit.

We enjoyed the nightly entertainment and appreciated them adding the DJ night since the nightclubs were closed.

We thought non motorized sports were included. And maybe they are (across the street at Aquaworld) but due to Covid we couldn’t use them.

We used the excursion desk for two excursions and they were helpful getting our large group taken care of.

The beach is beautiful and the beach drink and food service was amazing. The surf was rough the entire time we were there, and the lifeguard said it always was. If you are going for swims in the ocean, this is not going to be your place.

This place is top notch.... no complaints.

reviews.author: nitriz04
reviews.title: Excellent vacation!
reviews.text: Great staff, great food, great experience.  Shows every night were very entertaining.  We had a balcony view of the sea  to die for.  Look for Alex in the Malva buffet restaurant, he will take great care of you.  Also Giovanni in the Ginger bar.  Get down to the pool or beach early to claim your chairs with  the hotel towels.  Masks are the norm in the hotel and walking to the pool and the beach.  Covid test required before coming back to the US, but the hotel does it right on site.  Try to book an early in the day appointment for your test since they get backed up.  Also try not to book a Sat-Sat stay, the airport is chaotic enough with all the covid requirements and forms, let alone the many more travelers on the weekend.  Monday-Monday is ideal.  I enjoyed the spa massage and pampering by all the staff.  My husband enjoyed the beach except for the ugly and abundant seaweed. We also did a side trip to Isla Mujeres that was alot of fun. Their Playa Norte is beautiful, calm and no seaweed.  On the whole we had an amazing time.  I would wait until the pandemic is well under control to return though.

reviews.author: Vishal P
reviews.title: V. Patel
reviews.text:
I don’t know where to start , it was our first time in Cancun, we enjoyed hospitality at Paradisus very much. 
Good food verity, servers in Malaya were awesome
Manager Diego and his team is awesome good job.
Our helper SONI , she was best, everything planned and ready for us. Thank you Soni for that. 
The reserve pool area , Max was really helpful to reserve pool side and beach side tent for use throughout the stay. Server rebun , ceaser and all other staff were friendly, fast and attentive. You asked something and will be there in 5 minutes max. Awesome job guys. Thank you all of you guys for working really hard in hot weather.
My checking process was not so good. 
I booked room with 2 beds and they give me room with king size bed. We have to wait for 3 hours to get different room in crowded place. After 2 Nd night I went to ask for quite area room which I booked originally they told me they don’t have anything 
Finally they found me room which I paid 115$ per night extra. 
It was completely un professional.

reviews.author: 306navigate742985
reviews.title: Resort is nice, but...
reviews.text:
When I arrived at the resort they couldn’t find my reservations. I booked directly on their website, had a booking number and receipt with total cost. Took 3 hours to get a room after arriving. It was frustrating and the man kept trying to sell us a more expensive room saying it was ready now.

Be sure to call the operator from your rooms phone and book for dinner each night. It’s by reservations only, something we didn’t know. 

If you stay in the middle tower, tower 3, it gets very noisy at night. Usually a party until midnight and you can hear ALL the noise from your room with the door closed.

Resort was not too crowded and good covid procedures in place. Staff was very friendly and worked really hard. Take some ones and fives in American dollars to tip.

reviews.author: Morgan V
reviews.title: I turned into the Paradisus Princess
reviews.text:
This past week 6 of my girlfriends and I stayed at Paradisus for 5 days and 4 nights and enjoyed every minute of it. Just a 20-minute shuttle ride from Cancun airport, we had the pleasure to enjoy such beautiful blue water while immersing ourselves in the paradise of Cancun. With our grand experience, the first place I would like to start is the amazing and attentive service we received. Notable mentions for employees go to DD, or Didar, our pool server, Luis, our swim-up bartender, our other bartender Francisco, and activities coordinator Saul. These employees were so kind, attentive, charismatic, and always brought a smile to our faces. They truly embodied hospitality and provided an amazing experience for each of us. We loved how the gorgeous views from the lagoon and out back by the pool and beach. We became huge regulars at the breakfast buffet and the iced coffee where we had delicious meals to fuel our day and mid-afternoon espresso pick-me-ups. All the food for dinner was delicious but my favorite being Mole, it was my favorite and I dreamt about it every night after. 

Some things that we ran into trouble with were getting reservations for diner. Reservations are available three days out, which we discovered upon arriving and had such difficulty the first two nights that we couldn't get tables until 9:30 or 10 pm. After that, reservations were no problem but this is important to keep in mind. We do wish they played more music out by the pool. AC in our rooms was hit or miss, some days it'd be freezing while others it was humid.

Overall my friends and I had such an amazing time staying at Paradisus Cancun that by the end of the week we all thought we were royalty the way we were accommodated.

reviews.author: Elayna Myers
reviews.title: Beautiful property, reserve overhyped
reviews.text:
We traveled last week to this property after reading so many reviews and comparing endlessly to other resorts. We had 4 rooms in total, all in the Reserve area.

Upon arrival, we were shown to the "Reserve Check-in" area. There was a couple of larger groups. Someone was walking in to offer drinks. I had done the online check in and paid before arriving, yet when she went to check me in she said that I needed to pay. After a quite note, this was corrected. We arrived at 12:30pm, and our room was available which was fantastic, we we were ready to hit the pool. Our other friends were told to wait for their butler and they would be escorted upstairs. We were told ours was not yet available, but to download the WhatsApp and she would text us. Our friends butler, Adrian, escorted us and gave us some information as we walked to our room.

We were in room 5409 and had a partial view of the lagoon. Mostly we were looking at another building, but we didn't mind, we we did not plan to utilize the balcony. The room was clean, and the shower was really neat. The floors felt unclean, though. We were at the very end, opposite of the elevator, so noise was never an issue.

We were not able to find our butler at all our first day. I had to reach out multiple times. I was consistently told it had "been reported" to the reserve. Adrian let our other friends know that we needed reservations for bali beds and dinner.  There were no beds available until our last day, and dinner was 10pm or later. We were totally bummed. We took what we could and hit up the pool.

The second day, we were able to get a bali bed (and each day after) by getting some help from Victor and their team! There are daily cancelations, so just go check and see if there is anything. They were fantastic. We stayed over at the balid beds at the swim up bar area. The reserve, adults only wasnt our speed. It was much more quiet, and that was not what we wanted. Pedro and Luis at the swim up were our favorite bartenders our entire trip. They made sure to remember our names and our drinks.

We finally found our butler after my husband walked up to her, after seeing her name tag - Stef. She let us know she had made us reservations and would switch them from 2 people to 7, no problem. However, that was a huge problem. We had an issue EVERY NIGHT. Either no reservation, wrong time or wrong name. It became a hassle even going to dinner. She was totally MIA. When seeing Adrian, we definitely expected some type of the same service. 

Outside of the bali bed location, the reserve did nothing for us. I felt it was a total waste of money. 

The property itself is stunning. The beach had a lot of seaweed, but we knew to expect that, so it didnt bother us. We stayed at the pool, mostly. The service, outside of our "butler" was fantastic. The food was also amazing. A perk of the bali beds is that a server comes to bring your food. Ours was Jesus and he was a joy! 

Our COVID test took over a hour to get. Get a morning apt if possible!!! Our friends went at 915am and were out by 930. Ours was at 130 and we did not get back to the pool until 215pm.

Overall - the experience was ok. I likely would not stay here again, and if I did it would not be the reserve. The level of service we got from bartenders and the restaurant staff is what made our week good!

Try the baja tacos - they were our absolute favorite. We enjoyed Bana, Enso, the buffet and Mole for dinners. The buffet tacos were out of this world!

reviews.author: Maria T
reviews.title: Could have been much better.
reviews.text: Our butler was very inattentive. We had to make all of our own reservations. And he did not do the things we asked him to do. For example, I asked him to get me pricing and make an appointment for a facial and he never did. Also the room with the ocean view was VERY disappointing! The shrubs in the balcony boxes are so high that they BLOCK the ocean view when you sit in the chairs. So to see the ocean you have to be standing!! I strongly suggest a hotel manager go sit in the seats on the balcony of room 5089 and see how horrible it is. Take the bushes out and put in low growing plants! The pool at the spa had so many features that did not work it was not worth using. The room service menu was limited.

reviews.author: Samuel A
reviews.title: Skip the reserve “experience”
reviews.text:
First off, very nice resort and well maintained for its age. However, I feel the reserve experience is hyped up. Sure, the rooms are nicer, but the service wasn’t anything to brag about. 

I traveled with my family and we totaled seven. We had two rooms. I called the hotel from the US the day before after paying for my rooms I reserved a couple Months in advance. I even put on the additional notes my flight information because the reserve provides included transpiration to and from the airport. I called the resort the day before I left to make sure my flight information was given to someone to forward to the transport company. Well, it was not. Otium travel didn’t have myself or my family on their list and would not take us, even though I showed printed invoices of my rooms!  I had five swearing kids laying around on a Cancun airport floor trying to find shade with 100 eager taxi operators annoying us and wanting $150 to take us to the resort. After a good 20 minutes on the phone, I convinced the resort to handle this, which they did. Their initial reply was I had to pay the money and they would “see what they could do”.  This did not start the trip off well at all. 

However, the resort was very well cared for and I was impressed with the food. I didn’t have hot water for 2 nights around 6:30pm. Assuming because everyone was getting ready for dinner or going out. That wasn’t pleasant. 

Our butler left all the beer in our kids fridges even after we told him to get it out and replace with juices, chocolate milks and sodas. 

I just wouldn’t spend the money on reserve again. The resort I’d stay at though, but save some money and frustration. Check in took at least an hour because there were only two people working in the reserve check in lounge.

reviews.author: Britney E
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun best resort !
reviews.text:
Let me tell you bout my stay so to
Begin with the hotel was not far from the airport probably 15 minutes drive . It was hands down one of the best resorts I’ve Ever been too hands down !! I’m a frequent traveler that goes to many resorts different countries but I love it here so much ! I just came back on May 6th  of this year for my wedding anniversary my husband loves it the workers are so kind we always tipped them . It would Upset me to see groups of people at dinner or restaurants and don’t even give a tip me and my husband definitely look forward to coming back to paradisus. Enso best restaurant has down ! They are very caring and try to make the best of it our waiter Antonio was very kind he made things a plus for me and my husband . The resort is extremely clean it gives of a peaceful soothing vibes. But do not hesitate to book with them best decision I made .

reviews.author: Jade J
reviews.title: Paradisus makes you feel like one in a million!
reviews.text:
I traveled here to celebrate my birthday and college graduation with my best friend. We booked the week of due to awful customer service at Live Aqua Beach Resort Cancun (beware). My expectations of Paradisus were low given how large it is and how many guests they must handle. I was WRONG. This was one of the best vacations I have ever had! 

From the moment we walked into the hotel the staff made sure to meet out every need. Even if you aren’t in VIP they treat you like their most honored guest. We sat poolside and had delicious meals brought to us, as well as drinks. The food at this place is incredible, there’s no other word for it. I highly recommend the Japanese place (I forget the name). You’d think that Mexico isn’t a place to get delicious sushi, but you’d be wrong! Although the sushi was the standout, every meal we had was delicious including the buffet. We were constantly attended to, even when restaurants were packed. It is hard not to feel special at the Paradisus. Drinks were slightly watered down, but if you ask for an extra shot they are more than happy to oblige. When I mentioned it was my birthday, they were quick to bring out top shelf champagne. 

We booked three excursions through the hotel: the day long boat trip to Isla Mujeres, parasailing, and jet skiing (Wave runner). These were booked through a company called Aqua World. All I can say is that they made sure everything was perfect. For all three excursions we spent $140 USD per person, a great deal. We LOVED the Isla Mujeres trip and all our excursions. Aqua World has such helpful and friendly staff, it’s no wonder Paradisus works with them. I highly recommend booking excursions with them. 

I can’t say enough positive things about this hotel and our stay there. Although we were first time guests, I am certain we will be returning!

reviews.author: Mr10701
reviews.title: Visit during Covid
reviews.text: Most workers here are hard working but a small few need training in customer service. I say 8 of 10. Take a lesson from Martin, Orlando, Jonny in the buffet area. They work hard so I tip them well. Great resort

reviews.author: Travel675003
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: We had an amazing time here in Cancun. Melia Paradisus was truly a wonderful place. Soni our concierge was nothing great. She kept us informed about all the activities around the resort. Help us with dining reservations.  The room was very nicecand clean. Everybody we came in contact with were kind and helpful.

reviews.author: AJ M
reviews.title: So many things went wrong for us
reviews.text:
Just had horrible luck at this resort and will never stay here again:
1.  For some reason the power was off for HOURS upon arrival and into our first night there, so the room and entire building (and check-in process) was agonizing.  It felt like we were lied to about when the power would be back on and rooms would cool off, so by evening when it was still hot we demanded a different room in different building.  
2. The AC never would get below 73 and I know there are plenty of us that like a chilly hotel room especially after sun, beach and outdoor activities.  And all we did was sweat at night and it was awful.  My boyfriend wanted to leave to come back home but I insisted we'd make it through.  We complained, asked for maintenance but nothing dropped the temp.
3.  We called several times for extra towels or supplies in the room only to have to call multiple times.
4.  Safe didn't work and it took hours to fix plus two different guys--one to confirm the battery worked fine and another to say don't use keypad cuz it's broken and to just use this special key card.  
5.  The bathroom door didn't shut so there was another call to maintenance. 
6.  The fridge didn't cool any beverages off.  We called and they told us we can't put more than what came with room in it cuz it's just not meant to cool THAT much at a time and to take out our own stuff that we bought at a store.

reviews.author: Jose Remigio
reviews.title: Bumpy when checking in, but overall a dream come true! Excellent Service!
reviews.text: The young lady working at the front desk upon our arrival to the hotel (The Reserve section) was not friendly at all. My guest and I were not given the warm welcome that we regularly receive when we visit any of the Melia Hotels / Resorts. She carelessly asked for who's name is on the reservation, and then said our room will be ready by 3pm. That is all she said at check in. My guest and I observed the entire Reserve waiting area and honestly the appearance was very poor compared to other Melia Resorts The Reserve we have visited. The young lady had a mess on top of her desk and papers all over the place. The desk were the young lady sat looked like garbage, it was all scratched and many areas of the desk looked damaged. In simple terms, the young lady seriously needs better training and should revisit her job duties and at the same time revisit her customer service skills. Our first impression as you can see and with what I have expressed is more than poor. After our entire visit and interacting with other employees of the resort it was very obvious that the young lady who checked us in is definitely not in our opinion a good fit to the Paradisus Cancun team and example to other employees. On the other hand, we did unfortunately encountered an inconvenience with the air conditioning system in our room. We reported this issue immediately, but after going to bed that night then on forward we noticed that the air conditioner was still not working properly. I recognize that I should've reported this issue again but at the same time I feel that with our first report this problem should've been resolved once and for all. We did not stay at this resort to be reporting issues, however we visited the resort to relax and enjoy our vacation. Finally, everything else was perfect. The staff at La Palapa for instance Johnny, and especially "Diego" the manager were a dream come true. They were always super friendly with us and they definitely made sure we were 100% completely satisfied. Our butler "Diego" is what I call a world class leader. He is truly an asset to this resort and the company.  Diego is very thorough, responsible, upbeat, friendly and very welcoming. He always approached my guest and I with a warm smile and lots of positive energy. The team that catered to all guests visiting the pool within the Reserve section were always available and made sure guests had a drink or a snack at all times. Please reward your staff with a bonus or something because every

reviews.author: spiritfilled30
reviews.title: 14 NIGHT STAY
reviews.text:
First of all I would like to say that Alfredo Arcos and Cristhian Lovera were AMAZING!!!! They need to teach the other waiters how to serve because they were exemplary!  I think I tipped them well above and beyond what they ever received before possibly they were that good. They deserve a raise!!! 

Now onto the more bad things that I need to gripe about!  I was at this resort for 14 nights and I feel like I was intentionally not given what I wanted. My family does not consume alcohol at all. We are Christians and we do not drink.  We would only drink Seagrams Ginger Ale and VIRGIN daiquiris period.  Toward the end of our 14 night stay they started telling us they were out of ginger ale and bottled water?!?!?!  What kind of resorts runs out of ginger ale? or bottled water?   Nevertheless, my wife loves caramel in her ice cream or coffee and lo and behold they were out of that too real quick!!!  I was floored. We would repeatedly ask for ginger ales to no avail, or bottled water to no avail.  We finally gave up and started drinking the water they gave us not knowing if that would cause us to have explosive diarrhea or not! We took a risk.  

Anyway, another point that I know is that they nickel and dimed me completely, including at checkout.  They tried getting me for another 200 pesos and that was the last straw!  I also had to pay them a "FEDERAL TAX" upon checkout!  I thought an all inclusive was "ALL INCLUSIVE" including  "ROOM" and "MEALS", no other hidden fees or taxes etc.  I come back today and check out my credit card statement and I dropped an additional $1500 while I was there on top of my existing stay and on top of that they tell me that I need to pay extra for this and for that and they don't have ginger ale or caramel or they are out of all sorts of things.  I was very upset and I couldn't do anything about it.  And by the way I'm not one of these complainers I barely take any vacations so when I do take a vacation I don't have high expectations or I am not hard to please. On top of that the beach was full of sargassum (seaweed) and barely anyone was in the water.  The last time I was in Cancun to put it into perspective was back in 2010!  Anyway, the hotel has a lot of foliage or trees in the middle atrium and they had no AC in the public places it was very hot and humid and it felt like you couldn't breathe.  I loved our two waiters I cannot stop raving about them Alfredo Arcos and Cristhian Lovera were amazing!!!  They would hardly wait til we came down for lunch or dinner so they can wait on us.  Oh another thing is we would skip breakfast and only eat lunch and dinner. So I'm just overall flabbergasted as to why they would make us feel like they were out of caramel sauce or ginger ales or bottle waters because it made us feel like they were out of all that because of us?!?!

reviews.author: vjurad469874
reviews.title: Overall good stay
reviews.text: The resort was beautiful, unlike anything I’ve experienced before. Housekeeping kept the room clean & tidy. Pool & bar experience was great! Some waiters are slower than others. Check in was slow. They initially gave us a room that belonged to someone else & had to give us a different room, which was annoying after a long day of travel. Circle presentation was awful and a waste of 3 hours on our last day there. They had no respect for our time and were extremely pushy after we had told them we weren’t interested several times. Getting restaurant reservations was nearly impossible, so we had to eat at the buffet most times or go into town to eat. We were able to get one reservation at Bana at 10pm on our last day, the food and experience was great. Wish we would’ve been able to try others.

reviews.author: Alex W
reviews.title: Not great...
reviews.text:
We just returned from our wedding at Paradisus and overall the experience wasn't good. Here are the pros and cons:

Pros
-The staff is fabulous. Everyone goes above and beyond for anything you need, and they seem to enjoy their jobs. Truly, the phenomenal staff is the only reason I am not leaving a 1 star review. Moises at the reserve pool in particular is WONDERFUL, and Carlos at the Reserve desk was very helpful when we had a sudden issue.
-The food. The food in the restaurants is overall pretty good! Better than most resorts.
-The property is well maintained and very pretty.

Cons
-Check in. We were traveling with a large group of people for our wedding and many had different arrival days. Overall the check in process was an absolute nightmare even though we were in the reserve rooms. The computers always appeared to be "down", and our guests and us had to wait HOURS past check in time (3pm) to be let into their rooms. They also asked me for the total of the rooms and attempted to take my credit card information even though the system was down. Upon check out, Paradisus charged us an additional $240 that I never received an explanation for, other than they had "mischarged" us at check in which seems scammy. Our party was never given butlers despite paying for them, and I am still seeking a refund for that piece of our stay. 

-Management. This hotel seems to have been abandoned by Melia. Anything that needs to happen logistically at the hotel is impossible to accomplish. 

-App. Everything you want to do at the hotel needs to be done through the app which does not work most of the time. 

-Wedding services. While our wedding coordinator was very nice, overall I found the wedding planning experience to be incredibly disorganized and unimpressive. After paying $800 for a "private luxury dinner", we were sent a sample menu that included chicken breast and green salad. Not my idea of luxury. It was only after SEVERAL rounds of back and forth requesting a refund that we were eventually given a suitable option for our wedding menu. Why weren't we presented with this option to begin with? At 10pm the night before our wedding, our wedding coordinator texted me to let me know that they'd be charging me $1,000 in order for my make up artist to be allowed to come on the property. This issue was ultimately resolved by Carlos at the Reserve desk, which we were incredibly grateful for, but I just couldn't believe this was sprung on us at 10pm the night before the wedding when I'd told our coordinator I'd have someone coming from outside several days prior.

Overall impressions: I was disappointed with my stay and I will not be returning. I'm disappointed that a property with great potential is being run so poorly. I would not recommend this resort to anyone traveling with a large party, or anyone who wants a straight forward check in process. It truly felt like there was a different problem every single day and it greatly impacted our special day.

reviews.author: Jesenia Q
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: fifth time in this resort, the service excellent, big shout out to these crew members that go above and beyond to make feel like royalty: Malva buffet( Christian and Orlando), from Bahna (Esteban) pool side (Jesus & DD)  also to Saul & Agustin.

reviews.author: irina_t
reviews.title: A lot has changed
reviews.text: It makes me sad to even write this review since our last stay in Jan/Feb was so incredible. The entire staff has been changed here check in was horrible I did reserve again for this stay they took us into building 5 for check in and didn’t even put me in as a reserve guest even though she told me my butler would contact me in a little full day no butler when we went to our home we then saw they gave us the wrong room two double beds on the second floor of tower 3 right over the pool that is very loud and we couldn’t even open our balcony we didn’t receive a butler so it took us about 30 minutes of walking around the hotel to find our room we than called to let the staff know the room was not correct and were told that they had no other rooms till the following day we talked to the manager who first seemed very sorry and would try to Help us in the situation but that wasn’t the case..they changed our room the following day to building 5 a lot more quite and relaxing thankfully but then we get to the room the safe breaks, no alarm, coffee machine broke and then door breaks 3xs (we were locked out) and the worse part we were coming into our room and were in the elevator when the electricity went out and we start to drop let me tell you I wouldn’t wish that feeling on anyone your heart stops and you have no idea how to react. Once we got out the elevator Jorge the manager was there we let him know what happened and got a very dull response as if it didn’t happen and we were making it up. Long story short 5 days into our vacation and we are still waiting for the manager to let us know what can be done for all these inconveniences as it was A LOT HAPPENING in our first few days there we are here for 8 days. After being fed up I went to talk to another manager Eduardo I believe was his name and expressed how pissed I was about everything he was helpful and tried to make things right they gave us a couple 80min massage free and 40% off of amenities at the end of our stay (it’s all inclusive so kinda dumb as you really don’t pay extra for anything unless you go to the steak house or massage) but I’ll cut it short the resort is not as high end as before the staff is not the same butlers don’t do much at all you pay extra for just access to the adult pool (which many people without the reserve band were in the reserve area so I wasn’t really sure why we paid extra for it if we could have went there anyways) so sadly after rating this resort the best in Cancun it went down to 2 stars after all the horrible experience and lack of care by staff. A few staff that did make it great to come back which were still here from our last trip Ruben Ceaser and Miguel at la palapa Carlos at Mole and at the cabana reservation Max and Lucus I wish all staff were as great as them because they truly work hard and go above and beyond. And David who is from the spa who walks around the adult pool signing you up for massages and telling you the new deals for massages available he’s amazing and even helped us figure out who our butler was (none at that time since they didn’t assign us to reserve) sadly this will be my last stay here at Paradisus so I will miss all these people who did go above and beyond to try to make our stay more comfortable. However I do want to add Jorge did come an apologize for how things were handled and did say it was out of his power to try to make things right so the reason it took him long to talk to us is because he was talking to the main people. I don’t hold anything against any employees however I just was not pleased in anyway.

reviews.author: IrinaT
reviews.title: BEST RESORT IN CANCUN!
reviews.text: I’m not even sure where to start.. from the moment you walk into the lobby you’re literally in PARADISE! We booked this hotel last minute after getting to Mia reef hotel (horrible) and leaving the following morning after reading the reviews we decide to just get a room there instead and it was the best decision ever! We decided to get the reserve which comes with a “butler” although I personally don’t like that word I will call him our Host Rodalfo was truly the most amazing person he not only helped us with making sure for 7 days we had a reservation for dinner every night but if we wanted to change it to another restaurant he had it done. He also helped my now fiancé plan an entire engagement last minute since we changed our entire trip without hesitation and made it perfect! He made things happen in minutes when asked and never even questioned anything. Truly made our trip unforgettable and he will be the reason we come back for sure. Some of the waiters Jimmy,Hugo, Cesar, and Miguel of course were amazing and were always beyond helpful and made sure to always have my lychee martini even if it meant finding it at another bar/restaurant in the resort! There are not enough words that can even come close to describing the service here! Everyone including the chefs are amazing service by the beach and pools outstanding! Reserve is great if you want a little more of a private quite experience. Thank you to all the amazing staff for everything and we can’t wait to see you in a few months. Covid safety here is also huge everyone is in masks when indoors you must wear a mask they offer Covid tests for you before you leave you have to set up an appointment when checking in and it was at no charge! EASY SIMPLE BEAUTIFUL AND JUST ALL AROUND PERFECT! Again RODALFO YOU ARE THE BEST THANK YOU SO MUCH! Andy&Irina❤️

reviews.author: sls1032021
reviews.title: Nice relaxing get-away
reviews.text:
Staff was very friendly. Not sure about the whole butler service because other than scheduling our covid test and dinners, we could have done this ourself. The best part of the reserve is the Bali beds included. Mole food and staff was the best we had the whole week. Our bartenders for la palapa and the Bali beds were some
Of the most hard working and attentive staff we have experienced.

reviews.author: Andrew Angliss
reviews.title: RESERVE Complaint
reviews.text:
Who do I speak to to complain? I just checked out today I dont even want to deal with the people. I paid an extra $400 for reserve and i did not get any priority reservations! What am i paying for if everyone else can book the same restaurant reservations?? Butler service couldnt help, VIP check in took 40 minutes?? Only one person to check you in?? How does check in take so long?? And i couldnt even get my room a little bit earlier?? The hotel was empty on the day I checked in. 
Suites with luxury services??? There was no door to bathroom? Looked worse than the regular rooms. Had to even have someone fix the motor on the safe because it broke in the middle of my stay. It was my wife and I 9 year anniversary and I thought reserve would make it special. It did not!

I expect some sort of refund? I did not get what was expected for paying the extra $400. 

Andrew Angliss room 5703 may 12-16 

I already emailed havent gotten response yet

reviews.author: Maria M
reviews.title: Lovely hotel and service!
reviews.text:
Beautiful hotel! Would definitely stay again. We had an ocean view Jr suite. The best part is, hands-down, the service. Every employee, from the bellhops, to front desk, guest services, and the amazing waitstaff work really hard to make your stay special. I especially want to shout out Janeth at the breakfast buffet and Mr. Victor in the pool area. There was also a gentleman who was our waiter at Mole on May 8th. I wish I could remember his name because he was excellent. Victor was the rockstar of our entire trip though. He works extremely hard and went above and beyond for us every time he saw us. They were also very responsive. On our first day we called down because our mini fridge wasn’t working, and it was fully fixed within a couple of hours. The same thing happened with all of our requests. Also, the shower was AMAZING. 

Now a couple of things to consider. They weren’t huge dealbreakers for us because the service was so great, but...
I do not recommend the room service. Most of the food on that menu tastes gross. Definitely stay  away from the hot dog.

The buffet food is OK. The have some good things but mostly bland food. The other restaurants are a bit better.

The wind against the sliding door is EXTREMELY loud at night. I don’t know if it was only our room or if it’s a thing everywhere, but there is a certain spot where the wind hits that makes a whistle. I’m not a stickler for loud noises, but if I had been staying more nights, I would have requested a room change. 

All in all, we enjoyed our stay and will be back!

reviews.author: Kimberly D
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun May 2021
reviews.text:
I visited this property May 11-15 with my adult daughter and husband for some rest and relaxation and to mourn the passing of my mother and father-in-law who both passed from Covid in February.  This is a beautiful property and in all fairness, if there was an above-average rating, say 3.5, I would give it to them.  I hope this review will help others make a decision and I will try to break it down into categories.

Check-in-Junior Oceansuite Reserve Section
This was not a smooth process, but not too bad.  The room was not ready when we arrived.  Our luggage was taken and we were shown where we could eat and that our butler would contact us when the room was ready.  We were never contacted and we returned to the check-in desk and after a few minutes, we were told the room was ready and that our butler would contact us.  We were never shown around the hotel so it took us a day or so to navigate and figure out what we were doing and when.  I am extremely disappointed about this because the extra money was paid for this reason.  Our butler showed up to room 3307 around 8 pm.  You will be told to use Whatsapp to access all activities but it doesn't work until you are given a code which the butler has to give you.  We didn't have any dinner reservations the first night for this reason and were stuck eating room service.   The room was lovely with the rain shower in the bathroom, two queen beds and spectacular view from the balcony..  We requested a rollaway bed for our daughter, and they did one better and brought her a comfy twin bed.  I have a slipped disc in my back and the chairs on the balcony did not adjust to sit up so we requested different chairs.  More on this later.

Food
The second night, our butler, Diego, made reservations at Sal.  This is the only restaurant that was not included in the pricing and is a steakhouse.  Our food was $240 USD.  The service was fantastic, but the food was just average and I've had better food.  The grilled veggies were delicious, but the rice was similar to oatmeal..  We ordered two steaks and my daughter and I shared and my husband ordered a bone in ribeye.  Huge steaks, see pic.

La Palalpa
This is an outdoor restaurant with a limited menu but very good.  We ate there every day for lunch.  Honorable mention goes to Yamil and we tipped him accordingly for making us feel special.  The camabert cheese and fish tacos are to die for.   The fish finngers and fries are also very good.  The employee work hard.  Unlike any all inclusive we've visited in the Caribbean where tips are forbidden, tipping was done all over this result.  We took $400 just for tipping for four days and we wanted to spend it all, but did not.  The waiters at La Palapa got a good bit of it just for going above and beyond with a smile.

Malva
This is the buffet restaurant and we ate there each day for breakfast.  Huge spread of food.  Fresh omelets are delicious as well as fresh fruit, fresh fruit smoothies, french toast, etc.

Bana
This is a Japanese restaurant and was our favorite.  The service was great and the food is good.  The potsticker appetizers are so good, but you only get two so order 6 of them right off the top so you don't have to wait.  We made up dishes that were not on the menu and they came through.

Unfortunately, we didn't eat at Mole because we were told it was closed only to find out later they were open.  : -  <

Things to know: If you are in the reserve section, the Bali beds with the palapas are included in the price.  There are only 5.  We managed to get with the pool concierge and snag one for an entire day.  There are also Bali beds at the adult pool that need to be reserved.  I never found out how to reserve and our butler was unsuccessful at this.  Each time I tried to snag one, they were all reserved.  I was told to come back at 11 am and if there were no shows, we could have one.  This worked out each day, but it would have been nice to get help with the process of reserving.  Apparently, other people figured it out as those purple towels were out there indicating already reserved.

We were in building 3 and never heard any noise as mentioned in other reviews.  The rooms showed dating, but acceptable and comfortable with the exception of the air conditioning being a hit or miss.  We enjoyed our stay and this resort would have received 5 stars if I did not pay the extra money for the reserve section.  We just didn't get what we expected; however, we loved our butler and he brought a topical cream to ease some pain in my knee that was so appreciated.  He definitely has the personality, but maybe needs more experience or he was stretched too thin.

I've worked in customer service for years that includes hotel experience.  My tip is just make everyone feel important.  I felt other families were more important than us and was told daily that he was very busy with other families.  Big no no in my book.  I never received the adjustable chairs so I was unable to enjoy the large balcony over the ocean.  If this hotel smooths out their processes, I would return.

I hope this was helpful in making a decision.

reviews.author: alyssa
reviews.title: Amazing Staff!!
reviews.text: Best Birthday stay ever!! Overall all the activities and food were Amazing! Richer at the Nespresso coffee stand made the best latte I have ever had and always with a smile! At the food bazaar Alejandro, Samuel, Armando, end Christian Lovera had amazing service and kept the drinks coming. I Recommend getting a cabana at Kanna. Manuel, Luis, Samuel and Jorge made my birthday amazing. You get a free bottle of champagne and a lobster. Manuel recommend fun and new drinks. Try the Banana Sexy or the Tamarindo margarita! Luis is always there with anything you need and fresh towels. Don’t forget Rafael at Banna, he had exceptional service!! I highly recommend the paradises because everyone who works there was really great.

reviews.author: bprev
reviews.title: Bad resort.
reviews.text:
First I will start with the good. The poolside service was the best thing about the trip. Jesus offered service with a friendly personality and showed great hospitality 

Now the bad,  we had three different rooms. A lagoon view meant that we got to look at dead grass for the first half of our vacation. They changed our room which we had to pay for. This time we had a much better view. If we had gone with a cheaper room would have been able to look at the beach. However, we were not able to appreciate the view. The AC worked very poorly in all three rooms. We made repeated reports of the issue of the air. It never worked. We were told that it was just the way that it was because of the weather. Myself and my husband have stayed in other resorts with the same weather with no issues. We could not open the door to the patio because it would instantly heat the room up. The wind would blow into the room through the patio door even if it was shut. The food was ok but the staff for the most part was friendly. The website has different information for which restaurants would allow kids than what was posted at the resort. There were water outages with no notice. The reserve upgrade was a waste of money if you have kids. The resort also states that it is family friendly but the activities and amenities for kids are very few and far between. I would not recommend this resort to anyone. The only reason I have it two stars is because of the pool staff.

reviews.author: Rebecca H
reviews.title: Abel @Enso Restaurant (Paradisus Cancun)
reviews.text: We had the most delicious dinner and our server Abel went above and beyond to make our experience excellent. The food, service , and atmosphere was superb. Will definitely be returning and requesting Abel and Antonio as our servers. Thank you!

reviews.author: Javon U
reviews.title: Great customer service
reviews.text: My wife & I Enjoyed Our Stay at the Reserve Paradisus. Everyone was so kind, Always Smiling, Great Energy.. The staff Diego, Ruben, Oscar Moses,Jose, Yahmil, Valeria & Caesar made Our Vacation stay even better then we could have imagined. We’ll definitely be back.

reviews.author: Denise Reis
reviews.title: Family trip
reviews.text: The service on the entrance is SUPER SLOW. It can get you up to a hour to be attended. Frustrating and stressful! If you ask for a taxi at the entrance, they will tell you one price and charge you a higher amount. Take care if you think you can trust on what they tell you !

reviews.author: World Traveler
reviews.title: Paradise Found!
reviews.text: We have visited 4 times so far and can’t wait to return! The property is magnificent, the staff could not be more welcoming, and the location along the Cancun beach is paradise! With the ocean view rooms in particular, you have breathtaking views of the amazing colors of the Caribbean Sea along with the beautifully manicured grounds and inviting pools that line the sea side of the hotel. Service from all staff, but in particular, the Pool Side Staff, is above and beyond any expectation. They are the best, and seek only to bring you the most relaxing vacation imaginable, anticipating your every need with friendly accommodation to your every wish. I cannot thank them enough for all they do for each and every guest equally, to make their vacation perfect, always with a smile! We highly recommend Paradisus Cancun to everyone we know. You will not be disappointed!

reviews.author: Aldo M
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation time at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
this is the third time in less than a year my wife and I have been in this hotel ; the food  quality and choice of drinks and spirits are  beyond expectations as  staff always  makes sure you will have an option depending your preferences...
we would like to thank all the persons whom make our stay a pleasure , however just to mention a few: our butler, Jose at the Club Melia , Victor from the front line pool service and Kanna beach , Julio from Malva breakfast and Enso at lunch , Christian from Bana , Luis from Avenue Bar ....
thank you Paradisus , you made our days amazing !!!!!!

reviews.author: DCF75
reviews.title: Front line pool staff doesn’t  disappoint! Reserve does this time around.
reviews.text:
Have to start off strong and say that our stay would not have been as great if not for Francisco, Laura, and Enrique by the pool, Elliot and Josue taking care of our Bali bed and towels, Saul with activities, and Richer at the Nespresso bar!  Adriana and her colleagues at the Kids Club had our boy wanting to spend more time there than with us it seemed!  The front line staff kept us happy (and well refilled!!) the entire time and took the time to find us, interact with us, and interact with our five year old! I didn’t take all the names of the servers at the Malva buffet but those I do remember by name were Orlando, Martin, Julio, and ugh I wish I  would have written them all down!  Great and welcoming service there!
 
The resort was clean and made us feel safe and comfortable during a still somewhat uneasy time. We have been here before and didn’t have high expectations given the COVID limitations but I have to say, the front line staff and beauty of the resort definitely exceeded our low bar for this trip.  The on resort COVID testing was easy and convenient!
  
Now- the negative. We had a really hard time before the trip arranging for an upgrade to the Reserve. It was infuriating. We had Reserve on a prior trip (formerly Family Concierge) and we had a GREAT experience! This time around, not nearly so. If there is something that really put a damper on my vacation, it was the constant thought that I paid all this extra money and didn’t get the attention I expected from our butler. We weren’t assigned a butler when we were told we would be; we returned to meet our butler (who wasn’t there) and were basically greeted by someone who said “ok I will be your butler”.  We weren’t informed that reservations were made unless we asked, there were barely any checkins, no interactions with our son, on her day off we had zero contact, two requests for a dinner reservation went unanswered and then, when answered, it was for 10pm - yeah, that’s not gonna work for a 5 year old. It was a true disappointment especially since this was something we paid extra for and had been trying to arrange for a whole month prior. 

We turned down hearing about Circle. We spent more vacation time than we should have on our prior two trips and weren’t doing it again in this very much needed vacation. It felt as though we were ignored by Reserve once they realized how adamant  we were about not hearing about the program.  Shouldn’t have to feel like that. 

Another negative - diner beware! We were asked if we wanted wine at Vento. My husband ordered a glass and it was less than half a glass. I truly thought there was a misunderstanding - that this was just “a taste” - because the pour was just that small. When I told the waiter that he wanted a glass of wine, he filled it up to what looked like a normal pour and oh! At the end of the dinner, we were charged almost $25 - FOR TWO GLASSES OF WINE! We were never told we would be charged, didn’t see it anywhere in the menus, had wine earlier in the week and weren’t charged.... Really?!?  And frankly, the food wasn’t great either. We love the food at the resort. We believe it is above average, especially for an all inclusive!  Vento was not at all what we expected and it was disappointing. 

If we return, it will be for the positives we experienced with certain staff list above and the beauty of the resort but we will strongly evaluate upgrading to Reserve.

reviews.author: nyasha c
reviews.title: Excellent par service
reviews.text: Listen to me, i dont usually write reviews but my stay at paradisus is worth it. After the long pandemic we needed a break and paradisus cancun was the destination. I booked Royal service ocean view. My arrival was late and i checked in at the VIP reserve checkin. This comes with a butler. She was very wonderful ensuring i feel safe. I feel the word butler should be changed because they are so wonderful people. Please call them guest relations specialists. She made my family comfortable, did all our bookings and printings. She was available even before her shift started. Her name is cecelia. Paradisus staff is friendly and available all the time we had the best time of our life. Such memories deserve potraits and i am working on that. Keep it up Paradisus. My friends will be there soon after seeing all our pictures of the resort. I give a 5

reviews.author: Miranda R
reviews.title: Such a relaxing trip
reviews.text:
We usually make an annual trip to Cancun but we missed 2020 due to restrictions. This trip definitely made up for it. I am a part time travel agent and I try a different resort every year so I can recommend the right resort to my clients. I would definitely recommend to couples for a romantic trip. We didn't bring the kids but I noticed some great kids activities going on daily. The first person that spoke to us became a friend to husband immediately. Abel was so funny and sweet. He spoke to us each time he saw us. We loved him. Ivan was so helpful. We were waiting for our tour guide on the outside in from of the resort for our fishing excursion. Ivan was leaving the resort but stopped and asked us if we needed help. We must have looked confused lol. He didn't need to since he was obviously off the clock but he stopped anyway. We ran into him the next day while he was working and he asked about the fishing trip. That meant a lot to us. Our favorite restaurant was Fuego. We were able to get reservations for 2 nights of our stay. Jonathan was our first server. He was FANTASTIC. I asked for something off the menu and he made it happen. We didn't have him our 2nd reservation but he stopped and chatted to us. He was pretty great. Bana was good and we had an amazing service for his birthday. My husband was not feeling well so we ended up leaving dinner before we done eating. Our server (I feel so bad that I don't remember his name) chased me done to give us a piece of birthday cake and champagne. He wanted to make sure his birthday was celebrated. So SWEET. Eddie was super sweet during the 2 times we were at the buffet.  There were other wonderful employees but we didn't write their names down. 
The resort was beautiful and well maintained. I wish the Melia app worked a little better. Our butler was very nice but seemed to be kept busy by others. We used the WhatsApp to contact him.

reviews.author: Troy S
reviews.title: Beautiful resort but not with the extra for the reserve
reviews.text: We had a good time and loved the resort but we upgraded and paid the extra for reserve and never even got a butler! We got ZERO help with reservations or anything! We didn’t even get shown around the property and spent the first 2 days lost. I wish I had saved the money as the people we traveled with had better service without the reserve. I also mentioned this to several people and even called the desk to get help scheduling our covid tests but it fell on deaf ears! Nobody reached out to help us out! We did have great service from Juan Carlos and Abel who are in marketing but god bless them they helped us get a couple of reservations! And Enrique gave us fantastic service pool side! I am just disappointed I wasted the money on reserve!

reviews.author: davidcubells94
reviews.title: Amazing hotel
reviews.text: Great experience. The food was amazing, the staff were very friendly. The guys in the reserve pool bar made our stay very memorable. The team really knows how to treat their customers. Specially Moises

reviews.author: quint9
reviews.title: Old resort with awesome employees
reviews.text:
I've waited too long to drop this review but I felt I had to. I want to get a couple of negatives out of the way first. 
Every bar outside where the breeze and beautiful ocean are close at 7pm(except for the one where the entertainment is which closes the moment the entertainment is over). After that, there's one single bar open and it's inside with kids running around and almost no air movement. That bar closes at 11 so you had better be done for the night at 11.
Also, they were nice enough to "upgrade" our room when we got there. The only problem is that they upgraded us out of the newer tower 5 and into a very old room in tower 4. Now I get why they were so eager to "upgrade" us.
That all being said, the people who work at Paradisus Cancun are top notch!  They really do a good job of overcoming the older resort let down. Soni is the sweetest lady. She made our day every day. Max and Lucas at the pool are better at taking care of guests than probably any of the butlers. Moises is the best waiter. He recognized my wife and I from our previous trip and welcomed us back with open arms. Seriously GREAT people.

reviews.author: Hopp
reviews.title: Not a resort snob -
reviews.text:
Stayed at one of the resorts before. First time at this one. I do get it because it’s during Covid. But they cannot refill my mini fridge unless I’m in the room. According to my concierge (definitely not worth it). Sounds like some of the people here are really good though (Kinda of disappointed with ours). 
Just an example I attached a photo. Everything I tried to do he tried to convince me otherwise. Even down to reserving the Bali beds. I’m still here for a couple more days. Don’t think the upgrade was worth it

reviews.author: Stephany M
reviews.title: Mole
reviews.text: What a great time! From the time we walked in with my family Javier and Noe made us feel welcomed, they gave us a detailed explanation on our options. The chef Yoary cooked us a spectacular meal. Without a doubt the best restaurant in Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: Sienna1126
reviews.title: My experience
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel! Amazing food. Great people. Very clean. Very good vibes!! Everyone at the hotel is always ready to help and is super friendly! We had Adrian as our butler who was incredible! He made sure we had reservations each night and was very attentive with everything else. At the buffet every morning we had Martin who memorized our drink orders for everyday and was so sweet and friendly! Also, 10/10 recommend the ocean view rooms- waking up to that everyday can't be beat. Overall, a fun and memorable trip! Would definitely come back again!!

reviews.author: Annette O
reviews.title: Management has no customer service  interest
reviews.text:
Cancun

BEWARE OF MANAGEMENT

788481208

Management on this property was not even human.

My husband took me to this property for a Mother's Day gift and to CELEBRATE my 9th year healed from breast cancer.

We had visited this property before and was very pleased and wanted to come back to this location.

On Wednesday May 5, 2021 we arrived on the property checked in had lunch changed clothes went to the pool we were sitting at the pool in the lounge chair all of a sudden something popped and I heard my husband yell get my hand get my hand. Yes my husband was sitting in a defected chair that collapsed and crush his fingers had to have 12 stitches on one finger and the other hand he will loose one finger nail we were at the hospital in Cancun on our first night there all night.

That started our vacation first day crushed fingers. We missed dinner 2 nights and the other nights we just went to eat and came right back to the room at 8:30pm who does that on vacation(nobody) could not enjoy any activities because my husband was in so much pain and heavy medication.

That's just some of the story on what happen. What's a SLAP in the face is that Management did not have it in there hearts to talk or communicate with us face to face at all the whole entire time management sent messages to us on what they will do which was NOTHING!!!

What kind of business operates in customer service treats customers like that especially when their customer gets injured by a defected chair on their property no fault of ours and there's no compensation we were left on our own.

We thought Melia was much better than what was shown by MANAGEMENT in Cancun.

I'M SO DISAPPOINTED IN MANAGEMENT AT THIS MELIA LOCATION IN CANCUN. THE PROPERTY IS NICE BUT MANAGEMENT SUCKS.

reviews.author: Judy G
reviews.title: Exceptional
reviews.text: Hi!  My husband and I have been staying with the Melia resort chain for several years now.  We have stayed at La Perla in Play Del Carmen as well as the Los Cabos Paradisus location.  This was our first stay at Paradisus Cancun.  The reason we keep going back is that, while these are gorgeous locations, you simply can't beat the service.  We used to stay as Royal Service guests, but that has now changed to the Reserve.  We stayed at Paradisus Cancun from 5/5 - 5/10/21.  Jesus and Yvonne made themselves available for any and all of our needs while at the pool.  Each day they went above and beyond to make sure our experience was nothing less than perfect.  Esteban at Bana was beyond superb.  He made us feel welcomed as he served us with care and attention.  My husband loved the sashimi and the ramen and fried rice were amazing!    Moises at La Palapa greeted us each morning with smiles and jokes to get the day started.  I was spoiled each morning with fresh mango and payaya.  Finally, Violeta and Aaron, as our butlers, were communicative and helpful throughout our stay.  I look forward to our return knowing that we will continue to receive amazing service from all Melia resorts.

reviews.author: msgrill1
reviews.title: Great Rooms
reviews.text:
Great Property. Large in size, great food and a great experience
Pavel was our guy who handled everything from pool bed reservations to dinner reservations to suggestion on off property activities. 
If you are at this property be sure to ask for Pavel as he makes a good vacation great

reviews.author: aliscan0
reviews.title: Mix feelings about this property!
reviews.text: The property is magnificent and by all means far better than most of the all inclusive in the Cancun hotel zone. It's just my experience on the check in (supposedly VIP/THE RESERVE), lack of attentiveness, personalization on that area only and the problem that we had on the bathroom- it's flooding and they are not doing anything about it...

reviews.author: homanalaei
reviews.title: Great Hotel and exceptional food.
reviews.text: Their food and drinks were exceptional. Everything was delicious and very well organized. The staff is very professional and friendly. The bana (Sushi) restaurant and the buffet were my favorites. You will not regret coming to this resort!

reviews.author: keabrax
reviews.title: Paradisus  restaurant Enzo
reviews.text: Excellent service and food. Thank you Able so much for the awesome service. We loved it so much we came back 3 times during our trip. Couldn't find a better place to vacation. The service here is unbelievable

reviews.author: MHev
reviews.title: 60th Birthday Celebration
reviews.text: We had a great time and many employees were excellent but the best service was with Diego’s team at The Reserve pool. Oscar, Yamil, Jhony, Mo, and other numerous bar tenders, servers and wait staff went above and beyond. They took time to get to know our group and our preferences. They were very good at communicating and even provided items that we requested that weren’t on the menu. We spent a lot of time at the beach and reserved the Bali beds for 2 days(all that the resort will let you reserve) and then spent late afternoons in the pool. Our favorite restaurant was Mole. Many restaurant waiters weren’t familiar with the menu but the waiter at Mole was very informative. Definitely worth the upgrade to Reserve! We did have to keep checking all of the services provided by the butlers but as long as you’re proactive, you’ll be fine.

reviews.author: Seth R
reviews.title: Wonderful Family Trip Traveling First Time With an Infant!
reviews.text: My wife and I have stayed at the Paradisus Cancun several times, but we recently returned from a one week stay that included our four month old daughter. Not only was this her first trip to Cancun, but it was her first vacation ever. Our past experiences staying at the Paradisus made us comfortable with bringing her and we were not disappointed with our decision! Our fist major concern was obviously the Covid implications, however the resort took every precaution necessary to make us feel safe even while being there with a baby. This included not only the testing available directly at the hotel which was quick, easy and efficient, but also the distancing and mask requirements. They were also very good with extra sanitation and having masks and hand sanitizer readily available. The resort itself is beautiful and offers lots of options as far as restaurants, which are all excellent, shows and activities for all ages. The location is also a huge plus as it is only around 15 minutes from the Cancun Airport which makes getting there a breeze. With that being said, I would truly say that the best thing that this resort has to offer is the staff and people. They are all so welcoming and so willing to do anything that you need at anytime. We have visited a lot of resorts in many countries and I can easily say that the staff at the Paradisus is probably the best that we have encountered. I did want to give a shoutout to a few that we had excellent experiences with. First off the staff at the Kanna Beach Club/ Bar especially Rene, who was absolutely wonderful! We had the pleasure of being served by Rene on one of our previous trips and were absolutely delighted that he was still there. He always goes above and beyond getting you anything you need! Every time I took the last sip of my drink he was always there waiting with another one as if he read my mind. I can't say enough good thing about him! We also had very good experiences with Sergio and the rest of the servers at the pool. Once again so willing to go above and beyond to get you anything you want and need! Lastly, we had the pleasure of being served by Julio and Gaudicio at the breakfast buffet every morning. They were so great with everything including even taking time to talk with us and engage and interact with our baby despite having so many tables to take care of. We will definitely be returning to the Paradisus Cancun on multiple trips in the future!

reviews.author: Sam M
reviews.title: Moises, The Reserve
reviews.text: THE most nicest, most sincere, most cooperative, most coolest, most sweetest, most happiest and simply the best employee at The Reserve. From the very first night, to the very last day. Moises made sure that me and my fiance were happy, taken care of, had food and drinks at all times. He was also our server for our romantic dinner, he made it possible for me to propose to my girlfriend in the best way possible, he thinks of every detail to make the customer's experience better. I can't stress enough how much we enjoyed this man. He wasn't our concierge, but he sure acted like it... Moises was a BIG BIG reason why we had the most amazing vacation. Please take the time to meet this man if you're staying in the reserve. And to Paradisus, it is a necessity to give Moises not only a raise in money, but a promotion in his job and position. Can't thank Moises enough for the experience, seriously, I get emotional just thinking about it...

reviews.author: Milus1a
reviews.title: Great family stay!
reviews.text: Our stay at Paradisus Cancun was great! Most important food was delicious especially in speciality restaurants like Ensobor Bana. I loved the decor and atmosphere of the place. Very clean and well maintained. We celebrated Mexican Dia Del Nino while being there and Kids Club went above and beyond with their party. Activities for kids were great. We have met some great people all over resort like Martin from breakfast restaurant, Abel from Enso restaurant, Roberto at Fuego or Ismael from Reception. Let's not forget about beautiful beach and close proximity to local stores and attractions. I look forward to coming back to Paradisus Cancun one day.

reviews.author: Amy C
reviews.title: Excellent options for food allergies!
reviews.text:
Our experience at Paradisus Cancun was great. Everyone was so friendly and helpful. There’s one aspect I wanted to review in particular and that’s eating there with multiple food allergies (in my case, dairy and gluten). It can be very stressful and disappointing traveling and not being able to partake in the regular food offerings, but the amazing staff at Malva Food Bazaar made sure I had delicious meals provided for me that omitted my allergens. In particular manager Carlos, 
Chef David,  Alejandro & Marco. 
The food the chef made for me was so good I wish I could eat it everyday!! My last meal there was dinner and he had made me soup, a main course and even a delicious dessert (which I rarely get to have) !! 
I was very touched by their kindness and I just had to share.

reviews.author: Marcela G
reviews.title: Excelente lugar familiar!! Excellent family and couples resort ! Third time visit.
reviews.text: This is our third time visiting the Paradisus, although the place and commodities are great! We essentially continue to come back because of the incredible staff! The bar waiters, the servers, the front desk staff! Everyone goes above and beyond to make you feel like you are royalty! For two days we rented a cabana by the pool and had Sergio as our server. Sergio went above and  beyond to make us feel comfortable! Checking on us every 10-15 mins, bringing our food and champagne out as discussed and scheduled. Without a single doubt we will be returning to The Paradisus as the staff make it worth it every time ! Thank you Sergio for your excellent service

reviews.author: Coastal653788
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel and good restaurants
reviews.text:
Hotel esthetic is gorgeous, staff is SO KIND! Abel is so attentive and helpful!! At Mole restaurant, the food and presentation was amazing! Luis Zetina and Gabriela Lea were great and provided EXCELLENT service, no complaints! Fuego was so great, the food and presentation was 10/10!!!! Swim up bar area could be more lively does not have any music outside and service is okay. The little cabanas with straw roofs near the pool provide the BEST view! The ocean view going outside to the pool is undefeated!!! 

We had issues with the AC in our room, it was requested 4x to be fixed and was not. That was disappointing, every time we entered our room was 70 degrees plus, EACH TIME.

reviews.author: Shawn Andrea
reviews.title: Paradise in Cancun
reviews.text: We spent 11 fabulous days at Paradisus Cancun All Inclusive resort. We opted for the Royal Service which is the adults only section of the resort and includes a butler. This section of the resort has a private pool and restaurant that’s only for the guest in that section. The resort in its entirety is fantastic. It was at 40% capacity and was the most excellent experience I’ve had traveling in 2020 to date. Following Covid safety guidelines were their top priority. There are multiple restaurants to choose from, all excellent. Our butler Hector was top notch. “Let me cater to you” should be his motto. “At your service” is just that. They will spoil and pamper you. Unpack your luggage, iron your clothes, he meticulously arranged my personal shopping (I gave him a list and it was done), made our dinning reservations, helped select our meals (gluten free vegetarian), room service for our daily breakfast, want something that’s not on the menu...just ask, they’ll do their best to accommodate you, reserved our Bali bed daily, they even rolled out the red carpet for our makeup artist who wasn’t a guest at the resort. I highly recommend Paradisus Cancun. I’ve stayed in every section of this resort including the one bedroom time share section and the standard rooms. This resort is family friendly. I saw a few families with  kids having a blast but it was mostly couples and friend groups.

reviews.author: Melinda M
reviews.title: Excellent dinner and service!!!
reviews.text: A wonderful dinner at Enso.  We loved our waiter, Roger Chan!   The food was excellent.  Highly recommend Enso!  The tuna tartare was excellent!   The honey tuna was great!!   Guacamole was excellent.  Desserts are fantastic!!

reviews.author: JHQ
reviews.title: Hands down
reviews.text:
The Beach is one of the most beautiful I have seen in my life. The hotel is clean. We were deeply impressed at the hospitality and kindness of the entire staff at La Palapa. Josue, Ruben, Moises, Cesar, Oscar, Valeria, Diego were truly incredible.   They worked and worked and worked. They were incredibly attentive and always with a smile. I did not see them rest one time and we were in the Reserve beach area for days. They are high quality employees and even more impressive is the character and kindness shown so consistently.  

Maximilian working in the Reserve area was also helpful, knowledgeable and eager to help. 

David from the spa took time to ask about our day and was a genuinely great guy. 

Mauricio came to us late at night and brought us towels when towels were already put away for the night. He was incredibly kind and went way out of his way. He expressed to us that he did not want us to get cold after spending time in the water. 

The quality of an organization is always found in the character of its employees. We want to thank you all for being so kind and friendly and genuinely good people. I hope these people are recognized for going above and beyond for us. 

Love to you from Robert Beverly and Jennifer Quinn

reviews.author: Pattie F
reviews.title: EXCEEDED OUR EXPECTATIONS
reviews.text: My husband and I returned on 5/1 and spent 7 nights and it was amazing.  The hotel did a fantastic job managing COVID and arranged for our free test to return back to the US.  Our butler, Ale, went above and beyond to ensure our stay was perfection!  She is incredible.  The food was very good.  One of our favorite nights was in Bali, Japanese restaurant.  Our waiter, Raphael, made our dinner very comfortable.  It was little warm, and he brought us a fan, and suggested Amaretto Sours, his favorite, and now ours!!  We also had a 2nd butler, Abel, who was so much fun and full of energy.  He arranged for our day at the beach club which exceeded our expectations.  Our mornings began every day at Fuego, and the head waiter always greeted us with a smile and saved our favorite table.  We did nothing, but lay on the beach and enjoy this beautiful beach, the pool with lots of cocktails.  It was much needed R&R after a very long year! We will be back.

reviews.author: Yolanda R
reviews.title: Excellent Resort.
reviews.text: The property was exquisite and the staff was amazing.  Cesar our waiter was amazing and had excellent customer service and was very attentive.  This is our second time at the property and we absolutely loved every moment.  The hotel did a great job of keeping everyone safe by using COVID protocols. The only thing that I missed was the Royal Service treatment and access to the hydrotherapy as we had in the past.  I hope this comes back after COVID.

reviews.author: Edward1507
reviews.title: Great Service by Julian Ortega
reviews.text:
The hotel is amazing and the staff makes it even better. After getting an amazing and very professional check-in by the very competent front desk guy Julian Ortega we finally started our vacation with pleasure and fun.

The hotel is incredibly big but also very cute when it comes to details and little spaces where you settle down for a moment on a bench or a couch and simply listen to the water fountains in the inside of the hotel.

Keep doing the great work and clean a little bit more the beach from that sea grass, shells and some little stones by entering the water and the paradise is incomparable. 
Don't get me wrong the ocean and the beach is a 9.9 put

reviews.author: Victor_reviews
reviews.title: The best beach club at Cancun!
reviews.text: By far the best spot to ha g out with friends or family! From The minute you arrive you are welcomed by the staff who will guide you to your Bali bed in front of the blue waters! The food is amazing and the drinks selections is spectacular! Víctor Cauich que as our bar served and he made sure he was always paying attention to our needs, he made suggestions, and even special drinks! The place to be if you want to have fun with friends, family or just relax! 100% a great atmosphere! I revoked you reserve in advance.

reviews.author: Joseph K
reviews.title: Pool area
reviews.text:
Asuncion was absolutely an incredible lady..so nice and her service was just amazing....she is always happy and awesome at what she does.

My family was very pleased with her she really did take very good care of us and it meant a lot.

We will definitely be back because of the service and hospitality!!

Thank you Paradisus Cancun and thank you Asunción !!!

❤️

reviews.author: Jon A
reviews.title: Cancun In April - Paradisus
reviews.text: This is not your average hotel, definitely one of the top hotels in Cancun hands down. We did a lot of research before deciding where to stay, and everything considered we went with Paradisus. Initially we were going to go with a regular hotel, but decided to spend a little extra to go with the all inclusive. We didn't have much experience with all inclusive ,until Julian Ortega at front desk explained what our stayed included. Best decision ever, it was very convenient to have everything in the hotel and not have to drive a few miles down the road to grab food. 100% would recommend doing research like we did and consider distance, parking, etc

reviews.author: Jorge R
reviews.title: Paradisus Kanna best beach club in Cancun
reviews.text:
Absolutely WOW!! The best service, the best atmosphere, with the best music. 
Paco and his staff made it super special for my wife and I. Can not even describe with words how incredibly everything was. They all went above and beyond to make our time at Kanna incredible! 
Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: emster25
reviews.title: Beautiful place, but not 5 star
reviews.text:
My husband and I visited for a few days after being in Mexico City. On entering the hotel, the atmosphere is very relaxed and the interior of the hotel is amazing. We had an issue on our first night, as we.were next to very loud neighbours, who were winging and dancing well into the early hours of the morning. This was not what we wanted after a long flight. It took several calls and visits to the reception, who then agreed to put us in another room. This room, however, did not have the jacuzzi bath on the balcony like the other room had. This was really disappointing. It took a battle to get put into another room of the same standard to what we had originally. This was a very stressful start to the holiday and could.have been dealt with more promptly and apologetically by staff. 

There is a bit of a pushy vibe to the hotel - as we found when accessing the 'time share' type meeting. Luckily, my husband and I are intelligent enough to know that being a melia member is way above our price range. To be honest, I'm unsure who would be Able to afford it. Having said that, the discounted massage we had after that was the best massage I've ever had. The whole spa experience was amazing. 

Highlights for us were the Mole restaurant and accessing a cookery class. We thought there was good choice at the buffet restaurants. It was a bit disappointing that when we booked, we.were not made aware about some of the restaurants being under renovation during our visit, so unfortunately we were unable to access these. There is a lot going on at the hotel activity wise and we enjoyed the entertainment and ease off arranging excursions. 

Staff serving drinks and food were great, cheerful and helpful. The pool and beach areas are lovely and we definitely found this a nice area to relax. We found a lot of the things though, such as Bali beds, had an extra charge or a lot of things were royal service throughout the hotel and for us, that just sets a clear divide. 

Overall, we did not think the quality of the facilities, food and drink were 5 star standard. We stayed in a similar style resort in Jamaica that was 5 star and that was a lot better quality. I think with the Paradisuus, it is almost too big. This unfortunately means quality gets lost a bit and we also found it difficult to get to know other travellers, as it was just too big. Albeit, we did not stay for many days. We still had a great time though and enjoyed our stay.

reviews.author: Monique R
reviews.title: UNETHICAL MANAGEMENT TEAM
reviews.text: My family and I had a reservation to visit this hotel on April 11 but due to COVID-19 the reservation was cancelled. It is now May 28th and I am just getting a response that they will not be doing any refunds and giving me other dates this year where they will honor the rates. This cancellation is due to COVID-19 so why would they hold customers money which is theft and unethical when their reservation was cancelled. The country is still not fully open and there is so much up in the air with peoples lives and this is the unethical customer service treatment that I have received. I will never recommend this hotel or even want to visit there anymore. This is very unethical and theft if you ask me actually criminal to hold a customer money when visit was not completed due to an issue completely out of my control.

reviews.author: HandymanMike
