reviews.title: We are repeat customers!
reviews.text:
As frequent travelers to Cancun area, we've stayed in many hotels; largely depending on our travel partners and purpose of visit.  Suffice to say that this was our 3rd time at this property.   As I have already reviewed this property, I will only offer some updates based on experiences from this recent stay.

We booked the royal service room which offers its own private building and check in process.  We were assigned our own butler, Alex, who was extremely attentive and communicative.  (this was a complete opposite experience from our previous visit).  Alex immediately assisted with a group chat so all members of my travel party could be in sync.  His attention to special requests and even the routine were exceptional and should be commended for efforts and work ethic.

The waiters: we had only excellent experiences with waiters and would like to acknowledge Moises (whom we remember from our previous visit), Victor, Ramon, Joshua and a special thanks to Daniel the poolside manager for having a great team and going above and beyond himself.  Managers often get overlooked but he runs a great team.  The pool-service guys Degner and Aaron were also very accommodating.

We did indulge in the spa treatments and were very happy with the service and the facilities.  Some maintenance and cleaning should be done in the hydrotherapy area.

Restaurants:  It's nice to see there have been upgrades to the facilities including the main buffet area.  This was an excellent renovation and the quality of the food 
 of the buffet was superior to our previous visits.  We were very sad to see the Brazilian steakhouse be replaced with an average fare.  The Brazilian restaurant was very different from any other resort we stayed and we had always raved about it.  Do consider bringing it back. The sushi restaurant, which we love, was unfortunately only average this time.

The moving of the nightly entertainment to the pool-deck area is a major improvement than cramming into the lobby bar area.  Quality of the shows were better than we remembered and now easier to see.

Our only concern is the Expedia representative, Omar Rosado, who should be immediately replaced as he is a very poor reflection on the hotel; understanding that he is not an employee.  

Overall, we were very happy with our stay and will likely return if their pricing doesn't get out of control.  The time share folks (which was much more intense than our previous visits) were very aggressive but thankfully isolated to their own space.

reviews.author: World traveler 1947
reviews.title: 2nd Visit
reviews.text:
Let me start by saying I've been traveling to Cancun for 12 years now. I try to stay at most of the resorts and write honest reviews. Looking for that perfect place I'll always come back to. I stayed at Paradisus playa del Carmen last year for a week, and even though service there was great, I missed the beaches in Cancun.  So I extended my stayed with 2 nights at Paradisus Cancun.  I felt like I needed to try the resort again for a longer time to officially give it a proper review.
So I stayed the week of March 10-16 2020. Spring break was very busy. check in was delayed and when We finally got a room, it overlooked the parking lot,and smelled of a very strong chemical. I tried to bypass the smell, until I started feeling faint and wanted to vomit. I called the front desk to complain, and they told me if I wanted a new room I would have to pay $160 a night for a royal service room that was smaller than the JR suite that I already paid for. I fought with them saying I didn't need royal service,  just the same room that didn't have this chemical smell. They said nothing was available. Need less to say I was upset and went downstairs to speak with the manager and request my money back.  I even called the credit card company up to see what my rights were. After 30 minutes, the manager said he had an equivalent room to offer me. This room did not smell,  and was clean. It also had a better view. (I do want to clarify we wanted to investigate what the smell was) My husband found that the headboard, chairs,and coffee table were varnished. They stained all the wood furniture in a closed non ventilated room, and tried to put guests in there, while it still was wet! I included the picture of the wet varnish. management didn't even want to acknowledge the smell or the wet varnish. 
We tried to make the best of this trip, and were thankful they switched rooms. Pros: Service was good in the restaurant's. Beach side service was amazing, though drinks were so watered down. It was like drinking koolaid. Food in the restaurants 8/10. The cleaning crew for our room gets an A+, turn down service was great,we appreciated her very much. Thank you Cynthia!!! The beach was clean, and walkable.
Cons: The plastic cups they serve poolside are being reused! I didn't realize this until I got my own drink at the bar by the pool. All this time I thought they were disposable.  This is during CORONA!!! WE stopped drinking after that day. I purchased my own cup for outside. The only coffee poolside in the morning was by the bar,it was always empty. The royal service side was empty only 2 beds were in use, the other side was 100% full, we were kicked out of an empty palapa, and laid out on a towel on the beach.  Like I said when your on vacation u make the best of things,we didn't dwell. Nor did I feel like upgrading to Royal service, the first time I stayed at this resort I stayed in Royal service and didn't feel like it was worth the extra money. There was a Brazilian steakhouse when I stayed a year ago. They eliminated the steakhouse and replaced it with an ala cart steakhouse. Very pricey, food was just ok. Definitely not worth the money. You can go to a restaurant on the strip and pay half the money, for better food.

reviews.author: Paul
reviews.title: The Good and the Bad of staying at the resort - An unbiased review
reviews.text:
I stayed at the hotel in March 2020 and wanted to summarize the pro's and con's of the resort for people to be aware of when booking their vacation at the hotel.

Pro's:
- Hotel was very clean, everything had a sense of professionalism and seemed to be managed well for the most part
- Staff were awesome, from the waiters & bartenders to the front desk, room service clerks and chamber maids (Also, unlike Dominican or Cuba, everyone spoke English very well so there was no issues with language barrier
- Fair variety of alcoholic drink selection (also see alcoholic beverages in cons list)
- Room was nice, clean, prompt service with water/drink refills etc.
- Ground were beautiful and on a prime spot on the Cancun strip

Cons:
- The most beautiful portion of the beach is reserved for guests who pay $100-$300 USD per day to reserve a hut - it includes champagne and food but still seemed ridiculous to me. The section was always empty - Management should be able to figure out that no one wants to pay this kind of money for a nicer spot on the beach after already paying so much for their vacation
- Never enough chairs around the pool, I often had to lay on a towel on the concrete which was not pleasant
- It seemed like there were a lot of pressure tactics with regards to buying time shares etc. I didn't fall for it but I heard a lot of people complain about it wasting their time
- Nightlife was very poor, if not non-existent. I was hoping for shows, something fun to do at night and there was nothing - Keep in mind I was there also during spring break
- Food selection wasn't bad, I can't really complain, sometimes not very hot but it was decent overall. The Taco place was the best, simple but fresh and hot off the grill. A lot of the other food places (sushi, fancier Mexican etc) seemed like the food was pre-made and it wasn't hot when arriving to the table. Overall I didn't care for the sit down restaurants.
- Alcohol was almost certainly watered down. I swear I could have drank 30 cans of beer with little to no effect whereas back home in Canada 4-5 would have me feeling pretty intoxicated. I was weary of the hard alcohol as well, I ended up buying my tequila at a local liquor store to ensure the quality. I had a feeling the alcohol being served was not of the same quality of the stuff you would find at the store. Be weary.

Overall it was a fine vacation, the property was nice, staff were wonderful. My biggest issues were with the no nightlife, lack of chairs and the upsells that exist. Like much of Cancun, it felt to me more like a hotel on a beach vs. an all-inclusive resort which would find in Punta Cana or elsewhere. Overall 7/10 - Probably wouldn't return but still enjoyed my stay none the less

reviews.author: VaRa_ChiCity
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text:
My family and I visited this place at least 5 times during the pas few years.
We love everything: rooms with ocean view, activities for kids, food, people!

Special shot out to our all times favorite server- Mr. Armando Uc Balom! Kindest person ever, always goes above and beyond to make everyone's stay great! Greetings from Chicago!

reviews.author: Dianne G
reviews.title: You be the judge...
reviews.text:
We booked a family vacation. Booked it online through a booking site like this one. Got the all inclusive package.  The location is lovely. No complaints there. The room was clean and decent, but nothing to brag about. While checking-in, as part of it, they send you with one of their specialist to finish up explaining your All-Inclusive package. What they don’t advertise is that this “specialist” is smoothing the way for the “pressure sales pitchman/pitchwoman. Ours was a woman, which was a novice and her manager had to be hands on cuz she wasnt cutting it. 

Their trick is to sit you down from early on your trip, throw free stuff at you (which is typically not part of the all inclusive), they give you a special bracelet the staff recognize and they treat you like you’re king and queen of the manor. 

If you say NO to the sales pitch or no to the membership. They switch your bracelet to another one, which must be below the one the walk-ins get, cuz the quality of service went way downhill. It’s like you’ve been blacklisted, but couldn’t throw you out and we’re allowed to remain your stay. 

It’s a terrible terrible system they have there. 

It’s too bad. If they got rid of their little scam membership sales, it would be 5 star rating place.

reviews.author: Sandy and Stacy
reviews.title: Paradisus- A Wonderful Vacation!!!
reviews.text: We had Royal Service and it was definitely worth it and I highly recommend it!!  Our room was beautiful with a gorgeous view of the ocean.  Our butler was Alex.  He was absolutely amazing!  He anticipated our every need, from making our reservations to any questions or request we had! He even planned a birthday surprise for me and really helped to make it extra special.  We feel super lucky to have had him as our butler!!  Paradisus is a top notch resort and I couldn't have imagined a better vacation!

reviews.author: Clint
reviews.title: May 2019
reviews.text:
This was our third trip to Paradisus over the past couple of years. The resort is incredibly clean and the service is some of the best I've ever experienced. We love the variety of restaurants. Our favorites are Bana, Vento, Enzo and Mole. The servers are great. Huge thank you to Luis and Atlantios -I know i'm spelling that wrong- (Enzo) and Claudio (Bana). At the Family Concierge pool, we absolutely love Laura. She has always taken fantastic care of us and our little one. She even brings little gifts for our daughter, which was very thoughtful. Down at the beach, Miguel never let me see the bottom of my cup. The people really make this place wonderful. Can't say enough good things about them.

If you have the chance, you have to check out Tempo. It is the equivalent of a Michelin rated restaurant in the states. The food is delicious and creative and you won't get out of there without several complimentary dishes from the chef.  In my opinion, the service is better than anything I've seen at a Michelin restaurant. The staff are incredibly professional and elegant. They train hard to make the experience first class and it shows. This place is not part of the all-inclusive package abut we've been three times now and I look forward to going each time we visit the resort. You will need pants and a button-up for this one and leave the kids with a sitter. 

Through Family Concierge, you are assigned a butler. We had Alexa and Gloria, who were both very kind and accommodating. They made sure our rooms were well stocked and that we had our Bali Bed and dinner reservations for each day. 

Paradisus Cancun is a safe, lovely place full of great, hard working staff. This will not be our last trip to the resort and we highly recommend this place to anyone with or without kids.

reviews.author: Wander67123093167
reviews.title: Paradisus May 2019
reviews.text: Very hot humid in lobby no ac, hotel feels old outdated , not many food selections and the restaurant that requires reservations are generally booked . The lighting in the room is dark. The shower water is weak with no pressure

reviews.author: Mikedeso
reviews.title: May 18th - 25th
reviews.text: Overall, was a great experience. A little bit of a mixup in the room situation but that was quickly resolved. We had royal service, which was the cherry on top. Our butler, Alex was super attentive and always available. He handled all of our dinner reservations and if any instances arose, we simply went to him and within minutes it was handled. If you happen to get Alex as your butler, consider yourself lucky! Biance Paola at the front also needs a shout out. She is kind, generous and very knowledgeable in what she does.She had suggestions for every type of excursion we could imagine and knew everything about them all. She went above and beyond to ensure that this vacation was memorable.

reviews.author: TriniTravelingGirl
reviews.title: Do Not Hesitate! -->  BOOK NOW! --- You won't regret it!
reviews.text:
If you have read any bad or negative reviews - please IGNORE them...and Book!
If you have kids and are on the fence about which resort to choose.... Book!
If you are a single parent like myself and need a break from your kid(s) – Book! … 

I've just returned from celebrating my 40th birthday at Paradisus over the past week - with my 7 year old son.... sister and 9 year old nephew. I researched for months on end going back and forth between so many other all-inclusive resorts (this is my second time back in Cancun). I wanted an awesome resort for myself and my sister - but also fun for the kids. I booked the Family Concierge Package (Lagoon View) and I couldn't have been more happier...I emailed them months back with a few small requests...and closer to the time- requested to be in the Pyramid 3 - as we didn't want to walk far each day for meals..pool...etc... (Thank you for those reviews that mentioned this). It's only fair that I return the favor - so here we go!

Lagoon View Room -

For us... this was perfect.. While I usually do ocean view when I travel elsewhere..I didn't feel the need to upgrade in this instance - since we'd be out of our rooms for the majority of the day. We were on the 3rd floor - and it was perfectly fine... each night there was actually fireworks across the way that we all enjoyed...As long as I'm not facing a wall.... I'm fine...lol.... So if you're on a budget - lagoon view is GOOD!.. Our rooms were spacious... mini bar refilled each day... housekeeping was awesome..bath products are lovely....AC worked fine.. a small leaking sink faucet.. but nothing major.. Turn down service.. extra products and towels whenever needed.. They call and follow up for every request to make sure you have received whatever you requested… really awesome. My only gripe – I wish it were 2 Queen size beds…. Not regular size…. But other than that… everything was perfect….. more than enough room to spread out….for a family of 4…. (Tell your kids to leave the bidet alone! And to not make a mess in the bathroom  lol.. )

Room Service –

Gave them a try the first evening as we were exhausted and I was so pleasantly surprised! Most places take at least 45 minutes.. I swear they knocked on the door in 20 minutes… pizzas..salad..fruits… wings..and key lime pies…. We really love their desserts… do delicious..  No fee for room service when you have Family Concierge…. *as I read in other reviews that some were charged $5US each time they used it….

For Family Concierge -

Our 2 butlers - Alexa and Gloria - became instant family. Our warm welcome in the private check in area was the best.. small treats.. snacks.. drinks…. anytime we wanted to pop by... have a chat... or the kids to play games. The welcome packs for the kids on the first day in our room…loved it… beach toys… robes… backpacks…shirt…cap…..Chatting daily in our WhatsApp group for updates on activities for ourselves and the kids each day...  Alexa and Gloria made my 40th birthday incredible... They left wonderful treats for the boys each day - and decorated our room for my birthday....along with really special treats for me.. we all felt like royalty...It was emotional to leave them....as we truly adored them both.. and everything wouldn’t have been possible without them…. The level of warm customer service received is so high…. We can’t wait to return and see them again! 

Kids Pool -

It is shallow -  perfect for little ones....but quickly lets you into the deeper end/main pool…. if your kids need more space and depth. (Bring the life vests! So they can enjoy the main pool… it’s about 5 ft )..... We loved our Family Concierge Bali beds each day.... Laura is a gem…brings the drinks with such sweetness each day...As well as the gentlemen who bring fruit treats throughout the day.... There is a great ceramic art craft hut on this end ...my son painted an awesome jewelry box for me... *15US -...and the artist (Esteban) -  added some beautiful finishing touches..and delivered it to us the following day...Please support and visit them! Wonderful crafts..... The kids pool also gives you easy access to the Kids Zone/Kids Club – which is in building 2….. a few steps away from you….So if you have any concern…want to be near your kids…. If you send them there….. this is where you’d want to be…. It also works well…as we’d get the kids right after their pool time with the Kids Club….

Main Pool –

Large and expansive... never felt crowded..even on Friday (Memorial Day Weekend - when many more guests arrived)... lots of room to spread out.. hidden alcoves that you can hang out in.... almost has a lazy river feel.. if you travel from the main part - back over the kids pool side...There was a wonderful Mexican night...with vendors....dancers...Ancient Mayan performance...and much more... The pool party had a great Brazilian samba band with dancers..and a huge water slide for the kids. There are early birds that come down for their chairs.... but we had our Family Concierge bali bed by the kids pool…...so we didn't need to grab much on this side.... Highly recommend booking one if you like them.... if not... just grab your chairs before breakfast....and get back to them soon! Pool bar made us such a strong margarita! Wow… bring your waterproof case so you can tip those guys… …. They serve so many people and the drinks are really awesome…

Beach –

Unfortunately, the red flag was up each day as the waves were extremely rough…. Not suitable for children… only strong adult swimmers…or lifeguards LOL…
We did see many families venturing out…. But again … only STRONG swimmers… 
Every visit is different…..the tide changes each day….so who knows how the sea will be on our next visit.. I hope much calmer…
You have a beautiful blue ocean…and soft sand to play in…. seaweed is everywhere in the Caribbean as of last year…and it has affected many areas…. So no need to complain about that….
They do rake and keep the area very clean each day….and many people still enjoyed the beach…and their cabanas/bali beds… 

Food -

It was love at first bite for us at BLUE AGAVE - we ate there EVERYDAY for lunch.... we love street tacos.... pozole soup.. shrimp soup…..and the atmosphere in there... so good... all of the servers are just awesome...so kind... warm...welcoming.... there is nothing they can't do for you… don’t forget to ask the for special hot sauces on the side!

We also ate breakfast at NAOS -  EVERYDAY.....a wonderful selection of food... omelette stations.. fresh bread.. Mexican breakfasts....veggies….fruits....smoothies...grab your fresh fruit there to snack on through the day.... We had the best waiters here - Alejandro, Kristhian, Ignacio, Atilano.....they made me cry on my birthday.... so very sweet... and Maritza as you enter each morning at the entrance....she went out of her way to make me feel special on my birthday - and I'll never forget them.... If you have picky eaters in your family…. You will find something here!!.. Don’t forget to stop by in the day for ice cream cones…. And for your dessert!
If you love dessert – their spread each night is to die for…so many perfect bites of cake….and other treats….
If you love bread ---- their fresh bread is so good!.. My son had to stop by 1x or 2x a day for a roll and butter… ha…

Nespresso/Gelato-

My sister enjoyed her morning coffee here each day with no complaints….
I’m not a coffee drinker…. But I did enjoy the almond coffee! Delicious!
We enjoyed gelato here…as well as inside of Naos…

(ADULTS ONLY ) -  LA PALAPA.. -- Because we booked Family Concierge - adults have access to the   ROYAL SERVICE (adult side of the hotel ) - so my sister and I enjoyed a lunch there one day…(Walk over to building 5 for this) - Wow - beautiful plating.... delicious...We tried a few dishes…all the desserts! Lol… I felt so bad that my son - who is a big foodie - couldn't come over there to eat with me.. HA.... but it was really a treat to be on the adult side and enjoy our time in that atmosphere...We had grasshoppers on our tacos and brought some back for them to try... which was so fun....

MARKET GRILL - Rodizio/Brazilian Steakhouse.

OMG - we ate too much... but it was DELICIOUS... I don't eat much red meat at home..but I love a good steak... Brazilian Ribeye - to DIE FOR.......BBQ Chicken... Argentinian sausage.. Turkey sausage with bacon....so many great choices... We really enjoyed this dinner....Book here if you love meat…..

FUEGO - Latin Fusion...

I chose here for my birthday dinner.... what's great about Fuego - if you as parents want to dine here - and you don't think your kids will eat anything - it's connected to Naos- so they can grab a plate from the buffet and still sit with you while you enjoy your meal.. as they are only separated by a curtain once inside…. I had a gorgeous meal here.... wonderful ceviche....mango gazpacho...duck.. chicken... seafood .... desserts.. 

SUNSET GRILL - by the Pool

Stop here for basic snacks during the day (self serve)....hot dogs/hamburgers/fries/wings... gazpacho.... easy to hold you over until dinner...or if you're skipping lunch....or staying by the pool all day…

We really wanted to try ENSO -  for the seafood….but just didn't have the time to get over there for dinner..
I believe they also serve breakfast….if you’d rather not go to Naos buffet….

This was all we could fit in.. so we’ll try the others on our next visit… 

KIDS CLUB -

My son has never attended a kids club as we mostly travel to smaller resorts...condos.... or do airbnb…. and it’s always just him and I…..so I was excited to have him try it out. They have such an AWESOME STAFF there - Saul, Violeta, Fernanda, Paula, Angel and Nicole! .. we miss you all so much!.... My kid went from "NO.. I don't want to go!.. I want to stay with you"….. to …."CAN WE GO TO THE KIDS ZONE NOW?”...ha... They worked magic..... Their energy is awesome... The Kids Zone is so spacious... great indoor jungle gym...yoga… craft activities.. pool time in the afternoon.... They really do such a great job....We met some great kids...even exchanged numbers with parents so we can meet up again.. The kids would find each other at dinner and run off to chat... find out if the other one was going the next day....it was the sweetest... 
Thank you Kids Zone staff - for giving me --- my first "ME TIME" ever… LOL..... My son is so excited to visit again and spend time with the staff…he wishes they were his teachers back at home now..

SPA  

While we didn't have time to book any services - because of our Family Concierge booking – we….( *the Mom's  )- also had unlimited access to the water spa/Turkish style area of the spa... *thermal spa... cold plunge pool...relaxation area....tea...etc.... We visited one day...and had a glorious hour or so to ourselves…. I would have visited daily if we had more time.... worth stopping by!

The service at Paradisus is impeccable... I can't think of anything that needing adjusting or changing... Please tip your servers....let them know how much you appreciate them...We were treated like family each day by everyone... and I'm so thankful to everyone that we met there....Every single staff member was so warm and kind… thoughtful… accommodating… truly made us feel like we were at home… Thank you Paradisus for making my birthday so special... and for having such great programs for the kids.. we will be back again!!

reviews.author: Scenic51094248193
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: Had a great time here. Overall enjoyed my stay at this hotel. Loved the restaurant and different types of food they had to offer. I would definitely recommend this hotel to anyone that has kids or is planning to go on a family trip.

reviews.author: Jose Gomez
reviews.title: Horrible food and no Entertainment!
reviews.text:
For a 5 star hotel the buffet food was horrible and the restaurant food was moderate. If you wanted good food you had to leave the hotel.

There's no Entertainment past 10pm in this hotel, which for a 5 star hotel is very bad and yet again i had to leave the hotel to for entertainment. You might say is ok but at Majestic Hotels they had live shows until 12am.

My major problem with Paradisus was the sales pitch to be a Member of Melia club, it being and absolute waste of money. Please id you go to this hotel DO NOT GET THE MELIA CLUBS IS A SCAM AND YOU WILL LOSE A LOT OF MONEY.

NOW FOR THE GOOD PART, the beach was beautiful and the pool was awesome. Lots of booze for you to drink on and the staff nationals are amazing people.

reviews.author: Jenny M
reviews.title: Wonderful Family Vacation
reviews.text: Our vacation was plagued with trials from delayed and cancelled flights to sickness and broken everyday items (glasses and phone)... but our stay at Paradisus Cancun was amazing! We really enjoyed the food, our kids LOVED Kid's Club and we felt safe and cared for the entire time!

reviews.author: mrsscp
reviews.title: Good trip
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisua from May13-17. We had vacationed there last spring in a couples trip but decided to take the family this time, which included our two boys ages 12 and 15 and we stayed in a family concierge suite. Food was great, entertainment was fun and Gloria our concierge was always willing to help and set up everything we needed reservations for and consistently checked in to see if we needed anything. My two complaints are the family concierge suits are right above the adult pool so we had to constantly shoo the kids back into the room as there was some uncomfortable behavior. Similar thing happened at the main pool. Some people decided that would be a great opportunity to make a public display of affection with their own partner and with others😳 My kids aren't overly sheltered but this was a little much to see up close and personal. Overall we had a great vacation!

reviews.author: Ro T
reviews.title: Mixed Feelings
reviews.text:
This resort wants to be great but it failed in two key areas for me: customer service (guest reception lounge) and food options.

The check-in process has got to be the worst I have ever experienced. While the employees are nice and have the best of intentions, I feel like they are at the mercy of the company’s paper-intensive, complicated, outdated processes and systems. It takes 15-20 minutes to check two people in. Add another 5 minutes for every additional person and you could be waiting in line for quite awhile. Employees stare at their computer screens with these confused looks, like they’re trying to make sense of the universe. The line to check in or check out is usually long and people are obviously frustrated.  And you could even have 3 people at the counter and the line is still long. Either employees need better training or new more efficient processes are needed.

The food selection is okay. For such a large resort, I would expect a little more variety. The servers in all of the restaurants and buffet area are wonderful. These people are so hard working, quick, efficient, and proactive. Most go above and beyond to give outstanding service. But service alone cannot make up for the dining experience.

The facilities and grounds are beautiful. They do put a lot of effort into maintaining the public areas.

My biggest issue with them is more personal in nature. I accidentally booked a room for “2” when it was just myself. Of course, this resulted in a higher rate (prices are usually based on double occupancy). When I emailed customer service, they told me to go ahead and book another reservation with the correct number of people for the room, which is 1, and they would refund me the first reservation. They did say that they would make this exception for me because these prices are non-refundable.  It has been 5 weeks and I still have not received a refund. I was told that it would take about 2 weeks.  I was left with no choice but to call my credit card company and ask for assistance. I’m left to wonder if they are slow in refunding me because they’re dishonest or just very very VERY slow in getting things done.

This was my second visit to Paradisus and unfortunately will be my last. I gave them a second chance and realized that this resort is just not for me.

reviews.author: Eludium-Q36
reviews.title: Decent, but expected so much better
reviews.text: I was told there that the Paradisus is 35yo and is about to close for a 1 yr (or more) renovation. I would've liked to have known that ahead of time. I'm going to make what could be a LONG review into one as short as possible. The resort hotel is huge consisting of five pyramid sections though you'll only be in the main one and the one with your room. A/C throughout is lacking and can be uncomfortable even in the restaurants. We used the royal service which permitted almost all food and drink and private pool and beach area so that was a good thing for the most part. However, the pool area was marked non-smoking but the same daily set of a-holes thought they were above it and were not stopped by pool staff. Sodas were mostly zero-calorie and served barely cool - we ALWAYS had to ask for ice. Even regular canned Coke didn't taste quite right though. In-house restaurants disappointed, the morning juices seemed watered, and the food throughout was flavorless. Restaurants in Cancun were much better but were no bargain. Our royal service jr suite was passable but not memorable. The 42-in LCD tv had 40+ channels but only 3 were English speaking, so I was thrilled that my Fire TV stick with Dish Network app worked there - though I did accidentally leave the remote there which no one contacted me about, so that's a $30 unforced error. There were popular water sports available right there on the beach but at stupid, greedy pricing (parasail $65ea, jetski $75ea for 1/2 hr). People, they'll only drop the pricing to reasonable levels if you refuse to support those ridic prices. Tips: the later you book, the better the pricing. Change about $75 to Pesos if you plan to do light shopping in the area. Also, anything of any value to you must be stored in the room's safe or your locked luggage. We had something of minor value go missing after our first maid service so that was another disappointment. It was a decent trip overall but I wouldn't return there, though it may be better after renovations and they are building a new Paradisus on the north end so maybe that'll be better, too.

reviews.author: Irah Wooten
reviews.title: Came for a graduation present, not disappointed!
reviews.text: Our stay at Paradisus was an extremely wonderful experience, and I would recommend to anyone seeking the laid back environment. There was minimal partying and antics, this is more of a family style resort.  It is one of those places where you can relax and unwind yet it is close enough to the night life that you can go out.  The beaches and grounds were very well maintained, and the hotel staff was extremely friendly.  Every time you’d pass an employee they would greet you with a smile and warm hello.  The restaurants on the property were all very tasty, I highly recommend going into Enso and talking to Jesus.  He and his wait staff (Roman and Nicolas) were nothing less than incredible.  They also have services for the kids, and staff to make their stay fun and safe.

reviews.author: Relax48804414142
reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: Out of the dozens of resorts I've utilized in Cancun, this is by far the best. Service, food, cleanliness, atmosphere is top notch.  I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a resort in Cancun and I cannot wait to go back.

reviews.author: Kasunu
reviews.title: Package of pleasant
reviews.text:
Initially we booked a lagoon view room and done an update in the first day. The upgrade was well worth the extra amount we paid. The hotel structure is simple, 5 pyramids linked to each other and third one is being largest and contain most restaurants, indoor garden, shops and reception. It is used for daily performances as well. so if you prefer quietness at night, go for either other pyramids or top floor. We received a room in 5th floor between second and third (main) pyramid and noise didn't bother us at all.
In terms of restaurant selection, we prefer the all the restaurants however Mole (authentic Mexican - à la carte) and blueagave (tacos, enchiladas..etc) was our favourite. You can book the excursions through hotel and it is slightly expensive than booking online. However we recommended to try the aqua world activities like Jungle Tour (riding a boat, snorkelling), Isla Mujeres tour.
We had an amazing 7 days in the hotel and the service is excellent. The staff we dealt with are very friendly professionals and ease your stay. We highly recommend Paradisus.

reviews.author: Stay38630871052
reviews.title: Perfect!
reviews.text: The service was outstanding, we couldn’t ask for better. Small details as wet towels when you come to the hotel and is hot outside or waiters going around the pool with fruit sticks are just amazing. Some people like Jaime (Guest services) or Karina in the Coco’s bar, made our weekend just perfect. I wish i could remember all names of the nice people in there. Please Melia, praise your workers as they make people’s vacation a memorable experience

reviews.author: Josue S
reviews.title: Good Hotel - Noisy Room
reviews.text: The hotel was very nice and clean. The only issue I had was a constant bad "electrical" buzzing sound in my room that would not allow my family to sleep. I called the office several times to get this checked and fixed, but they would just tell me it was fixed when it was not. I eventually requested to be moved to a different room and even then they sent someone to double check that there was still this sound in my room. Finally I was moved to another room in which I was actually able to sleep properly. The rest of the hotel and restaurant were good, but this issue left a bad taste in our vacations.

reviews.author: Tom Oakley
reviews.title: Tom Oakley and Caitlin Roberts
reviews.text:
Today we are leaving Mexico and going home. What a terrible idea that is 😂 Paradisus is epic. Too good. The place is amazing, so many restaurants etc. But the level of service is what it’s all about. Mexicans are genuinely really nice people and a big shout out to all the boys within Naos restaurant for breakfast lunch and dinner!!
Ignacio Vazquez, David Blanco, Cristian Lovera, these lads have been extremely welcoming, have got pure bants and have made the trip even better. They’ve gone above and beyond. 
I would recommend Paradisus to anyone from all walks of life, regardless of their age.

reviews.author: Road24671596682
reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text: I visit Cancun at least twice a year, and I read the reviews and try to apply them to me. This hotel is not worth but 1 star. Hotel rooms need updating, such as lighting flickering the whole time, TV picture not clear on all channels, bathroom fixture and shower were falling apart, bathtub was literally sinking in the middle and Wifi was very very bad and connectivity was horrible on ALL DEVICES, had to log in every 2-3 min. NEVER AGAIN

reviews.author: Chef-Julie14
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: Big shout out to all the workers that made my moms and myself stay a special one. Great Mother’s Day /bday vacation. Gracias por todo Edwin, Ignacio,Francisco,Miguel,Josianne,Gaudencio y Angel. Thank you for your hard work,  Will definitely return soon and recommend to all my family and friends.

reviews.author: Nic
reviews.title: Montezuma's Revenge
reviews.text: Had a great time here on a short trip with the wife and friends until I could literally stomach no more. Royal service and a nice aesthetic saved this place from 2 stars, owing to the intestinal nightmare that ensued from the wee hours of our first night until now, 6 days later, as I type this at work after finally being able to consume solid food again. The food is poison here and you will remain sick for as long as you consume it. You will not believe the horrors that will come out of your system. I've traveled the developing world far and wide, and Paradisus was up there with the worst of them...only the food is better in most developing countries, so at least it's kind of worth it. I suppose their cuisine here rates as passable to excellent if you spend 340 days a year eating Hamburger Helper and the rest of your days going on all inclusive vacations. Then it's understandable why you'd have no frame of reference of what edible food actually is. But hey, it's Cancun and it's all inclusive, so what can one expect?

reviews.author: Trek34751006472
reviews.title: nice
reviews.text: Everything was great, the people, the venue and the food. The shows and the folks that helped us set up our events, excursions. Also the staff at the pool was amazing. We will definitely go again in the near future. We have referred Paradisus Cancun to our friends and family.

reviews.author: Jim S
reviews.title: Great Experience @ Paradisus
reviews.text: I stayed at the resort for 3 nights for a business conference.  Hotel was very well maintained with beautiful public areas and expansive pool(s) and beach areas.  Rooms were nicely appointed and the conference facilities were very good.  What really stuck out for me was the great employees.  I have stayed at a number of all inclusive resorts in the Caribbean and Central America and have always been very disappointed in the attentiveness, professionalism & attentiveness of the staff.  I can say without a doubt that Paradisus was the best experience I've had hands-down.  Everyone I encountered was polite and very helpful, from the porters to the servers to the front desk personnel.  Had a wonderful time at the resort and plan to come back with my family for a vacation.

reviews.author: PaulAK2011
reviews.title: Great Hotel, great staff & great location
reviews.text: My Europe friend & I wanted to return to Cancun to celebrate our 1st meeting in Cancun 7 years ago & chose the Paradisus.  It has been wonderful.  The resort is the cleanest, best kept I have experienced.  The entire staff have been extremely friendly & helpful.  The location is directly across Kukulcán Blvd from the Aqua water sports center, thus a 4 to 5 minute walk for any of the many water sports activities.   Also the bus service is excellent, about every 2 minutes anywhere into Cancun for Walmart, Costco etc. or the malls along Kukulcán Blvd and only 12 pesos . The restaurant choices are very good.  The towering interior with its amazing hanging green vines is stunning and very peaceful and soothing. There was a quality variety of good entertainment all week .   I highly recommend the a Paradisus !!

reviews.author: Miles
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort with exceptional views and customer service. For the best experience, you must reserve a cabana with Francisco. He made our time there truly amazing! Always happy to see us, joked around with us, and quick with any requests that we had. 
We will be back and the first thing we will do is reserve our cabana with Francisco. 
Thank you!
- Calli & Miles

reviews.author: Shiva P
reviews.title: Exceptional experience!
reviews.text: Fantastic. Great beach, very spacious rooms, perfect ocean view with balcony. Plenty of dining options and very friendly staff. Can't go wrong with this place. we'll go back again for sure. Pools are great with plenty of lounge chairs even on the beach

reviews.author: Emily Braga
reviews.title: PLEASE DO NOT STAY
reviews.text:
I was hesitant to book this resort because some of the reviews were not good, but I thought with a 4 star average rating, it must not be that bad. I was wrong. From check in, we needed to put a deposit down on our credit card of the full amount we were being charged for our stay after we already paid. This is crazy. Luckily we had a credit card with $3,000 available on it but I’ll tell you that most people don’t know about this. What would they do if we didn’t have a credit card on us? I digress. 
We get on the elevator to go to our rooms and our smacked with a stench that is so gross I don’t even know how to describe it. Smelled like a child peed in it three weeks ago and they never cleaned it. I brushed it off as maybe it was just that particular elevator but it ended up being all of them. 
The food here is below subpar. I could eat chips & guac for breakfast lunch and dinner. I’m not picky. Everything tasted frozen or stale. Simply gross to be blunt. We tried multiple restaurants and the only one worth going to was market grill. this is because they give you fresh cooked meats so you know it hasn’t been sitting out for hours. If you order room service, be aware they charge you $5 for every time you order it. You have to call the front desk to restock the mini fridge. My mother started complaining about stomach pains 2 days into our stay and started puking. She was completely out for the count for an entire day of our vacation. Some will chalk this up to drinking, how ever that was not the case.
The pool is beautiful. Problem is they don’t start giving out drinks before 10AM. If you’re an early bird and get out to the pool at 8, you will have to wait 2 hours before being able to get a water or any other beverage poolside. 
The rooms. Our AC was leaking the entire time. Although it had been running all day, it was still not as cold as my Mother’s room. The double beds are very small. My brother & I were sharing a double bed. we both weigh about 120 lbs & it was uncomfortably tight. By the second night of being there I noticed a couple of bugs in the bathroom. I shook that off as no big deal. As night four came around there were even MORE bugs. It was seriously grossing me out because they were beetle like creatures. I’ll move on. The last night of our stay they set up vendors in the hotel hallways selling bracelets and all sorts of souvineers. This was fantastic idea until they harassed us every time we walked by which felt awkward and cheap.

reviews.author: Maka Court
reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: It was a wonderful place to stay st. Nao was buffet and was open late. Vento was my fav eating place. Mole wasn’t that good to me. Very helpful and nice staff. Loved the drinks. The pina colada was my favorite drink. Well mango tango was good as well.

reviews.author: Larry S
reviews.title: Return to an older property
reviews.text: The Resort is old, some of the rooms have been upgraded and others have not, this was a return trip for us we have stayed here many times in the past prior to the all inclusive days. The temperature in rooms and hotel area was warm which gave the impression of air handler problems. The food at buffet was tolerable but temp control was an issue for many of the selections. The service was fantastic, the people ther are wonderful and eager to help.

reviews.author: Nnavi2018
reviews.title: Amaaaaazing place to stay with family!!!
reviews.text: We visited Cancun in April 2019 and stayed at Paradisus. This is one of the best places we stayed with kids. This all-inclusive 5 start hotel has amazing facilities, kids friendly activities, beautiful beach front, and above all great restaurants that’s part of the all-inclusive deal. The Naos buffet was good, but we also tried a bunch of other restaurants- one worth mentioning is blue agave and Enzo. Food was great in both. Naos is a general buffet, deserts were great, but you won’t get quality tacos unless you go to a restaurant. Overall we enjoyed the stay, friendly customer service and I will recommend this place to anyone!!

reviews.author: kris g
reviews.title: Beautiful , quiet hotel
reviews.text: Love the hotel itself but not how front receptionist handles customers. Very rude especially the guy named Alex. Instead of apologizing, he would try to insist what he wants to improve. He needs training

reviews.author: CathyGilman
reviews.title: Lovely people mediocre hotel
reviews.text:
The hotel has a lovely beach location but the Cancun strip has very little to recommend it, just hotel after hotel.
The check in after a long flight simply takes too long and the rooms are a bit faded for the price. Communal areas are largely not air conditioned and so the humidity is a bit uncomfortable throughout.
The people are lovely but this would not be a place high on my list to return to.

reviews.author: LalaAtl
reviews.title: BUGS & Basic Service
reviews.text:
Upon check in, expect to wait in a long line.  They do provide many people to greet you and offer drinks during this time though.  Arriving at our room, we saw bugs in the bathroom and asked the bellman to take care of them, hoping it would be an isolated incident.  Upon returning to our room that evening, roaches greeted us on our dresser and we had enough.  Not wanting to room with roaches, we called down to request a new room and proceed to repack all of our luggage.  What a huge surprise when "guest services" Paulina came to our room and demanded we show her the dead bug or a photo of the live bug!!  Because they ran behind the dresser when we entered, we could not find them and did not look, we were ready to get out of there.  After over an hour of them debating on how to handle this, finally we were offered a new room.  It was very frustrating to have gone through all this at 11pm after a long day of travel and just wanting to go to bed.  

We did encounter some great customer service throughout our stay from certain staff.  The "Guests Service" staff was the least helpful and least friendly of them all, ironically.  The servers on the beach are EXTREMELY attentive and never let your drink run dry.  The servers at most restaurants treated us well and were very friendly.

The food was nothing to brag about in our opinion.  The cantonese restaurant Enso was our favourite and the taco restaurant Blue Agave was awful.  How hard is it to make decent tacos!?

Housekeeping did not leave washcloths and when we called to request some they never brought us any so we were forced to attempt to wash the sand off our bodies with no washcloths which was super annoying.

The ocean view from the balcony was amazing and very private.  The room stayed nice and cool, but it was basically the ONLY place in the entire hotel with air conditioning!  It was cooler out on the beach than in the hotel the entire time!

The pool was nice and very big.  The beach was nice and mostly quiet, but the water was full of seaweed and you could´t swim without getting tangled up in it.  Not many people in the water, presumably because of this.

Regarding our SECOND room, I liked the shower, the hairdryer, and the beds were comfortable.  Only 1 channel on the TV was in English.  The first room they put us in was pretty bad and had old furniture, only one power outlet, and BUGS of course. The light switches in both rooms were confusing.  They are everywhere, most of them don´t do anything, and each switch is not even near what it controls.  They are not logical at all and need to be labeled.

My very expensive sunglasses disappeared on our last day and we only made 3 stops in the hotel.  We checked with the workers at all 3 places we had been and no one admitted to seeing them.  Not sure if it was housekeeping or someone else but they are gone, not returned to lost and found and SOMEONE has them.  I am very upset about this.

Basically, we enjoyed a decent stay here, but had some less than stellar experiences with BUGS and the customer service.  It was not worth a return visit in our opinion.

reviews.author: Macnhoz
reviews.title: Only love
reviews.text: We went here on a huge group trip. Wow . The service is over the top. Extra nice on everyone’s part. The beach was clean and cozy. Pool and bar rocks. The hotel was alittle hot even for a southern boy . The food was ok but the display was great. I caught fish from the shore of the hotel. Great place and I would go back.

reviews.author: Passion for Traveling
reviews.title: Vacation in Paradisus
reviews.text:
Stayed as a family at Paradisus from 6-13 May.

The Hotel
All the inside looks like a big botanical garden. The strong smell (candles) used to refresh the place sometimes felt overused and too strong. 
The hotel looked always clean.

Our Room
We got a free upgrade to family concierge suite, since king size bed suite we asked for in our reservation wasn't available. The suite is very big and just right for a family with kids. The 2 twin beds felt very small. 
The greatest thing about this suite is the ocean view you get from your bathroom, something truly amazing!
The suite was very clean and the cleaning lady kept it clean during all our stay.

The service
Amazing service everywhere you go, especially in the restaurants. Big thank you to all the servers! You made our stay very pleasant.

Kids club
Great kids club, nice activities, kids didn't feel boring.

Food
Buffets - the food was good in the morning and lunch time. Evening food was almost same as lunch. No wow, just ok. If compared to other resorts in Cancun, the food selection was small for dinner. At dinner time you expect something extra and not a repetition. Seafood night at the buffet wasn't impressing and was actually missing some seafood.
Specialty restaurants with/without reservation - they were all good, we tried them all. Good food and service.

Entertainment
Day entertainment - no day entertainment at all. Nothing happening near the pools, not even a sound of music. No games or competitions near the pool. This is something we see first time in Cancun resort. To somehow entertain ourselves during the day, we went to the Aquaworld and took excursions.
Night entertainment - some days very disappointing. There is no special area/stage for it so everything is happening around the pool. Sometimes not even enough chairs near the pool to watch it so you have to stand. 
*Advise - create a permanent place for the shows with stage, good lightening and place for everyone to sit instead of moving the chairs everyday.
The quality of the shows, if compared to other resorts is low. After the show, singers were performing inside the hotel every night but we didn't like it either because the song selection was boring and actually made us go to sleep couple of times although we didn't really want to. 
Red lounge (18+) - nice place but not too big. Music selection was ok.

Pools
Kids pool was good but it was missing some sort of entertainment or rides for kids.
Adult pools felt too deep. Comparing to our other stays in Cancun, these pools are too deep and felt sometimes uncomfortable.
Service at the pool was good, the servers always came to ask if we want anything and even offered melon, water melon and pineapple on a stick for everyone. The food served near the pool was ok.
Bali beds - looked very comfy but the price is so unreasonable. 180$ per day doesn't make any sense.
You can book activities for the Aquaworld right near the pool where you return your towels.

Beach
If the beach is very important then it is probably not the best place to stay. The waves are CRAZY HIGH and red flags are always present. We didn't get in the water the whole stay, too dangerous even for good swimmers. We like to swim in the sea so it was a big down side in our stay.
The seaweed cleanup was done every morning. Compared to other places, the amount of seaweed wasn't too high.
Bali beds on the beach also unreasonably expensive.

Aquaworld (right across the street)
The biggest advantage of the resort is that you only need to cross the street to get to the Aquaworld. Great place and lots of things to do.

Overall, we received a good service and vacation was good. Thank you, Paradisus.

reviews.author: Traveler34115270678
reviews.title: Our Family Vacation
reviews.text: I took my kids on a very memorable trip last month to Paridisius, we had a great time! The staff at the hotel was wonderful and our trip was fabulous! I would definitely go back :) All the restaurants had a very good variety of food also.

reviews.author: Discover546391
reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: This is our second time staying in Melia Resort and I would definitely stay there again. I highly recomend getting the Melia app to schedule dinner reservations etc. so convinient. We were a group of 10 and we asked to have rooms close by if possible, the staff was very accomodating. We were all a few doors from each other. Loved it. We rented a caba on the beach one of the days and it was the funnest day with great service. Can't wait for my next vacation.

reviews.author: H H
reviews.title: Top of the line resort
reviews.text:
Just returned from 5 days at this resort.  Never once did we wonder off the property because everything we would want was here.  Plenty of pools with a choice of louder or more serene, extremely attentive service, quality room and view plus great food and drinks.  A number of different restaurants onsite but we particularly enjoyed Market Grill for breakfast and dinner.  We want to recognize the outstanding service given to us at Market Grill by Andres and Pasqual. Looked forward to seeing them both every morning and lunch time. 
 Thank you Paradisus!

reviews.author: andressantacruz2017
reviews.title: Best Vacation at Paradisus
reviews.text: Highly recommended. The royal service upgrade is well worth it. Perfect for adults. The only thing is you have to be on top of the reservations to get the Beds in the pool. The drinks we Premium and the food amazing.

reviews.author: David Z
reviews.title: Very good overall.
reviews.text: Very attentive Staff for the most part. Quality food with plenty of options. Market Grill meats were awesome. Rooms were restocked every day. In room wifi wasnt very good and TV had limited English options. Overall very pleased and would definitely return.

reviews.author: Randy S
reviews.title: Membership Experience at Paradisus Cancun and Playa del Carmen
reviews.text:
First: The staff of Pyramid 1 (membership): Jose May May, Ruth & Betsy and at La Palapa: Daniel and Valerie provided outstanding service, and the Spa: Anna and David--many thanks/gracias con gusto. You are professional, polite, and your made our visit warmer and met all our expectations for service muy excellente!
Membership rooms, in our opinion, continue to not reflect maintenance and renovation in comparison to Royal Service. The window box outside our room was full of weeds and plastic bags (basura). The comforter had lumps in it that you could see when held to the light and could feel. One hinge on the shower door was missing--the middle hinge. We brought this to the attention of the staff, who told us this would be reported to the appropriate maintenance people.
Fish was not fresh. It might have been flash frozen, but having traveled around the world, we know when fish is fresh--it tastes fresh, is prepared properly, and does not smell. Simple things like chips and guacamole, the chips were soggy and you could not snap them or crunch them--horrible, really. The staff tries immediately to compensate and is prepared to offer another dish, but once something is wrong, it just ruins your appetite. Again, the staff far outshines the quality of the food and the maintenance of members' room, as this is a recurring experience that potential members should be prepared to address when invited to a sales meeting.
On a positive note, we relocated from Playa del Carmen to Paradisus Cancun (the seawood ruined the beach at Playa, unfortunately), but the hotel staff found us accomodations at Paradisus. They made the switch easily for us--thank you Jose and Jorge our butlers there for the one day we were at Playa. They were as nice as nice could be.

reviews.author: adlyle5280
reviews.title: Great service!
reviews.text: Loved our stay! Right across the street from aqua world so it made it super easy to go on our excursions. Cristhian was our waiter at the Naos restaurant and he was so amazing. He made our visit that much better! We can’t wait to go back.

reviews.author: Brenda T
reviews.title: Excellent View but Could be Better
reviews.text: The Luxury Junior Suite Ocean View in the 5th floor was amazing! The Royal Service tower is on the opposite side of the restaurants/lobby, but access to the private lounge and proximity to pool is great. Only received 1 out of 3 incentives advertised if you booked through them directly which was the airport transportation- had a great experience with the agency-Otium. All but one of the  staff members were very pleasant, the only bad customer service was the hostess from Mole who was very dry and rude. We did see her treating others more pleasantly however. The snacks at the Royal Service lounge were perfect for a late night, this was also the only place that offered free alcohol. Despite asking when booking reservation if drinks were included in the all inclusive package and being told yes, we were charged. The butler was nice and even surprised husband with birthday cake and a bottle of champagne; however, we wish she would have checked more on us or taken all reservations from check in date as we had to reserve our own dinners and the Bali bed requests were not honored. We were left without a reservation on one day because they told us booking through the app, the app you are told at check in to download, can glitch and if the restaurant is full you'll be left going to the no reservation restaurants. The best restaurant was Vento. The waiter and hostess were impeccable. The poolside waiter, Julio, was amazing and we believe he would be a great butler or hospitality leader as he is very attentive. We wish we hadn't been approached to do a time share presentation from within the resort on multiple occasions. Overall we loved the experience, but wish the hotel would make some adjustments to provide more to its guests such as having a guaranteed Bali bed reservation method for royal service guests as we only received a bed 2 out of 5 days and there were not enough chairs to leave your bags and towels at, have more proactive butlers, disclose at booking that drinks are not included, and limit the timeshare presentation invites to one. With all that being said the location, updated room ( make sure you get one as not all are updated), and amazing view will guarantee our return for later this year. We hope this stay will be improved.

reviews.author: saramarsdenille
reviews.title: Royal Service is excellent
reviews.text:
We had a junior suite with Royal Service for a 4-day visit to Paradisus.  I have to say I am so glad we opted for the Royal Service option.  Super service from start to finish. We really appreciated the adult only section.  The indoor atrium area where breakfast, snacks & drinks are available all day in a beautiful AC setting was great.  

Rode, our bespoke Butler, was super attentive & helped us with reservations.
The pool area, & especially the Bali cabana beds, was awesome!

Our junior suite was spacious, comfortable & very clean.  We did have a fridge as well, which was restocked daily with water, soft drinks, beer & crisps.

We did find the restaurants on-site that we tried (bearing in mind we were only here 3 nights) disappointing.  But maybe this was just bad choices.  We ate at the Market Fogo de Brazil style steak restaurant & Nao’s.  The lunch snacks we had around the pool excelled our evening dining experiences.

Overall, I was very satisfied with our stay, and would stay here again if in Cancun.

reviews.author: TiCoro
reviews.title: AMAZING Kids Club!
reviews.text:
We're a family of 5 (husband, pregnant wife, 3 boys ages 7, 5, and 2) traveling from Texas. 

Airport transfer:  Amazing!  It was included in our hotel reservation as a special.  The company they use, Otium, greeted us with a smile and a very clear sign in the front of a sea of other transfer companies, promptly showed us to our really new and nice private suburban, and safely shuttled us to the hotel, which is about 20 minutes from the airport.  I was really nervous about this part and they quickly helped us feel at ease.  The transfer back to the airport was equally as organized and easy. 

Check in:  Loved the cold towels that greeted us.  The driver unloaded our luggage onto the curb and the guy who greeted us showed us inside to the family concierge check in room.  Our bags were brought to our room about an hour later.  Once inside, the check in was easy although had we not specifically asked questions (ie about kids club, restaurants, Bali beds, activities, etc), I'm not sure we would have gotten the info.  We were showed to our room promptly and then waited 30 more minutes for our bags. Next time, we'll pack swim suites in 1 bag and keep it with us since we have impatient kids who were ready to hit the pool.  

Room #3401:  So quiet!  It seemed small for our large family and didn't have a bath tub for the kids so we asked about any available upgrades.  The next morning, they showed us a larger room (room #2019).  It had a tub and much much more room so we opted to move.  It did seem louder during the party times at the pool but it didn't bother us. Definitely not a deal breaker for us. We also liked the location of this room a lot more because it was super close to the kids zone and we discovered a back way to the kids pool.  

Random weird things:  One of the elevators wouldn't open on the first floor.  It would stop on floor 1, not open, then go to floor 2.  We mentioned this to a couple of people and it did get fixed relatively quickly.  The incense other reviewers complained about didn't bother us. We actually liked it.  It's only in one small section (floor 0 in building 3 by one set of elevators), which can be avoided if you're sensitive.

Melia Club pitch:  We were offered 2 free days of the Bali beds.  It was worth listening to the presentation for the Bali beds. The actual offer seems like a really bad idea..$12,000 down payment then finance the rest (I think the total was $44,000) for 2 annual vacations at the average rate of $95 per person over 12 years old/night.  Next level down is $1,300 down payment then 0% finance for 30 months for the rest + $600/yr fee for access to one vacation a year (4-5 nights) at the rate of $95/person/night over 12.  7-12 year olds are half that/night.  The guy who showed us the ropes was great!  His manager was awful.  Total sleezebag.  I called him out on discrepancies (I calculated that we really wouldn't be saving much but would be locked into a contract in a foreign country..which we didn't feel comfortable with...) and he got rude real fast.  We happily declined and enjoyed the rest of our stay.  Again..Totally worth it for the Bali beds.

Food:  We eat mostly vegetarian and were unimpressed with the food at most of the restaurants. Edible and boring menu with limited options.  We really liked the buffet though!  Our favorite was to sit on the patio and snag food from both the Naos buffet and the sides available at Market Grill.  Naos buffet has a different theme each night.  We had no idea about this until our last night (after being disappointed again and again with the restaurants needing reservations).  We were under the impression from other reviewers that it was the same all the time, which for breakfast it is but not for dinner.  We loved the breakfast though (Fresh juices, fruits, waffles, pancakes, oatmeal, fried plantains, potatoes, beans, omelets, and so much more).  Very fresh and hit the spot!    We ate at the poolside restaurant (didn't catch the name) a couple times for lunch (pizza, burgers, hot dogs, sandwiches, salads) and liked it as it was easy and close.  We grabbed the food and ate at our Bali bed by the pool.

Room service:  We liked the Quatro Leches and cheesecake, but still overall underwhelmed.  The best desert we got was chocolate covered strawberries from our family concierge the last day we were here.  And the ice cream at Naos.

Kids Zone and Baby Club:  AMAZING!!!  Our favorite part of the resort!  You can leave your kids and know they will be safe AND entertained.  Open 9AM to 9PM.  My kids are 7, 5 and 2.  Ages 1-4 go to baby club (you can actually drop them off if you want for no charge or play in there with them) and ages 5+ go to kids zone.  Plenty of staff, plenty of activity (ie pizza making, going to the shallow kids pool, bracelet making, feed the fish, big beach volleyball, beach games, cookie workshop, etc).  There's also a big playground inside, not just screens and video games.. Both clubs are adjacent to one another and they let my youngest hang with his siblings in the bigger kids club with his own personal baby club chaperone if there weren't too many babies and enough staff.  Ages 5+ can even eat lunch with the kids club daily if you want some kid free meals.  They do dinner club twice weekly where they feed the kiddos if you want to enjoy dinner alone.  I can't tell you how wonderful it was to have access to the kids zones for ALL our kids.  They begged to stay at the kids zone pretty much all day so we were able to enjoy lots of adult time guilt free.  The 7 year old spent 10 hours there our last full day and we had to drag him out because he was having so much fun.  We checked on them several times throughout the day and they always wanted to stay when given the choice to hang out with us or kids club.  Big shout out to Saul and Nicole for being amazing with our little ones!  Violeta and Paula were great too!  For potty training parents, there's even a baby potty in the baby club's bathroom.  :)

Kids pool:  Shallow and perfect for the little ones.  Away from the adult pool and swim up bar.  The pool side servers did a great job at keeping you hydrated though so you don't have to worry about walking to the bar.  The pink panther was our kids favorite drink (kind of like a pink pina colada) and my husband enjoyed a variety of beers and other mixed drinks).  I'd recommend water shoes if you have sensitive feet though.  My feet are a little raw from the bottom of the pool.  Not bad but I wish I would've worn my water shoes.  The kids didn't seem bothered at all.  

We made sushi (20 minute adult activity- free), which was fun thanks to Angel, an activities director, but didn't taste great.  The rice didn't have the right type/amount of vinegar.  We eat sushi all the time so we were disappointed.  It was still fun though and we look forward to making it at home now!  Definitely not something to avoid going to this hotel over.  We did avoid the sushi restaurant because of this though.  Also, our kids would've loved this activity but kids weren't allowed.

Spa-  We booked a deep tissue massage for my husband and a prenatal massage and facial for myself.  It was ok.  We've had better but have also had way worse.  They were running a special though, which made the price more comparable to the level of service we received.  We'd probably do it again.  Fyi-  you can't pay with cash at the spa.  If you want to pay with cash, you have to charge it to the room then pay with cash at checkout.  

Cleanliness of hotel and maid service- Great!  Some of the lounge furniture in one of the bars seemed a little worn but everything was nice and clean!

Family Concierge-  SO worth it!  The extra things they did for the kids was cool (cookies/milk at night, toys daily, kid robes/slippers, balloons in tub one night) but what really made it nice was the fact we could message them through Whatsapp with any problem (ie our fridge started leaking) or request (ie reservations for pictures, spa, restaurants, excursions, etc) and it was promptly taken care of at our preferential time.  If you try to schedule directly with someone, you likely won't get what you want but if you go through your concierge, you get exactly what you want and more. Highly recommend Jose!  Be sure to bring extra cash for tipping a job well done!

Gym-  Great!  They have spin classes, boot camp, HIT classes, etc.  I wish the classes started after 9 though because we couldn't drop the kids off until 9 and the gym is easily a 10 minute walk from the kids club.  A 9:15am start would be perfect. The weight room is also decently equipped.  

Photography-  Great experience and high quality pictures!  You don't pay the photographer, just pay either $25/picture (digital copy) or much more for printed photo books.  You can pay with cash.  We made the mistake of not going through our concierge though and got a less desirable time.  Will go through concierge next time!

Recommendations for hotel management to improve the family experience:  Offer wet wipes after dinner for sticky little hands and faces;  Increase food quality and options at the restaurants and offer menus of restaurants at check in;  Offer tour of the property at check in and menus of restaurants; Enhance air conditioning as we wish our room could get a *little* cooler; offer baby potty for little ones who are toilet training.  

We do plan on returning to a Paradisus property solely for the kids club.  The food here could definitely improve but the freedom we had from having the best kids club we've ever encountered will keep us coming back!  I never imagined my husband and I could ever have so much alone time to explore the property, chill on our Bali bed, or enjoy meals as a couple. Was wonderful! The hotel was clean, always smelled nice, and had a very friendly staff.  I'd give 4.5/5 stars.  Totally worth it for the price!

reviews.author: NorthStar12870930259
reviews.title: Walts
reviews.text: We had a great time with the family and would highly recommend this hotel for vacationing families. Rodolfo and Gloria provided excellent butler service and made our vacation a memorable one. The food was excellent and the upkeep of the property was great.

reviews.author: Storyteller640568
reviews.title: A Must Stay
reviews.text: Everything was great on our stay. The staff were friendly and hospitable. The rooms and food were great. I would definitely return to this hotel . The views and the indoor gardens were a sight to look at.

reviews.author: OnAir740821
reviews.title: Royal Service is the way to go!
reviews.text: We loved our stay! Our butler, Norma, was wonderful! Moises, Eddie, Cesar and Julio were terrific as well! The restaurants were great, especially Fuego. This is our third royal service experience with Melia, and it is by far the best!

reviews.author: Emily C
reviews.title: The BEST trip!
reviews.text:
I cannot begin to emphasize how amazing our stay was at the Paradisus!! 
  We came for our honeymoon and also my birthday . The resort was breathtaking and the staff for Royal Service exceeded all of our Expectations! Galdino, our butler, was absolutely wonderful! He arranged everything we needed the entire stay and took amazing care of us, Including setting up a surprise birthday decor throughout the room!
   The service was pretty impeccable entirely.Coco Beach Bar, amazing, thank you so much Kerina and Joshua, the entire staff , you guys were great ! And we absolutely LOVED La Palapa, was worth the Royal Service in itself, amazing food/atmosphere!Fuego and Enzo were also incredible restaurants including food and service. And the staff that served from pool/beach front entire day!
    Would definitely HIGHLY recommend Royal Service as well as Ocean view room , We cannot wait for another trip!Thank you for the best time !

reviews.author: Adventurer652895
reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.text: Second time here and will be back for a third. The whole food, hotel,beach is perfect. Staff is very attentive and helpful to guest. The Adults Only Royal Service is the way to go if it's an option...

reviews.author: skye_lee
reviews.title: KIDS CLUB IS WONDERFUL
reviews.text: I have mixed feelings about this hotel, however, the one thing I found that was really excellent was the Kids Club. Violeta and many of the other staff there truly cared about the kids, loved their jobs and had a passion for what they do. This in turn led to the kids having the most amazing experience at kids club and at the Paradisus in general. If you have kids, I strongly recommend you check out their activities there. We didn't until several days into the trip.

reviews.author: Brian D
reviews.title: very nice place and room
reviews.text: room was a junior suite over looking the lagoon, had two separate balconies with diff views. room service was fast and food was good, hotel added a 5 dollar room service fee. not sure why. all staff were extremely pleasant and helpful. pool area very clean and good service. mini bar stocked daily and also had a turn down service at night. had a problem with water in room after a rain storm, cloth's on floor go very wet but nobody offered to dry them when we complained about this.  also had problems with lights not working and safe battery died out. all complaints were quickly resolved . food at hotel was average at best.

reviews.author: Trek652910
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text:
Everything at the hotel was excellent, starting from the staff of front desk UP to waiters at restaurant

I feel like I was at home
Very confortable... A good option if you want to have fun and be attended 100%

reviews.author: PurpleLaurie876
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
reviews.text: I thought the hotel was very beautiful. The food at the hotel was average, your typical hotel food nothing to write home about and the drinks were very watered down (even juices) Other than the food and drinks however I have no complaints about this hotel. I thankfully experienced nothing bad

reviews.author: BPark77
reviews.title: Family Vacation in Paradise
reviews.text: We have been to Paradisus four times now and this time decided to treat my wife’s parents.  We upgraded to Royal Access and truly enjoyed the wonderful service from Cesar, Josue, Moises and Oscar.  The restaurants are top notch and the drinks are top shelf.  Do yourself a favor and try this resort.

reviews.author: kevinpB5858IS
reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: This was our 4th year in a row staying in the Royal Service and it was great.  The staff is amazing and very accommodating.  They really go out of  their way to help in any way possible. I had some requests before coming this time and Lazaro in Royal Service was very helpful to accommodate.

reviews.author: Coastal33948551330
reviews.title: Wonder Experience
reviews.text: Every aspect of customer services was address with a heart felt sincere desire to help. Traveling to cancun is always good and I will never stay at another hotel because everything is to perfection.  I cant say enough about the hotel and the wonderful experience that I had with my stay.

reviews.author: MrFlatwhite
reviews.title: Not the right hotel for a relaxing stay with kids
reviews.text:
We selected the family concierge package for our trip and was our first and last experience at a Melia - Paradisus hotel. The family concierge lounge is really nice with a good set of amenities. The welcoming  team was very pleasant and helpful. We had very high expectations since the hotel markets as a good place to be with your family. 

We visited with my 18 month old and some family friends with kids. Our experience turned sour the first night (Tuesday) when we realized they had 2 different events at the hotel and we could not go to bed because the music was so loud (8-9pm). I do not recommend this hotel to families with children that are looking for a relaxing vacation.

reviews.author: Tavares J
reviews.title: Needs improvement.
reviews.text: The staff is great. That is the best part of the hotel. The first floor seems to have a plumbing problem as it smelled of bathroom. They had tonput incence to hide it but it didn't work. The buffet was good. The a la carte restaurants were very good. The beach was great except for the seaweed.

reviews.author: Denissecolon1219
reviews.title: My first vacation
reviews.text: This was the first trip I ever experienced and my experience at this hotel was amazing the staff would never let me go without and I was always full from the food that they offered.. the staff and the Excursion or worse every dollar and I would definitely go back

reviews.author: izi na
reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text:
Nice hotel, but old. You feel it with the slow stream at the shower, and in other infrastructure. 
The staff is nice and friendly. Be sure to set with the bill boys the price for the taxi, because you might be surprised. The sheets and pillows weren't clean.

reviews.author: seeker54
reviews.title: excellent stay
reviews.text:
The hotel it’s so beautiful!!! And so comfortable ! You don’t need to go out to the city to find anything else you have everything at the hotel !!
The BEACH IS REALLY PRETTY ! You have one of the best catering and a great  array of liquors !!! 
The Bali beds include within the price CHAMPAIGN Of a very good label Plus  LOBSTER CEVICHE AND SHRIMP PLATTER!!! 

The swimming pools are so big and nice !!! You may choose to eat from snacks to  a Gourmet meal

What I like most are the kindness of every person that works at the hotel !!! Really kind helpful and cheerful and the HOTEL AREA nearby very good shopping centers 

The boutiques within the premises are really good and you may find all kind of gifts , accesories, Mexican artists jewelry , beach clothing, ATM , SPA 

Love to go back !!! With my family

reviews.author: bryney
reviews.title: Beautiful resort!
reviews.text:
My friend and I were very impressed by the cleanliness and friendliness of staff. Pool was pristine. Food was pretty good. Morning buffet was ok.
