There was many serving trays of food that were empty and not refilled very promptly. Overall it was good. The Fuego restaurant was excellent. Service and the filet were exceptional. There was burning insence by the elevators that choked you with smoke  fumes. 
The only thing I wished wouldn’t have happened was the Club Meliá (time share) pressure to join. They are very friendly but it becomes overwhelming with cost and multiple resort options. Way too much information that was a painful 90 min experience. Carolina was very intimidating and she kept throwing out financial numbers. What we got for that was a nice Bali bed on the beach with a lobster appetizer, champagne and live music. So I call it even.

reviews.author: Happiness65700092938
reviews.title: Paradisus review
reviews.text: Being all inclusive was a great experience. However, we needed alcohol bottles in the room too. I was there for my birthday, and I made a special request at reception for a bottle, they said that could make it happen, but it never did.

reviews.author: Shannon
reviews.title: Nice property
reviews.text: I was unimpressed with the food and the cleanliness of this resort. Great location... drinks were ok and the service was decent however I doubt I would stay here again. The food was subpar and seemed to be the same thing over and over everyday as there wasn’t much variety on the menu at the buffet and other restaurants on the property.

reviews.author: Lis S
reviews.title: The really GOOD and the not too good.
reviews.text:
This is a super late and long review but here it goes: As a gift for my 40th birthday, my husband took me to Paradisus Cancun in April 2018, My birthday was not until May 17 but we couldn't travel then. When we got to the airport a very professional driver was already waiting for us (we payed this fee to the company Paradisus uses for transportation) and we were told by him, to stay away from the time- share people. Advise we didn't follow. At check in, the receptionist told us they had a special on the Royal Service and we upgraded ,not so much for the butler service, but for the fact that is an Adults only section, check in was fast but the wait started when we were taken to the Royal Service area were they received us with sparkling wine and we talked to what seemed to be another receptionist who then, sent us to a "specialist" which was actually the time-share person; she explained that if we went to this 90 minute talk, we would get 4 days and 3 nights free on any Melia property   (within a year) plus other discounts at the hotel, we accepted :(
In total we waited about 2 and a half hours to be taken to our room. A gorgeous renovated room with ocean view.

The butler: After reading reviews from trip advisor, we were very enthusiastic to meet our butler (Jesiel) according to other people your butler makes reservations at restaurants for you, he reserves the cabanas at the beach for you, bubble baths and many more perks. Well,none of that happened, except for the reservation (one time) to one restaurant on our last day. Every time we asked him to please reserve a cabana for us, we will come up with all kinds of excuses. We explained to him that we were celebrating my 40th birthday and never once he did anything special about that. A shout out to Jose in the pool area who was the one who got the cabanas for us for the 4 days we stayed at the hotel.

Restaurants: We LOVED La Palapa. I think the name of the manager was Edgar, super nice and attentive. We ate there almost every day, the food was awesome and the service the same. I didn't like the buffet but my husband did, one night we had to wait for 20 minutes to get a salad. We chose one Asian restaurant located at the atrium (can't remember name) to have my "birthday diner celebration" my husband told the hostess this many times and she didn't even bother to say happy birthday to me.

The time share talk: It was not 90 minutes but 120!! We told then from the get go that we were NOT going to buy! The girl talked to us anyway and then after one hour of explaining and showing the property we told her that  we are ready to start our day and that we wanted to leave, then is when she called her manager who is the person who tries to convince you (almost in a rude way) to buy. When I said to her that we already knew we were not buying she starts tearing  saying that she could lose her job if we didn't sat thru with him. This guy knew about my country of origin and talked about the government and other things and got almost mad at us when we reinforced again, we were NOT going to buy!! Anyway, it was really uncomfortable and annoying, they gave us their 4 days and 3 nights coupon but looking at it when we came back home, we realized it was going to be more expensive than actually paying to stay since they charge $100 plus taxes for the All Inclusive feature. 

In general, is a gorgeous hotel, every one is very nice, food was okay. I usually never write reviews but now I want to go to the Paradisus Punta Cana but I am afraid my experience will be the same if we upgrade to Royal Service again. 

PS: I had to put I traveled in June 2018 because it doesn't give me the option to put April 2018 anymore.

reviews.author: Olga Z
reviews.title: Terrible check-in
reviews.text:
We arrived 02/05/2019 at 01:00 am to the hotel. Thanks god, I printed confirmation. It took more then hour to check in. First room was different that I 100% prepayed on Booking.com. I spent a lot of money for international phone call to improve our payment and room and service categories;(( also a lot of nerves;(( and lost good mood in the beginning of my vacation;(
But ocean view is amazing!

reviews.author: Haircut
reviews.title: Can't Wait to Go Back
reviews.text:
Had a wonderful time here.  Here are the Cons and Pros:
Note: I want to point out cons first as their pros will cover all of the negatives.
Cons:
- Do not book their lowest rate rooms.  They are dated, far from everything and kinda sad because the atmosphere were so quiet.  Try to ask for an upgrade and/or pay for the ungraded ocean view room that is newly renovated.  It makes the whole experience 100% better.  We did not like the basic room so we upgraded to an ocean view room in Building 3 where it is the most convenience location to restaurants, pools and beaches.  The view from the room was also spectacular.  It was also great to get coffee in the morning as the coffee stand is just on the ground floor in Building 3.
- The swimming pool was too deep.  I am not a good swimmer but at least I was not afraid to be in deep water.  Verses people who do not know how to swim and / or not taller than 5.5 ft, they will have huge difficulties enjoying the pool as they are 5.9 to 6 ft deep.  The kids’ pool is 1.5 meters deep but I don’t think adults would want to stay there for relaxing times.  Also, because of their deep pools, they do not do poolside party / bubble pool party like other resorts do which was something I miss.  Of course, they did not have Aqua-aerobics too because not many people can stand in the water and breathe.
- Very little choices of foods at the Buffet.  It is probably the smallest buffet I have encountered from All-Inclusive resorts.  Maybe they prefer guests to eat at their a-la-carte restaurants.
- Lack of chairs at the Pool.  If you don’t get up early in the morning to get your chair, it is likely that you won’t be getting any in the afternoon.  All “good chairs” with shade are taken by 7:30 am.  Other chairs could be available before noon.  At least this is how it was while I was there for a week.
- No entertainment manager / team.  I didn’t see activities personnel persuading people to join activities.  Maybe it was too hot while we were there.  My boyfriend did not get a chance to play beach volleyball the whole time as the court was always empty.
- The stage for their shows are too small and too far.  It is usually at the poolside outside the Grill restaurant.  Performers are really far away from their audience.
Pros:
- Friendly and absolutely amazing service from every staff at the Hotel.  To name a few, they are Mario, the manager of Naos; Jennifer and Mariza, hostesses from Naos, Pablo, Mesero Andres, Christian Rivero, Edwin Peree from Bana, the two Angel(s) from all those activities... I am sorry but I cannot remember all the names.  In general, these people have made our trip memorable.  You are assets to Paradisus.  Thank you All.
- Delicious foods from all restaurants.  Other than the lack of choices at the Buffet, all other restaurants have high standards dishes.  I love Fuego the most.  It was better than lots of dining experiences I had with Mexico All-inclusive.  Impressive overall.
- Spectacular views from Oceanview rooms.  Highly recommended.
- Gym and Exercise Classes were great.  I enjoyed the spinning class and their strong air-conditioning gym.  I forgot the name of the handsome instructor (pls see picture attached) but he always try his utmost to make sure guests are exercising well.  
- Nice and clean grounds / Beautiful Hotel - during the week we were there, I always see staffs cleaning / wiping every where in the hotel.  Spotless clean on most places.
Conclusion: Despite a few cons from the above, I will definitely recommend anyone to go to this hotel for a great time.  Please keep up the good work.

reviews.author: MikeKaren B
reviews.title: Amazing resort
reviews.text: This was our first stay at Paradisus and it certainly won't be our last. There were 8 of us (5 adults and 3 children). The buffet was the best we've ever experienced at an all-inclusive resort and the dinner restaurants were all great. We never had problems getting a table for 8 or in making reservations. But the absolute best part of the 6 days we spent there, was the poolside service we received from Sofonia. Our drink glasses were never empty, he remembered everyone's drink (including the children's smoothies) and made us feel like we were the most important people he was waiting on every day. We hope to see you again soon Sofonia!

reviews.author: May Trip Cancun
reviews.title: Great family trip
reviews.text:
I left just a few days ago and already miss it. This Hotel is great, specially for families. I have a 2 year old and a 5 year old. The facilities are great, I did pay for an upgrade for ocean view and it was worth it.
The food is great overall, I would have to say the Market Grill and Vento were the best. Always fresh and with new options. The little burger place at the pool is very convenient as well.
The pool and beach are fantastic, you do have to go down to the pool early if you want o have chairs, but I was up at 7AM because of the kids so... not a problem.
I would say the 2 things things I would change is the arrival experience, the check in took 1 hour of waiting, plus 30 minutes of the actual check in, some employees stand and do not offer much assistance with anything, just stand around and don't really make eye contact. They should take that opportunity to chat about the resort and everything it has to offer, that would make the experience much better.
The second thing is the main tower is crazy loud with the music late in the evening, we did the upgrade and it was honestly annoying that it was not mentioned how loud the music was going to be, when I called regarding this issue, they told me the music goes until 11PM. Was offered a different room, but was basically a downgrade of what I have, so I stayed and blocked the gaps of the door with the used towels...it helped.

I would like to mention a few employees that were beyond amazing during my stay. Armando helping my family with Bfast, always remembered us and was always with a smile. Orlando in the coffee place, same, very happy and with good memory because you can tell he remembered us but other people as well.
The two hosteses that helped with my wet phone and took a few extra steps to assist with that issue (I forgot their names but were at Naos).
The cleaning team was great, good job on keeping a property like this and the rooms clean.

Overall, just a great place to stay, I think their best asset are their employees that make their hotel something better than just nice facilities.

reviews.author: Family trippers
reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: What I bought and paid for was not what I was given when wr arrived and no remedy was offered to fix the issues. Additionally horrible smell of sewage being fanned our from under center bar and restaurant, smell of sewage was terrible next to children’s pool

reviews.author: HARDESH S
reviews.title: Excellent beautiful holiday
reviews.text: We arrived on 24th April evening and leaving cancun to London today on 1 may the 1735 pm flight to London.  Everything was good but I would love to point out my thanks to the lost important people in the hotel that actually made my holiday special . All their efforts and services was the reason why I have the smile on my face . Thanks to coco beach bar Jaime, Juan , Manuel , David and especially the pool lounge ELLIOT . He is the best love them and love cancun

reviews.author: Elz
reviews.title: Not the same
reviews.text:
My fiancé and I have been coming here for 3 years. Two of those times were in Royal Service and the other time was with my mom so we did the regular stay. Every time we come back we know what to expect and that is why we love it here. We know that we will get the same quality; however, this time we did not feel the same. Let’s start by saying that Royal Service is great and who makes it even better is Rode. He is the most personable, friendly, funny, respectful and professional person we have come across when staying at resorts (and we’ve been in some in Asia and BVI) Rode makes you feel welcome and does an EXCELLENT job getting in touch with you and making sure all your needs are cover, and much more. If every resort would have a person like Rode, vacations would be a better experience. It is Rode and the service that we have received in the past what made us take Paradisus in consideration for our wedding. He took us to see the people in charge of Wedding planning, and personally, I did not feel very welcome. I thought that would be a happier group of people to talk to (the person we spoke to was Marlene) and that not only would give us a brochure but that we can set an appointment to sit down with someone and make us feel that this is the right place for our venue. I asked to set an appointment, but they gave me a brochure, asked for my email to send the prices (which I have not received yet and this was a day ago... mind you, this was empty and no one was getting in to get info at the moment) and explained few things, but I think I expected more from a resort that I have loved for the last couple of years, so unfortunately, I would look for another venues in Cancun. 

Now, Fuego, the restaurant that also made me take in consideration this as a wedding venue... it is NOTHING like the last times we’ve been here. The menu gears a lot towards Peruvian food, they even claimed to write in their menus “Lima style” I am Peruvian and Limeña. I know Peruvian food and how it is traditionally served and prepared. The last times it was a Peruvian Chef in charge of the kitchen, and he even came out to asked how the food was and to greet customers. This time it is not the same chef (which I totally understand because i do not care the nationality AS LONG AS what you are describing in detailed in the menus is exactly what you are delivering) but it doesn’t represent Peruvian food. And yes, the restaurant is not Peruvian, but if you’re telling me you are delivering “Lima style” then that’s what I expect, like all the other times I have been here. 
I knew something was wrong because the carte they gave us was torn off, ripped at the edges and it just gave me a bad impression... but we decided to stay because of our past experiences. We do not know what has changed so much in the last two years we have not been here but saddened me. Could it be managing? Hopefully they fix it soon, but my fiancé and I will not be back to this resort in Cancun, perhaps the other Paradisus resorts but not this one.

reviews.author: Guide55327163840
reviews.title: Paradise in Cancun
reviews.text: This hotel was very aesthetically pleasing and comfortable.  The vegetation in and around the hotel was amazing!  A tropical paradise!! The hotel was very family friendly and there was something for everyone!

reviews.author: Estef_13
reviews.title: Pretty good all inclusive, yet an all-inclusive
reviews.text:
Considering this a all inclusive hotel built about 30 years ago, the hotel is pretty well kept. I loved the fact that there was no noise outside my room so I could get a good night sleep. 
The food is OK. The hotel offers an area for "adults only" that you can access if you buy the "royal service". I recommend this option if your are traveling with your partner and want to take it easy and chill. Otherwise the other pool is pretty crowded. The hotel offers a very good spa - with a complete water circuit. Service in general is good, and there is service at the beach with a special menu. 
Still - it is an all inclusive hotel - so there is a lot of people from all backgrounds and customs. It is not a luxurious nor fancy hotel. The first night the receptionist assigned us to the wrong room and we had to change rooms the day after, which is always a hassle because we had to cut our first beach day in order to switch rooms.

reviews.author: Gloria Y
reviews.title: Cancun
reviews.text: The hotel was great, and I really enjoyed myself. The rooms were cleaned daily, and had to call to asl for face towels.  They were brought up immediately.  We had to get help with the coffee maker and the safe, but all problems were taken care of in a timely manner.

reviews.author: Ashley S
reviews.title: Fantastic Hotel
reviews.text: we stayed in Royal Service room with lagoon view to save a little money. What you don't know about lagoon view is that is the sunset direction!!  Service was exeptional along with the food and drinks!! Can't to go back!!

reviews.author: Cara S
reviews.title: Great Honeymoon Spot
reviews.text: The staff was friendly, especially our first butler, Hector. We had an amazing dining experience at Enzo with our waiter DiRoberto. Our room was beautiful and kept very clean by the staff. Any minor problems were fixed immediately. Overall, the food was good. There were just a few things we didn't like, but for the most part we were satisfied. The shows were entertaining, especially the King of Pop and Mexican Fiesta Cultural Show. The LEX classes were great too, just wish there were more of them! Royal Service is the way to go. The private beach, bali beds, and service were amazing. We would definitely stay again!

reviews.author: HJMX
reviews.title: Paradisus by Melia Cancun
reviews.text: Everything was absolutely amazing. It was worth every penny. Outstanding level of service, food, cleanliness, etc. The one thing I want to point out though is that the whole lounge--although its beautiful architecture gave a forest vibe--smelled really bad (e.g. fish smell).

reviews.author: BleuJeen
reviews.title: Great Service, average food
reviews.text: Vacation - service and amenities were great. The attentive service, especially at the Royal Service pool and La Palapa made it very good. The servers there took good care of us - Valeria, Julio, Joel, and Eddie made it exceptional. Overall my biggest issue is the food quality and prep in the restaurants needs to be worked on overall. Bana being the worst.

reviews.author: Pamela D
reviews.title: Beyond Expectations
reviews.text:
We had an amazing week. Food options galore, we enjoyed the Market Grill (Brazilian Steakhouse) and the burgers from pool area were great. Really liked being able to choose as much or as little you want to do. We appreciated the special attention of Victor and Eduardo who really made our pool experience great. All of the staff focus on making service a priority. 
One exception to everything being perfect was on last day I fell in room due to drip from the A/C condenser. I am still waiting to hear from management about incident. I made report before leaving, have emailed photo of injury, but still no reply.

reviews.author: BPark77
reviews.title: Perfect weekend getaway
reviews.text: I will keep this short and sweet.  Paradisus Cancun is amazing from service to food to the cleanliness of the entire resort.  Top notch.  I highly recommend you upgrade to royal service if it's only adults in your party.  This gives you access to a quiet strip of beach and the crown jewel of the resort which is the outdoor La Palapa restaurant.  Delicious food with a beach side setting and wonderful waitstaff.  Speaking of food, all the other restaurants are solid as well.  We just came back and are already counting down the days until we go again next year.

reviews.author: Elizabeth J
reviews.title: Truly A Beautifu Resort..
reviews.text: Love this resort! It's spacious..The Balie beds are a must right on the ocean..Make sure to book one..The 9 restaurants all serve delicious food..Live entertainment every night..I have yet to come across another resort that has soo much to offer..Its clean..The grounds are so well maintained staff are so friendly and humble.. ( please make sure to tip generously)..We celebrated our 40 year anniversary..Every restaurant had something special for us..Imagine getting a 'gift' for 7 days!! Even the hotel had a bottle of champagne on Ice..with chocolate dipped strawberries delivered to our room..This was definitely something to rave about! Thank You Paradisus! We will be back..

reviews.author: gitanjaliraghav
reviews.title: Horrible Experience!
reviews.text: Very poor room maintenance. Coffee machine in the room was not working, bathtub and washbasin were always clogged. During our stay, the last day AC in the room was also not working. It took the staff 8 hours to look into the matter. Finally at around 10 PM we were made to shift to other room which was not cleaned (dirt everywhere) & smelled like fresh paint . My 8 month old baby couldn't sleep all night due to the smell. I requested refund for my last day stay at the hotel and I haven't yet heard from the hotel manager. It was a complete waste of our time and money.

reviews.author: Szyq2018
reviews.title: Room for improvement
reviews.text: Spent last week at Paradisus Cancun. From check-in the trip was problematic. After we were dropped off we wandered around the main lobby until we found a door that I assumed was check in. There was confusion about which building we were in, then once that was clear they had to send for someone from royal service to bring us over. Once we found the right area check in was easy, but after the flight and arrival stress we were immediately approached about sitting for a presentation about purchasing a time share. Many incentives were offered, which we agreed to revisit. The butler showed us to our room, waited for a tip and that was the last time we saw him. We had asked about dinner and bali beds, and were told everything was booked for that night and the following day. The first two days left a bitter taste in my mouth and we decided to speak with the royal service concierge. This is where we met the woman who turned the trip around. Melina at the royal service concierge is an asset to this company, hearing our concerns she tried to help with dinner, bali bed and class reservations. We were ready to leave, it was that bad, and this kind professional demonstrated the utmost competence. Melina even helped get us towels and maintenance, because the sink was stopped up and we did not have housekeeping services for a couple of days. The third day in we met Jose the pool concierge and along with the pool staff made us feel truly pampered. The classes were wonderful, we found Edgar the bartender every night just because he was worth it. The entertainment crew Omar, Hector and Luis made every days events enjoyable. Then came the tropical depression. The hotel leaks, all over. My daughters room flooded and the yellow caution cones became and obstacle course. I can honestly say that the service staff makes this hotel, it would be nothing without them. Due to our experiences we decided not to sit through the time share presentation, and we feel this may have contributed to the lack of "royal service" that we paid for. A note for people who dare to stay here; tip everyone regardless of how much gratuity is included in the price. I would also like to give special thanks to the crew at Blue Agave, we ended up eating here every day because the tacos are the best dinner option here.

reviews.author: alexsiemsen
reviews.title: Not what we expected.
reviews.text: Was not pleased with my stay the second time around. Due to construction that was going on next to our room and the fact we were placed in a handicap room, we will not be coming back to this resort on our next vacation.

reviews.author: aroigor65
reviews.title: Cancun + An amazing resort = Great Time!!!
reviews.text: Came to Cancun for Memorial Day weekend. An amazing resort on an amazing island. Exceptional customer service from Jose at the Restaurant Naos and the entertainment guy Hector. Will definitely be visiting Cancun again at this resort!!!

reviews.author: vagabondtraveler_13
reviews.title: Exceptional service and relaxing stay!
reviews.text: Wonderful place to relax!  The service on the beach/poolside is amazing!  The property is located on one of the best sections of Cancun Island.  The fine dining at Tempo is worth the trip here!  The staff does an extraordinary job making your stay as wonderful as possible.  Asunción, our waitress at the pool for consecutive days, provided exceptional service, was very attentive to our needs, as well as being pleasant and kind.  Jose was most gracious and helpful when we checked in.  Bali beds are a wonderful way to truly enjoy your day at the beach.  We were grateful to Mariza for reserving for us and making sure we were well taken care of.  The setting and the vibe of this hotel works for me.  Ocean view is a must!  Room was very clean and comfortable.

reviews.author: kimmethb
reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: We visited Paradisus the week of Mother's day. We recieved the most amazing service from everyone. But exceptional sevice from the following staff member's Gaudencio and Omar at restaurant Naos and Ruby at the pool bar. Hector the Athletic director was amazing.  We enjoyed our experience so much we will be going back.

reviews.author: Losfranksnyc
reviews.title: A week in Paradise!
reviews.text:
We just came back from one week in Paradisus Cancún! We brought a group of 65 people to celebrate our wedding in the hotel from all over the world! 

Everything was perfect ! We want to mention couple employees from the hotel that they were top- notch ! 
our wedding planner Marlene and Melina!
Our butler Eduardo in Royal Service ! 
Waitresses: Didier, Miguel, Jorge ! 
Bartenders; Alan and Perla !!!! 
All the staff in the hotel were very cordial ! 

The hotel was perfect ! All the employees are on point and they are very cordial , Congrats to the team of Food and beverage , Mr. Eduardo and Mr. hector! 

My only concern is the thirds party companies that work with the hotel when you do your wedding ! 

Novia mía Photography - bad . Too much money for the bad quality of Picts and videos. but at the end it’s the brand that matter bc the hotel told us to use this vendors! 

Js & audio visual- bad cero communication between the client and the company they want to do whatever they want and they don’t listen to the client! 

Alquimia florist - bad service they don’t know how to sell and they showed us pictures from another hotel since they work with Paradisus and are the prefer vendors from them ! 

Paradisus need to check out your third parties companies that work with the hotel! Because at final your name come first because you chose them to work with futures brides and grooms.

reviews.author: NikitaIryna
reviews.title: Wonderful Service
reviews.text:
Updating a previous review, upon settling in our room , we had raised concerns with our room. Immediately after previous post the management reached out and attended to all the matters and even upgraded us. We ended up staying at the royal service ocean view room and it’s absolutely gorgeous. The team here are very attentive, all
the service staff have also gone above and beyond. Very grateful to staff and management for really turning this trip around. Two thumbs up! Also the beach is very beautiful here and cabanas are really worth Getting, overall great vibe.

reviews.author: David T
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun (3rd time here)
reviews.text:
I am writing this review for Paradisus Cancun.  I wrote one for them 3 years ago.  We went back last year.  I didn't bother writing another one then.  I am writing it again now as we are Elite Club members.  While we were already members of the Melia vacation club since 2012, we upgraded our membership during May 2017.  So this review is based on that change.

I am still highly recommending this place regardless of whether you are part of Melia's  vacation club or not. But yes, membership has its privileges
To give some background if it helps you with the review

I am 48 year old male. I went with my wife who is 47. We don't have children
Were there 10 days 9 nights from Wednesday April 25 to Friday May 4.
We live in Brooklyn, NY.  we also have a house on the Jersey shore. 

I'm a CPA with a tax practice, my wife is my office manager. We usually use our vacation club 2x a year, once after each of the two busy periods of work (so usually 10 days between late April through May and 10 days between late october  through November)

The resort is about 20 minutes from the airport.  I would recommend doing the all inclusive option. Especially if you like to drink.  All inclusive is an extra $89 per day per person.  As we are club members, the cost of the room, I don't know as we use part of our membership points towards that.  

There are tours you can take to things outside the resort.  We didn't do that this trip as we've done it before. 

There are nine restaurants and 4 bars at the resort. That's not including the pool bar.  We had a master suite. Usually we get a regular size suite at any of the melia vacation club places, but figured with last year's vacation upgrade that we had more points per year, so why not?  This was bigger than our apartment in Brooklyn.  

We weren't able to get an ocean view this time. Weve had it before, but those were already booked. Not the places fault, we booked it about six weeks before, usually book 3 months in advance. 

Our favorite restaurants were Fuego and Mole.  None were bad, these just stood out more

There are several pools at the resort.  We used the royal service pool which has no kids, since we don't have any.  We were able to get a Bali bed every day. Bali beds are an extra price. For club members it's only 10 per day.  Non club members is higher, not sure the price.  Same with the beach there as far as the Bali beds. You have to claim your bed by 11 otherwise someone else who is on a waiting list will get it.  

If the royal service ones weren't available, we could still have gotten one at the main pool. The main pool is nice as well and we had Bali beds the two other times we stayed at the resort in 2015 and 2017

The ocean has a ton of seaweed. So while the beach is nice to sit at, the water is not great for swimming.  I'm not much of a swimmer, but my wife is.  

you will get quicker service at the pool if you tip when they bring you your first round of drinks. Not saying they won't come around at all if you don't.  But let's be realistic the better you tip, the more attentive the service will be.  But I would say that at any of the melia resorts, not just here.  People in the US, especially the east coast tend to tip more anyway, just how customs are.

Our butler was Brayant.  He was very attentive.  He went above and beyond.  
We had a welcome gift when we came in.  He also gave us some goodies when we left.  This is partly the club membership, especially the welcome gift.   But I do think taking care of your butler is a good thing to do for all the service they provide

He also arranged for us a private dinner in a gazebo on the beach.  This was included as being a club member.  Not all the melia resorts do this for club members, but this resort has done it before.  This was wonderful. You have your own waiter and the gazebo to yourself. It's very romantic. A bottle of wine and a bottle of champagne was also included. Four course dinner. After dinner drinks. I remember doing this at 
another of the melia resorts for my wife's birthday 5 years ago and the cost was about 400-450. As I said this was free here. 

Here I will mention that the waiter for our beach dinner was Oscar. He was very good. Attentive. But also would give us the time to enjoy our meal. Meaning he was there just for us but didn't hover.  Took pics of us and had a good sense of humor.

Our concierge was Carlos.  He arranged our dinner reservations.  He was good as well

As far as breakfast, the royal service pool side has a restaurant near it.  La palpapa.  It is not a buffet like it is at Naos.  But the food is even better. La palapa is also open for lunch

I want to mention Daniel here.  He's in charge at la palapa. Our first full day there we had trouble getting a Bali bed (even though our butler had arranged it). My wife tried paging our butler but it Wasn't working.  Daniel got in touch with him for us and everything was taken care of.  This was while breakfast was still being served. So he took time out for something that wasn't part of his area to help us.  He called him from his personal cell and gave it to my wife.  That's above and beyond

All the servers we had at la palapa were very good. We ate breakfast there six of the days and had lunch there the three days we didn't eat breakfast there.  Valeria, Joel and Orlando were the servers.  Breakfast ends at 11. One day when I was hungover from the night before and wasn't going to get to breakfast in time (and my wife thought when I texted her when I got up at 10:30 that I'd meet her by the pool that I meant I'd meet her there for breakfast.  So she texts me at ten to 11 asking where I was (I was getting ready for the pool). She told me that she ordered me food.  By the time I got there it was 11 and breakfast should have ended. They still held my food in the kitchen to keep it warm. Even though I got there as they should have stopped serving. Wonderful that they did that. Didn't rush us out either 

The pool servers I will mention are Ramon, Eddie, victor, Javier, Jorge, Cesar.  We were the 10 days. I don't remember how many days we had each one. But they are all very good. Kept the drinks coming.  There is food at the pool if you want as well

Marco was our pool concierge. Outside of the issue the first day with our Bali bEd, he was top notch.  He even moved us to a better Bali bed location two days when people didn't claim theirs by 11.  He checked on us every day. The issue the first day was not his fault, but he still "made good"

I mentioned earlier there are 4 bars. One is the red lounge. It's more of a night club type place, only place open past midnight (closes at 2 am). Neither me nor my wife are much for dancing.  We went there a couple of nights. Francisco is a server and he was good

Blue agave is a restaurant that has a bar in it.  It closes at 11   Samuel is the bartender there. He even gave us a couple of drinks "to go" when they were closing. 

Avenue Bar is open till midnight.  One thing that pissed me off here is that there is seating off the bar.  There was a couple with their two little kids (under age 10) in this area at 11 pm.  Yes they weren't sitting at the bar.  But they were in the bar area.  I don't think little kids should be in that area after the show times (there are two shows there nightly that end at nine or ten).  That's just me though most people probably don't mind.  

Fuego = Paola is the hostess. Even though we were a half hour late and the place was packed, she got us a table within 5 minutes. Jorge was the waiter and Guillermo was getting us drinks. Best combo of food and service was here

Enso is another restaurant. More causal dress than the others. Meaning you can wear shorts and tshirts.  Darwin was our waiter. And he was very good as well.  I had duck and it was great. 

Mole = 2nd best combo of food and service. Marvin was our waiter

Vento.  I normally love vento, but wasn't as impressed this time. Aurelio was our waiter and he wasn't as good as some of the other places. Not saying he was bad, just not as good. 

Blue agave (the restaurant part) is a place you can have lunch or dinner. Juan was our waiter and he was very good as well

Market grille. This is a rodizio restaurant. Same thing as Fuego we got there a half hour late and the hostess  benazir got us a table right away. Jorge was our waiter. Very good 

Naos  is open for dinner, lunch and breakfast.  No reservations needed. Buffet style.  Had lunch a few times here and dinner one night. Wasn't as impressed as 
I normally am. 

Blue agave becomes a snack bar from midnight until four. The two nights we went to red lounge we went here afterwards 

I am not much of a spa person.  But this time I got a massage. Cynthia was my masseuse. Its hard for me to rate massages when I hardly get them, but all I know is I she got the kinks out. 

My wife is more into the spa.  She went there once for a massage. Lilliana was her masseuse.  She also got another one at a table by the pool another day from the same woman 

Overall I love this place. Service is very good. All inclusive is the way to go.  All the pools are nice. Beach is beautiful. But the sea weed is tough

reviews.author: Kristina M
reviews.title: Will say here again!!
reviews.text: Our bartenders really made our experaince wonderful!! Eduardo, Edgar, and Eder were the best! Always helping us out and trying new drinks for us. Edgar at the sushi bar speaks great English and Eduardo will always take care of you at the pool bar. We went to the pool bar everyday we went to the pool. The sushi bar was an incredible experience

reviews.author: Melissa12340
reviews.title: Awful Service
reviews.text:
I came with 3 friends on a bachelorette stay at Paradisus. We were really excited to begin our adventure but at our check in the person at the front desk said that we needed to have the credit card which we had used (6 months ago) to pay our reservation with. Of course we didnt have this credit card since my friend’s fiance was the one who paid for her trip. 
The hotel said that it was hotel policy to show up with the exact credit card used 6 months ago and wouldnt let us do the check in even though it was paid for and we had other credit cards we could use for backup. 
In the end we had to give another credit card and the hotel charged the whole stay all over again! It is a really expensive hotel and they treat you like garbage; we asked them to show the terms and conditions where it stated that we had to give the exact credit card and they didnt have them. It was all a lie.
If a parent paid for their kids trip or you credit card was cancelled how can the hotel expect you to bring this exact credit card?

reviews.author: Margaret L
reviews.title: Moises is a gem!
reviews.text: This was a last minute 4night stay that was a good deal - had we paid more we would have been disappointed. Check in was horrible even after agreeing to a Royal Service upgrade. Rode our butler secured our choice of 4 dinner reservations (vento, Market Grill, Enso & Mole) as well as our Bali beds. We did not like the menu at Mole and went to Bana instead last minute and enjoyed the sushi. Food in general was horrible - the only hot meal we had was from the RS grill near the pool/beach. Food was consistently cold at the buffet, room service x 2 was cold, even the steak selections at the Brazilian restaurant were served cold. The resort is pretty to walk through although the ventilation is poor and subsequently very warm. We had the pleasure of meeting Moises (Go Real Madrid!!) several times in the RS lounge and him & Jorge were our Bali bed servers - they were fantastic. Service overall was outstanding 5/5 - servers and maids were always friendly and made efforts to exceed our expectations. We enjoyed our stay because of these incredible servers! Beautiful resort, great pools & beach and definitely worth the upgrade to Royal Service.

reviews.author: Jennifer A
reviews.title: Amazing Stay!
reviews.text:
I have been coming to Cancun for years and I decided to try a new hotel this time around. I can not begin to explain how great of a time me and my wife had. The hotel was beautiful, clean, and the hotel staff were top notch. They were always super attentive, especially Edwin Ordonez who hands down was just amazing. His attention, kindness, and always making us feel important  made our trip even better. 
Definitely will be coming back.

reviews.author: Ktraveler49
reviews.title: Birthday trio
reviews.text: It was great getting to spend time at the paradisus resort. I liked the greenery and gardens as well as the pools and activities. I went to the restaurant enso la perla and had a phenomenal time my server Jorge dined us like royalty and the food by Marcos was superb. Great visit overall

reviews.author: niini1994
reviews.title: The Stone's Cancun experience
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun was absolutely amazing! The Ambiance set to buy all of the live plants and incredible service was stunning! We truly enjoyed ourselves! It took us months to finally decide on a resort to stay at, and I am pleased to say that paradisus Cancun was a great choice!

reviews.author: bsmith9876
reviews.title: Great Resort - Royal Service a Must!
reviews.text:
We stayed May 19-26 and used USA transport from the airport.  This is a very efficient operation and wouldnt hesitate to use them again.

Check in was fine.  We were early so didnt mind the short timeshare talk.  We declined to purchase, but the gentleman giving the talk, Rapha, was so nice, we enjoyed just sitting and talking with him.

Our room was on the fourth floor.  Beautiful rooms.  Well appointed and well laid out.  Bed was hard, but you come to expect that.  The maids cleaning was timely and thorough.

Our Butler was Sergio.  What a delightful person.  Very good; took care of everything for us.  I would request him again.  Booked our restaurants and Bali Beds.  Wasnt intrusive but there when we needed him.

The food was wonderful.  We've been to many all inclusive and we both agreed Paradisus was the best AI food.  The restaurants were really good with Fuego being our favorite.

The service in the entire resort was very good.  Tip or no tip, you got the same excellent service.  

We would definitely return to this resort and are planning for next year.  Hasta Pronto, Paradisus!

reviews.author: Jennifer C
reviews.title: AMAZING!!
reviews.text: It was our first time in cancun and I really wanted to splurge out. Howver, it was very last minute so majority of the hotels were booked. Paradisus was available but I was not too sold on it. UNTIL the day of arrival.. WOW let me just start off by saying I will definitely be visiting this hotel again. The lobby itself is BEAUTIFUL. We got a ocean view on the 6th floor over looking the pool and beach, lovely. I rated it 4 stars because when I had booked I had asked for a king bed and mentioned how our flight would arrive early. Upon arrival at 9:00 AM they advised us that our room was not going to be available until 3:00 pm. Finally after our long wait we get our room, and to our dissapointment it was two twin beds. We had to wait until the next morning to switch out room, total inconvenience. I also wish the hotel would have other beer besides Tecate and sol. Food wise are favorite was the sushi restaurant located right in the middle of the lobby I believe it was ibana. As well as the buffet NAOS, we never were dissapointed with it especially breakfast time.  We had dinner at the market grill, and the chef came out to bring us a separate plate made by him in honor of my boyfriends birthday. They even brought out a cake and sung happy birthday. Upon arrival someone will want to sway you away to attend a meeting during breakfast, it's about an hour long and just for attending it gives you discounts on any tours you would like. The package deal they offer in the meeting is actually a good investment if you have the money for it, i didn't get it but still got the discounts for the tours. We also rented a cabana by the pool where they brought us champagne, lobster, shrimp cocktails, ceviche and chips with Guac. It was worth the ever buck. The service was ALWAYS great, everyone is so friendly and helpful all the time, not once did we get any rude or unpleasant service. When I say you will not be dissapointed, I mean it. Thank you paradisus for making our first trip to cancun so memorable we miss you and can't wait to go back!! Los vemos pronto chicos!

reviews.author: papasmith2
reviews.title: very happy
reviews.text: very relaxing very acomadating, the staff was great very frendly, rooms were very clean ,food was great,great variaty,very clean buftet ,resterant staff was very acomadating great selection of food from high end to buffet,

reviews.author: Andrea M
reviews.title: Fantastic as always!
reviews.text: We head down to this property almost every year and when we don't, we always compare our experience to this.  We love the location of the resort right on the ocean and the staff is very attentive, you don't have to do a thing!  The food is also very good!

reviews.author: 819nick
reviews.title: paradisus cancun
reviews.text: it was an excellent experience and the royal services were very royal. i highly recommend the hotel. The staff are very attentive, friendly and prepared.  overall the service was the best that we have received in any of the hotels that we ever stayed at.

reviews.author: Patricia A
reviews.title: Royal Service
reviews.text: First time staying on the Royal service side. Spent most of our time at the bali beds by the pool. Good food and drinks. Our Bali bed host, Elisander was very accommodating and helpful with anything we needed. Very nice and pleasant always has a smile on his face. We also had a concierge, Sergio. He also was extremely helpful and went out of his way to make sure we had everything we needed. Will definitely go back again.

reviews.author: veronicafales
reviews.title: Awesome family vacation
reviews.text: Excellent service overall.  I really enjoyed the variety of food choices that were available.  We never had any issue with getting chairs together by the pool.  The check in was a bit slow as we were travelling as a family and wanted to have two rooms near each other.  We were traveling with my 10 week old grandson and we had to wait about three hours for this to happen.  Other than that, all the service staff were polite and efficient and willing to go above and beyond to accommodate us.  Next time, I would get the family concierge service if travelling with a little one.

reviews.author: cruz5010
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Been to paradisus punta cana three times and just went to paradisus Cancun, wow! Was blown away with the service level in Cancun! Wanted to say thank you to Andres our waiter at the market grill everyday was amazing! The bartender Timoteo made the best drinks! The butler Fernanda was on top of all our needs. Very clean hotel perfect for family! Will definitely go back.

reviews.author: Brendan M
reviews.title: They do resorts really well
reviews.text:
My girlfriend and I spend a four day weekend at the Paradisus in the beginning of May. We'd researched and found Paradisus to have outstanding reviews and ratings. Our experience was enjoyable and memorable. The only complaint I have is the Royal Service wasn't worth it. 

Even though our Butler was mostly inactive, there were other staff members who made our experience special. Melvin (our waiter at La Perla) was thoughtful and surprised us with special appetizers and desserts. He really seemed to enjoy his work. 
Christyan (Fuego) provided exceptional service as well. He enthusiastically presented our dishes and made us laugh. 

Lastly, we met a very sweet woman named Asuncion on Mesera de la playa who went above and beyond to deliver a wonderful experience for us. 

If you're looking for a resort, I doubt anyone does it much better than Paradisus.

reviews.author: mcernest2018
reviews.title: Amazing Resort
reviews.text: Though we had issues and had occupied 3 rooms within our 5 night stay, staff were friendly and tried to help us as much as they can. Some may need more training but they tried their best and work hard.

reviews.author: Julianne H
reviews.title: A happy place with great service!
reviews.text: Paradisus lived up to our expectations from the time we walked through the door. We had excellent food and fantastic service. The resort is clean, beautiful and the people are extremely friendly.  We were a bit surprised that tipping was quite common so we also felt obliged to tip, even though it said tipping was not required (“no wet wallets”).  The resort is about 15-20 minutes from from the night clubs and Negro market (12 pesos bus fare each way).  Worth checking out!

reviews.author: George T
reviews.title: Waiters
reviews.text: Excellent service! Andres Contreras goes above and beyond to make my family and I happy. I am very please to be here at paridisius because of the great service. Andres and his co-workers in the morning are the best! Thank you Andres!!

reviews.author: Everydaymatters1
reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text:
The resort is very nice, very clean and the staff are very nice. The check in process was fast but and Martha gave us great service. We loved the Bali bed packages and took advantage of throughout out stay. Our room balcony was not facing the beach but we could see the marina. Carlo at the pool bar gave us great service.
We really enjoyed our stay there  and of the staff who work the beach, restaurants and bars are super attentive -please tip them generously as they work really hard to meet everyone's demands!!

reviews.author: Lt654
reviews.title: above amd beyond
reviews.text: just returned from a 10day holiday here, and it exceeded my expectations! the hotel was so much nicer once i was there, the photos do not do it justice. the staff are incredible ad a credit to the hotel! please say thankyou to Paulina on the reception desk who spent nearly 2 hours with us trying to sort out travel home the next day! we considered going for Royal Service but decided against it, not a decison i regret however, even after reading the great reviews about it. we were still waited on by the staff on the beach and all the resturants on site were incredible. we were off site alot on excursions, however, i would certainly reccommend this hotel to anyone, it made our holiday amazing and i can not thank the staff enough!!

reviews.author: Lola W
reviews.title: Best trip!
reviews.text:
This is my 3rd time here but this time Guadalupe Rodriguez (supervisor) made my family’s stay extra special. Guadalupe was extremely sweet, respectful and accommodating. She went the extra mile for us. We had 4 rooms and she helped get us next to each other. We were celebrating a birthday and the room was decorated perfectly for the birthday boy.. This hotel is so nice, very clean and lots to do. thank you Guadalupe for being so helpful and amazing. 
She has very good customer skills , she’s caring and loving person

reviews.author: KezMetz
reviews.title: Royal Service is a must
reviews.text: We spent a week in Royal Service which was incredible. The service (includes a butler), the beautiful room, the private adults only pool and dining areas were all impeccable. I advise however that this is only when you book Royal Service. After returning from Tulum we needed to stay a final night in Cancun so we booked here again but skipped the Royal Service as we were only there for a matter of hours but this was a mistake - it was like we were staying in an entirely different resort! The rooms are old, dated and at most 3 stars. The service dropped too and when we realised just how different it was to our initial experience we tried to move to Royal Service but it was booked. Moral of the story - Royal Service area = 5 stars and the Other area = at best 3 stars!

reviews.author: jaimegarr
reviews.title: Paradise for a Family of 5 in Cancun
reviews.text: This is our second visit to Paradisus - this time with a family of 5.  The first time we traveled as an engaged couple and found this hotel based on completely different criteria.  This hotel truly creates a customized experience for whatever your needs are (family, couples, etc).  What sets this hotel apart is the gorgeous natural atrium overflowing with greenery & plants, the many pools, the gorgeous beach, the friendly staff, and the family concierge program.  We upgraded to a family concierge suite ocean view and this allowed us separate living space with sofa bed, master bed and 2 balconies.  The family concierge allowed a separate lounge area with snacks and a baby play room.  The kids club had many activities planned and our older kids had to be dragged out of there, they were having so much fun.  The staff were extremely courteous and helpful with the baby.  After spending a week, we know we will be back!

reviews.author: Alexander  T
reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.text: Stayed here twice such a beautiful hotel clean beach's, the only thing that I would complain about is the food I wish there were more authentic Mexican food like Fajitas/enchiladas/beans rice Y la música porque no pone norteño or cumbias we're in Mexico😉  overall great hotel awesome staff!

reviews.author: Andrea DiCarlo
reviews.title: AMAZING SERVICE
reviews.text: First off get over how perfect this vacation was. The staff is always smiling and very helpful. Every day we were there we had the same waiters in the Naos restaurant, in the morning we would have Gaudenico and at dinner time we would have Omar Garcia. Both of them were phenomenal waiters. Never once had any dirty dishes or empty cups on the table and then if we didn't know where something we on the buffet or it was out they would go get it personally for you. Adam Lucila was also a huge help to us too at night time in Naos. My family and I can not thank you guys enough for giving us an amazing dining experience every time we ate. The activity director Hector was also a huge help to us every morning giving us information on what was going on for the day and what shows or type of music they were offering for the night. I could go on and on about how these guys just made our vacation experience over the top. We can not thank you guys enough either for making this the best vacation!

reviews.author: The Howards
reviews.title: Could have been better
reviews.text: Upon check in, we had to meet with Bianca who told us all about the hotel but also tried to sell us packages, which took 30 minutes. With 2 small kids after a long flight, would have liked to skip this. We asked if we could upgrade because we had the money to do so but were told the hotel was absolutely booked and no upgrades were available (they have 5 connecting hotels). Later on the beach we met a couple who asked if we had Family Concierge and we said no. Well apparently they upgraded upon check in to Family Concierge in Tower 3 where there is a special block of rooms only for families. The hotel staff make reservations for you, book your excursions, and you get a free bottle of champagne every night. We got a plain room in Tower 1. Really confused why we were not offered this even after we asked for an upgrade?? So we complained to our hostess Bianca about the roll away bed my husband had to sleep on-literally a very thin mattress on chunky coils. Bianca said she would get a new bed right away for us. She never did and we had to call the front desk and do it ourselves. Disappointing. FYI the hotel charges $400 for a trip to Excaret Park for 1 day. The photo people walk around and take pics of you with parrots etc; however, they charge $50 for 3 printed pics. The waiters expect to be tipped. Housekeeping was amazing. Food was okay, except all steaks were amazing. All the on site restaurants had NO air conditioning. They used fans to cool us off. The hotel did not have air on except the front desk check in and your room. It was hot. We did not feel taken care of here while everyone else were raving about Family Concierge. First time for my kids in Cancun, with a not so great experience. And yes we've been to Cancun many times before kids.

reviews.author: Carol S
reviews.title: The best most beautiful resort in Cancun!
reviews.text: They cleaned our room three times a day and always treated us like the most important guests. It’s a stunning place to stay! The food was good and the drinks were even better! They have beautiful views off the room and wonderful employees!

reviews.author: Matthew G
reviews.title: Awesome vacation while staying in shape!
reviews.text:
My wife and I took our first vacation with our 9-month-old to the Paradisus and found that the entire staff was welcoming and went out of there way to make us comfortable. We requested a room that was in a quiet section and was accommodated with the perfect room.
One of my biggest concerns while on vacation is getting a good workout in while still enjoying all the amenities that the resort has to offer. Paradisus has a gym like most resorts, but what stands out in their gym is their fitness instructor Eric. Eric holds classes throughout the week for bootcamp, spinning classes, and kickboxing as well as personal training. I requested to train Muay Thai and was given personal training by Eric in between his class schedule. It's hard to train while on vacation but Eric provides a motivational scenario that made me enjoy every class I had with him.
Eric is a very high-level trainer in Muay Thai and all other fitness programs that he offers and the best part is that all classes were included in our stay. 
My family and I look forward to our next visit to the Paradisus and staying in shape while we are there!

reviews.author: James M
reviews.title: Memorable Experience
reviews.text:
From the moment we step onto the doorstep of the hotel till the moment we left the hotel for home. we were greeted, pampered and treated with royalty service. There was never a dull moment. Our bedroom was clean,cold and refreshing with huge with a King size bed. The bathroom was big and nice. There were more towels than I could handle and they were really long towels.
There were so many restaurants to choose from, but we particularly like the one with the all inclusive buffet service. Every day and night, the the food was different. A different country theme each night. The night was filled with entertainment. We particularly liked the Michael Jackson impersonator, whose moves just blew us away.
We spent time on the beach and we were pampered with any any all the liquor and water we wanted, even food brought to us. A generous tip goes a long way with the waiters and waitresses. 
But be careful on their 90 minute presentation when they will try and sell you a time share condo. Just keep an open mind. I checked them out and it seems people who were caught in it have a hard time reselling or timeshare their condo units.
When you go out of the hotel, be very aware of your surroundings and do not go astray after dark or at least make sure you are in a safe place. We took a local bus to town but had difficulties coming back as most people don't speak English.
On the whole, we came home looking like red lobsters with a very satisfied grin on our faces.

reviews.author: sirlove11
reviews.title: What a trip, what I say?
reviews.text: From the moment we arrived the staff made sure our trip was memorable. We arrived super early ( 7:00 in the morning) they offered a room so we could rest until our suite was ready.  Our butler Rode made sure all our needs were met.  The restaurants were fabulous especially Tempo and the grill. Finally our pool concierge Elsander made sure we had a beach Bali beds everyday.  I could not ask for anything more.  I have traveled to some of the most beautiful beach locations in the world ( Turks and Cacios ,South of France, Canary Islands , Phuket Thailand) this trip was one of the best!! I am already set up our trip for next year.

reviews.author: Jenny C
reviews.title: Paradisus is our 2nd home!
reviews.text:
People keep asking: why do you keep going back to the same place? The answer is simple: because it is awesome! Hotel is beautiful and every single employee makes you feel special!!! 
It is so great to see again (and be recognized by) wonderful employees that helped us during prior visits like: Christian (Naos) and Rodrigo (events). But also, to meet new (for us) employees that made this trip a fantastic one! Specifically:
Pascual & Jorge (Naos) 
Marissa, Hector & Azuncion (Pool)
Daniel (Tempo)
Mae & Lilia (Spa)
Carla (Gelato) 
Carlos & José (Club Melia)

See you next time!!!!!

reviews.author: Coretta G
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation
reviews.text:
This was an amazing vacation for myself, husband and 10 year old daughter. Believe the good reviews that you hear! 

I have two words for family.....Family Concierge. You must do this!!! Our concierge was Fernanda and I cannot say enough amazing things about her! They go above and beyond to make you feel special and taken care of and will handle any situation you need or do their best trying!!!! 
Here is just a list of some of things Fernanda did for our family....book all restaurant activities, book reserved kids club activities, called airline to help confirm information, took us personally to our dinner reservations to make sure we got to the correct location, went to the pharmacy to get medication we needed, gave treats and gifts to our daughter every day, special items brought to our room (aromatherapy pillows, champagne and chocolate dipped strawberries, meat and cheese platter, fruit platter) and much much more I could go on. We absolutely loved her!!!!
Check in- so smooth and easy with the Family Concierge separate area and check in. Always snacks available there and drinks and if your room isn’t available you can use the washroom there to get changed and use the facilities. 
How does your concierge contact you? Download the app what’s app...all communication is done this way and it works so well!!!!!! 
Kids Club- when reading reviews of other resorts to decide where to go this was one that I kept looking for positive recommendations, Paradisus had great reviews which is another reason we chose it. What can I say about such a caring bunch of young ladies that made our daughter’s time so amazing. When you read reviews that say, our child didn’t want to leave, its true! Our daughter chose to go there every afternoon and loved every moment! From the games they play, to wax hand making, ceramics, bracelet making, fruit art, magic show, water aerobics, sports on the beach, decorating cupcakes, making cookies, mask making and so much more. Our daughter loved the girls there and met children from other countries and has an amazing time. It made her vacation!!!!
Beach- amazing! White sand, chairs on beach (but get there early to get a spot, around 8 am). Yes there is seaweed but it’s the ocean and they do their best to clean it up from the beach. The water is beautiful but yes wavy but so much fun to play in but it is not calm so for little children always stay close. 
You will be served on the beach any drink you want and I advise you to have pina coladas, mud slide, lots of water lol and a drink called a Kelly Kelly. The people that work here are very kind and helpful! 
Rooms- beautiful and clean. Checked on after dinner for extra towels or anything we need. We had a king bed and our daughter slept on the pull out couch. Bathroom very nice with a rain shower and lots of room for people to be in the shower, use the mirror or go in the separate bathroom. 
We had asked to be in a quiet area so we were in pyramid 4 and we loved it. At night you can hear the entertainment but it all stops around 10 pm.
The interior of the hotel is absolutely stunning! Greenery hanging everywhere and the smell is so amazing as incense burns all the time. 

Restaurants- during the day you can always use the buffet, or go to the Market Grill or sunset and grab a plate and take it to the beach with you. Blue agave  is also an option. 

Our absolutely favourite option for night dinner is Vento we loved it! We went twice! 
Market Grill was ok, Enso was good too.

We loved our vacation!!!! Loved it! I cannot say enough about it! 

Even though tips are not asked for I would suggest if you can....tip, tip. The people work so hard. 
Also a little suggestion, bring little things from your home country to leave for the house keepers along with a tip. I cannot tell you how much a simple pen with a Canadian flag was appreciated!

reviews.author: Ryan T
reviews.title: Absolutely Amazing Time!!!
reviews.text: My wife and I brought our 11yr daughter here for Spring Break  We stayed at the property March 8th through the 16th.  We booked the Family Concierge package and it was worth every penny.  We had Sandra and Alexander for hostess/host.  They were very attentive and ensured that all of our needs were met.  Every night there was a special gift and dessert for our daughter.  They made sure that she was aware of all of the kids activities that took place on property.  They also took care of our offsite dinner reservations and helped with transportation.  We highly recommend Harry's Steakhouse.  We also used the cabanas poolside and on the beach where Didier and Jaime took exceptional care of us.  The room was perfect for the 3 of us and was very clean.  The onsite food was better than other hotels that we have stayed at in the past.  We will be back next Spring Break!!!!

reviews.author: Lynn D
reviews.text:
Beautiful place, but they should fix the ditch between stairs and beach since I broke my ankle on it.
  We had a wonderful time. The resort was beautiful, staff very accommodating,  and food was good. Top notch.

reviews.author: veitchsmveitch
reviews.title: my stay at paradisus
reviews.text: great place to stay, great food , great service, great staff. best Michael Jackson show I have ever seen, all the shows were great.i would definatly go back,also very close to the airport.travel from the airport to the hotel is very quick

reviews.author: Michelle H
reviews.title: Stay at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: When we arrived to the hotel we were taken to the check-in area, where we were easily checked in and even quickly brought a drink from the friendly waiter they have working in the area. They handled our baggage while we were getting assigned to a room. After check in we were given a quick tour around the resort, were given detailed explanations about the restaurants (which needed reservations, hours, etc.), and then were asked if we would be interested in attending a time share presentation. This all took around 45 minutes, so be prepared for a longer than usual check in time. The resort is beautiful, nice and clean pools, clean rooms, friendly staff, and good restaurants. The beach is beautiful, there is an area with beach chairs and shade, and also have staff bringing drinks to you on the beach. The water was refreshing and clean. The staff working the buffet were all so nice, I don't have any of their names but the waiters were so kind, extremely friendly, and provided great service. Housekeeping did a good job with cleaning the rooms and re-stocking towels. Antonio the bell boy was so nice and took care of our bags when we were checking out. From arriving to Paradisus until leaving we were very happy with the resort and the people that work there. Would recommend this hotel to anyone, you will love it!

reviews.author: edns
reviews.title: Fun in the Sun
reviews.text: Wonderful location to walk on the hotel strip, walk on the beautiful long beach, catch a local bus to the market, or just soak up the sun. A must visit is the Tapas restaurant. Call for reservations (easy to get) and then just ask them to bring their most popular dishes and you will be wowed by the food. ALL restaurants serve extremely delicious and different food!

reviews.author: Voyage208802
reviews.title: Amazing stay at Paradisus
reviews.text: When we arrived, we were escorted to the family concierge area, that we upgraded to! I must say everyone should upgrade to this, we were quickly taken to our rooms, beautiful ocean view rooms with double balcony’s, we had access to premium alcohol and a complimentary cabana, we also had unlimited access to classes and activities for my kids 2 and 4 years old, in the kids zone, the staff was amiable, trustworthy, we felt secured. The gelatos and nespresso are we’re great. We had access to las palapas one of the best restaurants there with upgrading. Our butlers were Sandra and Alex, they organized our schedule, reservations for dinner and activities. They were very helpful, they decorated my sons room for his birthday, and send over a cake. We had champagne and strawberries sent to our room also, they stocked the mini fridge daily. The ladies there cleaned the room beautifully. The entertainment was amazing. Always a show to see or something to do. It’s def a resort for families .And we have no complaints everything was amazing. The waiters work so hard, they exceeded our expectations! Best trip so far in Cancun!

reviews.author: Carol-Ann K
reviews.title: Butler Luis
reviews.text: We loved this place! It’s beautiful! Our butler Luis was amazing. I wish it was a longer stay, but the days we were there, he made every moment count! We went for our friends birthday. He planned a surprise for her with balloons, rose petals, champagne and cake! He exceeded all expectations! He’s professional, informative, friendly and a great personality over all. When going to this resort and getting a room with butler service, be sure to request Luis. You’ll be very pleased you did!

reviews.author: Evelyn D
reviews.title: Memorable experience - Birthday & Pre-Mother's Day celebration
reviews.text:
I went with my son and his family along with my daughter-in-law's mother.  It was my grandson's 3rd birthday.  At first the start of the vacation was a bit disorganized at check-in as my son and his family had a family suite (in addition to two separate rooms for us mothers).  Naturally, we all wanted to check in together. Since there was no guidance initially other than being greeted and advised to enter the family lounge; we all went in to the family lounge for check-in. I understand the concept of the separate check-ins but there needs to be something in place to make it a less convoluted process, especially when joined with other family members. 
Only the family suite guests were escorted to their rooms, as for myself and my daughter-in-law's mother, we had to fiend for ourselves and got lost several times circling the same areas due to lack of proper signage posted in the hotel.  My recommendation is that more signs and directions should be posted or at least provide a staff escort to the rooms or conduct some sort of a tour for first time visitors. 
The "first" room assigned to me, upon finally finding it after 20 minutes was double-booked as another guest was already in the room (I walked in on him and his companion). The "second" room I attempted to locate on my own and could not, as I stopped to ask several staff who advised either they spoke minimal English or not at all. After much frustration, I walked back to guest services to request someone take me to the room as by now, I wasted nearly an hour!
Upon reaching my room, I found the room to be very well appointed and clean with super comfortable beds and a beautiful frontal view facing the lagoon. 
We rented a cabana 2 days by the pool and 1 on the beach with the lobster lunch and Moet! Food was totally amazing. Our wait staff there was Didi by the pool and Haime by the beach.  They were excellent!!
We had breakfast each day at the buffet and waiters were Arturo (the absolute best; remembered everyone's drink and how we liked it!).  Armando and Alfredo worked alongside him and also were very attentive to our needs (we had a 3 year-old with us, so they were always checking to make sure he was ok; Arturo even brought the staff over at breakfast with a cake to sing Happy Birthday to him!) 
Mariza and Jennifer accommodated us each morning when we arrived, remembering that we wanted the table outside.
I cannot wait to return to this beautiful haven!!! We also had reservations at Bana, Naos, and Vento.  It was great to experience the unique cuisines; food portions just very small. Blue Agave was also very good. Overall we had an ahhmazing time celebrating my grandson's birthday and being grateful for an early Mother's Day gift from my son and daughter-in-law. 
The staff was friendly, always smiling, and greeting you throughout the resort.

reviews.author: Poonam V
reviews.title: WOW.. They really go above and beyond
reviews.text: Paradisus was an absolute dream! From the moment we arrived we were treated with great hospitality until the day we left. they kindly upgraded us to the family conceriege, and this service was amazing. Voileta and Fernadez went above and beyond to make our stay extra special. gifts everyday in our room for us and our daughter.  I was also celebrating my 30th birthday which they made extra special, the room was fully decorated with ballons and banners. The service they provide is excellent and nothing is too much for them.The children club is excellent and full of different activities to keep your child entertained. Its been 3 months since we've return but a day doesnt go past where we dont mention Paradisus, we will be coming back!!

reviews.author: Iamforevermelanie
reviews.title: Beach is beautiful.....
reviews.text: After enjoying several vacations at the paradisus playa del Carmen we decided to try the paradisus Cancun with royal service. Arrival was a disaster; initially we were greeted by the main hotel and told they could not find our reservation, we waited ..... eventually we were taken to the royal service desk. As we expected our room was not ready, We were escorted to a very tiny bathroom to change so we could enjoy the pool facilities while we waited - this was not expected- change rooms were made available at playa del Carmen. There was some miscommunication regarding our room- this may have been on our part but again there was disappointment. We expected this resort to be on par with the playa del Carmen resort, let’s be clear it is not. The worst for me is the lack of shade available at the royal service pool area. A cabana is the only available shade, no umbrellas or trees, cabanas are not equal to the number of guests thus not accessible for everyone daily. The beach is lovely but the best thing about this resort is the staff. Most, not all, of the staff are very sweet, there is the exceptional staff as well and they are: Jennifer, a hostess with the royal service.  She recognized my disappointment immediately and she acknowledged it, she was not afraid to talk to me(as some staff were) and she worked very hard to make it better. Laura, the head butler. She too worked very hard to make our stay more pleasurable. She checked in daily, and is extremely compassionate. And then there is Elisander, a pool attendant.  He too had been checking with us daily, making sure our day was pleasant. He is a very pleasant, friendly, people person.  Each of these individuals have strengths, traits, characteristics, and assets that provide great value and contribute to the success of their working environment. They are managerial material!

reviews.author: S C
reviews.title: Mother Daughter getaway
reviews.text: Last week my mom and I spent the week at the Paradisus and had an amazing time! We had the Royal Sevice package and it was worth every penny. The entire staff was amazing but I have to specifically thank our butler Maria she was very thoughtful and attentive, also Elisander who assisted us on the beach everyday.I’m a vegan and there were plenty of options at all of the restaurants especially the buffet. We will definitely be visiting some of the other Melia properties in other countries.

reviews.author: AnishSamV
reviews.title: Had a fantastic time here
reviews.text: Stay at Paradisus was excellent. Overall resort stay was great. Minor issues like noisy air conditioning in room, and a very small number of not-so-friendly staff - everything else was awesome and we had a fantastic time here.

reviews.author: wyssmannl
reviews.title: The resort's name is very accurate!
reviews.text: Wow! This is paradise! Every aspect exceeded my expectations.  The facility is beautiful. The room was very large and beautifully appointed. The food is fantastic--both healthy and decadent options. The staff is truly amazing (kudos to Hector, social director). Everyone was so kind and helpful. The activities were enjoyable and varied...zumba, bootcamp, salsa, arts and crafts, etc.... The evening shows were enjoyable. Truly was a week in paradise.

reviews.author: Asma T
reviews.title: Nice Resort and Service inconsistent FOOD
reviews.text:
I Stayed at the resort last week and I can truly say that everything was spot on with the exception of food.

With little kids I didn’t get a chance to go to any a la carte restaurant, I only used the Buffet for convenience but unfortunately I was disappointed few times. It felt like the food was the same again and again and again.... I have been to couple of resort in the Caribbean and this is the resort with the least options for Seafood...except the Seafood night. Literally some nights we only had guacamole and chips... I mean we like it but it was a little too much.

I honestly advise the management to check on their food variety and consistency, we were really disappointed on that end.

reviews.author: Zhukpavlo
reviews.title: Nice stay - Better then Live Aqua - but has cons
reviews.text:
Hotel is very nice! Booked Ocean view and got ocean view! Check in was quick, but we arrived really early.  They have us bracelets and were able to use the resort.  Room was nice and big.  Hotel grounds are huge and nice with plenty of room to walk throughout the resort.

Food was great (buffet and restaurants)!  Had higher expectations for Market Grill though. Service was great everywhere! Drinks not so great.

Did the timeshare - and it was much better than others - no pressure at all.

Last day (after a storm) the seaweed was very bad - not the resort's fault.

Cons (why we would not return):

Resort credits are a joke (knew that beforehand)

Chairs on beach don't recline (some do - but have 2 positions sitting or flat) - have to get out early and reserve the ones that recline.

Drinks are all the same - with fake (Syrup) taste.  This was most disappointing! They use huge ice chunks - provide no straws - so all the ice floats.
