They reuse the same cups - prefer straws for that reason! Also smoothies in the morning were a letdown. They hide or don't have mangoes (in season in May in a country that grows them).

Mangoes during dinner would get wiped out and never replaced.  They seems really cheap on mangoes here.

In general a good stay - better then LIVE Aqua - but nothing to want me to return.

reviews.author: Jamie S
reviews.title: Babymoon getaway
reviews.text:
We booked this trip before we knew we were pregnant. We stayed in the Royal Service area. We had such a great time meet some really cool people.
 Our butler Hector was incredible one night he decorated our room for the baby complete with sparkling cider. 
We had great encounters with everyone that worked their. The servers were very attentive. Our favorite place to eat was Blue Agave the tacos were so yummy. We also loved sitting outside at La Palapa (worth the royal service alone). The entertainment each night was really nice. We will definitely return to this resort.

reviews.author: William B
reviews.title: Good Vacation Spot!
reviews.text: Overall, great resort.  Traveled with adult children, but this resort was very accommodating with younger children.  The All Inclusive was great.  Tipping seemed to be expected, which was a little disappointing.  Also, our concierge was not available/helpful all the time, but that was expected.

reviews.author: SHAUNA C
reviews.title: Amazing place to stay!!!
reviews.text:
I cannot say enough things about this amazing hotel!! The food was so good! Great atmosphere, but the number one thing I loved about the resort was the NO STAWS and reusable cups! So happy to see a resort not allowing straws that ultimately end up cluttering the beach and the oceans! 
The beach was really amazing too! Very strong current and fun waves, so definitely not for young children by themselves, but we had lots of fun!

We would definitely stay here again!!

reviews.author: xris36
reviews.title: Festus and Zora
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus from the last week of May into April and booked the family concierge service,Maria & Gloria looked after everything, they are super stars,they managed everything from my daughter's kids club activities to my son's football and volleyball games, our restaurants, even when we needed waterproofs for our phone because we wanted to go snorkelling. They are gems. There was Mariza at the main buffet restaurant for breakfast, she always had a smile on her face and knew our names and got to know our favourite spot for breakfast. Her service was impeccable. We had a room facingvthe sea and it was a glorious view every morning. The overall service at the Paradisus Cancun was amazing, the staff genuinely look after us, they are the stars of the hotel. And the entertainmen was really really good, each night after dinner, my family looked forward to the different acts, their favourite was the Michael Jackson act.i would recommend the Paradisus with hesitation. Many thanks for a great holiday

reviews.author: Glenn D. Godwin
reviews.title: Just amazing
reviews.text: I'm not one to write reviews but I've never been more impressed with a property. Managed perfect, employees gracious and well trained. The food was excellent, did not have a single bad meal. This is the best kept secret in Mexico. Hats off to Dan8al out Butler and Daphne inRoyal service. I'll be back in August for a full week! With family!

reviews.author: HALLIEG3
reviews.title: Great Resort, Great Service Thanks to Asuncion
reviews.text:
My friends and I visited the Paradisus Cancun for 3 days/4 nights. We weren’t really sure what to expect, having never been to an all-inclusive, but by the end of the trip we had all agreed to come back. The view from our room was beautiful and the grounds were very well maintained. Blue Agave was our favorite lunch spot, and Naos and Mole were are favorite restaurants for dinner. The resort staff was friendly and always made sure we had what we needed. 

We spent most of our time enjoying the ocean from the palapas near Cocoas Bar (just be sure to get there early to be able to soak up some shade). While the view itself was great, the best part of camping out at this location was the outstanding service from Asuncion. She always made sure we had cold beer and water and made fantastic drink recommendations, encouraging us to venture out. Aside from going above and beyond with her service, we loved her outgoing, kind and funny personality. She made the whole resort experience even better, by making it feel more personalized. Paradisus is lucky to have her – one of the biggest reasons we would decide to go back to this resort is because of Asuncion.

reviews.author: LynneRoblin
reviews.title: Love Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: This was our second year in a row staying at this resort...and loved every second of it.  We researched other resorts for 2018...but kept coming back to Paradisus Cancun!  Food & drinks were terrific!  Beach is gorgeous! Friendliest staff you will ever meet, they cannot do enough for you! And resort is super clean...staff were even cleaning the plant leaves in the interior of hotel! We will be back in 2019!!

reviews.author: chocokat
reviews.title: Family Concierge is a MUST if you have kids under 10.
reviews.text:
First resort all-inclusive for my little family. Last min (3 weeks out) booking, April 28-May 2. Family Suite Lagoon View (we didn't spend much time in the room, but it was a great view of the sunset). The place is well kept, feels somewhat luxurious and beautiful like all other reviews, so I wont have to further elaborate on those details.

Family Concierge check in was impressive. It is a separate lounge with play areas and refreshments/snacks. We were able to check in early, but our room wasn't ready. They will give you bracelets and allow to enjoy the property while you wait until your room is ready. We were assigned 2 butlers, Sandra and Alexander who are both in their own way AMAZING. They spoke English very well, and we communicated via WhatsApp (easy to use). Not sure what else I would have used Sandra or Alex for besides having them bring me items I needed right away or call housekeeping to refill towels. I asked a lot of questions and having that was valuable.

Room is your standard expectation, but my complaints are: not enough drawers, for some reason those drawers smelled musty, the bathroom has no ventilation. The fridge is not a fridge, but a cooler stocked with beer, juice, water. Be careful to close the door as it stopped working at one point. We were able to get a crib for my one year old, but it looked well used. Rooms were being renovated while we were there; I hope to return to experience.

Although we met our butler Alex first, we didnt see him as much until the second night when I needed milk (they can give you 1L), extra juice and ice. Most of my requests and interactions were with Sandra who is super sweet and was able to make all of my reservations for dinner, golf and spa, let me know of any kid events happening such as mini-disco, art, or anything they would interest my daughter who was 4. I have a son with food allergies and she was able to let the restaurants know I needed unseasoned chicken veggies and rice for his meals. Each night the kids get cookies, there were toys everyday, they decorated the bathroom one night with balloons...all these little surprises and seeing my daughter shriek in delight is everything. Sandra even ran back to my room to grab me a diaper at one time. That was amazing.

Restaurants: Blue Agave is great for quick bites (tacos+beer) and shoutout to Edgar who served our drinks and had pleasant conversation with us. Market Grill was our favorite (Brazilian Steakhouse style). Vento was not so great (and we tried a lot of tapas), but ambiance was nice. Enso was gross, don't even bother. Naos is the buffet and I feel like they had a good variety of foods, changed up every other evening. Breakfast is same everywhere. I had a crepe every night at the Gelato place. The grill next to the pool (I forgot the name) has actually good wings and fries. I only had drinks at Cocoa Beach Club, where I discovered there are hookah beds! Everybody we interacted with at all the restaurants were nice and accommodating. 

Did not spend time in Royal service (included with Family Concierge) part of the resort although I should have at least tried the food at La Palapas since everyone says its so good. We walked through it though, it's a nice area, secluded.

The Kid zone is AWESOME. Ok it smells musty, can be a little dirty (even though no shoes allowed) but my kids loved it. I left both my kids there, at most 2-3 hours. My daughter loved ROSA!!!! But actually all the staff there is very nice. There are 2 areas, one for the 12mo-4yr and the other for 5yr and up. Sometimes they will open up the 5 and up area to the younger kids (there is another playscape). One night they had a Disney theme live show--it was fantastic, my daughter was able to meet Ariel (her fave) and other princesses. The kid zone also sponsors a lot of the events on site like the mini-disco next to the main pool, arts and crafts, bracelet making, face painting, movie nights...so many activities. My daughter never wanted to leave. My son is 15mos, very independent and we had no issues with him either.

We golfed the Par 3 course in the front of the property. It's not in the best shape, but playable. Clubs/bag ($30 rental fee, $12 for 3 balls) are not well maintained and old. No signs to tell you where each hole is, or where to start. This amenity definitely needs improvement. The heavyset older lady at the shop needs to act like she likes her job. She was probably the only person on the resort that was not friendly.

We had a couples massage at YHI spa $160/pp. Lulu is...ugh, I wish I can take her home with me! She gave me THE BEST DEEP TISSUE MASSAGE. We didnt have time to enjoy the free spa amenities like the reflexology stuff and the hot tub--but i totally wished I had.

We had a Bali bed next to the pool for one day (comes with Family Concierge) and was able to get a Bali bed on the beach another day for a discount (SO WORTH IT, because the sun is not forgiving and all the beach chairs with shade were taken up by 8am). I was always able to get a chair at the pool, maybe we were lucky. Dont be discouraged with towels on the chairs, if there are no personal belongings, it's up for grabs. Family pool is just right size and the kids zone hosted a FOAM PARTY one day with giant inflated unicorns, swans and flamingos...Paradisus really caters to kids and families.

We didnt do any evening shows or activities because my kids were in bed by 8pm and we didnt bother getting babysitting service ($15/1st hr per child, $10 after). We took turns leaving the room for dessert each night. There are nightclubs and stuff but we weren't really into that. Benefit of going to sleep early was waking up early to see the gorgeous sunrise (and beat everyone to breakfast and the pool).

Leave tips. I know gratuity is included but a few dollars here and there makes a difference. We tipped the housekeeping about $5 a day, and our butlers significantly more. I even tipped Rosa at the kid zone for her attention with my children. We always tipped the guys that served us and prepared our tables/served drinks.

I am having withdrawals already. This property was perfect for my young family and I love how everyone says, "See you next year" when we were leaving.

reviews.author: Anna R
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful, most staff very friendly and helpful. the view from the room is spectacular. Buffet food is good, other restaurants weren't all good. We didn't like the check in, very slow, was told that the club and royal members get priority. The cabanas on the beach are reserved for club and royal members but most of them empty. Found most of the beach was reserved for club and royal members. Got the impression that they prefer Royal and club members only which is unfortunate as we really liked the resort.

reviews.author: Ashar K
reviews.title: Home away from home - Awesome vacation
reviews.text:
We have been coming to Cancun as Melia Member for past 5 years. First two we stayed at Playa Del Carmen and last 3 we are coming to Cancun. The views are breathtaking and staff is exceptional! Two main reasons we keep coming back year after year. Many faces recognize us and many we recognize from previous trips. They greet us and welcome us to our home in Cancun, the Paradisus! 

Even before we arrived, Valerie worked with my wife to prearranged the room, activities, dinners for the day etc. Ruth greeted us with big smile and  was waiting for us before we walked in. Check in was a breeze. We got the same Master Suite we had for past two years and George was assigned as our Butler. We love George and he made the trip very easy for us. He had welcome gifts for the kids and a bottle of champagne waiting for us in the room. George booked the same palapa we had last year. The breeze at the Melia area palapa is all I need to get into vacation mode! Jose substituted for George when he was off or out. Jose sure we had everything we need and kept checking on us and our kids at the Kids zone. I would highly recommend Jose to anyone if they want to have a relaxing time. Our palapa outlet was broken and he got it fixed in an hour. My son lost his Shark Fin on last day and Jose was calling everyone and went looking for it at the pools. 

Pool Side - kids pool is great. I have two boys. 8 year old is special needs and doesn't walk but 5 year old had a blast, made friends and didn't want to get out of the kids pool or the Main pool, swimming around with his Shark Fin! Hactor took care of the food and drinks at the palapa. We had Sergio last year and he was on the other side of the pool.

Kids Zone ---****** --- [A special place for my special needs kid with Exceptional staff] ..I would give 6 stars to kids zone team if I can. Kids Zone deserve it's own place at TripAdvisor. 
We don't normally leave him with new people since it takes time to get to know him and his cues. Susie, Vale, Sarah, Larissa took turns with him when we left him at the kids zone. They were kind to stroll him around when he wasn't happy. We love you guys and you made this trip so much better. We can tell when people love genuinely and we could tell you were doing a LOT more than just a job! Big Thanks! 

Vale babysit our kids one night so that we can go hangout with friends and we ended up attending silent party at Red Lounge. That was an experience.. it was hilarious hearing people sing along in a quiet room!  

FOOD - I actually have separate reviews for Naos and Enso... Food is great and a lot of verity... 

What can improve? There are a few things:

1: Kids activities are fun. The activities for adults at the main pool can improve. We loved the morning workout buy music needs to improve. 

2: Evening shows are better at Playa Paradisus. Last year there were shows at Avenue Bar which is small and this year they are outside. Fiesta was fun and kids loved it. Pineapple party wasn't much of a party. Music can be better. Circus shoe also  can be better. LEDs Show had a great show with jet ski, keep it up.

3: We missed good coffee at Members lounge. For past 5 years, we had snacks and coffee at Members lounge. This year it was limited and only till noon. Afternoon coffee is much needed. The coffee temperature was also very high and felt a bit burnt. 

Overall, a great vacation again and will see you next year! And to the staff, thanks for making it a true vacation.. 6 🌟 to you all!

reviews.author: Sarra
reviews.title: Gorgeous place!
reviews.text:
Late review: stayed in August 2017 with my husband. This was a quick 3 day weekend getaway we booked 2 days before. 

Stayed in one of the Royal Service Ocean View rooms and from check in to check out our experience was lovely. The interior of the resort is very modern zen, immaculately clean and beautiful with the vines hanging from everywhere. At night the central lobby area is lit up and has a wonderful ambiance. Very unique from the many other resorts I've stayed at in Cancun (Secret's The Vine, Sun Palace and the RIU Palace Las Americas).

Room was nice with a great oversized balcony and ocean view. Different decor from their counterparts La Perla but still very sleek, modern and well maintained. 

Service at all the restaurants and bars was excellent. Lots of restaurants to choose from even the buffets are above average in selection. Room service was a great option for quiet morning breakfasts on our balcony overlooking the ocean!

The Royal Service pool is smaller and quiet compared to the main pools and to be honest we didn't spend any time at the pools. We spent every day at the beach and our beach waiter was excellent and SO attentive (forget his name!). Top shelf liquor available everywhere and ate lunch right at our palapa everyday. 

This part of the beach in Cancun is truly spectacular there are no words to describe it. By far the best stretch of beach in Cancun proper.

Highly recommend and will certainly consider returning in the future!

reviews.author: Kristin P
reviews.title: Royal Service is definitely worth it
reviews.text: Great experience. All of the staff is very friendly and attentive. Our Royal Service butler, Louis, was super nice and took excellent care of us, especially with all of our restaurant reservations and getting us a bali bed next to the pool. Louis even got us a bottle of rum, a bottle of tequila, and a bottle of champagne for our room. He was excellent about providing reminders for us on reservations and our departure arrangements, which was a huge help. The gentleman who brought us drinks on the beach in the Royal Service section on Sunday, May 6th, was one of the hardest working men I've seen. He was the ONLY one servicing everyone in the Royal Service section on the beach and he had to go up and down stairs to get drinks/food/etc every single time. Probably has calves of iron. He was ALWAYS super cool to us, had a great personality, and he brought us more Miami Vices than we could count. The tables and chairs on the beach filled up FAST every day. Couldn't manage to get a spot on the front row even when we got up early one day for that purpose. The pool was immaculate and large enough to feel like you had your own space with other guests around. The beach was perfection. The water was perfect shades of turquoise and very clear. The sand was very soft with almost a playdough texture when damp. The beach was clean and quiet in the Royal Service area. All of the food we had was great, especially at Mole and La Palapa. The only negative moment was when a roach got into our room during the night one night. Seemed like a one-off type of issue, though. Our room was on the ground floor, so that probably had something to do with it. Everything was very clean, so I don't think it was an issue with the hotel. I would definitely stay here again. Did NOT want to come home.

reviews.author: Rani H
reviews.title: Best service
reviews.text: I will definitely be back at paradisus Cancun. The hospitality from the restaurants to the bars to every other store in the resort was excellent. My favorite bartender was the pool bartender Eduardo I spent most of my time at that bar. Eduardo makes the best drinks. My favorite waiter was Sergio at one of the pools, he was very fast and was always checking up on us to make sure everything was okay.

reviews.author: kaleesmith86
reviews.title: THE BEST SERVICE EVER
reviews.text: 3 words.....Jesiel is AMAZING. first my best friend and i booked royal service for our 6 day get away. From the moment we were introduced to Jesiel, he tended to all of our needs,  exceeded our expectations and was always available to us, even on his off days.  He was polite, professional, punctual, attentive, comedic and also very personable and friendly.  I believe we enjoyed our time even more because we had the ability to be worry free. Jesiel booked our dinner reservations, cabanas, as well as went out of his way to bring us the menu from the restaurants because my friend only eats particular foods.  He was always happy to help.  He went above and beyond to make sure my travel arrangements back to the airport were also taken care of,  so there was no need for me to worry. He was exceptional and if and when I do decide to go back to cancun, I will make sure to request Jesiel and I know my trip will be smooth and worry free. Thank you Jesiel.

reviews.author: Leah R
reviews.title: Amazing hotel and staff
reviews.text: Wowwww! I am sitting pool/ beachside writing this review. Paradisus has been amazing. I am picky and The hotel/ property is so well kept. The staff has been outrageously awesome. Hector, activities coordinator, has been so welcoming and engaging. He led us on a free eco tour on kayak. He even helped my mom make a sunglass retainer with string when the store was out of them. Hector was awesome! Erik at the gym led an awesome workout and modified it for my mom. Martin at Naos was especially awesome and really made our dinning experience memorable. We have loved our vacation and are so sad to be leaving soon.

reviews.author: traksat
reviews.title: A terrific place to vacation in Cancun!
reviews.text: The Paradisus Resort in Cancun can, at first, be deceiving. From the outside you are not exactly sure as to what will be found inside, but once there, the interior of the resort is amazing, Live, hanging plant vines can be found throughout the building, large open areas, and terrific "Must do" shopping. The restaurants and food are top notch, service  during your meals is ever present, the surroundings and ambiance add to your experience, and the best part, the walk between your room and the various restaurants is basically minimal. The pool areas are clean, well kept, and always staffed by servers who are there to meet your every food and drink need. Rooms are slightly above average in their outfitting. They are comfortable, and are serviced on a regular basis. Staff personnel are friendly, and in my experience, respond to any issues you may have quickly. Bus transportation is a short 5 minute walk from the front door of the resort. Be sure to check out the Isle Mujres trip, and the Cancun Mall. Both are worth the effort. Enjoy your stay!

reviews.author: RachVail
reviews.title: Best beach and service
reviews.text:
What an awesome week we had—we will definitely be back. We chose the resort primarily for the beach (we are beach people not those that sit at the pool at a resort) and for the family-style suite. We were very excited about both! The turquoise water and soft sand makes for perhaps the best beach we’ve ever been to, and we’ve been to Hawaii, Caribbean, other beaches in Riviera Maya and Puerto Vallarta. We loved jumping the waves, but note that the ocean can be rough; it’s not a calm bay beach. The color of the ocean water will be etched in my brain permanently! The lifeguards at the beach were very attentive and made us feel safe in the water. We did spend some time in the different pools and there’s something for everyone—a family pool, party pool, and several quiet spots to be more secluded. 

Our kids are 4 and 7 and we chose the Family Concierge Oceanview Suite. While we weren’t in our room much because we had perfect weather, it was great to have the separate bedroom for ourselves. We had lovely balconies where we spent time in the evenings looking at the ocean. Our room location in the 4th pyramid was very convenient and I’d ask to stay there again—room 4305. The rooms are super quiet. We didn’t use the kids club because our kids wanted to stay together and the 4 year old would have had to go to the baby club. We did partake in the foam party, which was a big hit, and all the shows at night were impressive as well. 

Overall the service was great. We are really glad we did the family concierge as Violeta and Fernanda made our vacation extra special by leaving surprises for the kids each day, treats in our room, dinner reservations, arranging for our beach bed and other room service. We also asked them to be proactive with us about telling us what activities were going on that the kids would like. They also went to the pharmacy for us and just aimed to please. The first two days we didn’t really know what to ask them for but once we discussed it with them, the rest of the week was awesome. There are delicious snacks and drinks in the family concierge lounge at all times too. 

We figured out that we got a pool bed for one day with our package but then we also figured out that we could get a Bali bed at the beach for $30/day and that worked great to have a comfortable reserved spot with shade. You can ask your concierge about this. 

The servers at the pool and beach were super friendly and helpful. We’d like to give a shout out to Laura at the pool and Sofonia at the beach. Thanks for the smiles and cocktails! The buffet worked best for our family for most meals, but having the Sunset Grill for lunch at the beach was great. Note ask for the guacamole and other food that you don’t see. It would be awesome if there was some ceviche or other healthy/lighter options too. We loved our 2 dinners at Fuego, mainly because the ceviche was so great. 

We did one excursion through Aquaworld that we booked at our resort and we are so glad we  went. We recommend the SubSee and snorkel trip, especially as a first snorkel adventure for the kids. It was so easy to just walk across the street and the guides made the boat rides really fun. But maybe skip the submarine portion if you are claustrophobic or prone to motion sickness. 

We also did a photo shoot with the onsite photographers and they were also wonderful to deal with and our pictures turned out fabulous. We did the shoot at 10 am in our bathing suits in the ocean and the water shows up as the perfect turquoise color. 

If you are at all worried about crime in Mexico right now, we saw police frequently patrolling and other security. We were a little nervous in advance, but we ended up letting our kids walk through the resort on their own to get ice cream (the Gelato at all times is another perk).

Anyway the service and the beach made for a perfect vacation and we can’t wait to go back. Thanks Paradisius Cancún!

reviews.author: SummerLoverNJ
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, not for foodies
reviews.text: Arriving to this resort was visually impressive. The decor and architecture is beautiful. The resort is clean and well kept. The pool area has cabanas and the ocean has tiki huts with beach chairs. We had the royal service package which was a great choice for our adult group. Our butler Daniel was attentive without being pushy, and was able to accommodate our reservation requests and book us a pool cabana. The gym facility was nice and clean. We took a class with Erick who was a good instructor who focused on form and was passionate about his job. The service at the resort was excellent. If you are not a drink and relax person, this isn’t the resort for you. The daily activities are limited unless you book an excursion. The nightly entertainment was far from entertaining, but the night dance location called the Red Lounge was a lot of fun and it was nice to have a place to dance right on the resort. The biggest downfall of this resort was the food. For lack of a better term, it was basically terrible. Good food is an important part of our vacations , but the food here was a let down. The Brazilian steakhouse could not even compare to a low end steak house at home. We booked dinner for sushi one night but after we tried the other food on the resort we decided to cancel the sushi dinner. The desserts were terrible with the exception of the gelato which was only served during the day. The gelato was def the best food on the resort. If you are a foodie this is not the place for you. There is no drink menu and the drinks are inconsistent between bars and bartenders. I asked for a rum runner and they said they ran out of banana, but a rum runner does not have banana. If you looking for a beautiful resort to just lay by the pool with a drink and a view of the beautiful aqua and teal colored ocean then this is a good resort for you, but if you are looking for some activities and good food this is not the place.

reviews.author: Spring001
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text:
Fabulous week in Cancun.  We did the upgraded family concierge package.  Our kids loved the special treats each day and our butler Sandra was amazing!
The food was excellent and we really enjoyed bana and la palapa restauarants.  Great view from la palapa. True paradise.  
We got an upgraded, ocean front room in tower 2.  Perfect view of the beach! 
Amazing family vacation! Lots of entertainment for kids and adults.  The kids loved the kids club as well.  
Outstanding customer service!!!!!
Cant wait to go back!

reviews.author: julie233512
reviews.title: Great resort, but most of our group got sick from one of the restaurants
reviews.text:
The resort was great and the beach was beautiful. The service was also great and everyone was friendly and helpful. 

However, 5 members of our group got sick after eating at one of the restaurants (Vento).

reviews.author: Adrian F
reviews.title: Perfect place to propose - amazing resort with outstanding customer service!!!
reviews.text: Let me start out by saying that I proposed to my girlfriend on this trip and everything went exactly as I wanted/pictured it in mind!! A special thank you goes to Nayeli Arzate at the Concierge. She went above and beyond to help me plan everything that I had in mind. This included setting up a private 1-on-1 dinner right by the beach and ocean with our own private wait staff, hiring and coordinating a professional photographer (which ended up being Outdoors Photos on property, special shout out to them! They did an amazing job! Go check them out if you want really nice professional photo done), and purchasing rose petals for me offsite and brought in to be sprinkled around at dinner and back in our hotel room while we were at dinner. She even surprised us with a bottle of champagne and chocolate covered strawberries back in our room the night of the proposal. She did a superb job of coordinating it all, dealing with all my nervous emails to make sure everything was all set and ready to go, and also all the small requests/needs I had along the way to make sure the proposal stayed a surprise. Now, as far as the resort itself, absolutely beautiful and amazing!!! Everything about the hotel, restaurants, pools, and beach were awesome!! One of the biggest things I noticed was everything was always so clean, that's a big one for me and it was 10/10! All of the food there was delicious; we never had a bad meal throughout our entire stay. The customer service was top notch- everyone from the housekeepers to the waiters to the bartenders were always extremely friendly and ready to serve you. I couldn't have asked for a better way to propose to my now fiance and make such a memorable perfect vacation!!! Thank you again!

reviews.author: melanielsemidey
reviews.title: Awesome Experience
reviews.text: Amazing stay at this hotel. The hotel was amazing and food was great. Especially at restaurant Fuego! Paola was such a wonderful host and very pleasant and attentive. Jorge was such a great waiter he explained everything in detail food was so amazing! Aaron was such a great help made sure to get us everything we needed in a timely fashion I’m glad we chose this restaurant our last night in paradise! In Paradisus Cancun! We will def continue to come here in the near future!

reviews.author: quincyawilliams
reviews.title: Fitness Vacation Exchange Experience
reviews.text: I went to visit for a week April 14th - 21st and it was the best vacation I've taken! I went down as a group fitness instructor and for vacation. Everyone was so helpful. The resort stayed spotless and the food (especially Fuego) is amazing. It's also close to lots of shopping on 5th st.  If you're a group fitness professional and looking to get away while still teaching, I highly recommend Paradisus at La Perla and book with Fitness Vacation Exchange!!

reviews.author: lanawl
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text:
We have been to a dozen resorts in the Caribbean and this one was one of the best in so many ways.  Top of the list was the service!  -prompt, courteous, professional, exceptional!

The resort itself is very well laid out. Everything close and easily accessible.  

Either side of the hotel- ocean view or lagoon view are equally beautiful.  Oceanside had sunrise and lagoon side has  sunset.  Buffet was excellent, if you love buffets.  Our breakfast waiter at buffet was awesome!!!  Gaudencio made us feel so welcome and important!  A la cartes- ironically, the Mole (Mexican) not great.  Market Grill was Brazilian at its finest.  REAL steak at a resort, FINALLY.  Room service food and service-
outstanding...prompt  and professional.  You even receive a call afterwards to make sure you received your food and everything is well.  

Ocean/beach AMAZING. We love big waves.  Beach is right behind the main pool. The beach was a perfect distance from chairs to waves.  Plenty of beach chairs and cabanas with drink service to them. 

Room was bright and beautiful with large, private balcony. Beautiful lagoon view. We were happily surprised because we initially wanted an ocean view and they were full.  Our room attendant, Zenaida, was amazing and informative when asked questions about the resort.  

Two small detractors- 
-LONGER than usual check in time but drinks were served as you wait. 
-If you are a smoker, smoking rules are STRONGLY enforced!!  If you’re used to smoking at the pool bar, you definitely don’t want to try it here.  Also, plan to wait a while for a drink at pool bar!!  Bring your bubba and fill it up!  They do have high quality alcohol.  If you’re used to going to Cuban resorts, there is a very different vibe here.  We only met a few Canadians and a few awesome Brits and Americans. Usually we meet many people pretty quickly when in Cuba and still are in touch with many of them. People at this resort tended to stay within their own groups during our time there, but I’m sure it had more to do with language than anything.  Most people had never heard of NS or worse.   This of course, is of no fault to this beautiful resort. 

There is a lovely 9 hole, par 27, immaculate golf course.  Club rental available ($25 USD), balls and tees are not cheap so bring your own.  

Twenty minute drive from airport to resort.  Airport in Cancun was smooth, quick and efficient.  

I had the best massage of my life!  So I had two!!!  But it’s not cheap!!  Liliana was my massage therapist!  AMAZING!!!  I can’t say enough about her skill and professionalism.  The hydrotherapy spa was included for the day and everyone and everything there was perfect.  Jose at reception at the spa was helpful and friendly.  

We will definitely return AFTER we quit smoking!!

reviews.author: Yameliz
reviews.title: Perfect Vacations !!!
reviews.text: Looooooooooooooooooved everything about this hotel.  Truly nothing negative about our stay.  We stayed 8 days and enjoyed every minute of it !!  The room is great, clean and everything is new.  The staff is excellent.  The bed is super comfortable, room service is excellent.  Modern hotel, the restaurants are delicious and the buffet area delish as well.  Stay here you will NOT regret it !  Enjoyed every minute of it.  Xcaret is a must if you go to cancun by the way !!  Just DO NOT GET SUCKED IN to sign up for their vacation club, it is a trap !

reviews.author: Dan A
reviews.title: My wife and my 10 year anniversary.
reviews.text:
We stayed for 8 days last week and had a very relaxing time. Pros:
Excellent food with an expansive buffet.
Big Pools with a swim-up bar.
The whole place was very clean.
Very large rooms.
Great service by the staff and most seemed to be happy to work there.
Cons:
No entertainment after 9:30pm.
Only 1 hot-tub, it’s in the exclusive “Royal Service” area, and it’s broken.
No nightly entertainment schedule. 

Tips: If you want to use your phone charger on the nightstand by the bed, bring a 3 way outlet splitter. 
Hotel Suggestions:
Have more of the nightly entertainment in the conference center when it’s not being used. It can fit a LOT more people, and post signs with directions to get there.
When a show is in the Avenue bar, bring up the seat pads you use by the outside steps for people to sit on.
Have Casino night EVERY night. Seriously, what’s stopping you? It seemed like a HUGE draw. Hold it in one of the smaller rooms in the conference center.
Buy puzzle mats for the gym and put them by the open area where the scale is. 
Put soap dishes by the bathroom sink in every room. Super cheap fix and it lets the soap dry out instead of sit in its own puddle all day. 
Add shrimp tacos to the Blue Agave menu. They already have shrimp soup, so the shrimp are there.
Post the nights entertainment by the front desk and the sign by the pool.

reviews.author: shyamdua
reviews.title: SSD Reviw
reviews.text: Front desk very poor service and needs improvement. A major turn off! It should not take 3+ hours to check in. In addition, it took forever to get any issues resolved because of their incompetence. In restaurants, they required 24 hour reservation while most of the times it was half empty.

reviews.author: Boomdiggity50
reviews.title: Great property for a relaxing vacation. Try the Royal Service
reviews.text:
We booked the Paradisus Royal Service on short notice and were a little apprehensive about the property, but upon arrival our expectations were exceeded. The interior of the property and especially the greenery is beautiful. As for the staff, everyone we interacted with was pleasant, friendly, and attentive to our needs. Jennifer and Paulina greeted us and got us checked in a friendly and timely manner.

As for the Royal Service, our room was spacious, well appointed, and had all of the amenities that we needed. Rode, the butler/assistant assigned to us, was top notch and provided impeccable service, handling all of our requests, i.e. dinner reservations, spa services, cabana reservations, etc. in a timely manner. The spa staff, Jose, Cristina, Illiana, and Josephina, was second to none, very accommodating, and very skilled, as we both fell asleep during our massages.

With the Royal service you have the run of the place and can go to any restaurant or pool area. Weused the Adults Only pool and the service at that pool and the associated pool and beach side La Palapa restaurant, was timely, helpful, and professional. Thank you Cesar and Javier. Besides La Palapa the other two restaurants we ate at were Vento (Mediterranean /Tapas) and Bana (Japanese/Sushi). The food at both of the was great and the service excellent, thank you Frank and Romero.

The overall experience at Paradisus well exceeded our expectations for quality, food, and service, thus we will be returning the next time we are in Cancun.

reviews.author: Debbie N
reviews.title: 3 star resort with a 5 staff that deserves 5 stars for trying
reviews.text:
This was a difficult review for me to write.  We returned about a week ago from Paradisus, having a 1 bedroom suite in Royal Service.  

Check in was easy in the Royal Service area.  We were then passed off to someone who was going to fill us in on the resort.  Unfortunately, that was nothing more than their timeshare sales person, trying to convince us to schedule a tour of the property for us to buy a timeshare.  She was nice and after I said "NO WAY" a few times, we were done and not bothered again.

The room is basic.  I was very disappointed, considering what we paid for a one bedroom suite, the furniture was basic, the living room area was small and had a pull out bed.  My husband and I just returned from a 2 wk cruise and chose this suite so we could have a little extra room (after being in a ship cabin for 2 wks).  Since he snores (I don't...lol) we chose to have them make up the pull out bed so we could each watch our own tv shows and get a peaceful night sleep.  That evening, my husband sat on the end of the bed and fell right thru, spraining his wrist on the way.  The springs were missing at the bottom of the bed which caused the mattress to fall to the floor when he sat there.  Maintenance did fix it the next day.

Bathroom amenities were not 5 star.  (again, after travelling for 2 wks, I was running low on some items).  The shampoo was a shampoo/conditioner combo (which doesn't work on my hair, especially after sun, sand, salt water and chlorine).  Not a big deal, but for "5 star" I expected some name brand, quality products.  However, the towels were great, bath sheets which were huge and decent quality.

The bed linens were comfortable and of a higher quality.  The pillows were not.  Our butler (who was fabulous and was the best part of this trip) offered to get me other pillows.  I chose 1 foam and 1 orthopedic.  They were much better than those in the room, but were standard size, not king.

Building:  the floors are all tile and when it rains (which it did), many of the windows leaked (you would see towels along the sills all around the hotel).  There were a few areas that were leaking from the ceiling and towels were strewn on the floor.  It was a recipe for disaster and how someone didn't slip and get hurt still amazes me.

Spa:  I booked a 90 min massage.  The spa is beautiful and very nicely appointed.  My therapist Cynthia was great.  About 60 min into the massage, I was really zoning out and SO happy that I could come to TripAdvisor with something really positive.  Unfortunately that's about the time the construction started.  It sounded like they were going to jack hammer thru the wall and the last 30 min of my massage were ruined.  The noise was so loud I couldn't hear the music or relax.

Food.  Here is the big problem.  Trying to get a HOT meal was difficult.  We tried the breakfast buffet, cold potatoes, cold sausage.  The next day we had breakfast at the Royal Service lounge....cold potatoes, cold sausage AND the grilled portobello mushrooms I was so excited to have, tasted as if they had just come out of the fridge and no one even attempted to warm them.  Next day we ate at LaPalapa, warmer sausage and potatoes.  I asked for pineapple juice and received OJ.  I mentioned it to the server, he apologized and offered to get me pineapple juice.  I told him, "no worries, I'll get it tomorrow".  Tomorrow comes, I order pineapple juice and get OJ.  Oh well !!  Enough about breakfast, I think you get my point.  Now to dinner.....Mole stunk!!  I ordered Sea Bass which was so over cooked you needed a knife to cut it.  
The tapas restaurant was "ok", Market Grill was so-so.  We were offered steak, chicken, lamb all of which were hot and "ok".  We saw other tables getting mashed potatoes but we were never offered.  There were no veggies either.  I asked if they had any sauces for the meat (A-1, bearnaise, peppercorn) and the answer was no.  The saving grace was after speaking with the manager of Royal Service (who truly tried to accomodate and understood why we were upset) offered to have a special meal prepared for us at Fuego.  It was AMAZING.  Captain Guillermo Lopez greeted us and took us to a fabulous corner table overlooking the ocean.  Then chef Eduardo Mukol came out to greet us and told us he prepared a special mean for us.  It was top notch.....lobster, filet mignon and shrimp.  He ended it with an unbelievable dessert that was one of the best I've had in a while.  He invited us back the next night for another special meal and he prepared the same thing and it was better than the first night.  He ended it with a dessert in the shape of a heart and told us this was from his heart to ours (very sweet).  

I'm not a complainer (although this post sounds like I am).  I'm pretty easy going, especially when travelling, but we were disappointed (almost to the point of me checking out early and going someplace else).  

All this being said, the staff here truly are caring people and really want to make you happy.  Would I return here???  That's a big maybe.  The staff makes me want to try again, but I now know what to expect.  The price would have to be spectacular in order for me to try this resort again.  

Staff:  I am so sorry for writing this.  I know you all tried so hard and we do appreciate your efforts.  Unfortunately we came with high expectations and some things were just out of your control, but I do appreciate you doing your best to turn things around for us.

reviews.author: Chase A
reviews.title: Royal Service for our Mini-moon
reviews.text: Wow! Royal service is almost a different hotel altogether. La palapa is great and the service is top notch. Jennifer started to help us get settled in and she has offered 1st class service since day one. I do wish we can return and request her as our butler! The room is gorgeous and amenities are the best!

reviews.author: Mercedes
reviews.title: Annual Family Fun Vacation
reviews.text:
Well, where should I start...we just got back last night. We are a party of four with two children ages 11 and 8. What can I say about this resort but that we had a blast! Cancun never fails! The beach is impeccable! Breathe taking!! This year we decided to stay at  “Paradisus Cancun” it is an old resort but has been renovated through out! The rooms are very nice! We were in room 3457 and had a perfect ocean view! Our cleaning lady I forgot her name always made sure our room was spotless every time we came back from being out in the sun. So make sure you take care of them as well. Tipping wise! They work hard too. What I also liked was that they would come and check in if we needed any new towels around 6 pm, which was perfect because we were done with showering by then! 

We didn’t do reservations at any restaurants because “NAOS” buffet was all we needed! They have a variety of food for breakfast, lunch and dinner! 

We would like to sincerely Thank our morning 
Servers that are all the way towards the back of the restaurant they are ALEJANDRO, ANDRES and ORLANDO if you’re looking for a great way to wake up. These guys are it for the job! Best way to start our mornings..they are very funny and entertaining! Loved them! 
For Lunch we would have a snack at Sunset Grill they have Hamburgers, French Fries and their Hot Dogs were the best! 
We also had a few Tacos at Blue Aguave, their Al pastor and Tacos de Lengua were awesome!

For Dinner... again we greatly appreciate the service and attentiveness from “NAOS” ADAM greeted us with such pleasure! our server EDWIN was AWESOME! “Chef ALI” the BEST! They went out of their way to make sure we were always taken care of. 

They have a Gelato spot during the day that has great ice cream. The kids loved it! 
And at Night they have Crepes with Nutella Strawberries etc. The Best! SARAÍ thank you for being so Nice! 

They have a NESPRESSO Section!! Open Mornings and Nights!! Great substitution for Starbucks! 
We would like to Thank “LUIS” Luis,Luis!! He makes the best coffee at night!!! He was VERY welcoming the first night we arrived! I’m a big Starbucks fan and was iffy to try their coffee but he convinced me to try the “SWEAT TREAT” it’s delicious!! LUIS you are the best! We will never forget you! Thank you for your conversations!! Loved this guy! 

THE KIDS ZONE is great! The girls there are the best!! Made sure our kids had fun every time! Very fun!! They have so many activities to do each day!! 

The Kids pool was were we were at the most!! 

We normally hang out at the pool bar while the kids are the kids pool..this was the first time ever for us that we didn’t!! 
There’s a down fall about that! That main pool is deep! 
I’m 5’2 and I couldn’t walk around or near the the pool bar!! That pool is deep!! It says it’s 5ft  deep but I didn’t think so! Still! Couldn’t really hang out and drink like we normally do.. so be careful if you’re drinking there you might need a floaty! 
MAKE SURE YOU TAKE ONE! 

Red Lounge was fun!! Best little get away!! It’s their night club they have after 10pm. It’s their only night life they have! 

They have shows each night! Our favorite was 
THE MICHAEL JACKSON SHOW it was awesome!!!

reviews.author: pagepresley
reviews.title: Amazing Food Choices!!
reviews.text:
This resort not only has the white sandy beach and beautiful ocean blue water, it also has the upmost amazing food choices.
With 9 restaurants to choose from!

Variety of fun entertainment inside and outside throughout the day to nights - for families, couples, and businesses. The swimming area never got too crowded due to four big swimming pools. 

Staffs are friendly and accommodating. Always helpful with questions or concerns. The room was always neat made every mid-morning and mini-fridge stock with plenty of goodies to eat and stay hydrated.

Overall, this stay at Paradisus definitely made me want to stay at other Melia's resorts!

reviews.author: delightfullady1
reviews.title: Ooh, La La Paradisus/Cancun but TEMPO is the jewel in this crown!!
reviews.text: Paradisus by Melia was exquisite and as an all inclusive, the resort was on top of their game.  Wait staff, food, beverage were quite pleasant and fun. However, dinner at TEMPO was beyond my creative palate,  Presentation, wine pairing, white glove service, attention to detail and the Chef visits with guests as a show gratitude. I enjoyed so many highly created tastes as part of the Tasting Menu that as a gastropod, pure nirvana. 5 Stars.........

reviews.author: isbundes
reviews.title: Best vacation!
reviews.text:
It is a pleasure to write a review for Paradisus Cancun. We had an amazing time in the resort.  Everything is organized beautifully. Staff is working extremely hard to keep place running smoothly.  
The thing we did right – booked ocean view room. The colors of the ocean are magnificent. I attached photo. So, you have green oasis surrounding you outside the room and ocean colors inside. Air-conditioning worked well everywhere, so you never feel too humid or hot.
The center of the main pyramid has green jungle inside surrounded by restaurants and souvenir shops. Nespresso coffee corner and ice-cream stand. It was very simple to book the restaurant, just call before 11 am and you can get reservation for the next day. We loved Market Grill the most!!!  Buffet had a huge variety of food to satisfy any taste.  Ranaos Alfredo Arcos, took care of us every morning, with a lightning speed and care. He knew what we needed in advance (2 Mojitos and sprite for a start). 
Despite of some seaweed, beach was well maintained and beautiful. Water was clear, warm and gentle waves added more fun for swimming.  Enough shade and beach chairs for everyone. People get up very early to reserve spots on the beach or pool chair, but we never did that, it was not a problem to find shade or chair.  Pools are well divided: there is section only for parents with kids, section mostly for adults with a pool bar and middle for everyone together. Pools have never been overcrowded, never.  Advise, if you want something to float on, bring it with you!  
Nightly entertainment was great and very different every night. The Bana restaurant, the one in the center of green oasis, had live music every night too. Nothing too loud and very tasteful. Three tenors were amazing. It starts a bit earlier, not sure, but around 7:00pm. Strongly recommended. 
We did Jungle, zip line and UTB tours.  Jungle tour was worth it. Mario, our guide, was great and snorkeling a lot of fun.  It is very safe area. We took R1 bus (1$ per person) to nearby shopping mall. The bus stop is right near hotel. We also travelled to Playa-Del-Carmen on local buses. Very safe and fast. Took R1 to the ADO terminal and from there bus to Playa del carmen. Total cost for round trip is 8$ per person. 
I can keep writing, but I think you should just go and discover it for yourself. We are already planning to come back and bring more family with us.

reviews.author: budxo
reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text:
Our first visit to Cancún, and it was absolute bliss! We came for my birthday - chose the standard all inclusive - didn’t splash out for royal service and didn’t feel like we missed out on anything at all, everything was superb. Every team member we came across was so helpful, polite, friendly and fun. We loved Ricardo in NAOS every morning for breakfast. 

Room - well appointed, spacious, very comfortable large bed. Amazing air conditioning - we would usually pop in after lunch if we needed to cool down and have a wee break from the sun. Great having the mini bar restocked every night! 

Pool/beach - GET IN EARLY! Didn’t take us long to realise everyone will get up early to reserve the best seats (and sometimes only seats!) very cheeky - but if you can’t beat them, join them. My partner was going down before 7am to secure the loungers that faced the ocean and had cover and already a lot were reserved. The pool itself is quite deep - 5”1 in some areas and 5”9 in others. Pool is huge - multiple areas, and a dedicated kids pool and family area which was nice. We also found people were bringing their own Bluetooth speakers and blasting music - incredibly obnoxious when other people are trying to read and relax. There is already music played by the bar and down on the beach, so it was quite annoying but no fault of the hotels. 

The pool cabanas started from around $130USD per day - which I believe includes champagne and a food platter. 

Restaurants - definitely book the day before or as much advance as possible. We missed out on Fuego but dined at Enso twice - delicious! On my birthday night we went to Market Grill - a Brazilian style BBQ where they bring different meat, vegetables and salads to the table. The staff sung me Happy Birthday and bought me a special dessert, lovely! A fun experience. Bana was such a unique setting in the middle of the pyramid, delicious sushi and the best fish I’ve ever had. Blue Agave had some quick and easy taco options - order lots as they’re relatively small portions! 

We didn’t do any excursions but multiple places to book some extra activities or day trips. Also a couple of shops inside the resort for swimwear, jewellery, souvenirs, health and beauty products, etc which proved handy.

We loved our vacation, and will definitely visit again. Thank you!

reviews.author: bshah35
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun May 2018
reviews.text: A very memorable experience !! We were 4 adults and 3 kids with lot of food restrictions (Vegetarian without eggs and no root vegetables). We weren't expecting a whole lot of options to eat but still decided to try an all-inclusive resort based on the reviews and the location, we zoned into Paradisus. However, it turned out to be the best decision. We just didn't get something to eat, we got some awesome food from different cuisines. A big THANK YOU to  Mario Vazquaz, GTE Eduardo Ramo, Jose Palesti and Chef Eduardo Mukul for making this happen. Our vacation turned from Great to Memorable just because of you guys. Beach is great and the location is awesome for excursions as AquaWorld is literally 5 minutes walk from the hotel which is a huge plus if you intend to do any activities. We did Parasiling in the ocean, Jungle tour with Snorkeling and Jet Ski. Our 5 year was allowed to do parasailing and jungle tour and he is going to cherish the experience for a long time. Overall, a great vacation. We will be coming back again to Paradisus #whereyouwanttobe

reviews.author: Nykia B
reviews.title: Paradise at the Paradisus
reviews.text: Love, love, love this place! We were looking for a place to celebrate our 1 year Anniversary back in October and this place was highly recommended by a friend. It exceeded our expectations for an all inclusive resort, by far! We typically avoid the college/party crowd and while we love kids, we tend to avoid them on vacation too( sorry not sorry), so we really enjoyed the royal service. Our personal concierge Eduardo was fantastic! He made our trip extra special with little touches each time we returned to our room, rose petals, champagne, personalized notes, etc. He also did a wonderful job making reservations for dinner, massages, and poolside Bali beds. The rooms show a little wear and tear but overall the design is lovely and our room was kept super clean. Our shower leaked on the first day but we just mentioned it to Eduardo and it was fixed by the time we went to get ready for dinner. They keep your bar stocked with the liquor of your choice and tons of drinks and snacks and the royal service lounge was great for a quick bite of you ever had the opportunity to get hungry. I hated that it was located in  the basement while they renovated the real area though. The food in the specialty restaurants was amazing but the buffet was...meh at best. If i had to eat there for every meal, my review rating might be vastly different. Decent entertainment, beautiful clean beach, and the pool was everything! Joel works poolside and was wonderful, excellent, fast service. Our only complaint is that we did not know the royal service area would be under construction during our stay. It was well done and we barely noticed but every now and then there was noise from the construction. Regardless, we enjoyed our stay so much we've already booked our next trip back. Highly recommend, but definitely stick with the royal service!

reviews.author: Blackhawks2010
reviews.title: Nice Family Resort...Honest Review; Good, Bad, Ugly
reviews.text: This was our first trip to the Cancun hotel zone.  We have been to numerous all inclusive resorts throughout the Caribbean, both family and adults only.  First, do not believe the media hype and reports regarding all of the murders and crime going on in Cancun.  Yes, there were people murdered, but like any major city, there is violence.  A majority of any. Ience happens in the inner city, just like the US.  Use common sense and you’ll have no issue.  Do you walk through the gang infested ghetto when you visit Chicago?  No, of course not.  So don’t do it here.  We left the resort in escorted and walked across the street to Aqua World for an excursion.  Tourist are everywhere, using public transit (bus), walking around without any indication of any problems.  I felt safer in Cancun then in any Caribbean destination other then Aruba.  If fact, I felt safer than in Chicago.  This was a family trip so we did not experience the adults only section and service.  The resort overall was in decent condition.  The lobby is just awesome.  It’s like a green house atrium and is stunning.  The service was excellent and better than most Caribbean resorts we have visited.  I never once felt the employees were soliciting tips and genuinely worked hard to make our experience better.  The buffet food quality and variety was the best we have ever had at a resort.  The only thing lacking was shellfish (no shrimp, crab or lobster).  The formal restaurants were above average and the authentic tacos at Blue Agave were phenomenal.  The nightly entertainment was also above average and they had themed dinners and events by the pool each night.  The resort does an extremely poor job of advertising these dinners and special events and it wasn’t until the third day that we realized they were taking place.  This resort is family friendly and lacks much of the college party nightlife associated with Cancun which is nice.  They really do a nice job with families while segregating the adults only section.  The rooms are average.  We stayed in the lowest category room on the 5th floor facing the lagoon.  I actually think the lagoon view was better than ocean view as it has a full view of the sunset over the lagoon/bay and your room didn’t face the restaurants or outside shows.  The rooms were probably ultra luxury 15 years ago but have gone down hill.  Still decent but with some issues such as a leaky shower head and some cracks in the tile.  Minor issues but she. You are paying big $$$ you expect attention to detail.  Also, the air conditioning in the room is limited so you can’t ever get it freezing cold if that’s your thing.  The worst part about the entire trip was walking through the gauntlet of time share cons at the airport and then after check-in at the resort.  Whatever you do, DO NOT, go on a timeshare presentation or accept any gifts.  You will regret it.  We didn’t but spoke with some people that did.  They want you to spend $100K plus just to start and are relentless.  The beach...it’s stunning with the colors of the water and the water is warm...but it’s rough.  The 2005 hurricane destroyed the reef and the beach.  The beach has been mostly rebuild and is nice but the water is not safe for children.  If you are looking for calm ocean water like in much of the Caribbean you will be disappointed.  There is a strong undertow.  The pools are warm and nice and the drink service is excellent.  I have included a few photos.  The resort is nice and we will probably return.  We used USA Transfers to and from the airport.  It was $55 round trip that I booked in advance on their website.    Bring lots of singles and fives for tips.  It’s not expected but a nice gesture for the excellent service you will receive.

reviews.author: Aneeta
reviews.title: Omar the Entertainment Lead
reviews.text: So the Paridisus has lots of activities throughout the day. Our first day there we ran into Omar who told us about a party that evening and welcomed us warmly when we attended. We asked him about other activities offered that weekend and he quickly became our go to person for all questions Cancun! He was so helpful, friendly and entertaining that every activity we partook in added to the fun and richness of our experience! He became the familiar face we associated with our stay at the Paridisus and while the property is nice and has lots to offer, the experience wouldn't have been what it was without Omar.

reviews.author: juju0429
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
reviews.text: Overall it was a good trip! The hotel is beautiful and the staff is great. Visit Ignacio Vazquez and Eligio at Naos Restaurant for breakfast! They were very attentive and had great customer service; we sat in their area every day. The only complaint I have is we kept getting asked to do the hotel presentation and my family and I kept saying no and they were too pushy! Be careful getting into the pool too, we seen several people slip and fall.

reviews.author: Prakash U
reviews.title: Great views, service, food and amenities
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay at Paradisus by Melia Cancun. We booked a room with ocean views and we weren't disappointed a bit. The views of the ocean and beach from the balcony were simply breathtaking and majestic, especially night time when the moonlight illuminates the ocean water. The check-in was fairly quick and straightforward although we felt a little rushed. We took our time to ask questions about dining options/pool/reservations and other amenities. The room came with a safe(room key operated) where you can store your valuables/belongings. The room had a mini bar (beer, soda, water, oreo and other stuff to eat) that was refreshed once a day. The room service was great, twice a day and they are flexible too. The resort has around 6-10 different restaurants for breakfast and dinner. The dinner reservations were hassle free, you will need to dial up guest services and make a reservation. Breakfast was good, lots of options to choose from. For dining, they had mexican, latin, asian, sushi, continental, Mediterranean tapas style and much more. Apart from these there were espresso, gelato booths, lounges and beach club too. The pool was huge, well maintained and had a bar for drinks. There are shows every night to entertain the visitors. There is plenty of lounge/pool chairs near the pool and on the beaches. Although we weren't able to explore other amenities such as spa, massages, gym etc. I am sure those will be exceptional too. We will definitely stay here on our next trip to Cancun!

reviews.author: Pegah N
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun had an impressive service
reviews.text:
We were incredibly impressed with our stay at Paradisus Cancun this April. I am unaware of how good the normal service is for the all-inclusive, but we upgraded to the royal service for an extra charge which I highly recommend. 
If you are a couple/ family looking to relax at a classy and peaceful resort, Paradisus is the best option for you. However, if you are single and young, and looking to have fun and party, this resort may be a little boring because there barely was any party. 

Getting the royal service (after bargaining about the price) was worth it because we got our own butler who made reservations on behalf of us and took care of our needs, we got access to the adults pool and royal side of the beach, we got 4 free bottles of liquor, a beautiful lounge room with snacks, a renovated room, and some other great options.

Some things that I would want Paradisus to improve is the entertainment team and the night-life. There were some awesome performances such as the guy with the flying board in the pool, the dancers, or the Mexican party. However, some days there were no activities by the pool, and the nightly entertainments were not that good. I was expecting to have at least one foam party in the pool, or any sort of party in the resort. However, our only night-time party was at the red lounge which was only busy and fun for one night of our stay. Other than that, the resort became somewhat boring. Our butler was somewhat helpful, but we were expecting to get more help for reserving cabanas and becoming aware of what the nightly entertainments were. 

We were incredibly impressed with all the staff working at Paradisus. They were all kind and helpful and I will actually miss some of them a lot. They all worked so hard to provide a good time for the guests. 
Francesco working at the Red Lounge was one of the most amazing guys I have ever met. He was professional, sweet, and caring. We only went to the red lounge because of him because he provided an awesome service. Aaron at the Fuego restaurant was a professional server. He was very kind and made our trip even better with his warm conversations. He even taught us some Spanish. Elisandro who worked at the Royal pool towel service was also an amazing person. He was very helpful for providing us with chairs and Cabana reservations. We had an amazing time talking with him because he truly cared about the guests.

reviews.author: Wanderlust_Twin
reviews.title: Great hotel and amenities, wonderful service, good food, old property
reviews.text: Went to Cancun for a girls' trip and had a great time at Paradisus. Lots to do at resort: sushi and ceviche and mixology classes, salsa at the pool, lounge and club on property. Amazing gelato and Nespresso bars. Buffet had decent food and restaurants were good, best one was Fuego. Rooms are old and resort is showing signs of aging (cracks in floors, in bathtub, sinks drain slowly, etc). but staff was quick to address the issues and moved us to another tower. The staff was amazing! Especially Omar on the entertainment team. He made our stay memorable! You can tell he loves what he does and was funny and so so helpful. By the end of our stay, he had become our "go to person" even if it wasn't related to entertainment.  The nightly shows were entertaining and there was tons to do at the property. View to the beach from the property was breathtaking and there were plenty of beach chairs/umbrellas. Luis at the Nespresso bar and Eddie at the Market Grill were so so nice. Another shoutout to Omar, thanks so much for everything, Paradisus is lucky to have you!

reviews.author: Laura H
reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text: Beautiful resort, but the beach had tons of seaweed that would not be removed at night so it just kept building up. Check in and check out procedures are far too long and complicated (checking in took an hour, checking out took 40 minutes while our taxi waited impatiently outside).  The bars are good, food as well, but limited nightlife.  So many children too - more of a family resort than a place for couples to go to get away from work.

reviews.author: Travelholic0711
reviews.title: Great hotel, great service, ok food
reviews.text:
This was our 2nd time at the Paradisus. We were there a year and a half ago and had a really great time! First the pros - the hotel is great, smells really good everywhere you go, the staff is very helpful with whatever it is that you need. Our waiter Armando at the Naos Restaurant was AWESOME! He’s pretty much the only reason we kept eating the buffet everyday. He made us feel so welcome and at home. He’s the reason I’m rating a 3 instead of a 1. The thing is, the staff is awesome, the management has to make changes to the way they run things. There are resorts in cancun that have a nice theatre, plenty of restaurant choices, and very similar service, and most resorts don’t even need reservations at the restaurants. Paradisus need to step it up and make it a reasonable deal. It almost seems like if you don’t have the Royal Service, you pretty much get the leftovers!
Cons: food was bland this time around and the buffet didn’t have too many options. The steak at the market grill smelled like kerosene 3 days in a row. I was upset with the fact that the nespresso coffee station closes during the day - not all of us like to be swimming in alcohol all day long, we want our caffeine! And it is almost impossible to get a reservation at the restaurants if you haven’t purchased their “Royal Service” deal. Unless you want to eat at 6:30pm or after 9:30pm, you’re going to have to eat the buffet. The nightly shows used to be a lot better too.. there is never enough space to sit - can’t believe a hotel this size doesn’t have it’s own theater. This hotel isn’t cheap, it’s on the more expensive side actually, so even if you don’t purchase the Royal Service, you should feel Royal! I’m going to try a different resort next time.

reviews.author: harrylin2000
reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text:
Just came back from Cancun, My wife,my 3 year old daughter and I had a wonderful time in Paradusis.  Every staff member was amazing, always helpful.  
I would especially like to thank Kay. After checked in, our daughter couldn’t find her favorite toy, the Stuffed Hippo. Last time we saw it was at Cancun airport.  We were not sure when and where she lost it.  It really ruined our mood. We didn’t expect to find it but asked hotel staff for help anyway.  Everyone we asked were willing to help, especially Kay who saved the day.  With her help our daughter finally got her toy back.  
We enjoyed our stay. Thanks to the entire staff for the great experience.

reviews.author: Coni812
reviews.title: Gorgeous View! Mediocure Food
reviews.text:
Was here in April for a work conference.  The resort location was beautiful!  Pool and beach well maintained,   Lots of chairs and palapa's.  Our room was on the first floor overlooking the pool and ocean. The room itself was disappointing.  We were missing a bathroom door.. which is a little awkward when rooming with someone you work with and don't know well. But the view was so wonderful we decided not to request another room.  Our lighted mirror and coffee maker didn't work though the front desk was quick to have someone come and fix them.   

We were with a large conference and on the all inclusive.   Food was very disappointing.  I survived the week on dinner rolls and chips and guacamole (the guac was fantastic though) and some fruit.  Most of the meals were barely warm. (that scares me)  The night we had Mexican was good.  Other nights there was Thai and Italian etc.  The pool food was much better - pizza, chicken wings, chicken sandwiches.  Also many in our group raved about the Sushi restaurant.  (I don't care for Sushi so didn't go).  There were also a few other restaurants that I didn't try because of time restrictions and wanting to spend time at the pool or beach.  Feedback from coworkers were mixed, some good some bad.   The drinks are weak, I'm not much of a drinker so that really wasn't an issue for me.  The meeting venues were really nice and the resort itself seemed clean though needing some maintenance (like our bathroom door, some paint touch up etc)  All the employees were very friendly and helpful. 

We have stayed at another resort twice that was much nicer but didn't have a view.   It wasn't an all inclusive and food and drinks were much better.   I didn't pay for this stay so I've given it an average score but probably wouldn't stay here if I were paying for a vacation.  I like to eat.   But the view and ocean was unbelievably beautiful!!!

reviews.author: David S
reviews.title: Going there for 7 years running!
reviews.text: I just returned from an 11-day visit to Cancun, staying at the Paradisus Resort for the seventh year in a row.  Overall, I have been very pleased with the place, and always look forward to my yearly return there.  That being said, I must express SOME disaffection with a few things.......Firstly, the place is beginning to show its years, and is very much in need of some serious make-over work.  Not a major overhaul, but definitely things like tile repair, installation of new stronger shower heads with greater pressure, and DEFINITELY an improvement in the cuisine!  I was on the "all inclusive" plan, and found that the quality of the food was seriously lacking.  Dinner meat was chewy and lacking in taste.  Breakfast pancakes were barely warm, as were the scrambled eggs, making for not-the-greatest start to the day!  The service at the hotel was EXCELLENT, as all the personnel were helpful, friendly, and ready to assist. I must single out several people for special praise.......Marisa and Christian at the breakfast reception, Leticia and Jesus at the pool, and Mekly, the Concierge........all of whom provided friendly efficient service that was especially worth noting. The pool deck and beach area are a definite plus!  As I said, a very enjoyable experience, which I hope to repeat next year........if needed improvements are hopefully enacted!

reviews.author: mgallonp
reviews.title: Memorable vacation, superb staff.. Paradisus Cancun really is a paradise!
reviews.text: This was the first time that my family and I traveled to Mexico, and Paradisus Cancun did not disappoint! From the gorgeous hotel, professional and friendly staff, delicious food, spacious pool and the gorgeous ocean view, everything was perfect. There's a couple of people that stood out and made our vacation even more memorable: Manuel Vasquez and David Dominguez from Coco's Beach Bar were absolutely fantastic! The service was incredible and they made sure we truly had a wonderful beachside experience. Fuego restaurant was also amazing. Unfortunately there were no more open slots for the night before we were traveling and the Hostess Paola made an exception and was able to accommodate my party of 3. The waiter Cristian was so helpful and the chef Alan even came out to say hello to us and ask how the food was. Everyone was amazing and truly went above and beyond to make our stay a dream. I know 100% that when I go back to Cancun I am staying at Paradisus Hotel. Truly recommend it to everyone!!

reviews.author: Mumzo13
reviews.title: Disappointed with check in and Butler
reviews.text: Beautiful resort. Upon arriving our room was not ready. Inquired about upgrade and there was an empty room available and was guaranteed a speedy check in. We paid the difference. We got to our room just prior to 3:00 pm. (We arrived at resort at 10:30 am) not impressed with Butler. She  was stalling for several hours, Claiming it would only be 10more minutes, room almost ready -luggage is in room,,,That  did not happen - we did not get the room that was available-so check in was not til 3:00 pm and our luggage was still sitting in the lobby. (So we basically lost most of the day)  Rarely saw our Butler - not receptive to our needs.  Tapas restaurant-my husband got food poisoning from raw tuna in the salad. Their response, well nobody else got sick. All in all,  the resort was beautiful, the waiters (female and male) in the adult section and in the restaurants were absolutely fantastic which made up for our disappointment. Yes we would return to this resort.  Very relaxing,,,

reviews.author: Lcisco1
reviews.title: Girl birthday trip
reviews.text: We traveled to the Paradisus Cancun April 12th thru the 16. The hotel was was amazing, it is one of the older hotels but still very nice. When we arrived , we were taken to a private lounge where we waited for a few minutes until a nice young man came to take us to the royal concierge check in. The check in was private and really fast. We then met our butler Jesiel Bravo who took us to our room. When we went into our room it was very nice and clean. Jesiel explained everything to us regarding the royal service. We had a well stocked fridge with beer and assorted beverages. There were also snacks. We booked a lagoon side room, but when we went out on the balcony we had a beautiful view of both the ocean and lagoon side! We were very pleased! Every one at the hotel gave excellent service! Shout out to Asunción, wonderful waitress at the pool. Captain Guillermo, Chef Eleazar, Meseros Efrain, Cochinlta Pulbil all from the Mole restaurant who made us a wonderful surprise meal for our birthdays! They were great! Also Guillermo Fuego who also worked the pool. Can’t say enough about the staff in this Hotel! Food was great and our stay was relaxing. My best friend Rose and I will come back for another’s girls trip. My husband and I are thinking of coming back for Thanksgiving. Loved it!

reviews.author: fromthe6ix2018
reviews.title: Literally Paradise!
reviews.text:
This was our first time at Paradisus Cancun and it was breathtaking. My husband and I were celebrating our anniversary and the staff left chocolate covered strawberries in our room for us - so sweet!! :)
From the beautiful amenities to the food - everything was perfect. The staff were so kind and friendly and would always go above & beyond for us. Our butler - Sergio was SO helpful and amazing. Royal Service was really worth it as you get access to La Palapa (adults only restaurant) which had fresh food - Must try is their grilled shrimp - SO DELICIOUS. We loved the following A La Carte restaurants: Fuego and Bana. The sushi at Bana was amazing!! Our butler booked all of the restaurants for us so we didn't even have to worry. Shoutout to Lazaro, Melina and Raphael-who were all SO amazing and helpful. The YHI spa hydrotherapy which was included in the all-inclusive package was also amazing -perfect for rainy days! We LOVED the Nespresso Cafe and the crepes in the night. Thank you for making our stay so enjoyable and memorable. We hope to return back soon!!

reviews.author: Edya B
reviews.title: Great time in the family concierge section
reviews.text:
We just returned from our vacation at Paradisus Cancún. We had a fabulous time. The hotel is beautiful. There beach is beautiful. No rocks and white sand. There was seaweed when we were there but that is not the hotels fault. The restaurants are decent for an all inclusive.
