Our favorites were the Market Grill which is a Brazilian steakhouse and Vento which is a tapas restaurant. Both had very tasty food. There are 3 pools. The main pool which is for everyone is the largest of the 3. It has a swim up bar and music always playing. One other pool is Adults only and the last one is a kids pool. There are Bali beds for rent near all the pools that are very comfortable but pricy. 
Some negatives for us where the amount of stairs leading down to the beach. It was hard for us because we were with a toddler so carrying all the stuff and him while it was hot was kind of tough. Because of the stairs we didn’t take the stroller ever to the beach. Everywhere else  in the hotel was fine with a stroller because there were ramps. The only place we were not able to go to was Bana restaurant located in the center of the main building because it also had stairs leading to it. The other thing was the weak air conditioning. The room air conditioning worked well but the restaurants were a bit warm. 

There were plenty of bars and lounges to just hang out and get a drink. All drinks were tasty. They also served bottled water and we were able to get that anywhere in the resort upon request. There is a specialty coffee stand and a gelato/crepe stand which was pretty cool. 

The thing that impressed us most was the incredible service. Anywhere you go, anything you need is not an issue. Everyone is willing to help. Regardless who you turn to they are all ready to drop what they are doing and help. Everyone was very accommodating. Also any issues we had with the room were addressed immediately. 

We stayed at the family concierge section. At first we weren’t sure if it was worth paying extra to stay at the family concierge but now we know that it definitely was and would recommend it to anyone staying with kids. They provided amenities for the child like a book bag, slippers, robe, and a small beach kit. They also left gifts for him on some of the days. They brought milk and cookies every day. We have to mention our butlers Maria and Gloria. These 2 people made our stay so easy, so stress free and so amazing. They were in contact with us from 7am until 11pm. Anything we needed, I repeat, anything, they were able to help with. They are so nice, kind, sweet, and welcoming. We texted each other through WhatsApp and it was so easy to communicate with them. Our toddler had a problem eating when we first arrived because it wasn’t food he was used to but Maria and Gloria were very quick to help and arrange for food for him that was delivered to our room. I cannot say enough good things about the both of them. They felt like our family this past week. It was sad saying goodbye to them because they really did make our time there so easy. We stayed in room 3005 which was a ocean front junior suite and the location was very good. It was right near the main pool so we heard the life of the party all day :) 

Overall this is a good hotel and we would recommend it.

reviews.author: Jenna Grant
reviews.title: Paradisus Never Disappoints
reviews.text:
This was our second time at Paradisus, and it was just as breathtaking as the last visit.  We booked through RCI, and the hotel was more than accommodating for our party of 5.  My husband and I ended up in Tower 2 with a beach view.  The remaining guests had lagoon views (Tower 1), and those rooms seemed to be a bit more updated than ours.  I think it has to do with the Melia membership we were able to utilize through RCI.

This time around we went with Canada Transfers to get to/from the airport.  For any stay in the hotel zone, there are taxi and bus options to get around the downtown area.  There is a bus stop right in front of the resort.  We didn't venture to far from the resort, opting to hit up Aquaworld (directly across the street) for our excursions.  I highly recommend the Jungle Tour!

Karina helped us get checked in on the RCI/Melia side of the resort.  The process is quite long, usually once we get to a resort we like to get to our room ASAP and unwind.  We had to wait for our rooms to be assigned and prepared.  We were assigned a concierge, Marta, who was absolutely wonderful.  We were wiped out after travel, so we relied on her to just choose dinner reservations for us.  We opted to try a different restaurant each night.  Marta was also kind enough to offer some great discounts for our participation in the timeshare presentation.  A free massage for my sister-in-law, a free beach location Bali bed with lobster platter for my husband and I (we all were able to sit and enjoy).  

I cannot say enough about how beautiful this resort is!  The pool/beach area is amazing.  There was much more beach area available this time around, during our last visit the waves were pretty much crashing maybe a foot or two away from the resort.  The seaweed was minimal (figured it was worth a mention since it's a common conversation topic in many reviews).  The bartenders/servers work their butts off to provide exceptional service.  I cannot say enough about how friendly, attentive, and hardworking they are.  Romano, Manuel, David, Maritza... swim up bar crew, poolside grill crew, everyone at Coco's, the buffet crew, the Gelato bar/Nespresso bar crew... every single person was pleasant, happy, welcoming, and helpful.  

The all-inclusive option here made things much easier.  There wasn't a particular restaurant that stood out, they were all great.  We did notice that some of what we had at the restaurants was also served at the buffet the following day or a few days afterwards (not in a leftovers type of situation, it was all freshly prepared).  I'm sure they were just maximizing their grocery purchases.  

WiFi worked great, we didn't watch any TV so I can't really review that part.  There are daily classes you can participate in... tequila tasting, cigar rolling, ceviche making, water aerobics, non-motorized sports.  There is a night club that had different theme nights, an outside bar area that offered drinks and hookah, and a nightly show outside near the pool area.  There area various shops for souvenirs... Quicksilver gear, jewelry, pottery.  There is a "market" that has trinkets, OTC medicines, snacks and drinks, wine and limited alcohol bottles, even golf clubs and accessories for the nearby course.  Onsite there is an ATM (one that provides pesos, another that provides USD).

If you're on the fence about staying at this resort... book it and enjoy it!  You will not regret it.  I'm almost certain we'll be back soon!

reviews.author: staceydwwfc
reviews.title: Amazing Cancun Holiday
reviews.text:
We stayed in the Paradisus in November 2017 for a week.

Upon check in we enquired about the Royal Service as we had read other reviews saying it was worth it, we paid an extra $400 for this service for the week and we didn't regret it.

We arrived late evening to the hotel and were advised that it would be worth ordering room service to the room so we could relax and get an early night after a day of travelling. We took this advice and ordered some pizza and dessert to the room which arrived quickly and was delicious.

Our first day was spent out of the hotel as we had booked a trip to chichen itza and on our return we visited the Royal Service office to arrange restaurant bookings for the rest of the week and book a bali bed around the pool for a couple of days.

We ate at the mexican tapas restaurant (cannot remember the name) and weren't sure what we were meant to do as it was a tapas style set up, after a few goes we got the hang of it and this was delicious.

We also ate in the other restaurants, all of which were really good and the service amazing.

That being said we had absolutely no issues with the buffet restaurant (no reservation required) which always offered a huge selection of food for all tastes.

The drinks served to us on the beach were always good and done with a smile and a joke and we also booked a few experiences using the kiosk located within the hotel grounds (near the pool) which was cost effective and well worth a look as the venue carrying out the activities was just across the road outside the front of the hotel grounds.

I was upset that we had to leave and quite honestly I could have stayed much much longer had my budget, holiday allowance and waistline allowed for it.

Would definitely come back!!!

reviews.author: karisharman
reviews.title: Wonderful birthday week at family concierge!
reviews.text: Just at had the best birthday week at the family concierge , Josue Kumul and Alexander Garcia were our butlers they were just wonderful and so helpful and attentive, they are excellent . loved the food , swimming pool and breath taking views of the beautiful Caribbean sea . I loved the hotel and was the birthday vacation ever . I can't wait to go back !

reviews.author: momandbeaches
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort & Attentive Staff
reviews.text:
This was our first trip to Cancun. We chose this resort from recommendation from our travel agent. The resort is beautiful with many views of the ocean, pool, and beautiful landscapes. 
 We had a slight hiccup checking in with our room not ready. We were also not happy that staff was trying to sell excursions as soon as we arrived. Once we did make it to our room, we were able to relax.
 We met Gaudencio in the lobby who provided us with refreshments. He then let us know he would be at Restaurant Naos for breakfast. He was very attentive, friendly and happy to see us. We also met Martin at dinner at Naos, another great server.
 The best restaurant was Market Grill & our server Angel.  Food was hot, fresh and delicious. 
 I recommend visiting Paradisus. It was a wonderful 10 days & look forward to visiting again.

reviews.author: Lisa M
reviews.title: Paradisus Wedding Perfection
reviews.text:
My husband and I got married at Paradisus Cancun on April 29th. We had nearly 100 guests from all over the world attend and everyone really enjoyed themselves. We got upgraded to Ocean view in Royal Service and had an amazing experience!  Our room in royal service was beautiful and with breathtaking views.  Out butlers, Galdino and Sergio provided prompt, excellent service and went above and beyond to provide "royal" service, my husband and I truly felt like royalty the 10 days we stayed there! Gaudecio was one of the servers at the Naos restaurant (buffet) and my family and husband and I sat in his "section" every morning (which is the part that turns into Fuego restaurant in the evenings).  Gaudecio was very attentive, friendly, personable, energetic, and provided great service!  My aunt even got a photo with him before we left.  One of the waiters names I remember from the welcome bbq and also from the wedding who really stood out was Daniel.  He is another one who provided excellent customer service, went above and beyond, was always friendly and had a smile on his face.  Last, but certainly not least, our wedding coordinator, Melina was extremely patient and very hard working. She put up with us for many months before the wedding with constant emails, questions, etc and she never once complained or had an attitude. Planning a destination is very stressful and she helped take off some of the burden the planning.  Everything on the wedding day turned out perfectly. The menu, decorations, linens, flowers, etc. were just as I had imagined them, thanks to Melina.  She is always busy and definitely has her work cut out for her but she manages to take care of even the small details and help give couples their dream wedding. She was always able to stay calm and was a joy to work with. 
We enjoyed all of the restaurants. We had my dad's birthday dinner at Mole and we had a private room in the back with a breathtaking view and the service was great! The duck at Mole was perfection and I would highly recommend it.  The buffet offers everything you could possibly want. My husband's favorite restaurant was Fuego and, if we had more time we would have gone back there. My husband was not impressed with the sushi at bana but I did not get to try it, and everyone else seemed to like it.  
The staff at Avenue Bar were very accommodating, fun, and provided great service! I was not as impressed with the staff at Coco's Beach Club unfortunately.  
 There is also a little coffee shop outside of blue agave restaurant near the lobby (facing the ocean) and I can't remember the name of the server there but he was also exceptionally friendly.  It's the little things like this that really make your experience stand out.  
Only negative I have to say is we had several issues with our safe in the room getting stuck and had to have maintenance come on 2 separate occasions to open it (and my husband had to wait in the room for over an hour each time).  Also, just a few of the guests rooms were less than desirable (cracked tub, sink, and door). These repairs need to be made before allowing guests to stay in these rooms. Those who had issues changed their rooms and the new rooms were fine, but of course it is a hassle to have to switch rooms on vacation. Also, our check in service was very smooth (since we were staying in royal service), but that was not the case for everyone as many people had to wait a lengthy amount of time before they could check into their rooms. 
The hotel is about 15-20 minutes from the airport, which to us was a huge selling point for having a destination wedding and getting our guests there.  We have stayed in Riviera Maya before and the drive after getting off of a long flight is exhausting.  The beaches at Paradisus are spacious and felt private, even though it is a public beach and the pools/pool areas were not too crowded. We were very happy with our stay here and will definitely be going back at some point.

reviews.author: Taylor B
reviews.title: Excellent Resort for Couples or Families
reviews.text: My husband and I just visited Paradisus for our honeymoon and it was the perfect spot! The beach is unbelievably beautiful! Crystal blue water, white sand...paradise! The pools are fantastic. There are several, so tons of space to spread out, drink, tan, relax, and still have a little privacy! I would definitely recommend reserving a Bala Bed at the pool. The hotel staff does all reservations for you...just ask!  What I was most impressed with though, was the amazing service we got literally everywhere. The bartenders, the servers, the hotel staff...they are all tremendous!

reviews.author: Jo Pina
reviews.title: Beautiful beach, good resort, good/great service
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed at Paradisus this past weekend. We had a bumpy start to our vacation because of circumstances out of our control, and I must admit that the resort reservations staff did everything they could do to ease our frustration. I would like to recognize Mario the reservations manager who expressed sincere empathy and dedicated time and energy into resolving our problem. He was incredibly patient, concerned, and diligent. Travel tip to anyone who books "Royal Service". Make sure to call the resort to confirm that the reservation is in fact for "Royal Service". Your travel agency may charge you for "Royal Service" but only book a basic room for you. No Bueno. After we were accommodate by Mario (he even made dinner reservations for us...God bless him), we headed to the beach. The beach is excellent! Beautiful and clean. Exactly what we were looking for. You will not be disappointed. The rooms were clean and decent--and they even have bidets! Lastly, the service was good/great. I had great service from Victor at the Palapa restaurant and Rafael. These two gentlemen really demonstrate a desire to make your experience unforgettable. They were friendly, made eye contact, and had a genuine smile to give every time we asked for assistance. These two individuals provided exceptional service and should be recognized. Lastly, if you're interested in a spa treatment, try the chocolate wrap. Veronica was an excellent massuse with strong hands! Overall, very pleased with our experience. Will most likely return.

reviews.author: Ken M
reviews.title: Wonderful Vacation - Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: My Fiancee and myself visited Paradisus Cancun April 24 - May 08 2017. We arrived early in the morning of April 24 and were advised that our room wasn't quite ready which we expected as we arrived quite early. We upgraded our room to Oceanfront and the front desk staff asked if we were celebrating anything special. We advised them that we were celebrating our 15th Anniversary but didn't ask for any fuss from the hotel. When we were taken to our room we were very surprised to see the entire hotel room decorated with rose petals and a bottle of champagne as well as a plate full of sweets and snacks. The resort is truly beautiful and the staff work constantly to keep the entire resort spotlessly clean. Our accommodations were awesome. The restaurants, food, beach and the entire resort were truly 5 Star. We have traveled to Cancun many times over the last few years and have stayed at resorts rated higher than Paradisus but I must say that Paradisus Cancun truly exceeded our expectations and we will definitely be back soon and will definitely recommend this resort to all our friends and family. There are a few staff members that deserve to be recognized - Breakfast waiters Orlando, Alberto Rest.Naos, Carlos and Gaudencio were truly amazing. Sergio Mesero that served drinks by the pool was also wonderful. The house cleaning staff were amazing, our room was cleaned at least twice per day and always asked if we needed anything. My only minor complaint was that we found it difficult to exchange large U.S. Currency into Pesos. We are from Canada and usually travel with U.S. funds and the front desk staff seemed to find it annoying to change U.S. One Hundred dollar bills into Mexican Pesos. If you choose to vacation at this resort you will truly not be disappointed. Thank you Paradisus Cancun for a truly memorable vacation. See you soon...

reviews.author: paulina761
reviews.title: Amazing Cancun Experience with Paradisus
reviews.text: This was my first all-inclusive experience and I have no complaints. The staff, food, service and hospitably were amazing and went beyond expectations. Daniel, Jorge, Denger, Omar and all staff were super polite, accommodating and made our stay memorable.

reviews.author: DanielZl
reviews.title: Good hotel, all inclusive
reviews.text:
The hotel was very good, good service, lot's of varieties of restaurants and food, all inclusive. Ac couple of pools with amazing view, private beach, the rooms were very good as well.
The hotel is a bit old but you don't feel it since the decoration and everything is great.

reviews.author: RichCBostonMa_
reviews.title: Really Nice BUT...
reviews.text:
We haven't been to Cancun in a while and decided to stay for 2 days before leaving for other destinations. We were greeted promptly and escorted to our checkin location. After a short checkin process, we were taken to our room which I immediately didn't like. We asked if we could change to another room and were told nothing was available until the following day. We agreed that we would change then, but were overruled by the room supervisor and so we stayed in the same room. It was clean and very nice, but the slider didn't close completely and the noise from the wind kept us awake, as did the constant heat and humidity coming into the room. The room was also in need of some maintenance, and I know Melia can do better. 

The Royal Service Beach was nice, and we enjoyed a quiet day to relax. The service there could have been better.  We ordered drinks and watched as the wait staff passed by several times saying, "Sorry, one minute." after 30 minutes I went to the bar and got them myself.  The Palapa restaurant was good for breakfast but better choices are available. 

The Royal Service building is really beautiful and very clean and quiet with some really nice accompaniments. The restaurants are excellent, and we really enjoyed Vento. Great food and service.

We had a nice couple of days here, and we are loyal Melia customers and know they can do better. It's a series of little things that get this place. 

A quick word to the wise. If your planning a quiet getaway stay in Royal Service. As we observed in the lobby, there are many "Young adults" looking to take advantage of the all inclusive beverages and were loud without them..

reviews.author: RebeccaF
reviews.title: A Wow!   Service, interior, food, restaurants, timeous
reviews.text:
Service, interior, food, restaurants, timeous. The location and access to the beach is too good to be true. Shuttles and busses to the markets and shops as well as accurate and quick trip bookings by the hotel staff. 
Room changed due to inconvenient details and most of all lovely food and facilities.

Its on my wish list and I have wanted to go back ever since, I went for work and then again for a holiday and both ties just relaxing and exceptional.

reviews.author: Paula R
reviews.title: A Wonderful Resort Experience
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun from May 8 to May 17, 2017. Our previous Melia vacations were in Cozumel and Punta Cana, DR.  In neither of the first two did we feel a need for Royal Service. However, we were a little trepidatious about Cancun, because it is such an enormous place.  We opted for the Royal Service services only, not a Royal Service room (which are in tower 5). Our room was very nice.

First of all, our trepidations were completely unfounded. This resort is so beautifully and thoughtfully designed, that there are plenty of spaces and plenty of space for every type of guest to feel comfortable. We were glad to have Royal Service, however:  the adults only pool, adults only beach area, the La Palapa (the Royal Service restaurant, the only one on the beach, and one of the two best), and the Royal Service lobby/lounge, a beautiful, quiet space with bar and gourmet snacks.

We tried all the pools, all the bars, and all the restaurants (except the Tempo). We wandered all over the place.  Everywhere we went the staff were exceptional!  We thought the best two restaurants were La Palapa and Mole. Our second visit to Mole, last night of our stay, the staff recognized us as foodies, and Victor, the chef, came to our table and created for us a special treat for dessert!  Everyone at Mole was wonderful!

Now to our other favorite parts.  Melina, the concierge for Royal Service, helped me understand what a concierge is, from my first phone call, to making our reservation, to checkout. She was a jewel and a lovely person.  As was our butler, Rosanna.  I was worried about someone hovering around me, and never thought I could appreciate a butler.  But Rosanna found exactly the right level of service to offer.  She checked in several times a day, found us wherever we were, and asked how it was going and what else we might need.  The few housekeeping things we needed were fixed immediately.  We thought $100 extra for her was not too much!

We received excellent and friendly service from many servers at the La Palapa, the pool, the beach, and the RS lobby/lounge.  Josue was a real pleasure, as was Moises, Rafael, Cesar, Eddie, Jorge, Eulyses, and Valeria (the only female server).  Omar the pool concierge was also very cool. There were others too, and we hope they know we appreciate them.

One note on tipping:  we think exceptional service deserves it.  And it may or may not have helped encourage friendly service—but we think being friendly, respectful, and appreciative toward the staff probably helped too!

Overall, a five star resort!  Bruce Elliot and Paula Ramsey had a wonderful time there!

reviews.author: Liz H
reviews.title: Very relaxing vacation
reviews.text: This was our first time staying at an all inclusive resort and first time in Cancun. Typically when we travel we stay in basic accommodations and like to explore but this trip we just wanted to relax, which is exactly what we did at Paradisus Cancun. This is going to be a long review because we had such a great time so bear with me. I'll start with the most important part of this resort, the staff. We spent most of our time lounging on the beach but we also took advantage of the different activities they have daily. My husband and I both took morning classes at the gym with Martín. His classes are awesome and I would recommend taking them to anyone staying here. He's very friendly and motivating - Gracias Martin! I told my husband we need a Martín in our lives everyday. I'd have a 6 pack by now if that was the case. I don't think we've ever eaten or drank as much in our lives as we did here so it was good to start the day sweating. I took a Zumba class with Daniel and Andrea and they were both very fun and engaging.  Even though I was the only one in the class I had a good time. We took a guacamole making lesson with Andrea and Leticia and a ceviche making lesson with Andrea and Virdiana which were both great. Andrea's always smiling and making conversation and very pleasant, so if you're reading this, gracias Andrea! We took a tango class which was also very fun. Can't remember the instructor's names but they were very patient with us and by the end of class I think we had the basic tango steps down...or maybe they were just being nice not sure haha. We were the only ones in the tango class too. Not sure if people coming to this resort don't know about all the classes, or if they'd just rather not take them but it was fun learning new things for us. All of the restaurants we went to were very good (favorites were Mole and Vento) and the waiters were excellent. The friendliest ones were Alberto from Market Grill, Francisco from Blue Agave, Carlos from Vento, and a waiter at Mole but we can't remember his name, maybe Leonardo? Our check in was fine, the only issue was that we booked a room with a king bed and got a room with 2 full beds but that was the only minor issue we had the whole vacation. The beach in front of the resort is beautiful and there are plenty of beach chairs and umbrellas. We never had an issue finding a spot no matter what time of day we went. There are a couple of different pool areas and a few different bars which were all very nice but we definitely are more beach people than pool people. The rooms are spacious and clean. We booked an ocean view room which was well worth it. Very nice view and overall a wonderful trip. I don't know if we will do this type of vacation again, but if we do I would definitely book here. Thanks for a wonderful stay :)

reviews.author: Tamila A
reviews.title: Paradise in Paradisus
reviews.text:
We just came back from our two weeks vacation and this is our third time at the Paradisus....I cannot say I Like this place I LOVE EVERYTHING about this resort! 
Modern, clean, cozy and has everything you need to take a break from everyday life.
Amazing beach, cleaned everyday...color of the sea is just like painting of real paradise! 
But what is the most important is the STAFF...hard workers, everyone makes you feel SPECIAL! I couldn't believe that some of them recognize us from the trip 6 month ago, this really makes you feel super Special! Love love our tickle guy Roberto from Bana sushi restaurant, I couldn't believe he remember my son and always always gave him so much attention and care...love was in the air...I love sushi and even without reservation they were able to fit us in...OMG food from Vento is a high level restaurant food...I am craving for it and I wish to have Vento next to us here in Colorado. DELICIOUS FOOD! Big recommendation for everyone to have a dinner over there and Big Kuddos to a chief! Armalio was our waiter and we cannot wish for anyone better than him....another word for the buffet Noas - it has everything and for everyone's taste...I seriously love this place and All our waiters, Christian Lovera and many many others...Good Job!!! I am so thankful to all of you and I really want us tourist to respect your hard work and everything you do to us to feel special even if it is only 1 day or 2 weeks..
Rooms are always clean! Fridge is full! Beds are comfortable! Staff is AMAZING! Sea is a DREAM! 
I am not looking to any other places anymore because my Paradisus have everything for me and my family. Thank you!

reviews.author: Neo R
reviews.title: Fabulous and Outstanding
reviews.text:
A true Five Star resort in Cancun. Out of all the Melia resorts I've stayed, it's another great establishment of Melia. I will try to cover all the aspects in a step by step manner. 

Airport and Transfer:
Cancun airport could be Chaotic and be ready to pay USD90 tax if you have more than allowances. And yes, there is a duty free store upon arrival before customs. Transfer to the hotel was fast and pleasant. BD Travel is the one who usually takes care of it and it's a quick 20-30min ride. 

Checking in:
Upon exiting vehicle, concierge took over our baggage and arrived us to deliver it to our room. Upon entering reception, we were greeted by a lady who offered us Beverages and fresh towel. Which was a great thing to have. Darisnel made checking in smooth and fast. A very polite and friendly man. He even assured our room change for next day as requested. Another great person  is Norma, answered all our questions with a very big smile. 

Room:
Nice spacious room with ocean view balcony. Great views of ocean and pool. It is amazing till sun comes up all the way and gives you a brain melting sensation :) I would definitely take ocean view room if I go in Winter. Balcony has 2 lounge/pool style chair that can turn into a bed. Very comfortable. 

Fridge stocked with snacks, soft drinks & beers. Nice big flat screen tv and various channels. Very spacious washroom with sliding door lockable toilet. Nice big closet with safety deposit box. 

Food:
Naos - Biggest restaurant and buffet. Despite people's nagging comments, I would say 5 out of 5. Wide selections of food an desert. They have indoor seating as well outdoor pool side. You could never go wrong with this restaurant. Great and polite waiter and hostess. My favorite waiter was Martin. A very hard working little man with a pace of a marathon runner. He took care of us every time we went there. Martin should be the employee of the Year. 

Mole - More of a Dinner & Date restaurant. Great atmosphere and great food. Decent selection of wine and imported beer. 

Market Grill - Meat lovers den :) wide varieties of meat to try from. Waiter would show up with meat at your table and you take as per your desire. They do have grilled vegetables as well. Very good food. Reservation required. It is at the back of Naos restaurant. 

Enso - Now this a restaurant of you want to take your partner for a date in a quiet restaurant by ocean. Nicely tucked away from the main building and at the end of the pool. Very nice and quiet place with nice music. Very good selection of food including Asian. Outstanding service by the waiter. You do need a day before booking to reserve your table. 

Blue Agave - One of my favorite restaurant for traditional Mexican food and drinks. Loved their Tacos and great team of workers but UNFORTUNATELY could never finish the food due to extreme heat inside. At the time of my visit, I believe only 3 out of 7 air conditioner was working. PARADISUS management, please fix or replace your air conditioning units!!! You don't need a reservation for this restaurant. 

Entertainment:
This resort is fully stuffed with entertainment and fun. Lots of pool side day activities, jet sports and fun. Nightly entertainment and a small club. 

Tours and Activities:
Chichen Itza, Snorkeling, Isla Mujeres, Playa Del Carmen, Tulum..... Book your tours from Visitor Center across the Plaza Isla. 30%-50% off compared to BD travel or any other travel agency operates out of the hotel. To get to Plaza Isla, take local bus from the entrance of the Resort for 10.50Pesos (1USD) and bus driver will drop you off right in front of the Visitors Center. Yes it is very safe to take the bus and no there are no Mexican cartel in that area :). 

Club Membership:
Not everyone's cup of tea but beneficial for big families. Lot of people likes it but not my cup of tea. I was offered by Carlos (a very nice man) to take the tour and it was with Gina who was okay. It's an experience and I would've probably purchased it if the Sales manager/Club Membership manger wasn't very persistent on Vegas Style speech and spills. 

Overall..... it's a great resort with great food and entertainment. Spotless clean. There is something happening for everyone to cater individuals needs. Didn't really ventured night life but was informed it's closed by. 

Will definitely recommend this resort and will definitely visit again.

reviews.author: Cara H
reviews.title: Royal Service..... the only way to go!
reviews.text:
Omg, where do I even begin? This trip was much needed..... Last year my husband was diagnosed with stage 4 lung cancer with brain mets. Our family never dreamed that we'd ever get to spend this special time together. But we were blessed. 

Paradisus Cancun was perfect!!! 💗☀️🌴
From the moment we arrived we were treated like royalty. 
We checked into the Royal guest lounge where we were greeted by Roberto and a drink!🍸🍷🍺Roberto was polite, kind and friendly. He answered questions we had, explained the "perks" that were available to us as royal guests(18+) and took us on a tour around the beautiful grounds. The entire resort was pristine! Roberto was very knowledgeable and had a smile on his face the whole time. Our last night there, Roberto decorated our room with rose petals and left goodbye notes on our beds. It was very touching, and even made me cry. Thank you Roberto, you'll make a wonderful Butler! 😊
Our Butler was Rode. Rode was extremely pleasant and did his job well. Rode showed us to our room. He made sure our room was what we wanted and checked on us frequently. He gave us his cell phone # to text him at ANYTIME we needed anything, had any questions or concerns, even on his day off! Rode even took care of all of our dinner reservations too. Our daughter is a Spanish minor in college and Rode conversed with her whenever he was around which I found pretty cool 😊 Thank you Rode! 
The pool area was perfect. On the "Royal" side there are Cabanas everywhere! (and no kids) I highly recommend reserving one. (Your Butler can do this as well) It makes it nice to be able to get out of Mexico's hot sun and relax or even nap if you want to. All while being right there to enjoy the ocean breeze and beautiful view. 
Omar and Carlos were our pool concierge. 
Omar was helpful, pleasant and funny! He constantly came around and made us laugh. Thank you Omar😊
Carlos was like a breath of fresh air! He frequently came over to check on us and ALWAYS had a wonderful smile on his face 😊
Carlos even went out of his way for me one day and got me a bottle of aloe when i got sunburned. I highly recommend using sunscreen!! (We used SPF 50), and we still got sunburned. That Mexico sun is HOT☀️
The morning we were leaving, Carlos made sure he found us to come and give us hugs and say good bye. Thank you Carlos for making our trip special 😊

The restaurants were amazing! We ate at LaPalapa, Molè, Vento, Naõs, Sunset Grill and Blue Agavè, but Our favorite was the Market Grill. It is a Brazilian steakhouse. If you like meat, I highly recommend you try it! All of the wait staff there were friendly and efficient. They even remembered our favorite drinks and brought them to us when we were seated (since we ate there a few nights). There were a few other restaurants that we didn't get a chance to dine at. 

LaPalapa was a restaurant exclusively for royal guests. We had breakfast and lunch here many times. It was situated outside right on the ocean. The view was exceptional!! And so was the food 😊
Paradisus was a phenomenal family vacation. We made many memories there that will stay with us for the rest of our lives. I pray we get the opportunity to return again one day 💗☀️🌴

reviews.author: Paige M
reviews.title: Perfect vacation
reviews.text:
Everything about this resort was wonderful ! Went for 4 days and wish we went for longer. 

The hotel is just stunning ! They take amazing care of the property, workers are always cleaning the grounds and service was very fast. 

We had a lagoon view and it was so beautiful, our room was always clean and always stocked. Beds were comfortable. Our room seemed slightly warm and a/c wouldn't go down past 65. 

The beach was very clean, life guards are always out watching. It wasn't too busy so we always had a spot to sit under an umbrella, but people do go early and reserve spots. 

Food was amazing ! We ate at 2 a la cartes: Bana (which should be #1 on everyones list of to do's) and wow this place was delicious !!! And Vento which we weren't the biggest fans of only because we didn't realize the style of meals were to get multiple small orders and share the portions. Buffet was so great ! In our group there were 2 vegans and a vegetarian and we were all very well fed, options for everyone ! 

Short ride to airport as well, around 15-20 minutes. 

Highly recommend and will be returning in the future !

reviews.author: Momspeed12
reviews.title: LOVED it... cant wait to return!
reviews.text:
My husband and I traveled with our 5 year old daughter.  Honestly.... the vacation was awesome!  From the moment we checked in to the moment we left, my worries were gone.  We had a FEW hiccups with our family concierge, and a few hiccups with our dinner reservations, but at the en of the day, everything was taken care of beautifully. 

Overall, the food at this resort was AMAZING!!  Although breakfast was "mundane", it was good and for lunch and dinner, we never had a meal that wasn't WAY above our expectations!

Our family concierge "Alexander", was really really amazing.  He must've had a tracker on us as he could always find us to check how we were doing. My daughter was thrilled with his "treats" for her and even 2 months later, is asking when we can  go back to Cancun to see Alexander.  Additionally, the kids club was very responsive and entertaining for our daughter.  She has NEVER been willing to stay in a club, but asked to go play several times.

We so enjoyed our planned stay that we extended our vacation for an extra 2 days.  For this extension, Alexander made arrangements for us to be upgraded to an AMAZING room with double balcony and GORGEOUS ocean view.  I can't thank him enough!.  And even though we hadn't paid to extend the "concierge", Alexander continued to monitor our needs and made sure our daughter was cared for.  For our final night, we returned from dinner to find Chocolate covered strawberries and rose petals strewn across the bed.  (nice thought..... but hello child in room)

Ocean water was extremely rough for the entire stay but there are plenty of pools to keep anyone occupied.

Hotel itself is beautiful.  It was so peaceful to have all the greenery and running water inside.  We didn't get to use the spa, as it was out of order for a few days.  But it didn't dampen my experience.  

LOVED it... Would love to go back today!

reviews.author: springmissy
reviews.title: Wonderful!
reviews.text:
Let me preface my review with the fact that we are Melia Vacation Club Members and have many benefits not available to standard hotel room occupants.  As members, we have a concierge, a butler, free use of the gym facilities and various discounts.
Prior to arrival, we asked our concierge to note we wanted an ocean view room.  I had specifically reserved a studio in hopes that there would be more studios with an ocean view than the size room which we originally bought.  That worked; we were given an ocean view room (although not guaranteed prior to arrival) and avoided an argument at check in over room assignment.  
Our concierge also put us in touch with Otiem for hotel transports.  Service was prompt; the vehicle was clean.  Also, our transport was private; we didn’t have to stop at other resorts or be packed into a van.
From check in to check out, our time at the Paradisus was near perfect.  The room, while maybe a bit small, was clean and well decorated.  With a few minor exceptions:  there are very few electrical outlets and the sleeper sofa is poorly designed – my husband and I each cracked a toe on it, the bathroom outlet tripped regularly and was difficult to reset and the hot water was not on when we arrived.  The fixable items were taken care of the next day.  The ac wasn’t as cold as we would have liked but it was comfortable, even while sleeping.  There was a one-speed (high) fan in the room which we couldn’t leave on all night as it rattled a bit.  But when we returned from the pool, it was nice to have running to move the air in the room. (Okay, so the power was out one day; but no matter what hotel you were at on that day, the power was out – that was definitely not within the hotel’s control).
With a lot of open air space, air conditioning in the hotel literally runs from comfortable to hot.  Our room was never “cold” but comfortable.  There was a one-speed (high) fan in the room which we couldn’t leave on all night as it rattled a bit.  But when we returned from the pool, it was nice to have running to move the air in the room.  
The view of the beautiful blue ocean, as you walk out the doors at the center of the hotel, onto the patio area, will take your breath away.  Every time I visit, I am awestruck at the beauty!
Breakfast at Nao restaurant was always delicious.  Service was cheerful and, usually, our coffee and water were monitored by the wait staff.  There were a tremendous number of breakfast items from which to choose:  Mexican fare, omelet / egg station, fresh fruits, cereals, breads and pastries, cheeses, etc.  With the vast selection, it would be hard to walk away hungry.
We also ate at Nao two evening.  (Sometimes a full restaurant meal would have been too much).  Don’t know if there is an upcharge but I heard that Wednesday evenings feature seafood, including lobster tails.  Tuesday was Mexican night.  We were happy to enjoy soup and salad with a large dessert selection on our two visits.  
For the reservation only restaurants, I wonder if the chefs are trying to outperform each other for wildest creations.  They were good in their own way; but in reading the menu, we opted for the most “normal” sounding items.  We ate at Fuego and Mole and were treated to one wine paring dinner at Tempo.  At Mole, a family came in with a very cranky infant.  Definitely ruined the evening.  Please, I don’t pay to dine out and listen to your child scream.
Tempo is a very upscale restaurant in the hotel.  The chef (can’t remember or say the name) is a 6 star Michelin chef.  While I couldn’t tell you what we were served, I can say that the food was delicious.  Since this is not part of the all-inclusive, a visit to this restaurant will cost you big dollars (@ $200 US per person).  The restaurant is very quiet and romantic, featuring a pianist and the best service in all of Cancun.  If you think you would like to enjoy Tempo’s offerings, be sure to pack “nice” clothes – slacks and collared shirt for men and a dress for women.  I think we will splurge on this one when we return to Paradisus Cancun.
The hotel and grounds are beautiful.  There are several pools: one pool is vast, running from a shallow “kiddie” area (near Tower 1) to a deep, large area (near Tower 2).  The water temperature was comfortable.  The pool bar is in the large pool.  The other pool is split with Royal Service (Tower 4) and a more quiet pool area (Tower 3).  Pool seating was often all “reserved” by 9 am.  I know, the hotel discourages reserving chairs; but it happens.  One afternoon, I did see a server removing towels from unoccupied chairs.  Most likely, the server knew the occupants had left for the day.  Most days, we treated ourselves to a Bali bed (Members have privileges, including reduced rates).  These beds were made up daily with fresh covers on the mattress and pillows.  Did I mention NO TOWEL CARDS?!
Pool service was excellent.  The three ladies (names not known) were the best.  We were never out of water or drinks.  While we could get our own snacks at the poolside grill, the servers offered and brought to us plates of chips with queso and salsa.  Hamburgers, hot dogs, pizza and various other items were also available at the grill.
In all, thank you to the Vacation staff and pool servers for their attention to making our trip wonderful.  Our concierge, Louis, helped pre-arrival and made our reservations for dinners.  Our butler, Jorge / Georgie, was so pleasant and fun.  He took care of the details and showered us with a couple of surprise gifts. The three ladies who provided pool-side service were wonderful.  They kept us from getting thirsty!  It was fun to interact with all of them as we like to learn about them and the culture.  Thank you, thank you!
While gratuities are included in the all-inclusive, we did tip the servers.  A few dollars for good service went a long way to ensure continued good service.  Tipping was our choice.
In all, this trip was wonderful.  What could go wrong with sun, sand and a drink in my hand?

reviews.author: 792merlins
reviews.title: Had the greatest time and great value!
reviews.text: We signed up for the Royal treatment and that is exactly what we got!  Loved the all-inclusive package.  It was nice to not have to carry wallet around to pay for meal, drinks and other incidentals.  We made sure to tip all of the outstanding employees who did everything they could to make our trip better.  This is definitely a resort I will return to in the future!

reviews.author: ca2556
reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text: It was okay wouldn't recommend not that it was bad it's just that I've been treated better at other hotels.one day the electricity went  out and no ac that day so that sucked didn't get the room I had asked for so we had to change rooms three times !!! Smh!

reviews.author: Sean C
reviews.title: The beach is unreal
reviews.text:
I went here as a couple in the beginning of May for 5 days. The forecast was supposed to be thunderstorms for most of the week but fortunately it doesn't seem like the rain lasts long here. We got plenty of sunshine and sunburn.

========
  Landing
========

As soon as we landed in the airport, we got approached by some sort of travel agent that wanted to sell us excursions. We originally thought they were giving us directions until 20 minutes later when they were recommending alternate hotels and adventures that we were supposed to pay for on the spot. Having booked the trip through Expedia, I had already gotten emails about the various excursions that were available but we decided not to book anything ahead of time in order to be flexible. The last thing we wanted was to book a trip and not be in the mood for adventure. 

==========
  Excursions 
==========

We ended up booking a package adventure through Aventuras Mayas to visit the ruins of Tulum, snorkel in a cenote (cave), and lastly ride ATVs in the jungle. 

Tulum was pretty interesting. The Tulum tour of the ruins lasted about 45 minutes to an hour. Twenty minutes or so was guided by our group leader Julio Cesar. He was very knowledgeable about the history of the ruins and had a good sense of humor. After the guided part of the tour, you get the rest of the time to explore yourself around the ruins to take pictures. You could even go to the beach. There was a bit of seaweed so we just watched people from afar. They have lots of little shops where you can buy souvenirs and tequila for pretty cheap. It was pretty hot out that day but luckily Aventuras Mayas provided water bottles and umbrellas. I don't know what we would have done without that umbrella as we were already sunburned.

Next stop of the excursion was the cenote (cave). There are many different cenotes around Cancun but our particular one was underground. The water was freezing cold. And not in the way where the water is cold once you get in, but you get used to it after a little. I almost gave up on this part of the excursion as soon as I got in the water and it took a while to get used to the water even after being in it. Seeing the insides of the cave was pretty cool though and I wish I had a waterproof case for my phone to take pictures like some of our group members. They had some for sale at the location before we got in (2 for $20 if I remember correctly) but I forgot my wallet so I recommend you get your waterproof case and wallet before going there. There weren't many fish in the cave but the guides did give you history of the cenotes and teach you about stalactites and stalagmites. After the snorkeling, we had lunch which was pretty good.

After lunch we went to go to the ATV's. Riding the ATV's in the jungle lasted longer than I expected. It was the best part of the excursion in my opinion. The ride was about 30-45 minutes. When booking the excursion, you get a choice of getting 1 ATV per person, or you can double up on 1 ATV. My girlfriend was worried about riding one by herself since she had never ridden one before but after it was all said and done, she's glad she we both rode single. It was a great time for both of us. Before you actually ride, they try to upsell you on buying insurance in case you crash or ruin the ATV. Since I forgot my wallet, I obviously didn't buy it. After going on the ride, I realized it's not necessary if you're not trying to do crazy tricks or drive reckless.

Ricardo was our main driver from the hotel and was nice the whole time. Thanks for saving my life in that cenote. Also shoutout to Miguel who was also great and guided us part of the time. On the way back they drop everyone off at their respective hotels. The excursion lasted about the whole day (7am - 4pm). Ricardo was nice enough to wait for me to get my wallet from the hotel room, even after we realized we lost the hotel key at some point during the trip. The hotel lobby replaced the key with no hassle.

======
  Hotel
======

The hotel was beautiful inside and out. From green vines hanging from the ceiling in the center of the hotel to our balcony ocean view. There is an option to get Royal Service which is the adults only part of the hotel. After reading some of the reviews before we went, we wanted to try and upgrade to the Royal Service when we go there since there weren't any available Royal Service rooms available online when we booked. We just knew we had to get an ocean view room so we booked the regular King Size Ocean View. Pro-tip: Don't waste your money on a Royal Service room. They are similar to the regular rooms but you get access to the spa and adults only section of the resort which includes its own restaurant and pool. When we tried to upgrade to the Royal Service, they had no rooms open at the time, but instead of paying $700 more dollars each for a Royal Service room, we got to buy a Royal Service wristband which gave us access to everything and still got to keep our ocean view room in building 3 which is in the middle of everything. I HIGHLY recommend this if you really want to get Royal Service. The spa was nice, although a lot of the water functions in the hydrotherapy pool were broken. The spa also included a sauna, steam room, and shower. The adults only section overall seemed pretty boring and the pool did not include a swim-up bar like the main pool in the general area had. It was generally quiet so if you're into that sort of thing, go for it by all means.

Since it was supposed to rain (although it didn't rain very much), the main pool area lacked entertainment during the day. One of the staff mentioned because it was cloudy and looked like rain, they didn't want to bring the equipment out. I brought a Jambox BIG, and I noticed a few other people brought their own portable speaker to have by the pool so I'm glad I brought that. We got to see entertainment during the day a couple days of our stay. One of which were Brazilian dancers dancing Samba and martial artists performing Capoeira. They were really good. The pool and all the outside things closed at 12 midnight which was surprising. Other resorts I've been to, I've hung out in the jacuzzi late at night. There are jacuzzi sections in the pool at Paradisus but they do not get warm. They only hold room temperature water.

The ocean/beach was something out of a movie. The white sands and blue water were definitely something I wasn't used to seeing. It doesn't make sense to stay here without getting an ocean view room.

======
  Food
======

There are many restaurants on the resort, a lot of which require a reservation before hand. All of them are free with the exception of one which we did not attend. The food at the various restaurants were pretty good so pick a cuisine you like and I don't think you can go wrong. If reservations aren't your sort of thing, you can go to the buffet which is open every day. It also has pretty good breakfast/lunch/dinner.

You can also get food delivered via room service for free at any time. They have a menu in the room.

=======
  Drinks
=======

Obviously this is an important section since the resort is All-Inclusive. You can get drinks from any of the staff walking around the pool areas. The restaurants all serve drinks. The thing I was surprised about was I couldn't get drinks delivered via room service. You can get about anything else from food to first aid. They stock beer in the little refrigerator in the room but since I don't drink beer, it was necessary to get a bottle from the gift shop in the hotel for late nights when you're hanging out on the balcony. Crazy enough it was about 12USD for a bottle. I think we paid more for the shot glasses in there. I'm not sure if Royal Service provides liquor in the refrigerator but the non Royal Service rooms do not.

========
  Nightlife
========
There is a club (Red Lounge) in the hotel. It was pretty mediocre compared to clubs here in NY but I didn't expect much from a hotel club. We ended up going here at least for a little about 3 or 4 nights out of our stay. The DJ seemed to play the same playlist every night. Shout out to the bartender Christian AKA Gato who always was keeping the party going. I think the bachelorettes were a fan.

On the Saturday night of our stay we went to Coco Bongo which is a club/disco downtown. They provide transportation from the hotel, but you'll have to get your own cab back. They make it seem like all transportation is included when you buy the wristband but it is not. It was 80 USD so it seemed a bit pricey and I was hardly in the mood at the time. After going though, the show was well worth it. 80USD covers the open bar which was hard to get to (try not to go on a Friday/Saturday), and was supposed to get us in the VIP line although we still found ourselves waiting for 20-30 minutes outside. There was also a Canelo fight that night so downtown was packed. But as I mentioned before, the show was well worth it. It had a Broadway/Cirque Du Soleil/Comedy Show vibe and later in the night (like 2am-3am), it turns into a club. The show itself was worth the 80 bucks though, even without the drinks. They apparently have one in Vegas and other islands (Punta Cana maybe?), but this one is supposed to be the best. I was definitely impressed and glad I went.

There are other clubs around the same area as Coco Bongo for the people who don't want to pay 80USD. One of the clubs they mentioned was 30USD for open bar but we didn't go anywhere else downtown besides Coco Bongo.

Overall I would definitely stay at this exact hotel again.

reviews.author: Bessie M
reviews.title: If u want activities and variety of restratuants this is not the place.
reviews.text: Would not stay here again. Front desk staff not friendly. Did nothing to accommodate for room mix up. Maids never left enough wash clothes or towels. Not enough space for most guest to attend shows had to sit on steps outside.

reviews.author: roro2102
reviews.title: Please do not stay anywhere else... Paradisus is the best!
reviews.text:
One of the best resorts with amazing staff and brilliant food! I went there with 5 other friends and I can say it is one of the most amazing holiday I ever had. As a vegetarian i didn't struggle with the food, there were always so many options. Additionally, the dive centre inside and across the road makes this deal more sweet. We booked Junior Suite with the adults only section and it was really good.

I hope you go there lie by the pool whole day, enjoy their mango ice cream, have pina coladas, have dinner at one of the exclusive dinner places (they have some 7 or 9 I forgot places) and then go to the club xxx

I wish I was there

reviews.author: moakley9
reviews.title: Overall Very Good but Be Aware it's Not All-Inclusive
reviews.text:
My family and I stayed at this hotel the first week of May. There were 8 of us: Myself, my wife, my 3-year old son, my 7-month old daughter, my wife's parents, and my wife's sister and boyfriend.

Would I consider this a family resort? I would say "no", however they do a really good job of providing entertainment and amenities for families. The target audience is not families but there's enough to keep the kids entertained. They have a good-sized kiddie pool that is about waist deep for a 3-year old. It's just a pool, not a water park with sprays or slides. So you will need to bring pool toys to help keep the kids entertained. (There is a gift shop where you can but stuff but it's overpriced). The pool is located by a hut that is an activity area for kids. They have all different types of events throughout the day and some of the events are really good. There's also a small playground for kids with a slide and swing.

Our room location was right in front of one of the adult pools. The view was spectacular but, for a family with kids, it was a terrible spot because it was next to the main stage area for the nightly shows. Thankfully, we brought a noise machine for our room. Otherwise there would have been no way our kids would have been able to sleep.

Be aware that it's not truly "all-inclusive". It depends on the level you selected. For example, we didn't get the "Family Concierge" package because we felt that we would be excessive to have our own butler. Sounded good but would rather spend that money on activities. Figured we could get our own ice. However, what we didn't realize was you can't have alcohol delivered to the room without paying for "Family Concierge". The very first night we put the kids to bed and were excited to sit on the balcony and make plans for the week over a bottle of wine... only to find out I would have to pay for the bottle if I wanted it delivered. They only way I could get drinks to the room would be to go to a bar and bring it back. But that would only be a single glass, not a bottle, and I could potentially wake up the kids opening and shutting the door. So we were a little sour we couldn't get the drinks we wanted. Additionally, there are little cabana huts all over the resort. But those are only given to people that paid for a certain level. We lowly regular all-inclusive people would have to pay for them each day if we wanted to use them. I also wasn't allowed to drink some of the top shelf liquor, such as Don Julio anejo.

So we definitely felt like lesser-ofs because we didn't have the highest levels. The sad thing is we could have afforded the higher level, we just didn't realize how necessary it was.

Overall, it's a beautiful hotel. The food was generally good. The atmosphere was great. We were treated with respect. It was clean. The room was nice (aside from the location). So I do consider it a nice hotel. Just be aware that it isn't completely focused on families (but I don't think they advertise themselves that way) and I would recommend forking over the extra money for the higher level, especially if you want to be able to order drinks to your room or have a cabana/hut.

reviews.author: Kelsey W
reviews.title: Wonderful Staff, Very Clean
reviews.text: Had a wonderful experience staying here with my family. There are lots of activities at the hotel and nearby (aquaworld is right across the street, and the mall is just a 5 min taxi ride). The staff are some of the kindest and happiest people I have ever met. Exceptionally accommodating and they regularly went the extra mile for us (including our server at Enzo going all the way to pyramid 3 to get us cappocinos!) The rooms are all very clean and well kept and the beds are surprisingly cozy. I can't say enough about the wonderful time we had here and I am certain we will be returning!

reviews.author: Kypatsfan
reviews.title: Excellent resort
reviews.text:
My girlfriend and I stayed at this resort last week, loved it!

The good: 1. Service was outstanding. From the front desk check-in to check-out, all service was awesome. Beach service was particularly great considering the heat and amount of customers. 2. Beach was beautiful, the Internet pictures don't do it justice. 3. Landscaping was very pretty and well kept. 4. I only know English, but that's ok, most of the workers are very good with English. 

The bad: 1. Food was good, but not great. (In fairness, I'm a picky eater, most of the issue is me!) 2. Balcony a little small, but again, that's a personal thing. 3. Beach vendors, although not real pushy, could be annoying at times. 4. I'm a beer guy and beer brands were limited. Not a big deal, I knew it when I booked. (I learned to love Dos Equis!!) There is no American beer available. 

It was my first time in Cancun, and I was very impressed and definitely feel I received an incredible amount of bang for my buck! 

Last thought.......I booked through Apple vacations- they were excellent as well.

reviews.author: isabelarose
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: My husband surprised me with a getaway to Cancun and booked Paradisus hotel. It was INCREDIBLE!!! The staff is so friendly and accommodating! The food was so delicious, the pool was amazing, the grounds were gorgeous, it was by far one of our favorite trips! We highly recommend Paradisus!

reviews.author: Suzanne R
reviews.title: Awesome resort! With every penny!
reviews.text: This resort was top notch in every way! We stayed in the "Royal" section of the resort and it was a heavenly experience! When I return to Cancun (this is my 4th tiem) I will definitely choose to come back to the Paradisus! Huge facility with an awesome beach footprint!! The restaurants were wonderful with a very diverse choice of meals. The staff were the most helpful and cheerful people I have ever met! The room we stayed in was so beautifully decorated and just plain stunning in every way! You will not be disappointed if you choose to stay here!

reviews.author: Elizabeth J
reviews.title: Exquisite
reviews.text:
Let me start by saying my husband and I have visited this resort for 13 years it should tell readers something!
I'm just amazed at what people critique i.e. 'The waves are too rough' 'The Play area for children is not good enough' 'The kiddy pool should have water slides' 'The breakfast/lunch/dinner has no variety' ' The night entertainment is not upscale enough' The rooms are outdated'...I can go on and on...What I will say is..Do your research! If you're not satisfied beforehand..why bother going?
Off course I will and should be able to answer any questions readers might have..Fire Away..I also understand tast does differ..Bottom line..We have ALWAYS enjoyed our stay..Why can't everyone else?

reviews.author: dablitt1960
reviews.title: amazing service
reviews.text:
We were a bit hesitant after reading past reviews but were pleasantly surprised after spending a week here. 
Lets start with the positives, The service was excellent, there was not a moment that went by without a server asking if there was anything that they could do for you, whether at the bar, in the restaurant, by the pool or at the beach, someone would always make sure your needs were met. The food for an all inclusive was very good and extremely creative, presentation at the a la cartes were excellent and the buffet had a great selection that was always fresh. The unique setting in the centre of the main building is worth the trip in itself. The pool was very warm but that's what we were looking for, never felt chilled. The beach is to die for, waves to lay in, sandy with no weeds and cool to walk on even in the hottest time of day. It was refreshing that you didnt need towel cards and towels were always available. The balconies are the most private that we have come across
Now the areas they could improve upon. Though the royal suites have been renovated, the rest of the rooms are dated and need upgrading, room service quality is average at best, and they lack a sports bar. If you are looking for nightly entertainment on a grand scale, you wont find it here as there is no space for an ampitheatre. We found that there were no delays at restaurants and lounge chairs were always available but this could change in busy season. It was annoying that there was a surcharge for using the cabana beds. Most remained empty due to extra cost.

reviews.author: MarcGarciaHallam
reviews.title: Relaxing and pampered.
reviews.text: This is one of my favorite vacations and not just because it is the most recent. The food was good (some restaurants far better than others), the quality for what we paid was far more than I expected, the staff is trained impeccably and had knowledge of activities outside of the resort and the pool/beach areas were very well-managed with a relaxing atmosphere even when they were at their peak with foot traffic.

reviews.author: Vahiide
reviews.title: Best ever
reviews.text: That was one of my best holidays i had in Paradisus the resort is great the people there are great special thank to Brenda who made with us the salsa lesson and to antonio for the best icecoffee you people are great come to visit you again. The service and the foot is excellent and in one word everything is great❤️❤️

reviews.author: Joe T
reviews.title: Relaxing and so well taken care of
reviews.text: Beautiful location and very well maintained. I have to say that the Royal service is the way to go. Our Butler, Sakny, took very good care of us the entire trip. Royal Service has a separate building with a lounge that has snacks and drinks until 10pm. La Palapa, the restaurant by the pool for Royal Service was amazing. We will be back!

reviews.author: Traveller & Foodie
reviews.title: Nice All Inclusive Resort however not perfect
reviews.text: I came here on business 3 nights.    Check-in was smooth.    The first room they gave us was on the third floor.   After a sleepless night because our room was right over the disco (3353) we called the reception the next day and changed our room to the 8th floor (3806).   Stay away from rooms on 3rd floor over the disco (Building 3), the noise of the music was very loud into the early morning.  However our room 3353 had a better view than the one on the 8th floor.    Once we changed room we had no issues sleeping.   The room is a bit outdated, and so is the bathroom however the service for room was very good and the room was clean.   The lobby area was a jungle so there was a lot of humidity because of the plants/trees.   Honestly I would get rid of the jungle and make this area more modern as it was a very hot lobby while having dinner in the Japanese/Sushi restaurant.     To me the jungle was a bit outdated and with the beautiful area on the first floor near the Concierge and Check-in area I see a lot of potential for this hotel to be a bit more fancy in that section, the trees and jungle have to go for a more luxury feel to a very nice hotel.    The are 3 pools, one with a bar in the pool area, another bigger pool with lots of chairs always available and the Royal Service pool which was for Royal customers only and more intimate.     The ocean view from the pool was breathtaking.    Beach chairs were a bit hard to find if you didn't come early, like before 8:30 am if you wanted an umbrella.   Restaurants, Naos: international buffet for breakfast, lunch and dinner:  breakfast amazing, lunch sometimes not consistent, first hamburger was delicious and the second time it was under cooked and so was their chicken. I must mention that the buffet had really good service, the waiters were very attentive and caring.   Market Grill was a Argentina/Brazil style restaurant which was actually very nice.    The house wine served from the all inclusive plan was very ordinary however they have a great wine list which we ordered from and enjoyed the wine with their grilled meats.    The Asian restaurant, not the lobby one near the jungle the one you have to walk over to through the rooms on the first floor was just ok to me.    The service was just ok too, and the food tapas was ok to me.    I would of liked to have tried Mole, Vento and Tempo however we did not have time because the dinners were sometimes in the area the company had chosen for us to eat as a group.    The last night we had a buffet dinner outside near the Royal Service pool area and honestly the buffet food was cold and not amazing like the food at the Naos buffet.   We were all very disappointed.   Overall a nice 3 night stay for an all inclusive.  This hotel has a lot of potential if they can change a few things.   I must add that they had live music near the beds on the beach was very nice.  The band was pleasant and the music was very good.     Again overall a 4 star hotel with a potential to me for a 5 with a few fine tuning in certain areas.  The disco and the bar lounge was amazing.  Every night during our stay they had different shows at the avenue bar, some were quite interesting.  The Red lounge disco was also very fun, the music was great.

reviews.author: Diana N
reviews.title: Best experience ever!!!
reviews.text: Wonderful hotel, the food is delicious, the drinks are marvelous. I'm just spending 5 days at Paradisus Cancún Royal Service,and everything is superb!, especially the guys at "Avenue bar " Andrés and William, the guy at "La Palapa" Eddie, and my butler Sergio. Best time ever!!!.

reviews.author: Mr Onthego
reviews.title: Amazing Resort!!!!
reviews.text:
This is the first time I've ever posted on TripAdvisor but I felt that the staff and resort management deserve credit on making this resort amazing!!
My wife and I have been to many destinations across the Caribbean and Hawaii over the last 30 years on family vacations with our children as well as business conferences. We've stayed at 5 Diamond high end hotels and luxurious resorts but I must say that the week we spent here ranks as one of our best stays anywhere. The check in staff went out of there way to have our room close to our daughter and son in law who were traveling with us and our 9 month old granddaughter. The junior suites were clean and comfortable. We called to have more hangers sent up while we unpacked and they were sent up within 5 minutes! The resort is well laid out and unlike large "village" resorts all the restaurants, pools and beach are within a 4minute elevator ride and walk from your room.
There was a great variety of food to suit everyone's taste at both the buffet restaurant and restaurants. The waiters went out of their way to cater for our granddaughter which made meal time enjoyable for all of us. Every morning at the buffet our waiter Pascual Franco met us with juice, coffee and the best service anyone could ask for!!! The beach has lots of tiki huts ( you still have to get there before 9am to get one ) and Luis our waiter always brought us a bucket of ice filled with bottled water and beer and kept it full all day long as well as any mixed drink you could imagine. He's been at the Paradisus for 21 years and his love of the place reflects on his service and love of the guests. Most employees we talked to had also been there for numerous years which shows how well this place is ran. The water ( on calm days ) was crystal clear and we counted 5 different shades of blue! The beach was clean with very few vendors and the pool area and washrooms were also very clean.
We didn't stay out late at night but the Avenue Bar had all top shelf liquor at no extra charge and even put on the hockey game for all of us "Leaf" fans to watch lose against the Capitals!  Amazing service everywhere!
I was not a fan of Cancun having gotten sick on a previous trip there at another 5 star resort a few years earlier but you can be sure that we will be back to the Paradisus Cancun and look forward to meeting the great people that make it a truly amazing place to relax!!!

reviews.author: Rupesh B
reviews.title: Great family vacation
reviews.text:
Paradisus is a lovely all inclusive resort with friendly staff and great service.... they have plenty of restaurants and good food variety ... the beach front and the swimming pool is lovely with cabanas on the side which have to be booked .... the Vento restaurant was really great and served good food ..... the concierge were really helpful and Ceasar went out of the way to help us try and locate a lost iPhone ..... 
the down side is that the property is old and needs to upgrade the rooms and bathrooms are in urgent need of upgradation ..... the golf is a small nine hole par three which is reasonably maintained but the rental clubs are really in bad shape and the bags are inconvenient... the 1500 $ coupon credits weren't of much use as they just give discounts on items not full money off ..... 
all in all a great vacation at a great place .....

reviews.author: Vadim M
reviews.title: Another Great Stay at Paradisus
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed 11 days in April - May in Paradisus Cancun. This was our second trip in two years, and it did not disappoint again.

We went with Royal Service again, and would recommend it, if you are traveling without kids. While it is not substantially more expensive, you do get a few perks - butler, additional restaurants, pool, better beach service and just more attention, in general. 

The property has a very "zen" feeling to it, with lots of greenery and soothing aroma throughout. It is an upscale resort, with top shelf food and liquor selections, and excellent service. We ate at every restaurant, and enjoyed every single one of them, including buffet. Specialty restaurants served delicious, high quality food, that you find at upscale restaurants in the US, definitely an adventure for foodies. Our favorite were Vento and Fuego. Market Grill was the only one that we found just OK, as the meat quality was somewhat rough and chewy. Special thank you to Oscar at Naos buffet, for providing great service and teaching us about tequilas. 

The beach section is very big, plenty of beds. The beach itself is very clean and beautiful. Water was rough, but I think it is common for this side of Cancun.

We also used resort gym and found it pretty good for a hotel, with all the needed equipment for a cardio and weight workout. As the rest of the property, very clean and well maintained. They also have classes with a trainer every day. 

As I mentioned, we stayed at Royal Service, and that's where we spent most of the time (beach/pool). Service is excellent, our butler Galdino (highly recommended) made reservations for us every morning and provided help with any questions/assistance we needed. The wait staff at our section was unbelievable, running around in the heat with orders but yet always with a smile and respect. I always take time to remember names of the people I really liked, and have to say special thank you to our Royal servers Eddie C, Alejandro, Edier and Cesar, and also Carlos and Omar at cabana reservations. 

The only thing we'd love to be changed, is more entertainment daytime/poolside. Music would be great poolside, and maybe some more fun activities (some hotels have foam parties, and such). Beach Club has great potential, but needs more liveliness added to be happening spot, maybe not extra charged. While Paradisus carries itself as a relaxing resort, more lively atmosphere would be great, for younger couples or singles. 

So overall, highly recommend this property, and hope to stay here again.

reviews.author: JennJo
reviews.title: Ahhhh-mazzzing
reviews.text:
This resort has staffed with the most wonderful employees---literally everyone we came into contact with went out of their way to be welcoming, heartfelt, sincere, and just down right outstanding!
Rooms were very clean, excellent housekeeping. 
Manny our pool server was beyond exceptional! He IS the reason we will return!
Restaurants were delicious! Meals were fresh, delish, and again amazing service!
We did all inclusive and will aways do that!
Tip this staff generously --they all deserve it!

reviews.author: Attila1905
reviews.title: The best looking hotel on the strip
reviews.text: We just came back from an amazing ten day vacation. The staff was extremely friendly. Jaime showed us the hotel and made sure to answer each of our question with professional manner. I bothered him with so many things during our trip and he always made time to help us out. Alberto at the front who worked in the evenings was extremely nice to us as well. Told us about the area while we were super drunk. The beach, the pool. the food, everything was amazing. they just need to work on the evening shows I think. They were nothing special. Dont forget the stop by Illy to get some freshly made donuts everyday. Antonio (AKa Tony Montana) is the best. lol :)

reviews.author: SpaDepot
reviews.title: We recommend the "Royal Service"
reviews.text: We just returned from our 6 day, 5 night visit to Paradisus Cancun. Our all-inclusive trip included a regular double-room which, upon our first view was "underwhelming" to say the least. Although it had a jetted tub on the outdoor balcony, the room décor was dated, and I'm many areas in need of repair. At check-in, the front desk mentioned there were some "upgrades" available for an additional fee. We decided to see our room before making any decision. Needless to say, we immediately called the front desk to express our disappointment, and inquired what our options were. The first upgrade was to a suite, but with similar décor, so we opted for the "Royal Service" upgrade in pyramid#5, Adults Only area. A staff member arrived promptly to take us to view the new room and we were delighted! Newer, updated, bright and very comfortable accomodations, along with a list of additional included services and our own personal "butler"! Our butler was "Maria" who was attentive, friendly, informative and generous with her time and smile. We made the right decision to upgrade our room & services as it took our vacation to another level. We HIGHLY recommend the upgrade to "Royal Service". You will be glad you did! : ) Also, Food was excellent, and staff could not be any nicer.

reviews.author: Carristrunk
reviews.title: Incredible week
reviews.text:
We absolutely loved the hotel,  beach and pools.  Breakfast was great,  no matter where you got it from.  The rest of the food was not our preference.  
We never left the resort. The balibeds by the pool and beach were our home for the week. The resort is large butt not too large.  Everything is easily accessible by a short walk.
