The evening entertainment was entertaining enough.  A couple of nights we had to miss the entertainment because there was not enough room in the lounge where it was being held.

reviews.author: Jennifer C
reviews.title: Great Choice For Couples & Families!
reviews.text: My sister and I are both in our early 20's. we came to this resort during our spring break the first week of march, and we opted for the royal service upgrade. the resort itself is stunning and very well maintained, the rooms are spacious and beautiful, the beach is breathtaking and the service is impecable. however, this resort caters mainly to couples and families. i wouldn't recommend this resort to young, single people because you'll get really bored. the red lounge which is their only nightclub was pretty much dead every night so if you wanna have a fun night out you have to go out of the resort to the main strip which is not too far and it's super fun.  we visited most of the restaurants which were all pretty good, we also loved the 24hr room service. we absolutely loved the VIP treatment that comes with royal service, the exclusive royal service pool and the Bali beds. our butler Eric was amazing and tried to help us with everything we needed. overall this resort is beautiful and i'd highly recommend it to couples and families who are looking to relax, we feel like it wasn't the right choice for us and wish there was more entertainment and fun.

reviews.author: ajc182017
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun – Very good overall
reviews.text:
I visited this resort in May 2017 with my boyfriend. We got the all-inclusive Royal Service so that we would have access to an area without children. The experience with these Royal Services was great. The beach/poolside service was wonderful. Our butler was not very good, but the small amount extra for Royal Service was still worth it. 

The hotel is difficult to navigate, but very nice. Rooms were clean and comfortable. The only room complaint would be that the shower flooded the bathroom every time, so we needed a ton of towels throughout the stay to dry the floor. 

Balcony was beautiful for the ocean view. Late night room service was fast, but the food left a little to be desired. 

Several very good restaurants on premises. Definitely make sure you go to Fuego—this was our favorite restaurant. Bana was great as well if you like seafood.

reviews.author: Lbunny03
reviews.title: 1st All inclusive
reviews.text:
My husband and I decided to take a kid free trip to Cancun. We are both in our 30's, and this was our 1st time in Mexico and 1st time doing an all inclusive. Being that we live in Texas where everything is "Bigger & Better" (LOL), it takes a lot to please us (JK). We ended up picking Paradisus because I waited too long in making a resort decision. I originally wanted to stay at Moon Palace, followed by Riu Pennisula, but they were all sold out. So we finally decided on Paridisus since the searching process for a resort was becoming exhausting. 

1st Impression 5/5:
We had Amstar transportation pick us up from the airport and drop us off at our resort along with 3 other couples. We were the 2nd couple to be dropped off and when we pulled up to the resort everyone said "WOW" because it looks so different, & it was pretty big compared to the previous resorts. So the exterior portion of Paradisus is lovely. All the pyramids and landscaping was very welcoming and well kept.

Welcome/Check-In 4/5
Smelled amazing, & of course the staff was extremely friendly & greeted us like royalty! Can't complain about the friendliness & how they greet you by name, and are extremely helpful by answering questions you have. Check-In is at 3p, this is one downside to the resort (although understandable to an extent) Our flight arrived at 10:30, got to Paridisus at 11:00a. While waiting on our room, the hotel kept our luggage and paired us with an employee who gave us a basic tour of the facility, provided us with a schedule of activities within the resort, & made 2 days of dinner reservations for us as well as booking a Club Melia tour (optional 90 min presentation to be club members for a cost of $12,900 that you can pay over 5 years with a ridiculous interest rate coming out to be about $600 every month for 5 years etc.... maybe nice deal for ppl who travel more than 2 times a year I would say) in exchange for $200 spa credit (spa service for one person is about $175-$215 depending on what you want). So while waiting 4 hours for our room, we walked around, ate lunch & lounged in the lobby (b/c we were tired). You do have the option to ask for a hospitality room where you can change your clothing if needed or even change into your bathing suit & swim while waiting for your room. So there are things to do while you wait.

Rooms 3.9/5
We had the Junior Suit Ocean View room in pyramid 3 on the 6th floor. Our room was perfect! Amazing ocean view, pool view & we were even able to watch some of the night shows from our private balcony. The size of the room was very spacious for 2 ppl with a nice size closet. We had two double beds (we were initially going to be placed on the ground level in order to have the 1 king bed, but we asked to be moved up higher so we had a better view of everything & of coarse all the Kings were taken on the 6th floor..oh well). Initially a lot of reviews stated the hotel is "dated" but for the age of the hotel, they have done an excellent job at maintaining the place. The rooms have marble floors and counter tops. Hand held & overhead showers, toilet and bidet. Warm undertone lighting with peach, white & olive color bedding. I would say it's a modern/contemporary mix. The lighting could be better in the bathroom for us women that like a good "face beat" (as in make-up application). We met a nice couple from ATL who said they didn't like their room at first then got moved to another room which was better, but that the ceiling in the bathroom needed new paint. So overall the rooms were okay, minibar included & stocked with drinks & snacks daily. In room safe included (highly recommend using). 

Food 4.3/5:
I loved the food! Everybody is different, but for an all inclusive, I think the food was pretty good. Although the I don't have another all inclusive to compare it to, I felt the service was good, there was plenty of food to go around with a lot of variety! Blue agave was my favorite for tacos. Sunset grill was good for poolside food, market grill (similar to Texas de Brazil) was nice, Naos buffet had great breakfast and different foods each night. Mole had amazing steak! Vento was Mediterranean and my least favorite. There is also Enso & Bana which are Asian cuisines. So there was a little bit of everything! Also had 24 hour room service for basic food like sandwiches, nachos, burgers, pizza etc. The coffee shop had great coffee & pastries. 

Pools 5/5:
I counted 3 pools the main pool which is in front of pyramid 3 is the best. The main pool is where we stayed. You will meet ppl a the pool, drink a lot of drinks at the swim up bar & have a great time. They have outdoor poolside performances during the day, live baby monkeys you can take pictures with as well as parrots. Great pool for families & singles!

Activities 3/5 (hotel) 5/5 (general activities)
Daily shows from 8:30p-9:30p. I enjoyed the Michael Jackson performance & the Circus. During the day they offer free classes such as Zumba, line dancing, soccer etc just depends on what you like. Across from Paradisus is aqua- world you can walk there and do a lot of water activities! Prices vary. We did the jungle tour with snorkeling ($60pp with an additional $10pp dock fee. Jungle tour was fun & scary being that it was my first time doing such a thing! Glad I did though. On the 3rd floor of the hotel the Amstar staff is there to booked additional tours & excursions isla mujeres, xcaret, tulum etc everything you can think of!!! So much to do but get ready to spend between $60-$90 per person depending on the activities. 

Service 5/5:
Clean, great room service, waiters etc.... Please make sure you tip the workers & cleaners!!!!!

Transportation 1/5:
The hotel doesn't offer transportation. You either have to walk (which is a good workout with all the damn stairs you climb outside the hotel), take a taxi, private driver or a bus. Bus is the cheapest and easiest (10.50 peso) so it seems as hotel staff recommend it. 

Overall experience 4/5:
I enjoyed my time here, I didn't like the heat inside the lobby of the hotel as it made things a little uncomfortable when walking around inside, but for a 1st time all inclusive I really enjoyed Paradisus! I would recommend it to family & friends.

reviews.author: Christina G
reviews.title: Was just ok
reviews.text: We stayed here for a week. We would not go back. It's too hotel like and doesn't have a nice resort feel.  There is nothing family oriented to do in the evenings. Just a bar that you seem to be able to hear from every room (although some rooms are worse than others).  The pool is nice and the beach is nice.  The shows...well who knows if they are good because they have such a poor set up you can never see them.  The food was good but other than the buffet not great for kids.  We found it not very entertaining for our kids but our standards were high as we had previously been to the now jade and honesty we don't think it gets better than that place. We will not venture outside that chain of resorts from now on.

reviews.author: Vika P
reviews.title: Good old - fashioned hotel
reviews.text: Have spend 7 days in that lovey hotel!Yes exactly -  hotel is really lovely,nice design with jungles inside of piramide,but it has really old managment!Food isnt good,from all la carte restaurants - brazilian was good!Others was awful!Beach is pretty good but sea is very wavy!Entertaiment is poor.Very talanted people but cant show their own ability but make american clone!Was sad....

reviews.author: Sarah N
reviews.title: Best Wedding & Exceptional Stay
reviews.text:
I just got married to the love of my life at Paradisus this past Saturday May 13. From the planning to our actual wedding day everything was absolutely stress-free. Donovan, our wedding coordinator is truly heaven sent. We thought planning a wedding overseas would be a nightmare but Donovan's attentiveness and attention to detail allowed us to relax and enjoy the process. We hired all of Paradisus' preferred vendors and are so happy we did. True professionals and all of their combined experiences exceeded our expectations. Even all of our guests were blown away by them. Not a single thing went wrong!!

We picked Paradisus because of the level of service provided when we stayed there in Oct 2014. We knew that the resort we'd want our wedding has to have great customer service.. let's say its the same as we remembered! Our guests could not stop raving about their stay and how the resort staff never under-delivered. Also, a quick shout out to Andrea on the entertainment team. She's a ball of energy and always greeted us wherever she saw us! Make sure you say hi when you see her! :)

All in all, the best resort we've been to in Cancun. Don't knock it until you try it.

- Sarah & Vitaliy

reviews.author: Melinda M
reviews.title: I am in heaven
reviews.text: I'm currently at the paradisus cancun. Had an unbelievable massage at the Yhi Spa today by Brenda.  I don't normally go to spas on vacation but this place is incredible.  90 minutes of pure bliss and pampering, full massage with aromatherapy and noninvasive facial. Very reasonable. Highly recommend the spa and Brenda!

reviews.author: jay81k
reviews.title: Fantastic hotel
reviews.text:
Once again I over thought the whole booking process and drove myself crazy for a couple months before deciding on the Paradisus. Once I booked a few bad reviews start coming which made me think I made a bad choice but in the end the hotel was top notch and we had a great time! 

Check in:

Im sure everybody thinks the check in counter is right when you walk in to your right but its not (it should be), that's where the concierge counter is. Anyway its just across in a separate room so no big deal. We arrived around 1pm and your room is only available starting at 3pm , so we had a bit of time to kill. At first a concierge started explaining us the hotel and its amenities but he was really just trying to sell us on their time share (Club Melia). He tried to get us to have breakfast with him the next morning so he can convince us to join Im assuming and offered us 100$ off at the spa which would of come to 290$ USD instead of 390$ for a massage for both of us! Even with the 100$ off that's really not worth it as I pay about 70$ CAD on average to get one over here so that did not appeal to us at all , and kindly told him no thanks. We then went for tacos at Blue agave downstairs and came back to get our room keys. Our room was not ready at 3pm like they said so they found us another room which was on the bottom floor. We weren't too happy about that at first as we would of liked a better view but in the end was perfectly fine and was well situated in Pyramid 2 close to everything. And besides we didnt come to Cancun to stay in our room! 

Room:

The Room was slightly dated but still nice. Floors were all marble, bed was perfectly good, balcony had lounge chairs which was nice. flat screen TV and a decent bathroom. Wasn't like what we had at the Royalton but still very acceptable. 

Beach/Pool:

The beach was absolutely beautiful! We had a bad experience the last time at the Royalton with their beach that had so much seaweed but this beach was perfect! Although when the water was rough there was a bit of seaweed but nothing like we had experienced over there. About 6 of the days we were there it was very windy so the beach was rough and had strong waves but we loved it! It was lots of fun. It wasnt hard to get any lounge chairs but if you didnt wake up by 8am it may have been difficult to get some shaded ones under a palapa but this is the case at every hotel. Regardless we managed to get one every single day. 
I played beach volleyball every day thanks to Andrea who got the games together and that was always a great time. 
As far as the pool goes, we did not go once but it was very nice and seemed a little livelier than the beach , but the beach was too nice not to stay at. 

Food:

The food was actually pretty good especially for an all inclusive! We appreciated the fact that they offered authentic mexican food. There was authentic tacos at Blue agave which were good, and then more traditional mexican at Mole. No Tex mex! 
The Buffet was best for breakfast but for lunch and dinner was slightly disappointing but still good. You can always find something to eat. There was no pasta station like at every other resort Ive been to which we thought was odd but didnt care. The main problem with the buffet was that the food wasnt always hot enough. 
We managed to eat at a different restaurant every night which was great. First night we ate at Enso, and that was the worst of them all and would not return if I came back here. Vento the tapas place was ok. id say about 7 out 12 dishes we had were good. The portions were not as small as they had told us they would be also! Market grill was great. Very nice experience, there was an endless amount of meat and side dishes coming every couple minutes and they were for the most part really good! Feugo was our favorite! The ceviches were good and the Sirloin main on top of risotto was amazing! Mole was also pretty good. Bana the sushi restaurant was surprisingly not bad as well. I expected horrible sushi but was not the case at all. The salmon was actually very good. I was very satisfied with the selection of restaurants, it was the perfect amount for a weeks stay and left very full every night.
There was a nice little coffee stand that served good quality coffee and desserts. We had iced coffee after lunch every day that was very good. Just wished it was open early in the morning and at night. 

Service:

The service was great! Everybody was so friendly. We constantly were asked what we wanted to drink on the beach as well. Also on two occasions they accommodated our requests with no issues. Like for example one night we couldnt get reservations at Feugo the night before but they still allowed us to eat there when we showed up. And another time we got to our reservation an hour early and they let us go in without an issue. Everybody was very chill and we loved them for it! 
 
Overall it was a great time and would return for sure! Highly recommend this place. We loved all the plants in the hotel, really made it have great ambiance. Royal service would be a nice addition but was not necessary, the service was still amazing without it.

reviews.author: dacimo4257
reviews.title: 60th  Birthday Celeberation
reviews.text: In celebration of my 60th Birthday, myself, along with my husband, two daughters and my son-in-law spent a week at Paradisus, Cancun.  It was like a week in paradise.  We opted for the Royal Service and couldn’t be more pleased.  From the time we walked into the Main Lobby to the time we left the resort we were treated like royalty.  The staff was unbelievable and could not do enough for us.  The resort was beautiful, our room was great.  Special thanks to Galdino, our Royal Service Butler.  He was always there with a smile to help us in any way he could.  He made all our dinner reservations, Bali Hut reservations and helped with whatever else we needed.  Not only did he decorate our room for my birthday (along with champagne)  he also decorated my Son-In-Laws room for his birthday.  He always made us all feel special.  I also have to give a shout out to Eddie!  Eddie was our waiter, pool boy and beach boy depending on where he was assigned for the day.  Our drinks were always cold and our bellies always full.  He was happy to help in any way he could.   I would highly recommend Paradisus Cancun and can't wait to go back.  Royal Service is a must if you are travelling without young children and want the Royal Treatment.

reviews.author: Golfingwli
reviews.title: Anniversary
reviews.text:
Second time to the Paradisus Cancun and as the first time my wife and I loved it. Great service from all the workers from cleaning staff to waiters and bartenders. Awesome food selections from the restaurants which is 7 to choose from . Only negative that I experience is once you check in the person assigned to you to show you the hotel grounds must sell you something extra and keep pushing for you to buy extras. I experienced the same thing the first time around but this time I cut it off and declined everything. I felt bad for the worker but all we wanted to do is grab a drink and go to the pool after a long day of traveling. 

Paradisus is awesome and I highly recommend it . Worth the $$$$ you pay !

reviews.author: Sue D
reviews.title: 2 Wks Were Not Enough
reviews.text:
We had a great 2 wk stay at this resort!!!  And would absolutely return.  Here's a quick Pit & Peak overview.
PEAKS:
1) The food!!  Was fantastic!!  The buffet to the A la Cartes were amazing! Easy to reserve a table by calling from your room, 24hr in advance.  (Please to Blue Agave and see the best server in the Yucatan; Sergio!!  For lunch or dinner...best tacos/quesadillas!!)
2)Free, quick WIFI throughout the resort
3)Beautiful, clean, well maintained, traditional building.  In the evening the hallways are lit by candles and lanterns.  Lovely way to unwind.
4)well equipped gym AND classes!  For 2 hrs (8am & 9am)  there are classes offered. (HIIT, Step,TRX, Circuit, Yoga)  Martin teaches the classes and he is fantastic.  You can see enjoys his job and does a fine job of including all levels.  
5) all the servers in all the restaurants!!  You cannot ask for better service.  And when the say to you "it's my pleasure", you honestly believe them!  
6)Pool side beer service.  Again, exceptional.  They are frequent and friendly.
7)Clean pool and beach.  Quiet pool & bar pool.(Sunset grill pool side has THE best chicken wings!)

PITS:
1)The resort inside is very tropical.  It is not a modern style. Which was fine with us...just a heads up.  Also it is very "scented".  Husband said it smelled 'Spa' like.  It added to the relaxing atmosphere for us.  BUT if you are "scent-sensitive" it may be a problem
2) Not enough umbrellas pool side.  The staff was GREAT at removing saved loungers. But a few more umbrellas would be great.
3) the beds around the pool and in the bars!  Not enough tables in the Ave Bar.  I'm sorry but I find those beds disgusting......
4) we faced the lagoon that had great sunsets.....but if you are actually sitting on the chairs on the deck, you view is obstructed by the planters.  Not sure if the ocean front has the same issues....but I would suspect yes. 

Overall we had zero complaints and we would be happy to return.

FInally, we traveled with Sunwing.  Which is always......unpredictable.  Free meals are no longer offered on flight.  This also includes snacks, cookies, pretzels and even the little chocolate you used to get on decent.  Also, no champagne service or hot towels at beginning of the flight.

Sunwing rep at the resort.....when he actually made an appearance was disappointing as well.  We booked a shopping tour. And were never picked up!!!!  

The rep is located in a hallway and it is VERY hot/humind.  So pack your patience when you go to see him.  Also the info session was done one on one, instead of a group.  So get there early....or you will be waiting.

reviews.author: mrtows
reviews.title: spring vacation
reviews.text: was a good time   friendly staff  ok food  drinks were flowing all was nice  new to the club and not satisfied with that part club rooms located way at the end of building    long way to food    and club on the child end of the pool

reviews.author: Natalia P
reviews.title: Great hotel, clean and children friendly
reviews.text: Kidz zone was fun for our kids. Clean hotel and pools. Just wish melia club employed would stop pushing us to attend their event. We refused on day two and every single day after someone would either call us or talk to us inthe hall way about attending, annoying. We were there to enjoy vacation

reviews.author: Leslie E
reviews.title: Not Customer Friendly - BEWARE!
reviews.text: Very disappointing experience. Upon Check-In we were told that we did not have reservations. I showed them our confirmation email from TripAdvisor. Then I logged into TripAdvisor to check the status of our reservation; it still showed as a valid reservation. The check-in person kept telling me that they aren't responsible for reservations made on TripAdvisor. They also kept asking me if I was a rewards member; this was our first trip to Cancun we have no reason to be rewards members. We asked them to honor the reservation since we had the printed confirmation and could show them a current, valid reservation on TripAdvisor; they said "no". They said we could use one of our devices (iPhone) to rebook at the current rate on THEIR website (I can only assume this cuts TripAdvisor out of their compensation). At this point, I was crying and terrified that we were stuck in Cancun with no hotel for 4 days. We used our device to rebook at $200 more (for 3 nights). Beware of staying at this hotel!!!!!

reviews.author: michelepK7403GR
reviews.title: Great Family Vacation
reviews.text:
I booked this hotel on a whim after changing our travel plans 2 days prior to flying out. I loved the paradisus palma real in DR so i hoped that this resort was the same with our 8mth old and 3yr old. We booked a family concerige one bedroom suite and where greeted and taken to the special check in area immediately. Check in was a fast and easy process where you meet your butlers Gabriel and Fernanda we had.  They gave our children welcome backpacks with everything they need for there beach stay and walked us to our room. 

Pros: Concierge is great and will handle all of your reservations from kids to adults. They will help with plane checkin and ordering cars if needed. I loved how everyday they left something ( surprise ) for my daughter and also my son even though he was an infant.  They even set up a bubble bath with balloons and gave them goodbye gift. Fernanda and Gabriel were great and friendly.  Naos restaurant is great for breakfast and lunch. Market grill was a delicious argentian grill and we ate everyday at the Sunset pool grill for lunch. Blue agave is a mexican restuarant think fast food option as everything is made already and they just make the tacos. 

Cons:
   Did not know about the phone set up for family concierge. it wasnt explained at check in. the kids pool is just a pool that is very shallow and does not have anything there for them. The playground is rusted which is expected being around the ocean water.  I would have liked a daily schedule elsehwere around the resort instead of only by the pools. Rooms are a little outdated but kept in good condition. it would have been nice to know about the animals that you can take pictures with since we caught them by walking around the resort.

This hotel is very big and does not have strollers to rent. Make sure to bring your stroller and there is some stairs to the beach to carry it down.

overall: I would recommend this hotel and even go back. The staff is very friendly and make you feel like home. My daughter did not want to leave and loved every person she came in contact with.  The resort exceeded my expections and is kept in immaculate condition. If you are traveling with small children there is a supermarket near by that sells all baby products so that you dont have to worry about bringing them. The hotel will also provide baby wash, shampoo , mosquito repellent or whatever else you need.

reviews.author: aamedeo11@comcast.net
reviews.title: Beautiful resort & beaches
reviews.text:
Hotel is very large, but nicely laid out.  Beautiful garden style atrium after entering
the lobby.   Easy access to pretty much all of the restaurants.  Food was good at
the restaurants, but some food cold @ buffet.  Kathia is a lovely hostess at buffet  &
we very much enjoyed Atalano our server.   Pleasant young man & good worker.
We loved the beach area & pleased with the attendants bringing bottled water &
drinks constantly.  We did find the waves to be rough that week.  Our room was
nice & kept clean.   All the workers at this resort are so friendly.  They should be
commended for the great work they do.   I would also suggest alerting us more to what's going on at night for entertainment & where.  One night we received something saying it was in the bar but no one was there, found it going on outside.   The Michael Jackson revue was great.  Check in & check out was pretty quick.  We had a nice stay.

reviews.author: Marian G
reviews.title: Relax & Enjoy
reviews.text: Beautiful beach resort to relax and enjoy the sun, dining experiences and quiet evenings.  Nothing after 9pm, no Latin dancing available.  Daily Zumba and Aquafit is available, but other daily activities scheduled may change or not be available.

reviews.author: Krikor B
reviews.title: Had a very good time.
reviews.text:
Everything was great, food, pool, restaurants, room the hotel was awesome. Very friendly staff, always greeting you and having that big smile. I don't know how to describe it other than saying MAGNIFICENT. I would definitely recommend this hotel to my friends and family members. Next year in 2018 we are definitely going back and already making plans for it, this time we are taking the kids as well.
Thank you for everything 
P.S. Edwardo the bartender at the pool was awesome. He made BOMB drinks, specially HURRICANE (which I called it VOLCANO, our joke). Go see Edwardo

reviews.author: rhedrick
reviews.title: Tried to Love it, But Just Can't
reviews.text:
I am a retired travel agent from Denver.  I paid for this trip.  My company specialized in travel to Mexico.  We sent over 1000 persons to Mexico each year for 29 years!  I am 59 years old. I have made over 55 trips to Cancun and the Riviera Maya since 1985.
This is a large hotel, pyramid style, in the center of the hotel zone in Cancun.  The beach is excellent - you can walk for hours which is what we do.  The water is clean, and perfect for swimming.  An excellent location in Cancun hotel zone.
I booked a cheap deal through Apple Vacations, including air on Frontier, hotel, taxes, and transfers, from Denver.  I had no problems getting here.  I checked in, and paid an extra $50/nt upon check in, for an ocean front room in the main building.  The view is worth it.  The rooms are comfortable, clean, and the AC worked great!

The buffet breakfast was good, but did not vary at all over our 8 night stay.  The waiter service was mostly excellent.
While lunch service is available early, we found it to be inadequate, and mostly disgusting.  We learned after the first day to wait until the opening of the main restaurant, at 12:30pm.  The ceviche at lunch time buffet was consistently excellent, as were the grilled Mahi Mahi, and other fish dishes. The variety overall was somewhat lacking, especially for my wife, who is not a seafood lover.  The Coconut ice cream is to die for!
The deserts are mostly show - not worth the calories.

We found the beach drink service to be sporadic- sometimes attentive, and other times they ignored us, despite our tips.  The drinks were so so, unless you ordered something straight, which is impossible to mess up.

The pools were inviting, but we preferred the beach, which is excellent.  The lounge chairs are the best of any resort I have stayed in Mexico!  Very comfortable! After a week, that is important!  The beach is awesome fine white sand, ocean is perfectly clean, perfect for swimming - highly recc'd.  We are beach walkers and honestly took a 2 ½ hr round trip walk and did not make it to the north end of the beach!  The beach alone is just incredible and worth the trip!

The bad:
-Too many younger parents ignoring their crying infant kids.  We were concerned for some of them! 
-Music at the pool, which is mandatory in Mexico, was way past too loud.  I had to cover my ears when walking through the pool area.  I can't imagine spending a day at the pool with my kids - their ears would suffer!  On some days, they also had music on the beach, equally loud.   We were able to find a palapa far enough away to hear the ocean.
-The hotel uses Insence sticks throughout the lobby at night.  This may sound petty, but everyone we spoke to hated it, including us.  Imagine getting off the elevator, ready for drinks and dinner and being gassed out.  I am highly allergic.  The smell alone was so overpowering that it felt like I was having an allergic attack with my throat closing!  This was a nightly occurrance.  Even walking in/out to the pool and beach there was an electric smell machine which was disgustingly obnoxious.  For this reason alone, I would never stay at this hotel again!  We spoke to numerous others who agreed.
-We paid for an ocean front upgrade.  Unfortunately, the prevailing winds blow from the ocean, towards to the hotel.  Normally, this would be good, but the exhaust vents for the main buffet restaurant were in front of our room - we, and at least 100 other rooms were gassed out for several hours every night!  This made our balcony unusable at night.  Otherwise, the room location was perfect.
-The specialty restaurants we found to be either boring, grossly weird menus at an extra cost, or just lousy.  Some people we saw, left after receiving their dishes (before eating them) The best was Blue Agave, no reservations, excellent service from Sergio for 3 nights, but it was basic Tacos, which was fine with us.

The workers were genuinely friendly and very helpful.  I cannot value this enough - they are that much better than elsewhere.

But unfortunately, the negatives outweigh the positives, and I won't stay here again, nor would I advise you to do so.

Just my opinion.  Please make sure you read at least 30 other reviews before deciding on your hotel.  Do not ever rely only on one opinion!

Cheers!  And enjoy Cancun and the Riviera Maya.
It remains to be the best beach destination value for US travelers, and is well worth the trip!

reviews.author: annay157
reviews.title: A solid 3 star average Cancun resort
reviews.text:
The property and common areas were lovely, as expected at any Cancun AI resort, the service was awesome, the pools were nice, although the kids pool is not really a kids pool (no fun slides), just a wading pool I would say but still my son loved it. The restaurants had nice modern decor, service was good, food was just OK. My problem with the food was that everything was room temperature, and this is not only for the NAOS buffet restaurant, it was even in the sit down restaurants. We were so disappointed with the tapas restaurant Vento, everything was room temperature, we had one bite of each tapas and left and decided to go to the buffet. BANA was a huge disappointment; the food did not taste Japanese, I would call it really bad wannabe Japanese/Chinese food. They had a speciality Udon stir fry, it was seriously inedible; the udon noodles were so overcooked, it was broke into one inch pieces, it was just bad. BUT the service at the restaurants were excellent. The only restaurant that we enjoyed was Market Grill, went there 3x during our stay, everything served hot! 

NOW for the cons: aside from the average food, the rooms are so outdated, they need to renovate ASAP. Door knobs falling off, cracks in the stone and patched up, the decor is old and dark. We actually paid for an upgrade and were shocked that this was the upgrade. We asked one of the room service people about the room and he stated that the was one of the nicer rooms...shocked!

SO overall our stay was good: my son loved the wading pool and beach, service was excellent, food was average, rooms were old= 3 star resort.

reviews.author: Rema P
reviews.title: Another Lovely stay!
reviews.text:
We had another lovely vacation last month at Paradisus Cancun; we were here 2 years ago. Overall service, entertainment and food continues to be excellent. Resort does need better upkeep though, many spots had leaky ceilings. 

Martin Andrade at the gym was truly excellent!! Made it a point to go every morning for his classes which allowed for guilt-free eating and drinking the rest of the day.

reviews.author: 979jorge
reviews.title: Best vacations I had in 7 years
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun had everything my family and I  needed, four days was not enough, we making plan to be back in soon, we left places to visit in the same hotel, lovely service people, the kid zone has all your kid will need to be entertained.

reviews.author: carolynw377
reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text:
We stayed at the paradisus Cancun for 7 days we had the all inclusive, we had a good time,
The negatives are 
1st : the drinks package is ok ( there is only about 2 types of beer, wine is average and I am a southern comfort drinker and they do not have it)
2nd : do not stay in reception tower I think this is the 3 rd tower it is way to noisy we could not sleep we had 2 rooms 4 adults we had to shift after 1 st night we could not get 2 double rooms again so 1 couple had to have single beds for rest of trip.
3rd : They let people get very drunk. First experience of hotel we stood outside and a girl beside us vomited on the ground beside us, it was 4.30 in afternoon.

The positives are
1st : The food was really good.
2nd: The amenities were great to.
All in all it was a good holiday

reviews.author: Buddy52
reviews.title: Wonderful all inclusive hotel
reviews.text: Excellent hotel on the beach in Cancen.  Spent 10 days here in royal service all inclusive option. Everything was great and not crowded at all in April.  The staff make this a superb hotel, all very helpful, happy and very service oriented. Nothing was too much trouble for them and they seem to really want to help you have a great time. The restaurants were great especially fuego. That was our favorite and went there 3 times in 10 days. The royal service pool was lovely but you did have to make sure you booked a bed the day before or they were all full for most of the day. The beach was great but was windy as you would expect.  The hotel was clean with everything you needed on site and a great beach. Overall a fantastic visit to a lovely location with great service and friendly staff.  This hotel had the best all inclusive restaurants we have ever had. I can't think of anything negative to say at all.

reviews.author: Nabil S
reviews.title: Wonderful experience
reviews.text:
From our arrival day/check in experience, to the day we departed, our experience at Paradisus Cancun was wonderful. The staff here are not only courteous but sincere in their interactions with guests.

 The beach is beautiful. The pools and grounds are well-maintained. The rooms are clean and more than adequate to enjoy your stay. There are plenty of options for meals. I would say the food is really good, but not excellent. That being said, it is by far the best food and service I've had at an all-inclusive resort. I would be surprised to receive "excellent" food at an all-inclusive resort.

 Without question, the most enjoyable meals my family enjoyed were at Restaurant Naos!  We loved all the breakfast options, but even more than that we enjoyed meeting and being served by Gaudencia and Pascual! Both of these kind gentleman deserve recognition for top-notch service and warm personalities. If management is reading this please reward and recognize these two in particular. 

We will certainly be returning to vacation here! Recommend without reservation!

reviews.author: mantisfactory
reviews.title: Amazing! Royal treatment
reviews.text: I almost didn't book hotel because I saw a few bad reviews and I always religiously stay at the ME Cancun. I am a total hotel snob and this place was 5 stars. Never one issue. We paid for the Royal service and probably didn't use all that was offered but we reallly loved the private adult pool area.

reviews.author: Michelle M
reviews.title: Stayed from 5/5/17 to 5/10/17
reviews.text:
I stayed at the hotel from 5/5/17 to 5/10/17 with my son. We decided to go with the Royal Service area and that was a good decision. La Palapa Restaurant was fantastic, in fact most of the food was really good compared to other all-inclusive resorts that I have stayed at. Our favorite restaurants were Fuego and Mole because we enjoy Mexican food. I enjoyed Bana which is a Japanese sushi place.  If you do not like ethnic food or spa like food this might not be a good choice for you. They did have an all you can eat buffet called Market but we didn't go. 

The resort is right across the street from Aqua World which has a variety of activities to do. We did the Sky Rider and the Jungle Tour with snorkeling. The city bus also stops right in front of the hotel very frequently and costs only one dollar to ride. This was very helpful when shopping.  

As part of Royal Service you get daily access to the spa YHI facilities. There water therapies were very good and the staff were nice. We had back massages and a facial which were part of a special promotion for $165 each- 90 minutes total which is comparable to where we live. The spa has a steam room, sauna, and water experiences. Also as part of Royal Service you get two days in a bali bed included-this was awesome and service was really good along with drink and food delivered to your bali bed.  With Royal Service you have a butler assigned to you. Rode came thru with my special request for liquor and Champagne in the room, as we don't drink beer. He also handled all of the reservations and checked in with us every time he saw us.

There were daily activities offered in the resort. Most of the ones we did required reservations: sushi making class, ceviche making class, tequila tasting, mixology and Eco tour. My Eco tour guide Daniel was very nice. We did kayaking for an hour on the lagoon.  The only thing about the activities was the evening ones occur outside and there is not enough seating for everyone. Other all inclusive resorts have their own theatre area and I would suggest this would be a nice improvement. I would suggest more activities in the evening. During the day at the Royal pool we did have some music for about 1.5 hours each day but that was about it. 

The beach is beautiful here and I felt safe all of the time I was at this resort. The resort is very clean. Staff were cleaning all hours of the day which I appreciated.  I would recommend this resort for people who want to relax as it is not a Spring Break type of resort which is what I was looking for. If you can afford the upgrade go Royal Service-I don't think I would have liked the resort without it as then you are battling with small children.  Royal Service is 18 years and older only.

reviews.author: Exploring World
reviews.title: Luxurious Stay!!
reviews.text: Overall great rooms, awesome food and good though process by hotel by organizing in house activities and keeping people engaged. I think they can improve on activities but it was overall great experience.

reviews.author: Ellen V
reviews.title: Family Vacation at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: A week during Spring Break - busy, but nice - the resort felt full but not crowded.  The restaurants were good and varied - except for the Mediterranean restaurant (forgot its name, but steer clear!).  The Mexican, Japanese and Tapas were all great.  One tip - you must reserve beds/cabana by the pool in advance otherwise they'll all be gone...

reviews.author: jaimegG7512PM
reviews.title: Great Place!!
reviews.text: Awesome service and great place to stay. Everyone employed there has great customer service. Lot's of options when it comes to dining. Bar and lounge area are a blast. Pool area has plenti of room and activities

reviews.author: clarag951
reviews.title: Best Birthday Ever
reviews.text: This resort was by far more than I could ask for. The service was excellent, the food, the atmosphere. Strongly recommend the ocean view. For a relaxing time go to Yhi spa. The only down fall there's not much of a night life.

reviews.author: Cass T
reviews.title: Birthday with family & friends
reviews.text:
Just returned from 7 great days at the Paradisus with family and friends. We booked into the Royal Service with our own butler Daniel who took care of everything for us from restaurant bookings sunbeds, and all our other needs, Royal service highly recommended.
The resort itself beautifully kept all the restaurants were great especially Market Grill infact all the staff were great.
The Cabanas were a great luxury a must experience with all the poolside waiters and La Palapa restaurant waiters were fantastic especially Eddie & Moses.
A good tip to the waiters goes a long way to making your stay a memorable one considering most of us spend at least 6 hours a day by the pool.
The room was very clean and tidy all you could ask for, ocean view highly recommended.
The beach is one of the best around.
Overall the resort is excellent would definitely go back with Royal service and ocean view room

reviews.author: abatinic219
reviews.title: Overall Good but some bad
reviews.text:
My boyfriend and I just got back from Paradisus Cancun yesterday and overall it was a good experience. I wanted to give a sincere thanks to most of the staff who provided superb service. The buffet was not very good, struggled to find something to enjoy. Food was cold, and bread was stale. Not impressed with the buffet. The restaurants were absolutely gorgeous! Although some of the food was not the greatest overall but it was okay. The Market Place was our absolute favourite, the steak, fish and rest of the food were absolutely divine! One thing this resort, really fell short on was entertainment! By far, I can say this was the worst resort when it comes to entertainment and we have had our fair share of all inclusive vacations. First off, the show is at 8:30 every night and is either outside where you are crammed sitting on the PAVEMENT or inside in the lobby, where you are standing on your tippy-toes just to have a peek at the show. Really disappointed. Also the first night, we headed to the red lounge, and it was nice, nothing great. BUT for the next 4 days we would walk right in and out, Why? Because the SAME songs were played over and over again each night. Sadly, that was the only thing to do at night. For which, we then decided to walk around the hotel and go to bed early... I did want to commend one of the servers, Laura who was an absolute sweetheart! Always gave nothing but incredible service by the beach. PS. Was extremely disappointed to see how many individuals would not tip, leave a mess like pigs..absolute arrogance. These workers work extremely hard And people could not leave a DOLLAR, but can purchase an all inclusive vacation. We were both extremely sad to see this.
Overall this resort was not bad, could  have been more pleasant, if they improve on their entertainment and quality of food.

reviews.author: Magna
reviews.title: Best vacation ever!
reviews.text:
I absolutely loved my experience at the  Paradisus Cancun! The checked in process was fast and the first impression was great.. the food was better than we expected and the room super comfortable. The only complaint  was not getting a king size bed (considering we're on our honeymoon). I called the front desk to ask for a king size and was told there none available... to call next day but we just decided to keep what we had once we opened our bags, there was too much work pack again.
The restaurants were great, specially Mole! Omg the chef is super talented and Francisco provided the best service. Fuego was great too.. 
We also enjoyed the buffet and the open bar! I recommend Paradisus Cancun and we will be back next year.

reviews.author: Rachel M
reviews.title: It's not great and it's not terrible.
reviews.text: I don't have anything bad to say about the Paradisus. The staff was always wonderful, especially Jesus at the pool bar. But I have stayed at several resorts in the Cancun area (Rui Peninsula, Now, Secrets) and all are relatively close in price range and all are better in quality. The beach is gorgeous at this resort, but the beach is gorgeous everywhere in Cancun. I never had outstanding food but I never had bad food, it was always just ok. The mixed drinks were very weak but the bartenders were very happy to provide alcohol when asked. It appears to be an older resort that some of the newer places are just passing up in respect to modernness. For the price it's nice for a few days.

reviews.author: nilofer k
reviews.title: 4 day stay at paradisus cancun
reviews.text:
Stayed at paradisus for 4 nights end of april.
Overall, I would say we had a great time and a good experience.
We have stayed at a lot of all inclusive resorts and paradisus is on top of our list.  We were overall very satisfied with the hotel and also the  food.  The food at the buffet was great and they had a lot of variety.  Our favorite restaurant was the sushi place.  They had really good quality of fish and they were very generous with the portions.
Also, it was not difficult getting reservations at the restaurants.
Apart from all this I would really like to take the time to give my appreciation to the house keeping staff.
My husband left his Apple laptop in the room and did not realize until we returned home.  The house keeping staff turned the laptop to lost and found and the hotel shipped it to us.  I was absolutely awed by this gesture and their honestly.  And, for this alone I would return to this property again

reviews.author: Rcain_LUV_2travel
reviews.title: Fantastic service and stay
reviews.text:
Absolutely loved my stay at the Paradisus. This is my 6th visit to Cancun and first time with this chain and I was pleasantly surprised. This is my favorite hotel now. 

The staff was very attentive in every aspect. From the hosts and wait staff at restaurants, to waiters at the pool to maintenance. Everyone was very pleasant and helpful. The grounds were kept immaculate. My room was very clean and looked new (I stayed in building 3). The food at the buffet was outstanding. The only slight was the food at the Japanese restaurant, it was bland and not much to it. The wait staff was very attentive. 

At the Mediterranean restaurant my waiter was ok but the host was outstanding. They didn't have pinot grigio at the restaurant and he took it upon himself to go to another bar and get it for me. I was traveling/dining alone and little things like this left a very positive impression. 

The pool was huge and clean. There were even shows poolside during the afternoon which I really enjoyed. At many all inclusive resorts it can be difficult to get a waiter while lounging near the pool. That wasn't the case here. I had a wonderful gentleman (can't remember his name). I'd hand him a $5 bill and he would come around for the rest of the day. He was always pleasant and helpful if I needed to find a chair, which could be difficult to find later in the morning. 

The fridge in the room actually kept my drinks COLD. It's rare, even in hotels in the states, most are barely cool. Beverages were restocked daily and there were snack too! The towels in the room are bath sheet size. Those are huge if you've never used them. No mold or bugs anywhere. They even have disposable drawer liners in the drawers. That way you're guaranteed fresh drawers to put personal items in. 

The grounds were immaculate, well kept and beautiful. There are real flower arrangements throughout the resort. 

I vacationed solo but checked out the kids area for possible future travel. They have 2 kid's areas divided by age. Babies to kids age 5, and 5-12. Unfortunately it is quite the age difference but I still see my son having a great time; he's 4. There's a building near there that has family suites and concierge. The children's pool is also there. It's 2 feet in depth with build in sun lounge chairs. It's a perfect depth for my son to play in since he doesn't know how to swim.

Highly recommend this resort. Great quality and value.

reviews.author: Clare C
reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: The hotel is large and was very beautiful.  The pools were never overcrowed and the service was excellent!  Our only regret is that we were ther for 5 nights and did not have the opportunity to experiece all the dining options.

reviews.author: avaldez_vanessa
reviews.title: Great family experience.
reviews.text: I definitely recommend staying at Paradisus Cancun. We had a wonderful visit.  We took the kids to the kids club a twice to take a break from the sun and they loved it.  Lots of toys and room to run around.  The kids pool area was great too!.  The food was terrific and there was plenty of variety.  The shows at night were fun.  We enjoyed our stay.

reviews.author: travelchic138
reviews.title: Best Wedding Ever
reviews.text: My wedding planning started off as a disaster and ended as a fairytale.  I was supposed to get married at Me Cancun, but with all the construction delays we were going back and forth with a location and if the resort was going to be open in time. it was a crazy experience. Then Irma, the planner at Me Cancun introduced me to Melina the wedding coordinator for Paradisus. I cannot say enough about these 2 ladies. Irma had been with me through the whole process and Melina just fell right in with great energy. I want to thank you all again for the best wedding ever. I cannot tell you how perfect everything was from the beginning to the end. I hate to say this but I am actually glad that Me was still under construction because I was able to experience something new and I will definitely be back to visit. Once again thank you ladies for working so hard to make it happen.

reviews.author: ashley d
reviews.title: Love
reviews.text:
Loved everything about this place 
Everybody was nice very helpful and over all very welcoming will definitely be going back to this place it was worth every penny. I'm in my 20's and went with friends

reviews.author: JRod1977
reviews.title: Service is key at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Butlers Gabriel and Fernanda were beyond helpful and extra thoughtful.took care of dinner and spa reservations,secured spots and towels by the pool/beach everyday, made wife's bday special with surprise cake and flowers in our room, even delivering her gift for me. Our kids 3and1yrs old were always thought of with extra supplies toys etc. Even had bathing suit malfunction and within minutes were poolside with a solution. Made relaxing so much easier. They reminded me of John Tatturo in Mr Deeds, every time I turned around,there they were asking if we needed anything(BUT IN A GOOD WAY). If not they were a cell phone call away. Thank god for those 2. Now to Yhi Spa... That is a must, best the day before you leave.. the sauna/steam/aquatic start to treatment is good and then comes in the massage. my wife and I did the couples pkg and it has to be one of the best massages I ever received and for the price way better than anything in NYC. Waiters here were always around, never had and empty cup. Relaxation, sun, and Fun.

reviews.author: travelingc
reviews.title: Simply heaven
reviews.text: The food was outstanding, top shelf liquor and talented bartenders who were creative and fun, amazing service and breathtaking local. Located right across from Aquaworld where the jungle tour was not to be missed! All in aall, perfect hotel for our family reunion.

reviews.author: zinnfamjam
reviews.title: Most beautiful vacation yet!
reviews.text:
We stayed at paradisus Cancun for the week of April 22. We were traveling with our 9 month old daughter and although we were very nervous, the staff went above and beyond to ensure she was always comfortable and offered her baby friendly foods such as chopped up bananas, apple juice and bottled water. The hotel itself is beyond beautiful and the lobby makes you feel like you're outdoors. The beach and pool area are both pristine! What we were most impressed with though was the outstanding service from all the staff!! To name a few: Veronica the server at the pool always came back to ensure we had everything we needed, Luis was also amazing! The restaurant servers went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed and treated us all like royalty!! 

As for the rooms, they are beautiful! We had a lagoon view suite and were very pleased with the view! 

We had travelled to Mexico in the past and were not overly impressed however this trip exceeded all of our expectations! We will definitely be staying at Paradisus Cancun again in the future! :)

reviews.author: Ron B
reviews.title: Great Place!
reviews.text: Very friendly and helpful staff. Great location and beach. My wife and I really enjoyed the buffet and overall food quality. The restaurants were fine. Would come back again. Rooms were nice. We were treated very well.

reviews.author: Darine N
reviews.title: My Cancun first experience
reviews.text: I really enjoyed my stay at Paradisus...Very well located, luxurious hotel and many amenities.Too bad our stay was too short in Cancun that we couldnt take the opportunity to try the spa and the many restaurants in the resort.

reviews.author: kevinpB5858IS
reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: Just stayed at the Paradisus Cancun for the second year in a row and equally satisfied the second time.  Great and relaxing environment.  I would highly recommend trying their Royal Service if you are going without kids.

reviews.author: W7550PUpierrec
reviews.title: Outstanding get away
reviews.text: We stayed from April 15-18, just a short get away, but everything was perfect, great facility, nice ocean view room on the 8th floor, outstanding food, staff was courteous, pleasant and proactive.  We enjoyed the spa experience as well with the best massage ever!  Just wish there was more seating availability around the pools, but I would go back in a split second.  I highly recommend it!

reviews.author: 752constanceb
reviews.title: #1 tip= TIP
reviews.text:
My party was switched to this resort because the original resort we book was not done being renovated. The resort is visually appealing. There is a luxurious spa feeling throughout. We did not get the Royal service but I can see how it is worth the penny. We tip very well so I had not problems with service. I also noticed that the Royal service guest food was a little better. You must try the shrimp chirviche! My friend had her wedding there and you could not beat the back drop of the ocean. We had a nice time.
I gave it 4 stars because the food was not the best. I tried very hard to try and appreciate the dishes but they tasted mass produced and did not impress. Your best bet is to make reservations as soon as you check in for the restaurants. I liked the Market Grill. The petite beef was pretty good. I was disappointed int he lack of seafood options. 
You also have to tell the bartender what drink to put in your drink or you are stuck with watered down  well options.
Overall the service is very good. Just be sure to tip! The beach was one of the nicest ones I seen. There was plenty of tikis to lay under and plenty of drinks being served.

reviews.author: Alberto R
reviews.title: Used to be a great hotel, Going down unfortunately.
reviews.text:
This is our fourth trip to this resort and we obviously came back to enjoy the same quality of food and environment. My surprise was that the condition of the hotel (facilities) is getting worst every time. My room balcony door did looked like it was damaged by a hurricane to the point it would not work. The air conditioning sounded like it was going to fall apart and leaking water all the time. Took their maintenance crew about 6 hours to send someone to put tape and reduce the annoying whistle noise of the door. 
Other than that, people working there were wonderful to the point it overcome my room condition. My wife and I had a great time.

reviews.author: Kimberly Alfau
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: I love this hotel, so big, the rooms amazing, the staff very gentle. The food very good. And they have amazing view of the beach. Everything very close, and its in the Hotel Zone, you can go see more. And you Cime back to your hotel. Very good complex. I will go back again with my family.

reviews.author: Kenneth K
reviews.title: Don't be fooled by their lobby
reviews.text: Lobby is beautiful it's like a rain forest.  Food is poor, cleanliness of restaurants that I was able to actually eat at was poor, reservations of the nicer restaurants says one day not true but plenty of open tables.  Maybe this is how they save money on the all inclusive. Many restaurants listed in their property but seating in some is few except for buffet restaurants.  You literally can walk in one restaurant and exit thru another.    Bathroom with a fiberglass tub/ shower and a bidet that needed updated made me want to run out of their "resort".   Seating around pool is nuts definitely not enough seating and crowded.  lounge chair was broken

reviews.author: Michele N
reviews.title: Paradisus - a real Paradise
reviews.text: The hotel was beautiful and loved the plants they had in the lobbies.  Friendly staff-great service, excellent food and just a good overall atmosphere.  It is worth getting the Royal Service.  Would definitely return here!

reviews.author: BermudaBilly
reviews.title: Wonderful hotel with amazing service
reviews.text: Highly recommend the hotel.  High level of service, great food with a large choice of restaurants. Good quality drinks.  All the staff were brilliant but special mentions for Daniel, our butler, Lazario, Moises and Eddie, they really made the visit special and enjoyable.

reviews.author: 788agustinm
reviews.title: Royal service is way to go!
reviews.text: Second time staying here and had another phenomenal experience. Highly recommend it! Staff was friendly throughout the hotel, very attentive and ready to assist. My birthday passed while I was there and the staff surprised me with a birthday cake and ballons... very nice touch

reviews.author: Jocelyn P
reviews.title: Incredible service
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun for a week. What can we say: It is a Meliá all the way! The place is generally clean, staff is courteous and polite, a smile coming up to their face very easily. They want your stay to be memorable. The private beach is beautiful and well furnished (chairs and big bamboo sun shades along with beach beds).

The staff wants to make sure you do not run out of beverage, being water, beer or local specialties. Having gone to other Meliá hotels, and the Paradisus at Playa Del Carmen, people will notice the difference: The hotel is 29 years old and there are some parts that unfortunately look 30 years. For example, the air conditioning units in the rooms are a little bit more noisier then in newer hotels. But all electrical outlets and lighting have been upgraded and it’s modern (in-wall USB chargers, did not even use my chargers). About the food, well, there is pretty much everything or every taste! The tapas restaurant Vento were super, the Fuego was excellent. Overall, we were not disappointed. We were less thrilled with Enso, which is a kind of fusion oriental (Thaï, indian, Chineese). I liked the Mahi-mahi Tandoori but could have been tastier. But you know, taste is very subjective... Some people adore sushi, but I am not a fan. The Bana, right in the center pyramid, was very nice, and serves good sushi.

As we stayed through the Club Meliá, we were pampered!! Our concierge Claudia is a gift from the Gods! She is beautiful, honest, helpfull, what else can we say just in a few words. And we must not forget our butler Ana Velasco who was so nice to us, so cheerful and attentive and took care of anything we needed regarding our room or outdoor stuff like reservation of private Bali beds near the pools or on the beach.

I will go back to that hotel just because of the excellent service they have. It’s simply a Meliá!

reviews.author: Marc-André H
reviews.title: Nice and relaxing vacation
reviews.text: Very good services, anywhere y ou go, somebody is ready to feed pour need. Spécial tank to Gerardo at the  Vento,  all the staff at the  Mole and at the Bana. My wife and i Also apreciate all the litle attention from Judith show took care of us during pour vacation.

reviews.author: craftysue62
reviews.title: Been to better
reviews.text:
After staying at the Paridisius Palma Real in Punta Cana and having a wonderful time during a 7 day stay we decided that we would book the Paridisius Cancun and stay for 10 days this time. We where greatly surprised that there could be such a difference between two Melia resorts.

At the Palma Real we did not have royal service and still had a great time as the resort had such beautiful grounds open to all and events on the beach a few times during our stay.

We decided to go for royal service this time as there is a issue with specialty restaurant reservations without having royal service.Check in was quick and staff was excellent. Our butler Maria was top notch and assisted us in making all our dinner reservations. The room was nice except for view low floor lagoon view huge balcony but hardly used.

Servers at all restaurants were excellent, please tip these people they work so hard for so little pay,it does get you more personalized service but did notice they were very nice to those who did not.

The water is beautiful at the beach but was rough most days.when the wind died out and the waves calmed down its breath taking. Our biggest complaint about the beach is that the tide never seemed to go out any so long walks on the beach were difficult as the water is almost up to the shore line and there is a drop offf from the sand level.

Pools where plentiful from quiet in the royal service area to swim up pool at building 3, royal service is building 5. Nice beach service at the royal service beach where a bucket of bottled water was supplied at your chairs. Beach chairs on the beach are horrible no padding and just two positions. Come on for what they charge for royal service padded chairs should be the norm as in other resorts we have been to.

Food was good at the buffets with many choices. Specialty restaurants was ok have had much better with very poor desserts at the specialty ones. We would skip desserts and return to the buffet after dinner for deserts.

Our biggest complaint is the lack.of a theater for the entertainment shows. They are held in a bar lounge where there is club type beds were people lay down trying to whatch a show that is visible to only those that get on these ridiculous beds and couches. There is limited couches with any kind of waitress service where one can have a drink and chill though out the resort.

If you have trouble walking up stairs this is not the resort you should go to. You must walk up stairs almos everywhere. To the beach, to the restaurants, to the pools. Oh yes all the pools are deep over five feet so walking in pools are not easy.

If you want to do Melia resort go to Paridisius in Punta Cana there is no comparison between the two when it comes to entertainment and grounds.

reviews.author: Jackie N
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: A 5-star resort for sure!  The lobby is beautiful, the rooms are spacious and everything is clean. The restaurant food was superior and each of them had a special ambiance!  Our favorite was The Market Place-Argentina Steak House.  The staff are friendly everywhere you go.  People are so generous and willing to help you. Karla Sanchez was our personal concierge for the week.  She assisted in setting up reservations for dinner and all events we attended.  We appreciated her and the service she provided very much.

reviews.author: Meg K
reviews.title: Fun with friends!
reviews.text: So relaxing and easy. We had a stress free wonderful vacation. Very much enjoyed the Royal Service! So nice to have the adults only section which had direct access to the beach, a nice pool, delicious food and soaking tubs, too.

reviews.author: kevinC8560AN
reviews.title: Best location Hotel
reviews.text: Power outage 4 times a day. some restaurant had high room temp setting. we have kids and have to leave early to take a shower. other place are ok. food selection were limited as most of the place must have reservations and we are not coming in peek season.

reviews.author: Robert M
reviews.title: Great  guacamole classes
reviews.text:
Just took a guacamole class with Andrea and Leticia. They were great and now I can bring a little mexician cooking home with me back to Canada. The food is amazing in the NAOS buffet. The entertainment at night is fun and even seen the mexician Michael Jackson. 

Thanks

reviews.author: Shianne Z
reviews.title: Cancun - Tropical Paradise
reviews.text: For anyone wanting to stay at Melia Paradisus in Cancun, i would suggest the hotel hands down. The resort was fantastic, the staff friendly and eager to assist or just say a friendly hello. The food was great, always drinks of any variety available. Only downfall i am a smoker. I do not like to throw my cigarettes on the floor or in the garden or on the beach. I had to resort to using an empty bottle so that i could throw it away later. Other than that being my only complaint, everything else was absolutely amazing and i will defiantly be returning soon.

reviews.author: afn75980
reviews.title: Wonderful Parents Getaway
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed at the Paradisus Cancun for 5 days and 4 nights for a quick parents getaway after just having our first child. We chose this hotel as we RCI timeshare owners and were looking for a good quality quick trip. The Paradisus Cancun by far exceeded our expectations!!

Despite the reviews, check in was very quick and easy. We arrived super early in the morning and were even offered early check in so our room was ready by 10am. To kill some time before the room was ready we changed, stored our bags and decided to grab breakfast and hit the beach. Since I am a nursing mother, I needed somewhere to pump before heading outside. Karla our amazing concierge through the Club Melia program provided a family restroom for me to go in so that I was more comfortable and could begin to enjoy my vacation. I was so happy that this could be accommodated, and she was truly the best throughout the remainder of our stay!!

Room: We were located on the Club Melia side of the resort in tower one. The room was a clean and fairly large suite with built in kitchen area which was nice. Fridge was always fully stocked with drinks and treats which my husband enjoyed. Only downside was the room was located on the ground floor with a view of the parking lot. Because we were doing a short stay and hardly in the room we didn't mind it too much.

Beach: Very clean clear water and the wait staff was great! One of the female waitresses even had our orders memorized just two days into our trip. As new parents we were already used to getting up early, so we headed out by 8am to reserve our chairs and never had a problem getting one.

Food: Since we were only there for a short time we didn't get to try all the restaurants but really enjoyed Bana (sushi), Enso (Asian), Market Grill (Brazilian steakhouse) , and Fuego (Peruvian). The buffet was actually one of the best ones we have experienced at an all-inclusive resort! Very clean, and offering a wide variety of tasty food options. 

Spa/Gym: Managed to make it to the gym a fews days of our stay and really enjoyed it! Equipment was in working order and they had pretty much everything you need. I actually took a crossfit class with Martin and he was amazing! He was so nice and energetic which really made the class fun. We also did a couples massage and thought it was amazing! The staff was very nice and the spa overall was very well kept. You won't be disappointed with booking any spa services!

Entertainment: Each night around 8:30pm there are shows right outside one of the bars with a view of the ocean. Whether it was live music, dancers and even acrobats all of them were very entertaining. It was nice to have something to watch and then grab a couple drinks before going to bed. There was also a nightclub onsite but we only attended for a short time one evening.

Service: All the staff at this resort went above and beyond to accommodate us. Because we came in through RCI we were invited to do a timeshare presentation. Kayla was our presenter and she was truly phenomenal!! She showed us all aspects of the property and was professional and very personable. She was truly that amazing! Everyone that the resort was extremely nice and anything we needed was never too much to ask. Really that's what sets this resort apart from all others in Cancun!

Overall, we really loved our stay at the Paradisus Cancun. It was a perfect relaxing getaway and one of our top vacations thus far. We will definitely be back again!!

reviews.author: emosbergen
reviews.title: Beautiful resort & Royal Service had amazing service!
reviews.text:
It was my first time in Cancun. It was a special occasion and we did the Royal Service - it was worth every penny! We had Rosanna and she was nothing but professional, friendly & helpful!! The check-in experience was smooth, other than a hiccup about our upgrade to Royal Service. The food was upscale & delicious - the only "bad" comment I would have is the beer selection- but I've been told by friends that it is common to only have Sol, DosEquis, and Tecate (Paradisus had Heineken so this was a plus).
The Royal Service gave you access to the adults-only pool, a Bali bed (2 days), and a room in Pyramid 5 (adults only), plus a butler! We would definitely do Royal Service again! The only negative about Royal Service was that you could not pick your Bali bed (although we saw some "regulars" that seemed to have first dibs). The staff at the Adults-only side was amazingly friendly and helpful! There was only one server who was rude- Moises. However, we asked our butler to get another server for us and she not only got us the amazingly helpful and sweet server we had the day before (we forgot her name, but were told she was the only female server at the adult-only pool), but our butler also told Moises' supervisor and he came to talk to us to make sure we were comfortable and that our complaint was taken seriously.
 The only negative I noticed about the main hotel was that the main pool was very busy and had a party vibe. But, if you like quiet and relaxing (like we do), you should pay for access to the adult-only pool.

reviews.author: Debbie & Jose R
reviews.title: Average resort
reviews.text: Our butler Maria was excellent. She was very attentive and accommodating. Service from  servers Carlos at Vento, Arturo, Armando, Pasquale, in Naos was excellent. The room was very nice, although I would have preferred an Ocean view. The beach was gorgeous, but must get there early to reserve lounge chairs. Would have been more comfortable if they had cushions. Too many stairs to climb all over resort. Even the beach had quite a few steps to walk up and down. Entertainment was limited and not enough comfortable seating at the Avenue bar where show takes place. There is no theater like most resorts have. Although everyone was nice, I don't think I would return.

reviews.author: Gigi
reviews.title: Relaxing vacation
reviews.text:
Excellent location with walking distance to malls and upscale shops.
  Wide and beautiful beach. Lots of activities by the pool if you like .
Variety of restaurants to choose from during your stay , friendly staff and superior service .

reviews.author: juanrM688BX
reviews.title: Excellent hotel, instalation y restaurant.
reviews.text: All restaurants are excellent, the attention and pool area. The only bad situation is the resort club hosts whos insist in sell the membership of Melia Club at all cost. The best restaurant are Fuego, Enso and the Japanese  one. The beach is ok taking in consideration that it is oceanic. Just one think, I don't think that the bungalow must be paid additional. The hotel most have these as part of the package.

reviews.author: GratitudeBryn
reviews.title: One of the best resorts/all inclusives we've ever stayed at!
reviews.text:
What a phenomenal experience from start to finish.  We were treated like VIPs and every thing we asked for was provided.  My wife has food allergies and eating abroad is always a challenge, but not at Melia.  We turn in her allergy list and every dining experience comes with custom dishes prepared just for her, and they are all delicious!  

The hotel is filled with "Wow!" and "Look at that!" moments from the design to the lighting to every little detail.  My wife LOVES it when I tell her we are staying at a Melia resort.  She almost doesn't want to go anyplace else.

reviews.author: Julie E
reviews.title: Great break
reviews.text: Visited the Paradisus for a 4 night stay on the way to Cuba. Lovely hotel with helpful staff. The choice of restaurants was great and the food was excellent. Loved the pina coladas at the swim up bar.

reviews.author: twinkernella
reviews.title: Amazing trip!
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus for a week, celebrating my fiance's birthday and we upgraded to royal service when we got there.  I am so happy we did!  Galdino was our butler and he was so nice and took care of everything we wanted.  I enjoyed the Royal Service pool and loved the Bali beds.   All of the staff were super nice and went out of their way to help you but Eddie at La Palapa was one of the best!  Also, Omar, our server at Fuego, made our dinner there unforgettable.  The drinks were great and every restaurant had good food, even the buffet, which made the all inclusive package well worth it.  The mini-bar was stocked daily and the housekeeper came by each evening for turn down service.  Having 24 hour room service was also great when we had to leave early for an all day trip and before we left for the airport.  The beach was nice, not over crowded and you could get a lounge chair with no problems and beach towels were readily available.  This was our first time in Cancun and we had a blast.  Paradisus exceeded my expectations and made for a great trip.

reviews.author: Roshni N
reviews.title: GREAT SERVICE & RESORT
reviews.text: I just got back from a 5 day stay at Paradisus and it was Fantastic! We stayed on the eigth floor and had a lagoon facing view which was beautiful! The pool was was big and spacious and so was the swim up bar. There were a lot of different food options Blue Agave is probably my favourite they had authentic mexican food! The best part about the trip was the service! It was excellent! We were always greeted with smiling faces and all our needs were taken care of. The hotel also has a person selling tours in the lobby which was good

reviews.author: jessicarE5625LE
reviews.title: So many issues!
reviews.text: The "hotel tour" is actually a sales presentation, and doesn't last for 90 mins, but instead lasts for 2 hours and 15 mins, your entire morning. You're told you are getting a VIP breakfast... you just sit at another table but go through the buffet like everyone else. You are told you're getting a free return trip, but they don't mention the activation fee as well as the $88 per person you have to pay when you return for your stay for the "All Inclusive Package". You are also told you will get a 50 min massage, it is actually 40 mins. Just a ton of BAIT AND SWITCH. Many of the couch cushions are torn, electric candles are out, when it rained and leaked, they just threw towels on the floor. There is very little effort to get adults hanging out with each other. On the 2nd day of our stay, we were woken up at 8 am by construction going on in the room next to us, loud banging and terrible odors. The hotel moved our room, but made ZERO effort to compensate us for this inconvenience. It was just a poor stay.

reviews.author: V77Leigh
reviews.title: 2 weeks of Royal Service!
reviews.text:
Just wow. 
We went as a couple for 2 weeks all inclusive in the Adults only - Royal service section with a sea view.The adults only section is 100% times better than the regular. Larger pool, plenty of sun beds, own beach area, 2 own breakfast areas, private check in and your own butler. Only the royal service rooms are allowed in this section. i would definitely recommend it.

Definitely book all inclusive, so so worth it. Food in every a la carte restaurant is amazing with so much choice. All alcohol is premium quality, no watered down rubbish! 

We booked all of our excursions via the hotel, which was very efficient, although a little expensive very worth it. (We spent around $1,200 on 5 tours)

Currency wise, take dollars. This is what everyone wants, all stores, taxi's, tips etc. 
Bus stop right outside the hotel to the main strip is around 5-10 mins, bargain price of $1 and the buses are flowing constantly. 

Rooms with a sea view are gorgeous. The beach is beautiful golden sand. The rooms are clean, modern and very well equipped. All Items in the mini bar are all included in the package and refreshed everyday. 24 hour room service is also great, especially after a night in Coco-bongo!
