(Located on the main strip, definitely worth a visit. A lot of fun) ! Maids do a lovely job and come around again at about 7pm to refresh towels. 

All the staff are so lovely and nothing is too much to ask. They all remembered our names and always said hello! Our butler was Hector and he really is a credit to the hotel. As well as Omar who works in the pool hut. 

All in all, it was a very memorable holiday and would be more than happy to return when in mexico. Thank you Paradisus x

reviews.author: cindy f
reviews.title: Love Paradisus Royal Service!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus from April 21st to 26 celebrating our 25th wedding anniversary.  I can't say enough good things about this resort and its' staff!  From the moment you enter, everyone is so friendly and welcoming.  We started off in the main lobby where we were greeted and given a brief tour while making our way to the Royal Service check in  There we received cool towels and drinks and were checked in and met our butler Erik.  He was awesome!!! He decorated our room with rose petals for our anniversary and had champagne and a fresh fruit plate waiting for us.  He took care of all of our reservations, checked on us frequently to see if we needed anything,  and even printed our boarding passes.  The resort is beautiful and the Royal Service area is so worth it. All the staff were great but Eddie and Valeria at La Palapa/beach service were incredible, as well as the Royal Service front desk who moved us to a higher floor on our request.  Can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: K_Van
reviews.title: Everything is Excellent - especially the Service
reviews.text:
We just left Paradisus yesterday after 1 week at the resort.  We stayed in an oceanfront room without the Royal Service. I've stayed in approx 20 resorts in Mexico (with many in Cancun and the Riviera Maya) and Paradisus was definitely the best. 

The Service is Amazing!

Keep in mind that we didn't upgrade to the Royal Service and I'm glad we didn't - it's totally unnecessary.  The staff trip over themselves to help you. You never wait on the beach longer than 10 mins to be asked if you want another drip. Same goes for the pool. And if you are lucky enough to get Ascuncion in your section, you'll never wait. We started to plan our beach/pool chairs based on where she was covering.  She remembered our names and drinks after the first day and was soooooo friendly.  She loved her job and it showed.   In this respect, Gabriela (Gabby/Anna) was the same in the Avenue Bar. She remembered our names and drinks and ran over to greet us every time she saw us. 

I can't think of one bad service moment from the entire trip. We had a minor problem with our room and the concierge (Rosa) had a new room, with the keys for us in less than 10 minutes. And then she came up to make sure the new room was ok. 

The Restaurants 

All great.  Bana was our favourite. Awesome, creative sushi. Blue Agave had great tacos. Market Grill was a meat lover's dream. We didn't try Mole. The buffet was really good for all meals - tons of options. Emiliano and Julio were constantly helping. We also loved the tuna sandwiches at the pool Snack Bar.  It was just a great snack while drinking during the day. 

The Beach

Perfect. Nothing else to say. We got a palapa every day without needing to go down early to reserve. 

The Pool

Is huge and really spread out so we could always find a private area to float or sit with our legs in the water. 

The Room

Excellent.  Replenished bar fridge with beer and snacks. Huge private deck to sit on.  Every room has a huge private balcony. No one can see you from either side. 

Although I like to try different places, we've decided to go back to the Paradisus Cancun again next year because I can't see another resort being as good and we'll just be disappointed.

reviews.author: Julie N
reviews.title: great value all-inclusive!
reviews.text:
We had an oceanfront room with a gorgeous view! The staff was amazing, especially Martin Andrade, the fitness instructor (thank you for all the tough classes so I did not gain weight on this vacation!) and Veronica in the Yhi spa (fantastic massage.)
The food was good, the wine OK, I heard the tequila was great! We enjoyed the entertainment and the activities under the stars. Wish we could have stayed longer than 5 nights!

reviews.author: N6339GBchrisg
reviews.title: Good Experience
reviews.text: I would love this hotel if they had a better Air Conditioning System, the lobby, and restaurants are extremely hot, other than that it was a really great experience, the entire staff was super friendly and the food is absolutely fantastic!

reviews.author: dpbeyer
reviews.title: Great place for a wedding!
reviews.text:
We went to Paradisus to attend our son's wedding and this was a fabulous venue.  The food - the service - the atmosphere - the staff friendliness & helpfulness - all were top notch.  We were so glad our kids picked Paradisus for their wedding.  We stayed 8 days/7 nights in Royal Service and were treated like royalty.  We ate a different restaurant each night and they were all fabulous -even the one we paid for!  We booked a Chichen Itza tour right at the hotel and it was a marvelous day.  My wife & i can't can't say enough good things about the experience - very highly recommended.  And although it rained the 2 days before the wedding the skies cooperated and the wedding on the beach came off perfectly!
w

reviews.author: Elizabeth P
reviews.title: The Butlers were fantastic
reviews.text: The service was outstanding because of Alexander and Josue.  We had the family concierge level and these two were our butlers.  They were always accessible and went out of their way to help.  The service was considerably better than Iberostar Cancun and Barcelo the last two places we stayed.

reviews.author: joharra_ceniza
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun review
reviews.text: I had an amazing stay at this hotel.  The customer service was perfect for instance, the server at the NAOS buffet remembered us after Day 1 and directed the waitress to seat us in his area.  The staff is friendly and professional. The complaints I had were the wifi was good inside the hotel and in my room but didn't reach the pool area as good.  Also, the AC in the rooms were not as cool as I hoped only because it's extremely hot and humid outside during the day.  Lastly, the ATM was not working during my last 2 days stay there so make sure you bring enough cash.  They accept dollar, even at the market place down the street.

reviews.author: Jordan_Debol
reviews.title: Royal Service/ La Palapa
reviews.text:
Recently, we had an excellent experience with the royal service upgrade. From the minute we first entered the resort our experience was wonderful. The royal service staff were very friendly and more than willing to help with whatever we needed. We had great experiences with the housekeeping staff, pool boys and the waiters at almost all of the restaurants. Specifically, Edier Cab - waiter at the Royal Service's La Palapa restaurant, was one of our favorite waiters. He was very friendly and helpful and we purposefully sought him out for all of our breakfasts and lunches when possible. 

We would definitely recommend spending the extra money to upgrade to the Royal Service. Some of the benefits that we appreciated the most were: reservable cabanas by the pool, ability to make reservations at almost all of the restaurants, private pool, section of the beach was private, butler services, and many more.

We thought the food was very good. Our favorite restaurants for dinner were: Fuego, Bana and Enso. For breakfast and lunch we definitely recommend La Palapa (exclusive to Royal Service guests) due to the excellent food and the views of the beach since the restaurant is outside. 

Although it was not required, we decided to tip for most of our services. As we were not prepared for this, it was often hard to break larger bills as the only people who could help you were the waiters and bell boys. Therefore I would recommend bringing smaller bills if you plan on tipping so you don't have to hassle with breaking larger bills.

Overall, we had a great time and a great experience at the Paradisus Cancun resort! We are hoping to go back again soon!

reviews.author: Wendy C
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: Loved the staff.. The cleanliness of the location was great...everyone was on point with everything....the night shows at avenue bar were very entertaining ....the staff at the beach are was amazing ....very friendly...

reviews.author: BonTerre
reviews.title: Wonderful Hotel, Best Services!!
reviews.text:
I am writing to express my sincere appreciation for the service that I received while visiting Hotel Paradisus Cancun from May 20 thru May 23, 2016. Upon arrival in our room, we discovered a water leak dripping from our bathroom ceiling. I called customer service and was told that the Resort was at full capacity and that there was no room available for us to move into. After calling the second time concerning the leak Ms. Rosa Lee from concierge came to our room to check the damage. When she saw the damage she apologized and said again that the resort was at full capacity, but that she would try her best to find a remedy for our situation. She came back shortly to tell us that we would be moved to a suite since there were no more rooms available. We were very happy with the room that was assigned to us, but the suite was just beautiful. Ms. Rosa Lee made sure that our luggage was moved and told us that if we needed anything else to please call and she would take care of it. We called her several times about making restaurant reservations and activities for our kids and each time she exceeded our expectations with her reply that she would happy to help. 
Your resort is very nice and we hope to return again soon, but our stay was made much more special by the friendly and efficient service of Ms. Rosa Lee. Please let her know that she is very special to us and we hope to visit her again soon.

reviews.author: Madelyn M
reviews.title: Love this resort!
reviews.text: Staff is so kind and accommodating. Location is great, close to downtown markets, shopping malls and nightlife! The restaurant, Bana, is my favorite restaurant in the resort. Overall, great experience

reviews.author: Cashstro215
reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text:
Ive been to mexico twice now once to cabo san lucas and this time to cancun. I was searching around for all inclusive resorts and came across paradisus. I read the reviews and talked to my agent who also recommended this resort. 
I was not let down at all, when you first get there it can be a little overwhelming because the resort is so big. The moment you walk through the doors you are greeted with hospitality and a cold drink. I opted to do the "my time" package with the private check in so everything was quick and i was off to my room. 
I had a direct ocean view on the 5th floor, everything was included meals drinks room service etc. They have a very large pool with a swim up bar that can get very crowded quickly so i would advise you to get out there early if you plan on relaxing by the pool.

There are plenty restaurants but you will have to make reservations for them 24hrs prior and thats still not guaranteed. I tried to 
make reservations snd everything was booked pretty much everynight so i had to do the buffet a few nights. The buffet isn't bad at all, a lot of variety and flavors.
My only question is since this is mexico why cant i get a corona anywhere on the resort? Someone please explain this to me, this is my second time in mexcio staying on a resort that didnt offer corona's. Thats like me going to dunkin donuts and them saying they dont have any donuts.

reviews.author: Carlos C
reviews.title: Surprisingly Awesome!!!
reviews.text: Second time staying at a Melia Hotel. I have to say, they are consistently awesome. Stayed here with my family and they took great care of us. Had a small bump in the road in the beginning, expressed my concerns and had the Hotel Manager and the Family Concierge Manager (Ms. Reyes) meet with me and my family. Ms. Reyes took very good care of us. The food was great and the staff was super helpful. The beach views and access was amazing. I definitely recommend this hotel for families looking for great memories.

reviews.author: Frank R
reviews.title: Our vacation
reviews.text: The resort was amazing. The staff were very helpful.  When we checked in they upgraded us to the royal services. The food was great at the buffet and at the market grill. The views from our room were fabulous. We would go here again and do the royal services without thinking twice about it. The pool was great and we were able to get the beds at poolside a couple of times which were great.  We were able to order lunch and be served right there by the pool. The beach was nice and the ocean was good when we could get in it.

reviews.author: Jamial C
reviews.title: Felt like royalty
reviews.text:
My first time visiting Cancun and I wasn't disappointed. The hotel is huge and you will get loss a time a two walking around, but that's normal. I upgraded to the Royal Service after reading the reviews and it is well worth it. My butler Juan was awesome and made sure we were taken care of daily. Also a special shout out to Omar who works the pool area. He also made our daily visits to the pool enjoyable. 

The beach is beautiful with turquoise color water and white sand. Be careful using outside resort vendors for jet ski's. I paid $60 for 30 minutes and they cut the time to 15 minutes while I was out there. I was able to get half my money back. But use the resources at the hotel to ensure you get what you paid for. I will be back to visit for sure.

reviews.author: Jackquito
reviews.title: Excellent Service - Great Beach - Good Food
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Royal Service Tower With a Luxury Junior Suite Ocean View Room. The view from the room is gorgeous and the service is the best we have experienced (and we travel to Mexico yearly, and some years even twice). We traveled here after a week long vacation going to other places in the USA.

I will divide up the review between Cons and Pros.

Pros:
- Service: Definitely their strongest aspect. Thanks to their service and constant help throughout our stay made the difference between a normal vacation and a GREAT vacation. Many thanks to Galdino our butler and Sandra at the Royal Service Desk. Thanks to them and all of their attention we are already inquiring about having our wedding celebrations here.
- Beach: Now this is a beach you can swim and lounge in for hours on end. The beach is so beautiful that it looks like something out of a magazine. Definitely one of the best beaches in the Riviera Maya section (and Cancun).
- Grounds: All the pyramids around the hotel are connected internally therefore you can go to the main lobby area and back to your room without having to get wet if it rains or if you just do not want to walk in the blistering heat you can do so. This is definitely something to consider especially if you travel during the rainy season and know you might be stuck for a day or two inside the hotel.
- Bali Beds: They change the outer sheet every day! I mean come on, this is great! The outer sheet is like a big towel. I do not know if they wash them or not, but at least I felt a lot more comfortable about sleeping on these beds. This is a great feature and service that other hotels should copy.

Cons:
- Rooms: The rooms are outdated and you can tell the age. Also the hot water is so hard to control. We never could get it right and it was either too cold or too hot so we were constantly adjusting. Also the rooms A/C filter has not been changed in God knows how long. Not to be picky, but some people do have certain allergies that are more susceptible than others and having a good maintenance of an A/C filter I would believe should be one of the most important aspect of room maintenance.
- Tipping A Must: As other reviewers have noticed tipping is a must. Though we tip anyways, but usually have not felt as mandatory. First time that we feel we had to tip to be treated a little bit better. Though tipping should be a choice, we recommend to tip heavily the pool concierge guy in order to get a Bali bed for as many days possible. You are only guaranteed a Bali bed for two days of your entire stay. The rest is upon availability after 11AM each day.
- Food: Food is not the best and we were disappointed with the Palapa restaurant which is only for Royal Service Guests. We were so disappointed that we decided to always go to the main buffet for breakfast and lunch. Also the service here is a bit slow, it seems they are understaffed. The other specialty restaurants are OK, not the best we have had in other resorts. Again, sometimes we would just order room service instead. You know something is not right when guests prefer room service.

Due to these CONS I did not award the property 5 stars, but believe me that the service is the best we have experienced in a while and we try not to let any negatives bring our vacation attitude down. 

In summary Paradisus is a good hotel to stay for a short getaway and if you are a beach person then this is the best place to stay in our opinion. In all the service is the part that made our trip special and we will return, but next time with our families.

reviews.author: Ed L
reviews.title: Great location!
reviews.text: The location is great. The facilities were in need of a few repairs (tiles missing in the pool, cracked stucco on the railings of the balcony...) but not bad.  The staff was friendly with the exception of one staffer, Rafael.  The issue I had was with Rafael, we had early check-in and he told us at that time that we could enjoy the breakfast buffet, we questioned him but he assured us that we could go.  So, we went to the buffet and after we were done we were presented with a bill for $140.  I was upset because Rafael said we could go, so i went to Rafael and he said he didn't say that and we will have to pay for breakfast.  Maybe it was a communication problem but my wife, son, niece and father-in-law all heard the same thing when we checked in.  When we checked out the same thing happened but this time they fixed the bill.  With all that said, I would definitely stay here again, just don't eat the buffet the day you arrive.

reviews.author: August C
reviews.title: Second visit to a great hotel
reviews.text:
This was our second visit to Paradisus Cancun. We stayed from 5/11-5/18.

The inside of this hotel is absolutely beautiful thanks to the long, hanging vines and all other assortment of greenery in the main building. This does lead to higher humidity walking around the hotel, but if you're in Cancun, expect there to be heat.

The building itself is older, but they continue to maintain it. Not many obvious signs of age. The decor is very modern.

Rooms are decently sized, comfortable beds, good pillows, and OK minibars (typical beer, soda, and snack selection). Out of the three rooms I've seen, each have been similar in size and quality, all with the same bathroom layout (toilet and bidet in a separate closed room off the main bathroom), standing shower/tub combo with rainshower faucet, etc.). The lighting, each time, has been incredibly poor. You're better off getting ready in your room with the curtains open and all the lights on. 

Room service menu isn't so great, and often times they brought the wrong food even after confirming the items. Never took very long, though, and other requests were met quickly (such as for towels or extra hangers for the closet).

The restaurant selection is decent here, and the food is usually above average at each of them. We didn't spend the money on Tempo (menu wasn't all that interesting). It was disappointing to see they replaced the outdoor restaurant La Perla with Enso this year. It had been a steak/seafood place with really amazing cuts of beef, including hanger steak, and there's not much else comparable now (aside from the Market Grill, which is Brazilian rodizio). The new restaurant, Enso, is an Asian-fusion style place that we couldn't finish one full meal at. Might interest some but not us.

As for Market Grill, the only place you can get real steak there, it seemed to be hit or miss depending on the night we went. At times it was excellent and we were offered all cuts multiple times, whereas other nights the meat was either raw or very well done and we didn't get offered even half the options. 

If you enjoy sushi, the Japanese restaurant in the middle of the resort is a really nice place to have dinner. It tends to be the most popular, so make reservations 2 days out as much as possible (good idea for any restaurant there really).

We had to play the towel game again for good pool seats. Here's what you do: One person gets up around 7, 730 and heads out with 2 towels and 2 personal items (such as a book or magazine), and places them on the chairs you want. Go have breakfast, then go to your chairs within an hour to be safe. Otherwise, the pool concierge may remove all your items (they say they give you an hour, but they can't really keep track). One thing is for sure, if you don't leave a personal item, your towels will be removed promptly and you'll lose your seats.

The pool area is where the most action happens, but the resort's entertainment is subpar. Two years in a row it's been the most disappointing feature. Feedback I've heard is the management wants to keep a more 'calm' and 'relaxing' environment, but this doesn't fit the clientele at all. Bring a decent wireless speaker with you and the pool crowd will gather around. There's basically no music for the bulk of the day, and the pool bar closes at 5, which is silly.

The beach is beautiful and there's tons of chairs out there, but we always preferred staying close to the pool bar. Waiting for service by the beach took forever, and by the pool areas it was inconsistent. Easier to just go get it yourself. Tipping didn't seem to have an impact on most of the employees here no matter how much you gave, so don't go crazy.

There's also a lack of good nightly entertainment. They have live music in the center of the hotel (the sushi restaurant), which is decent, but the nightly shows by the main bar make it impossible to get a seat without arriving an hour early. It is way too small of a spot and you'll see a lot of other people here complaining of that. In the two times I've been here, I haven't come early enough to snag a seat and actually watch a show. Don't expect I was missing much though.

The fitness center here is a step above most hotels'. Great selection of machines and free weights, along with plenty of cardio machines. They have daily yoga classes and I believe spin classes as well, but the gym is open 24/7. It is connected to the spa, which is also beautiful, but we never got a chance to get any services done there.

A few employees really stood out this time, and both were in the buffet (Naos): Ignacio and Jesus. Way above and beyond every other waiter we encountered, coming up with custom drink recipes to fit our tastes, chatting about the hotel and life in Cancun, etc... Great guys who went out of there way for us each day. Thanks!

As for the buffet food, they have a really decent selection each day and usually gets changed up enough to keep it interesting day to day. However, as so many others have commented, the food is often cold. Not ice cold, but room temperature or colder is to be expected, even for plates they just brought out and set down on the counter in front of you. It's perplexing. We still enjoyed it and didn't worry about getting sick - two times now and no issues here. The other restaurants were always hot in comparison.

When I go back to Cancun next, we won't be staying here again, at least for a while. Want to explore some other options after having been here twice. I don't think of it as our 'go to' hotel for future stays, mostly because of the lack of music/entertainment and limited restaurant options (the one restaurant, Vento, isn't exactly a restaurant - it's about 15 tables next to the buffet and only serves small plate appetizer type options). But don't get me wrong, it's a beautiful hotel in a decent location with an amazing beach. The interior alone is worth checking out. 

Couple other last minute thoughts:

1) Wifi sucks, mostly everywhere. Strongest in the room, and next best bet is by the main pool (close to the bar). Everywhere else you're SOL.

2) Royal Service is a waste. Had it the first time around. The private area is desolate, or filled with much older clientele who enjoy the silence and privacy. It's simply not fun over there, and there's nothing really 'extra' about it. We weren't treated differently for being royal service, so I saw no reason to go that route this time. No regrets.

3) Ocean view is incredible here, but remember you won't be in the room much anyway.

reviews.author: Erika C
reviews.title: Best vacation ever!
reviews.text: We visited this resort for 7 days last week and there is nothing I can even think to complain about! All the food was delicious, very clean place, the workers are so welcoming, nice and hard working- they truly made our experience one of a kind! I recommend making reservations for the dinner places a few days ahead of time all at once because they can book fast at times since so many people are at the resort. You might not like ALL of the food but you need to try it and experience it- not always will you like it all but regardless of taste buds taste, the food looks and is delicious overall. Rey- cool bartender by the sushi place. We had the best service at the market grill. I recommend doing the jungle tour and doing some activities. Also make sure to bring floaties, sunscreen, and all necessary products bc the resort gift shop is expensive (nothing against them, all travel places are like that). Also stay away from 8th floor lagoon side. Because of the sun the room is normally a little warmer than the rest not bc of the bad AC problems but simply bc Mexico is hot and the sun is constantly shining but you can also ask for a fan. Enjoy and remain open minded to trying new things!

reviews.author: Bcool Follow A
reviews.title: AMAZING!!!!
reviews.text:
it was an experience of a life time
although, he only down side of it all was the hot weather. it was so super hot!
i recommend coming in a cooler time so its not too hot or too cold!
!!!!!a good idea is to bring all your bathing suits, your gonna need it!!!!!

reviews.author: DestWedThompson
reviews.title: Grateful Destination Wedding Guests
reviews.text:
This place exceeded our expectations beyond anything we imagined. It was our first experience with a butler, Fernando, and he was absolutely wonderful.  We LOVED his sweet surprises throughout our stay. 

All the staff genuinely seemed happy to please.   We came for a friends' destination wedding and long awaited vacation, and we will be back. We may even send our folks.

reviews.author: Oleebg
reviews.title: This is just an all-round happy place! And the breakfasts...
reviews.text: I was here for a few days for a work event, though don't get me wrong, this is a great place for a vacation - in fact what it was made for. It is very bright, and has everything - spacious settings, perhaps the most varied breakfast and buffet I have seen, with some great restaurants as well, like Blue Agave. It has is it 3 swimming pools (maybe it's 2 but large) and then that perfect Cancun beach. If you dive, they have a diving and watersports desk, and a fantastic dive center just across the road. Rooms are bright and comfortable (high resort quality). Efficient staff. An espresso place, and much more. Could easily spend weeks here.

reviews.author: Cici30045
reviews.title: Paradisus Royal Service Cancun
reviews.text:
This is a beautiful resort. I never had a shortage of beach chairs, no matter what time I got up. I went the end May it was totally over crowded. You are guarantee in Royal Service 2 nights of Bali bed by pool and beach.

The beach and pool had excellent service with drink or a lite snack. I like to compliment VALERIA GALLARDO and JOSUE Leon at the resturant Palapo. She also waited on us at the pool. She was friendly, hard working and provided excellent service with a smile. JOSUE provided excellent service by the beach and ensure our water always had ice. They give you a bucket of ice with water bottles in it. 

I did receive a nice welcome drink by YHONI GONZALEZ TORRES at the WELCOME LOUNGE. I did request it but it was no issue to receive a drink you prefer.  He was EXCELLENT in his service. I observed that he always had a smile and was so professional and friendly.  What a nice welcome.

If your going to this resort. I would recommend Royal Service, unless you have children. There are no children on Royal Service side. Everything is within walking distance and you can walk inside or out. 

Market Grill was my favorite. They bring out all various meat and steak. Everything was also if you love beef.

The maanager Daniel at MOLE went above and beyond for us. He was compassionate and friendly.

reviews.author: StormCrow2
reviews.title: Amazing hotel and service!
reviews.text: The last time I stayed at this hotel was before they added on the two new pyramids. I can say that they have made this place even better! The service was outstanding from the time I arrived until the time I left! Pablo at Naos and the crew at the beach side bar in the evenings, and housekeeping went above and beyond to make my stay special. The hotel has a great scent that varies from pyramid to pyramid. I highly recommend to anyone for excellent food, exceptional service, and a beautiful well-maintained hotel!

reviews.author: Regina D
reviews.title: Great Cancun experience !,,
reviews.text: This was my first time staying in Cancun hotel district. I was very impressed with this Paradisus, due to it is not brand new,but in Excellent condition . Had a great suite with (2) bathrooms, so my husband & I did not have to share. Love Royal Service, worth the little extra charge. My butler Galdino, was amazing. Took care of everything , checked in on us several times a day, and surprised us with a romantic set-up in our room!, Everyone there is so friendly and accomdating, in a genius way. This is why I love Paradisus resorts. I have stayed at most of them and have never been disappointed. I recommend them to friends often. Great food, great rooms, and great service!,, That's what keeps us coming back!,!!

reviews.author: Jose Luis O
reviews.title: Super cool hotel - good selection of all inclusive
reviews.text:
Facilities are amazing, the room is very clean and comfortable, hotel is located at the sea side with palapas at the beach.
Great staff and super friendly
Night shows are great - worth to stay at the bar and enjoy them
Food and beverage selection is top

The only downside I saw is the lack of palm trees or shades around the pool, no one can stay at the pool directly at the heat with out free shades

reviews.author: DanielleSaldana
reviews.title: Wonderful stay! With a few hiccups...
reviews.text: We stayed here May 22nd through the 26th. The property itself is beautiful! Worth every penny paid to stay here and enjoy the beautiful surroundings! The beach is absolutely perfect at this property, white sand and clear blue waters! (it's not all the same in other parts of Cancun) The only reservation required restaurant we were able to try was Market Grill, which I would rate as just okay. Still good but we've tried many Brazilian steakhouse style restaurants here in the US and it just doesn't compare. Blue Agave is excellent if your looking for a quick bite. The chips, guacamole, and salsa are amazing and the street tacos are delicious! Great option if you are unable to get reservations at the other restaurants. The buffet at Naos was great for dinner time! My boyfriend and I were blown away and very impressed with the quality selection. The breakfast buffet was good also. Not as great as dinner but still pretty good. We also got massages at the spa which was to die for! So relaxing, my therapist Daniela did an excellent job I fell asleep during the massage, she even braided my hair at the end! she had such a gentle touch I didn't even notice until I looked in the mirror! As for the room, it was very nice and spacious, it did the job as we were not in the room much. The showers were hit and miss. Sometimes they would be warm but a lot of the time we couldn't get them to warm up no matter how much we waited and messed with it. We also couldn't get the ceiling fan to turn on. We called in the evening and they said they would send someone to our room to help us but no one ever showed up. We also keep in mind that tipping does go a long way when it comes to service, however when we first arrived we went to the pool around 5:30 and by then the swim up bar was closed...we did notice an employee bringing a group of people some drinks. We approached him and asked if we could also order some drinks and he told us no...and we would have to go to the bar inside. He continued to keep bringing that same group drinks right in front of us. We did notice that group continuously tipping him which is obviously why he was serving them. We found that incredibly rude...it wasn't a great first impression of the staff. However throughout our stay most of the staff was wonderful and friendly. Overall I would recommend this hotel! A few hiccups here and there but overall a wonderful stay!

reviews.author: George S
reviews.title: another week in paradise
reviews.text: as usual we had another wonderful week with the paradisus! Cesar, our butler in the royal service is the BEST! He made us feel pamperd and special the entire week. Shout out to Omar & Daniel for getting us Bali beds and Palapas beachside, Amazing service from them. Heizler and Ventura made wonderful meals for us at the Palapa restaurant and all our favorite waiters, Edier,Valonia,Alejandro,cesar, Jurge,and Moises always had smile on their faces and a drink in their hands for us. Looking forward to next year already!!

reviews.author: CHICAGO TRAVELER
reviews.title: Food and the room service is not worth the money!
reviews.text: I hate to give negative reviews but I have to do it. I go to cancun every year and I had a better experience at ME(Melia Hotel).First of all room 3332 has water leaking from the roof in the bathroom on directly above the toilet. I told the front desk about it and nothing was done. Second, we did not receive any face towels, call room service but they never came.Third, I called down to the front desk to ask where a microwave was at and they told me they would send someone to warm up my pizza that I Bought from Papa Johns (Paradisus uses hot dogs as their sausage on their pizza) and some guy either from room service or maintenance knocks on the door takes my pizza and never comes back with the pizza. I went down to the front desk to ask where my pizza was at and they made a couple of phone calls but couldn't figure out who took my pizza. One guy even laughed about it. Stayed 4 nights and the Food was not as good as hotel ME, breakfast was ok but the restaurants to me was like one of thoses all you can eat joints. Im from chicago so i do know what good food is.The pool and bar area was clean and vallet parking was pretty nice but besides that I would not stay here again. Also dont waste your time with the 90 minute seminar, they will promise you discounts for activities if you go but we did not receive anything but  waste of time especially when they are asking for $1700.00 a month to be a part of ""Melia Club"

reviews.author: MissMarcia2016
reviews.title: I have food allergies and they are trained to deal with this. visit 4/23-4/30/2016
reviews.text: I went to Paradisus Cancun as part of a convention group of about 1400 people. I have a serious food allergy and extensive food sensitivities.  I found several people at Paradisus Cancun were amazing, and helped me enjoy my meals there for the week I was there. In all my travels, I’ve never felt so well cared for, the experience was simply amazing.  I’d like to first of all thank ANDREA, of Naos restaurant.  ANDREA has an excellent understanding of English, and its many nuances.   She has excellent communication skills.  She was the first person to explain to me how to arrange for food I could eat, and she called each of the restaurants  where I planned to eat later in the week, to explain to their maître de’s, what my requirements were.  She even did this for room service, which by the way, was excellent.  I’d just show up to a restaurant, and ANDREA had called ahead of time, people were expecting me, knew what I could and couldn’t eat.  ANDREA was always on the move, always checking to make sure people were provided for.  Why isn’t ANDREA a manager?  She’s just exceptional.   The next person I’d like to thank is GUILLERMO of Naos restaurant.  He’s the maître de, and as soon as I walked in, he’d come over and ask me what I’d like to eat, and have it prepared specially for me.  Such a lovely person, so caring, so detailed oriented.  I’d especially like to thank ALEJANDRO, the maître de of Vento restaurant.  On my first night there, he was expecting me, and at the time, I was very wary.  I’d already found out that all of the food was cooked in my allergen.  So this was a real trial for everyone.  ALEJANDRO made me feel welcome, and cared for.  ALEJANDRO informed the kitchen staff and the waiters of my requirement.  He assigned his “best waiter” GERARDO, to my table.  Because of their efforts, each meal at Vento was a taste extravaganza, exceptionally prepared and presented.  And, I could eat everything I was served.  If you don’t have allergies, you don’t realize how extraordinary is this experience.  So wonderful!  I decided to eat at Vento each night, and I was greeted enthusiastically by ALEJANDRO as if I were a family friend, and given extraordinary choices that were made with care and consideration of my requirements.  Even when  I ate at other restaurants, if ALEJANDRO were there, he’d take over my service, and I felt very well cared for.  His "best waiter" GERARDO really understands food, there is a depth of understanding that is rare to find, and GERARDO has it!  He made sure I had new choices eat night to choose from.  I’d also like to thank ANGEL  of Blue Agave and Mole restaurants.  I’d go to Blue Agave for an afternoon snack, and because of my sensitivities, my choices are pretty limited.  ANGEL made sure the food was safe for me, and he told me that “they are trained to handle food allergies.”  This is very nice, you can’t imagine how difficult allergies can be, and when the staff is properly trained, the experience becomes heart warming.  I feel as though I have a new family at the Paradisus Cancun, what an extraordinary culinary experience.

reviews.author: Robs3120
reviews.title: Amazing stay at the Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: This is our second visit to a Paradisus resort, 1st time in Paradisus Cancun.  We loved everything about the resort especially the friendly staff.  Upgrade to Royal Service is well worth it.  Our butler Fernando was great and made sure we had everything we needed to make our stay perfect.  The Royal Service pool staff were also great.  We will be back next year.

reviews.author: 3beachhunters
reviews.title: Excellent in all aspects!
reviews.text: We just returned from our week in paradise at Paradisus Cancun.  It was myself, my husband and our 19 yr old son. Though not our first trip to Cancun, it was our first time staying at Paradisus and the resort and staff did not disappoint!  This was the most relaxing trip we had and it is because of the staff and the fact that the resort has everything you could possible need. The resort itself is immaculate.  The gardens (inside and outside) are so miticulously maintained - absolutely beautify.  Our room provided us an incredible view of the sunrises, and the beauty of the Caribbean Sea.  The beach was so peaceful, not crowded at all.  There was no need to get up at 4 in the AM to secure your palapa or chairs.  The towel game was going on.  We were out at the beach around 8 each morning and had no problem getting our special spot. The staff at the resort goes out of their way to accomodate your needs to ensure you have an enjoyable and relaxing stay!  From the staff in guest relations, conceirge, the shops, restaurants, bars, to the housekeeping staff - all are so friendly and happy to help and do an outstanding job for you.  Even the chefs were taking care of us and making us feel so special.  It was truly an enjoyable week, and I cannot wait to go back!  Gracias to the resort management for the outstanding job they and their staff do each and every day to ensure the guests have a grand time!

reviews.author: Jaclyn S
reviews.title: Royal service!!!!
reviews.text:
A few weeks ago my boyfriend and I visited Cancun and stayed at the Paradisus Resort. We stayed in their royal service section which was unbelievable. For anyone considering getting the royal service package; I highly recommend you do. The service comes with additional places to eat, a private pool and a butler. Our butler for the week was named Cesar and he was great! He went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we wanted and needed. He made our reservations for dinner, helped us get bali beds by the pool everyday and made sure we had a relaxing vacation.
Unfortunately a week before our vacation my boyfriend broke his ankle, and since it was such short notice we couldn't reschedule the trip. The Paradisus staff did everything in their power to help and make sure we still had an enjoyable time. They brought a wheelchair whenever we needed one and offered to help whenever we were struggling to carry our stuff.
Other staff members who helped to make our trip truly unforgettable were Jorge and Omar who worked at the royal service pool and Alan the bartender at the Blue Agave restaurant and bar. 
We have already started about taking another trip to Cancun and would definitely look into staying at Paradisus again!

reviews.author: rosanabenitez0515
reviews.title: Best Trip Ever!!
reviews.text: This hotel is heaven on earth! I guarantee there is nothing you will not love from it! We booked 4 nights in the Royal Service and loved it so much that we added 2 more nights while we were there. It was destiny: we were celebrating our 5th Wedding anniversary on May 15 and without them knowing gave us room 5515 !! :-) But putting that aside, the Food is just great, No complaints!! The service was excellent, the staff is the best, the attention was great. All the restaurants have good food and the pool was beautiful and clean and the beach was to die for! The color of the water and just so beautiful will take ur breath away! We have stayed in Paradisus Punta Cana but LOVED Paradisus Cancun better!! We are already planning to go back next month! I must mention all these nice attentive beautiful people that bent over backwards for us: Rode- our butler ! Gracias Rode! Nacho who helped us with our anniversary dinner in gazebo! And Rode and Moises too! Moises was so funny,  Andrea the Manager of all the restaurants- so nice and sweet! The Palapa is the BEST !! You eat outside by the pool overlooking the beach and they serve you awesome food.. They will accommodate you if you want something or need something else.. We always tipped them.. Not mandatory obviously but the way they help and treat you, we just couldn't have it any other way,.. Eduardo Ramo supervisor at La Palapa .. Good guy! Heisler one of the cooks in Palapa.. He is just Awesome he cooks great! Thank you! Sindy, Valeria, Alejandro.. Gracias poor los helados! Cesar y Ricardo.. Thanks for helping us with the scissors!! Mario in Bana Sushi Restaurant ,,, gracias Mario! Y Lazaro Asencio Gerente Royal Service.. Thank you! Do Royal Service if you can! You won't regret it!!  Regresamos el mes que viene!! Yay

reviews.author: sandyc2899
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun is fantastic!
reviews.text: This is a beautiful resort, the room was lovely and the staff could not have been nicer!   We were there May 14 - 21 and the weather was sunny and warm.  We had a private check-in where our concierge went over the amenities.  You have to make reservations for dinner in one of the 9 restaurants in advance.  At check-in they told us about each one and booked our first two nights for us.  After that, we just stopped at one of the many desks and booked for the next night.  Dinner is an event with several courses and you take your time to enjoy. But service is excellent and you are well taken care of. We ate at a different one each night. Our favorite meal was at Vento and Carlos took such good care of us.  We also enjoyed Enzo where Benito and Ernesto teamed up and gave us wonderful service. We ate the buffet, Naos, for breakfast and lunch every day.  Pablo was our favorite waiter but they were all very attentive.  At one of the several pools, waiters circulate all day and bring anything that you ask for.  The beach is spotless and there is lots of sand and ocean.  There were several weddings while we were there.  They didn't really interfere with us very much.  They do close off part of the pool area for the reception but it is a huge pool area and you stil have room to swim.  We took a day catamaran trip to Isla Mujeres which was nice.  Then we went to Xel-Ha and loved the snorkeling. Some people upgrade to Royal Service but we did not.  It did not seem necessary. You get a butler, private pool and one extra restaurant.  We didn't get to eat in all of them anyway!  The only negative to us was they have a lot of cabanas and you have to reserve and pay for them. The daily rate was pretty expensive.  There are other chairs but few umbrellas.  People go to the pool and beach area early in the morning and reserve the chairs with towels and other items and then go back to their rooms or to eat breakfast.  We would go back in a heartbeat!

reviews.author: Jetsetter4TX
reviews.title: A fabulous vacation destination spot
reviews.text:
I come to Cancun often and stay at various resorts. Paradisus never disappoints, especially the royal service side. It is right on the beach and also has a private pool on royal side - which is adult only. The restaurants, the service, and food are superb. In fact, I usually don't leave the resort when I come here. However, the part that keeps me coming back is the Royal Service side and the team that keeps this running. The team really goes above and beyond. My butler during my visits it Antonio at Royal Service,  he is the most accommodating, always smiling, and makes sure I am taken care of during my stay - from checkin to checkout, including dinner reservations and any special requests. 

Again, the team at this property are so polite it's almost jarring. Everyone from the housekeepers to the waiters to the concierge could not have been nicer or more eager to please. It made for a great experience.

reviews.author: Rajeevgopal
reviews.title: Nice all inclusive
reviews.text:
Large well managed and well maintained property. Staff is plentiful, unlike most Caribbean resorts, and ever helpful - unlike most American hotels. The property is huge, so walking can be excessive, particularly if you are in the Royal Section on one end. The royal section has its own breakfast and snacks place which is convenient.

The quality of food is good and the level of service very high. You don't get a feeling or being in a crowded place unlike some all inclusive destination. In summary this all inclusive didn't feel like a 'don't care, too busy to bother' all inclusive.

Cancun itself is amazing - 20 km of resort after resort after resort. All huge. 

The beach is great - large and wide and good waves. The absence of reefs makes the waves nice - unlike in the Caribbean island where the beaches are thin strips and interrupted by rocky reefs.

Pls find time to go to the town for at least one evening - most tourists do not. It gives you a bit of Mexican flavor. The local bus service operates every five minutes and charges Peso 11 or $1. Stops at each resort . So travel time is 45 minutes.

reviews.author: jenandike
reviews.title: Definitely not above a three star hotel!
reviews.text:
My husband and I arrived at the Paradisus on a Friday morning.  We were greeted at check-in by a very nice girl who was accommodating and said our room would be ready by noon.  Since we arrived very early, 6am, that was welcome news.  I had planned spa appointments for 10am so it worked out great.  I will do another review of the spa on it's own.  The room was very small and we were right over the air-conditioning main units.  My husband thought we were in the wrong room as the description on Expedia did not match what we were in. (Expedia's fault). I have to warn you that there is a tricky step out and in of the bathroom.  My husband and I both fell three times, I hurt my foot pretty bad.  The tub/shower combination was not what we thought it would be.  The button to make the water go into the tub was stuck so we couldn't use it.  The air conditioner in our room leaked all over the floor making it very slippery.  The safe in our room was so old that the instructions could not be read.  I also had been calling for weeks to try and get an upgrade to Royal Service but it never happened.  We stayed for one night in that room and then asked for a different room.  The first room was 3344.  The view was nice but if there are any weddings going on it is very noisy until late at night.  

The next room we got was 3605. It was the same set up as the other room.  If there were 4 adults it would be too small.  In this room we encountered small black bugs all over the bathroom.  They were on our toothbrushes, hairbrushes, the sink, mirror, everywhere!  I showed them to housekeeping who said they would check into it.  I hope we didn't bring anything home with us!  We never got a single person to come try and spray or anything.  

The food was okay.  The buffet was good, food was good, but nothing great.  The last night we were there my foot was swollen and my stomach was hurting ( i have a rare disease) so I sent my husband down to the buffet to get the few pieces of fruit I could eat and that would help my situation.  My husband was told he was not allowed to bring food to me, that if I was sick I needed to see a DR.  He tried to explain my situation to the manager but they kept telling him no!.  Finally they got the General Manager who conceded to letting him take me a few pieces of fruit, a plastic fork and that was it.  They told my husband it was against policy, that I should have called room service.  Room service is a very limited menu and did not have what I needed. 

While I was there I lost two items.  One was a children's neck pillow.  I went to the Concierge three times until someone finally called lost and found.  They had had it all along!.  The next item that was lost was by someone else.  It was a heart shaped custom button.  I actually found the item by the pool and turned it into housekeeping right away.  When the person came looking for the item I told them I gave it to housekeeping and to check lost and found.  They came back and told me he concierge told them no one turned in the item.  I know that I turned it in so I went to the Concierge.  I asked him again if someone had turned in a gold heart shaped button.  He looked me straight in the eye and said "no miss, I PROMISE you , no one has turned in an item like that".  When I told him I had turned it in to housekeeping myself he said I must have been mistaken.  So, be very careful with your items as they will not be returned very easily.

There are no lifeguards so swim at your own risk in the ocean and the pool.  

People start saving spots by the pool around 9:30, even though there are signs that say it's not allowed.  It happens and by 11 there are no more spots unless you pay for a cabana or Bali bed.

The setting is beautiful, the beach very clean.

The only place to get iced coffee is at the little store inside the hotel and you have to pay for it.

Everything is included, alcoholic drinks, room service and the mini bar

I would not stay here again. Too many other choices in Cancun

reviews.author: Melo L
reviews.title: Husband birthday trip
reviews.text:
I must say this hotel is one of the best hotels I've stayed in , am so impressed !! Service was amazing and place is amazing beach is just right and food is great !! Warning !!!! Chips and guac could get boring after a while if you love avocado it could make u hate avocado !! I have no complaints shouts to FERNANDO !! and all the pool entertainers ! Everyone there is soo nice and u don't have to have "royal service" to be treated like royalty ! I am impressed with free room service and the fantastic wifi connection ( room was located in the main pyramid 3rd floor ) hotel has 8 floors !! I love how all the restaurant are all on the same floor and everything is close but spaced out ! Can't complain about this hotel ! We got the beach front jr. Suite and it was worth my money !! Waiter Christian he's sooo attentive and omg u get your own robes and slippers how sweet is that Tuesday's they have sushi classes but I got to do seviche class with erica and Fernanda they were awesome as well ! I wish I could name everyone -- 

I recommend booking excursions at the beach I got 3 excursions for 160 - "jungle tour " jet skies " and I forgot the name of the other one ( pretty good price ) get nothing at the airports and your booker nigh charge you More to get his commission therefore try going to the towel section of the pool to see the deals .. U can choose from at least 8 different excursions for the same price ( 160 after tax ) 

Pesos =18 = 1 dollar 
Hotel is 16=1 dollar
Downtown 19=1 dollar the bus is externally safe running 24 hrs 
And u could get the best deals for the clubs downtown remember hotels boomers work off commission 

Another thing bus fair is 
1 dollar aka 18 pesos 
But for two people is 21 pesos 
Hope this helps :) 

Hotel is located right across the street from aqua world ( most of your excursions are there ) l

reviews.author: missehuang
reviews.title: Destination Wedding
reviews.text: I just returned from my destination wedding at Paradisus Cancun and I am SO happy that my husband and I chose to have it there! The majority of our guests stayed in Royal Service and we were all super impressed with the cleanliness, service, and comfort. Gerardo was my "butler" and he was amazing. He checked in with us every morning to see what we needed for the day, and even took it upon himself to make dinner reservations for me and my family on the last night of our stay at a restaurant we haven't tried yet. Thank you again! Leticia at the front desk concierge of Royal Service was also a pleasure to work with! She helped all my guests check in/out with no problems and helped us with reservations/bookings throughout the week. Melina, our Romance Coordinator, was amazing!! Upon arrival, she set up a meeting with us immediately to discuss wedding details. All we had to do was give her everything we needed displayed/handed out at the wedding and work with her to finalize our itinerary. After that, I just watched as everything was taken care of for us from decor, music, bridal party organization etc. The entire wait staff/servers/bartenders and housekeeping were all so friendly, it was so fun chatting with them! Everyone made me and our 45 guests incredibly comfortable, constantly bringing us drinks and making sure we were having a good time. The food, as usual, was great! My favorite restaurant has to be Vento! We all had such a fabulous time at the resort, I personally cannot wait to go back. Thank you again to all the staff here for making our wedding day something truly special and memorable :)

reviews.author: johnciora1
reviews.title: Amazing!!! Booked already to go back in August
reviews.text: This place is amazing.. Hotel:  I am OCD and I felt "clean" the entire time I was there.  The place is spotless, always smells good and the staff is great.  The entire staff made you feel "special" the whole time.  When they walk past you, they put their hand over their heart and smile.  That means they thank you from their heart.  Pretty neat.... The hallways in the main area were lines with candles that were lit every night.  Was very classy.  The food was very good compared to other places we have been.  Making reservations every night seemed to be a pain in the butt for others but we just mapped out what restaurants we wanted to go to and made all the reservations at once. Room: Our room was very clean and the maid service came in the late morning then while we were at dinner.  Did not need to call for service once.  The air conditioning was great.  The balcony was big.  The bathroom was great with 2 shower heads and a bidet.  Shows at night were held in an open area that was too small for a show.  I think they should invest in a "show area".  Pool:  The pool was great.  Its over 5 foot deep which is tough for the shorter people but was good.  Fernando, the event coordinator was upbeat and got people moving.  He was great.  One thing I did not like was there was not music by the pool all day.  I like listening to music when at the pool all day.  We brought our own bluetooth speaker which was a hit for us and the surrounding people near us.  There were times with music while they were doing Zumba and water aerobics then there was silence.  The food at the pool was pretty good.  Burgers, chicken wraps, nachos, chicken patties, and fries.  There was staff walking around all day asking if you needed anything.  Restaurants:  Marco from Naos was the best waiter by far.  He was always so happy, upbeat, on top of things and remembered what we needed as soon as w sat down.  Darwin from Bana was also awesome.  He explained everything so clear and never missed a beat.  When walking thru the Market Grill, Alesando stopped us and asked if we wanted to come to Vento but we had already eaten.  He assured us we would have a great dinner there so that's where we went the next night.  Alesandro made us feel like VIP and Leobardo, our waiter was great.  They really made us feel special the entire time.  I do not recommend Blue Agave as the tacos were greasy and they really didn't taste too good.  They have a coffee hut which is open from 10-6.  I love coffee and I think this should be open earlier for the early risers who need coffee.  Tonii, who works at the coffee hut, has the best personality ever. Very nice guy.  Made you feel very welcome and thanked you 10x every time.  The beach was very clean and beautiful.  Went to gym everyday.  Good enough for a vacation workout.  Yhi spa was so relaxing just walking thru it.  There were workers walking around w bags picking up the smallest pieces of garbage off the beach.   Over all this resort rocked!!!  We already booked for August. Oh and free wifi worked everywhere.

reviews.author: Jetsetter283
reviews.title: Truly Paradise
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel. very clean, lovely food 24/7. staff very polite and helpful, especially liked Andreas in coffee corner, fab personality, should be upgraded to reception.!! location very central on main bus route, just at front of hotel. Beach amazing and good size pools. please watch out sunbeds are dangerous they fold easily. saw three people hurt themselves including myself! shared room with two other adults, daughter and friend. lagoon view room definately not big enough for us, two beds divan size and a fold up bed added. insisted on only catering for two people with robes slippers pillows etc. asked for whole week for duvet and quilt for extra bed, it never arrived.  was special occasion so was a bit of a negative that we were so confined when we were in room. virgin rep Elouise did her best to sort things out. very nice person. restaurants very good especially enjoyed tapas. would still recommend this lovely hotel, but two people per room in lagoon view junior suite only.!!

reviews.author: Amy B
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text:
This was my first time in Mexico and I wasn't sure what to expect. I speak NO Spanish. My friend asked me to go on the business trip with her but we had plenty of time on our own also. This resort is beautiful! The staff is amazing and super friendly!!! The food was excellent, the shows at night were really good. The wait staff were so sweet. The beach was very nice, there was a DJ playing music which I enjoyed a lot. They give you fresh beach towels at any point of the day. There are fresh flowers in the front lobby, water falls, coy fish , places to buy things you may need. I loved it so much I talked my husband into going there instead of FL this year. It is a family resort or a place for couples. We had a few small issues with our room but were dealt with. 

We were thrown a huge party on the beach the last night we were there that looked like a wedding. The people worked all day to put that together and it was a beautiful party with terrific food and service! I applaud all of the men and women that work at this resort. I didn't want to leave.

reviews.author: CEO333
reviews.title: Beautiful resort and beach!
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I just returned from an 8 day stay at the Paradisus Cancun and we enjoyed our entire stay. First off let me say that the staff friendliness is OUTSTANDING!!!! We have stayed at a few all-inclusive resorts and this resort has BY FAR THE MOST FRIENDLY STAFF WE HAVE EVER ENCOUNTERED!!! We only encountered two rude staff members the entire time and both of these women worked together in “The Store”, the resorts general store. We often ate at the buffet, Naos, and RICARDO and ROBERTO were AMAZING!! They gave us the best service ever and both were always quick to spot us and seat us as soon as we walked in…which was nice not to have to wait for a table. There was also another waiter at Naos who was also GREAT, but I am so sorry I forgot his name…he was an older man with a shaved smooth head. The resort itself is a nice resort and smells good (they have some sort of scent boxes that make the inside smell awesome). At night the resort is beautiful as it is lit up with colored lights (mostly purple). The pools are also nice, but it is sort of a downer that there is only one pool with a bar (unless you pay for Royal Service)…and it is very hard to find a chair at that pool. However, going to the other pool is not a bad thing because they do have staff members coming around to serve you pool side…and if you tip they do come around very often to make sure you are never with an empty glass. The beach view is definitely worth the extra money!!! We were in pyramid 3 on the 5th floor and our view was amazing! Thank you Paradisus staff for making our trip wonderful!!!

reviews.author: LilyYoi G
reviews.title: Excellent hotel in Cancun
reviews.text: This hotel is beautiful all the way around. Once you enter, you feel welcomed by the hotel's Asian energy style and the smell place you somewhere else. The resort is very cleaned and every night there is a show at the Avenue Bar. You don't have to be in the Royal Service to be treated well, all the employees make you feel welcomed and appreciated throughout your stay. My husband and I had the best honeymoon we could imagine.

reviews.author: Jynv
reviews.title: Best Service and Friendly Staff
reviews.text:
We had the Royal Service option, the hotel was better than I had expected, and  my expectations were high. The staff is beyond friendly and helpful, they will do anything to make you feel welcome and comfortable. Guillermo, our butler was amazing, he was so helpful ad organized, specially since it was our firs time in Cancún, and he always had the best attitude, I can't say enough good things about him. We had him change our reservations to restaurants several times due to our excursions running later than planned, and he was always happy to help us.

Our room was very clean, the hotel in general is beautiful with a relaxing atmosphere, wonderful flowery scents all day and incense in the afternoons, simply stress free. The restaurants were very good, the buffet had good options and delicious desserts. But our favorite restaurant was MOLE, its just the best, great flavor combinations and awesome servers.

The only thing is that I wish the pool and drinks area there stayed open until later, getting back from our excursions we didn't have much time left to relax and have a drink at the pool.

Overall, awesome hotel, hardworking friendly staff. Loved it! recommended to my friends and family, and we'll be coming back!

reviews.author: 696kristenw
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: We booked last minute for the family. FAMILY CONCIERGE WAS AWESOME. Food was ok not great but we loved market grill for dinner. Service around the pool and beach was great and we would definitely go back

reviews.author: Graeme B
reviews.title: A wow experience!
reviews.text: A truly surreal experience. From the drive up to the hotel at night seeing the domes lit up in purple along with the other lighting, to the view from the room's balcony down over the main pool and beach and out over the ocean is really amazing. Great friendly staff, and a special thanks to Asuncion, Laura, Eric and Salvador at the Pool Bar, and Karina at Coco's Bar. We will never forget you guys! Thank you!

reviews.author: Melissa0703
reviews.title: Amazing stay...but..
reviews.text: We just returned from 6 days at the resort.  The service was nothing less than amazing!  They have the hardest working people we have ever experienced!  My only complaint is there wasn't any place to get a cup of coffee after 6:00 unless we were in a restaurant.  The Nespresso bar was fabulous but should be open much later!  Also, there should be seating outside..the theatre area gets way too hot and there is not enough seating.  We would go outside and sit on the pool chairs.  It would have been nice if there were outdoor chairs/couches with cushions located sporadically outside.  We love nothing more than getting a cup of coffee at night and sitting outside.  We will definitely be returning.

reviews.author: Carolyn1205
reviews.title: Royal Service at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: We loved our stay.  We definitely would visit again with the Royal Service option.  We felt very pampered and cared for our entire stay. the staff is was very friendly and accommodating.  This is our third visit to Cancun, and the Royal Service at Paradisus Cancun has been our favorite.

reviews.author: rojil18
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Hotel and staff were amazing. Very attentive great service. Would recommend. Food was delicious and the drinks too. Definitely going back with more friends and family members. Can't wait to go back. Thanks.

reviews.author: joev854
reviews.title: Fantastic Hotel and Resort
reviews.text: This was my very first time to Cancun, I was attending a company conference (7th-12th May) and I must say I don't think they could have picked a nicer or better hotel. The conference facilities were very good and all the staff at the hotel were very friendly. There were plenty of places to eat and no shortage of drinks. I would like to say a special thank you to Andres in the Nespresso bar for looking after me so well on my last day. I was quite sad to be leave and hope to visit again soon for a holiday.

reviews.author: Francisco S
reviews.title: Was not as good as I thought it would be
reviews.text:
Stayed from May 14-May 20. Resort is clean, spotless always smelling nice. People are Amazing. Workers are the hardest working and nicest people I ever met in my entire life. The food was OK. I felt like I was eating the same things everyday. Not much variety at buffet. Did not like the hindu food at their buffet. Their buffet Naos has a different theme every night. Hindu was one and it was awful and smelled pretty bad made me nauseous. The seafood buffet on weds. Was great. Fuego, bana and blue agave was our favorite. Sunset grill was awful. Room service was great and free. When we did not want to go down for breakfast they had it brought up to us which was great. Our check in was not smooth. We ended up checking into the room an hour late because they were still cleaning. Apparently the guy before us checked out late and did not advise the front desk. Front desk manager Francisco is first class and extremely professional, i can not thank him enough. Him and his staff and everyone else at the hotel can go to any hotel in the world and make it better. They are a very well trained staff and they are experts in hospitality. He made up the late check in by hooking up the bali bed for half price which was nice. The resort credits was very confusing. We thought we had $550 to spend in whatever but its just coupons worth $550. Each slip clearly says that the beds are for a certain price and does not specify it is 10$ off if you spend a certain amount. I know this because there are other slips that say if you spend a certain amount its 10$ off. I paid 40$ over for the bali bed($50 with the "discount"). I tried to get them to give it for 10$ but they would not. Im very disappointed that other guests were able to get the bed for 10$ but the coupon did not apply for me. The room key did not work once so we had that fixed. Upon arrival every guest gets a schedule of when every restaurant is open and that schedule that was given must be outdated because there were times we wanted to go to certain places and it was closed. Another complain is the swim up bar and closes too early. Swim up bar closes at 6 and pool closes at 7. If i sign up for an all day excursion and i get back at 5:00 i have an hour to enjoy a drink and I have 2 hours to enjoy the pool. Pool should be open until 8 and the bar should be open until 8. At the earliest. Another complain was the service from the agents inside the hotel. BD TRAVEL  andrea and mikael were very rude and disrespectful to my wife. They represent that company poorly. You can buy excursion tickets for cheaper directly from the company online and you get more because there is no commission you need to pay. If you wanna go to senor frogs or coco bongos do it thru the website. Again, you get more and pAy less. Go to aquaworld for all water sports. Or book at hotel by pool area with Diego. Another complain was the ocean. Its beautiful and blue but the waves are too rough. Couldn't even go in the water for more than 5minutes. But thats not the hotels fault. The ocean is too dangerous for kids but maybe its more calm in different months? Another complain is that it is way too hot in the hotel and in the room. The ac is poor. Could barely sleep at night. Was sweating entire time. Another complain is the lack of space for the shows at night. Its disrespectful to the performers who do a great job and uncomfortable for patrons.   Over all. Beautiful hotel even better staff. But i would not stay here again. I dont feel i got my money worth because of all my complaints. I expected more. But the staff was amazing. The waiters are hard working and super friendly and so is all the other staff. I do not recommend this hotel to other people based on there was more cons than pros. 

Pros: 
Blue water nice to look at... (But cant swim in it to rough ????)
Free safe
Free semi working wifi
Amazing friendly hard working staff 
Clean 
Smells nice 
Close to airport

Cons: 
allows smoking at pool wouldnt bring my kids around that trash
Pool closes early
Poor resort credit usage and clarity
Poor AC 
Restaurants closed often does not correlate with schedule
Sunset grill (pool rest.) is awful 
Can't swim in rough ocean 
Poor space for shows 
Pool closes too early 
Swim bar closes too early
Key did not work(common theme among guests)

reviews.author: jendelosreyes
reviews.title: Worst vacation
reviews.text:
My husband and I and my cousin and her husband decided to take a trip to cancun and stay in paradisus because of all the hype, even our travel agent recommened it. However, from the moment we stepped into the hotel the experience was mediocre at best. First of all, our room wasnt ready at the promised time. On our second day, my cousins roof in her room started to crumble and fall on her head. About 40 minutes later maintenace get there. By this time we had already wasted half a day. Understandably so we were very upset; so they promised to move our rooms and UPGRADE both rooms. My cousin got an upgrade but my husband and I got 2 separate beds in the same room type we had before. When we went to inquire, they said they were out of the room they had promised us. At this point we were furious so they promised us 4 free massages. The massages were anything but free... we had to sit through a 90 min presentation and then they only wanted to give us 2 massages. We asked for them call manager and they said they had none on campus. What kind of hotel doesnt have a manager?

Another issue- In order to eat at any of their restaurants you need to reserve 1 day in advance, forget about walkin they never have space. 

The last straw was we took pictures paid for them and when we went to pick them up they said they werent ready and would ship them to us. When we paid for the pictures we were clear and told them we would be leaving they said no problem they would be ready, that obviously wasnt the case. 

Then to try to"fix it" they gave us a voucher for a "free vacation"  which is far from free, its actually 180 pp per night. 

I have never been more dissatisfied with a vacation, I will not be coming here again.

reviews.author: mikegross50
reviews.title: OK, Not Great
reviews.text:
The hotel was nice and the people very polite but the rooms need work.  The food wasn't very good.  In fact we found ourselves going to the buffet almost every night after being so disappointed with the other restaurants.

The butler service was amazing and our butler was the best.

reviews.author: kimkimkim2016
reviews.title: Fantastic Vacation with Fantastic Services
reviews.text:
We(me and my wife) have stayed at the Paradisus Cancun Resort May 9(Mon)-13(Fri). Everything was really great. The food and drink were abundant and hospitality at everywhere with really free(all include option) . The resort has so many excellent food options for all meals. 

We, especially, visited 2 times at Vento restaurant. There are really really fantastic services by manager, Alexandro and Gerado and even Chef, Humerto. We want to say thank them again. My wife and I also very enjoyed at Avenue Bar with very warm and kindly Alan's service at every night even evening. We also want deeply appreciate to serving every morning & sometime Lunch by Moises, Miguel and Jose at  Naos buffet and Pascual at Market Grill. 

We will definitely come back to this resort at next year and already recommend to my close two friends. 

I would like to say again that Thank Paradisus and fantastic service guys.

Have a wonderful one Paradisus Crews!

reviews.author: Katerina K
reviews.title: Please read this review... I actually tried. =^._.^=
reviews.text:
We arrived at approximately 9 p.m. in local time, sweating all over and extremely mad at the policeman who though it was really funny to stop unaware tourists twice in a row for "not stopping before a traffic light." (?) This trip had a bad start (well, he didn't give us a ticket, soooo...), and I, being a little superstitious, began to think this trip may not end as I would have ever hoped. How I was wrong.
This trip was one of the best in my entire life (cheesy, yeah.) That is a lot for me to say. I mean, we've went to the Caribbean every year, and that stacks up to be, let's say, a lot. However, this beat all of my expectations. The service was superb, the maids and workers always cheerful and ready to help whenever, whatever. The room was always cleaned, a speck of dust considered a calamity, and the mini refrigerator always stocked and refilled. :) The setting overall is amazing, with lush green vines hanging and all real (!) plants, such as bamboo and palm trees, growing right along the pathways. Moreover, it is right across Aquaworld, and that I consider the highlight of my trip. I had always dreamed of acquiring a scuba diving certificate, one that made me a professional diver. Where I live, it would take almost a year to get such a specialized permission. Here, it took me 2 days.
The instructors were all amazing (lack of better word), especially Rene Cicero, who instructed me. he was always helping me and fixing whatever i was doing wrong, even 30 feet underwater. Overall, it was an amazing (aiiiiiiiiiii, fine, FANTASTIC) trip, one I will never forget.

=^._.^=

reviews.author: Alton Custus
reviews.title: Paradisus Review
reviews.text: By far the best trip I've ever been on! Everyone at the hotel is very nice and friendly. Yhonl and Edge are two people at the hotel that made our stay even more special, they were the best! We'll definitely be back & we hope to see them two again! Also booking with our travel agent we had the opportunity to get the $1,000 hotel credit and was able to upgrade our room for the last night with royal service! I've already recommended Paradisus to many of my friends that are planning on going to Cancún!

reviews.author: leojenny2016
reviews.title: Like Family
reviews.text:
My wife and I absolutely love visiting Cancun and always stay at the Paradisus, since we are club members.  The hotel is clean, the staff attentive and the food delicious.   The powdery white sands and the turquoise waters are spectacular.  We have visited the Paradisus for years and we cultivated   friendships along the way with several of the staff members.  Every visit is like visiting with family. 

Wine:
 If you like wine, they have a fantastic selection, thanks to Sommelier Durante.  Carlos, thank you for that special bottle of New Zealand Savignblanc went perfectly with our dinner at Bana. 
  
Bana Restaurant: 
Great atmosphere, fantastic food and incredible service. 
 Jesus was our server for the two nights that we dined at Bana.  He was such a genuine person, great personality and provided the finest service.  Jesus made our experience great. 

Special thanks to Mario Vazquez (Manager) at Bana Restaurant for his service and incredible hospitality.  I can’t thank you enough Mario the rose pedals at the table were a lovely touch to the outstanding dinner and delicious desert.  Thank you to Chef Marcos for taking time to visit the table to deliver that delectable dessert and presentation.  You have a great team at Bana.  You made us feel like royalty.  
   
Mole Restaurant:  
Our server for the evening was Javier.  He was personable and professional and made on point recommendations.  The food was very good. 

Avenue Bar: 
Our server Carlos was outstanding.  My wife and I would to the evening show every night and Carlos remembered our order from the night prior.  By the third night I didn’t have to order and my glass was never empty.  Carlos…thank you for great service. 
 
Nespresso Bar: 
 Great coffee and service.  Andres has a great personality and is a terrific server
.
Market Grill Buffet: 
 The buffet has delicious food with an abundance of choices.  If you can’t find something you like to eat…you’re the problem.
