For the week that we stayed we sat at the outside lower level and Pasqual and his team (Jaime, Victor and Jesus) waited on us.  What an awesome bunch of guys that provided incredible service.  Thanks Pasqual for everything, especially all the laughs
.  
Rody Otero (Captain)  -  Rody we can’t thank you enough for all that you do for us.   Your team(s) at all the restaurants (Vento,Mole, Bana, Fuego, Market Grill) provided us with outstanding service and made us feel special and loved.   Thank you for everything. 

I highly recommend the Paradisus Cancun, quality service, great food, friendly staff one of the best resorts in Cancun.

reviews.author: Julia P
reviews.title: Absolute Paradise
reviews.text: On my first trip to Cancun ever, I can absolutely say that I enjoyed every moment spent at the Paradisus. The food was wonderful, the employees were all very courteous and kind, and the view was spectacular, inside and outside of the resort.

reviews.author: MOONTX99
reviews.title: Absolutely breath taking!!
reviews.text: My husband and I visited here with some family. I've visited Cancun, Playa and Cozamel several times and nothing compares to Paradisus. If you're looking for class and a romantic getaway....You've found it!!! Five stars!!!

reviews.author: Anastasia K
reviews.title: An Unforgettable Experience
reviews.text: This was not the first time I visited Mexico, but my family and I surely agreed it was the best. Unlike other anything else I have seen, the pyramids in which the rooms and activities were located were ginormous. With beautiful, long, leafy vines in the open-air hallways and a balcony with a view of the Caribbean sea, It was impossible to stop gaping at all of this majesty like a little kid. The service was astounding. The rooms were always clean and stocked with supplies. The lobby and hallways did not have even a speck of dust. The maids and waiters were very friendly, joyous, and constantly laughing, lighting up the hotel with their smiles. Another good thing about this hotel is that it is located, and is part of, an activity center called AquaWorld. This was what made this vacation the best I ever had. I learned how to ride on a jet-ski and zoomed across the ocean. I signed up for scuba diving sessions. In just four days, I became a certified diver. The instructor, Rene Cicero, was everything we could ask for. He showed us easier ways to perform tasks, helped me clear my goggles of water( a seemingly insignificant ting but how can you swim if your mask is full of salty ocean water?), he showed us all the sea life he could find, like barracudas, school of fish, and a really big lobster. He combined helpful and entertaining into one dive. I will never ever forget this trip.

reviews.author: Mike G
reviews.title: A really nice resort
reviews.text: Just left the Paradisus Cancun after a week long visit. Being members we have visited many times but not since the change over from Gran Melia to Paradisus. Happy to say we very pleased to the quality and personality of our hotel is still the same! Each meal we throughly enjoyed from the abundant breakfast buffet to the delicious Mole restaurant ... Special mentions should go out to " Mr Clean"  who took great care of us in the breakfast and lunch buffets and to Ingrid, our pool server-always there when we were in need of a fresh drink... Can't wait to return.   Thanks for a great time Paradisus!!!

reviews.author: Sonia C
reviews.title: Total relaxation
reviews.text:
Building 5,  Royal Service.  From the moment we stepped onto the resort, we were treated with nothing more than the best and most courteous service.  Everyone has been so kind and friendly.  We spent five days going from bali bed to bali bed with a few hops here and there to the restaurants for lunch and dinner (aside from Tempo, the upscale one, we were very underwhelmed by the food at the resort).  All the personnel at La Palapa was so accommodating and friendly, we loved spending lazy days by the pool or on the beach.  The spa offers fantastic massages but the water area (pool, saunas, showers) are showing their age.  The fitness center is well equipped although it gets busy early in the morning.  
Overall I totally recommend this resort.  I did not find much that was worthy of a complaint.

reviews.author: rodneydmitris
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: The Paradisus  resort and spa in cancun Mexico, is one of the best resorts on the island. Located in the hotel  zone,  minutes away from shops, local market etc. Check in was a breeze,  with the Family package, you had your own personal lounge, with Snacks,  bar,  and play area for the kids. Awesome

reviews.author: jdk h
reviews.title: birthday getaway
reviews.text: love this resort I had been to paradisus in punta cana and loved it so when I went to cancun I knew I had to stay here all the melia chain resorts are great! great staff, great food, drinks, clean rooms, best location, best beacher...excellent overall!

reviews.author: u001jlf
reviews.title: A stay in May at the Paradisus Cancun Resort
reviews.text:
This was our 3rd trip to Cancun and our 10th all inclusive in the Riviera Maya/Yucatan region. This is one of the neatest looking resorts with a great beach. Fortunately, the ocean was calm for most of our stay (Cancun's beach can be rough and tiresome for swimming)
Cons:
- I was very disappointed with the A/C in our room. 
- The entertainment people were slacking when compared to those that work for 
  Iberostar and other Resorts. 
- Beach volleyball was to happen twice a day and, at times it did. But, a lot of this 
 was because we got it started. The entertainment guys  rarely announced that 
  volleyball was about to happen.
- Pool games were rare.
- While I am an American. It was EMBARRASSING to witness the actions of some  fellow Americans and how they acted. This happened on different days during our stay:
 Playing their loud boom box at the pool bar. Another group playing loud Rap music at pool side with Lyrics using the "N" word and "F" Bomb. And, another group in the pool with their large speaker playing their music as, the entertainment group's music was playing. They allowed their children to jump into the water at the pool bar which splashed other people and their drinks. I might add that the profanity used along with lots of slurred words was hideous. While this was not the fault of the Resort I do however believe it is their responsibility to stop stuff like this from happening. One of the entertainment guys Fernando commented to my family about how some of  obnoxious Americans were behaving. I suggested to him that the Resort do something about it. Nothing was done.
- Why are these beautiful Resorts putting the awful looking beds on the beach. Only a few are ever used and it takes away from the whole beach thing.
- The kids pool is at the far end but, the water is not as deep.

PRO'S:
- The food at the Ala Carts was very good. We really like the Market Grill (Brazilian Steakhouse). The Mexican restaurant had a Tortilla Soup that was great. I really like the lunch . The Mexican Cantina has authentic and delicious food. It is easy to get a reservation for the restaurants. You need to call early in the morning and you schedule seating for the next day. If you try to make a reservation for the same day you may not get anything or at least not before 9:30 p.m.
- The place is beautiful inside and out.
- Cleanliness is very apparent.
- You can get coffee and tea really early. Located just outside of the Buffet restaurant.
- The buffet breakfast is great. You need to have patience due to the lines at the omelet stations.
- The buffet lunch is great. You can get food from the Market Grill and lunch buffet at the same time - they are connected.
- Their is a coffee shop with espresso and deserts near the exit lobby to the beach.
- Top shelf alcohol even at the pool bar. 
- You can easily get a spot on the beach in the morning. No need to give a card for a towel.
- The pools are open very early and are very clean. The water level is around 5' everywhere so, it may not be suited for small children. 
- The gym has quality equipment and plenty of it.
- I thought the nightly shows were very good and not cheesy.
 - The inside of the resort is unique and pleasing.

This was our first time going this early in the year. The temps are great. The water can be refreshingly cool at times. The crowds are noticeably smaller this time of year.  I would not pay for the Royal service. Most importantly, I would make sure my room is located in the main building.

reviews.author: kamal m
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: It's so relaxing especially by the entrance of the hotel . Staff is so welcoming and try to help you at their best even though some of them have language barrier. Best part you can see sunset and sunrise from your room and front lobby. Which is best experience. I would highly recommend to stay here rather than other neighbors!

reviews.author: juliebean512
reviews.title: Our second trip
reviews.text:
We enjoyed our trip in 2015 so much that we came back in 2016.  It was even more amazing this time.  When I checked in, they didn't say, "Welcome Back".  They said, "Welcome Home", and honestly - that's how it felt.  Like home, but much much more relaxing.  We stayed at the Royal Service.  The rest of the hotel is very nice, but if you can afford it and you don't have kids, I would recommend the Royal Service very highly.

When we came to the hotel, we were greeted by a hostess of sorts, who had us sit in a room - and then we were escorted to check in at the Royal Service desk.  Juan Carlos helped us check in and introduced us to our butler, Rode.  Rode was wonderful - he helped with restaurant reservations - and he decorated my room three times since it was my birthday.

One of the reasons to stay at the Royal Service is access to La Palapa restaurant.  It is only for the Royal Service guests.  I ate breakfast there every morning.  The waitstaff are so friendly and remember you and take such good care of you.  Eddie and Valeria were there most every morning.  They seem so warm and genuine. 

Since this time it was not part of an Award trip, we had a lot more time to ourselves.  There are many people who might consider what we did to be a waste of time - but the majority of our trip was spent in one of the Bali Beds pictured.  We were near the ocean, but in the shade, with unlimited refreshments and time to read.  It was fantastic.  Omar and Daniel were the gentlemen who helped us make reservations for the Bali Beds, and they are amazing.  They remembered my name and how many towels I liked and walked us to the bed so that we could get everything set up "just so" every morning.  They even changed the rotation of the cushions so that we could face the ocean, rather than the pool.

The wait staff at the Royal Service pool/Bali Beds are exceptional.  Cesar, Alejandro and Jesue were the ones we saw most often.  They walked so quickly between the beds, but I never felt like they rushed through our time together.  They made suggestions and remembered our drinks.  They brought buckets full of ice and bottled water, and changed the ice through the day so our water stayed cold.  

Once again, we didn't take part in many of the nightlife options.  Truthfully, it didn't seem like a "party" hotel.  There were families at one end - adults only on the other, and a mix in between.  

We were in a slightly smaller room than the year before, but that was not a drawback for us.  For one thing, we didn't spend much time in the room - and the balcony was the same size - so plenty big with a gorgeous view of the ocean.  And for another reason, it felt like the AC was able to keep the room much cooler than the year before.  

The hotel itself had some improvements since the year before, and it seemed as though they were still making some while we were there.  It's definitely not a new resort, but it has great "bones" and the service is just unparalleled. I truly do miss all of the staff there and wish I could turn around and go back immediately.  It won't be my last trip there.

reviews.author: Roweena D
reviews.title: Abraham Hicks Land Cruise
reviews.text: The Paradisus was fabulous our waiters at Naos restaurant Marco & David were the best, the food was amazing and the interior, grounds and location were all stunning. The food was also fabulous and was everywhere. We made lots of great friends and had heaps of fun would definitely stay there again. The spa was a bit pricey but worth the visit💞

reviews.author: Averagegal11
reviews.title: A little slice of paradise
reviews.text:
I did an all inclusive stay here and it was fabulous. The food selection and quality was fabulous, the grounds were beautiful, the weather was amazing. If you have the opportunity to swim with the dolphins while you are there, do it. That was outstanding.
I would absolutely do another all inclusive trip here again.

reviews.author: Perry R
reviews.title: Beautiful propertyf
reviews.text: We arrived 5/15/2016, check in was a bit painful, not as welcoming as some other resort chains we've stayed at.  We booked a Royal Service room.  The room is nice with a private balcony overlooking the Caribbean Sea.  Service is a bit spotty with some of the waiters very friendly and accommodating and others somewhat indifferent.  Not like the Amstar properties we've stayed at where everyone is friendly and completely at your service.  That being said we've had some great people taking care of us.  The food other than the Naos Buffet has been above expectations.  We had some interesting Mexican cuisine at Mole restaurant, great Brazilian grilled meats at Market Grill.  The Mediterranean tapas at Vento were just ok but our server Juan made us feel welcome and seemed to anticipate what we needed before we'd asked.  Royal Service guests get their own restaurant overlooking the sea, La Palapa.  We've eaten lunch and breakfast there every day and been well taken care of by Jorge and the rest of the staff.  Overall Paradisus Cancun is a good choice if you like relaxing on one of the nicest beaches in Mexico.  One other note the central atriums are stunning by day and night.

reviews.author: Jean C
reviews.title: 10 Anniversary
reviews.text:
Excellent, The Help me to Surprise my wife with bottle of  champagne and Rose petals in our bed, then we went to the hot-tub on the balcony of the room  facing the Beach .... hey!!! Amazing  Experience ...
Good Food, International Drinks , The Japanese Restaurant is Top of the line......  The Service was simply perfect , friendly, educated   and  known of the culture of the place (Cancun) ......

reviews.author: 60Marg
reviews.title: Older resort but very good service!
reviews.text: I stayed at this hotel one week for a conference. This is an older resort but still with very good facilities and great staff. The food at the restaurant was above average for and all inclusive resort, but if you get tired of the hotel food, there are many restaurants in town that you can choose. The beach is spectacular as well as the surroundings. I would definitively return for a family vacation.

reviews.author: Charlie C
reviews.title: First Class
reviews.text: We expect a lot, and this property impressed us.  Very classy, polished and first class service from every staff member we met.  Beautiful room and view (we had ocean view), food in every restaurant including buffet was super.  Top shelf alcohol and we were pleased with the all inclusive liquor and wine. Loved the ambiance/energy.  We purchased deep tissue massage and it was top notch.  The spa is super.  Have no negative comments.

reviews.author: Noel D
reviews.title: Paradisus Review
reviews.text: Paradisus is truly Paradise. We were a family of 16 with 3 very young children, everyone enjoyed our stay @ this hotel. The ambience was great, food was delicious. We tried most of d restaurants n reservations was easy. Service was excellent, staff work very hard n remain friendly with smiling faces.Will highly recommend this hotel, will definitely come back!

reviews.author: Dayle D
reviews.title: April Trip to Paradisus, Water, Food and Fun
reviews.text:
Stayed for 10 days in April in an ocean-view room (no hot tub on the balcony or jetted tub in the bathroom).  The room was a very nice size with a comfy bed and very nice view.  The bathroom was good size and the towels were soft and large.  There is a slight step up to get to both the bathroom and the balcony, SO WATCH YOUR STEP.  (When checking in, you can ask what is available for a possibly better view or whatever you like.)  The service and staff for the most part was excellent, helpful and friendly.  We went to all the restaurants.  Some are better than others, but they all have different types of food, so I will not give any of them bad reviews.  The sushi place even made me rolls that had cooked meat and talked me into a grilled tuna they made special for me–it was great!  Fuentes, get the blackened salmon.  Also, the buffet had sea food on Wednesday night. Great selection of sea food, and they even cook it for you or you can pick one already done.  Market Grill was fun too.  Nothing is open 24 hours, but there is always room service.

     The pool and pool bar was wonderful.  Drinks were plentiful, and they have agua aerobics, zumba, music, belly dancing, and other fun stuff going on throughout the day.  RENT A CABANA AND ORDER A LOBSTER LUNCH ONE DAY.  It was about $70 and worth every penny.  

     The ocean is beautiful but always rough.  The floors are marble throughout the premises, beautiful to look at but really slippery when wet.  The lobby is also really nice.  We stayed in the infamous third tower.  Yes, you will hear music at night in your room.  Turn on your air conditioner or open up your door to hear the ocean, it’s just that simple.  For me, I loved the third tower as all the restaurants and action was going on there.  Also, check out the shows at the night club.  Wednesday was Michael Jackson and Thursday was dancers and music from Queen.  Lots of energy and the best shows all week.  We were there with two other couples and would definitely go back.  

     GET UP EARLY AND GET THOSE SUN RISE PICTURES.  Beautiful beach, beautiful view, and sometimes bands playing on the beach at the neighboring resorts – perfect.  If you have children, bring life vests AND blow up floatees. Check the web for the best prices.  Bring your camera, electrical strip, TWO SUNSCREENS, and at least two bathing suits and cover-ups.

reviews.author: Gabriel S
reviews.title: Amazing Experience
reviews.text: I stayed at Paradisus for a total of 4 days and I wish I would have booked it longer. Everything was great,  from the room, the food, the beach and all the staff everywhere. We went back twice to the Blue Agave restaurant because the tacos were delicious. Both nights we were waited by a server  named Atilano. He provided us with exceptional service both nights and would have gone back for a third time to eat if we were staying longer. Overall, definitely recommend this resort as well as the Blue Agave. Will be booking here again!

reviews.author: Samantha C
reviews.title: Relaxing vacation for 2!
reviews.text: We went at the end of August 2015 and stayed in the Royal Service Lagoon View Suite which gives you access to the RS amenities and restaurants. We highly recommend upgrading to royal service if you're looking for a more quiet pool to lounge under the cabanas which you can reserve. The cabanas were the highlight of the trip since it's very hot in August, we took many naps under the shade accompanied by the sound of waves. The bar has better quality alcohol and the pool side food is delicious, highly recommend the chicken wings and the burger! The pool servers are always friendly (so make sure to tip!) and our butler Antonio always made sure our reservations were in order. Antonio made our stay very relaxing because of the extra steps he took to ensure our comfort! Jose at Bana (Japanese restaurant) made our trip! We went to Bana twice during our stay, purely to see Jose again! He was very friendly and always made sure we were comfortable (since the air conditioning isn't that strong due to Bana being in the centre of a pyramid), he always had a smile on his face and a good joke! Fuego was also a great restaurant! Thanks to the staff, especially Jose and Antonio, our trip was not just another vacation, but a memorable one!

reviews.author: INGA L
reviews.title: GREAT PLACE FOR VACATION
reviews.text: The service was  great,excellent food , especially the "Vendo" restaurant, the ocean was rough , wasn't able to swim, but you can not control the weather, right? Other than that everything was great. This is our second time staying in this resort.

reviews.author: niknchas
reviews.title: Great service at this hotel
reviews.text:
We have been to this hotel on a few occasions and we are never disappointed. I must say it is an older resort, but they maintain the property very well. For an all inclusive the food is above average. They have many different options to choose from. 
   What makes this hotel is the service. The waiters go out of their way to ensure great service. What we were most impressed with was the pool service. I must acknowledge,at the members pool, both Jorge and Asuncion. They are two of the hardest working people at this hotel. 
   The only reason I did not give 5 stars was due to the age of this property, with that said, I would definitely return.

reviews.author: richard z
reviews.title: good food, nice pool, good location, beautiful beach
reviews.text: The first night we were there our air conditioning went out, after a quick call to the front desk and a visit from maintenance they said it couldn't be fixed. The desk had the maintenance man show us another room. it was better than the one we had and in a better location, so we were very pleased. The staff down at the pool was excellent especially victor and Manuel. The front desk staff at check in and check out were very good, so was the staff at the money exchange and concierge desk especially Victor and Francisco. The manager at COCO's bar Tabitha took care of a problem we had and made everything right. The restaurants were very good even the buffets were good, the omelet stations at breakfast took a little while. The beach beds were great to rent if you do ask for alexander and ask him about the specials some include extras. the atmosphere at night is great the atriums were very cool looking when they are all lit up. the spa was good, we had a massage and used the steam room, sauna, and pool. the swim up bar has good service so does the beach the wait staff is very good, good snacks at the pool snack bar.

reviews.author: Yaritza H
reviews.title: Great place to stay with family
reviews.text: First time in Cancun. It was a great experience at the paradisus. I stayed at the club melia and it was just perfect. Accomodations are great, everything's clean and very well organized. Staff is fantastic and I really loved the attention at the restaurants. Totally recommended!

reviews.author: Ronald. B
reviews.title: Return trip was as good as the first time!
reviews.text:
We arrived mid-April 2016 at the airport and we were welcomed by our rep, OLYMPUS Tours who provided the airport transfers, well scheduled clean vans with wi-fi. 
The Melia PARADISUS hotel (several pyramid shaped buildings) was gorgeous and clean. Our plan was "all inclusive" but tipping is very welcomed and appreciated (don't forget the daily maids). I met many wonderful guests at the pool and bar. The young attendants at the pool and restaurants are absolutely delightful.  They are compassionate, polite, more than caring and helpful. Most memorable was the extenuated family pool and beach attendant named Armando. Young, always smiling, always attentive and available to us (party of 8).  He kept us fed and watered and helped us obtain a beach cabana and "late" restaurant reservations (a must). The ocean tides were rough.  All pool waiters were wonderful.  The pool side entertainment was fun.  One activity was the "wax hand" by ART WAX (free).   Other free pool activities were the wonderful pool bar, salsa and belly dance lessons, and festive pool games and music.
We frequented the BANA and NAOS buffet restaurants and were never disappointed with the many many diverse food stations including almost anything you would desire. Lovely waiters there were Fernando, Arturo, Chacho, Rodrigo, Freddy, Alexia and Jessy. Very attentive and helpful. Every restaurant (with or without reservations) was just wonderful and tasty.
In the main AVENUE BAR we were welcomed and attended by Gerard who kept us well watered and amused. His smile was heartfelt. Evening hotel entertainment was interesting.
When you take the short bus ride to "downtown" you can find up-scale designer shops and a large clean mall.  If you have extra dinner money don't miss LORENZILLO's fish restaurant (bit pricey) including it's lake side alligator who eats your left overs off the patio.
We took the ferry ride over to THE ILSAND OF WOMEN and toured the island on golf carts for and hour or so (separate costs). LOTS and lots of souvenir shops!!
We went on vacation to relax despite all the available tours and we were were never disappointed. We have returned and will again.

reviews.author: cherifphilippeg
reviews.title: Paradisus is " The best hotel in Cancun "
reviews.text:
Exceptional service , wonderful resort 
Very attentive and exceptional staff 
Kauil, best waiter , Mr Lazarus was very professional and hospitable , Sandra also at guest service , Royal service is really royal thank you so much to all the staff 
Sorry if we forgot some names ...
Our butler Guillermo was exceptionally wonderful , Javier at Mole the best ever service , attention to detail and hospitality 
Excellent job 
And the chef at Mole wow ! No words can express , excellent meal preparation and presentation delicious flavors
We were there in April the chef was new but absolutely amazing sorry we forgot his name 
The best of all who needs special mention and our sincere thanks is Mr Abraham Franco , manager who goes out of his way to make sure the guests are most comfortable and happy and no words can express our thanks to him for making our vacation most memorable , best vacation ever! 
We look forward to come back soon to this beautiful resort that is more wonderful because of the caring wonderful people like Mr Franco whose Purpose is to make guests happy 
See you soon !

reviews.author: Bob & Cathy M
reviews.title: a great time at the Paradisus
reviews.text:
The staff was extremely helpful.  Be sure to get your reservations in right away once you get on site or even before you come for dinner.  I would recommend the Royal Service.  The place is better set up for you.  The little bar/ food area is always stocked for you.  There is music every evening.  Some of groups are amazing and every night it is different., very relaxing.  Food was excellent at the Market Grill, Ocean front grill and everywhere we ate the service was great. I recommend having dollars in your pocket for tips.  a few dollars provides for great service.  Stay away from town.  You are better off making a trip to Walmart back at the states or the local Walmart in Cancun than shopping at local areas near the resorts.  Priced way to high.  Bus service is cheap, about a dollar ride each way.  Take a trip to the Yucatan area.  You will see amazing sights.  Weather was the best and pay for the Ocean view it is worth every penny.  Partial is not that good.  The breezes never stop.  We loved sitting on the deck and hearing the ocean roar.  

It is a great place to sit and do nothing.  Read a book on the beach, loved the Cabana's.  If you get Royal Service be sure to hook with Omar at the pool area.     The place is spotless and he'll take care of you.  

Our butler was Guillermo, he was really good at watching over us and taking care of any issues.  Help and tried hard to get us whatever we wanted.  Had some great advise and always wanted to help.  He gave us a great tour of the place, made our reservations with the Spa, dinners etc.  Helped in reserving our arrival to our departure and for every aspect of the stay.  

I will stay at the Paradisus again. 

We had room service one morning and the food.  Called in the order the night before and we had breakfast right on time because we had an early excursion.  Loved it .

reviews.author: M. Golec
reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text: We have stayed here twice and would consider staying here again.  We love the pool area and pool bar.  The hotel is beautiful.  Rooms are very nice. Food is okay. Hard to complain in such a wonderful environment.  Biggest negative would be the housekeeping.  Some days we got multiple towels and washcloths and some days none.  Other days we got one and not the other.  It did make us a little crazy, but again.........hard to complain too much in such a beautiful place. They are going to try to sell you on their version of Timeshare.  It is RCI.

reviews.author: Mark K
reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text:
Every one was amazing . The food was fantastic . The service was great. I can t say 

anything bad .  We asked if we could walk in to town and we were told we could take 
the bus. We walked up to town had a great time . We loved our time there!

reviews.author: Stephanie O
reviews.title: Family Concierge is wonderful!
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our visit and loved both the kids club and our concierge. Really family friendly place! The resort is gorgeous. Our kids loved the baby club and asked repeatedly to go there throughout the day. Special shoutout for Alma who was such a sweetheart to our children. Our concierge, Alvaro spoiled us with special treats like toys for the kids and tequila and wine and cheese for us adults! The major drawback was how security treats the guests. Upon check in, we went to get lunch at Naos. I went outside to see the beach and who I thought was a lifeguard came over and asked to see my bracelet. I had no idea what he was talking about as we had not gotten anything at check in. He rudely insisted I be escorted back to the front desk immediately. I told him I would go with him but needed to let my family know where o was going. They refused to let me go. I had to literally run away from them to tell my husband not to worry about me. It was so humiatibg and embarrassing and set the wrong tone to the beginning of our stay. Once we got over that "welcome" we really had a lovely vacation. It also helps to tip! ;)

reviews.author: Cheryl H H
reviews.title: A winner for several reasons
reviews.text:
Reasons to stay at this amazing hotel: quiet but not dull or boring,  wonderful personal attention to guests, very friendly staff at all levels, beautiful and super clean grounds, rooms, restaurants, great food no matter which restaurant you choose to dine at, the day use palapa is so comfortable and relaxing,  the little extras like Popsicles and fruit kabobs passed around in Royal Service pool area, personal butler service in the pool area means you will never want a poolside bar again,  turndown service, personalized gifts,  great management, very comfortable bed and pillows, very delicious continental breakfast and evening snacks with coffee/tea/bar service and live music nightlife, clean pool, very fresh fruits, quality name brand liquor.  We stayed in Royal Service and would recommend it highly!! Try the Mango Tango drink, and for sure try the Nao buffet for dinner or breakfast - this is not your ordinary buffet...think lobster, filet minon, and other absolutely delicious food.  Lastly,  huge thank you to Sandra, Eddie, Javier for your extra special efforts that made our stay remarkable.  

Cheryl and Don
Seattle

reviews.author: Desireeflakita
reviews.title: The best resort in Cancun!
reviews.text: We are truly happy with everything about the Paradisus Cancun All Inclusive Resort! Wouldn't want to go anywhere else!! Loved it! The food was just great! Such a big variety!! A place for family and just couples as well! Lots of volleyball games!

reviews.author: 868christinaf
reviews.title: Pampered at the Paradisus 💕
reviews.text: I highly recommend going with the Royal service. Our butler, Edwardo was amazing and the service from Victor while poolside was exemplary. Overall the staff is very pleasant and accommodating. It was truly a tropical pradise and we will be back!!

reviews.author: Traveler042
reviews.title: Enjoyable and pampered vacation
reviews.text: We stayed here for 5 nights after staying on Isla Mujeres for 3 nights and we were very pleased.  The Paradisus Cancun - adult only is the only way to go if you are looking for a vacation away from kids.  We had a great room, wonderful butler, and service around the pool and beach was perfect.  The restaurants were excellent and always had something to enjoy.  The beach is beautiful but when we were there beginning of April the waves were huge so we could not enjoy the water.  I would definitely stay there again.

reviews.author: mhendoI8974MV
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation
reviews.text:
My fiancé and I travelled on April 9th 2016, stayed a week at Paradisus Cancun. 

Ill start by saying that the service was amazing, the staff were on top of it the entire time. We would sit in the same section when going to eat breakfast and lunch at the buffet, the same server would serve us and would remember what drinks we liked which was nice. They were happy and very outgoing.

The food selection was very good, we really enjoyed the market and the sushi. 

Entertainment was good, they had performances every night at around 7 pm which was nice.

We had a ocean view room, the rooms were great and the beds were VERY comfortable.

We were in the main tower (highly recommend it) the tower to the left was hot and muggy (only negative comment about the hotel). Another couple we met said their room which was in that tower was hot so we lucked out. Our room was kept cool & wasn't muggy.

We loved the look of the hotel, very clean and modern.

I recommend this hotel, we had a FANTASTIC vacation and cant wait to go back!

reviews.author: emmadB6612IG
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Outstanding.  Shout out to Royal Service Staff, Samantha (awesome) at front desk check in/out (and throughout), Butler Juan (wonderful), Sindy at La Palapa (incredibly outstanding!), Eddie at La Palapa and Pool service, Victor at Pool server, and Omar, Pool/towels, etc.

reviews.author: l200625
reviews.title: Awesome vacations
reviews.text: We went to have fun and relax at the same time after a rough semester of class and we found both. I do really recommend this hotel to everyone thinking on going to Cancun. My visit wouldn't be that good without tha special attention of Kauil at the Naos Reataurant and Flor at the beach area. Also, we had a wonderful experience thanks to Miriam and Miguel at Bana restaurant.

reviews.author: terryrn63
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation!
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time in Cancun, Mexico! The Paradisus Cancun was perfect, so was the weather. I would highly recommend the hotel to anyone. There were no cons. The room was updated and terrace was extra large. Even though we faced the lagoon, we were very happy with the view. Food was fantastic and abundant along with the service at the restaurants and poolside. Our favorite restaurant was Blue Agave for lunch and dinner. Great food with exceptional service by waiter Atilano. Lots of palapas on the beach and at the pool. The Caribbean Sea was beautiful with hues of blue and a panoramic beach. We went jet skiing and parasailing and had a great time. The check in area was private and comfortable. I slept there while waiting for our room and my daughter went down to the pool😋. We didn't want to leave. Service with Olympus tours was smooth and hospitable. Entertainment every night was great with shows and music. We loved all the glass windows and walls in the hotel. The hotel was very updated, modern and clean. You could see the sea wherever you went. We didn't use any of the My Time coupons but it was great to have the option.

reviews.author: Blanca July B
reviews.title: Cancun trip
reviews.text: Very good overall.  Great mattress.  Good service at beach and pool.  All employees seemed to be eager to be of help throughout the hotel. Food was okay, not exceptional.  Shows could be better.  Still had a good time.

reviews.author: turk704
reviews.title: It's Good but it's not Playa
reviews.text:
After experiencing Paradisus at Playa Del Carmen  maybe our expectations were too high, but although this is a pretty good resort we felt like it was a bit of a let down.

Great beach. you walk down to an awesome Cancun beach. It is Clean. Well taken cared of. 

We stayed on the  Pyramid 5 (Adults only I think)  it was pretty good. The LaPalapa restaurant was OK for breakfast without the crowds of the Market Place Cafe.  However food came out wrong at least 3 times ( example Asked for Bacon egg and cheese omelette. Got Cheese omelette with bunch of bacon on the side) 

For a RESORT that  serve to many Foreigners the number of English Speakers were not enough. Most of the staff spoke survival English rather than actually being able to understand and help guests.

Restaurants were good but not excellent choices. Selection of food was pretty good.  

We scheduled a couples massage on the free day (from our seminar) using the butler service.  When we showed up they didn't have our reservation. So we had to get it couple of days later (they did offer 50% off instead of comping the whole thing) 

So overall, I say it's a 4Star at best.

reviews.author: popejoy59
reviews.title: great service
reviews.text: Asuncion the waitress at the beach at the Paradisus Cancun was one of the best.  She provided excellent service and very professional and hard working.  One of the few female wait staff members in the hotel.

reviews.author: Brian F
reviews.title: Family Vacay
reviews.text: We went to Paradisus Cancun Resort for a family get away. Very well maintained property and we stayed in the middle building. The rooms were very nice and clean. Only thing is that they didn't have enough chairs for the balcony. Most of the restaurant on the resort were really good as well as the buffet. We would stay here again if we came back to Cancun.

reviews.author: Nicole O
reviews.title: Paradisus MX
reviews.text: I came to Paradisus for my 30th birthday and it was exceptional! From the surprise cake and balloons in my room to the service! Kauil from Naos was 100% dedicated to providing me with anything I needed. As soon as he saw me he had a table waiting for me. I actually cried when I had to leave him at the end of my stay. Thank you to him, for everything.

reviews.author: Michael C
reviews.title: Another nice stay at a Paradisus resort
reviews.text:
Our room was located on the lagoon side of the building.  We were here for the all-inclusive Abraham-Hicks weekend.  The quality of the food and the room service really improved after the group left and we stayed on for a couple more days.  Was wishing it was the same level of quality during the Abraham-Hicks week.  The staff was wonderful.  Our mini bar could've been restocked better, and we needed new towels at times, but overall the stay was good.  The friendly staff made up for it.  

Apollo our butler was absolutely the best, kindest person we could've had.  We travel the world, and have had all levels of butlers.  Apollo stands out as a rockstar.  Seriously dedicated to providing guests the highest level of service.  Cannot say enough good things about this guy!  

A special shout out to Andres Contreras in the Nespresso booth... probably the highlight of my trip.  I own a Nespresso Lattisma, and it was a welcome sight to see good espresso was available.  Andres was a wonderful host, and treated every guest with a smile and was eager to help.  He's witty and kind, and probably the best person to be working as the face of Nespresso in Cancun!

reviews.author: 190irist
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text:
This is truly a paradise resort! Beautiful setting, good food (though I did not like the quality in all restaurants, some others were indeed wonderful and there is enough to pick from.) fun entertainment. 
And the service is superb!

The only thing I missed is a bit more culture. The resort is very far away from "real" Mexico and though they offer a lot of trips to natural, eco and water activities, there are no trips to see Mexican culture, at least none that I saw.

reviews.author: Y6708IObrendas
reviews.title: April 23-30 2016
reviews.text:
This was a beautiful resort, although it was too hot for my liking in most areas, at times it felt like the only air conditioned place was my room.  

We had too many maintenance issues during our week stay.  The safe box door had to be replaced because the lock didn't work.  Our key cards needed to be inserted several times before the door would open, and we had to go to the front desk to exchange keys that eventually didn't work at all multiple times.  We were told it was due to being near cell phones, but even after making sure the key card was not near a cell phone the issues persisted.  We also saw people from a room a few doors down sitting in the hallway one day because they couldn't get into their room because their key cards were not working and they were waiting for maintenance, which makes me think it was not a isolated incident.  They had to come more than once to fix a ceiling air conditioner that was dripping large amounts of water onto the floor.  Our alarm clock never worked after trying to plug it into many different outlets, I asked to exchange it but that never happened so we asked for wake up calls.  Maintenance staff were kind, timely and they did fix every issue except the alarm clock.

The evening  shows were at The Red Lounge which was an extremely small venue for the amount of guests staying at the resort.  After standing out in the hallway trying to see the shows because there was not enough seating,  I gave up trying to go at all.  The show dancers I did see were great, they deserve a more appropriate venue location.

There was a Nexpresso coffee shop but it was never open in the morning when most people would want a coffee specialty drink.  The drinks were good and the staff there were extremely friendly.
The food was good at the resort, I seemed to really like all the different chicken dishes, which sounds odd, but it made me think that I need to learn more ways to cook chicken at home.  The drinks were good, they used good quality alcohol.

The beach was beautiful, but the main beach area directly out of the central building only had cabana beds and not chairs.  There was a DJ booth playing music, but if you sat on the beach chairs to the side you could not hear the music, so it seemed like the music was catering to a small area that could not accommodate very many people.  Both beach & pool areas did not have enough spaces with shade or umbrellas.  

5 star staff, extremely and genuinely friendly.

reviews.author: Karla C
reviews.text:
The hotel is beautiful and the service is great overall, however, there were a few incidents that left a bad taste in our mouth. One where our room was not cleaned during the entire morning/afternoon and we had to request someone to clean it (we did not leave a 'Do not disturb' sign or anything). We were in the room while it was being cleaned and that was not very comfortable. Also, we left a card requesting breakfast in our room before the specified time for requests. The next morning when we saw that breakfast hadn't arrived by the time we requested we opened the door and saw that the card was still there! No one checked the rooms to pick up the requests. My fiance had to call room service to request the breakfast that we had already requested the night before and the person who answered the phone was very rude! He didn't feel comfortable making the request at all. After we got the food we noticed that we hadn't gotten the juice he asked for, but he didn't want to say anything because the lady who took the order was rude and not welcoming. 
We made some comments when we left the hotel but are not sure if anything happened with that. We stayed in room 1605 (we paid for the upgrade) from May 9 to 11 (2016). 
I have also tried MULTIPLE times to contact their event management people and no one has answered my calls nor returned them. When checking out they said they would send me an email with information about weddings in their hotel and I never received it. I left a voicemail recently and no one has returned it :/. Not very good follow up there. Hopefully that will improve. In the meantime we have already received information for other hotels' wedding departments.

reviews.author: aaronjteston
reviews.title: Servers Are The Best at Supreme Customer Service
reviews.text: Our May 2016 visit being our second, we were happy to come back to Paradisus Cancun! The initial visit was so enjoyable and truly fun . This second was just as enjoyable and RELAXING. Although all of the credit should go to the servers. They're very sincere in making us happy. Anticipating every need before having to ask. Manuel at the Pool bar was exceptional ! Paradisus Cancun is lucky to have him ! He moved heaven and earth to make not only us happy but everyone around us. He should train the staff at the front desk how to smile and serve and be actually happy to be there! Jesus Martin in the Naos was great,too. Guillermo and Melvin at the Market Grill were also exemplary! I hope they are all there for our 3rd visit!

reviews.author: Marcus B
reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: Attended a conference at the hotel and overall it's a good hotel. The conference facilities were excellent and general hotel facilities very good. The hotel has some nice swimming pools and excellent beach. It is a huge hotel and very accommodating to groups, families, couples. My room was a double room overlooking the front of the hotel, it was fine, a little old school, slightly tired but pretty good. The food overall was good, huge buffet options and the taco place at the front of the hotel was great. Overall would I come back and stay here, probably not, but overall it's a good hotel.

reviews.author: pepperstuffer
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort with outstanding service!
reviews.text:
Our family stayed at the Paradisus for 8 days. The staff is amazing, the hotel is beautiful and spotless. The service was the BEST EVER! Thank you, Rodrigo Velaquez for your fantastic entertainment, Freddy Ocampo for all the smiles and kindness and laughter, Manuel Dominquez and  Victor chale for the best pool side service I ever seen in my life, Fernando Ling, Chucko Barreva, Alexander Garcia, Abraham, Victor Petul, Christian (gato). Upper management really needs to look at promoting these individuals they are truly super stars for this resort. As a food and Beverage director in the US I have an eye for hard working people, and let me tell you they are Amazing, we had the most beautiful vacation because of your staff members and we had 10 people last year, next year we will have 20, BEST RESORT IN CANCUN absolutely amazing because of these staff members. The Food is fabulous, the beach is spotless, I even learned how to Zumba! Don't waste your money going anywhere else. 5+stars.....this Hotel and staff are a class act. Thank you again and see you next year.

Patti Bova

reviews.author: Jen M
reviews.title: Good Beach
reviews.text: Arrival and check in process was very easy.  Offered a cool scented towel on arrival and escorted into the private check-in.  We were offered an upgraded to ocean view room and we took it.  Room and view was perfect!  We did make reservations for a few of the restaurants and ended up canceling some!  We ate at the Market Grill and all of the servers where excellent!  My 19 year old son must have eaten about 5 pounds of meat and they just kept bringing him more!  Every morning we at at the buffet and our servers there took great care of us.  We always had our coffee and juice refilled! We ate dinner at Enso.  Our servers Fernando Manual & Jose Palesti took very good care of us.  Made up a special appetizer plate for us and refilled the appetizers with whatever we liked!  They also made "Special" drinks for us too!  Love the ambiance as this restaurant is out by the beach.

reviews.author: P7762JWkevinc
reviews.title: First timers,not the last
reviews.text: We had such a great time. pleasantness ALL the way around. Our morning waiter Kauil was over the top outstanding. took care of us well. His partners Jaime and Pablo all on the morning shift were very helpful as well. While some of the food in the buffet could be hotter,all food was good. the pool grill the best.,other than breakfast. ALL the wait staff and bartenders very nice. grade F, gift shop only took mexican money and nobody could exchange US for Mexican,sad. No matter how many staff say, go downtown to shop better deals. NOT stay in the resort. Overall B rating. beach, pools,staff. The hotel could use an upgrade. some things were wearing down. seemed dated.

reviews.author: Jeri Z
reviews.title: The happiest place in Cancun!!!!
reviews.text: This resort was absolutely beautiful, but it paled in comparison to the service!!! Everyone of the staff, and I am not embellishing, was totally focused on us, the customer...Every bartender, wait staff, room service, every customer service person, in whatever capacity, was exceptional. If someone even had a raised eyebrow, the wait staff was on it, asking that person if there was anyway they could help them...My friend broke her leg while staying here, and the staff was absolutely accommodating, compassionate and attentive to her every need....I felt like the staff loved their jobs, and it showed. , Concierge Abraham Aletandes, waiter, Nurbi and so many others that I did not get their names...there was one female waitress at the pool in the afternoon that was phenomenal!!! But all the wait staff was phenomenal!! Thank all of you for making my Paradisus Cancun vacation the best time I have ever had in my life!!!

reviews.author: ruben607
reviews.title: Royal Service at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
This is an excellent resort.
Perfect location, beautiful beaches, excellent service (Gerardo our majordomo was excellent, very polite, good manners, excellent treatment. If possible we will request him next time we are back). 
Good restaurants, definitely we will be coming back to this especial resort.

reviews.author: AdrienneGawlowski
reviews.title: Vacation of Great Memories
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun over Christmas and New Years 2015-2016. We are members of Melia Vacation Club, so we has extra service and attention. We love the way we are welcomed by the staff. The Children's pool and beach were fun. One day, we rented a cabana at the beach club for the day. It included a lobster lunch and all day bar service. The DJ was great - he played house music (my favorite) all day long. Even though I'm a mom now, it was fun and cool like a club. The food was really good - we especially loved the sushi restaurant and the casual taco restaurant. On Christmas day, Santa Clause arrived at the hotel via a helicopter and gave each child an age and gender specific present.
However, our trip would not have been as pleasurable if it wasn't for our regular waiter at Naos - the buffet restaurant. He is the best and most hospitable waiter we've ever had at any restaurant or hotel. His name is Martin Sanchez. He anticipated our needs, spoke English beautifully and treated us very well. We always asked to be in his section. One family arrived that were French speaking and sat at a table next to us and Martin started to speak in fluent French to them! He is a quintessential professional. My children almost cried when we said goodbye to him. If you go, please ask for Martin.

reviews.author: Maribel F
reviews.title: Unhappy
reviews.text: Food was horrible Royal Service was not worth it there was no royal treatment we were not pamper at all. An the butler did nothing for us and didn't know anything her name was Rosanna. Fuego restaurant was not good I recommend the Brazilian Restaurant.

reviews.author: PatNirag
reviews.title: Pleasant stay
reviews.text:
Very pleasant hotel situated in a great place. Spacious room, clean with beautiful view on the sea or laguna. Very good and high quality restaurants, especially The Bana and don't miss the Tempo by Berasategui, even if it's not included in the all inclusive offer. Great beach with big waves and welcoming swiming pool. Friendly staff.
On a negative side : the noise (music and bass) coming from a bar (red lounge) inside the main building is embarrassing to sleep regarding all the rooms situated in this building (higher you are (floor) better it is. Lock door damaged but not changed. Poor wi-fi.

reviews.author: amesbuddy
reviews.title: hello
reviews.text: It was a fantastic experience ... so much fun and the staff was beyond great especially Fernando our butler!  He was super and belongs being in the manager level! My friend and I will be coming back because we had so much fun.

reviews.author: A1574HVRyan
reviews.title: Poor Customer Service
reviews.text: I was charged twice, it took almost 2 weeks to resolve the issue. Our butler almost never answered the phone, when he did, he never did anything we asked him to do. We did not have enough towels in our room. We requested towels 2 days in a row and never received them. Water leaked from the ceiling in the bathroom, we were told to "just turn the air conditioning off!" It was 95 degrees outside! Hostess was rude at the Market Grill. Our waitress at the Bali Beds only came to check on us once. Our friends waiter came like every 20 minutes! Very Poor Customer Service, the resort is nice minus the people.

reviews.author: joesingh
reviews.title: Great Family Friendly Place, with few recommendations
reviews.text: Great Family Friendly Place, with few recommendations. The environment was great, the staff was excellent, the pools were great, the beach access was excellent. We had our 12 year old girl with us and felt comfortable with the surroundings. Biggest feedback is that the Bed was very uncomfortable, check to see if they are going to replace them soon and the couch had a big rip in it. The menu could be improved a bit for the price! other then that we loved it.

reviews.author: John M
reviews.title: Gracious service in a wonderful hotel
reviews.text:
There were so many positives to our experience it is hard to know where to start. This is a property that is meticulously cared for and managed. The food service was exceptional and the service levels of the staff were outstanding. With multiple dining options, it's hard not to find something to delight and they were always attentive to any dietary needs or allergies.
The views from our room (third floor in the third building) were lovely from a spacious balcony. The surf, although vigorous, was beautiful and enjoyable with very comfortable (81 F) temperatures.
The general manager was frequently out interacting on the property and was very hospitable and approachable.
If you want quite accommodations, one thing to be aware of with a room request is that frequently the main pool area is a location for classes and other events, so the sound of musical accompaniment was prominent. Also, our room was close to the elevators and that was a positive given some physical restrictions my wife has. However, it also was close to the atrium and that is also where evening musical events and shows are located in some of the lounge locations. That also had volumes that could be heard in our room. The volume went down after 9:30 pm so it had little impact on our ability to rest and sleep.
There are many conveniences that facilitate shopping and excursions and the activities on the property were many and varied. We did avail ourselves of several different snorkeling excursions, but one really does not need to leave the property for anything.
The dining service and staff were outstanding. All of the staff were most accommodating. The captain, Guillermo Lopez in the main buffet dining restaurant, Naos, was particularly personable and pleasant, seeing to our needs for beverages, etc. All the staff in each department were impressive in their attention and their bi-lingual skills.
We can't recommend this hotel highly enough.

reviews.author: picklesforsnookie
reviews.title: Quick get away to paradise
reviews.text: Everything about this resort was amazing!! Staff, beach, service, room, food-all fantastic. Would go back and couldn't have been happier with my stay!! Very good mix of other travelers. Never felt over crowded. With three pools and several lounge chairs on the beach there was always a spot to relax. Staff was attentive and entertaining.

reviews.author: Maria R
reviews.title: STAY AWAY FROM LETICIA ROYAL SERVICE
reviews.text:
"We stayed from January 20 to January 24 the acting honestly and found amazing staff , warmth and kindness, and to say our Rodrigo butler! It was very funny and made ​​us laugh all the time, he recommended restaurants and food and became good friends , plus we kept in touch with him and he told us is Dad !!! Every day you were leaving an envelope with $ 50 for the baby from the first day , and when we said we never got NOTHING we feel angry !!! Every day the concierge LETICIA received the envelopes. And now Rodrigo tells us not to receive anything ! LETICIA STOLE A BABY !!! WE FEEL VERY ANGRY WITH THAT !!! Rodrigo work so hard and so well, and she stole it! Do not trust her, just trying to fool people in a sexist way! I hope to do something about it, there are many butlers who are in Royal Service and surely it also robs them ! For her NEVER be back! Please do not leave your money or belongings near her !
I want her to be fired !!!!, She does not deserve to be surrounded by such great people."

reviews.author: Npassanita
reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: This place was great. We stayed there May 1,2016 to May 7,2016. This would be our 3rd time traveling to Mexico and our experience this time was so good all because of the Paradisus! The food had so much flavor (at the restraunts and the buffet) the beach was great, and the service was excellent in the rooms, pool, and bars. The pool was right next to the beach so we had the best of both worlds as well! My husband did use the golf course one time and he was not too impressed just because it was so short. Another thing is if you have a hard time walking, request a room in tower 3 because the resort is so large. We stayed in tower 1 and everytime we wanted to go to eat or go to the bar or spa, it seemed like the walk took forever and sometimes it was confusing to get from place to place. Other than that, we would give this place a 9/10...absolutely beautiful vacation!

reviews.author: AndreJacinthe
reviews.title: Our second time at this resort !
reviews.text: Hello, This was our second time at this resort. We enjoyed every moment. The buffet was excellent at Naos. Thank you to Guillermo Lopez and his awesome team (Eder, David, Ceasar, Jaime, Victor, Vincente, Jordhi, Marco, Servendo) Everyone was amazing. Customer service is priority for them. We really recommended this resort. We enjoy also the beach every day. Service at the beach was excellent, thanks to Ingrid and Sergio.

reviews.author: Jeff J
reviews.title: Pardisus Resort - Cancun
reviews.text: The Paradisus is a fabulous hotel. It is conveniently located so the excursions off property don't take all day...but who needs to leave the property. The friendliness of the hotel staff is tremendous. I would highly recommend The Paradisus.

reviews.author: jane b
reviews.title: stunning resort & beach!
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort with an abundance of plants, vines and trees inside as well as a fish pond, flowing water and a glass ceiling high above it all. Lovely wooden walkways and furniture all immaculately kept with cleaners working 24/7. The resort was spotless inside and out at all times, the staff were extremely polite, and the atmosphere was wonderful.
Truly a 5 star resort. 

My favourite restaurant was the Market Grill. It serves food in a dim sum style - yet the food is not asian!  They come around with steak, roast beef, chicken, potatoes, vegetables, salad etc etc. Tasted fantastic!

The reason i give the resort a 4 instead of a 5 was the noise level in our room in the evenings (this was in the main pyramid #3). Unfortunately the music permeated into my room on the 3rd floor as if I had the door open. 

The only other mild complaint was that the coffee bar had kind of useless hours (10am - 10pm). But really.......if that is all i could complain about, thats pretty awesome.

I would totally recommend this resort. I had an amazing time. And it was so so clean you could have eaten off the floors both inside and out.

reviews.author: Rick Plant
reviews.title: Our second trip and not the last one!
reviews.text:
Hello,

This was our second trip to the Paradisus Cancun Royal Service section. We were there last year at the same time.

We have had a superb stay at this hotel last year and we are very happy to say that this year stay was better. This resort is very well run by the management and you can see that they are always improving the customer experience.

The resort condition:
Not new, but exceptionally clean and well maintained. The washroom at the beach and on the resort are always clean. The glasses, the utensils and the plates at all restaurants are very clean. There are a lot of windows in this resort and there are always clean.

The beach:
Superb! The beach is cleaned every second day and the ocean was just amazing. The weather was great during our stay and we enjoyed nice days at the beach. The bali beds are great and very cozy.

Service at the beach:
This is what makes the difference. The service that we receive at the beach is excellent. Water bottles in a bucket of ice, beers in a bucket of ice, drinks delivered to your chair, amazing beach food and a Royal Service exclusive ocean-view restaurant. All the people working there were just amazing and they are always happy to see you.

The restaurant:
The quality of the food and the service was again amazing! My wife has Gluten intolerance and everyone on the staff were well informed of what this is and the consequence it could have on her. At every restaurant, we were offered Gluten-Free options. This is well indicated on the menu and they also offer to make special dishes if we prefer. Once again… Amazing service and staff!

The Naos buffet, The Market Grill, the Mole (Mexican), the Banna (Sushi) and the Palapa (exclusive to the Royal Service customers) were the best. 

For the Royal Service customers, you have an area before going to your room where you can stop and eat a quick bite and drink whatever you want. I was very nice to be able to bring a cold bottle of white Chardonnay from Spain to our room while getting prepared to go for dinner.

Drinks:
The house wine was great. It was composed of wine selection from Spain and Chile. We were always offer to buy wine from special wine list and pricing was affordable, but we were very happy with the house selection.

All the beer came in cans and there was a great selection including light beer. 
Liquors brands included all the great brands that we are used to.

The people:
Our butler Fernando made sure that everything was as per our expectations. He took care of our reservation, informed the staff about my wife intolerance and checked on us every day to make sure that everything was as per our expectations.

Christian and Eder at the morning buffet provided great services and made us smile every morning.

Jorge and Cesar took great care of us at the beach and at the Palapa in the Royal Service section.

Efrain and Jose at the Market Grill provided us great service on two nights. If you go there, you absolutely need to try the Market Grill. 

Alberth also provided great services in the Royal Service section and he was always happy to see us.

Darwin took great care of us at the Banna and made our sushi dinner a great experience.

Daniel at the pool always made sure we had the Bali bed we wanted and all the towels we wanted.

To be honest, we have had great service from every member of the staff from the beginning of our stay until the end.

Only one complaint:
The shows in the evening are of very high quality. Unfortunately, not enough room space for everyone to have a seat. The room is too small.

One thing is sure, it was again a great vacation and we will go back in the months to come.

Whenever I read a bad review about this hotel, I always laugh about it.

I highly recommend this hotel.

Erick and Diane

reviews.author: Tammy S
reviews.title: Most relaxing vacation we have ever had!
reviews.text:
My husband and I decided to book the Paradisus for our 25th Anniversary, and it was a great decision.  From the moment we arrived, we were welcomed with snacks and drinks.  We had a very quick check-in with Angel, who was able to explain and process very quickly.  We were introduced to our Butler, Fernando, who was outstanding!  He provided a great overview of the beautiful hotel, our room and all of the restaurants.  He made reservations at all of our requested restaurants, and had special drinks delivered to our room.  

The hotel was absolutely amazing and beautiful.  We had a one bedroom ocean front suite, that was stunning, and had the most awesome views of the resort and ocean.  We loved our rental of the bali beds, and had fantastic service from our waiters Moises, Gorge, and Abraham.  The swim up bar was also fun.

We enjoyed all of the restaurants, but one of our favorites was LaPalapa that was ocean front.  We also enjoyed our lunch at the Blue Agave.  We really enjoyed the Market Grill which was a Brazilian Steak house.  Another perk was being able to order room service whenever!  We enjoyed our little lounge area in Pyramid 6, there was always delicious snacks and great entertainment.  We also enjoyed the shows that were held at The Avenue Bar.

The spa was one of the most amazing experiences that I have had, and Gemma provided me one of the best massages that I ever had!

reviews.author: Ryan Roberto
reviews.title: Nice & Relaxing
reviews.text: We checked in late on Thursday night around 11:30pm. The family concierge desk was closed so we went through the main reception desk. There was a significant line and while the employees were polite and trying to give each guest the appropriate attention they deserve, I believe there should of been more staff on duty. The room was clean and decorated on arrival and Maria the Family concierge manager made sure to stock the room with snack and fruit trays upon our arrival. She also had kid bags waiting on the beds with pool toys and sun screen etc etc. our Concierge is Alvaro and he's great. He will do anything for you and never says "no". Even when are preferred restaurant was completely booked he got us a table. The pool is large and clean, however it's deep on average is approx 5 feet or more in most  areas, there is a kids splash pool adjacent to the main pool. The drinks were always good and cold and the attention from the waiters at the pool area seemed to come by and check on us every 20 min or so. My kids loved the PlayStation and Xbox in the family concierge lounge, and everyone in there is always ready to assist. All in all a great time in Cancun.

reviews.author: LA_Success
reviews.title: Paradise Lost
reviews.text: Beautiful grounds - beautiful views, nice staff, very nice outdoor entertainment options - Late night food at late night food station on final night (thank goodness!) was the only food option available and boy oh boy -  did not sit well for both me and my friend the next day.. Sorry to say - the whole week was OK so did not expect to be hit. Food must have been on heat lamps too long?

reviews.author: anastasiahunter
reviews.title: Too many little things
reviews.text:
Nice resort, rooms are all tile and pretty, service is good people are nice. But there are many little cons that would keep me
from returning..

Lounge chairs with shade (umbrellas) are reserved early in the morning, but there are usually lounge chairs available without any shade. Sad for the kids or people recovering from their sunburns. Very few chairs have umbrellas and they are taken right away. You can rent the bed for the day ranging from $50-$100 per day.  The "good" or "fun" pool is the one with the swim up bar and entertainment, the other pool has nothing, no entertainment, no bar, and only one server that makes her rounds as often as she can.

There is only one bar outside. 

There are limited bars inside. (I only found 2). One in a restaurant and the other on the second floor. 

*there is a nice nespresso bar, where the barista very cheerfully makes you cool flavored coffee's or macchiatos etc. all made "with love". 

You will not get drunk. You are drinking water in that cocktail all day. Stick to beer. 

There is no room for your clothes. Might be OK if there are only 2 of you. Otherwise you'll be living out of your suitcase. (Junior suite, lagoon view) If you ask for more hangers and squeeze it all in the closet you might be ok. (5 small drawers and a small closet) 

Balcony is nice. We got 2 chairs outside of ours and our family got 2 lounge chairs. So if you prefer one over the other you should ask for it. 

Lounge chairs have 2 positions, flat down or halfway up, no in between. And they're very uncomfortable. (Same chairs wherever you go including royal service.)

We had a chance to check out royal service. Nothing special except a butler and top shelf liquor. No entertainment and there's one or two separate restaurants otherwise you share the restaurants with everyone else. You can pay $75-$100 per day for the perks of Royal service without the room change. 

*Room service is all inclusive. That was a big plus as all hotels don't offer that. They do not bring cocktails to the room but food is included. 

Mini bar is ok. Water, beer and a few snacks. Our minibar had only 2 Mexican beers and our family had Heineken. No coronas to be found anywhere unless you buy outside of the hotel. 

I don't like to comment on food because everyone has their own taste. I don't like the buffet at all, including breakfast, the eggs are strange, but so far the restaurants have been pleasing to me.

All in all, for the price of this hotel, I would not return.

reviews.author: cjmspcun
reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text:
My daughter and I stayed at the Paradisus Cancun over Spring break this year and from the first moment we arrived it was a pain! We arrived at 6:00 pm and were told we would have to wait for an hour for our room. We were given over to a Concierge who proceeded to sell us hard on every adventure she could think of as well as trying to get us to sign up for an hour and a half breakfast the next morning at 7:30 am to see the condos that were for sale. We signed up just to get away from her. 

When we arrived in our room we were given one King bed and not the two double beds we had booked. For the next three days we were told we would need to come to the front desk and check to see if any other rooms were available. The problem was that every morning no matter what time we stopped we were required to wait in the check in reception line for nearly an hour- we never did get a different room and after several days gave up!

To cut to the chase, room was not as described, room was never cleaned before 3:00 in the afternoon, no pool chairs or beach chairs even at 7:00 am in the morning, towels ran out every day and you couldn't get a clean towel, general helpfulness of the room service staff and front desk borderline RUDE!! 

I will NEVER go back to this hotel or ANY of its properties. Not four stars. I wouldn't give it more than two at best and not worth the expense. 

Hotel rooms need to be updated. Linens and towels (when available) were old and threadbare.

Worst vacation we have ever had and we have been to Mexico and Cancun 6 times over the years. Couldn't wait to leave!!!

reviews.author: ElleAhr
reviews.title: Royal Service earns its name
reviews.text: Excellent service from the Royal Service butler and the staff that supported him. Great selection of restaurants, all with superior food selections though our favorite was Mole. House wine was satisfactory and other liquors were premium as promised. A major benefit of Royal Service is more calm and quiet plus we got reservations at every restaurant we requested while others tried all week to get into some of the more popular venues.  The main pool has constant loud music from which we could distance ourselves somewhat at the Royal Service pool.  We heard from others staying in pyramid 3 that the nightclub music went on until 4AM; there was blissful quiet in Pyramid 5 (Royal Service)

reviews.author: Petalpages
reviews.title: Wonderful Place to Be
reviews.text: We loved our trip to Cancun and our stay at the Paradisus Cancun.  The service was excellent and the care we received wonderful. We loved the nightly entertainment and the meals that we had at Fuego and Mole were delicious.

reviews.author: emmaj182
reviews.title: Awesomeness at its very best!
reviews.text: The staff were amazing so friendly, kind, helpful, happy & joyful they go the extra mile always. Big shout out and big HUGS especially to all the pool bar staff, Market grill staff, and Bana staff. My favorite restaurant was by far Bana and also the NAOS Buffett always pleased. Fuego also delicious go with a group so you can try everything. I will be back again what an awesomely special place :) THANKYOU!

reviews.author: 1234jmj
reviews.title: Best Vacation so far!
reviews.text: Had the most amazing stay with our group!  Very accommodating staff and very attentive . I never waited for a beverage or food! The rooms were lovely.  There was a great kids area . The beach is beautiful !

reviews.author: dpmeade
reviews.title: Great service & accomodations
reviews.text: This was a group conference with around 1500 attendees. Service and accommodations were above average. Food was good including the every day buffet.There was no tipping as this was included in the price and the staff did not expect a tip.

reviews.author: Terry V
reviews.title: Group Adventure
reviews.text: I'd never go to an all inclusive resort of this type on my own, but we had a huge conference there and our group took over the whole place and it was amazing!  Amazing!  Amazing! Food was good, the setting was breathtaking, the beach large and clean, the pool refreshing and large.  Loved every minute there.

reviews.author: Shendil P
reviews.title: Great Resort for Families
reviews.text: This resort is perfect for our family since we have two very young kids. The rooms are clean with the beach and pools all close proximity to the lodging areas. Again, with young kids this is a plus unlike some of the other resorts with huge properties that require bikes or golf carts to get around. The resort staff was very nice to us - we really appreciate the service that was provided at Naos by Kauil and Pablo. Both of them took unbelievable care of us. If you come to this resort, I recommend sitting at the tables that they look after which is near the fruit and salad area of the buffet. They both treat you like royalty and we haven't seen service like this in a resort before.

reviews.author: Shanna F
reviews.title: Loved every moment in Paradise!
reviews.text: I enjoyed the set up of the whole place, the service, the food, it was all wonderful! Friendly and helpful staff. The spa was great! It was a pleasure to be there and would definitely go again! The pool's were amazing and everything was so clean and well tended to.

reviews.author: williamchuat
reviews.title: Must Stay in Cancun.
reviews.text:
The location and the Hotel is beautiful. After 14 yrs., it has maintained the charm and cleanliness. 
The Staff super friendly and hard working. Must give recommendation to Andrea Cardinas , a staff who works with passion and made sure we get the service due us.

reviews.author: Matthew A
reviews.title: Incredible space
reviews.text:
This was a beautiful facility, inside and out.  Really spectacular. The giant center, filled with green and the giant glass dome at top, were really stunning.  

Restaurants:

There are over a half dozen restaurants, all with great food.  The buffet was the only wobbly spot.  It's often good food, but sometimes mediocre.   

The rooms were also lovely.  Far more spacious and luxurious than other hotels.  The views from our deck were great.

The pools and beach set up were amazing as well.  Pool is very nice.  Warm and cool design.  Swim up bar very fun!  A little too deep in some parts, around 5 1/2 feet.  The only downside is that it closed at 7:00 in April.  But it did start to get a little cool.

Beach was beautiful.  They have lots of cabanas and thatch umbrellas that were fun to hang in.  The ocean was warm and so much fun.  A few days the waves were too intense to fight, so we had to stay out, but other days a blast.  Cancun I guess is known to have wile waves at times.  

I would absolutely go there again.  Was really a special place.

reviews.author: Charles J
reviews.title: Not likely to return
reviews.text: The air conditioning was set at 65 the whole week and could not cool the room on 6th floor. The Building 1 only had a single stairwell and the only elevator in building 1 was broke for the first 30 hours we were there. Not good for six floor building.

reviews.author: betzaida2016
reviews.title: Excellent Service!!! All Included is the way to go!
reviews.text: The place is amazing, clean, great food food... the Personal is super friendly. Thanks to William and Pablo from Naos Budfet, Claudio from Enzo, Andres from the Expresso Stand and all the hostess specially Sandra Luz, Miriam, Kathia and Alicia.

reviews.author: rono207
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun review
reviews.text: In all areas the resort did a great job for our group.   Entertainment and food were excellent.  Staff very friendly. Convention space for the group was perfect.  Beach is beautiful.  We plan to come back with another buyout in two years.

reviews.author: dmahaffey
reviews.title: Paradisus Paradise
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time! So much to do and see and great people to be with. I would return to this hotel again in a heartbeat. Looking forward to the next Landcruise with the Abraham-Hicks family. It's so damn easy to have an amazing life!

reviews.author: Abrahamster
reviews.title: Fun and relaxation
reviews.text:
Thank you Paradisus. Be advised that you can walk across the street to Aqua World and use kayaks and paddle boats for free in the lagoon (hotel relationship). Also easy walk to Mayan Museum (wonderful!) and simple bus ride from the hotel to shopping areas.
Activity staff do a great job. A huge spectrum of activities to choose from, or put your feet up and enjoy being still.

reviews.author: Marina P
reviews.title: Paradisus...not so much
