reviews.text: our family came along for the weeklong seminar; the hotel is falling apart, from the rooms to the spa things look like they are disintegrating and fast; the most expensive ocean view family concierge room that we had barely had enough seats to accommodate a comfortable meal;  the paint was peeling, the curtains had stains,  the beds were uncomfortable, the air conditioning worked when you turned it off and barely and quite unpredictably;  however, the staff is great, especially the Kids' club staff - they are the only reason this place is getting any stars from us.  The food is ok, with the exception of  Mole and Tempo, which were great.  The layout of the hotel is such that if you have a stroller or wheelchair and you need to move about  quite a bit you will be met with a few obstacles. The pyramids are not all alighted - you have to go up the stairs and then down the stairs to get from one pyramid to another.  There are elevators but many were often broken or just took too long when we visited.  If you choose you can walk outside but there are lots of up/down ramps which again can make stroller operation challenging.  Again, the staff were great for the most part, except if you call 0, you might have to call for a long time - no one would really pick up or call back.    So we are definitely not coming back to this location.

reviews.author: Barbara A
reviews.title: Loved everything but the food
reviews.text: The property is gorgeous, the beach incredible, but the food was terrible.  We stayed in Royal service and I loved that part.  Unfortunately many people at the hotel got sick,   My husband included and it was my understanding that the doctors ran out of IV for people. I hardly wanted to eat because of the food quality and taste.  Because it's all-inclusive I think  there were too many shortcuts on food quality. We stayed at a different Paradiso's in Playa Del Carmen and the food there was outstanding two years ago.

reviews.author: Annie T
reviews.title: Didn't want to leave!
reviews.text:
We traveled with our 6 year old.  The staff were very nice and very professional . We ate at the buffet every meal cause there's no reservation . Everyday it's a different theme. Naos is the buffet place inside the hotel. Cesar prado , Gullermo Pech and Osar Hdz were amazing! 
The hotel room were clean and house keeping did an amazing job. The pool is always clean!  And all the staff by pool and beach side are super attentive.  If you have never been there before its 15 min ride from the airport .  The taxi from the hotel to Jfk were 25$ usd.  We paid a little more from airport to hotel because of our poor planning . 
We can't wait to go back again!

reviews.author: Charles M
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Very nice hotel with very friendly staff. Well located for various activities. The rooms are nice sized, and the restaurants offer decent, but not great, food. Beautiful hotel on the inside and the outside. I would not hesitate to stay again.

reviews.author: Jamie
reviews.title: I've been to better but still great.
reviews.text: We are here now and enjoying it very much. There are only 2 pools and only one bar outside (unless you have royal service). Drinks are watered down as expected. You can order drinks *and food* by the pool with the waiter so that's a plus (takes a while to come but not terrible). Room is nice all tile, staying in lagoon room, decent view. Not a lot of drawer space, not many hangers for the closet but we asked for more and got more. Major Plus* room service is all inclusive! And reservations for dinner were not hard to get.

reviews.author: JENNIFER L. BURNS
reviews.title: April 2016
reviews.text:
Overall was a fab experience!  Great value for price!  Customer service was great!  Layout with all food choices was wonderful.  They were very a conidati g on food allergies and sensitivities!  Wow!  These guys at market grill were great!  
Sonya
Effrain
Jose
Melvin

reviews.author: kathycU6842QP
reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: Stunningly beautiful resort with fabulous clean white sand beach and awesome waves to play in. Very clean and staff were really helpful. Lots of choices for dining and food was pretty good to excellent. Coffee addicts might want to pack their own as the resort coffee is pretty weak and only available at limited times

reviews.author: NimoKelly
reviews.title: Incredible service and luxury
reviews.text: Can't recommend it highly enough! Can't fault a thing! The staff were so attentive and nice, the surroundings were so beautiful and the food, music and atmosphere were outstanding! The entertainment at the beach, pool and in the red lounge were fantastic!

reviews.author: Leticia M
reviews.title: Average
reviews.text: Facility is ok nothing fancy.  Food very limited in the selection.  Hotel is dark not enough lighting. The set up in the hotel is very confusing. Got lost several times getting to my room. I couldn't find anyone to help me out, had to go to reception for help.

reviews.author: Denita C
reviews.title: Abraham Hick Land Cruise - April 2016
reviews.text: Perfecto.  The staff was friendly and eager to attend to your needs.  Food was delicious, entertainment was off the hook. Every day the sunrise & sunsets were amazing.  The resort is beautiful, our room was very comfortable, all our needs were meet.

reviews.author: DayTrip370762
reviews.title: Beautiful place!
reviews.text: What a beautiful resort!  Excellent food.  Very friendly service, they bend over backwards to keep you happy.  Beautiful beach with soft white sand with beautiful blue water.  Nice swimming pools & plenty of chairs for everyone.  Will diffently go back.

reviews.author: 2tradergal
reviews.title: Very good with 2 exceptions
reviews.text: This is a great resort, with 2 exceptions. The service is super fantastic, the location is fantastic, the beach is fantastic, the food is generally very good, the rooms and facilities are very nice, and the price is right. 2 exceptions: the pools all close at 7 PM, and the buffet desserts are very low quality. I feel that a decent resort would have evening swimming possible, since even most cheap motels typically keep the pool open until 10 pm. And the buffet desserts were very low quality and not recognizable as any particular "thing." They were mostly blobs of tasteless gel/pudding-type stuff in all different colors, with a tantalizing sliver of dark chocolate on top. Beautiful, but not enjoyable to eat. Even the so-called cheesecake was made of the same stuff. But overall, this resort is very good.

reviews.author: DIANA V
reviews.title: Best in class service
reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay at the hotel.  Accommodations were nice, but most importantly was the service!  Our waiter, Sergio Mosero was outstanding!  He went out of his way to make sure we had a great time - rain and all!  The food was also really good!  My only complaint is that they are very trained in trying to sell timeshares which is not how we wanted to spent our vacation.

reviews.author: colletti5
reviews.title: amazing resort
reviews.text:
I just spent a week there and have to say the resort is wonderful and would definitely come back.  I stayed in pyramid 3 and the humidity in the lobby area was awful though.  
The best part of my stay was using the poolside cabana's, they were amazing.  The pool concierge's Victor and Nurbi went above and beyond-great service!!  I felt like a queen.
All of the staff were very helpful with any requests we had.  The restaurants we ate at were wonderful, good service and good food.  We did try to make reservations for dinner for other restaurants and they were already booked, which was disappointing.

reviews.author: sn0rkers
reviews.title: Pyramid fun
reviews.text:
Our family stayed here at the end of April.  I was accompanying my wife who was attending the Abraham Hicks convention there.  I was making the most of enjoying the facilities and having a great time with my young daughter.  She enjoyed the pool, the beach, the evening entertainments and the extra attention from the delightful staff.  We had a room on the lagoon side which was perfect for our needs.  The only fault I had with the room was when the door to the mini bar fell off and landed on my bare foot.  Fortunately no lasting damage caused and the prompt attention of the maintenance staff meant that it was fixed within 10 minutes of reporting it.
The ambiance inside was made extra calming by the decoration for the convention - you couldn't fail to be in a chilled and happy mood!  We met some great people there and overall this was a really special and memorable holiday.   Thank you Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: travelingfriendReno
reviews.title: Beautiful resort.  NIce accommodations
reviews.text:
Strange layout. Took a week to mostly be able to find my way around. Had to climb stairs  and then then descend stairs to get to the other side of the same floor.  I was on the zero floor.
Beautiful interior.  Some maintenance needed on bathroom fixtures. Too dark. Smelled like sewer gas in the bathroom.

reviews.author: 1anncat7
reviews.title: We had an amzing time.  The resort was top quality and the service was amazing!
reviews.text:
I was amazed at how great the service was.  They worked so hard to make sure our trip was special and always had a smile on their faces.
The rooms were beautiful and very comfortable.  And the food was great.  Most of all I was amazed at the service.
Our waiter Ignacio Vazquez was so helpful and pleasant.  He did a great job taking care of us.
The concierge Abraham was also very helpful.

reviews.author: דליה מ
reviews.title: Excellent, fabulous!
reviews.text:
My husband stayed in Paradisus Cancun‬ for 7 nights in a conference that took place there. The resort is amazing! The food is extraordinary! We loved every minute of our staying. 
Pool has warm water and I loved it. The ocean was wavy and fun. Waiters and staff are friendly and willing to help and to serve. We made friends with waiter Erik at the Bana restaurant (grate guy, and they serve the Best Sushi!). Samanta Rachel was an amazing hostess, beautiful and kind. We highly recommend.

reviews.author: Herbie J
reviews.title: Service Service Service
reviews.text:
I spent a week at the Paradisus Resort. I can't rave Enough about the Quality of the food at Every one of their restaurants. Not to mention the actual location and view of each one. They make it Too easy to eat well.  The coffee stop called "Nespresso" with hosts Anores and Yhoni was a must have daily. All of the wait staff were beyond friendly and attentive.  
The "Entertainment" staff were Just as Friendly. Fernando, Freddy, Rodrigo, Hugo and Chacho (*the DJ staff) worked non stop to bring the best of sound, lights and Talent to Coco's Beach and the Pool activites Daily. Werk. The Nightly Red Lounge entertainment was First class talent, Some of their Singers should have recording contracts they were that good.
The Paradisus Resort itself is Stunning,  The rooms, the views, and the "Piramides" (*all 5 of them.) I was always looking UP to catch the amazing lighting and flora. 'Highly recommended for all Family , Couples, (*sexy singles) and Business events.
I want to go back for sure.  Thank you all for makeing it memorable.

reviews.author: bmorehappy19
reviews.title: Beautiful beach, excellent staff
reviews.text:
My husband and I travelled here for a relaxing vacation. I was impressed by the lobby and beauty of the common areas. The views were breathtaking, especially eating outdoors overlooking the water. The beach was very close and gorgeous There were plenty of towels and we had no issue finding a chair and umbrella on the beach daily. The service was wonderful, we had some stand out interactions. A delight was getting our coffee daily from Andres. Rodrigo provided excellent service with a smile on the beach daily. And the servers at Blue Agave each evening were professional and courteous, especially Roberto. 

Also we loved the gym facility. The yoga class was a highlight for me, I loved the instructor. She really taught to all levels and the class in dual English/Spanish was awesome. 

Our room was okay... the room was clean, but I felt the bathroom could use some fixing up. The stopper in the tub was broken, and the bathroom looked like it could use a deep clean and updating. However, I don't go on vacation to spend all day in the room. We had an ocean view room, but I wish the balcony had glass railings rather than cement. You couldn't sit on the balcony and see the water. This is obviously a small thing. 

The only downside was the hard sell of the vacation club breakfast at check in. We attempted to say no several times, but our concierge would not let us go. When we finally agreed and then tried to cancel later, we were approached again in the lobby and questioned why we would not go.  This is very unappealing, and really left a negative taste in my mouth. Please take guests at their word when they say they are not interested.

reviews.author: bobdQ6790BO
reviews.title: Most amazing trip with amazing manifesters
reviews.text: I knew I would have fun, but it was so much more than that. Amazing people everywhere and the best service imaginable. Unbelievable parties, wonderful food, relaxing beach, and awesome swim up bar! And I met an amazing woman who just blew me away! How does it get any better?

reviews.author: E802OOsallyb
reviews.title: wonderful hotel
reviews.text:
My week at the Paradisus Cancun was amazing..  the people working there are so friendly and helpful. 
The whole hotel is kept spotlessly clean. There is a good variety of food . The sand and sea is stunning.

reviews.author: brigitte m
reviews.title: Beautiful setting. Spectacular beach.
reviews.text: I stayed at the Paradisus for a one week workshop, fun and sun. I had an amazing time. My room was beautiful and very clean. My Ocean view was a real ocean view! The resort is clean and beautiful. I have met wonderful guests and staff. Bana restaurant was my favorite by far. The food was delicious and Erik, our waiter, was amazing, professional and so thoughtful. The best coffee and friendlyess staff was at the Nespresso booth. Delicious and fun. My best morning service was with Gaudencio at Naos restaurant. So kind and so thoughtful...preempting my every needs. Thank you!!!

reviews.author: Xiaoyang G
reviews.title: Good hotel, but poor service
reviews.text:
It is a very nice hotel, clean and beautiful with a lot of famous restaurants inside. I was very happy when I first got to the hotel. But then the bad service turn me down.
I arrived the hotel about 7pm at night. The staff told me I can not make reservation for any restaurant after 4pm, I must go to buffet. That is ok. I told him I want to make a reservation for tomorrow's dinner. Then he told me he can only find a table for me after 9:30pm. I asked him how about the day after tomorrow? He finally book a restaurant for me at 8:30pm. So I went to buffet for 2 days, finally the good restaurant on the third day. I was so hungry when I got to the restaurant at 8:30pm, but I told myself, it is worth waiting. Then the receptionist told me that THEY CAN NOT FIND MY RESERVATION!!!!! I tried to argue with them, but it is useless. They treat me like liar or trouble maker. So, I went to buffet again. I know those people don't really care about the tourists, but they should at least pretend they feel sorry for their mistake.

reviews.author: Karin S
reviews.title: Wonderful hotel
reviews.text: Great service, Asuncion the waitress by the poolbar was absolutely great. The food was great. Everything was wonderful. The beach is beautiful, although a bit to wild to swim in. I had a great room in the familyconcierge building.

reviews.author: Nikki S
reviews.title: What an amazing vacation!
reviews.text: From the moment we were dropped off at our resort, we loved it. Everyone was so friendly! We were upgraded to Royal Service free of charge when we checked in and it was amazing! The exclusive pool area was extremely relaxing and most of the staff was great (especially Kauil from Naos and Anores from Nespresso). We would HIGHLY recommend staying here and enjoying a great time at a very classy resort.

reviews.author: Nancy M
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: All staff were very friendly and there were so many options for restaurants and poolsides. Never saw garbage around. Nightclub acts were very good. The lush greenery everywhere was absolutely stunning. The spa was exceptional.

reviews.author: 616sheilak
reviews.title: Paradise the most beautiful ocean views! I  could hear ocean at night the waves crashing. I love the beautiful atritium
reviews.text:
Loved the Atrium . The service was out standing. Always being offered a drink or something to eat!! Such an erray of fresh fruits veges and seafood!
Even the bed was nice and firm. And room very clean.

reviews.author: firetwirling
reviews.title: beautiful resort
reviews.text: everything was great, the staff was amazing and friendly....until the last day.  our flight wasn't until later and the attitude of the staff changed once we were no longer 'guests' of the hotel.  you are not entitled to any food or beverages after noon on your checkout day.  our flight wasn't until 9pm so this was kind of inconvenient.  the last day of food at least should be included as well considering the price for the resort

reviews.author: prglidden52
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation
reviews.text: We loved our experience at the Paradisus Cancun.  The service was impeccable, the room comfortable, the views breaktaking and the food choices varied and delicious!  The evening entertainment was fun and well-done.  We highly recommend!

reviews.author: Michelle J
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun Beautiful!
reviews.text:
I recently stayed with 1399 others at the Paradisus Cancun and the experience was delightful. 
Beautiful property, location was great, entertainment spectacular and many restaurants to choose from. It appears staffing for all inclusive is on a contractual basis meaning the staff are hired for lengths of time and then must be rehired. They were really great and respectful.

reviews.author: Joyful042016
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: All inclusive feature was great, especially considering the quality of the restaurants and facilities.  Great shows every night.  Beautiful setting inside and outside.   Plus, as a solo traveler, I felt safe there.

reviews.author: Tirzah W
reviews.title: Gorgeous property and attentive staff
reviews.text: our stay here was absolutely exceptional. the food was great at the buffet and all the restaurants. the landscaping throughout the hotel is gorgeously done. but what I really want to highlight is the service staff. they were so incredibly warm and genuine the entire week we stayed there; no matter what their station, waiters, bussers, hostesses, those washing windows or cleaning bathrooms, everyone had a smile for us and a hello. we particularly enjoyed Andres, Yhoni, Gonzales and Torres at the popular Nespresso cafe! And Pablo, Orlando, Abraham, Moises, and Gerardo on the wait staff!  Incredible attention to detail. Really really pleased!

reviews.author: Wendy-iamhpy
reviews.title: Simply Magnificent
reviews.text: This resort has everything needed to enjoy a wonderful vacation.  Your every need and desire is catered to.  There were many restaurant choices within the resort.  I enjoyed the nightly entertainment.  The pools were fabulous.  Easy access to the beach.

reviews.author: Robert E
reviews.title: ALL INCLUSIVE COMFORT
reviews.text: This is a great resort for those who like the all-inclusive vacation. The food was good to exceptional. The staff where amazing! They went out of their way to make sure you had everything you desired. Any off-resort trip was available at the front desk or poolside. Totally accommodating the vacationer.

reviews.author: perkinsbritni
reviews.title: Junior Family Concierge Oceanview
reviews.text: Loved the room. Was a little loud being so close to the avenue bar where the shows were held. The view was beautiful. Loved being able to see the pool and the ocean from the room. My family and I really enjoyed the resort.

reviews.author: Mandy K
reviews.title: Great time at the Paradisus
reviews.text: Amazing location. Great access to beach. Staff incredibly friendly and accommodating. Food on average was pretty good. Some was a bit disappointing. Surprised by how good the daily buffet was so we ate there a lot!

reviews.author: ShellySantaFe
reviews.title: Terrific all inclusive resort
reviews.text: Many wonderful amenities here at Paradisus Cancun and the best is its beach and pools. Great beachside service, large towels and comfortable lounge chairs. Beds both on the beach and by the pool are available for a fee. I was with a group so we also had music and many activities like salsa lessons, workouts in the pool, and other entertainment. Rooms either face the lagoon or the ocean so both views are beautiful. Beds very comphy. Staff very efficient and friendly. Good selection of restaurants and delicious food.

reviews.author: wandaisis
reviews.title: Law of Attraction week
reviews.text: The hotel is perfect if you want an Amazing experience. We have stayed in the Royal Service pyramid and have experienced Excellent food and ambiance. And the service from every body in the hotel was really amazing... Specially the butlers.

reviews.author: Anthony P
reviews.title: cancun acation
reviews.text: Satisfied with service and overall accommodations.  Preference for a larger room and more space. Arrangements for private party was very good. Activities for young adults was limited to the pool and dining.

reviews.author: Pamela A
reviews.title: TRULY PARADISE
reviews.text: a week of rejuvenation felt like a month - so lovely indoors & outdoors.........surprised at the number of places to simply relax and take in the beauty of it all :-D  The staff is very friendly and efficient.  Always someone available to provide assistance.

reviews.author: Lisa M
reviews.title: The name says it all!
reviews.text: Loved every bit of my stay here!!! Friendly hard working staff alway attending my every need :). Soft sandy beach front property. Warm pool. Variety of food and alchol to choose from. And did I mention that I had a butler that would have a rose petal bubble bath waiting for me each evening!

reviews.author: singingwoman55
reviews.title: Even better than I expected.
reviews.text: Weather was good. The hotel has everything great food, great rooms, right on beach, comfort. It was better than expected. The service staff were the most committed that I have ever seen. This place has it all going on. I would love to come back.

reviews.author: P T
reviews.title: Great all inclusive weekend! Experience.
reviews.text:
Tha BOMB!
Many restaurants of high quality.   Great pool.  Tremendously friendly staff.   
Ask for Mayra at the South Bar.  Why not!
She is awesome!   
Rooms were awesome with turn down service.   Many shows and great excursions.  Ask for Ricardo from activities he will wear you out.
Hotel is very clean and modern
You must come Play-a!

reviews.author: TomStretches
reviews.title: Visually Intriguing Design, Beautiful Spaces, Great Service
reviews.text: I loved many aspects of this resort. The design of 5 pyramids is quite intriguing, allowing you to look down from above from any floor into a wide open space. And when you are below, you look up into this big open space with greenery hanging from all the floors above. The restaurants were varied and laid out in a fun way, but still near to each other to create a central entertainment area. All the finishings and decor was modern and colorful and beautiful. The food was excellent and so varied in the buffet, and then there were many specialty restaurants for more fun. The pool areas are great and go on forever, and the actual beach is very nice, with lots of beds and chairs, great live music or DJ, and amazing ocean. The staff is friendly and helpful, which is most important while on vacation.

reviews.author: Jerri A
reviews.title: Awesome Resort, Beautiful Beach, Exceptional Staff
reviews.text: We reserved rooms in Pyramid 5 which was the Royal Service area (adults only) with a private beach and private pool, fresh fruit, cheese, meats, and other snacks and drinks available all day.  La Palapa restaurant was a beautiful open air restaurant between the pool and the beach with great food and friendly waiters.  Our butler, Rosanna, was organized, efficient, and gracious.  She unpacked/packed my suitcases and ironed items that were wrinkled.  She also handled all dining reservations, etc.  The resort had over 10 restaurants with delicious food and charming, friendly wait staff.  All staff went the extra mile creating a memorable experience, from the lifeguard on the beach, to the store clerk that inflated our swim rings, to our waiter in Mole restaurant that not only expanded our knowledge by explaining the difference between a dozen varieties of tequila but also informed us about interesting facts (did you know that Cancun means "Serpents Nest"?)

reviews.author: Maggi S
reviews.title: Great escape
reviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed our experience. Of course the large group we were with made it even more amazing! The staff was so friendly and seemed to be like long lost friends. There is so much to do there. I look forward to going back! We loved the "all included" aspects, including use of kayaks& Hobie Cats for lagoon adventures.

reviews.author: carilynd
reviews.title: Excellent hotel.
reviews.text: Everything you could ask for in a hotel. The service was excellent.  The foliage was perfect.  The ponds were exceptional. The service was superb.  The food had variety and delicious taste.  Keep up the good work.

reviews.author: Carina M
reviews.title: Beautiful Paradise at Paradisus
reviews.text: My mother and I spent a week at Paradisus Cancun at the end of April 2016. We were picked up by the resort shuttle and it was a very quick and smooth 15 minute ride to the resort. Checking in took less than 10 minutes and our room was ready immediately. The whole resort is absolutely breathtaking, there are 3 large pools and many chairs to be shared amongst everyone at the resort. The staff are all very kind and always smiling. The resort has one store in it, and there is a lot of good souvenirs and food there reasonably priced. The resort has lots of greenery and a beautiful spa, where we had the best massages we have ever had! Those ladies sure are talented. We really had no issues except a slight musty smell in our living room and be warned- there is a lounge open until 2am every night and the bass of the music does travel throughout all of pyramid 3 in the resort. You definitely want to be in pyramid 3 though however, as all of the restaurants and beach access is through that pyramid. Overall, a very clean and beautiful resort with wonderful staff and lots of nice views inside and outside the resort. Would go back and would recommend. This was our first time in Cancun and it was a very nice impression.

reviews.author: 100thmonkey
reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: Nice clean place very nice staff - food excellent with wide range of choices - pool and outdoor beautifully maintained would recommend hotel and would stay again easy to get to good transportation chech-in well done

reviews.author: Sharon P
reviews.title: A little disappointed
reviews.text: Bathroom lighting was so dark it was hard to see.  No one spoke enough english to be helpful.  Staff not very knowledgeable.  Spa was chaotic. Massage was nice but staff not helpful about signing us in and giving us guidance.

reviews.author: kpaide
reviews.title: Better than the Ritz Carleton
reviews.text: My sister and I were visiting as a part of a week-long group retreat and could not have been more pleased with the friendliness of staff, service in general, luxury of hotel, and food.  In fact, one evening we walked down the beach thinking we'd like to explore and have a drink at the Ritz Carleton.  We were shocked that a hotel with a reputation that precedes it, was far inferior to the Paradisus.  We immediately bolted and joyously returned to the Paradisus for dinner.  I still fantasize about the buffet!  Everywhere we turned, there was a staff member greeting us with a smile and asking if we needed anything.  Every detail was in place and cared for.   We would return without hesitation!

reviews.author: mary m
reviews.title: Air conditioning
reviews.text: Has an issue with the Air conditioning the whole 8 days stayed in room 5006 from April 22 to 30 2011 . Put in my complaint several times they came in to check on it but never followed up, everything in our room was damp from the humidity, my grandson slept on the belong every night because it was cooler. Everthing else was wonderful outside of the room was wonderful.

reviews.author: dianasN2340GF
reviews.title: No regrets, here!
reviews.text: Great location, with plenty of restaurant variety, big, beautiful interior open spaces with a great sense of privacy, and perfect outdoor pool areas and huge beach front access.  Definitely lives up to its motto:  "The place to just Be"

reviews.author: katiev492016
reviews.title: Gorgeous resort with wonderful service
reviews.text: We had a fantastic time enjoying Paradisus resort. It was fantastic to enjoy the lagoon and ocean sides of the resort. The pool and ocean front were so lovely we did hardly any other Cancun exploring and had a wonderful time. The housekeeping service was frequent and our room was kept beautiful! Our favorite restaurants were Bana (delicious sushi) and Vento (Mediterranean tapas). Among many wonderful servers, a couple stood out. Erick Sanchez at Bana Restaurant made sure we had stellar sushi dinners and was thoughtful with great suggestions on drink and food orders. You will need to make reservations for eating at the restaurants outside of the buffet, so definitely request to be seated in Erick S.'s section. He'll take great care of you. Manuel took great care of us at the pool, as well. We are so happy we chose to come to Paradisus -- it was such a stellar experience.

reviews.author: Angel179Ruby
reviews.title: Amazing resort!
reviews.text: I have just returned from spending 10 days at Paradisus hotel with my family. The resort is absolutely amazing and there is so much going on you would never get bored. The staff at the resort go out of there way to make sure you are being taken care of with food and drinks. The pool staff constantly made sure you were happy and having a good time. Thanks to Armando for making it extra special. The entertainment team are absolutely brilliant and there is a constant turnaround of activities. They made it fun and put the guests first. All the entertainment team were amazing and a special mention to Freddy who went that extra mile. I would recommend this hotel to friends and family and anyone else looking to go to Cancun. Thanks to all the staff at Paradisus who made are holiday the best it could be!

reviews.author: Elizabeth L
reviews.title: Attention to details!
reviews.text:
Beautiful surroundings. Friendly staff. Abundant variety - pools, beach, spa, restaurants.
Fabulous entertainment! The staff seemed very, very happy.
They accommodated our group of over 1,000 effortlessly...or so it seemed!

reviews.author: TheEnergyWizard
reviews.title: Attended the Abraham Hicks Workshop
reviews.text: Amazing time with this resort.   Staff was excellent and nice.  Pool area was great.  Beach was great.  Little smelly on the middle due to the plants, I'm sure.  Rooms are nice. We did book a suite ocean view.  I would recommend letting them know at booking that you do not want floor zero.  We were disappointed with our room, especially since we paid a premium.  There was an ocean view a little of you stood on top of the balcony wall.  Since you're a little underground you cannot see over the pool huts.

reviews.author: shari173
reviews.title: Paradise in Cancun
reviews.text: Everything about this resort was spectacular! The food was abundant and a wide variety of items to choose from. The entertainment was the best!! The crew at the pool had activities every day - shout out to the entertainment crew!! the best ever!!!

reviews.author: RottenBob
reviews.title: Wonderful resort and staff
reviews.text: The resort was very nice, the food and drinks were plentiful and good but it was really the amazing staff that made this one of the greatest weeks of our lives. The pool and swim up bar were perfect, the beach was wonderful, and the atrium of the hotel was continually amazing. The paella along with the taco bar by the pool each day were wonderful and the activities next to the pool were very fun to watch and participate in. We would return Paradisus in a heartbeat!

reviews.author: Dee M
reviews.title: Group of Love (Abraham-Hicks)
reviews.text: This was an all inclusive Abraham-Hicks land cruise- 1400 happy, positive people - good food, good music, fun activities at the resort- I didn't go on any excursions but the hotel would arrange them- friendly staff and very well organized.

reviews.author: pallen21
reviews.title: awesome resort!!!
reviews.text: This was our first trip to Mexico and we were beyond satisfied with every aspect of Paradisus Cancun. The resort is spectacular and beautifully maintained. We were so impressed with the gracious and smiling staff that went out of their way to provide the best service we have ever received. And the food was outstanding!

reviews.author: vince v
reviews.title: Great time!
reviews.text: All looked fabulous when we arrived and got better as we began to experience the full facility. Pool side and beach are we're excellent with lots of very comfortable seating and cabanas to enjoy the amazing weather. Very easy to have s great time but I would highly recommend you study the site map, it is large and easy to get turned around but lots of happy faces to help get you back on track

reviews.author: Cynthia F
reviews.title: Real vacations
reviews.text:
I have two kids, 4 and 5 years old and all this time I haven't had so much rest and real vacations!
I really pass a great time, my kids love all the activities at kids club, you can have great time indoors
Amazing

reviews.author: Compass39969
reviews.title: Paradisus will not disappoint
reviews.text: If you're looking for an idyllic spot with a variety of high quality food and entertainment options, look no further.  Paradisus offers everything you're looking for without ever leaving the premises in an innovative indoor garden jungle setting on glorious full-luxury service beaches.

reviews.author: Pushkala
reviews.title: Top notch resort in Cancun!!
reviews.text: The entire resort is immaculate and absolutely stunning, the interior areas of the buildings are gorgeous, the water views are spectacular, the spa is lovely, there is a wonderful selection of restaurants, and the staff is incredibly friendly and willing to accommodate any request. Highly recommend the Royal Service building and a favorite food item was the shrimp and fish ceviche at Mole.

reviews.author: Lidewij d
reviews.title: New definition of service!
reviews.text:
We booked the royal service which is highly recommended. Great resort, amazing beach and perfect service. 
We didn't have ocean view but were on the first floor which apparantly left us with a spacier room. As mentioned by others: good bed, good ac, clean, good shower, towels etc

We were amazed by the friendliness of *all* the staff, and especially Fernando, who cared for the first floor in the royal service area. The service shown by the people in this place is so remarkable that it really redefines our sense of service. Always friendly, always greeting, always helpful, even when we turned multiple appointments into impossible situations: they make it work. Also the Spa is amazing!! They do everything to please your every muscle. Take the 80 min massage if you can. Thank you so much for this great experience! We'd love to visit again.

reviews.author: benny_decock
reviews.title: Paradise in Cancun
reviews.text:
Great hotel Paradisus , Great service !!! Nice pools, cocktails bars, resto's.
Every class can be handeld, Family, adults only, Royal Service.
Even for your wedding is this the place to be, there is a very nicy wedding chapel with a view on the beach.
For a vacation without worries. If you look for a piece of paradise you will find it here !!!

reviews.author: karen g
reviews.title: Excellent stay, would recommend it.
reviews.text:
My husband attended a conference held at the hotel so I went along with him.  SO glad I did!  The resort was very very nice, picture perfect in fact... well maintained and everyone seemed very friendly and willing to help.  From the white-sand beach, to the turquoise-colored water, to the immaculate grounds and pool area, to the well-stocked buffets and restaurants, I really have nothing to complain about.  Perhaps they could add a few more palapas or umbrella areas so you don't have to be out in the sun, I could see that being a problem in more crowded conditions.  We found our shaded area early in the day, beating the afternoon crowd.  We did leave our towels, sandals, iPhones, room key, etc., in a bag [hidden from view] on our chairs and never had a problem with anything being taken.  We also utilized the in-room safe for all valuables and never had an issue.  

The housekeeping service was excellent, beds made fresh daily and with a turn-down service and chocolates on the pillows every evening!  Nice touch.  [Altho' friends in the room next door did not receive chocolates, kind of odd!]  The mini-bar is included, which was unexpected but really nice.  Our room was made up early and always every clean!

The resort had many restaurants to choose from, however reservations are needed at most of them and they must be made before 5 pm the day you want to visit.   It was odd as many didn't seem 'full', but it was the rule and they didn't made any exceptions unless someone cancelled a reservation.  There were two places that were not part of the all-inclusive and required an extra charge.  We did not eat there.  

As part of the conference we had a few nights where staff had to serve around 150 people and they did so without problems, and with a different theme for each of the nights.  We felt the food was great, lots of authentic Mexican food choices along with healthy options and food made-to-order.

A couple complaints I have regarding the conference accommodations... a couple times there was a cocktail hour that was held in what seemed like the basement of the building [however with views to the street].  The room echoed a lot and seemed a bit 'cold', not much decor and lots of white tile.  It was loud and not a nice place for the conference attendees to mingle and network.  I would think there must be other places within the resort that would have been a much better fit for that purpose.  Also, the last night we attended an awards dinner and it was held at the same time another group had a dinner/meeting and the other group didn't seem to know where they were to go-a bit of confusion.  They were a much 'louder' group and during our meeting they could be heard yelling and playing their loud music.  Again, I would think some of that could have been avoided given the size of the resort.

reviews.author: Maria Luisa G
reviews.title: Recent vacation at Paradisus Cancun.
reviews.text: My husband and I recently spent 19 days at Paradisus Cancun, a resort we have been visiting since 1996.   As members of the Melia Club, we received an outstanding assistance by all staff members that made our visit to be unforgettable.  We are already looking forward to visiting Paradisus Cancun in the very near future.

reviews.author: richardz248
reviews.title: Awsome Trip
reviews.text: I recommend this 100%. Our concierge Juan was awesome. We didn't need to ask for anything because he was already on it. Also was really enjoyed the service of Eddier in the Royal Service lounge and at the pool side breakfast. They both became like family to us. We felt spoiled the whole trip.

reviews.author: floody10
reviews.title: Lovely Hotel
reviews.text: The hotel is lovely rooms are clean bathroom was a bit tired sink was blocked , but someone did unblock it after a couple of days. The beach and pool are very nice but you have to get up very early if you want a sun bed, we found a lot of people leave towels on the beds then go off for four or five hours although there are signs saying they will be removed but they are not. We found most of the staff very helpful special thanks to Barbara in the buffet restaurant and Christian and Santiago in the Avenue bar who went out of their way to make us feel welcome. What spoiled the holiday for us was there was no furniture on the balcony, when we asked why we were told they  are being refurbished but they would try to get some from a room with furniture when guests checked out, but never heard a thing. Then on our last night we left our room to go to dinner, on our return i found that my I phone had been stolen reported this to reception who sent security to my room, they searched our room and luggage but found nothing. I was told they would make some enquiries and let me know in the morning before we checked out guess what NOTHING. You work hard all year to have a nice holiday and when this sort of thing happens it feels like once they have your money they don't care, it leaves a very bad taste in your mouth.

reviews.author: gwenc375
reviews.title: A very nice resort
reviews.text:
The pros:
•	All inclusive – you don’t have to tote your wallet with you everywhere you go
•	The staff was super attentive
•	Clean, clean, clean – I think they came and changed our towels twice a day
•	Inside the pyramids there were many water features and plants, giving a very soothing rainforest feel
•	Huge pools and easy access to the beach
•	Multiple restaurants with different cuisine options
The cons:
•	Shopping and other restaurants were not within walking distance
•	There never seemed to be anyone working the Guest Service desks
•	Only 2 of the 7 restaurants didn’t require prior reservations. Reservations had to be made the day prior (they tell you that you can make reservations day of, but we found this to be untrue)
•	The food was good, but uniformly under salted, so it tended towards being bland
•	We paid for a lagoon facing room, but our view was of another building. Luckily we didn’t spend any time on the room’s balcony – mostly because there were no chairs.
 Overall, I would stay at this resort again.

reviews.author: amw67
reviews.title: Beautiful resort for a relaxing in the sun
reviews.text:
Great resort, the people were incredibly friendly and the resort was well maintained. The grounds, pool and beach were beautiful and the service was prompt and efficient.

Particularly impressed with the generosity of the hotel - many 'all inclusive' hotels can be mean with what they provide in the package but not Paradisus; even room service and the mini-bar were all inclusive.

A variety of restaurants offered something for everyone and Naos, the buffet restaurant, had an amazing choice all day.

A special mention to the staff the took extra care to make our holiday great:

Jessica and Lilia (hostesses in Naos restaurant)
Daniel and Antonio (waiters in Naos restaurant)
Carlos (serving drinks on the beach)

I'd love to say the hotel was perfect but there were some minor niggles - they won't rent golf clubs after 1pm so you can't play late in the afternoon, the DJ on the beach during the day loved a bass beat far too much(!), and Guest Services really need to focus on serving the guests and refrain from 'selling' Club Melia. Don't let this put you off the hotel, it won't stop you enjoying a fantastic resort.

reviews.author: jgoldie
reviews.title: Gorgeous Resort, Honest review
reviews.text: Resort, pool, rooms and beach are beautiful one of the best in Cancun. There is sun all day it is not blocked by the resort building like many other resorts. There is plenty of shade if you want shade. Getting shade/umbrellas at other resorts in Cancun is often a problem. Staff around the pools were wonderful. We've  used USA transfers from the airport for the last 16 years and have always been happy with the service. We do not like the food at this resort. They do not have many options and there has always been at least one restaurant closed every year that we have visited. They do have one highly reviewed restaurant that is not part of the all inclusive, we have not tried this restaurant recently so we can't review it. Do not leave anything unattended at this resort. We have had something stolen on numerous occasions and the resort does nothing except take a note of what the missing item is, this is a common problem in Cancun no matter where you stay, but some resorts do make an effort to discourage their employees from stealing and do try to find your missing items, it is clear that this resort did not care and blamed us for leaving anything where someone could take it. They made it clear it is a common problem there. I am sure there are many honest employees, but it only takes a few. They do have entertainment but it is in the nightclub and unless you are one of the first ones there you will not be able to see it. Very bad location for shows. Cancun is safe to walk around and you can take the public bus for $1 each way where ever you want to go There are bus stops on the street.. Do not stay on the bus past downtown thinking it loops around. It ends up at a depot in an area that is run down. There are many excellent restaurants in Cancun, Lorenzillo's, Thai, Harry's, La Habichuela. There is even an excellent bakery in the new supermarket in the Kukulcan plaza Soriana is on the second floor, excellent chocolate empanada . Soriana is better than Walmart. This time we flew in earlier than our reservation and paid for an extra day, we were made to check out of our room in the morning and were told we could not check into our new room till evening. The hotel was not full and our original room still was not cleaned in the evening when we were in the second room. So why make us get out?? We thought we left something in the room so we know it still was not cleaned. There has been a convention every year we visit that takes over the Hotel and is given priority. There are numerous steps to get to the street from this hotel so it is not good for anyone out of shape. We were given the 3rd degree from the sales staff on numerous occasions when we were walking to the street from this hotel, They sat in a golf cart or stood on the sidewalk by the bottom of the stairs. They wanted to know where we were going and accused us of leaving to do a timeshare presentation and said they didn't believe we were going where we said, there is no excuse for that.

reviews.author: Jamie M
reviews.title: Amazing Stay!
reviews.text: I stayed at this property for a corporate event and enjoyed every minute of it. The property itself is beautiful and the rooms were very nice, clean, and well maintained. I was lucky enough to stay in the Royal Services area and the level of service was fantastic! The staff was so helpful and friendly and really made us feel special during our stay. Its a beautiful place to relax, unwind, and enjoy great food and drinks by the pool and beach. A special thank you to Edier, Octavio, Elizabeth, Juan, and Axel for taking such amazing care of our group. Thanks for everything!

reviews.author: Bobearmy
reviews.title: DO NOT GET MARRIED HERE
reviews.text:
First I will start by saying if I hadnt gotten married here and it was based on the resort stay only I would have given it 4 stars. Property is beautiful from the beach to the pool. Very well kept, most of the staff is very pleasant and helpful and the food is pretty good considering it is an all inclusive. We did have a butler, Juan, who was awesome. Took care of multiple issues on very short notice, couldnt have been more pleased with Juan. I will also say in terms of the wedding we had an amazing time due to the people we were with and the fact that we were in Cancun. The major problems were setting up the wedding. Throughout the planning, do not expect to hear from your contact until about 2 weeks after any email. Leading up to the wedding we could not get in contact with anyone we needed to for weeks at a time. This was beyond frustrating to say the least. I should have known better once we got our deposit in however. After emailing what we wanted we were told everything we wanted could be done. We wanted the ceremony and cocktail hour at the gazebo, and the reception on the beach. Approved, deposit sent. I then went to meet with the planner for details and planning. After finding out that "turtle season" was around our wedding date (not being told by the staff), I asked to make sure this would not be a problem. For a second time I was informed the reception could be on the beach for the time and location we originally requested. You can see where this is going. About 6 weeks prior to the wedding we were informed we could not have the reception on the beach due to the turtles at the time we requested. We could either have it by the pool, or 3 hours earlier on the beach. I did not want a beach reception at 5 in the afternoon, sun still blazing and having to end the party at 8pm which was required. I completely understand the turtles and having to protect them, but as this has been happening for decades, we should have been informed WAY prior to placing our deposit that we would be unable to get what we had planned. I have no doubt this information was kept from us intentionally to get our deposit and leave us no choice but to change our events. We decided on the pool area which they did set up nice. The next major problem was the DJ which they contract out. However, if you contract with this company, it might as well be Paradisus in my eyes as they are representing you. We spent countless hours coming up with about 15 songs we wanted played at the reception, the rest would be left to the DJ. We had maybe 4 of them played. After noticing time was winding down and we had only heard a couple songs, I approached the DJ who had the list in hand, and asked him to only play what was on the list. He proceeded to play the next song from the list, then go off it once again. 11 pm hit and we got 4 of our songs. I didnt let it bother me as it was our wedding night but was very upset after the fact. As for the wedding planner, I wont mention by name but if she reads this shell know exactly who she is, might as well should not have even showed up. Seemed as if we were bothering her with any questions or concerns we had. She was also the one who would take 2 weeks to respond to simple questions that would have taken less than a minute to answer. 

If you are going to stay just to stay, the resort itself was very nice. I WOULD NOT suggest getting married here however. Check out staff was not very nice either, tried to overcharge us then got "bothered" when we pointed it out. They did correct it but took some time. Also skip the sushi place, small group went and most of us felt sick the next day with one person puking and pooing himself all night. Buffet and Blue Agave were very good though. 

Other than planning the wedding itself with Paradisus and the stupid DJ, I would stay here again for vaca only. Great pool and swim up bar, nice rooms, great beach, mostly good food.

reviews.author: Alexguerra12015
reviews.title: Paradises personal
reviews.text: I have a very good attention from Christian and Santiago from Avenue Bar and Marco and Alberto Lopez from Naos Restorant and for all most of the hotel that is beautiful, pools, installations, building but my room don't fill my expectations not sufficient with electric ports at strategic places it has balcony but not seats and table inside need also a table and seats were to have access to work on your laptop or have service room diner.

reviews.author: Expedition533504
reviews.title: Royal Service!!!
reviews.text:
After thorough research and reading through tons of reviews, we decided to stay at Paradisus Cancun. The hotel is beautiful, spacious and clean. About a week after booking our stay, we decided to upgrade to Royal Service, and we are SO GLAD we did.

The Royal Service rooms are located in Pyramid 5. It really is not that far from the main pyramid, Pyramid 3. We had an amazing and spacious ocean front room with a balcony. It was absolutely perfect. Right below our room, on the first floor, there is an open bar of premium alcohol and food throughout the day. We also had a butler, Ivan, who took care of us the whole trip. He booked our dinner every night, and reserved a cabana for us in the morning. You're only able to reserve it for 2 days, and be wait listed on the other days. Two days was enough for us, but it wasn't crowded at all, so it probably would have been easy to get one. The RS pool was peaceful and relaxing, and also very close to the rooms, so that was convenient. We were also given a cell phone to contact Ivan whenever we needed something. He even sent us cigars when we had requested them!

The food was amazing, I looked forward to dinner every night. There are so many choices, we wanted to try them all during our 4 night stay but were not able to. As part of RS, we had access to La Palapa, the restaurant by the RS pool. They have amazing brunch/lunch food and you can eat it right in your cabana! Naos, the buffet was also very good. They had a varied selection every night, and was a great place to go if we wanted to snack throughout the day. Fuego, Vento and Mole were also all very good. The only restaurant we did not like was Market Grill for lunch, definitely would not recommend that.

The staff was also amazing. Everyone was very courteous, and conscious of making your stay as comfortable as possible.

******
After returning home to NYC, I realized I had forgotten my brand new Ipad at the hotel. I was absolutely frantic, and contacted the hotel immediately. After going through a few staff members, we were put in contact with Lazaro. He let us know that they had found it, and worked with us for a few weeks to have it shipped and returned to me in the US. After about a month, I finally received my ipad! This truly shows just how amazing the staff at Paradisus is, providing exceptional service even after leaving the hotel. I would absolutely return again, and recommend anyone to stay at Paradisus!!

reviews.author: 394harveys
reviews.title: Beautiful lobby
reviews.text:
Very accommodating. Can manage dietary restrictions with a smile.  Lobby is beautiful, rooms are very clean and well appointed
      
      Double rooms are very tight for a family of four.  Think about two rooms. We had suites

reviews.author: ponchtraveler
reviews.title: Paradisus - Decide who you want to cater to
reviews.text: Hotel needs to decide who they want to cater to - families, young couples, young people, old people or wedding parties.  They try to cater a little to each group which isn't working.  For example, if they would focus on a younger crowd, they need music by the pool and on the beach, live music at night, activities at night and around the pool (none existed).  For families - they need activities for children away from the rowdy pool (lots of drinking at the pool bar).  The violin playing was lovely, but definitely for an older crowd.  They definitely need more chairs on the beach - the sunbeds are not used and are a waste of space.  On Friday night, a wedding party was held around one pool and an anniversary party at the other pool.  Both pools closed for the evening.

reviews.author: sebastanl2015
reviews.title: Loved it!!
reviews.text: We went for memorial day weekend and we loved it. the food was good the beach atmosphere was good, the staff was very nice and courteous. we stayed on the royal suite so everything was al inclusive and it was well worth the money, plus its a no kids under 18 could stay in the royal suites, so no baby crying all night. Our butler Rode was exceptionally polite and helpful. We will definitely return.

reviews.author: Jelena M
reviews.title: my favorite cancun hotel
reviews.text: after visiting cancun for probably 10 times now I can say that this is my personal favorite hotel even though I have stayed in more expensive and more fancy ones. It is absolutely amazing whether you want to take kids or have a romantic vacation. rooms are very modern and the lobby is just the finest lobby ever, set as a nice jungle in the middle of the building, just amazing!

reviews.author: dcsilvap
reviews.title: Relax at its best!
reviews.text:
First state that I have already stayed at Paradisus' Palma Real in Punta Cana, and La Perla at Playa del Carmen (adults section) for business/leisure reasons. 
My wife and I stayed at Paradisus Cancun Beach for a weekend (May 22nd-24th) at the Royal Service area and our expectations were fully met and beyond. With a delightful experience and service level, you easily get disconnected and realise you can truly enjoy "doing nothing". 
Great room with a relaxing ocean-view and king size bedding. We enjoyed an amazing beach, pool area, balinese beds, restaurants, while we were gently cuddled by waiters like Eddie and Edgar who were always anticipating every need, and an outstanding concierge service delivered by César who was always there (in "invisible" mode) from the arrival through departure taking care of every detail - ground transportation, flight confirmations, and also arranged dinner for us at Harry's on a very crowded Saturday night  -. 
In summary, an absolutely enjoyable experience, with first class facilities, and more important, GREAT PEOPLE that make you feel "at home"...we are very looking forward to be there again.

reviews.author: P D
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Loved this place!!! Felt very welcomed....everyone was friendly and really seemed to care that we had a great vacation.  The whole staff was wonderful...never had to ask for anything...they seemed intuned to what was needed.

reviews.author: Tina10Travels
reviews.title: impresionante
reviews.text:
Very impressive atrium with all the vines.  The koi ponds were peaceful.  Outside the pools and beach was great and big enough to party or find a quite spot.  They do a good job of entertaining guest day and night.  
Food: desserts all yummy,  drinks perfect cuz they'll make whatever you want, the savory plates varied from good to oddly bad.  
Rooms are spacious as are the baths.  
The staff is kind.  Their English is good and they appeased my attempts at broken Spanish.
Location is good.  Easy walking to various activities.  Convenience store and pizza joint very close if you get those kind of cravings.  
The bus stop was really close also.  We never waited more than 10min for a bus.  The bus ride into town was short and easy.

reviews.author: luigilandry
reviews.title: Amazing stay!
reviews.text:
Stayed last year and went with my boyfriend and best girlfriend. Fortunately, we had perfect weather our whole stay.

We booked the adults only royal service room and it was worth the extra money. We had our own butler, jose, and he was the best!  He was very professional, friendly and helpful - he was easy to get in touch with and remembered/completed all of our requests.  He got us in to all of our requested restaurants for dinner: Mole, Bana, Fuego, and Market Grill. And we did the dinner buffet, Naos, one night.

Bringing up the topic of food, all of our meals (breakfast, lunch, snacks, dinner and late night room service) were exceptional. It wasn't generic, left-over or cheap food, it was fresh, unique and amazingly tasteful.

We spent a lot of time at the pool bar during the day - the service and drinks were spot on.  This is a great spot to meet people - we met a lot of tourists from all over the world who we enjoyed talking and hanging out with.  With the royal service you got at least 2 days for cabana rentals at the pool. Jose was able to reserve 2 days for us and it was worth it. Here there were drink servers and free use of sunscreen - which was helpful as I ran out of mine from home.

There were a lot of activities during the day and night that we took advantage of so we didn't even leave the resort. We enjoyed the beach cabanas ($100 extra) where we had our own drink servers and a dj was spinning right on the beach. And one night they had a casino themed party in the main lobby. 

The beach itself was well maintained and the water was clear, blue and warm. There was no debree or seaweed in the water - I unfortunately encountered this in my trip to playa del carmen the previous year. 

As for the customer service, every employee we encountered was pleasant and accommodating - they seemed to truly enjoy working at the Paradisus and their main focus was to ensure every guest enjoyed their stay.

Bottom line-I would come back in a heartbeat. It's worth it to upgrade to the royal service but I bet the normal rooms would be just as good.  Thank you, Paradisus Cancun, for making my hard earned vacation memorable - I will be back again!

reviews.author: Vivian_MIA
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel
reviews.text:
Pros: 

Beautiful location with turquoise waters

Top shelf liquors!!! I've been to several All Inclusive Resorts but this one takes the cake with the liquor selection...Patron, Don Julio, Johnny Walker, etc. for no extra charge

Amazing service at the pool bar by Carlos!

Overall, the staff was polite and helpful. Audberto, who we guess must be the food & beverage manager, was truly a life saver when he booked dinner reservations for us when we were on our way to dine out due to lack of reservations

Rooms are spacious with a great balcony (although balcony didn't have any furniture)

Fuego restaurant was by far the best food we had at the hotel

Cons:

Spotty Wi-Fi

They ran out of pool towels by 1PM on a Saturday!

Reservation are required for most of the restaurants and must be done at least 1 day in advance which can be a bummer. We try walking in but, even though you can clearly see empty tables they, won't seat you. We were turned down at the sushi restaurant due to lack of reservation and 15 minute later, and with the help of Audberto, we were seated! On that note, the sushi place: nothing to write home about

Food is ok, not bad not amazing...just ok

We had an incident at one of the stores that required the intervention of the hotel manager (Alberto) who did NOTHING to help at all, even when the store clerk was being disrespectful to us in front of him. This incident alone will make me seriously consider returning to this hotel in the future

In summary, this was my 3rd time in Cancun, but my 1st time in more than 10 years and I was a little disappointed with the customer service experience. My memories of Cancun were always those of amazing customer service and this time, and based on the service at this hotel, I would rate it a 3 out of 5, tops

reviews.author: Michael H
reviews.title: Best Ever
reviews.text: Cant say enough about this hotel. Staff were very attentive. Drinks top shelf and food was very good. We did royal service, if you want quiet defintiely the way to go, you can visit the the party side. Cant wait to go back!

reviews.author: Guide563565
reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: My husband and I went here back in September 2014 for my 30th birthday. Two other couples joined us.  The resort was beautiful and the staff was extremely friendly.  The view is awesome!  Very relaxing.  Wish there was more entertainment however.  But I would still recommend it.  Ideal location. It was in the middle of all the main attractions.

reviews.author: klc94568
reviews.title: Beautiful property and beach, excellent location
reviews.text: The hotel was absolutely beautiful. The staff were exceptionally friendly, particularly Francisco, the bartender at the swim-up bar.  The food at the buffet was quite good, particularly the made to order omelette grill. The alcohol was top notch, using premium brands. Only three minor complaints: there were no chaise lounges or chairs on our balcony, room service at times could be a little slow, maid service varied - sometimes the maids cleaned the room early and left ample towels, other times the room had not been cleaned by 4 pm and towels had to be requested.

reviews.author: Peter H
reviews.title: Service, relaxation
reviews.text: we stayed with two other couples in the Royal Service area.  We paid for the extras and received what we looked for.  The service, friendliness of the staff was great.  Restaurant options were good to very good, but our butler did everything and the pool guys were super.  This is our second Melia Paradisus resort, we'll do another.

reviews.author: Lori H
reviews.title: Nice place Butler no so much
reviews.text: The facility is nice and has restaurants and Bali beds to use for the  residents .  The food is delicious .  The butler was a disappointment. The Bali beds are supposed to be scheduled by the Butler. The extra service promised was not done.  I reported the poor Butler service during my stay.  It did not get better.    Make sure you understand about making restaurant reservations and Bali bed reservations to ensure the benefits promised.  Hopefully your butler will explain the services and provide services offered

reviews.author: Nia H
reviews.title: Amazing Hotel
reviews.text:
Amazing hotel! I love Paradisus Cancun! It's a beautiful resort, very clean, friendly staff! Me and my family have no complaints. We enjoyed our stay so much!  It was worth every penny! I would definitely recommend Paradisus cancun to anybody! I will definitely stay at Paradisus again next time I go to Cancun! I am even considering to have my wedding there in the future! Do not even bother with the bad reviews! You won't regret your stay at Paradisus Cancun! Overall i'd give 5 stars to everything, the food, service , staff , cleanliness and the hotel itself. 
Paradisus hotels are amazing!! They offer amazing quality!!

reviews.author: Eduardo Lara
reviews.title: I was expecting more ...
reviews.text:
I was expecting more from this Hotel, even though the service in general was very good, there were some dark points. 
The room doesn't have furniture in the balcony, we were told that "the rooms are in remodeling" so our experience was bad in this sense.
The thing that most bodered us was that even though the hotel says that is an "all inclusive", there are several services that are not included, such as wines at dinner. Also there is a "nice" beach area where you need to pay US$75 per day per person to get access, otherwise you can use another beach area further and where you cannot get food service, only at such "VIP" area!!! That was unpleasant and uncomfortable!!

reviews.author: Robert R
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: Overall great stay, good food, generally good service, great location and weather.  WiFi was a problem, but was fixed after several complaints (if it is slow, keep telling them!), and pool service was slow some days, good others, but overall a great trip.  Special thanks to our Butler Juan, and Pool Concierge Daniel.  For some reason we were "Royal Service" but still put in pyramid 4, which was not very convenient to get to the Royal Service lounge or pool, but we make it work.

reviews.author: Jessica V
reviews.title: Nice vacation!
reviews.text: Great value for the money. Beautiful beach and pool. Friendly staff and friendly atmosphere.  They didn't harass us too much about time shares either, which was great since we were not interested!  We had a great trip!

reviews.author: Marcela R
reviews.title: Excelente hotel
reviews.text:
Excelent hotel! Delicious food. Wonderful service! The restaurant Fuego is spectacular! Alejandro, the manager, and Juan de Dios make you feel special!. Every body is cordial! Just make sure to reserve at least one or two days in advance or you won't be able to try the good options available!
The only thing we didn't like is that you have to pay extra if you want,  what they call, beds on the beach. If you don't pay it is very hard to find a place to lay down.

reviews.author: J S
reviews.title: Lovely Resort
reviews.text: The resort is gorgeous and has many restaurants + a buffet  if you are looking to get the "Royal Service" I would add it on when booking due to when we got to the resort we were unable to add it on due to a large convention at the property. We had a blast on the beach and in our pool it was not over crowded to have to even need the royal pool. The beach amazing the water is crystal clear and felt like swimming in bath water they have covered beach beds and chairs that can be reserved at a extra cost as well but there are uncovered beach chairs that are not at a cost but you should clam them early in the morning before it gets busy. The pool bar was great! we loved the swim up section. We went with the Amstar company to book our excursions we went to Xel-Ha & Tulum and both were fantastic go to places that I would recommend we also took a short walk down the street to the right in front of the resort to Harry's Prime Steakhouse & Raw Bar Restaurant and oh my god this place is a MUST go it was the best place I have ever eaten the steak was like butter so good! the service was on point (www.harrys.com.mx) , The ONLY down side about this resort was the fact that the beach and pool close @ 7:00pm and the fact that our ac unit did not work 3 out of our 4 night stay it was rather hot.

reviews.author: juliebean512
reviews.title: Relaxed and pampered
reviews.text:
I should preface this by saying that my stay was part of a group sponsored by my company for their award winners.  So some of the standard experiences, such as transfers and check in/out, I can't comment on except to say that the lobby was never overfull and no one seemed anxious or upset as I came and left.  Also, I had never been to Cancun so I can not compare this hotel to other Cancun hotels, though I've traveled fairly extensively elsewhere.

We stayed in the Royal Service Pyramid 5 - and had a lovely room with a view of the ocean.  The entire room had marble floors, which felt nice and cool on the feet.  It was a spacious room with two double beds, a desk, a sitting area and a table.  The entire back wall was all window, including sliding glass doors to get to the very spacious balcony.  I spent a great deal of time on the balcony, reading and listening to the ocean.  The bathroom was a good size with a very deep tub and a rain and hand shower.  Due to the humidity and the sun coming through the glass, it was very difficult to get the room cool enough for my American preferences.  But I had adjusted by the second night.

The highlight of the trip for me was the Royal Service pool and the Bali Beds.  These were complimentary for Royal Service guests.  You had to reserve them in advance, but you could also go after 11AM and ask if any beds were unclaimed, and if so, then you had one for the rest of the day.  I spent 3 of the 5 days there in one of those beds.  Daniel, one of the staff that set up the beds and brought towels, was very attentive and remembered me after the first day.  Cesar and Luis were fantastic waiters - stopping often to bring beverages and food - tempting me with Bailey's ice cream and Gin and Tonic sorbets (I imagine this wouldn't be the easiest place for a recovering alcoholic - lots of drinks around).  I felt like royalty the way they took care of me, and especially in that bed.  

The food was plentiful.  In the Royal Service pyramid, even room service is included.  I did have room service twice, but it was a bit too "American" and wasn't very warm.  I was only able to try a couple of the "reservation" restaurants, Vento and Bana, but they were good. I ate at the Royal Service restaurant for breakfast (very good Eggs Benedict) and lunch (served to the bed - try the skirt steak or shrimp flatbread).  I ate at the Buffet, Naos, several times.  The buffet had a variety but nothing particularly outstanding.  However, the service was wonderful.  Pascual and Arturo remembered our drinks by the second day and encouraged us to try different things.  Overall, the food at this hotel is good and fresh but not someplace that a "foodie" would be drooling over.

I did not try the spa but others that traveled with me said it was fantastic. I didn't want to try the nightlife, but there were shows and bars to choose from that looked interesting.  It was nice that the options were there.

Overall, I would definitely recommend this hotel - and, in fact, I'm already looking at prices to return.  If what you're looking for is a relaxing stay, this would be the place.  It was gorgeous and quiet and just what I wanted.

reviews.author: Nicole L
reviews.title: Had a Blast!
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I just came back yesterday and we SO disappointed  to leave. We had an amazing time from beginning to the very end. The entire time the staff was just amazing! They always went above and beyond, especially Carlos and Edgar from the swim up bar. They were really the best, always engaging in conversation and made our trip even more special. The only bad thing of the trip was you had to make reservations for dinner 1 night in advance and there was never any seats at the pool. The pool you had to go at least by 8am to catch a seat because people would throw there towels there to save there spot and leave for the entire morning and come back late afternoon, which I think wasn't right. Same thing went for the beach as well. They should really look into fixing that problem because every time we went down to the pool area there were so many chairs with just towels on them and barely anyone at the pool. Over all we had an amazing time and the staff was so nice and helpful for anything we needed. I would definitely come back to this hotel.

reviews.author: pem63
reviews.title: Peaceful & Relaxing Vacation
reviews.text: We were looking for a place that offered all inclusive amenities.  We wanted a place to relax and enjoy the beach. The Royal Services offered us that experience. We loved the poolside services and found the food service excellent. We thought tge butler service accommodated our needs and wasn't too overwhelming. We loved the buffet service in the Royal Service lobby and looked forward to it everyday.

reviews.author: Deb C
reviews.title: Company incentive trip
reviews.text: Food for all the group functions was very good, not as good in the restaurants but fine for all inclusive.  Rode our butler was great, but we had to move rooms to get a butler even though we were supposed to have Royal Service the entire stay.  The pool service was great, premium alcohol and Cadillac Margaritas are a must have.  Lights in the smoke detector were totally annoying but they can take the battery out and the lights will stop.  People were great, no storage in the rooms, public areas could use some updates.  Tons of fun!!!

reviews.author: nniicchhoollee
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, Great Service!
reviews.text:
I stayed here with a group of five friends from May 20th thru May 24th and had a great time!  The resort is breathtaking inside and out.

Can't say enough about how great the service is!  The front desk staff was able to secure my friends and I rooms near each other which was very helpful (the resort is huge).  The concierge was even able get in touch with my airline when my luggage was lost.  

We eat at Blue Agave, Vento, Fuego, and The Market Grill and all the food was amazing.  We especially enjoyed our dinner at Vento; Emmuael our waiter kept the drinks and shots coming.  Enrique the bartender also made us so unique shots and cocktails throughout our trip.  

The Red Lounge and hotel bar never seem to get too crowded or crazy at night (we're in our 20s and were looking to party at night).  Not really a huge issue because the major clubs and bars are about 15 minutes away by taxi/bus.  There are families here but you can still have a great time if you're young too.

reviews.author: Intiporn R
reviews.title: in love with Cancun
reviews.text: If you stay or visit USA and don't know whereelse to visit, Cancun is one of the places you should not miss. Sea is turquoise color, very beautiful. Beach in front of Praadisus is clean. Staff are friendly.

reviews.author: rjl3045
reviews.title: Regular Trip - Non Royal Service
reviews.text:
I took a solo trip to the Paradisus Cancun for a weekend getaway. 

PROS:
1) Room was great, although I arrived at 11am and finally checked in at 330pm. Room is very spacious and the lagoon view was great. I asked for a room in Tower 4 in a high floor and they were able to accomodate.  It was nice and quiet
2) Beach is beautiful, although there is a lot of seaweed. I was able to get a chair on the bed under a Palapa as long as I got there in the morning to reserve my seat
3) Hotel is impeccably clean
4) Service was good. Not amazing. Just good.
5) All-inclusive style vacation is such an easy way to go and the Paradisus Cancun made it easy
6) Room service was great. All the waiters were very friendly. 

CONS:
1) Check in desk definitely was a bit of a wait. 
2) Food wasn't great. I was disappointed.  It wasn't the fault of the chefs, it just seemed the quality of ingredients wasn't what I was hoping for. 
3) I was a little thrown off by the prices on the menus and sometimes didn't know what was included in the All Inclusive package. 
4) It took me a while to figure out where the "regular' people could hang out on the beach. Palapas are up for grabs but if you want one of the fancy beds off the club you have to get bottle service
5) Water excursion people are very pushy. Felt like I had to say no a lot. 
6) Wifi was incredibly spotty

reviews.author: Donna L
reviews.title: An anniversary, an engagement and a get away
reviews.text:
We arrived May 13th for a 10 day stay in tower 1.  We had friends join us for 5 days and a second group join us for 7 days. As club members we were able to book 3 rooms to accommodate the group. We all opted for the all inclusive.  
The hotel has a wide beach with plenty of umbrellas, chairs, and Bali beds.  If you're not a beach person the pool is quite large with plenty of areas to swim, sit, lounge, eat, drink, and relax.  There's a swim up bar with top shelf selections and wait staff covering every inch of the perimeter.  If you like frozen drinks the selection is good. The hotel prides itself on service and we had several who delivered.  Antonio greeted us each morning for breakfast with fresh coffee and juice.  The entire breakfast crew outside of market grill was terrific.  Sofonia and Luis spoiled us with buckets of ice cold water and drinks by the pool.  The guys working the sunset grill snack area were kind, courteous and kept the snack bar clean and stocked with fresh sandwiches, wings, fries and nachos.  The addition of ground beef and white Mexican cheese for the nachos would be a great improvement.  We enjoyed the food and mariachi band at Blue Agave.  We also liked Fuego and Market Grill.  The option to select a protein  tasting group versus slices from the skewer would reduce waste and improve the overall experience at the Market Grill.
