The lamb & pineapple never made it to our table and the pork was dry.  I highly recommend the all inclusive option you won't be disappointed.  
My biggest disappointment was our vacation club concierge.   We made a great effort to contact the club in advance to let them know we had friends who were celebrating an anniversary.  We were also celebrating an engagement.  We wanted to have a bottle of champagne delivered to the room for our friends anniversary and thought we had it covered but it didn't come through.  :(  We also requested several reservations through our vacation concierge but they weren't well communicated or scheduled per our request.  I know reservations are just a request but a day later and 10 pm versus 8 pm without any notification isn't exactly a slight change.  I felt like our vacation concierge was strictly a sales representative with a concierge title.  I understand its just business but don't offer if you're not going to deliver.

reviews.author: trinabena
reviews.title: Rayvon's Birthday Celebration
reviews.text: Royal Service Stay, the best ever.. We had a blast...6day vacation  , butler service  was the way to go...PAMPERED. .. YESSSSS. THE  Market Grill was Rayvon's  favorite restaurant  he gave  them 5☆..waiters  RODY,  RENE, KARLA ,ALEN , ARMADO and ALFREDO ..were the best ever.. see you again in October  2015

reviews.author: Spencer F
reviews.title: Awesome Stay Overall
reviews.text:
We picked the resort because of the location (we hadn't visited Cancun yet), the room, the resorts amenities, and the restaurant options. Also we have stayed at a Paradisus resort before and were very impressed with the quality. 

Arrival and Check-In Process:

We booked the shuttle the hotel offers and it was great. Private ride over from the airport to an absolutely gorgeous driveway/unloading area in the Club Melia portion of the resort. The inside is gorgeous as well with hanging vines, ambient lighting, and vegetation. Unfortunately the Club Melia staff were un-friendly (borderline Rude) and didn't seem particularly happy to see us. In addition, I am accustomed to having a welcome cocktail and a warm reception but we did not receive that here. After a long checkin process we were taken to our room (Ocean view 1 bedroom Suite). Our luggage was brought up promptly and our minibar filled with a selection of beer (we got to pick out). 

The Room:

We were very pleased with our room - the layout, amenities, comfort, cleanliness, and view were all top notch. Beautiful large bathroom, comfortable King bed, living room, and a balcony with a beautiful ocean view, jacuzzi, and sitting area. Our room was cleaned well daily and our minibar stocked with the things we liked. Room service was great - had late night wings a couple of times and they were fresh, hot, and delivered quickly. 

The Resort Layout / facilities:

Beautiful resort - well groomed with beautiful pools. I can't speak to most of the resort as we upgraded to Royal Service and spent 98% of our time in that area. I would highly recommend the upgrade for those travelling without children. It's a modest extra charge which we felt was well worth it. Private adults-only pool and beach area, separate bar, and dedicated food/bar and pool staff. 

During the days we spent most of our time by the pool or ocean in private cabanas lapping up the sun (and many, many cold drinks). 

The Staff / Service:

Excellent (except for Club Melia unfortunately) 

We were treated like royalty in the royal service section. The staff got to know us after a couple of days and by day 2 afternoon they knew what we liked to drink (and how often). Our waiter was by every 15-20 minutes and was quick to take our orders and bring us our drinks. Food service was great too - fresh chips and guacamole, burgers, etc brought poolside for those days we didn't feel like getting up. 

Our sit-down lunches and dinners were no different - the staff treated us like royalty - friendly, professional, accommodating, and fun. 

I highly recommend you tip your pool waiters and your dinner/lunch servers - they do not expect it but they greatly appreciate it. 

Food:

Excellent overall with only a couple complaints. We ate at just about every restaurant and from breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks we were very happy with the quality, freshness, and quantity. Again, staff was extremely accommodating, professional, and friendly.

Complaint: when we arrived, no dinner reservations were required (no reservations at all). Midway through our week we arrived at Fuego for dinner to be told that they couldn't accomodate us because reservations were now required. They changed policy mid-week without notifying anyone. Not really sure why, but it all turned out okay. 

Buffet:

Ate here many days for breakfast and lunch. Breakfast included a great variety of fresh fruit, baked goods, eggs, meat, fish, and a smoothie bar. Lunch featured fruit, veggies, soups, and a great variety of meat and seafood. 

Blue Agave:

I was excited about eating here because they feature a huge selection of Tequila and being the only one in our group of 4 that drinks it I was ready to partake. Our waiter was great in recommending tequilas for me to try and kept my glass full. We shared soft tacos and quesadillas. I highly recommend both - fresh and delicious. 

Vento:

Best restaurant hands down. We ate here twice we enjoyed it so much. Excellent Tapas - great for sharing. We had duck, beef, chicken, pizza, and more. Beautiful setting too with great service. Only complaint is how hot it is in this area! Made it a bit uncomfortable. 

Bana:

We ordered a big selection of sushi to share. It was 3.8 out of 5 if I were to rate it. I've eaten plenty of sushi and this was certainly not the best, but it was good and fresh. 

Market Grill:

This is a Brazilian steakhouse so if you go, expect a fast paced meal. We enjoy Brazilian style and this was no exception. Great food and good variety. 

Mole: 

We enjoyed it but for the fact our food was not hot. Luke-warm at best. I had the Mole Chicken and my Fiancé had the Lamb. Excellent seasoning in both. The mariachi band was a lot of fun!

Fuego: 

Mixed experience. The other couple we were with loved it, I though it was just okay. My fiancé was very disappointed. Her food came out cold - very cold. 

La Perla:

Closed. Not happy about that part as we were very much looking forward to eating here.

Royal Service restaurant:

Great breakfast area outside. I had Eggs Benedict and it was 5/5. They do well at keeping the food hot considering they have to bring it outside. 

Liquor / Drinks:

Awesome. Each bar had different drinks and it the bartenders all had a few special recipes of their own. They were quick to recommend drinks for us. Several different varieties of each type of liquor and a few beer choices. Drink service was excellent and quick.

reviews.author: sergiovargas2015
reviews.title: Excellent Service at this Resort
reviews.text:
We stayed May 11th till the 18th,
 based on our last September Experience here,
 we decided to chose this Resort again which we never do
Lazaro from Royal Service made our Experinece one of a kind.
 Eric from Bana made the first dinner the best, hes great 
At Ventos Gerardo the manager took good care of us and offered to do it for the rest of our stay,
 we loved to go to breakfast every morning and enjoyed the variety of food and the service from pablo who remembered our drinks and the manager whos name i forgot was very attentive . 
the swim up bar was good but my favorite was the beach
Enriques service was outstanding he is who I encountered the most at the hotel so special thanks to him , he always had a smile, worked very hard to take care of everyone on the beach and deserves a promotion 
This Resort has some of the Best Beaches in Cancun,
and I've Stayed at many.
The Shows need alot of improvement and variety.
 The Entertaintment staff need to be more involved with the Guest
Over all we Highly recomend this Resort and would hope to come back.

reviews.author: Kayprince
reviews.title: Another wonderful vacation @Paradisus
reviews.text:
We stayed May 17-24 so I am writing this from my wonderful Bali Bed and it's been a sunny 30 Celsius all week. We stayed in a beautiful 1 bedroom suite with two generous baths. We choose family concierge, as we are always so well cared for. This visit we received outstanding service from Salvador and Charley our butler. Charley wowed the kids with his care and surprises like fish food to feed the fish and Marvel superheroes colouring bookings which they loved!

Salvador made sure all our dinner reservations and Bali beds were reserved
 and always asked if there was anything else he could do to make our stay more pleasurable. Thank you😃

At the pool Luis is our main man, he took great care of us and remembered what we liked to drink and was always available when needed.

We have stayed at this resort 4 times and will continue to choose this as a preferred destination. All of the restaurants are great and the buffet is convenient, the only suggestion is more kid friendly options in  
the buffet in the Paradisus kids section.
We had dinner at Feugo, Vento, Market grill and Mole, loved all 4 and Bana will be tonight. Service was  great and so was the food.

There are always areas of opportunity in any hotel or resort but we just asked and they made our stay better or fixed the concern. We will be sure to return next year for our annual vacation in Mexcio☀️

Thank you Paradisus Cancun for a wonderful week!!

Prince Family:)

reviews.author: Michael M
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, Generally Great Service (yet inconsistent), Poor Management
reviews.text:
This is vacation day 6 of 8 here and I can't wait any longer to post a review. This is my fifth time in Cancun, first (and last) time at the Gran Melia Paradisus Cancun. Day 1 was great, but It has just gotten worst with each passing day - the inconsistencies with service and problems that arise on a daily basis keeps deteoriating the experience here. 

Let me just state that the general overall customer service here is great, from bell men to front desk, to servers & house keeping. Rooms are very clean and comfortable. The resort is beautiful. However, there were a few instances that just just odd but unacceptable.

 Midway through our stay we received a letter slipped under our door stating that maintenece needed to be done with the balcony, showing dates two weeks prior to our arrival. Thinking it was a mistake I ignored it, however, returning from the beach one afternoon, our friends 2 doors down, returned to their room with a crew of 3 doing rennovations on their balcony. They called the front desk and asked for the manager to come to the room to handle the situation. The customer relations manager (Sergio) arrived and asked what the problem was...as if it was normal to do rennovations on a room that was occupied with no maintenece request. When asked why that is happening he said it was "normal protocol for them to do that here" to guest rooms that are currently occupied. He had no sympathy nor empathy for how it affects guests. I was alerted to what was going on and had to vacate the pool, dripping wet, to go to the front desk to tell them that I got the same notice with dates that passed and that it was unacceptable for anyone to renovate my room during my stay. The front desk handled it perfectly well and advised that no one will be renovating my room - at my request. 

Tonight, day 6, I went to confirm my dinner reservations at Fuego Restaurant... The manager (Alejandro) gave me a card with a phone number to call for reservations. I reiterated that I was not looking to make a reservation, I wanted to confirm my reservation. He apparently was not used to people wanting to confirm reservations as he seemed incoherent and kept on repeating that I needed to call for reservations. I kept on reiterating that reservations were made and I wanted to confirm since the front desk manager made them for me. A server had to come by to explain it to him. It was baffling to me since he is supposed to the the manger and I'm sure that was not the first time a manager of that restaurant has encountered someone wanting to confirm a reservation! He eventually said that the reservations are no longer there but will reappear the next morning - whatever that means, if it even makes any sense. 

I've stayed at 5 resorts and the Paradisus was chosen for this trip because the Dreams Cancun was closed for rennovations - what a mistake this decision was. I started out with "this resort is nice, I like it, but it's not as good as dreams" to "I will not come back nor would I recommend it to anyone I care about having a great experience in Cancun"

This is sad as my review title says: Beautiful Resort, Generally Great Service (yet inconsistent), Poor Management. It's unfortunate that a few bad seeds in management can ruin a 9 day vacation experience. Perhaps those who can't embody the resort's customer service culture should be replaced so they don't lose future customers.

I still have 2 more nights and can't imagine how much more downhill it can go. Upside: the food is good, the coco's beach cabanas are amazing, the nightly shows are wonderful, the location is central, and the majority of the service is great. In a place with so many resorts vying for guests to stay at - this will not be a place I would return to.

reviews.author: Anya A
reviews.title: Great time here-we would return
reviews.text:
My first visit to Mexico and I enjoyed it tremendously. Just be aware of the airport hustlers trying to get you to take a timeshare tour the minute you leave the airport doors!! We paid the extra for Royal Service which was pretty great. You're taken over to a separate building to check-in and wait for your room. In the meantime they make you a drink and offer you to sample from the buffet style food in the area. Every morning noon and night-this was always full and fresh. Fresh fruits, mini cakes, cheese, meats, desserts and a pretty good breakfast. That side of the hotel was pretty Zen. It had it's own pool area, along with a dedicated person to serve you food and drinks while on the beach. We tried the buffet restaurant in the other buildings and quite enjoyed it. We mostly spent our time on the beach and the pool, with a couple excursions into town and on a trip. The water was a bit rough so no real swimming. We walked to the Fiesta Americana hotel and right next to it was a beautiful, calm part of the ocean we had driven past many times but hadn't realized was there. Paradisus was definitely great though. Fiesta looks great but a tad old, and their strip of beach, although calm is rather small.
Everyone was very helpful and warm and if they didn't know something would find someone who did. I wish we had taken a lot more money to tip them with!

reviews.author: Teddy R
reviews.title: First Vacation Outside My Home Country
reviews.text:
This was my first vacation as an adult outside of my home country. I couldn't have asked for a better resort. We stayed in a Royal Service Luxury Ocean View Room and it was fantastic. The view was like no other.
The room was clean, the food was great, drinks were flowing and the employees were extremely friendly. We got a complimentary bottle of champagne which we saved for our last night. The Yhi Spa was the best thing I've ever experienced.
Our butler, Lainer (not sure if I spelt that right) made all our restaurant reservations and checked on us during our trip.
Market Grill (the Meat Carnival) is not to be missed, by far my favourite (I love meat).
I wish we could go back but its so expensive now.
Anyway, many more places left in the world to see.
I would highly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: carolq806
reviews.title: Love this place!
reviews.text: We went here for a destination wedding and I am looking forward to going back very soon. The hotel was clean, the restaurants were wonderful and the staff was amazing!  The waiters were so friendly and accommodating - they took care of your every need.

reviews.author: sallys452
reviews.title: Perfect Week in Cancun
reviews.text: I stayed in the timeshare owners tower as I utilized my uncle's timeshare. It was the perfect location for being near everything without the interference of the spring break party-goers. The biggest surprise was the many options for dining and the high quality of food offered in the all-inclusive. We would definitely recommend the all-inclusive and this was a desirable hotel because you can opt in or out of the all-inclusive depending upon your plans. This hotel has ample pool area, cabanas that can be reserved and rented for a reasonable price each day - right on the beach - and this hotel seems to have some of the best beach frontage in the surrounding area. Our beachfront room with ocean view was divine and the service was excellent. Our personal concierge, Keyla Madrid was personable, listened to our needs and made some excellent recommendations for places to visit in the area. Keyla is top notch! She was attentive and made our dinner reservations and made sure that we had everything that we wanted. Keyla speaks excellent English and never grew tired of our questions! I would definitely recommend this hotel and will return. We did not travel with children, but see that it is a good place for families, but it is also good for couples who can find space without kids.

reviews.author: Elizabeth M
reviews.title: Best Vacation ever
reviews.text: This all inclusive is well worth the money.. We stayed in the Adults only Royal service and the people were so attentive to our needs.. The rooms were nice and I slept great every night. I really enjoyed the different types of food available..Edgar, Omar, Juan, Pedro, Alberth and others made our vacation the best ever.

reviews.author: 284franka
reviews.title: Fabulous way to spend your vaca
reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay. Everything was very clean and the beach was fabulous. The only issue we had was that sometimes the food in the Naos dining was cold and should have been hot or at least warm. Everything else was top notch. We are looking forward to returning again sometime.

reviews.author: Guillermo L
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text:
Great for kids to be on their own (and parents also) :) 
Lowest point: The buffet restaurant is a typical one which is a bad thing. They do have excellent breads but awful pastries and the flavours are not good either.

Highest points: events, activities every day and night, shows, games, kids club keeps them busy all day :)

reviews.author: diane s
reviews.title: Excellent service and excellent food!
reviews.text:
We had a great time. This was our second visit and we thoroughly enjoyed it. The food is wonderful and we love the staff. The premium liquor is a bonus. We always meet other guests that are enjoyable. 
    We will return next year.

reviews.author: Cahyani F
reviews.title: Swimming pool is the best
reviews.text:
The most highlighted great things from Paradisus is their huge and nice swimming pools. They also have very huge place and the main atrium lookings is nice.
The restaurants is many but for dinner, 90% needs a reservation and the place with better food is always fully booked during 4 days we've stay there (La Perla). International Buffet offers many variety of foods but for me the taste is not going anywhere.
Wifi just fine but the lift is super slow and small.
The staff are nice but some of them are too active I would say. I've got 2x they insist to enter my room while I'm already said they doesnt need to come (tag "do not disturb" was on the door too). If looking on the price and compare with the things you've got this resort is just ok in my opinion.

reviews.author: larryw976
reviews.title: THE BEST
reviews.text:
Had a great time.The best beach we seen.Room with ocean view was great.
Food and service was good.
All around we had no complaints.Did some para sailing and went on seadoos.
Went on a pirate ship trip.

reviews.author: KrissyShea
reviews.title: Great property but the food was OK
reviews.text: The Paradisus Cancun is a beautiful resort with an amazing ocean view. There is a lot of explore in and out and you can easily get lost but in the best way. The food however could have been better, breakfast felt limited. The pools were spacious, never felt crowded and the beach is right there. Every morning I posted a FB video from my room overlooking the ocean. Make sure you take advantage of the airport transfers, most are included in your package.

reviews.author: 241linda
reviews.title: A wonderful week in paradise
reviews.text: Food was excellent and the staff very friendly.  The resort was clean and well maintained.  We loved the restaurants, especially Tempo and the upscale Mexican place (I forgot the name).  I would recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Skl341
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: Beautiful all-inclusive resort. Only issues were our room was noisy & housekeeping failed to leave us coffee 2 days. Otherwise exceptional! Pool, pool bar and restaurants were exceptional! Our favorite was Mole!

reviews.author: LJlovetravel
reviews.title: Nice, but the service could have been better.
reviews.text: We upgraded to the Royal Service when we booked, and it was nice to have someone assist you when needed. Our butler's name was Rodrigo, and he did an excellent job. You would think if you had Royal Service that you would have no problem getting into restaurants that required reservations. This was not the case, and we ended up having limited options of where we could eat, and on top of that we had to eat at times later than we wanted to. I would rate the places we ate at the resort as just average, nothing was really great. We also had some problems with our travel and needed to stay a day later. Although there were vacant rooms that weren't booked, we were told by the hotel that they were saving them for incoming guests, because they might need them due to overbooking in other parts of the hotel. Well, thanks for trying to take care of us! We ended up having to pack all of our things up and book a room next door at the Marriott.

reviews.author: bellsgunners
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun in March
reviews.text: Great hotel, great staff, great time.......we went with the royal service, it was great value with all the extra services provided to us whilst we were there (including pool, restaurant, bar etc) and it made the holiday.

reviews.author: stanlina
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: This Place was just about perfect. We went for a Batchelor party in January. This was my first time in cancun and Paradisus did nit disappoint. From the moment we pulled up to the front of the hotel to the front desk staff to the food to the beach, you name it...just simply exceptional service. We will certainly be back next time.

reviews.author: Kelly M
reviews.title: Destination wedding
reviews.text: The hotel was very nice. The rooms were very clean.  There weren't any plants in the planters outside the room however.  There were a lot of food options for dinner along with the buffet. The beach was beautiful however they needed more cabanas on the shade as the sun can get very hot.

reviews.author: jlt528
reviews.title: Gorgeous resort!!!
reviews.text: We stayed here because our friends were getting married on the resort. It was a fantastic experience and we would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a relaxing and beautiful location. Our only issue was that we tried to book transportation through the onsite service, and we had some issues with them keeping up with our flight changes, even though we notified them several times. Otherwise it was a wonderful experience overall!

reviews.author: 364bigdog
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: We read all the reviews and couldn't believe all the excellent reviews.  We had to find out for ourselves just how real this Paradisus Cancun is.Well everything was excellent.  Impeccable customer service. Everywhere it was super clean.  The staff was friendly and courteous.  The food was very good and the drinks were fun and outstanding.  The rooms were quiet, clean and kept that way.  No bed bugs and we checked!

reviews.author: Tri L
reviews.title: Great Resort!
reviews.text:
This resort is wonderful. Place is clean, workers had excellent customer service, and food at every restaurant was delicious.

My wife and I stayed at the main center pyramid and had the lagoon view. We had actually requested a beach view, but all those rooms were already filled. The main pyramid is where all the restaurants, stores, and club are at so you will hear constant noise (people talking music playing, etc). This didn't bother my wife and I at all though. We slept like a baby every night.

Besides the restaurants, this resort also had a very clean beach, great gym facility, many water activities, and also a wonderful spa. Although our stay was short (4 nights), we made sure we made time to try all all these activities before we left and we are so glad we did. It really made us feel like we got the most bang for our buck.

I highly recommend this resort. Although my trip was a couple's trip, this place appears to be great for family/friend trips as well as they have activities to accommodate all types of travel.

reviews.author: kennys768
reviews.title: The Paradisus will spoil every future vacation for you
reviews.text:
The location is amazing.  We stayed in the ocean side and was truly amazed by the view.  The water color is nothing less than breathtaking.  Great location.  The marina is literally across the street.  Tours, diving, boats, 2 minute walk from the front door.  Food was fantastic.  I have picky eaters, everyone loved it.  Service was great.  Warning, this will spoil your future vacations.  Seriously.  We have stayed in a lot of wonderful locations and hotels.  This is our favorite.  My only warning, DO NOT CAVE AND AGREE TO THE VACATION CLUB TOUR.  Our hostess was so sweet, we agreed reluctantly to the tour.  90 minute informational meeting was what we were told, 4 hours later after several VERY hard selling salesmen took their time pressuring us, they finally gave up.  It was soooo bad, it took me several days to get over the anger I had.  ....and a lot of drinking.   

We are going back again soon, we loved it that much!

reviews.author: Travel D
reviews.title: MIxed Reviews
reviews.text:
My husband and I (both mid 30s) traveled together to this resort.  We have been to many all inclusive resorts and we are not hard to please and we like to party.  I give this resort 3 stars only because I have mixed reviews about this place.  Making reservations to restaurants were a breeze.  We did not do the royal service and we did not feel like we missed out on anything.  All of the staff were extremely friendly and they were not pushy for tips.

Check In:  This was the longest check in that I ever experience on ANY vacation. It took 45 minutes and we were the only ones checking in at that time.  It would have taken an hour if she had given us our resorts credits book.  We received this book the next day as I realized they didn't mention it. 

Atmosphere: If you are looking for relaxation, this is the place to be!  This hotel is BORING!!!!  No music by the pool.  Also the main pool is 5.9 feet deep. Really!!! Hope that you are taller or know how to swim.  One night the club (Red Lounge) was weak with a overwhelming smoke machine (Friday) and the other night (Saturday) it was popping with a overwhelming smoke machine.  They set up a casino night at the Avenue bar, where they had table games.  This same bar also had a Spanish style dance show  and a Michael Jackson show.

Beach: Didn't use it.  Another couple that we met paid for a Bali Bed ($100).  They showed us a picture of a huge lobster that came with shrimp and steak.  Your resort credit booklet has a discount for the beach and pool beds.  We order a pool bed ($50) and used a $10 dollar off credit.  Bed came with an option to use some of their sunscreen.

Room - Clean with a nice ocean view and AC. Bed, pillows, and flower box needs updating.  Mini fridge had soda, beer, 1 bag of chips, 1 package of cookies. Our balcony did have 2 pool chairs compared to other reviews I have seen.

We stayed in the main pyramid.  This is good and bad (you can't have it all).  The good: Main pyramid had the restaurants, shows, shops, entrance to beach and pool.
The bad: You can hear boom, boom, boom all night long from the club and the Michael Jackson show.  In addition to this noise, outside our room was two weddings on one night and one on another night.  So the weddings of course had a DJ.

Housekeeping:  They kept the room clean and ready for us.  However there is always the towel game on some days. 

Food:  So disappointed.  The buffet NAOS, everything was cold. Even the food that was supposed to be hot.  Vento was fancy (menu), food was ok.  Mole, my husband loved the grouper, my sea bass was plain (no taste).  La Perla was closed the entire time we were there.  We did not eat at Bana (sushi).  We ate at the Market Grill for dinner.  It was the best meal. Lunch there was not good. We did not try Fuego (didn't like the menu).  Went to Blue Agave twice.  The Tacos were ok for a quick snack.  Food by the pool was ok. Nachos, chicken wings, burgers, etc.

Excursions: We did the express trip to Chichen Itza that is offered on Tuesday and Thursday only from 7-3pm.  It was $79 per person.  Enjoyed the trip.  It was extremely hot so take a hat, sunscreen, and a umbrella for shade.  Its a 2 1/2 hour ride there and back.  On other days this trip is from 7-7pm. To long. On that trip you go swimming in a cave.  The express trip does not provide lunch.  They tell you to get a box lunch from the hotel, however its $23 for a ham and cheese sandwich with a few snacks.  You can not take food out of the restaurants. There is a snack bar at Chichen Itza and a restaurant.  They also have vendors that sell souvenirs (not credit cards).  They will work with you on prices.  The bus stops at a million other hotels before you hit the road.

We did parasailing (sky rider) with Aqua World.  You can sign up at the hotel.  Two options.  Either do it at another hotel next door over the ocean or across the street at Aqua World over the lagoon (cost more due to a docking fee). This was fun.

Transportation:  We paid a dollar for the bus. It was probably less than that if you used peso.  Never waited more that 2 minutes for a bus. They come back to back.

Wif: Worked well.

Check Out: Less than 5 minutes.

Overall the trip was ok.  It wasn't Atlantis (Bahamas) lol.

reviews.author: Shellyduchsk8s
reviews.title: This place was HEAVEN in Cancun!
reviews.text:
We stayed for 4 days at Paradisus (5/15 - 5/18).  We upgraded to Royal Service ($100/day), and it was worth the money! No lines for anything, the ultimate attention in service and Bali beds reserved in our private area of the hotel.  What more could you want?!

Day 1 we arrived around 10am after catching a 6am flight out of PHL.  Getting up at 3am was not fun, but getting here and being in a Bali Bed by 10:30am made it all worth it!  The amazing service began as soon as we upgrade to the Royal Service (RS).  We were escorted to Pyramid 5, where our check in was completed while drinking a glass of champagne.  Our butler, Pedro, was promptly assigned to us, and took care of arranging our luggage delivery to our suite.  We ended up in a Jr Lagoon Suite, which, to be honest, more than met our needs.  I had no intention of spending hours in our suite, my sights were firmly set on reserving our Bali beds by the pool for the duration of our stay.  Don’t worry about sunscreen, as it is provided for you on the RS side.  We ended up napping in our Bali bed before going to dinner at Market Grill, which is a Brazilian steakhouse.  

The RS side is much quieter and has a serene and peaceful quality to it.  Do you like waiting in lines for breakfast lunch and dinner? No? Then upgrade.  Do you want tons of people around you at the pool? No? Then upgrade.  Do you want personal attention and preferential/special treatment?  UPGRADE!  I can't stress enough how amazing RS is.  I'll never book just a standard room reservation here again.  People that wandered over from the other side of the hotel to our side of the pool were discretely intercepted and sent back to their side (there are walkways connecting the two pools, but the gates were being upgraded during our stay, so there was no barrier to keep out the standard fee guests).  The RS guys take the exclusivity seriously, and will maintain that status for the RS guests.

Day 2 was spent in our reserved Bali bed ("Sebang") which was located near the stairs to the pool.  This was my favorite Bali bed the whole stay.  Breakfast was room service, which was right on time and good.  We ate lunch at Market Grill, which was buffet, and ok. I preferred our lunch from day 1, which was served to us in the comfort of our Bali bed.  For dinner we went offsite, which was fun, but if that's not your thing, there are plenty of options at the resort.  Our butler, Pedro, was more than happy to book us onsite dinner reservations just in case we decided to not go off site. 

Day 3 we had breakfast down in the RS area, and there were only a handful of other guests with us.  Cappuccinos were delivered to our table, and were delicious.  Hit up the gift shop for a few souvenirs before heading to our reserved Bali bed ("Rembau").  This bed is directly across from the bar, with ladder access to the pool.  Definitely bring flip flops as the pavement/stones get very hot to walk on.  Had lunch delivered to our bed, and it was delicious - you can ask for off-menu items, and the RS side will do whatever they can to fulfill your request. Drinks were plentiful and cold.  You can pretty much ask for anything and the RS guys will make it happen. Our butler had arranged for champagne and strawberries on our deck before dinner, which was sweet.  Dinner was at Fuego, which was not bad, but not Peruvian like we were told. It’s ok, the steaks were good, and they went and got us ice cream for dessert.

Day 4 was our last, sadly, but the checkout process was smooth and easy.  We were given a small card after turning in our room keys, and this card was handed to the doorman on our way out to our waiting car service.  Leaving was hard, but we plan to return in a few months!

Thank you to Pedro in RS who was great!!!  Daniel and Arturo by the pool were also awesome.  THANK YOU!!

TIPS:
-Upgrade to Royal Service if you’re looking for peace and quiet.  You are also given your own concierge, no need to go to the main tower to get something or have a request fulfilled.
-If you are concerned about your view, get a room w/ an ocean front view.
-If you are scent-sensitive, this place may give you a headache.  They have aromatherapy in the pyramid, and also in your room (if requested). I loved it, but others may not.
-AC did not make our room cold, however it was more than enough to take the humidity and heat out of the room.
-Flip flops by the pool are a must!
-Reserve your Bali bed a day in advance if you can, as the best ones go quickly.
-Dress code is resort casual - no need for fancy dresses!
-Order the Gold Margarita - it’s delicious!
-Ask for a bucket of bottled water in ice as soon as you get to your Bali bed.
-Tip $ - even if it’s only a dollar every few drinks. The little bit goes a long way!
-Ignore the calls from the desk saying they have a “gift” for you - it’s just the Melia timeshare people looking to ensnare you into a sales pitch.  I ended up just walking away, because I didn’t want to waste my vacation time on something I had no interest in.
-WifI is good - was about 95% reliable out by the pool.  There were a few times each day where a webpage wouldn’t load, or a message wouldn’t go through, but it still worked well.
-Water - I had no issues w/ brushing my teeth or showering w/ the resort water.  I did only drink bottled water, but neither my SO or I experienced any “stomach bugs” due to the water.
-If you want to get off the resort, the doormen will get a cab for you within 2 minutes.  You can also take the short walk to the street and catch the local bus (definitely an experience!).
-The malls are not too far away, but not a reasonable walking distance - you will need a car/bus to get to either of the 2 shopping centers. ($10-14 USD one way).

I love Paradisus!

reviews.author: Lauren S
reviews.title: Top of the Line Resort
reviews.text:
This resort is so outstanding, the food, the appearance, cleanliness, but overall the service! I have never experienced such excellent service anywhere I have been. If the resort had any flaws at all, the service makes up for it. The only small flaws we had were a few tiny ants in our room and the A/C vent leaked a little from the condensation. I suggest requesting a room away from the atrium if you want it to be more quiet at night. If you called with any issue at all it immediately gets resolved, followed up by an immediate phone call to ensure your issue was fixed. The 24-hour fully included room service was outstanding and ALL of the servers were very professional when delivering and setting up our room service. We always got a call to follow up and be sure our room service was delivered and we had everything we needed. 

There were some staff that stood out to us and we built a great relationship with them, causing our week stay to make us want to come back next year and every year following. The one person who took care of us the most deserves to be recognized for all of his hard work. Kauil works in the restaurant Naos, he ensured that our breakfast and lunch everyday at the buffet was everything we could want and more. He went out of his way to find us when we walked into the buffet to take our plates for us and give us a table with a nice view or even a private romantic area. He made sure we had everything we needed without needing to get up constantly to get another drink from the juice station. We were sad when we had to say goodbye on our last day, he really went out of his way to take care of us. Although, it doesn't stop there, Nelly at the concierge desk was sweet and welcoming she knew of all the places to send us outside of the resort. Victor at the water sports desk remembered us everyday and knew what type of adventures we would like and where he should send us. Rey at the pool bar always made us laugh and enjoy our time at the bar helping us open up to other people staying at the resort. If we were on the beach, we would always be sure to stop by and visit Rey before going in for the day. At night, the bartenders at Coco's were all incredible. We especially enjoyed hanging out at the lounge where the nightly shows happened, Alberto mixes a great Mojito!

Overall, I have nothing bad to say about this resort, there was not one bad experience. Everyone deserves to be recognized that works there, they all seem like they truly enjoy their job and they are there to make your vacation everything it should be and more. They really bring the relaxing, peaceful, spa environment to life and that is exactly what we needed as working parents. Now that I am home I cannot stop telling all of my family and friends how much they need to experience Paradisus Cancun. As a manager at a retail store, I know how important it is to build relationships and make a customers stay comfortable and enjoyable and Paradisus has nailed it! We look forward to coming back next year, We can't wait to reunite with all of the friends we made! 

If you haven't experienced Paradisus Cancun yet, I highly recommend you do!

reviews.author: Kelley C
reviews.title: Great Hotel, Friendly staff, good food
reviews.text: My Husband and I just got back from Visiting the Paradisus in cancun.  It was a great trip and teh staff were very helpful and friendly.  There were so many different restaurants to choose from witht he All-Inclusive package, and the mini bar and room service were included as well.  Bottled water was readily available anytime you asked.  The beach had PLENTY of chairs and covered "huts" to sit under throughout the day. There was a waiter that came by about every 30 minutes with bottled water or taking drink orders while on the beach as well. There were Bali beds that you could rent, but they were over priced by the beach and no one used them ($100/day).  The pool had a swimp up bar and plenty of chairs and more Bali Beds for $50/day. The staff did great with activities, and there was beach volleyball everyday.  Lifeguards were very attentive and watchful, as the waves were very strong witht eh undertow pulling people back out if they went to far.  Lifeguards were watching to make sure that didn't happen.  There were shows at night for people to watch which were fun and differetn variety.  The hotel was very clean, and kept up to date, and the staff did turn down service each night on your beds with chocolate and pulling sheets down etc. There was free Wifi to use as well, and it was nice and quiet at night so we could sleep! We did the Ocean View suite that was only $200 more (total) than the other rooms, and it was worth it.  There was a jetted bathtub outside, 2 chairs, and a little table.  there was a 2 TVS, double sinks, diding room table, couch, and plenty of storage space for clothes.   We had a wonderful time and would go back again!!!

reviews.author: OceanLoverMermaid
reviews.title: We love Paradisus Cancun!
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I went on this trip in May 2015 and it was incredible. It was his first time to Cancun, and my third time.This is a beautiful, safe property,  kept very clean at all times. You will always see someone cleaning something.  This resort was amazing and everyone was always friendly. What we did love about this resort is that they had top alcohol. We also really enjoyed the food, although most of the time we just went to the buffet because it was fast and easy, The pools and beach are beautiful and clean.  The only thing that was a bummer was that the ocean was rougher the week we were there (Cancun is usually really wavey but more so when we went than I ever saw it)and we didn't get to go in it as much as we would have liked. We really enjoyed this trip and will be back Cancun!

reviews.author: Kristina J
reviews.title: Another Great Trip to Cancun!
reviews.text:
We have traveled to Mexico every 6 months for the past 3 years and just love it.  This is the 2nd time that we stayed at the Paradisus Resort.  We usually try and travel to different resorts just to try and get a feel for the different options.  I spend a good amount of time researching resorts and prices to see what the best deal is for the money.  My husband, and two daughters age 10 and 12 love to rate what we like about each of the resorts.  I must say that so far the Paradisus has the best food.  I am pretty surprised that we enjoy eating at their buffet every night.  After spending all day at the beach and pool the kids are too tired to eat in one of the reservation restaurants so we end up eating at the buffet.  Typically this is a nightmare for me or at least it has been at other resorts, but I will admit that the food at Paradisus is exceptional for a buffet.  They offer fish, steak, scallops and chicken (prepared differently each night) which suits the pickiest eaters in my family.  We also had an awesome server each night at the buffet, his name was Luis Linares-Martinez.  Lucky for us, there were weddings most nights so he did not work at La Perla and ended up being our waiter at Naos.  He would anticipate our needs before we even had to ask.  He kept our kids drinks flowing and also would put in special ice cream orders for my husband each night.  He remembered our names and was the upmost, respectable person and a pleasure to visit.

We also love the cabanas that you can rent near the pool.  It costs $50 a day to rent one, but it is well worth the price for our family so we have a spot we can relax in out of the sun and also get a few mid-day naps.  My only negative for the Paradisus was the lack of entertainment during the trip.  They provided us with the daytime schedule of activities, but nothing occurred at the poolside and volleyball (our favorite) barely occurred at 11am and was hit or miss at 3pm.  My husband and I ended up walking down to the Fiesta Americana resort to get some games in so we would have some way of working off all the food we ate.  The other part that was partially disappointing was the fitness room.  The first day we were there, they had 3 treadmills, 1 was being repaired and 2 were working.  They also were down to once bike.  By day 2, there was only 1 working treadmill so you had to get their early if you wanted a chance to use it.  When we visited last May they had 4 working treadmills and 2 bikes which allowed us to use them even if others were in the fitness area.  I only state that this is a little disappointing, because overall they have a good fitness area.  We have been to other resorts where the fitness rooms were pretty bad.

reviews.author: jcampy1973
reviews.title: Great service, Enjoyable stay!
reviews.text:
Stayed at Paradisus from 5/11-16 with the family (wife, 15 year old son, 9 year old daughter).  Here's a breakdown on our trip:

1. Hotel: lushly decorated, well-kept.  Clean common areas, speedy check-in, logical hotel lay-out.  Easy to find everything.
2. Rooms: Two double beds were underwhelming.  Decor was dated.  Great balcony and ocean view, but no patio furniture.  Air conditioning worked great, frig was stocked daily.  Stayed on 7th floor, view was awesome!
3. Food: Blue Agave was great.  Vento not worth a visit. Mojo was decent. Naos (buffet) was OK, nothing spectacular.  Sushi restaurant was our favorite (white tuna sashimi was the best I've ever had).  Drinks were potent enough to notice, nothing was really watered down.
4. Pool/beach: Pool was immaculate, pool bar provided good drinks and great service.  Beach waves were pretty rough, had to be mindful of how far my daughter swam out.  Lots of sea kelp, but it wasn't too bothersome.  Plenty of palapas were available, since crowds were down this week.
5. Service: fantastic.  Very impressed.  Everyone was helpful, had a high sense of urgency to solve any issue, positive atmosphere all-around.  Want to especially thank Axel (Blue Agave) and Mario (concierge) for their outstanding service.  Axel went out of his way to get a non-menu item (queso for chips) for us - not a big deal, but he treated our request with urgency and provided a special treat for us - thanks, Axel!  Mario was always there when we needed something (help w the TV, more towels/bedding, suggestions on places to visit, etc).  You rock, Mario!

I'd recommend this resort, and hope to visit again in the future!

reviews.author: Pam L
reviews.title: Beautiful vacation club
reviews.text: 3rd year back for 2 weeks and it was fabulous as usual.  First class luxury hotel, great food and service, wonderful pool, Nicki was our outstanding concierge rep.  Our vacation club room is ocean side with 2 full baths, 1 bedroom, pull out sofa and we ordered a roll away bed, at no charge, for our guests.  Long wrap around balcony.  Very clean room, very clean hotel

reviews.author: Derrick C
reviews.title: Overall a great trip!
reviews.text:
Very nice, beautiful, and clean hotel. We had an excellent vacation in september, weather was actually nice without hurricanes. A few things I didn't like: the lobby and inside common area are without air conditioning, very warm and humid, like a green house, probably because of all the decorative plants. It's was acceptable initially and pretty to look at, but after coming in from humid outside, I wanted to cool off fast. The AC and all electricity in the guest room automatically shut off after you leave the room, took awhile for me to figure it out, as our iPads are not charged and room was warm and humid after we returned after being out all day. Two parties in my group, they gave us a room on the 5th floor, and another on the first, when asked to put us closer, they claim there isn't one available, had to fork over extra $50 for ocean view, find that hard to believe, as it was not peak season and saw very few people ever on my floor throughout the stay. 

Other than those minor details above, everything else were excellent, good food (not much sea food though) at all the restaurants, (service at the Market Grill was a little slow), great location, very friendly and caring staff. My 2 year old slept thru diner one day and woke up at 2 am hungry, I walked him down to the 24hr section, got hot dog, chips, pastries, and one of the staff walked back to the kitchen to grab him some milk. I read some negative reviews on having to make reservation at the non-buffet restaurants, they were starting to doing away with reservation when we were there, so not an issue for us.

reviews.author: Elizabeth R
reviews.title: Is Everyone Drunk When They Write Reviews?
reviews.text:
I am actually still here at the resort. ì leave tomorrow afternoon. If I am taking time from my vacation to review you know I am not thrilled. Let me begin with stating that this was my 25th anniversary getaway 4 days away. ì even mentioned on my booking form (I booked with Book It.Com) that I really hoped for NO mess ups on this special weekend. Well, my story begins...When I booked there was no option for the "Royal"service so I had to upgrade when I got here. I had read everyone that you MUST do ROYAL. Let me give you my non-drunk review.

I have come to Mexico (Cancun and Punta Cana) before. As far as ...
Accomodations: above average. ì had room 5601 overlooking what they said would be a `lagoon'but it was basically front facing street view and after the gas station, etc, you saw the water. There was a small balcony and the sun was great out there but who wants to face the street? Lagoon? Por favor!!  For a 'royal'service room there was nothing really royal about it. Typical hotel room.  You also have to walk these mazes to get to the main building (3) where everything is at. 

Food: eh. ì have to say like I told my husband, this is just the way it is in these resorts. You can't come expecting fine dining. It was all average. Sometimes cold food, sometimes not enough food. Again, not surprised since at most resorts this is the way food is in Mexico or Domincian republic.

Activities: Since we had 'royal'service we were away from all the loud stuff. But they did have some things. I saw dancers, zumba, etc. however, we did not participate in any of it. We went to relax and that we did. 

Royal Service: well, I have to say, this is much ado about nothing. You do get a 'personal butler" if he is ever around when you want something. You can get a phone to reach him directly but that will cost you a $100 on your debit card returned after you check out. We decided against it. He did try to please us but we don't drink so all the free liquor couldn't be used on us which ì could see why everyone would be so happy after a few drinks. There is also a private area for people on the royal service which was a plus because we didn't want to hear children irking us all weekend. ìt as quiet just like we liked it. THAT was the part of the royal service we enjoyed. And having our own bali bed each day. Royal customers also had a private lounge to eat in on the way to their rooms but the problem was that they never had enough food and it took way too long to restock the food (no manager watching to restock as soon as a plate empties) plus not much of a selection.   Also when ì asked to print my boarding pass, i had to save it as pdf and send it to an email that didn't even get emails. So they offered for me to do the entire procedure again çheck in'so that they can print themselves which is what i was asking from the get go. Err. I said forget it.  `cesar did try to please us so he gets the most credit for anything in this place!

All in all, my husband gives me a much better royal treatment every day versus these last 4 days. It was not horrible, don't get me wrong. We enjoyed our stay other than the no kids in our area, we don't really think the upgrade was worth it for us.

reviews.author: Tze-Kau
reviews.title: Nice Ocean Views
reviews.text:
Hotel rooms are little out dated but ok, very beautiful ocean view. Easy to jump on a city bus to downtown.
The buffet restaurant Naos is the best restaurant of the hotel, the servers are very nice and polite. Forget about the other specialty restaurants, their foods won't meet your expectations.

reviews.author: Sstep79
reviews.title: Nice Vacation
reviews.text:
This was a large, nice resort.  It was a little older, but was very clean.  It seemed as it catered more towards Hispanics than other hotels we have stayed at, but never had a problem communicating.  Drink service on the beach was very slow.  I think they wanted people to rent the cabanas,  
Do not use the free hotel transfer offered by this hotel.  We could not contact them for our pickup back to the airport.  They were never at the hotel when they were supposed to be, and no one could ever get a hold of them.  I would have much rather paid and know when my transfer was coming.  The restaurants were all very good, and when we went in September, reservations were not required and we did not have to wait which was nice.  
One thing other guests complained of was the smell of the air freshener.  It was a little strong, but smelled nice.  Also, there was no bacon or sausage on the breakfast buffet, but if you ask, they bring a huge plate.  I thought this was a little strange, but no big deal.  We stayed in pyramid 1, which is the vacation club pyramid.  We are not a part of it, but that is where they put us. Our room was nice and had a nice view of the pool and beach.  It was our anniversary and they decorated our room with rose petals and had champagne and fruit waiting for us.
Over all this was a nice vacation.  It was not my favorite hotel that we stayed at, but it was nice.

reviews.author: Andrew M
reviews.title: Stay at Paradisus Royal Service
reviews.text:
Myself and partner stayed at the Paradisus may this year. The service and quality from the staff was some I've never experienced. 
The pool service and staff made you feel like a king. On our second last day we were at the pool (royal area) and had a shorter man with glasses I think his name was Rafael. He was attending to us every time we needed something. Always a mind step ahead of us, and knew what we needed or wanted, always greeting with a smile. 
In the royal area our Buttler "Cesar" was excellent he went the extra step and made our stay feel like we didn't need to ask or plan anything. Everything was always done and little surprises were always popping up champaign and chocolates or tropical scented pillows. He really made our stay perfect.  

We also went to the Avenue Bar a few times and got excellent service from Karina Reyes, she helped with local knowledge and suggestion to help our already perfect trip even better. 

All in all this place is the best place I have stayed and would advise the stay there. Some people might think the price is high but the service you receive and quality of food and drinks is the reason for that pricing

reviews.author: Dixie M
reviews.title: Wonderful get-a-way!
reviews.text: Had a great 4 day trip at the Paradisus Cancun! Went to celebrate a few girlfriend's 50th birthdays and had a wonderful time. We upgraded to Royal Service which was very worthwhile! Our butler, Hector, was great! He had balloons in our room for the birthdays when we arrived as well as a yummy chocolate dessert and fruit. He was great about making our dinner reservations and taking care of anything we needed. Loved the lobby area of the Royal Service area with the lovely breakfast and afternoon snack spread as well as a private bar. Pool and beach area were great too  and the service was amazing out there as well. Only small complaint was the view from our room. We were on a lower level on the lagoon side which gave us a view of the service entrance. Not great, but we didn't spend a lot of time sitting in the room! Our favorite meal was at the Asian restaurant. Delicious and fun atmosphere! All meals and service were good! Great get-a-way.

reviews.author: Douglas c
reviews.title: Great hotel!
reviews.text:
Stayed from May 6 - 12, giving a shout out to 
Jose bana
Letty royal service
Hervik mayordomo royal service
Miguel naos
Guadalupe vento
Cesar pool service
Gabriel Fuego. 

I need to be honest, the service is so good that you do not need the upgrade in my opinion! Only difference is the private pool and Bali beds! Only minor bad thing that my wife and I did not let ruin our vacation was wet floor caused my wife to slip and fall spent 4 hours in hospital getting  X-ray hotel payed for everything and gave proper follow up next day! Beautiful place and super service! Definitely going back.

reviews.author: Mike V
reviews.title: Good Property - Expensive All Inclusive
reviews.text: If you are into large, well appointed and relatively new all-inclusive properties, you'll be happy with this property.  From our perspective, the all-inclusive costs were an unnecessary expense as we could not eat or drink enough to make it nearly worthwhile.  But overall it is a worthy property.  Deserving of special note is the service we received in the main restaurant from Abraham.  He made it his mission to be sure that if we weren't pleased or satisfied with the buffet offering of the day or how something was prepared, that he would find in the kitchen what we wanted.  (Eg., if they were not serving chicken, he'd find it in the kitchen for us.)  And, he did this on a daily basis with grace and a smile.  Excellent service far above expectation.  Pools are great.  We were disappointed initially not to have a Caribbean view, but it turned out that the sunset view over the Lagoon was a more satisfying view at that time of the day, and we spent most of the day at the pools next to the Caribbean, so we had no shortage of that view.  The staff in general was friendly and considerate.  However, the timeshare check in and check out process was way more cumbersome than it needed to be with some relatively inexperienced people manning the desks.  Weather overall was excellent.  The bus service up and down the boulevard operates with a degree of frequency that makes it unnecessary to take cabs if you are sticking to the main hotel area.

reviews.author: jtaskw
reviews.title: Such fun
reviews.text: Loved hanging out by the beach, the drink service was excellent. Loved Naos and Blue Agave restaurants, such excellent food and service. Our AC didn't seem to be working well a couple times but they came right away and made it better. I liked the way the AC cut off automatically if you opened the sliding door to outside. But the light switches and what they controlled were a little confusing.

reviews.author: Kristen F
reviews.title: Very happy
reviews.text: Apart from check-in problems, which also took a very very long time and minor communication issues regarding restaurants, we had a great stay. Would probably stay there again and would recommend it to others.

reviews.author: Lisa H
reviews.title: Mother/Daughter getaway
reviews.text: We had a wonderful 4 day Mother/Daughter trip in April 2015.  Perfect weather.  Our only complaint (as was many others) was that there was no balcony furniture.  When we complained about this we were told that many were damaged during the Spring Break weeks.  We never got any during our stay and therefore couldn't enjoy sitting out on our balcony facing the ocean.  That was too bad.  Otherwise, we had a great time just relaxing on the beach and soaking up the sun.

reviews.author: malvicinir
reviews.title: cancun
reviews.text: Overall a fine stay but complaints neglected. Wait staff and housekeeping very acommadating. Front desk personel not so and misleading. Butler very friendly and resorceful. Nitely entertainment very good , both in center court and the lounge.

reviews.author: roccom714
reviews.title: Rough Waters
reviews.text: If you love swimming in the ocean , I would not recommend staying here. When we first arrived there was a PANDORA Conference,  Extremely way to loud for me . I love that the hotel moved our room to a quieter location . The staff are very friendly , the pool was nice .The hotel decore was absolutely breathtaking ( I love plants ). Only problem is we really couldn't swim in the ocean , the water was way to rough , so again if you are a ocean lover like myself I would stay here , but not the hotels fault.

reviews.author: vparker43
reviews.title: 25th Wedding Anniversary
reviews.text:
My family and friends stayed at the resort this past weekend and the service was exceptional.   We stayed on the Royal service side and Rode was our Butler and he was the best.  Even when he was off he answered my call.  Room 5214 is the best ocean view room.

Victor was one of our bar tenders and he makes the best margaritas at the resort. 

If you eat at the market grill ask for Nacho great waiter very attentive. 

My husband and I renewed our wedding vows while we were there.   We had a fill ceremony and our Romance Coordinator Esther was the best.  Everything was as we expected and in some areas exceeded our expectation.   I recommend this resort to anyone looking for great customer service.

reviews.author: scottrF294QS
reviews.title: 30th birthday celebration.
reviews.text:
Had a very nice time though we were somewhat disappointed with a few things. We had hoped there'd be more entertainment and excitement throughout the hotel, especially at the pools but it was still a very enjoyable stay. Our butler Rode was amazing as was Victor down at the Royal Service pool/restaurant. 

Overall we were happy with our stay but if you're looking for a party, you may want to look elsewhere. If you want a very nice hotel to relax, have some drinks and eat well, I would definitely recommend this place.

reviews.author: polymerizer
reviews.title: Nice Resort - average food
reviews.text:
The Resort is nice and has a beautiful infrastructure. Pools, beach access, rooms, lobby are all outstandingly beautiful. People are really friendly and helpful.
What wasn't so fantastic was the food, and even less the drinks. The all - inclusive philosophy has clearly a negative influence on what's being served. Eating from a buffet is always a difference than being cooked for individually. Places in the a la carte restaurants were unfortunately so scarce that it was almost impossible to try the Mexican specialties or one of the other smaller restaurants. Fruit juices and cocktails were all instant and sugar taste... anywhere else in Mexico you get freshly squeezed juices and wonderful margeritas for very little money... so it shouldn't be a problem in a 5 star resort. Also pity that the pools close so early, a late evening drink at the pool bar would have been highly appreciated. A little more outside seating restaurants wouldn't harm either.
Temperature in the lobby area is way too hot, aircon in the rooms works well.
Avoid rooms towards the lobby area, as it is very loud at night. Definitely book an Ocean View room away from the busy central pyramid area.
All in all a great place to stay for some days, so still 4 stars for me.

reviews.author: George S
reviews.title: paradisus cancun
reviews.text: food is very good with many varieties to choose from, bar service is excellent, waiters and butlers are always there to help out, resort is a bit dated, especially the rooms, where you can see wear and tear. and the resort is way to dimly lit, it needs a bit more lighting, actually a lot more. i would recommend this resort for a unique getaway

reviews.author: 531arianav
reviews.title: Amazing Place to Stay!
reviews.text:
The paradisus was one of the best vacations I've been on.  From the moment you arrive, you feel like royalty.  Anything that can be done, they do for you.  The hotel staff were excellent - so nice and very accomodating.  The resort itself is beautiful.  The restaurant food was delicious and we had no problems getting reservations each night.

PS
Salvador at the pool bar is THE BEST.

PSS
Try the "Dirty Banana" drink :)

reviews.author: Karen O
reviews.title: The food and service need a Hugh improvement
reviews.text: The food was so disappointing and very little entertainment.  The butler service was poor and needed training. It's never proper to had someone ask for a tip. Tip are earned with service. The best meal we had was room service getting a salad and wings.

reviews.author: Ted S
reviews.title: Be Treated Like You Didn't Spend $300+ a Night
reviews.text: Absolutely horrific service. Nice Rooms, Pool and Beach, but the common areas are terribly hot and service is so bad. If you are a male, expect to be ignored by bartenders unless you tip every single time (not so all inclusive).

reviews.author: TraceyTC71
reviews.title: Great Hotel & Fantastic Service
reviews.text: There were 6 of us stayed in the Paradisus Cancun all inclusive and were not disappointed.  The service was great, especially Simon in the Bana Bar for our evening drinks, not forgetting SoFonia, Jesus, Enrique and Alcudia who looked after us all poolside with a huge range of cocktails!.  Food in the inclusive was excellent, even the buffet had a huge amount of selection.  Rooms were clean and tidy and the fridge stocked with beers, drinks, crisps and biscuits.  A 9 hole gold course on sight was well used.  Would recommend to others and would stay again.

reviews.author: Walter M
reviews.title: False Advertising
reviews.text: My girlfriend and I spent 5 nights at the Paradisus Cancun, although it was a beautiful resort with friendly staff, the restaurants and hotel manager receive a thumbs down. One of the reasons we chose the Paradisus Cancun was because of the numerous restaurants and bars that they offer. Upon our arrival and meeting with the concierge we were informed that there were 2 restaurants already closed for the week and another one that is not included in the all inclusive. On the second day a 3rd  restaurant was closed for the week. Every morning we would wake up early and make our dinner reservations for the day only to find out that the only options available were usually 6pm and 10pm for most restaurants. Even though a majority of the restaurants had seating available we were still unable to sit down. On the second day we made reservations and when we arrived we were told that we were not on the list and could not get a table. The following night we sat down at Bana for dinner at 7:30pm and ordered drinks and appetizers, 9:30 quickly approached and dinner was still not served, we ended up leaving and going to the Buffett. The restaurants at the Paradisus Cancun are not accommodating at all. I decided to speak with the hotel manager and see if something could be done only to find out she was extremely uncooperative, and bordering the inappropriate line for customer service. She offered no solutions to the problem and told us to have a nice day. Since we had such a negative experience with the restaurants and the Managers lack of concern for our issue we will not be returning to the Paradisus Cancun. This resort is not worth the price of an all inclusive. We also will not be recommending this resort to anyone. We travel quite frequently and all over the world and this resort does not stand up to the reputation and image that they try to portray.

reviews.author: Russell R
reviews.title: Supreme Service and Hospitality
reviews.text: We just returned from a week of "all inclusive" service at the Paradisus Cancun International Hotel in Cancun, Mexico. We opted for the round trip transportation package offered by the Hotel and it made our airport experience go smoothly. Upon arrival at the hotel, we were greeted by courteous and attentive doormen, receptionists and our personal concierge, Kayla Madrid. Our week in "paradise" could not have been more fun. Every service you can imagine was available to us. Kayla set us up with golf and restaurant reservations. My wife and the wife our traveling campions enjoyed an afternoon at the hotel's fabulous spa while the "guys" enjoyed rounds of golf at local courses. The week sped by and it was time to pack up and head home before we knew it. We will always have positive and fond memories of our wonderful time at the Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: TexasTravelFreak
reviews.title: 4.5 Stars for Excellent Service!
reviews.text:
After much research, I chose Paradisus Cancun and the Family Concierge Service for our family of 3. Our son is nearly 4 years old and he had a blast. I stayed here over 10 years ago when it was the Gran Melia and they have certainly made many upgrades to the resort. This was our first All-Inclusive vacation and it completely met our expectations. We usually like to do more exploring which is why we don't do the All-Inclusive, but this time, we wanted to "do nothing" and be pampered. The Family Concierge lounge is wonderful and the concierges do everything they can to make your stay amazing. There is always a smiling face in the Family Concierge lounge, along with yummy snacks and drinks for both kids and adults. Ricardo was fabulous, as were the other concierges. Our butler, Mauro, was muy fantastico. He was very attentive, yet let us have a lot of space. Our son loved all of the special surprises that Mauro left for us in our room at the end of each day. The resort is very clean and all of the staff are courteous and will go out of their way to make a pleasant experience. A special shout out to Luis in the Naos and Market Grill restaurant for getting our picky eater son, a pizza from room service while we were at dinner at the Market Grill. Our pool concierge was great at setting up the bali bed that we rented every day. The pool waiters were great, especially Enrique. 

The food at the restaurants are average to good. There were many hits and misses but overall, nothing horrible. The outside grill by the pool was very convenient, with plenty of "kids" foods (hamburgers, hot dogs, nachos, chicken wings, etc.) The chicken wings and shrimp cocktail were delicious. 

We stayed for 7 nights and on our 4th night, our AC broke. It took them 1.5 hours to fix it. The next day, it went out again and they had to move us to another room. First, they said that the only ocean view room available was next to the club (loud) and I politely said that I was sure they could do better. After about 30 minutes, they moved us to a one bedroom suite. The balconies were spacious with much broader views and the separate living room was nice. However, the bathroom was half the size of our previous room. 

If you are there for many nights, I would suggest that you try all of the restaurants. If you only have a few nights, I would avoid Bana and Mole. The buffet is usually a safe bet that you can find something to your liking. 

When I booked on melia.com, the web page stated that we would get $1500 in resort credits, a free upgrade to next room level (if available), late check-out,etc. You have to tell them about those. I don't think they would have given us the resort credit (coupons) and room upgrade if I had not said something. But it wasn't any trouble, you just have to "remind" them politely. 

We rented a bali bed every day but there were plenty of pool chairs every day (unlike other times when reviewers said that pool chairs were taken by 7am!). This must be an off season time as the resort was not crowded at all. EXCEPT that during our stay, Pandora was having a conference there and some of them were loud and obnoxious. Our first day, they began setting up a huge buffet right behind our bali bed. Clearly, we did not pay for the noise and high traffic. There was also a huge tent and sound stage set up on the beach right in front of our bali bed. We found out later that Pandora had a concert there with Wyclef Jean. Luckily, the conference goers cleared out around Thursday and we were able to enjoy the rest of our vacation. 

We were happy with all of the extra amenities with Family Concierge and beautiful beaches. My husband got a very nice massage at YHI spa. 

Some parts of the hotel (and rooms) have seen better days, but it is still in good condition. Pyramid 3 is the most convenient location and we had no issues with the noise from the club.

NOTE on Free Airport Transfer: If you book on melia.com, you are given the option for a free transfer with OTIUM. When we arrived in Cancun, there was nobody to meet us at the airport transfer station. After about 15-20 minutes, someone showed up. Our toddler was already tired and fussy, but since it is a group transfer, we would still have to wait for others to arrive. The OTIUM guy noticed my irritation and offered to give us a private transfer to the hotel. If you have kids, I would not recommend the group transfer. We decided to book a private transfer for the ride back and used USA Transfers (Entertainment Plus). 

Overall, we had an amazing time at Paradisus Cancun. I would recommend it for families with kids. Thanks again to Mauro, Ricardo, Luis, Enrique and the entire Family Concierge staff. Gracias!

reviews.author: D4chesi
reviews.title: Luxury all inclusive
reviews.text: This hotel is one of the best all inclusive hotel in cancun.  Not to far from the airport.  18 minutes cab drive. Their staff are extremely friendly and the butlers which came with royal service are very nice helpful and useful.  They will pampered you are make you feel like royalty.  The food is good the have a wide selection of food and if you are alcohol friendly the have premium liquor for the savy drinkers.  Pool side view and ocean cabana are great for relaxation.  The royal service is adult mostly.

reviews.author: steve m
reviews.title: great
reviews.text:
Beautiful place, outstanding service, great area. Can't speak highly enough about the hard working, wonderful staff at the resturant. lots of kids running around where a litle anoying i can sugest an kids area , as many adults are going for a peace retreat, but overal great experience and restaurants where top noch
.

reviews.author: Amy1770
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation and Great Staff
reviews.text: My daughter and I stayed here for a week following her high school graduation.  I cannot say enough great things about this resort.  The resort is beautiful. The staff was super helpful and friendly.  The food was great and the nightly shows were fun and entertaining.  We will definitely go back.

reviews.author: nascar921
reviews.title: Luxurious, romantic, & restful at the Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
My wife won a 3-night 4-day trip to Cancun from work so we extended it and made a 7-night stay at The Paradisus Cancun. 

We usually take cruises or stay at a sandals resort. We have been to both Cozumel and Costa Maya Mexico but never Cancun, so we were not sure what to expect. I must say we were pleasantly surprised. Not sure if the experience would have been the same if we had come during spring break!

We stayed in the Royal services luxury included (adults only) side and had a great experience. We had a butler service (Sergio was awesome) and we highly recommend it as he took care of anything we needed. Our pool cabana was set up for us every day and dinner reservations were never an issue. In fact, I decided to surprise my wife with a romantic dinner served beach side (on Mother's Day) and they made it happen last minute...AMAZING SERVICE!!!

The only thing that kept us from a 5-rating was that the air conditioning could be a bit better.

reviews.author: Mr_Icu
reviews.title: Great Relaxing Vacation
reviews.text:
We had a great time at the end of March celebrating our little ones 1st birthday in Cancun.  We had the all inclusive package and opted for the King Bed.  We were placed in Pyramid 1 (Club Melia) eventhough we were not members.  This Pyramid is the only one with hot tubs on the balconies ... it was a great time! Here's the run down:

Pros:
-------
- Very attentive staff.  No request is too small or too big.

- Very infant/toddler/kid friendly.  Cribs were available in the rooms and they have a Kids Club and Baby club where the kids have activities and toys to play with and free babysitting.  The buffet had a special kids area with kid friendly items.

- Food was not as bad as most reviews give it.  If you are flexible in your food, then it will do.  Not the best, but I have had much much much worse.  The food at the restaurants are smaller portioned, but are tasty.  Plenty of vegetarian options.

- The hotel is accessible in that there are ramps and elevators everywhere for those with mobility issues.

- Although we were there during spring break, there wasn't much partying going on because I think the place is a higher price point.

- The stores give good value on trinkets and everyday items.  We found the souveniers we bought at the store were cheaper than those at the malls.

- The location is pretty good.  You can walk to the resorts next door and experience those hotels and some of their amenities.

- They have 4 main pool areas: 1 for infants which is about 1 ft deep, one for kids, 1 for adults with a swim up bar and 1 for Royal Service

- Beach was very beautiful and powdery.  Only wish they cleaned up the seaweed once a day.

- Free Wifi is accessible in most areas of the property.  We were streaming Netflix programs through wifi.  Printing is avialable for a fee at one of the convinience stores.

Cons:
---------
- The purple shashed ladies ... they are everywhere and hounding you to join them for their welcome breakfast ... which is really a time share presentation.

- Room service ... never got our orders right the first time.

- If you are sensitive to scents, then stay away from this hotel.  Scents are pumped into the place at every corner (Like those at higher end Vegas casinos)!

- This one can be a pro and a con: When you check in, there is someone there to give you a complete orientation of the property.  They give you all the information upfront.  I put it as a con for me because we arrived in the late evening with a cranky child, but they insisted on giving us the orientation when all we wanted to do was go to our rooms to rest and get some food into us.  They should give the option of getting the orientation at a later time, or create a video that can be viewed on the tvs.

- We had the unfortunate opportunity to use the medical services.  The service was fine, but the prices are ridiculus.  $60 US for the consult, $250 for medications that I'm sure is avilable for a few bucks across the street at the pharmacy.  Luckily we got travel medical insurance that will cover it.

All around good place to stay and I would not hesitate to recommend it (unless you are sensitive to scents!).  There is way too much to cover in the review so feel free to ask me questions.

reviews.author: Dmcastillo
reviews.title: Great all inclusive luxury resort catering family friendly superb amenities!
reviews.text:
Pros - Great personalized service, restaurant choices & food (final evening dined at bana sushi restaurant, delicious), location, kids amenities (baby zone with nurturing child care ask for Francis), ample space in rooms with oversized balconies with views to lagoon or beach, bali beds to relax an entire day by the poolside.
