Cons - Staff is persistent trying to sell time shares, non-friendly family concierge staff, maybe because we overlooked purchasing this service when booking our reservation and lastly free wifi service is very slow in rooms (hint...fast wifi by club melia pyramid.

reviews.author: Hookm36
reviews.title: Full of friendly faces, Excellent place
reviews.text:
I just got back from a relaxing and very enjoyable 6 nights and 7 days in Cancun while staying at the Paradisus Cancun. I believe that different people have different experiences, and hopefully my report will help others who are trying to make future travel plans.

About 10am, we pulled up the steep driveway of the Paradisus, and had a sigh or relief knowing that all of our planning and waiting was finally over, and we finally arrived...

Upon checking in we find out we are on floor 0, and have 2 double beds instead of our King we reserved. There were no other rooms available because Pandora (the music app) had rented out 300 rooms that morning for their employees!!! After getting all the information I felt the sales pitch coming on, and I calmly explained we were not interested, and had a long morning and just wanted to eat breakfast. He smiled, shook his head, and walked us to Naos where we ate Breakfast at 10:30, and were in our room at 11:15am.

Sooooo.........I quickly realized the mini bar was not cooling, and the Tv did not work !!! I looked at my wife, and we just shook our heads in disbelief. At this time my daughter had asked 48 times when she was going to see the beach, so we quickly left the room, and walked down to the beach. It was during this walk when we noticed the grand size of the resort, and how everything was fresh, clean, and everyone was going out of there way to be friendly. As we approached the the double glass sliding doors they opened and the gusty winds of the outdoor air met our faces, we quickly forgot about all our troubles....Absolutely beautiful ! Stunning ! It was as if the palm trees were waiving at us, and the sights and sounds of the day hit us smack in the face. We couldn't wipe the smiles off our faces, but we never really tried too...

After getting back to the room, I informed the front desk of the tv and mini bar issues. 5 minutes later a technician was at my door, and quickly resolved both issues. Happy once again. We ate lunch at the Market Grill and ate the Fresh Grouper which was very good, and my wife had the Ribs which were okay. My daughter loved her pizza and fries, and we went straight to the pool. HUGE. Huge pool. We snacked at the poolside stand, and had a few drinks at the poolside bar. We ate Dinner at La Perla. The steaks were great, but I didn't care much for the choices of the pasta and salad bars...

Monday morning arrived quickly, and I received a phone call informing my my King bed room on the 3rd floor in the 3rd pyramid was ready, and a bellman would be at my door to help me move upon my request. We were ready, moved to the new room, and went down stairs for a fabulous breakfast at Naos. Cooked to order Omelets, pastries, bacon, pancakes, waffles, fruits, mimosas, you name it...they had everything. Even had nutella... I reserved a Bali bed (which I highly recommend if you plan on staying at the resort all day) After a few hours relaxing at the pool, we had lunch brought to us in our bed, drinks a plenty, and the relaxing views of the ocean as my wife and 3 year old enjoyed the pool were very rewarding. After showering and changing it was time to eat Dinner at the Market Grill. They brought several meats every 2 minutes. Salad, potatoes and meats galore... New York Steak, Chicken, Lamb, Pork, you name it, they brought it. We got overwhelmed very quick and very full also. Our nightly stroll on the beach after taking a few shots of tequila were a great way to walk it off, and let my daughter run through the sand. Once back in the room we ordered room service (no extra charge) and had a cheesecake, key lime pie, chocolate, strawberry and coconut ice cream delivered to our door 20 minutes later. My daughter was in heaven...

Tuesday morning seemed to arrive quicker than the day before and we were taken by golf cart to the street at 8am so we could catch the bus to Playa Tortugas so we could take the 9am ferry to Isla De Mujeres. We got our tickets at 8:30, and were walking on the island at 9:30. Rented our Golfcart (only 38.00) at Gomar across the street, and drove to the square..... We parked and walked to the Rooster, where we had the BEST BREAKFAST OF OUR LIVES. My wife had the Eggs Benedict, and it was out of this world amazing. I had pancakes, eggs, biggest pieces of bacon Ive ever seen and potatoes that were cooked in chorizo. Words can't explain how great the food and service was. Highly recommend. Drive to the Turtle farm, my daughter loved it. Went to Punta Sur, explored, took pictures, and were amazed by the beauty. Saw the crayola house, and the shell house before heading back north to Playa Norte. Had drinks at a small bar and enjoyed the water (small waves suitable for small children, not ferocious like the hotel zone) Ate lunch at Bally-Hoo. I had the fish tacos, my wife had the garlic shrimp. Bother were reasonable and good, but nothing compared to The Rooster. It was 4:30, so we turned the golf cart in and caught the 5:00 ferry back. Showered and had dinner at Bana at Paradisus. Excellent, and I don't care for Sushi !! We then headed over to Naos so my daughter could eat, because she didn't care for the food at Bana. The waiter at Naos immediately brought my wife and I 2 shots of Don Julio, and we enjoyed another walk on the beach...

Wednesday we had a fabulous breakfast again then headed to Wet-n-Wild. Book online in advance and get 50% off. I only payed 49.00 for the 3 of us. Lazy river, wave pool and kids park were good. Did the park show signes of its age ? Yes, Did the liquor in the bar suck ? Yes, was the Buffet food edible ? Yes Did we expect anything more than what we got ? No. Bottom line, if you have young kids they will enjoy it, and overall we all had fun. Took a taxi back to Paradisus, washed up and had dinner at the Buffet. Yes, the waiter remembered us, and half way through our meal brought us 2 shots or Don Julio...as we finished those, he brought us 2 more.... another walk on the beach, and another order of room service, we all went to sleep with tired, but very happy smiles on our faces.

Thursday was a nice day, but you could feel the staff getting ready for something...something big. A Huge tent was going up on the beach. I estimated a 200ft by 100ft tent. We had a bali bed again and saw the entire set-up. They were getting ready for Pandora's big beach party. The only thing I didn't like was the pool bars closing at 6pm so the staff could help set-up the bars for the Pandora party. We ate dinner at Blue Agave (Tacos y tequila) and it was excellent. My 2nd best meal of the trip !!! They brought us tacos after tacos, and a few tequilla shots as well. You could feel the electricity in the air as the entire 3rd pyramid was filled with 550 Pandora employees all dressed in white. They were extremely nice to us and all the other guest too. 9pm and it was here...the big bang...strobe lights, music, the flash, the pizazz, and the curiosity of all the normal vacationers checking out the scene. We hung out outside then the music started, it was Wyclef Sean from the Fugees singing !!! The place erupted and we were allowed to walk down there on the water side of the beach and take part in the festivities. It was cool seeing him sing, and talking to all the other guest staying at the hotel enjoying themselves too. Needless to say...a great night. Oh and my daughter got a neon ring, led the event and danced the entire night !

Friday morning was very calm. I enjoyed coffee on our huge balcony listening to the waves and enjoying the view. Spent more time in a less-crowded pool as all the Pandora guest were checking out and heading back home. We were enjoying our last day, and reflecting on the night before. Yes, we got a bali bed again, ate at Bana again, had a few shots again, and enjoyed our nightly walk on the beach. Room service ? You betcha...

After Breakfast on Saturday morning we got our phone call that our Airport transfer was in the lobby ready and waiting. We realized our trip was finally over. We felt as though we had made some real friends of the staff, and didnt want to leave. In the transfer van, and driving back down the steep hill away from the resort, it all felt so fast, but realized over the past 7 days we had so many memories that would last a lifetime.....

Other pieces of info for those that care.

Pyramid 3 is NOT loud.

The AC stayed on the entire time, it never got too cold, and only got humid once our balcony door remained open for long periods of time.

They had nutella.

Small playground by the kids pool on the side of pyramid 1

Pyramid 1 DOES have jacuzees on the balcony, but I believe that is only for timeshare owners

Food was pretty good. There were some great items, and some bad items, but overall pretty good.

Top shelf liquor was great

I tipped 3 at breakfast, 5 at lunch, and 7-12 at dinner (i know i didn't have too, but when they work really hard to please, make jokes, and are very accommodating to my 3 year old, i tipped.) Ill believe that my tips is what made the rest of the stay easy. never had to wait for a drink, brought me shots, ice cream etc before i even asked for it)

Get room service, why not.

The resort is spotless, and filled with happy employees.

reviews.author: Tony W
reviews.title: Longterm owner positive and negative feedback
reviews.text:
I have been an owner for over 15 years and have been to the Paradisus many times.

The staff is exceptional, they are always friendly and willing to go the extra mile. The food and drink is always top notch. I will continue to come back. I was there May 2015 and am planning a return trip in December 2015.

I have 2 wishes and one criticism.
Wish one: Add some up beat music at the swim up bar at the main pool.
Wish two: Add nightly dancing in the Red Lounge Bar. They have not used this lounge much in the past and would be a great addition for guest.

Complaint: I loved the all-inclusive food and premium drinks but, you are required to purchase a full 7 days. We arrived late Saturday and left the following Saturday morning. They should have  pro-rated the short days.  

PS. Check before you book a week to make sure there are no large groups there. Pandora had several hundred guest there and they closed one of the main pools for most part of a day. At times it made the bars and restaurants crowded. When Pandora took a break from meetings that is when several hundred people all headed to the bars and restaurants at once...I will check myself before I book a week.

reviews.author: NeenahMarie
reviews.title: Fun for everyone!
reviews.text:
I took a romantic vacation with my boyfriend in April and stayed at the Paradisus Cancun. We stayed in the Royal Service section in a Jr Suite with Ocean View. It was awesome! I loved having the butler service and the adults only section along with a private lounge area, free bali bed reservations and a royal service pool. 

This resort is very large but once you figure out the layout, it's easy to get around. It smells amazing inside as well. The beach is very nice. A lot of seaweed but the waves were pretty rough so it was bringing up all the seaweed. You could walk for miles each way on the beach. It was amazing. 

The resort is in a good location. The staff is very friendly. I recommend this resort to couples, honeymooners, families, singles and getaways. 

The kids programs are very nice! 

This resort was at capacity when I was there but you never would have known. It was not crowded at all.

The food is different but it was good. You always have to be open minded when travelling. It's not always going to be "Mom's" cooking. Try everything and have a great time!

One thing that my boyfriend didn't like is that they served Tecate beer and not Modelo or Corona. That was seriously the biggest downfall, not the right beer. For me, I was good with everything. 

Book your trip with confidence and remember to always book with a travel agent! You don't know what you are getting even though you think you do when you are booking online. A good travel agent ALWAYS has your back! Happy travels!

reviews.author: Jesenia Q
reviews.title: Wonderful!!!
reviews.text: This is our secind time in this resort, everything is excellent, thanks to Manuel server at Bana he goes above and beyond, William bartender in Bana, friendly people all around the serves are Naos Antonio, there is not a single thing that I can complain well yea a minor thing, people in the front desk are not the friendly ones, try to training them how to be much nicer since they are the first impression, just my opinion, we will come back soon.

reviews.author: BKLYNShopper
reviews.title: Excellent for Club Melia Members...Only slight improvements needed
reviews.text:
My husband and I are Club Melia (their vacation club) members.  We stayed at the resort from late April through early May of 2015.  It was our first time at this resort.  I am noting that we are club members as I believe it is a different experience. I also had a difficult time finding reviews from a club member's experience.  This may be lengthy, but I will try to give a detailed review of our visit.

We arranged an airport transfer through a link sent to us by the resort.  It was a private van, inexpensive and a smooth pick up.  The resort is 15-20 minutes from the airport.  There is a main entrance and also one for club members.  Our driver dropped us off at the main entrance.  I tried to ask the bellman if we were in the correct spot, but I think he misunderstood me.  They took our luggage and gave us a ticket for it.   After another person checked our name, we were told we needed to check in at the Club Melia desk.  At other Paradisus resorts, the greeters walk you to a check in area, offer a moist towel, etc.  This person walked with a few feet and then pointed directions to the club lobby.  It was not the best introduction to the resort.  We would have appreciated someone walking us to the proper location.  When we arrived at the club member check in desk, a woman who I didn't see again during our visit worked with us.  She did not seem familiar at all with Club Melia or member benefits.  She handed us a paper with general hotel information including a phone number for restaurant reservations.  I said I was told that we would be assigned someone to make the reservations (as they did at other Paradisus resorts).  She seemed confused and then asked if we were club members.  That concerned me as were at the club check in desk.  At that point, I was questioning our choice in staying at this resort.  She then introduced us to someone who would be able to assist us and answer any questions.  That person was Bladimir.  He was the club butler assigned to work with us during our stay.  Bladimir immediately made us feel comfortable with our decision to vacation at this resort.  He went over the different restaurants and offered to make a reservation for us that evening for dinner.  He answered any of our initial questions and took notes as to our preference of dinner time, mini bar requests, etc. Bladimir was wonderful.  He was in constant contact with us throughout our stay.  He arranged gifts in our room and made us feel like his top priority.  He is an asset to this resort.  

The following are my thoughts on the room, restaurants, pool, etc: 

- Our Room
We chose a one bedroom suite. We were lucky enough to get a room with an ocean view.  The view was breathtaking.  The room itself was perfect for two people.  While it did not have a separate shower from the tub, it was fine with us.  The sleeping area had a king size bed, desk and tv.  There was also a small dining table, sleeper sofa and kitchenette.  The balcony had a chair, lounge chair and jetted tub.  Overall, we found the room to be very nice.  It wasn't brand new looking, but it was still an above average room.  

- Mini bar
It was stocked with water, beer, soda (diet and regular), potato chips and oreos.  They filled it on a daily basis.  One day they did not restock it and after we called, it was immediately filled.  The only improvement would be to add additional items of things that they noticed we drank on a daily basis.  For example, we prefer Coca Cola Light and it would have been nice to have an extra one of two each day.  

- Housekeeping
They did a great job of cleaning each day.  Once they did not restock our shampoo or bars of soap.  That was an issue as we realized it while my husband was in the shower.  I called the front desk to ask for some.  After that, we had several extra of each placed in our room on a daily basis.  The only other improvement would be to add extra large towels each day.  Some days we only received two.  Four would have been nice as we each use two to shower.  As I said, overall they did an excellent job cleaning our room and we appreciated their hard work.

- Pool
Club members do not have a private pool, but our section of the pool is shared with Family Concierge.  The pool is large, but not the largest I have seen.  It has a couple of jetted areas, a swim up bar and the far end of it is the member and Family Concierge section.  The downside is that it isn't a private area for club members.  Even though our paperwork when we checked in mentioned our own pool area, that is not the case.  It is all one pool.  We noticed couples without club wrist bands hanging out in our jetted area and kind of taking over that section.  That was a little annoying considering we spend quite a bit of money to become members.  But, they probably didn't realize it and thought it was a quieter part of the pool.

Bali beds need to be reserved and they include two lounge chairs to the left of each bed.  Members received two free days of beds by the pool or beach.  Additional days were $10 per day.  We did not have one reserved for our first day as we got to the pool around 5pm.  We found some chairs near the swim up bar end of the pool.  Poolside drink service ends around 5:30, but we were able to get a couple of drinks before it ended.  The swim up bar was a bit crowded, but not to the point where we would not have been able to get drinks.  That end of the pool tends to get a little loud, but not out of control.  It is just a bit more rowdy at times.  On our second day, we met Jose, the pool concierge. He arranged a bed by the pool for the additional days of our stay.  Jose was wonderful.  He made sure that we had a bed in a quieter part of the pool as he knew we were not there with children.  He also reserved the same bed for us each day.  It was stocked with towels and set up for us each day before we arrived at the pool.  I highly recommend reserving a bed.  It made a huge difference to our stay.  Club Melia beds overlook the beach. The view is the nicest I have ever had on vacation.  

The poolside servers were great, too.  They usually brought over a bucket of beer and ice to start us off.  Throughout the day they replaced our ice and refilled our drinks.  They also brought us mixed drinks, shots, etc.  They probably checked on us every half hour or so.  They also brought us food from the Sunset Grill.  The servers were all great, but Miguel and Sofonia really stood out to me.  Sofinia always greeted us by name and brought our favorite drinks before even asking us.  He was awesome.  Miguel kept our drinks coming and even brought one that he thought I might like to try.  He also reminded us before the Sunset Grill closed for the day or let us know if La Perla (a sit down restaurant) was open for the afternoon.  

- Beach
Unlike some other Paradisus resorts, the beach here is right next to the pool.  Our Bali beds by the pool overlooked the beach.  The sand was powder white and the water was the most beautiful shades of turquoise to deep blue.  There were Bali beds and chairs available on the beach.  We usually left a few things on our bed by the pool and carried anything of value, such as our phones or iPads, in a bag with us.  They offered drinks by the beach.  I am pretty sure food was available there, too.  We didn't ask for any, so I cannot say for sure if you can get food there.  One annoying thing is that we walked down with full drinks, put our bag and towels on chairs, only to return to our drinks having been taken away.  It is an all inclusive, so we didn't lose money on them, but it seemed like it was a little fast to take them as well as a waste of good drinks.  I really loved the location of the beach vs the pool.  It was so convenient to take a quick dip in the ocean and then relax in the pool.  We didn't have to choose one over the other for the day.  

-Wifi
The signal was strong throughout our room.  Everywhere else it was hit or miss.  It did not work in most restaurants. It was especially disappointing that it did not work well by the pool.  I enjoy checking my email and surfing the web while I relax by the pool.  On one occasion I really needed to email someone for an important matter and I had to leave the pool area to take care of it.  If they could work on improving the signal and coverage, that would make a big difference for guests. 

- Dress Code
Very casual.  A lot of the guests dressed a little too casual for my taste.  Many of the men were wearing concert type or printed t-shirts, shorts and flip flops for dinner.  Some women were in short shorts and tank tops.  I tend to wear maxi dresses with sandals for dinner.  For the most part, my husband wore polo shirts, khakis and boat shoes.  A couple of nights, he wore cargo shorts with a polo.  

- Room Service
The menu is limited, but it is available 24hrs.  The wait is about 45 minutes, so be prepared for that.

- Breakfast
Naos is the buffet breakfast restaurant.  It is an average size buffet for a resort.  They have two stations with omelettes and eggs made to order.  They have all of your standard breakfast items like pancakes, sausage, cereal, juices, etc.  They have a large variety of breads for toasting.  The bacon was a little undercooked for my taste, but it was not a big issue for me.  They also have an area with smoothies with a new daily recipe.  Another nice touch was a self serve bloody mary section with assorted vodkas.  Champagne and mimosas were also available from the servers.  I think it was a great breakfast with something for everyone.  Martin was especially friendly and gave us great service on more than one occasion.  

- Lunch

For the most part we ate by the pool and had food from the Sunset Grill.  The poolside servers can bring it to you or you can take a seat around the grill.  It is a self serve restaurant that is part of the pool area.  They have potato chips, fries, pizza, chicken wings, nachos, veggie burgers and a few other things.  The variety is greater than I have had at other Paradisus resorts.  They close down a little after 5 and are not shy about pulling food away even if people are still trying to take some.  One day, I wanted to grab some nachos before closing.  My husband was considering a hot dog.  Even though there were people in line and food was still available, they still took it away.  we turned our heads and the hot dogs were gone.  The cheese for the nachos had been taken away, too.  I understand they needed to close.  I do think they could have let what was left run out since people were in line and obviously wanted some food.  That was the only negative about the Sunset Grill.

Another lunch option was La Perla.  On occasion, they were open for a buffet lunch.  They usually had a few desserts, salad, fried shrimp, fried calamari and other fish for tacos.  The restaurant is an open air style and overlooks the pool.  

One day we tried Naos for the lunch buffet.  This is the largest buffet option for lunch.  It was nice, but I didn't love it.  Nothing really stood out as special.  We sat outside by the Market Grill.  They also had a one page menu of food to order.  If you don't like staying by the pool or beach, it is a nice option.  I really loved relaxing by the pool, so I was in a hurry to get back to our Bali bed.

- Dinner

Mole - Mexican restaurant, indoors. Excellent service Oscar, our waiter knew our names and greeted us. Very good food. Not rushed at all.  Oscar made us feel very relaxed and welcome.  He was the best waiter we had during our trip.  He is an asset to the resort.

Market Grill- open air restaurant. Rodizio style.  They serve a variety of meats on what looks like spears or swords.  The concept is great.  Unfortunately, we felt very rushed. We finished within an hour. My husband was in restroom and they skipped some meats while he was gone. They said they did not want it to be cold when we returned to the table.  The problem is they never came back around with the meats he missed,  They then assumed we were done eating when we said we were taking a break as the food was brought out one on top of another. Before we could say something, they started mentioning desserts.  By that point, we chose a dessert and called it a night.  We were very disappointed as this was our favorite restaurant at Paradisus in Playa del Carmen.  

Vento-  indoor restaurant. tapas. They recommended two cold, one salad, three hot per person. Excellent food and very nice looking restaurant 

Fuego- indoor restaurant. Food was good as well as the service. Main course didn't have sides. More al a cart. Portions were small

Bana- indoor restaurant. mostly sushi. Excellent service. Best dinner location in the resort. Located by the entrance/lobby in the middle of everything. Miguel was an excellent waiter.  He gave us great service and wonderful recommendations for our meal.

La Perla- open air restaurant near club side of pool. Pasta and Steak..Only open certain nights for dinner.  The service was so so. Waiter introduced himself and then handed us bottles of water. Small salad bar with four pasta varieties and grilled vegetables . Assorted sausages that waiter brings you. Meat entrees are brought over by waiter. Tenderloin was awful. Over cooked and terrible, gamey flavor? Could not eat it. Dessert was decent. Wouldn't go back.  They didn't offer coffee or after dinner drinks or more water. They also took husband's champagne glass without offering anything else.  This was the worst meal of our trip

Private Dinner On The Beach

- Club Melia arranged a private dinner for us on the beach.  It was spectacular.  The service was outstanding and the food was perfect.  I highly recommend trying this.

- Bars/Alcohol

I found the variety of top shelf alcohol to be above my expectation.  They offered Grey Goose at most bars.  The house wine was decent.  I wouldn't expect much as far as wine at an all inclusive resort.  They had some available to purchase, but I didn't find it necessary.  

Avenue Bar - Nightly shows take place at this bar.  Seating is limited and without a seat it can be hard to see the shows.  We skipped most of them.  We did stop by this bar after dinner for drinks.  Service is slow if you are not at the bar itself. 

Red Lounge - the club/lounge and only option for drinks after midnight.  Don't expect a large, party atmosphere.  It is a small club with a couple of bartenders and servers.  It was fine for us.  A younger crowd may prefer to leave the resort and visit a larger bar or club

Conventions

- One thing to note is that this resort hosts conventions.  During our stay, Pandora jewelry held a sales convention there. I was told there were 600 attendees.  On our last full day at the pool, workers were setting up several tables and a bar for a private cocktail party for Pandora.  The problem is they set up right on top of our lounge chairs and bed.  I mean right next to us.  The back of our chairs touched the chairs they set up.  While the people at the bed next to us were away for lunch, they pushed their lounge chairs forward and moved a huge bar behind them.  I was stunned.  After a week of phenomenal service, they completely disregarded our presence and disrupted the relaxing afternoon that we were all trying to have.  I would say they set up a little after 1pm.  I spoke with other guests who were also club members and they felt the same way about it.  By 3pm, they pretty much pushed us out of our bed.  We asked Jose for another location.  He was very apologetic.  I considered it the fault of whichever department was setting up the party.  They clearly did not care about the guests around them.  When we went to our new bed, a woman next to us was speaking loudly on her cell phone.  For at least 20 minutes she went on and on about reports, etc.  I told my husband to ignore it (even though she was loud and rude)  as she was using her bed/space.  When she finished, she walked to a table by the pool.  I realized she was part of the convention and it wasn't her bed.  I guess she didn't want to be rude in front of her coworkers, but it was ok to take over a space she didn't reserve.  Now I wish my husband had said something to her.  I guess my point about the woman is to be aware that convention attendees do not always behave the same as guests on vacation and you may have to deal with that.  I took photos of the bar set up that forced us out of our bed.  I will try to post them later.

Final Thoughts

For the most part, this was a fabulous vacation.  The service we received was outstanding.  We went in not expecting much and left extremely impressed.  Most of the people we encountered went out of their way to make our stay special.  Valeria the club concierge was a excellent.  She was always so friendly and cheerful.  We would absolutely return to this resort.  

Also, I am a firm believer in tipping for good service.  I know it is not required, but my husband and I always try to tip well when we travel.  We never ordered drinks without tipping.  We tipped at every meal.  Even when the service was not up to our expectations, we left something.  Of course, we also took care of our butler and  housekeeping.  In most cases, a small tip made a huge difference in the service we received.  I could also see how much they appreciated it.  I am always amazed at the number of people I see who do not tip.  Try to keep in mind that a dollar or two may not be much for you, but it could really make a person's day.

reviews.author: David T
reviews.title: 11 days/ 10 nights in paradise at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
My wife and I are Melia club members.  We joined during the Fall of 2011 and this was our first time in Paradisus Cancun.   We are in our mid-40s, no children.  We went from Sunday, April 26 to Wednesday, May 6.  We used Tropical Incentives for a private airport transfer.
arrived at the resort around 4 p.m.  After checking in at the Club area, our butler told us about the 10 restaurants (6 of which needed reservations, 2 which were buffet style and didn't need reservations, and 2 of which were not part of the all inclusive package).  He then told us we could rent a bali bed by the pool or the beach.  They cost $10 per day for Club members ($50 for non-members).  You also got 2 lounge chairs with the bed. We chose to do one by the pool.  Our room was a one bedroom suite.  We had a gorgeous view of the beach from
our room.
Of any of the 4 trips that we have taken since becoming members, this place made us feel the most special.  They arranged a dinner for us on the beach.  This did not cost us anything extra.  We had never done that before (i tried doing that at another of their resorts last year for my wife's birthday, but there was a wedding on the beach that night).  4 course meal, a champagne toast and a bottle of wine.  When we got back to our room that night, they had rose petals leading from the bed to the soaking tub.

  Our butler also gave us a bag of chocolates one day and a bottle of tequila to take back home.  Things like this were part of creating a wonderful memory.  

The water at the beach was a beautiful turquoise color.  We did spend more time at the pool than at the beach.  Both were within a 5 minute walk of our room.  
Our butler brought us to the pool concierge on our first full day.  The first bali bed that we were given was pool side, but not with the view of the beach.  They were going to give us a better view the next day, but a couple did not show up to the pool on their final day, so he gave us their bali bed.  The service at the pool was wonderful.  We had lunch at the pool most days, there is a Sunset Grill which they got us food from.  Both my wife and I are above average drinkers for our ages and we certainly had our fair share of drinks at the pool.
I learned years ago that on all inclusives, that the more you tip, the better service you will get. (can say the same anywhere I guess).  

I wore dockers and a polo shirt for most dinners.  I was over dressed as it is pretty casual.
We tried 7 of the 10 restaurants.  one was closed the day we had chosen.  2 of the ones that we liked the best we went to 2 nights.  we had the beach dinner the other night
-  mole - Mexican restaurant.  Best service of any restaurant.  Very good food as well. we went there twice
-  Fuego - Latin food.  so-so
- Bana - Japanese food.  mostly sushi.  if you like sushi, it's a very good place
with very good service
- Perla - steak and pasta.  Pasta was great. The steak was so-so
- vento.  Tapas.  2nd favorite place.  Great food, good service
- Market Grille - brazilian rodizio - good food.  but it was rushed. 
- Naos.  That was the buffet dinner.  We had already been there several times for breakfast and once for lunch by the time we went there for dinner.  So we could have skipped it for dinner.

- There were  shows every night at the avenue bar.  We only went once.  That's because there was very little seating available.  The show we did see was good, but neither
 of us had the desire to stand 45 minutes to an hour for each show.

The avenue bar is open to midnight.  We went several times.  nice atmosphere and probably the most packed of the bars.

There was a tequila bar in the Agave restaurant (that was the one restaurant we missed as it was closed the last few days).  We went there once and it was nice. It closed at 11.

The Red Lounge was a club that was open until 2 a.m.  We went there a few times.  Clubs are not my thing nor my wife's, but we had a nice time.  Though my wife was laughing at the amount of smoke from the smoke machine.

Toji was another bar, but we didn't go to it.  It was open to 11

The Agave restaurant became a snack bar from midnight until 5 a.m., every night.  We went a few times.  Burgers, nachos, hot dogs and desserts.  Service was good.
We did a wine tasting one day.  The sommlir was as knowledgable as any wine tasting we have ever been to ( we have been to Tuscany and Napa). That was a pleasant surprise.

These are the people that made our visit extra special

Sofonia - pool server
Jose - pool concierge
Bladimir - club butler.  Can't say enough about hom, he was very good
Francisco - server at the snack bar
Oscar - waiter at mole.  Mole was closed the last few days we were there and Oscar was helping out at Vento and he was good there as well
Iran - the sommelier at the wine tasting
Miguel - pool server
Ulyses - pool server
Octavio - waiter the night we had dinner on the beach
Miguel - waiter at Bana
Martin - waiter at La Perla for dinner and Naos for lunch
Irving - waiter at Mole
Valeria - club conceirge.  My wife lost her iPad.  Valeria was able to find it by going through security.

Overall, we had a great time.  We will definitely be going back in the next year or two.

reviews.author: Manny O
reviews.title: Looking forward to retrurning!
reviews.text: This was our first time staying at this hotel but we are big fans of Paradisus as we have stayed in others around the world. The Royal Service check-in/check-out process was quick and easy. Our Mayordomo was helpful in getting us reservations to "Fuego" which was a great dining experience. Our room had an exquisite view of the ocean that I will always remember. The"Palapas" restaurant at the Royal Service Pool deck great ambiance food and you could smoke. The ceviche, guacamole, mil hojas and fish were delicious. Our waiter provided us with special super spicy salsa. The restaurant provided a beautiful view of the ocean. The main pool bar was staffed by very friendly hosts who made sure our cups were always full

reviews.author: Katie  Chris J
reviews.title: Best Hotel in Cancun
reviews.text: Beginning last November we went for week to Cancun and OMG how happy we was that we choose that brilliant hotel , could not pick any better , spoiled by choice of restaurant, food delicious especially in market grill u can't ask for better steak and selection of it , every morning buffet for a breakfast spoiled by choice of food , delicious and fresh . Evening ohhh well u can do a lot or just chill outside in the bar have a drink or two or maybe three and enjoy sound of crushing waves..and then start another day with a spectacular view from the balcony and have a fab day in Paradise Hotel :)

reviews.author: swmyoungson
reviews.title: A week to see the Sun
reviews.text: We stayed at this hotel for a week in March. We enjoyed the atmosphere, the room was very good view over the pool and sea. extremely comfortable. The choice of restaurants very good although we used the main one most times. The quality and choice of food was very good and waiters excellent especially one Alejandro Parra who always made our meal a pleasure. All the staff were very helpful and always happy. we would definitely go again.

reviews.author: Claudia M
reviews.title: Paradisus the best
reviews.text: This was my first trip to Cancun,Mexico the purpose of my trip was for a family wedding . All I can say that my stay at the Paradisus was excellent from the monent we arrived at the resort until we c/o . I want to recognize Luis,Marcos,Carlos for the best customer service.

reviews.author: josephmX4713HA
reviews.title: No Pinot Grigio and no seats on the balcony
reviews.text: The hotel was very clean and the service was great!!! But I would not come back because there were no seats on the balcony and the 24 hour room service did not give champagne or wine when you ordered it. Also the house wine was Chardonnay and if you wanted something else you were given a wine list and the prices on that list were higher the New York prices!! So an $8 Pinot Grigio was offered for $60 and in my opinion that's not all inclusive.  Also, I've been to many hotels with 24 hour room service and when they say 24 hour room service that means food, wine, champagne etc...

reviews.author: Jenna L
reviews.title: depends what you are looking for....
reviews.text:
After having stayed a many (smaller) resorts, my sisters and I decided we would give a bigger resort a try, to see how it compared; we all agreed, smaller is, without a doubt, better.
I'll start from the beginning...
Checking in....we stood in the lobby for almost an hour before we were helped and able to complete our check in process. The other resorts we stayed at immediately seat you, and bring you a drink....not this one, and nor did the others take this long.

We upgraded to the Royal service, which means you get the promise of a bali bed for 2 days of your stay, a butler and the Royals dont have to share their pool, nor their side of the beach with the non-royal service. We saw our butler upon check-in, and after that, we felt like he avoided us, never made contact with us again. The bali bed situation, although we were told 2 days, we were unable to reserve a bed for any of the 5 days we were there, as they were already spoken for. It was nice having our own pool/side of the beach, the other side was extremely crowded.

We saw room service ONE day of the 5....ONE...

If you call for anything to be brought to your room, grab a book and plan on waiting at least 45 minutes

Avoid Mole (for dinner) no beuno

All we planned on doing this trip was laying at the beach and reading our books...relaxing, this place was good for that. If you would like to do anything, have entertainment...look elsewhere. Even the "free watersports" that are included with your stay were lacking...nightly entertainment was non-existent. I am not talking club scene, Im talking something to do after you eat dinner besides go straight to your room...

As far as checking out, we had to take our own luggage down to the lobby, which is not usual for all-inclusive resorts.

Overall, although the building is nice (although huge, and difficult to navigate) there is something to be said for the smaller resorts. I compared the resort to a buffet..the more people you have to serve, the lower quality you provide, and that was definitely true of Paradisus.

Also, if you depend on an elevator, seek another location...or plan on waiting for an elevator most of your stay

reviews.author: Quest564856
reviews.title: Wonderful short stay
reviews.text: We spent two nights and three days at the Paradisus Cancun after a week traveling around the Yucatan visiting mayan ruins, charming towns, and wonderful beaches throughout the Peninsula.  We didn't know what to expect, except that we thought it would likely be over the top, and perhaps a little tacky,  but relaxing.  It was relaxing, for sure but it was also elegant, friendly, easy going, and the food everywhere was, to our surprise, absolutely delicious.  Its amazing that such a large place can maintain such a high level of service both by the staff, the food, the beach, really every aspect.  Well done, Paradisus staff!

reviews.author: Adry R
reviews.title: Very nice and luxurious hotel, not with good food
reviews.text: It is a great hotel. A nice relaxing atmosphere in the center of the hotel near the lobby with beautiful natural green plants hanging from the top of the building. It has it's own beach with beds to lie down and chill. Every restaurant has it's own luxurious theme which is really nice, comfortable and in most of the places cozy. The only thing I would complain is the food, it was not so bad, but I was expecting more considering the fact that we were staying at one of the best hotels in Cancun. In my opinion the food wasn't tasty or delicious, it was just a meal and that was all.

reviews.author: Wander Luster
reviews.title: Nice relaxing couples vacation
reviews.text: My wife and I plus 3 other couples stayed at The Paradisus for 5 nights in April. Everybody had a great time. We paid extra for the adults only Royal Service which is in a private part of the resort. It included our own pool, private cabanas, premium restaurants, and a butler. Every restaurant we tried was fabulous. The buffet offered many types of food and drinks. Our room was quiet and comfortable, however, our friends complained of noises that sounded like furniture being dragged across the floor above them. The only disturbance we heard was at 6:00 am every morning we could hear plates being banged together. I assumed it was the staff setting up the breakfast area on the first floor. The beds were very comfortable. The mini fridge was re-stocked every day with water, fruit juice, soda and beer. They even left us a bottle of tequila one night. The pool was a little warm for my taste as the temperature outside was in the high 80's with about 98% humidity. I come from a place that has dry heat so the ocean was a better place to cool off. There were red flags every day at the beach meaning the surf was too rough for surfing or swimming but going out waist deep was fine. The only complaint I have about the pool was that it closed every night around 7:00 pm. The night entertainment was pretty lacking, too. They had a few dancing shows but nothing spectacular. Every other night they had a live band on the beach which was nice. I really though this was going to be a total raging party place but it wasn't. It was a nice relaxing vacation and I would definitely go again.

reviews.author: Heatbake
reviews.title: Best Relaxing trip ever!
reviews.text:
We were worried as we always stay at ME but this was an amazing trip. We stayed the Royal service, WORTH IT! Hector- AMAZING- took care of our reservations, was always available, we had a few tiny issues but nothing major that couldnt be fixed.
The FOOD HERE IS AMAZING!!!!
we have stayed at many all -inclusives, but by far t he best restaurants ever. the sushi restaurant, SO GOOD! make sure to go!! 
We went over to the regular pool to go to swim up bar, you can tell the difference in the two areas. 
The royal service is the way to go.
HOWEVER
it is really quiet. We are not poeple that want chaos, but maybe a little music at the pool would be nice!
Service: BEYOND! everyone is so willing to go to the extra mile. If you tip - you will be treated like a queen.
Will definitely go back next year- hopefully with friends to have more on an atmosphere.

GO HERE If you want a quiet get- a-way. If you want a fun filled day and night, this is not the spot for you. 

Thank you Hector! when we come back we will be asking for you! made our trip so special!!

reviews.author: Academyroots
reviews.title: Wedding + 29 Family
reviews.text:
We just returned from having our destination wedding at the Paradisus Cancun.  I will start off by saying that the hotel and property are STUNNINGLY BEAUTIFUL!  The location is perfect and the water is even prettier than any photo we saw of it before going.  

We had never been to Cancun so it was a big order to bring 31 people down for our wedding.  We didn't know what to expect and had a lot of reservations.  We usually travel and vacation - warm weather - in Aruba or St. Martin.

We did the Royal Service Adults Only and for the most party, I would recommend it.  I will say that we were not happy to find them pouring rail vodka in our drinks when we had requested absolute.  They advertise upgraded premium bar but we caught them pouring the lower shelf vodka when they thought we were not looking.  Not okay.  Our butler was very sweet but spread thin.  They oversee several rooms.  It's a bit tricky to get dinner reservations so the second you get in- line them up.  Cabanas are free with Royal Service so I suggest booking them every day -- it was our favorite part to lay in there and break from the sun.  They are the best cabanas we have ever been in!

For weddings, the location is a dream.  It is beautiful, clean, and the perfect - and more affordable - destination!

I did get sick from something (maybe the ice cubes as I was even brushing my teeth with bottled water) so that has left me not wanting to return to Cancun in general but overall- I would recommend this hotel.  It is pure bliss!

reviews.author: Selim B
reviews.title: The place you don't want to miss !
reviews.text: Fantastic experience at this hotel ! It's my 3rd time in Cancun, and this hotel is what attracts me to always come back here ! Fully recommended .. and staff will always be there to help you and make you feel like you've always belonged there.

reviews.author: Paul N
reviews.title: Great Staff
reviews.text:
I would like to compliment the staff at the Paradisus Cancun.  From Sergio, the Chief Concierge, who made our stay special to Leticia who kept us well stocked with endless cold drinks poolside.  The staff at Tempo, Ignacio Fernanda, Fares, Carlos and Chef Ismael created one the most memorable dining experiences.

My wife, daughter and I have stayed at the Paradisus twice and we have had a fabulous time.  We'll be back.

reviews.author: Ali S
reviews.title: Wonderful family vacation
reviews.text:
We just returned from our family vacation, this was our first time at the Paradisus Cancun resort, it was a beautiful hotel, very clean and the beach was spectacular!  The food was good and the wait staff were very friendly, especially our waiters at the Nois buffet, Guadencio was exceptional and by far the best most attentive caring waiter we have met, he went out of his way to seat and take care of our family of 10 everyday.  He truly enjoys his job and is very passionate about making your vacation and meal experience the best it can be.  He went above and beyond everyday, Pacual and Kauil were also very attentive and nice.

Rooms:  The rooms were nice and the cleaning staff were very good, Alberto was exceptional and went above and beyond to make us feel comfortable and attend to anything we needed for our room.  We did not get our room right away and had to wait a long time for it to be ready.....he made it well worth the wait!

The only complaint I have is that the music was lacking near the pool swim up bar as well as pool activities and games.  The music only played for a short amount of time each day and the remainder of the day we heard nothing but hammering/pounding from the workers maintaining the property.  We also complained several times and asked that they turn the music back on but management never honored our request.  Several others complained as well and nothing was ever done.  This was the first resort we stayed at that had very little music playing and no pool games and or activities, this was very disappointing!!!!!

Bar staff:  They were all very nice, Enrique and Salvatore did an exceptional job bartending and served the best drinks, they were true professionals and made our days/evenings so enjoyable...I wish all the bar tenders were as knowledgeable and fun as they were.

I would definitely return again if they improved the music at the swim up bars and also added some theme nights during the week, that is the only thing the resort lacked.

reviews.author: Sherrisse A
reviews.title: Best holiday so far. Really a paradise
reviews.text: Stayed here for 10 days with my partner after i booked it for him as a surprise birthday gift which he loved, best holiday so far. This hotel is an amazing hotel located right on the beach. I would recommend the royal service option for a better experience. You get a personal butler who can be contacted easily. We were supposed to get a complimentary mobile to contact our butler at our convenience but never received it. Our butler was Hervik he was absolutely amazing and went the extra mile for everything. The hotel is in a good location with a very regular bus service which takes you down town. The hotel has amazing selections of restaurants to suit everyones taste. All the hotel staff friendly and always ready to help. Staff never ask for tips but they do deserve them so always give. Aquaworld is right across the street offering loads of different water activities. The hotel has ocean views or lagoon views both lovely. From the ocean you can see the sun rise and from the lagoon the sun set. The hotel has a spa attached which is also amazing and offer a range of treatments. With royal service you have a mini bar that is restocked daily. Room service which is included at no extra cost and 4 bottles of liquor which is also at no extra cost. The royal service has it own pool where your get bali beds and its own restaurant is also attached. The unlimited alcohol and food is a bonus because you can never get hungry or thirsty. I recommend tasting all the different cocktails on offer, the hotel serves premium brand alcohol none of which is watered down. Hotel is immaculately clean and has an amazing aroma to it. The staff always address you appropriately and they are always well presented. Both myself and my partner really enjoyed this trip and we will be coming back soon. The only down fall to this hotel is that there are loads of stairs to walk up to get to the entrance. You will lose a few pounds doing this. The hotel has free wifi with royal service which spreads to all areas of the hotel including the beach and even across the street.

reviews.author: Tony B
reviews.title: Super Service
reviews.text:
I stayed at Paradisus for one week with my son - the resort is beautiful! The huge "lobby" is very peaceful, and the plants, and colors at night are breathtaking. We stayed in building 3, and the singers/instrumentalists doing their thing were real treats in the evening. The pools were awesome, and the beach was great. I wish I could have the views from Coco's bar every day.
While the resort is beautiful, and well kept, the best part about our stay were the employees working hard to please us every day. The Market Grill was our favorite restaurant, and we had great service from Rody, Karla, Efrain and Armando. They wore their shoes our trying to keep my son fed, and did so with a smile. The next time we visited (because it's sooo good), we were served by Abraham and Andree - they too really kept up the great service.
Salvador was serving up cervesa in Coco's with a smile and small talk.
If you try Naos for the terrific buffet at breakfast, sit outside and say 'hi' to Juan, Tomas & Serefando. Carlos at Vento took great care of my son when he ate there. My son insisted we say 'good by' to Carlos before we left.
All of the restaurants were serving up delicious food. Try not to miss the burgers/dogs/chicken by the pool in the afternoon, and swim up to the bar for tasty Miami Vice.
A great resort, with plenty of activities close by to get out and enjoy. You won't believe your eyes when you step into the lobby - very memorable, relaxed, and had a great stay.

reviews.author: klundberg01
reviews.title: Best Vacation Ever
reviews.text:
This is a little late but I had such an amazing time at the Paradisus Cancun that I felt guilty that I didn't do this review before.  My husband and I booked the Paradisus Cancun Royal Service for a week in mid-November 2014.  We travel to all-inclusive resorts 3-4 times a year for so we have an idea of what to expect.  The Paradisus blew away all of our expectations.  

Letitia greeted us warmly and helped us through the check in process.  She was so friendly and helpful throughout the entire week.  She even helped us check-in for our return flight.

Our Royal Service butler, Leyner, was great.  He checked in with us every day, reserved our bali bed days, and even had a hot bubble bath with rose petals waiting after a long excursion day.  He told us the next day that he tried to guess what time we would be getting back and made the bath water extra hot so that it would still be warm when I got back.  It was perfect!  He also found out that my husband likes to try different beers so one day he had our refridgerator stocked with each kind of canned beer offered at the resort.

The guys around the Royal Service pool were great.  Edier always made a point to find us and make sure that we had everything we needed. It was the most relaxing trip that I've ever had because I didn't have to worry about anything.

We enjoyed the trip so much I recommended the Paradisus to a friend for a trip in December and she loved it too.  So when it was time to book our next vacation I knew that we wouldn't be happy anywhere else. Can't wait to get back.

reviews.author: drmikedpm
reviews.title: A relaxing time together just my wife and I away from the kids.
reviews.text: The views of the beach from the hotel and from the beach itself were wonderful.  The service very good, however a lot of tipping the staff was necessary.  The best restaurant we went to was the Naos buffet.  Fuego was the second best.  The other restaurants did not have very good food.  There are some other restaurants that are not included in the all inclusive and we didn't try them.  The internet is spotty and works sometimes and then doesn't others.  We took two excursions from the hotel and there are several travel agencies with offices in the hotel.  Orlando, vincente and guerrero were the best servers in the Naos restaurant, I highly recommended sitting at their table when going.

reviews.author: ChrisAG01
reviews.title: Family Vacation in Paradise
reviews.text: We traveled together with another family totaling 7 of us including 3 children. The accommodations, the pools and the beach were excellent.  The sandy beaches with the cool Cancun breezes were the best.   However, it was the service and friendly faces from the staff which make this resort truly top notch. Special thank you to Kauil and David at Naos in the morning, Louis and Carlos by the pool, Hector by the beach, Jose for ensuring our cabana was perfect everyday, and lastly Iran the Wine Sommelier.  We will definitely travel back to this wonderful resort

reviews.author: Keri C
reviews.title: The most relaxing trip I have ever had
reviews.text:
I stayed at this resort from April 17-April 24 with 3 of my friends. This trip was by far the best trip I have ever had. I booked the trip about 2 months in advance on Expedia and at that time I decided to splurge and upgrade to royal service. If you want to relax and enjoy your trip this is the way to go. Coming from New york we needed to escape from the cold and what better way then to an all inclusive resort?

We arrived at the hotel around 11am and were immediately whisked away to a special royal service lounge. The first thing you noticed is the amazing ambiance of the hotel and the aromatherapy smell. Checking in was quick and painless, we all were greeted with a drink and friendly smiles. Since we arrived so early I was not expecting us to get a room until after 3pm, however we were able to get 1 room so we were able to change and start planning our day. We met our butler Sergio and were given a phone to call or text him with our needs. If you can request your butler I highly recommend him, he was AMAZING! We were also surprised the phone would last so long without ever being charged… but it worked! *Side note, the hotel has an expedia office onsite. You can go there to book your excursions and if you booked your trip through expedia they will be able to help you with your return transportation back to the airport.*

Since we stayed so long we were able to eat at every restaurant for dinner including Tempo. You will leave this resort gaining a few pounds, the food was great everywhere we went. We gave Sergio a list of the restaurants and what day we wanted to eat there on the second day so we never had a problem with having a reservation. 

We want to give thanks to everybody we encountered at this resort but most importantly the royal service pool concierge staff. We spent all of our time outside and Daniel and Cesar really went out of their way to make sure we had everything we needed and that we were happy. The Bali beds were amazing!!!!

Overall I would give this trip a 10 out of 10. The nightlife was a little sparse but we came to relax so this didn't bother us. I think if there is anything the hotel could improve on it would be more events at night outside. We can't wait to come back and we highly recommend this hotel to our friends and family. Thank you for the best week of my life.

reviews.author: EllenfromCA
reviews.title: Really had a great time!
reviews.text: Stayed a week back in July 2014 with 21 family members.  We had 5 rooms in the main tower, all on same hallway.  View was beautiful.  Everyone was so nice, waiters, bartenders, maids alike.  We really enjoyed our stay and really don't have any complaints.  Vento was the best add-on restaurant, and the best bartender was Luis Cortez at the swim up bar in the smaller pool.  I would definitely come here again.  Why not 5 stars?  They didn't have salmon at the breakfast buffet, but sometimes they would 'find' some if you asked.  But they should have it available for guests, not just those who ask.  Still I had a wonderful, relaxing time!

reviews.author: anthony0305RI
reviews.title: A week in paradise
reviews.text:
Myself and five friends stayed at The Paradisus Resort Cancún this past week and ate at each of the all-inclusive restaurants on the resort. Our most memorable experience dining on the resort was our incredible waiter, Gaudencio. Gaudencio made us feel like we were at home (even 3,000 miles away from home) and was one of the most attentive, caring waiters we've ever had. Thank you again Gaudencio for making us feel at home and for making our first stay in Cancún such a wonderful experience. See you soon!

Also: special thanks to Kauil who was an incredible waiter as well. Kauil was always ready to place a napkin on your lap, refill your drink, or tell a funny joke to make the table laugh. Kauil in the few times dining with you, it was an absolute pleasure! (You and Gaudencio are the DREAM TEAM)!

reviews.author: brian w
reviews.title: Beach waiters
reviews.text: Amazing service all week!  Victor, Enrique and sofonia took great care of us.  I can't wait to come back next year. I hope all the beach waiters are still there. I have been coming to This hotel for20 years and this time was the best beach experience ever

reviews.author: lizzie u
reviews.title: Properly looked after!
reviews.text: We travelled to Cancun in April, I should probably say we are Melia vacation club members.  We received outstanding levels of service from all the staff, the Mexicans are lovely lovely people and do hospitality brilliantly.  We were royally looked after by the beautiful Claudia in the Melia lounge, she organised everything for us and nothing was too much trouble, including getting me a kettle!  She was ably supported by Bladimir, our butler.  We were lucky enough to find Juan and Raphael on our first morning in the excellent buffet, and made sure we were sat in their section, they were outstanding!  Juan organised a fillet steak special one lunchtime as a surprise, delicious!  These two are an absolute credit to the hotel.  Our room was a gigantic suite and although a little dated it suited us perfectly and was very well serviced throughout our stay.  We ate in all the restaurants and agreed that the food was excellent without exception. Tempo, the fine dining restuarant was right up there with one of the best meals ever, our waiter, Miguel was superb.  The Royal Service pool area overlooking the ocean is the best way to spend the day, our pool boys, Daniel and Omar did a great job of looking after us as did the busy waiters.  All in all a truly super holiday and we would definitely go back.  A big thank you to all the staff who looked after us.

reviews.author: John M
reviews.title: Stay away from the "Time Share" pitch!!!!
reviews.text:
Things to avoid.
Don't talk to anyone at the airport regarding excursions, they want to have you show up for their "Time Share" pitch!!!!!!! 
The hotel will want you to schedule your departure time the SAME DAY you get there, DON'T!!!! The goal, is to get you SUCKERED into giving them 90 minutes of your vacation time to learn about a "Time Share" and offer you excursions in return.  Your 90 minutes turns into 3-4 hours. 
Schedule your departure the day before you leave, takes about 5 minutes.
If you purchase the shuttle option to and from the airport, DON'T! Make sure it is to the hotel only! The hotel will want to drop you off 3 hours early for your departing flight, we made it through customs and to our gate in 46 minutes!!! Take a cab to the airport when departing, it will save you time.
They drop you off hours early so you will shop and eat. NORMALLY, airport food is not overly expensive. Cancun's airport IS the exception! 2 hamburgers, fries and 2 drinks at Johnny Rockets ran us $35+ US!!!!!!!!!! ONE SLICE of Domino's pizza $12(Example).  We have been outside the US multiple times, never have we witnessed food/product prices this high. Eat before you leave.
We have stayed at multiple Sandals Resorts which are All Inclusive, we have never been approached or enticed to spend more money. Pathetic. 
We chose ALL INCLUSIVE for a reason, to enjoy a hassle free vacation, not what we experienced. 
   Positive note
Great hotel over all. Good service, great beach, beautiful ocean front.
Most of the hotel staff deserves a A+, thank you.

reviews.author: Rick Plant
reviews.title: Paradise on earth and Gluten free friendly resort
reviews.text:
We just came back from a seven days’ vacation at the Paradisus Cancun Royal section. The services where exceptional and this was truly a five stars vacation.

The beach, the resort layout, the restaurants and the personnel where all very pleasant to enjoy from the morning to the end of the day. The team at the Paradisus are always there to please you and meet any needs you may have. 
My wife as severe intolerance to Gluten and everybody was very knowledgeable about what was OK for her to eat and what was not. We have travel to many resorts in the past, and this resort was the most gluten free friendly we have found so far. 

All restaurants clearly indicated what is gluten free or not. The staff are very knowledgeable about the intolerance and always offer to prepare a dish of our choice if the menu was not acceptable. Fresh Gluten-free bread at all time…
One suggestion: It would be very nice at the buffet if the dishes that are gluten free would be identified.

My wife was treated like a queen, and we did have a fantastic vacation.

A special tank you to Victor Perez and Valeria at the beach for their super beach service, Vicente Guerrero Perez for his exceptional breakfast services every morning and Efrain at the market Grill. Our Butler Hervick was also very helpful and made sure daily that we were very satisfied with the level of service received.

Everyone at the resort did an exceptional job at making sure we would have an exceptional stay.

The ocean view room was perfect; the bed was comfortable, always many towels; the fridge was always full with what you wanted, no humidity problems, great AC, etc.

Will we go back? You bet we are going back!

Congratulation Melia and the Paradisus team!

reviews.author: DmRN15
reviews.title: Great Hotel! Toped our expectations!
reviews.text:
The Paradisus is the only place to stay in Cancun!!! We did the Royal Service which is a must for any couple!!!! You have your own personal butler who sets all your dinner reservations and reservations for the INCLUDED Bali beds!! La Palapa is private for royal service guests only, great breakfast and lunch with a view! You also van order food from here while you're in the Bali beds! All cocktails were amazing!!! You walk down to your private lobby where appetizers and fancy meats, cheeses, and breads are served! You even have your own private bar where you can grab a drink or make a cocktail with top shelf liquor anytime! Tipping in U.S. Dollars is a must!! This hotel was the best and made our trip even better and more relaxing. Royal service is the way to go! Our butler, Hervik, was top of the line!! He surprised us one night with the hotel filled with rose petals, bubble bath, champagne, and a swan made of towels on the bed! He was always attentive and so nice! We will defentintly be back to Paradisus in Cancun!! 

Cons: food was a little slow at some of the restaurants, a couple waiters were not the nicest, the 65$ coral/gold braclet I bought broke the minute I got home :(

reviews.author: mvanderhill61111
reviews.title: Great Resort for a Beach Escape!
reviews.text:
My husband and I had a great vacation at the Paradisus Cancun in April 2015! We are in our 20s and wanted a place to sit and relax on the beach for the week. The resort is huge but offered great service. We were greeted with a damp scented towel (which was kind of funny but nice) :). We got right into our room that overlooked the lagoon. I would not spend the extra money for an ocean view room, because the sunsets are beautiful over the lagoon.

The food was wonderful! I've been to other all-inclusives in the Caribbean and this food was much better than some of those places. There were plenty of restaurants to choose from, and even the buffet was good. We loved Blue Agave which served authentic tacos, guacamole, etc. The Market Grill was also great for dinner, a Brazilian steakhouse. The Sunset grill out by the pool was awesome for lunch (nachos, burgers, wings, etc). The service was great everywhere! I also thought it was nice that waiters would come down to the beach to take drink orders and bring water.

Before we arrived, I emailed a reservations representative and requested to stay in Pyramid 4. From other reviews, I saw that this was a quieter pyramid (and to stay away from Pyramid 5 which is the main one that has a night club). He said that he would make a note on our reservation. However, when we arrived, the front desk did not have that note and they were not able to accommodate. In fact, we were put on the 5th floor in Pyramid 5, and definitely could hear the nightclub until about 2am each night which was frustrating. (We used earplugs and slept fine). The resort also seemed to be fairly empty during our week so I was unsure why they couldn't accommodate the request. It didn't put a dent in our vacation though! The room was beautiful, the bed was comfortable, shower and bathroom were very clean.

We also met Alberto who worked in housekeeping. He found out that we were celebrating our anniversary and did everything he could to make our stay special! He brought lawn chairs up for our patio (no rooms have furniture on the patios), he drew a bath for us one night and made a swan arrangement on our bed with towels and rose petals. :) On our last night, he came to the room and gave us a "special gift" of a carved Mayan mask and a Paradisus pen. He was so sweet and definitely went over the top to make it special for us.

We are not the "partier" types, so we didn't go out to the clubs and bars at night. There really wasn't much to do at the hotel in the evenings, so we usually stayed on the beach later and made dinner reservations later. There was a short entertainment bit each night but it was over by 9pm. It would have been nice to have at least one big show or some activity in the evenings.

Overall, we were very please with this resort! The service was excellent, and the rooms were very, very nice! The food was great. It wasn't an over-the-top luxury hotel, but had more of a Mexican feel to it which I liked. I would definitely recommend staying here!

reviews.author: Samantha S
reviews.title: The Paradisus doesn't disappoint-- again!
reviews.text:
My boyfriend and I had a fabulous time at the Paradisus Cancun last year, so we decided to return again... Our friends warned us by saying that since our expectations were so high, there was a chance we would be disappointed the second time around.  Well, they couldn't have been more WRONG!!!

We upgraded to Royal Service again and had the same butler, Juan (more on him later!).  The resort is still beautifully maintained and expertly cleaned.  There were plenty of chairs available both along the gorgeous pools and the spectacular beach.  The food at the restaurants was delicious, especially for resort standards. Our favorite restaurants were the Market Grill and Mole.  (Shoutout to our new friends at Market Grill-- Rody, Karla, Benito, Jose, and Jaime! They gave us great customer service at the Market Grill and made the experience that much more enjoyable.) 

Besides the fact that the resort is beautiful, clean, and has great food, the best part is by far the service.  Everyone from the waiters to the butlers to the front desk staff is professional and they all go out of their way to help in any way they can.  For example, when offered desert at Fuego, my boyfriend asked if there were any chocolate options.  The waiter replied no, so we ordered something else and thought nothing else of it...but within 5 minutes our waiter returned to our table with a slice of chocolate cake from the buffet for him! Furthermore, all of the waiters for the Bali Beds were extremely helpful in recommending new drinks, food options, and stopped by often to ask us of there was anything else we needed.  Whenever we said thank you, their response was always, "It's a pleasure!" It's that type of over-the-top, anything-you-need service that really separates good resorts from great ones.  

Back to Juan...Juan is unbelievable and took such good care of us, including a few surprises! Rose petals sprinkled around the room with a warm bubble bath waiting for me after a day at the beach? Yes please!!! Juan was also so personable, and we had some great conversations with him about music, his family, and our life in Boston.  He even helped my boyfriend plan a romantic candlelit dinner for two on the beach for our last night! He's just fantastic.

The bottom line is, the Paradisus will not disappoint! We've now had TWO perfect vacations there, and we will without a doubt be back for a third!!!

reviews.author: Tiza H
reviews.title: Top notch resort
reviews.text: Paradisus cancun is THE place to stay at. Everything about this place is excellent. Royal service is the way to go. Exclusive access to lounges, pools, and restaurants, enhanced service for guests like having your own butler and priority booking for restaurants and pool/beach cabanas are just the surface of what the royal service offers guests. Hotel is very clean, staff is friendly, and everything over all is very organized and we'll thought out. Everywhere your go, this place even smells awesome! The good is top notch and gourmet to say the least. Their beach club- cocos is awesome. Laying out on a Bali bad all day enjoying a hookah was one of the highlights of our vacation. Booking an excursion, even to Isla mujeres like we did, was easy and convenient. Once again, the staff is very friendly and helpful. Rooms are comfortable and very we'll decorated. Once again, royal service is the way to go if you prefer peace and quite, no kids, and an added touch of luxury and service. We did nothing but eat, drink, relax, and chill and enjoyed ourselves to the max. Paradisus cancun is the best resort to stay at while in cancan. Excellently located being quite close to the airport, and still right on the beautiful beach. Their portion of the beach is clean, and beautiful. Definitely stay here and you will enjoy as much as we did. Oh, and definitely get a room with ocean view. Trust me!!!

reviews.author: Foodieallstar
reviews.title: Honey moon May 26-Jun3
reviews.text:
My husband and I upgraded our room at the Paradisus to a one bedroom suite in the royal service tower. Best decision ever! Our butler, Hector, is always available to help us when we needed him! He has been awesome! He gave us a phone to contact him whenever necessary. We read some reviews that the butlers were not helpful but we did not find this to be the case. He is not going to call you multiple times throughout the day to check up on you but if you see him around or call him he is always there to help immediately. The waiters by the pool are so kind and so attentive. Eddie was by far the best although all of them are very friendly.  Every worker on this resort is so friendly and helpful. There is not one person without a smile. Food 
Has been amazing so far all the restaurants have been excellent our favorite so far would have to be Vento followed by Blue Agave ,Market Grill , Fuego.. Bana and Mole we will try in the next couple days.  We absolutely love Paradisus and would definitely come back...! Glad we still have 3 more days.!

reviews.author: Nico C
reviews.title: Paraíso - fantastic hotel with superb service
reviews.text:
This hotel was one of the best I have ever stayed at. I couldn't fault anything - from the superb range of food offered at its wide selection of restaurants with impeccable service (sushi, Mediterranean tapas, Italian, a wide range of authentic Mexican flavours - our favourite was Mole where Sonia was a superb host) through to the first class service from every single member of staff at the hotel. 

Our butler Sergio was attentive and organised everything for us during our stay, while round the pool Francisco and the rest of his team were fantastic, with the bar providing great cocktails all day long.

The facilities were also first class with an amazing private beach, great spa and entertainment. 

I would recommend this hotel to anybody looking at the 5 star hotels in Cancun, although I havnt stayed at others I can certainly say you won't be disappointed if you choose this place!

reviews.author: Dr. TaMara Rose
reviews.title: Great Experience!!!!
reviews.text:
I usually DO NOT write reviews but I just had to write one for the Paradisus because it has been such an amazing experience so far.......

My husband and I and a group of our friends are staying at the Paradisus for our honeymoon. First let me just say that the Paradisus is a very beautiful resort! The photos online do not do it justice! The hotel was breathtaking and smelled great. I could not have imagined a more beautiful hotel! 

Upon check in, we received royal service! Our host was very gracious. The check in process went very smoothly. Since we arrived early, our rooms were not ready so we were escorted to the LA Palapa restaurant for lunch. The manager, Carlos was absolutely phenomenal! He accommodated us in every way! One of the members in our group had an allergy to plastic, so the staff made sure to accommodate her by giving her a glass throughout the entire trip without her needing to ask or remind them. 

After lunch our rooms were ready. We were escorted to our rooms by our butler Sergio. Sergio was Amazing!! He made sure we had everything we needed! He was awesome! The room was so beautiful and the view was amazing! We had a royal service deluxe junior suite ocean view room. Our bed was decorated with Rose petals. We also had a bottle of champagne and chocolates. Our rooms have been spotless everyday! They have been customized to meet our desires! Royal service is definitely the way to go!!! 

The only challenge we had so far is that we had to wait about 3 hours for our luggage and we did not receive our complimentary cellphone until today, when we had to ask for it. However, the manager was very accommodating.  Again, out butler Sergio was extremely helpful with EVERYTHING!!!!!!! We loved him!!!!

Coco Beach private beach area was beautiful!! Diego, Jorge, and Jonathan took very good care of us! The DJ played great music and the food was good. Omar at the poolside also took very good care of us as well! The wait staff kept the drinks flowing all day and night long.

As far as the food, Blue Agave was our favorite restaurant by far! Market Grill and LaPalapa were great too! I definitely recommend trying the shrimp wontons at LaPalapa! Bans restaurant was delicious if you like sushi. Haven't had a chance yet to try the other restaurants but I am sure they are just as delicious. 

Overall, the experience was totally amazing so far!!! The hotel is beautiful and very clean. The staff works extremely hard to maintain the hotel, to please and accommodate guest needs.  I would definitely give the Paradisus and 5 out of 5 stars, even with the small challenges we had. I will most definitely be back next year and I have even left this trip yet. :)

reviews.author: Eduardo M
reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text:
We have nothing but good comments about the resort. We have stayed at various "adults only" properties in the Mayan Riviera and this is by far one of the best adults only services we have ever had. The staff of the royal area (Cesar, Chely, Galindo and Victor) went above and beyond to make our stay memorable. 
The food was outstanding! Starting for the most extensive breakfast Buffett we've experienced, every breakfast the juice station (Zoila) would prepare our special fruit smoothie with our selection of ingredients.
