The staff in the area of the Vento restaurant for breakfast (Jose Luis) always kept our table clean and our cups full.
The waiters in the royal pool and beach areas (Francisco and Edier) were always there and assuring they would keep us satisfied at all times. And the service from the restaurants mole (Angel and Sonia) and Bana (Roberto) was more than exceptional. The Chefs at the Palapa, Vento, Mole and Bana restaurants were more than willing to please the most exquisite demands.
We would definitively go back to this resort and recommend it!!!
Thank you Paradisus Cancun!!!

reviews.author: Brittanyy521
reviews.title: Best trip ever!
reviews.text: I just got back from the Paradisus in Cancun and it was fantastic! The hotel is gorgeous, clean, smells wonderful and has a friendly and helpful staff. The ocean view was unbelievable, the beach was clean and the staff was always bringing out more drinks to you either by the pool or on the beach. The restaurants were very pretty - I enjoyed Vento, Fuego and Bana the best. I would go back in a heart beat and highly recommend this resort!

reviews.author: Tracey G
reviews.title: Staff
reviews.text: I just got back from spending a week at the Paradisus resort in Cancun.   It is a beautiful resort but what made the stay a great experience was the staff.  The pool wait staff, particularly Laura and Juan Queno and Keith Lopez who all attended to our every need and were always friendly and helpful.    The activity staff Roderic Garciamoreno and Nester Fernandez were always friendly and accommodating and brought lots of fun energy to the pool area.   I would definitely revisit this resort due to the great staff they have there.

reviews.author: tripinMay
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text:
We just returned from a five-night stay at Paradisus. Our reception was a bit confusing and we waited in the main lobby check-in for a bit before someone came and took us to Royal Service. We had upgraded to the Royal Service at the time of booking and then upgraded to ocean-view room at the time of check-in. When we were settled in our room, we ordered room service, as most of the restaurants were closed around 9pm. 

Beach/Pools: We primarily stayed in the Royal Service area, but my girls did go to the swim-up bar once. We were lucky to get a bali bed for most of four days. As others have mentioned, it can be very difficult to get the bali bed, so plan ahead, and reserve, if possible. The beach and pools were kept very clean- even the bathroom located near the beach. The food and service poolside and at La Palapa, the beach restaurant, were exceptional. Tip the servers, who literally run to provide impeccable service, accordingly. 

Room: Recommend ocean front, Royal Service, third floor or higher for a good view. Royal Service is the way to go! The shower was fabulous and the well-stocked fridge impressive.
We did have some issues with amenities not provided: had to request turn-down service 4 of the 5 nights, no options for pillows, etc. and other services as promised.

Butler: While our butler, Eric, met us and showed us to our room, we never heard from him again, except in passing in the halls, etc. He was pleasant, but there was no phone and since it would have required an extra step to contact him, we simply made all of our reservations for restaurants, activities and bali bed ourselves. Melissa, on the other hand, went out of her way to help us a number of times. Advice: if the butler is nowhere to be found, just call down to the concierge desk and they will take care of you.

Restaurants: Mole, Vento, Market Grill...all wonderful! The food presentation in all restaurants and Royal Service lounge was impressive. The service was outstanding and the mariachi band at Mole was one of the best I have heard! 

The resort can be difficult to navigate and there was suppose to have been a tour included with Royal Service. The only map we found was on the room key holder and it was helpful. 

In short, the Royal Service upgrade will provide you with a quiet, calm environment and some amenities. It appears that the butler service may be hit-or-miss, depending on who you get. However, many others, such as Melissa, will pick up the slack. We found that some issues were directly linked to lack of communication: in less than 5 minutes, we were told we could have a late-check out, then we were told we couldn't, then we could, then they would call us......all by different individuals working the concierge desk. 

"Hotel Credits" of $550 were a joke: most stated "one per person per stay". For example, there were no less than six spa "credits" with $10 off of $200 massage, with each stating "one per person per stay". The gift shop refused to honor the $10 credit without $100 purchase, not stated on credit sheet. Don't bother....

Enjoy the water and the beach- which are perfect and more beautiful than can be believed.

reviews.author: Pearl S
reviews.title: This trip was our 4th to the Gran Melia/Pardisus in Cancun.  Enjoyed our visit.
reviews.text:
Enjoyed our stay with one exception - bali beds only available for 2 days due to the fact
that the Red Level was completely booked.     Our butler took care of making reservations
at the various dining rooms - made it a lot easier than booking them ourselves.

reviews.author: Norris D
reviews.title: Resort was great, just one minor thing.
reviews.text: Check in was nice. We arrived early and our room was not ready as expected and this fine because check in was at 3pm. However they took our bags and locked them up and checked us in except for our room key which they said to come back at 3 and we did and they were ready. When we got in our rooms the staff came with our bags within 5 minutes. While we waited to get our room key we were given our bracelets and told to enjoy lunch and tour the property if we wanted so we did that and i have no complaints. If you arrive early and expect to get a room you set yourself up for disappointment, if you get a room before check in time its a major plus. only gripe was the pool goes from 3.2 ft to 5.9 ft to 5.01 ft to 6 ft. That is an awful design. If you cannot swim this will be uncomfortable for you. The pool is HUGE so plenty of space. Golf was fun and they do have clubs for rent for lefties! Food was good not amazing and you have lots of options with all the different restaurants. Had an oceanfront room on 7 floor so the view was spectacular. Went during a holiday weekend and although the place was booked almost to capacity I did not once feel it was overcrowded. This resort is massive, clean, great staff, great beach, and good food...I will be going back.

reviews.author: 512Kelly
reviews.title: Why its not rated higher I don't know?!
reviews.text: We left a not so great (couldn't wait to get out of there) resort Fiesta American Condesa which is next door to come to Paradisus Cancun.  It was WONDERFUL.  My husband and I have a 2 year old and can be very picky with where we stay.  It was absolutely wonderful.  After reading pages and pages of reviews we unfortunately picked the wrong resort originally (Trip Advisor reviews don't make any sense to me) but glad we ended up here.  It was great for kids.  If you go spend the extra for the concierge service.  This resort really made our vacation.  Service was great, beach was beautiful, resort is large so lots to walk around and see, they have lots of kids stuff not mentioned online which was a nice surprise.  The kid pool is truly a kid pool.  No drunk idiots near by.  A better class of people at this resort then the previous one we were at by far.  We had an ocean front room and it was lovely.  Food was great, lots to choose from.  The Adults section is what feels like miles away from the kids pool which is nice.  So if you have kids all of the families are together.  We will for sure go back.

reviews.author: Jakeosaurus
reviews.title: Truly a great vacation destination
reviews.text:
My Fiancé and I stayed at Paradisus from May 17 -23rd. We had read hundreds of reviews on expedia and tripadvisor prior to our travel and were both excited and nervous about the things we have read. First and foremost, we were absolutely blown away by the resort, amenities, and service. I would highly suggest the Royal Service for the private pool, pool-side restaurant, and beach drink and food service. Here are some of our take-aways from various parts of the resort.

Room – as stated above, we paid for the royal service. Upon check in we were put into the deluxe jr. lagoon view suite that we booked. This room was 2nd floor, and faced the 4th pyramid which means it faced the resort and there was a lagoon view to your right when looking off the balcony. Immediately upon check-in, the woman helping us said there would be the possibility to change rooms on day 2. On day 2 we were switched to a deluxe lagoon view room which had an additional bench and a few more square feet of living space. Overall the rooms were great. I had no complaints about the bed, but that is obviously totally dependent on your preferences. We had no problems getting wi-fi in either of the rooms we were in(2nd and 5th floors) in the royal service area.

Restaurants – The restaurants were something we were very nervous about after having read many reviews. Seems to be either you love it, or hate it. I’ve come to the conclusion that the people who hate it probably eat at the buffet far too much. We had no problems getting reservations at any of the restaurants we wanted to go to. Simply tell the royal service desk what restaurant you’d like to eat at a day or two in advance as well as your room number and last name and your reservation was taken care of. Bana is absolutely amazing. While my fiancé is a sushi person, I had tried sushi only about 5 times in my life prior to our stay at Paradisus. It was my favorite restaurant by far. The teriyaki, yakifornia, and fried sea bass rolls were all very good and I would also suggest the calamari rings. Also, the spicy mayo is out of this world. Market Grill was our 2nd favorite restaurant. Here you will order appetizers and sides, but no entrée. The entrée  consists of skewers of meat which will be brought around to your table periodically. I love this concept because it allows you to try all the kinds of meat. The BBQ chicken was very good, and the most creative was the bacon wrapped turkey. Vento was likely our next favorite and this consists of Spanish style Tapas. The plates are small, so when the waiter says “order 6 things” you really should. I can’t remember what I all had here, but I did try octopus which was surprisingly good, even though we could still see the suction cups on the tentacles. We were not overly impressed by Mole, I would just say it was “good”. Blue Agave is more of an authentic Mexican style taco place. This was good, and was a fast dining experience. Naos is the buffet….not much to say here, it is your run of the mill buffet. We went here for breakfast 2-3 times until we realized that another restaurant served breakfast. La Palapa is a Royal Service only restaurant that is on the other side of the pool side bar. This restaurant opens at 7am and provides a beach view dining experience(the seating is outdoors). This restaurant was also our go-to for on the beach guacamole and chips during the day, and even lunch a few times. Everything was very good. The pool-side snacks near La Perla was a good thing to pig out on for lunch one day. They had Hot Dogs, Nachos, Burgers, personal size Pizzas, and chicken wings. As a side note, the juices(orange, pineapple, etc) are very fresh and delicious throughout the resort, on the other hand deserts are not quite a sweet as we would have them in the United States.

The Beach - Very white sand and little to no sea weed. Even if there was a few strands of sea weed the resort staff raked it 3 times that I saw during our stay. The beach was a little breezy but this kept us comfortable when there were no clouds. The ocean had good waves which always made the afternoon ocean dip more fun. The waves are probably too much for smaller children. The locals selling items on the beach were harmless. One wave of the hand or a “no gracias” and they will leave you alone and move on. Plenty of cigars for purchase as well as knock off sunglasses(comes by early to midafternoon), sombreros, jewelry, sea shells, and the excursion/para-sailling sales people will be by too. 

Service - We received excellent service everywhere we went. When the beach was busy on a few occasions we did have to wait 20ish minutes for a drink to be brought out, but I can hardly complain about somebody bringing a drink to my beach chair. If you happen to see Alberto at any of the bars, he had only been studying English for 2 months as of the date of our stay, but he is a great bartender. Be sure to ask him about special drinks he makes(Zombie, Bob Marley, Scorpions Mole). His mojitos with extra mint and lime are also very good. Fernando, who is one of the servers at the La Palapa restaurant is great. He took good care of us and if the drinks did take a little longer, he would bring you two of whatever you ordered. The restaurant service is very good, and the servers seem overly nice. I will say that the steaks were a little under-done, as I ordered medium-well and the steaks were more on the medium side, but they were still very good and this is just me being picky. 

Pool areas – I can only speak to the Royal Service pool area as we didn’t even go into the pools that the rest of the resort has access to. The pools are not heated, but the air temperature ensures that they are comfortable. The pools are open from 8am-7pm. I thought I would dislike that they closed at 7pm but I was worn out from being outside all day by the time 7pm rolled around so this was not an issue. The “Bali” beds are free to Royal Service guests, but make sure you get your reservation in a few days ahead as there is a long list of them. If you want a “Bali” bed and don’t have one reserved, I would suggest waiting until noon and then asking the pool concierge if there were any “no-shows” for guests who did have reservations. If you don’t get a Bali bed, the grass covered umbrellas on the beach are first come-first serve. We typically headed out to the beach about 8am and were the first ones out there. Plenty of people came down to get a beach grass umbrella from the pool concierge and then left towels there to save their spot until later. 

Overall our trip was amazing and we are already planning a return trip. I will say a few things about the resort’s workers. They work extremely hard, speak up about what you want and they will do anything within reason to accommodate. If you want more chocolate in the mini fridge in your room, leave the maids a note and a few extra dollars. Being able to speak Spanish goes a long way. My fiancé is quite fluent in Spanish and this did wonders for us. The workers regularly spoke to her in Spanish and carried out conversations with her. Prior to our stay I was astonished when I read reviews where people complained that some of the workers couldn’t speak English very well….you’re in a foreign country, what do you expect? Also, talking louder and more clearly in English won’t help a non-English speaking person understand you any better, saw this more than once from other guests.

If I had to complain about something, and this is me being very picky, it would be that drinks aren’t really available until 10am. There are a few beers in the mini fridge in your room, but the pool-side bar and Royal Service self-serve bar aren’t available until 10 and 11am respectively. I know it’s an irregular thing to complain about, but us travelers from Wisconsin like Whiskey earlier in the day than most.

reviews.author: uvafan1515
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text:
My wife and I just got back from our honeymoon at Paradisus Cancun, we stayed 6 nights May 19-26th.  As soon as we pulled up we were greeted and the lady asked for our names.  Saw we purchased the Royal Service and quickly took us to tower 5 where Royal Service is located.  We were greeted with champagne and had a personal check in which lasted less than 10 minutes.  We were told our room was ready and after they issued us a personal cell phone to contact our butler whenever needed our butler (Sergio) took us to our room.  The room is much larger than I expected and plenty big for a couple.  You get more than enough pillows and towels.  They aslo supply you with a beach bag to use during your stay.  

I will just highlight the trip.

Rooms -   Spacious, very comfortable beds, if you're royal service you get to chose aromatherapy scented pillows....TAKE ADVANTAGE!

Pools -  I read on here how you wouldn't get a chair after 7am here....Not true, atleast for the duration of our stay.  The first morning we went down at 8:30 and reserved chairs before breakfast.  Every other day we realized it wasn't needed and had no problem getting a chair at 10am.  We spent one day at the main pool with the swim up bar, the rest we spent at the Royal service pool.  The Paradisus has servers who come around and bring you drinks/food whenever you want it.  A couple dollar tip here and there and they were bringing me buckets of beer and fresh ice ever 30 minutes.  The tip wasn't neccessary to get the service but these guys were busting their butts so I wanted to reward them.  I want to thank Miguel, Diego, and Oscar for making it so much fun around the pool and taking care of us.

Beach -  Clean, wide, and beautiful.  Plenty of chairs.  The ocean is a little rough, but I enjoyed it.

Restaurants - You've probably looked into the resort so you know what all they have to offer.  Our favorite restaurant is Bana, which is sushi.  Absolutely delicous!  Close 2nd was Market Grill, endless amounts of all kinds of different meats.  Mole was not good at all, we left mole and went to Blue Agave which is like a taco/quesidlilla joint which does not require reservations....Delicous!  Our surprise restaurant was Fuego....We didn't think we would really like it but figured we would try it and man we were glad we did.  Our waiter told us before we ordered that portions are small so order several.  The food here is exploding with flavor.

Wifi is free at the resort, and it is great everywhere except our room.   It was impossible to access the internet in the room but not really a big deal.

My one complaint about the resort, and it is minor is the nightly entertainment.  They do have a show each night, and from the one we saw it's good.  The problem is the location it's at is small and compact which makes it hard to see.  Other than the show, they have the "Red Lounge" which is their night club but there was never really anything going on there.

If you are in between Royal Service or not, let me suggest go for it!  Our butlers Sergio, and Melissa went above and beyond service.  US Air sent our bag to Boston instead of Cancun and Melissa called every two hours to track our bag and get it to Cancun, we did not have to worry about it.  I wanted a bottle of absolut vodka for my room, hour later Sergio had it there with a personal note.

Speaking of alcohol...The beer they have is Tecate, Tecate Light, Dos Equis, Heinekin, and Corona all in cans. Dos Equis on tap.  ALL the liqour is top shelf, Absolut and stoli vodka, crown royal, captain morgan, bacardi rum, 1800 tequila.

I could go on all day about the resort and I know I am forgetting a lot but this sums it up.  Enjoy the Paradisus, we can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: Eliza W
reviews.title: Wonderful week in paradise!
reviews.text:
We just returned from Paradisus Cancun, where we got married and honeymooned for 7 nights. 
First of all, I cannot express how pleased we were with our wedding. We got the Wish package which was free of charge with a 7 night stay in Royal Service and with four guests or less. It included a ceremony, cake, bouquet, boutonnière and champagne toast. Honestly, I was expecting something super quick and basic, which was pretty much what we had in mind. But no, it was fabulous! Lourdes, the wedding coordinator, was so sweet and efficient, she organized everything perfectly, brought me a breathtaking bouquet and escorted me out to the amazing gazebo overlooking the Caribbean where my family and my future husband were waiting. It was like a dream. The pastor who married us was wonderful, everything he said was touching and it was the best moment of my life. Thank you Lourdes for making us all so happy!

As for the vacation itself:
Our room was Lagoon view, which at first we wanted to upgrade to ocean front, but we stayed in the room very little and the view is still beautiful. Great room, great bathroom! Loved the shower.

The resort is enormous but easy to find your way around, although my dad got lost a few times haha. It's so beautiful and smells great ( each building different aromatherapy scent) The royal service area is so relaxing with a pour it yourself bar and fresh snacks out all day. My husband loved the salami. Nothing better than grabbing a beer or a glass of wine whenever you want. 

The pool in royal service was fantastic. Such great service, constantly asking what you needed whether you were laying out or swimming. The electric lemonades were so tasty. Special thanks to Edrian (Eddie) at the royal service pool who gave us the best service I have ever gotten pretty much anywhere. He was so gracious, funny, great at his job and we never wanted for anything. He deserves a promotion! 

The beach is gorgeous. The prettiest beach any of us have ever been to. Turquoise water and white sand. While lying on the beach under the umbrellas was so nice, Bali beds by the pool were the best part of the trip. So relaxing, huge, luxurious. We actually got one for 3 days although they are hard to come by. The Bali beds are like gold, everybody wants one all the time.  I recommend planning out your days before you go so you can secure a Bali bed on the days you plan to stay by the pool or beach. If you wait to get one the day of, you probably won't be able to, and you will be very jealous of the people in the Bali beds, I promise. 

This resort is big on reservations, so like I said, plan it out. We are the type to go with the flow, but when we wanted dinner at one of the more sought after restaurants on our second night we couldn't get in and had to go to La Perla, which is not bad, but service was very  slow and our waiters got into an argument in front of us. It wasn't a good dinner, over all. However, Mole was good, Vento was great (perfect service by Leo) and Bana was exceptional (Manuel was our waiter, fantastic), try the Thai soup and seaweed salad. Can't stop thinking about it! Yum! Also, Blue Agave was consistently great, and the buffet was too. I loved the green juice! So much to choose from and the donut style fritters were amazing one afternoon. 

When it comes to butler service we were disappointed. If we needed our butler we usually couldn't find  him or he wasn't there, he didn't make the reservations for dinner or our Bali bed although he said he did, we had to go to the royal service concierge for pretty much everything but thank you Melissa for taking care of any problems.  If our butler had checked up on us or followed thru throughout the week he would've gotten a major tip from us, but he was no where to be found pretty much ever. However, we had a rose petal covered room with chocolate strawberries and champagne on our wedding night and that was a great touch. Not sure if that was the resort or the butler, but thank you! My point is the butler should come to us, at least once a day, and that would've changed our opinion completely. We also didn't have a butler phone so maybe that made a difference. 

As for excursions, we found out quickly that it's very safe to take the bus or walk across the street to Aquaworld to get a better price than what the resort charges. We took the jungle tour at Aquaworld and it was fun, especially driving the boats so fast! However snorkeling was in pretty choppy water and it freaked me out after a while. We took a trip to Isla Mujeres for very little and it was great! Less than a dollar for a speedy bus ride, $20 round trip ferry for 2, and $45 for a fun golf cart to cruise around the island. It was a great time. 

Also, walk across the street if you need medicine or sunscreen, the market store is crazy expensive. Pretty ridiculous that I paid $19 for a bottle of pepto bismol there, and like 30 pesos across the street ($2). Lots of rich food and drink will do that to you haha. 

All in all, the best trip I have ever been on and the best resort I have had the privilege to stay at. See you next year Paradisus for our first anniversary!

reviews.author: 414jennat
reviews.title: Great Family Vacation
reviews.text:
Great vacation!  This was my fourth time traveling to Mexico (have been to secrets maroma & the royal in playa recently).  This was our first family trip so finding a nice luxury resort for families is tough but I think this resort really caters to families.  We travelled as a family with our 14 month old son and with another couple.  We had the ocean view one bedroom family concierge suite in the main pyramid.  If you have a baby and don't want to tip-toe around after they to to bed this suite worked well because it separates the bedroom from a living room area with a door and there are 2 nice sized balconies over looking the beautiful ocean.  Just a warning though the main lobby does get a little loud at night, but it didn't bother our baby or us.  The room was clean and comfortable.  The mini-fridge was stocked daily, however we had a difficult time getting them to stock plain milk for our baby the first day as they kept bringing us chocolate milk, but we told our butler and he had it stocked up right away.  At night they bring cookies for the kids, which is cute.
Our Butler (Hervick) was fabulous and he was extremely helpful with anything we needed.  They give you a cell phone that u can call him on.  He made our dinner reservations and we never had any issues, however you do need to make the reservations at least 1-2 days in advance so plan out your restaurants on your first day and just make all the reservations then and be done.  Our favorite restaurants were the market grill, Vento (tapas) and Bana (sushi restaurant).  If we went back we would only eat at these restaurants and the buffet.  We didn't try Fuego so I don't know how that one is because we ate at Vento twice since we loved it.  Blue agave and Mole were just ok.  Only issue we ran into at all the restaurants is that I ended up having to leave at 7:30 to put our son to bed and they don't let you bring the dessert or anything from the buffet upstairs.  Which for most people isn't a big deal because the can order room service but we couldn't order room service since baby was asleep and we didn't want them knocking or ringing loud doorbell.  One time my husband tried to bring me a piece of cake from dinner since I had to leave and really wanted it, but they blocked him coming out and told him to sit in buffet and eat it even though he explained he didn't want it himself.  I guess its a rule, but oh well not that big of a deal but also unnecessary rule I think.
Family Concierge Lounge is nice and has a pool table & video games for older kids plus an espresso machine and a help yourself premium liquor bar which we used to get coffee with Bailey's several times.  We rented a Bali bed by the pool for 2 of our days which was very nice and stays cool under the shade.  During our stay we used the kids play room twice a day so our son could get out of the sun for a bit and play.  It's a nice clean room with some toys (balls, mr potatoe head, barbies), they also had a blow up bouncy house for bigger kids.  A lot of activities for older kids that seemed nice.  The lobby is beautiful and there is a coy fish pond our son enjoyed feeding the fish.  One small negative that didn't really bother us much but bothered others is the lobby is hot/humid and the Asian restaurant Bana is right in the lobby so we were pretty warm & sweaty while we ate.  Other reviewers complained of a mildew smell in lobby but to us it smelled like strong incense burning.  The elevators smelled a little, but that was it.
The beach was great.  Water was pretty choppy but perfect temperature and beautiful blue.  Volleyball was fun daily.  The kiddie pool area was great for our son.  The pool bar bartenders (Julien & Rafael) were fantastic!  They would memorize your drink order and make it before we'd even ask!  Next to the pool they had a grill with hotdogs, hamburgers, nachos, and mini pizzas that we usually would snack at for lunch (wasnt the best but ok), if you want better food go to buffet at lunch.  
Overall, excellent trip!  Great resort!

reviews.author: sher ann n
reviews.title: Family fun
reviews.text: Our entire family (7adults & a 2 yr old)went to Paradisus Hotel Cancun. We were very impressed with the modern facility, great & friendly service. It was the best beach we've seen yet. Will recommend Fuego & Market Grill restaurants. Buffet doesn't have much food variety.

reviews.author: Nadie M
reviews.title: Awesome!
reviews.text: We wanted a relaxing couples vacation and that is what we got and more. We never had to wait or ask for a thing! We booked a cabana on the beach. It was the best! We had entertainment and food right there! We will be back!

reviews.author: Jen E
reviews.title: Paradisus is Luxury!
reviews.text:
Stayed May 17-23.  I booked through Beach Bum Vacations & dealt with Rachel.  She's pretty awesome!  She gave me options that really catered to the vacation I was looking for.  So I decided on Paradisus.  Had some issues with Lomas transportation transfers after arriving at the airport but it was in no way a Beach Bum error.  And I was communicating w/ Rachel via email dealing with it all & she was on top of it.  She literally kept me from worrying about anything during this trip.  I'll be booking w/ her next year for sure.  Very knowledgable.  

I upgraded to the Royal Service b/c this was an anniversary trip-NO KIDS-& Royal Service is adults only, seperate pyramid at the hotel, seperate pool, the works.  Totally worth it & we got some extra perks also.  

Room was great, spacious, nice size bathroom, bed was uber comfortable.  Pillows were a little soft but they gave us tons.  We had a view of the lagoon & caught some nice evening views.  Check in was a special section & was really fast.  Our room wasn't ready but they held our bags & we just toured the hotel.  It's pretty big.  

The beach is gorgeous.  Waves were pretty intense but it was fairly windy during the visit.  The hotel literally has someone out cleaning the beach every morning.  I NEVER saw seaweed or trash.  Pools were never ending at the hotel.  Adults only pool is great if you want some quietness.  Music played but relaxing, great service for drinks & food.  The Royal Service beach bartender Francisco is amazing!  He remembered our names the whole 7 days we were there & found us lounge chairs & shade every time we came to the beach.  He worked SOOO hard, bringing us food, drinks, water, etc.  Just always in great spirits.  

Bali beds are great by the pool & if you get the Royal Service, you get 2 free reservations.  Worth it!  They did mess up on one of our days we made a reservation for but Francisco to the rescue...got me a shaded area on the beach!

We ate at Bana (sushi) & it was my favorite, delicious & fresh sushi.  Vento was ok.  Small portions so order lots of items.  Blue Agave had some fabulous chicken stew enchiladas.  There are some bars & lounges if you want to hang out & drink at night.  We are more early risers so we opted to go to bed early but the main lobby was always lively after we finished dinner.  Shows seemed to be very popular.  The Royal Service buffet was good if you just want snack stuff.  Naos was the main buffet for breakfast & lunch.  Breakfast was great, huge variety of food from an omlette station to pancakes, fruit, breads, smoothie bar, etc.  Neverending options.  Lunch was ok at the buffet but we mostly ate at La Palapas.  Again, this is for the Royal Service only & may have a fee if you are not in that room category.  But they had about 10-12 lunch options & all were great, chicken wrap w/ sweet potato fries were my regular.  

Also, Market Grill for dinner was great, BBQ chicken was my favorite there & lots of meat options & sides were very fresh.

Gym was nice for a hotel gym.  It can get crowded in the mornings & it's kind of humid but the treadmills were state of the art.  Nice set of free weights that you don't normally see at a hotel gym.

One thing I noticed some reviews complaining about, the scents throughout the hotel.  I personally loved it & I felt like I was in a spa all the time.  But I love stuff like that & insence has never bothered me.  It was never overwhelming to me.  It just smelled fresh & clean 24-7.  The staff at this hotel are friendly but not overbearing & I appreciated that.  It was an anniversary trip & we just wanted to do our own thing & we were never hounded by people.  We snuck our way out of the whole time share thing & never got bothered by it after arriving.

That's about it, loved the whole vacation, hotel, beach, food, etc.  Just perfect & it was all due to Rachel at Beach Bum Vacation.  I heard about them from a review I read on Tripadvisor a year or 2 ago & so glad I went with them this time.

reviews.author: Genaro D
reviews.title: Wonderful Waters
reviews.text:
Went on a trip with my wife and friends in November and stayed at the Paradisus Cancun. Luckily I found a non all-inclusive option as I felt that was the best plan for my wife and I, and it was! The all-inclusive is a great option if you plan on not leaving the resort, but if you decide to go out and explore Cancun, it seems to be a bit of a waste of money and food. 

The resort was nice and the restaurants were great! The pricing was about the same as any other resort, no complaints here. They had specials on drinks at the beach, this was a pleasant surprise and made the beach experience even more enjoyable. The service was great and the staff was very friendly. I would visit again, if I have the option of hotel stay only.

reviews.author: Abel
reviews.title: Amazing property! Amazing time!
reviews.text: This was our first time in Mexico. The main driving force for choosing Cancun was our interest in visiting Chichen Itza (amazing historical site). We were a bit iffy about safety but once we arrived to the airport we were in paradise. Our travel agent booked us with Olympus Tours and they were great! Very friendly and welcoming. The drive to Paradisus was a smooth 15 minutes and all throughout Cancun the landscaping and environment was beautiful. Arriving at Paradisus we were amazed at how beautiful the property was. It was like being in the middle of the rain forest. We were with the Royal Service so they brought us to an exclusive area to check in with our butler to greet us! Our butler was Ibarra and he was so sweet and helpful. He made us feel special and taken care of. Thank you Ibarra for making our stay so memorable! All the restaurants were great with nice menu choices and ambiance. A special thank you to Octavio and Rafaelo at the beach and bali beds- they took care of us and made sure we had everything we needed. Fuego was our favorite restaurant- latin fusion. The food was amazing, the staff were quick, efficient, knowledgeable and friendly. The ambiance was nice and intimate. Overall amazing time. The rooms were well kept and clean. Mattress and size of the pillows were a bit uncomfortable. Nice bathroom amenities. The only thing we were not a big fan of was the room service. Food quality wasn't all there and it arrived cold. But there were enough restaurants for us to choose from to not have to order room service. We definitely recommend Paradisus!

reviews.author: Ieesha M
reviews.title: Very relaxing
reviews.text: Just got back from our 10 trip to Cancun.  We stayed at the Paradusis and it is a beautiful hotel.  This was my daughters graduation present.  We did not opted for the family or royal service because the hotel offers so much.  I'm sure its nice, but really didn't need it.  They employees are waiting on you continuously so by the end of the second day it felt like I've been there for weeks.  The complaints I had about the resort is that the main areas, elevators and hallways were not air conditioned, and our room air wasn't really working to its full potential.  Another problem was that the handle on our balcony was missing and when we closed the door it was very hard to open.  We were pushing the door with our hands to open and when it rained we had an inch of water in our room and we were on the 3rd floor.  We called the concierge but nothing happened.  We stayed in Pyramid 3  rooms 3306, 3305 which was nice, ocean-view and everything is right there.  We couldn't here the shows or the club downstairs. Most of the restaurants where pretty good our favorites were the Market Grill and Blue Agave.  The beaches and the pools were so nice.  At night they rake all the beaches and the water is so blue and just the right temp. LOVE IT!!! I was there every day.  Now about the beach chairs. I went in low season and i had no problem getting a chair in the morning.  The pool chairs do go quick, but i had no problems even though I did wake up at 6 every morning just to watch the sunrise and take a walk on the beach.  Just absolutely beautiful.  There is no need to go to the flea markets just go the the little shopping malls they definitely have better prices and more down to earth people not crooks like in the market. When we got off the plan you get greeted by time share people.  We actually got a fantastic deal just to sit through 2 hours.  We got for a family of 4 tickets to an all day all inclusive catamaran to Isla Mujeres  which was gorgeous and alot of fun.  An all day all inclusive to CHICHEN ITZA, great day but very long and this tour doesn't not go to the cenotes which i was sad, because that was something we all really wanted to do, and finally a 3 hour jungle tour with snorkeling.  It only costs us $220.00 Us dollars.  I was gonna book that online and i'm so glad i didn't save me over $1,000 dollars. It rained the last two days we were there so thats when we went shopping.  All in all the resort is very nice, and recommend it.

reviews.author: Jennifer W
reviews.title: Amazing Views
reviews.text: Although when I got to the hotel they could have offered more than "One" free ride from the airport for more than one person staying at the hotel. At first complicated due to the fact that I had to go to a different part of the hotel since it was a part of a "club" . The hotel overall was beautiful and picturesque! The bar by the pool was the best. Of course "all you can drink" the staff by the bar was AMAZING! The gym was great as well and the staff was just excellent. I lost a personal item and by  the end of the night it was found and left on my bed! The experience was worth it. Although we didn't do any excursions but go out to clubs at night (once) we stayed in the hotel the entire time.

reviews.author: GuilhermeGCASachetim
reviews.title: Highly recommend this Paradise!
reviews.text: My wife and I we had a very pleasant stay in this magnificent hotel Paradisus Cancún Resort, and we are very grateful for their hospitality, in special Sonia and Jesus from Mole Restaurant, and Rudy from Meliá. We highly recommend this hotel when staying in Cancún, Mexico.

reviews.author: Andrea M
reviews.title: Vento
reviews.text: Delicious! The tapas were beautifully prepared with a stunning presentation. I highly recommend and appreciate the personal attention.  Wonderful menu, fine ambiance and quality/amazing service! Thank you Iran, Ignacio, Victor, Violeta for a memorable and lovely evening. Bravissimo!

reviews.author: Yongmi B
reviews.title: Great experience with reasonable price.
reviews.text: I searched many other sites and compared price. This hotel offered best price, and had really good service. We really liked this hotel and will be back when we go Cacun again. All restaurants were good! Especially, we enjoyed the pool. It was very comfortable, and made us feel free.

reviews.author: Martha B
reviews.title: Best time ever!
reviews.text: Our stay in this hotel was awesome!  We had a great time relaxing and enjoying all the amenities the hotel offers. I had to mention the wonderful service we had in the restaurants. I want to  especially thank Tomás & Edgar at restaurant Naos because they went out of their way to serve us! Also Veronica at Bana restaurant & Guillermo, Gerardo, Giovani & Giovanna at Market Grill. And THANKS to the main chef (sorry, I forgot his name), he made us a delicious mexican treat!!!!! THANK YOU ALL FOR MAKING OUR STAY A WONDERFUL ONE!!

reviews.author: ilovesusielicious
reviews.title: Texas lady says its decent !
reviews.text:
I travel often to Caribbean & Mexico and stay at all inclusives.  I usually go cheaper and stay at Riu hotels..but we decided to spend a little more $$ and try something new.  This hotel has a GREAT BEACH and the hotel is clean and customer service is good. FREE WIFI with strong signal in the lobby and food areas.  Good for couples, families, singles.   

We stayed in Room 1401 and view was GREAT, but wi fi did not cooperate in bedroom...only the main areas of hotel.  There is NO SPORTS BAR ...but Marriott sports bar is literally next door within walking distance. (they had US sports on)

The buffet is  limited and I was a bit disappointed with the lack of options compared to other resorts I stayed at. The few options they had were good though- and they have several other restaurant options.

Location? Beach is perfect ...clubs & shops are NOT walking distance though. 

I HIGHLY RECOMMEND  the ISLA MUJERES catamaran tour. The vendor on beach charged us $50 each .. but it was worth it.  (includes snorkeling, booze, lunch, trip to the island Isla Mujeres)  ..bring extra CASH for $10 tax charge, shops, swim with sharks etc

Overall-- more good than bad.... I definitely recommend Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: Troy M
reviews.title: Best Bang for your Buck
reviews.text: Hotel Paradisus was clean, friendly and inviting. While the room was just above average (and looked nothing like the booking photos) it was well appointed and inviting. The staff was outstanding. Courteous and fabulous, ever attentive to your every need or concern. The quality of the food was fantastic, whether at the buffet or the many restaurants. The various swimming pools were a blast and service/drinks there were top notch. We definitely will return!

reviews.author: Bradkcrna
reviews.title: Great value, upscale amenities, over the top service
reviews.text: Great food, service and workers attitudes were the best. Room clean and comfortable. Our servers were Jose, Orlando, David,and Suzie ? One downside may be in the summer. The hotel common areas are not air-conditioned and will be quite warm in the summer- be advised. Room AC worked great.

reviews.author: LokiAbby
reviews.title: Great service!!!!
reviews.text:
We just returned from 9 days at the Paradisus Cancun. For reference we have stayed at the Playa del Carmen Paradisus and at several of the Riu resorts.  The Hotel is 20+ years old, so the rooms are getting a little dated and worn.  We stayed in the Royal Service (RS) section which gives you access to all the pools and restaurants, but also gives you a resort within a resort.

The service in the RS area was unbelievable.  Probably the best service we have had in all our trips to Mexico. Some noteable names of the people that looked after us are: Hector (RS butler), Rojelio and Octavio (poolside servers) and David, Omar, Mauricio and Alexander (pool concierges).  This group of employees made the trip what it was because of their attention to detail and their dedication to everyone in the RS area.

If you are looking for a livelier time then head to the main pool or to the Coco's section.  Once you have had enough then you can return to RS area and relax in your Bali bed.

Food and drinks are very subjective, so I won't spend a lot of time on it.  We didn't hear any complaints from the people we met over the time we were at the resort.

To Captain America and Tony Stark:

It was great to meet you and your spouses.

Canada and The Better Half of Canada

reviews.author: ilovevacations787
reviews.title: AMAZING-can't wait to return
reviews.text:
Let me first start off with this: this was our first all-inclusive trip in another country, and Paradisus Cancun set the bar incredibly high.

We recently returned from a glorious 7 night stay. We opted for Royal Service, and boy was it worth it. immediately upon our arrival, we were greeted by numerous people and given a tour of the hotel. Then, we were escorted to the Royal Service building for check-in. It was very intimate, probably the nicest check-in experience I have ever had. We then met our lovely butler, Juan. Boy, was he awesome. Throughout our stay he always made sure we had everything we needed-he was prompt in making reservations, bringing us aromatherapy pillows, ensuring we were comfortable in our room, and overall well taken care of. He was just a sweet heart and we really enjoyed conversation with him. One day, I was really craving some Oreos (random), and we couldn't find any in the hotel store. I asked Juan if they had any, and he said "let me see what I can do". When we returned to our room that afternoon, there were 2 packages of Oeros. My heart was happy-it was something so small, but he was so eager to help (all the time!).

The resort itself is absolutely beautiful. I really appreciated how clean everything felt-you constantly saw employees scrubbing hallways, windows, doors, etc. They do have aromatherapy throughout the hotel, and although I read some reviews that the smell was overpowering, we didn't mind it. It was actually pretty calming. The incense could have been a bit excessive, but definitely not a deal breaker. 

The service-OH, the service. We could not believe how helpful and friendly everyone was. Even passing an employee who was cleaning or rolling a housekeeping cart-each person would stop and greet you with a warm hello. We felt so welcome-all the time! Now I do have to give credit to some extraordinary employees. The first is Juan, our Royal Service butler who I mentioned already. The second is Carlos, the manager at La Palapa (the Royal Service poolside restaurant). Our very first day, right after check-in, we were seated to eat lunch at La Palapa. Carlos immediately approached our table and asked if we had just arrived. He then proceeded to tell us his role at the hotel and that if we need anything, no matter how small, to tell him. From that moment on, every time we saw Carlos, he would stop what he was doing to come greet us and ask what we had planned for the day, did we eat yet, how were things going. He was such a sweetheart and we simply adored his friendliness and service! Hands-down amazing. The third employee who really stood out was Gerardo Reyes, a Royal Service poolside waiter. Gerardo exhibited impeccable service during our pool visits by prompting serving us drinks-he never let our cups become empty! We were extremely impressed by his swiftness and sweet demeanor-you are truly blessed if you get him as a waiter! He was very quick with bringing out lunch to our bali bed, and picking the plates up when we had finished. On our last pool day, we had requested Gerardo but he was assigned to work inside that day. That afternoon, Gerardo stopped by our bali bed to say hello and that he was sorry he couldn't serve us that day, but hoped we had a great day! It was the sweetest thing...he truly has a kind heart. We just loved Gerardo, Carlos, and Juan. (I also need to mention that Javier was a wonderful pool server, and a quick shout-out to Natalie, a Royal Service concierge. She was quick to take care of us and greet us warmly each day!) Seriously, hands-down the BEST service we have ever experienced. I would return just for that.

The food...I had read a lot of mixed reviews, so I was a little unsure of what to expect. Our favorite restaurants: Bana (Japanese cusine-order the Thai Soup and Tempura Fried Sushi), La Palapa (Royal Service poolside restaurant for breakfast and dinner-try the chicken wrap, skirt steak, and the guacamole and pico are a MUST), and Naos (international buffet for breakfast lunch and dinner-we always found something tasty there! Also, room service was quick and yummy! Our least favorite restaurant was Vento-the portions were small, as it is a tapas restaurant, but it just wasn't our style. We liked Mole and especially enjoyed Mariachis, and Fuego was very tasty! Service at all restaurants was great. There are also 2 bars, one is more of a lounge and the other is a "disco" with a DJ. Made for great people watching! 

The room was very comfortable, I enjoyed the rainfall shower head and also appreciated the handheld shower. I really liked that everything was in marble-definitely a nice touch. We had a lagoon-view room which has nice views of the sunsets! The bed was very comfy, I am a picky sleeper and had no problems falling right to sleep.

The beach is absolutely breath-taking. Words cannot even describe. The water was a bit choppy but we still had a blast in the waves. We also had some professional pictures done by the hotel's contracted photographer, Adventure Photos, and they were absolutely terrific.

Overall, we had an incredible vacation. I was so sad to leave, but we are planning to return soon! Such a great resort, you cannot beat all that they have to offer.

reviews.author: Cestopier1
reviews.title: A superb all inclusive hotel
reviews.text: A superb all inclusive hotel, the food options are really vast, the courtesy if the personnel is incredible, and I would like to mention Mr. Sergio Legorreta, guest relationship's manager as some one who made our stay a great weekend, my congratulations

reviews.author: noe r
reviews.title: bana sushi restaurant
reviews.text: if you want to be treated like a star and get the best tasting sushi in cancun, please visit Bana, the staff here in this awesome resort are great and deserve a 5 diamond rating. thank you mr alejandro from bana rest. you made our last night a night to remember for a long time. your courtesy and enthusiasm made us feel loved and cared for. we will definately return and visit you all guys. thanks for the great work and for your dedication everybody. god bless you all.

reviews.author: Kelsey S
reviews.title: Incredible vacation!
reviews.text:
My friend and I just got back from a 10 day stay here and absolutely loved everything about it! The resort itself is beautiful, the food is all really good and  you can't get better staff anywhere else, especially when it comes to those in charge of all the activities going on like, Nestor, Magnolia, Arturo, Angel, Eduardo, Freddie and Roderic. They were always around making sure everyone was having a good time, they were a lot of fun! Later on if you go to the Avenue Bar, make sure you get a chance to meet Enrique and Israel, they are the best bartenders you could ask for and Enrique can do some awesome bar tricks. Carlos was great too!
Will most definitely be returning to Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: adonkinv
reviews.title: Unforgettable vacation!
reviews.text: I visited this resort with a friend of mine, and we stayed for 10 days. In all honesty, it was the most remarkable and unforgettable vacation I have ever taken! The staff, especially those in charge of the activities (Nestor, Arturo, Magnolia, Angel, Eduardo, Freddie, Rodrigo, etc) were phenomenal! Very friendly and attentive, there was never a moment where we weren't having a blast! Also at the avenue bar, definitely visit Israel and Enrique! They proved to be the best bartenders I've encountered in years! Overall the food was excellent and the property is incredible! The staff are so welcoming and kind; I am definitely returning with my family later this year!

reviews.author: Wade C
reviews.title: Great Resort, but food was NOT.
reviews.text:
My wife and I have stayed at this resort 3 times now - Most recently on May 7th, 2014. 

In our two previous stays the resort was named the Gran Melia..Not sure if it is now under different management, but the food used to be very good, and is now almost indedible.

Naos offered the best selection, but if not careful water would drip from the AC vents onto your plate... Which is known to be a cause of Legionnaires' disease. AVOID the Market Grill  -Meat is brought to the table on skewers, but this is NO Fogo De Chao. I could only try the beef...marinade was excellent and meat looked to be cooked to medium... but it was so tough I could not eat it..

There is a hidden buffet with Cheese Nachos, Hot Dogs, Chicken Wings and Brick Oven Pizza near the pool. I beleive it opened at 11:00. There are no signs.. If people were not walking by with plates full of wings we wouldn't have known it existed.

I will say that service was exceptional and we love the property. Rooms are nice and ocean view rooms are difinitley worth the added cost. 

In my opinion...If you have not been to Cancun...the Ocean and Beach at the Paradisus and most of the Hotel Zone is the possibly the nicest in the World. Sand is perfect and water is crystal clear.... My little girl thought the ocean was a giant swimming pool.

reviews.author: paperman99
reviews.title: Bestest trip ever!
reviews.text:
Yes, yes and yes...  Paradisus Cancun was awesome.  Royal Service is great and well worth a reasonable upgrade fee.  I believe we paid about $160 extra for the week.  La Palapa was excellent for breakfast and lunch.  The shrimp won tons are just incredible!  It was amazing how the pool in Royal Service was so quiet compared to the other areas.  As soon as you walked over to that side, the noise started.  Kids are great, even better when you can go to the other side and not hear them.  We ate at Vento, Fuego, Bana,  La Perla, Market Grille, Blue Agave and of course, the buffet.  We really liked Market Grille for lunch, you could order off the menu and still go in and pick something up at the buffet.  Our service there was great except for one day.  We ordered and still didn't get our meal 25 minutes later.  It was no problem, we just left and walked over to La Palapa and had a great meal in our Bali Bed.  It was a Bali picnic!  

As for the restaurants

Vento - Tapas.  Small portions, high quality

Blue Agave - not impressed the first time.  Really didn't understand the menu though.  Second time we really enjoyed it

Bana- Sushi.  Very good quality.  Walked out of here stuffed.  

La Perla - My least favorite.  They were out of filet so I had a strip.  It was about 8 oz, fatty and chewy.  Took us about 15 minutes to eat total and we then went to the bar...  

Fuego - Awesome dinner.  I had the Filet, Wife had the Sea Bass.  Seafood chowder was very good and the corn soup my wife had was great as well.

Market Grille - Excellent meats.  Sausage was out of this world.  The chimichurri sauce was so good, I have already made it at home.  Memory may be a little hazy on this one.  The wife deemed Wednesday tequila night and we had 6 shots before we had any food.  Great time!

Coco's was the bar we hung out at the most.  Keep in mind, they close from 6-7.  Great place to hang out after dinner.  Awesome view, nice breezes and great drinks.  Grey Goose was an up charge but they had plenty of other top shelf alcohol to choose from.   We also hit Avenue Bar and went into the Red Lounge a couple times.  We sat at the bar at Bana one night, that was a lot of fun.

Our butler was ok.  We saw him a few times but didn't really use him much.  For the most part, we just booked our reservations by hitting 0 and someone took care of it.  Not sure if it was our butler or someone else.  

Overall, this was the best time that we have ever had.  This was our first trip without our daughter.  I can't imagine that had anything to do with it!  Love her to death but we are 45 year old kids and we had a blast without our supervisor!  We met some great people....Running Tab and his family...the Ohicians..... the fine folks from Tennessee...the light guy from Philly, etc.  Just pull up a bar stool at Coco's or say hi to the people next to you on the beach.  It's amazing what a good Hello can do.

The ONLY real complaint is that damn aromatherapy they pump out.  I have to admit though, it never gave me a headache.  Normally stuff like that causes me some issues.  This was annoying, but not painful.

I have her about 95% talked into going again soon.  Going back to Paradisus is a given.  Going back this year is the only challenge.

reviews.author: HappytobeHome1001
reviews.title: Great Service - shame about the leaks!
reviews.text:
Just returned from a week here and cannot speak too highly about the level of service from the moment you get here. The food was great. Naos the Buffet Restaurant offers and excellant choice, I also enjoyed the Market Grill which gives an Argentine experience with various meats arriving on large skewers and Vento which has a Tapas theme. Loved the tropical theme in the main pyramid and the aromatherapy scents in the air. Quite the best stretch of white sand and generous pool area I have seen.

A few tips to fellow travellers. There is a convenience store called Oxxo across the street which is far cheaper for bits and pieces than the hotel's own shop which is very expensive. Also there is a small booth next to the store where you can book local trips much more cheaply than in the hotel.

I originally had booked a lagoon view room and was offered an upgrade to Ocean View for 60 USD per night which was well worth the money. We had a view on the 4th Floor and it was in the Central pyramid No 3 but just where it joins on to No 2 Pyramid. I would actually recomend this location on any of the floors if you want a quieter room but are still not too far from all of the major facilities. We overlooked the main pool and sometimes all we could hear was the waves on the sea shore.

A few draw backs - there is a lack of info about what is included on All inclusive. It does cover room service - look in the big white folder in the room and the English version of the room service menu is toward the back of the folder. Wi-fi is very fitful, even the hotel staff have problems with it. Always remember to book a day ahead for any specialty restaurants and learn when the Room Service comes to refill the mini fridge - with us early evening so that you can make sure you get what you want in it. Fresh milk for tea and coffee appears to only be available via room service or to purchase in the hotel shop. It would be nice if it were offered as an option in the mini fridge, many people don't want just beers and sodas. I found it very difficult also to get the fruit juice re-supplied.

The big problem with the hotel at present is water leaks and I'm sorry guys but it was leaking even on dry days. The air conditioners drip water and have done for some time as you can see from the black mould in places. Many corridors have towels and hazard triangles out where the water is dripping down from above. There are water stains down the pillars in the main atrium which look to have been there for some time. We found it impossible to get hangers to hang clothes in one half of our closet and so I improvised with a travel washline I had brought with me only to find that anything hung there was damp to the touch. I never thought I'd find myself being sorry for Time Share touts but the Club Melia Sales Reps are going to have a tough job selling a luxury lifestyle when the place is leaking all over. I think the metal framed windows maybe some 30 plus years old and the air conditioning need a serious up grade to bring this property up to spec. Also to really compete with the 4-5 star market you need to have an attention to detail with the furnishings in the room which is very tired - paint work needing an update, scratched  and broken furniture, bed valances with water stains and curtain rings that are rusted.

None of this spoiled my holiday and I would go to other Melia Resorts but people should be aware of the draw backs and as we're entering the wet season in Cancun it might be better to avoid this hotel until the drier weather.

reviews.author: Strictlybizz
reviews.title: One of the best in Cancun
reviews.text: My 3rd time to Cancun, 1st time staying at the Paradisus.  Excellent propertly, every single staff member was extremely attentive.  Rooms were very nice and very clean, all top shelf liquor in all restaurants and bars.  Every restaurant was great as well as the buffet.  My one and only coplaint was that all the warm food in the buffet was a bit cold.  Other than that, this is an amzing place, with amazing views, awesome restaurants, (Tempo is one of the best restaurants I have ever dined at, not included in the all inclusive) and wonderful staff!  I will definately stay at the Paradisus on my next trip.

reviews.author: Amandadale S
reviews.title: Girls Trip
reviews.text: Had a great time here for a weekend girls trip. All staff was so friendly, hotel was beautiful & clean. Rooms were roomy. Food was so so. Some better than others, but overall not bad. Eric our butler & Omar & Francisco at the poolwere great!!! Eden & Juan @ the swim up bar were so fun & kept the shots coming! Ask for a donkey semen shot (I know it sounds gross, but trust me on this!)

reviews.author: Margie C
reviews.title: Meh...
reviews.text: They really need to speed up their check in AND check out process, I have no idea what they were doing since there weren't many guests ahead of us plus they had more than enough staff. Pool servers were rude and inattentive. Restaurants were nice and clean but the food was awful.  Rooms are comfortable but they desperately need renovations (although I was under the impression that they had already renovated their rooms?)  On a positive note, the hotel is well maintained, clean, their best features are their pools and views. Beach area was clean. I love the courtyard/jungle-ey feel throughout the main pyramid.

reviews.author: shopaddict
reviews.title: great family vacation to cancun!
reviews.text:
we went with our kids as well my mother in law and sister in law who had their own room.  Our rooms were in the main building and had a nice view of the pools and beach.  we had paid extra for ocean view and they had not but they still got ocean view next door to us.  The hotel accidentally put us in a double bed room when we had requested a king bed room (which has a little more room to move around and sofa and coffee table).  we had nice patio which could sit out on.  They didnt refill bathroom amenities unless you requested it.  one day they didnt clean the room at all and we had to call them.  the young man that came did an excellent and thorough job.  We were at the resort over Easter weekend and the kids enjoyed the easter bunny and the scavenger hunt although as parents we didnt.  we thought it was too hot at 230pm to take the kids all over the entire resort and beach for over an hour.  The pool mustve had a lot of chemicals because one of our white swim rash guards turned green and even with washing and bleaching is still yellow looking and not white.  

the food in the restaraunts was great, but you have to make reservations the day before and the first couple days we forgot and had to eat in the buffet.  the food in the buffet is good but gets old because you eat there daily for breakfast and lunch too (not much more variety at dinner time).  There are tons of fruits and veggies and salad stuff though.  
The mediterranean restaurant Vento was amazing and wish couldve eaten here again.  Mole had mexican food that had an upscale twist with unusual items such as cactus, etc. but very good too.  both restaurants had great staff that helped us with vegetarian items on the menu!
Jesus, Rody and Sonia at Mole restaurant were awesome!
overall had a good time, and would come again.

reviews.author: 3travelbugs111
reviews.title: Best
reviews.text: I picked this resort for its Mayan temple theme..rather than staying at one of the american/european franchise. I am so glad I picked  it. It was the best room we ever had. If you plan to stay only at the resort then definitely pick this one..Ocean view is worth the extra money. Breakfast every morning at the beach view restaurant was the most memorable our family.Infact, now wherever  we go we compare it to this resort. The ocean view was beautiful. We went with my 2.5 years old. there is a convinience store and papajohns right across the street. There is a conviniece store inside the property as well. We didnt have all inclusive plan but next time we might try that. This resort has so much to offer that you need 2-3 days to fully enjoy the resort itself.

reviews.author: kflie83
reviews.title: Amazing resort. Even people staying in higher priced hotels were jealous!
reviews.text: We had a smaller vacation fund than normal for this trip, so we decided to give it a try. We were pleasantly surprised by how upscale it was when we walked in. The restaurants were great (except La Perla. Skip that one). The drinks didn't seem watered down at all. The room was gorgeous with an amazing view. We really couldn't have asked for a better hotel on our first trip to Cancun. We usually stay at a 5 star in Hawaii if that helps you figure out my view point. Every excursion we went on, we'd hear people saying how beautiful the hotel was. There were even a few couples that said that they were staying at much more expensive hotels that didn't look as good. Whoo hoo! My trip advisor detective skills definitely paid off on this one! We will be coming back again for sure!

reviews.author: etapngav
reviews.title: Cancun vacay
reviews.text: The Paradisus Hotel in Cancun is a beautiful resort.  We were a group of 6 travelers (3 rooms).  Our rooms were ready upon our arrival and were located next to one another.  We had a wonderful ocean view.  The pool and beach service was great.  Our only complaint (small) was that getting reservations for the restaurants was hard, if you call by 7:10 am, most reservations were already taken.  We were only able to get reservations on one night and were able to walk-in to one of the restaurants on another night. The "Red Lounge" played a great mix of songs and was a great place to hangout instead of the crowded (overcrowded) bars in town.  They had a beach night club on a Friday night that we really enjoyed.  "Dollar rent a car" kiosk at the hotel was great for the 2 days when we toured the area.  We drove to Tulum, Xcaret, and Playa del Carmen.

reviews.author: MHB1971
reviews.title: Beautiful location, needs remodeling and new HVAC
reviews.text: I spent 5 days at the Paradisus for a business meeting. The price was certainly great for an all inclusive stay. However, food options are extremely limited if you have any dietary restrictions (e.g., gluten-free for medical reasons, thus cross contamination is an issue). While there are some restaurant options that could work, we were consistently told our only option was the main buffet restaurant. We had difficulty getting into the Japanese restaurant despite it being virtually empty one evening.  Overall, the hotel is extremely humid and air quality is poor - it smells very musty and moldy. Of course, that's hard to avoid due to all the indoor plants and water features. But, it was also that way in the meeting rooms in the convention center. And, it carries into the guest rooms.    It was quite strong in the bathtub area with the plexiglass bathtub shell moving under my feet, as well as in the toilet area.  Fortunately, the beach was nice so I minimized the time spent in the room. Since the Internet in the rooms did not work well at all (connecting for 2 minutes and then dropping all the time!), there wasn't much to do in the room anyways.

reviews.author: Erica B
reviews.title: Absolutely amazing!!!!
reviews.text:
I just got back from a week vacation from Paradisus Cancun and I am extremely happy that I chose this resort. I had been doing research for months and decided to stay here for my week vacation. I went with my family and my boyfriend. The staff was phenomenal!!! They were extremely welcoming as soon as we got there. Throughout our stay the staff was very friendly. They definitely catered to our needs and made our stay so enjoyable that we really didn't leave the resort other than going to Playa Mujeres and the Mexican Market.  Our servers Arturo and Orlando outside by the Market Grill were extremely nice and pleasant. We constantly sat at the same table and they made sure we had drinks and everything that we needed. Oscar, Julio, and Eden were awesome out by the swim up bar. They always remembered what drinks we had and made sure we were having a good time. They really made our time out in the pool enjoyable. We were out there almost every day and had some interesting shots and drinks. The servers at all the other restaurants were also extremely nice.

The restaurants were also all pretty good. My favorite being Vento and Fuego. The buffet was also very good for being a buffet. The only thing is I wish there was more Mexican food. Mole was okay and the tacos were just okay at Blue Agave.

The resort was absolutely beautiful. I really enjoyed the decor in the main part of the hotel where the Asian restaurant Bana is. Pictures just don't do it. The ambiance in all the restaurants were very nice as well. The rooms were just okay but who goes to Cancun to stay cooped up in the room?  The beaches were also beautiful! The crystal clear blue waters I was just in awe. I am from Fort Lauderdale Florida and the beaches here are also beautiful but Cancun was just breathtaking. 

The only cons I have is that it was windy and overcast for the last couple of days and we were not able to go into the beach as much as we wanted but that has nothing to do with the resort. Also I wish they played some music out by the pool. Besides that we had a really great tie. I will definitely be back and I will definitely be recommending this resort.

reviews.author: Leslie N
reviews.title: Wedding Getaway!
reviews.text: We went to this resort for our dear friends wedding for four nights. We had a lovely experience. Nanos restaurant was our main eating area; we enjoyed the selection morning, noon and night. The staff was frequently attentive and happy to serve. Further, we chose to experience the Myan Pyramids which was the zenith of the trip after we watched our friends beautiful union on the beach. Remember when going to Mexico, hydrate, hydrate, hydrate because many of us got a bit sick with all that drinking in the sun!

reviews.author: cigarfanatic
reviews.title: Superior poolside service!
reviews.text: My family and I are currently vacationing here for a week. When you come here to lay by the pool, ask for Keith to assist you... He is the poolside manager and is the friendliest, most accommodating employee at the resort. 5 star outstanding service, and we would come back to Paradisus just for him!

reviews.author: jgoldie
reviews.title: Beautiful property
reviews.text: We go here every year for at least a week or two. The hotel itself is beautiful. The staff are very helpful. The pool is beautiful. It is a great property. The only down side is that the restaurants are just ok. The food could definitely be better. If you do not see something just ask staff will try their best to help you.

reviews.author: Whitworther
reviews.title: Excellent Royal service
reviews.text:
From the minute we arrived the hotel was fantastic. We were greeted by the extremely happy doorman, our bags were whisked away to our room and we were seated in the lobby whilst we waited for our butler, Erik. We were then taken to block 5 in a golfing cart, where we were booked in and given a welcome glass of bubbly.

The room was excellent, we had a lagoon view, which was perfect as you get the full sunset as you relax on your balcony. The TV service was excellent with loads of English speaking channels, and the shower was excellent. Even the bathroom products were of a high standard.

The royal area in block 5 is peaceful and provides drinks and snacks all day, it is a little bit dark, but it is very relaxing, with fish ponds and lots of natural tropical greenery.

The restaurants are all of a high standard, and Erik booked 5 in a row for us with no hassle whatsoever. We really enjoyed Vento and The Market Grill, and visited both twice during our two week stay. The buffet is excellent too, although we only ate there once at night. You can also eat overlooking the sea for breakfast and lunch in the Royal area, I can recommend the sirloin steak burger with sweet potato fries! Orlando gave us exceptional service in the buffet restaurant each morning.

The pool area is great with loads of sunbeds and Bali beds. we had no issue getting a bed by the pool or the beach at any time, booking them from 7 to 10am most days. (Book Bali beds a day or two prior). The staff are brilliant, especially the towel boys and waiting staff who help with everything and have no problem assisting you. We took 100 single dollar bills for tips and tipped every other round of drinks, which worked perfectly. Felix, Michael and Geradio were particularly good.

The bars are many and it was no hassle to get branded alcohol, you just have to ask for it. The hotel is huge and there are endless places to sit and eat and drink, chat and chill out. The level of service, hygiene and staff morale is constantly excellent. The gym was also very good, (although it can get pretty busy), with good equipment and very clean standards.

We had a truly great stay, and would definitely return to this hotel in the future. The bus service into Cancun is fantastic and makes for easy access to all of the shops and activities for just 9.5 pesos per trip - don't waste money on taxis!! Whilst the hotel is quiet, there are options for late drinks and beach parties.

reviews.author: 62country
reviews.title: Second time back and loved it
reviews.text: This is my husband and I second trip back and it was better then the first. We booked Royal service and this time they got it right. Last year they brought us to the wrong check in when we finally checked in at RS our butler took us to our room and that was the last we saw of him. This year our butler was Sergio and he greated us at the main entrance and escorted us to Royal Service. He was amazing and checked up on us twice a day to make sure we were Ok and if we need anything. Thank you Sergio!!!  We loved the Bali beds and how quiet it was at RS. David and his team do an excellent job on taking good care of reservation and the beds. Special thank you to Alexander and Omar as they would always come by and say hi and tell a joke or two. Please say Hi from Ken. The pool staff were great at serving drinks and food never a chance of going thirsty!!!  The Concierge was  Natalia and she was very cine and helped us plan a romantic dinner on the beach which we loved. Michael was our waiter that night and did a great job. We always had breakfast outside at the restaurant at RS. We had lunch and dinner at Market Grill very good. One night we were 30 minutes late for our reservation at MG and they would not let us dine there so we ate at the buffet Naos, found the food very bland and did not go back. Ate at Fuego and Mole they were really good. The entertainment at avenue bar was very good . really enjoyed Michael Jackson and Carebeno. Our only big complaint is the music at the New beach bar Coco.s and Avenue bar. its some sort of Electronic elevator music really Annoying!! We asked the staff to change it and they have no control. Really????  So please change your music especially at the beach bar. Anything familiar would be nice. Feel sorry for the staff that have to listen to it all day and night There is one club that does play really good dance music but it does not open till 10:30 so we only went once. . Special thanks to Enrique, Israel and Karina at the Coco's bar, we went there every night and they were always knew what we wanted to drink and were so nice.      So overall we had a great trip and the staff made it that much better. Hope to be back again if not this year next.

reviews.author: James K
reviews.title: Exceptional dining options "Tempo"
reviews.text: We just returned after a most satisfying week of gourmet dining at 7 out of 9 available restaurants. We saved the best for last, and that would be Tempo. They list it as contemporary eclectric Basque cusine, I call it a little bit of gastronomic Heaven. From manager: Fares, waiter; Samuel, to Cheffs: Ismuel & Felipe. We selected the Tasting menu which was 9 courses with wine pairings. This was a slam dunk! A perfect 10!

reviews.author: Mary Ann G
reviews.title: Girls trip
reviews.text: Loved this resort. Have been to cancun many times, this was our first time at   Paradisus and will likely be back. The food was excellence. Service was great through out the resort. Has to be one of the cleanest hotels I ever stayed at.

reviews.author: ally1922
reviews.title: Had a fantastic two weeks at Paradisus
reviews.text:
The hotel is very clean and comfortable.  Our room in the main block 8th floor has all the facilities we needed including good air con system.  The maid service and drinks refills were daily and good. Lots of clean sheets, towels and toiletries 

The bars were excellent and had a full range of international  drinks freely available.  A special mention for Josua in Cocos who without a doubt is a master cocktail maker and friendly - a valuable employee for your hotel who made our many afternoons there a pleasure - we also enjoyed a cocktail hour in the bar by the sushi restaurant and enjoyed the music early evening 

Was slightly disappointed in the restaurants after reading so many good reviews - The steakhouse was poor and did not enjoy Mole - Fuego was good and Market Grill was ok 
Dined out of hotel several times 

The staff could not do enough for you throughout the hotel and were very friendly ( Simon and Marisol and Jorge on the beach ) 

After a 10 and half hour flight - we were welcomed at concierge who explained the restaurants etc and asked if anything special - once she found out it was  our wedding  anniversary she had a bottle of champagne but wanted us to go to breakfast for this - we were then asked for a $20 USD deposit for breakfast at which point we realised was timeshare and refused - she immediately left us and said would get our bags bought up however after 2 hours they had not arrived and upon calling the bell boy he had not been given the ticket - he did apologise and brought the bags straight away

reviews.author: Anne P
reviews.title: La Perla, Restaurant
reviews.text: Best restaurant on the resort!  Try the beef medallion!  Exceptional service from Javier Varela.  Also special mention of Francisco.  We also enjoy lunches at La Perla, particularly fresh seafood!  Beautiful view of the beach.

reviews.author: Jessica L
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text:
Stayed in room #3558 May 11-16th... The resort is absolutely stunning.
