The lush vegetation, modern lounging areas, and breathtaking ocean views kept my eyes and camera very busy. The resort is very clean, safe, and strikes a great balance of fun and relaxing. The food was excellent. Naos is basically the only option for breakfast and lunch, but the international style buffet offered plenty to chose from. Multiple options for dinner. A personal favorite was Blue Agave, the tacos and tequila bar that doesn't require reservations. Naos, Blue Agave, Fuego, Bana, and La Perla all exceeded expectations in both food quality and personal service. Market Grill was decent, but will probably skip in future visits. Reservations did not seem necessary during our stay, but it is highly suggested that you book a few upon arrival. 
Overall service throughout the resort was top notch.. restaurant, bar, and housekeeping staff were all very friendly, fast, and helpful. The room was clean and well appointed with a gorgeous view. The beach is my idea of perfection.. tides can be dangerous, but just use caution and pay attention to the flags. There are plenty of activities and social opportunities if you are looking for fun and excitement.. but there is no pressure to take part if relaxation is the priority. 
This vacation/resort was true paradise, and I will absolutely visit Paradisus Cancun again!

reviews.author: Shannon4343
reviews.title: Beautiful property & excellent food
reviews.text:
I just returned from a trip to the Paradisus with my mother.  We had a wonderful time.  The décor is beautiful.  My mother loved all of the plants and water features including the koi ponds.  We stayed in the Royal Service area.  It was very quiet.  We enjoyed the amenities offered in the Royal Service lounge area like the continental breakfast and the bar/snacks available the rest of the day.  Our butler, Cesar, was very nice.  We didn't use his services a lot, but he was very friendly and brought us white tea pillows at night and a bottle of tequila to take home.  He also helped make our restaurant reservations.  Our favorite part of having Royal Service was having the Bali bed at the pool.  It was so relaxing and nice to get a break from the sun.  

The beach was beautiful even though the water was a bit rough.  The grounds, in general, were immaculate.  

We ate at the Blue Agave on our first night as it is the only restaurant other than the buffet that doesn't require reservations.  The tacos were very good.  We also ate at Fuego.  It was fantastic.  Hector went above and beyond to help us as I have celiac disease and have to eat gluten free.  All restaurants were very accommodating of this.  We also enjoyed our dinner at The Market Grill which is like a Brazilian steakhouse.  On our final night we had tapas at Vento.  Another excellent meal.  

The only minor complaint was that the housekeeping staff kept taking our washcloths when they cleaned and not replacing them with new ones.  

All in all, we had a very enjoyable experience and would love to go back.  My mother is already talking about returning next year with her husband.

reviews.author: NLBA
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus May 2 -10 and we loved it!  We were there for our daughters wedding and it was beautiful. The staff was very helpful when we were not happy with our first room.  We ate at several of the restaurants and we were not disappointed with any of them. A special thanks to Luis at Naos. He was very attentive. The beach was great and the staff that brought us drinks there were great!  We will be back!!

reviews.author: Regula_9
reviews.title: Lovely and very good
reviews.text:
The hotel is beautiful, the lobby very exotic with lots of plants. I attended a Forum. Too many steps to get to the convention center, first you can use a ramp, then go up two steps, walk a few yards, then go down 5 steps (why not keep it on one level and descend 3 steps??), then walk another few steps, another step down, repeat same and finally get to the escalator. My knees were killing me after doing this several times a day.  The single steps are not marked, if you are distracted you can easily miss it and fall.
The hotel lacks clear markings, very few places indicate room numer locations. Many of us kept getting lost, I finally learned my way around on the third day. Everybody was very friendly and helpful, housekeeping a bit spotty, out of 3 nights I received turn-down service the second night only.. Coffee in the room was replaced after I asked for it, not automatically. 
The food was good, some of it delicious. You have to be a good walker in that hotel!
I did not see a lot of installations for handicapped guests, except the one ramp going down to the convention center. Could stand some improvement in that regard.
The hotel gives a relaxed feeling, the music in the evening in the hallways is very soothing. The view of the ocean is breathtaking, the beach is OK, of course it has waves and can be rough, but after all, you are in Cancun. If you want calmer waters go to Riviera Maya. I hear Paradisus just opened a hotel there.

reviews.author: Tammy Y
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
reviews.text: The hotel was beautiful as well as the staff with one small issue/problem. The housekeeping staff was slow. Our bed didn't get made until after 3pm, I don't like that. But, overall it was great and yes I would return.

reviews.author: Nick B
reviews.title: Outstanding in most areas
reviews.text:
This is a truly special resort where we had a memorable time. 

First of all the stunning looking venue stands out to you and has a very warm welcome (even if the incense smell is a bit over powering on the nose.

We went for the Royal Service which meant we had a adult only area of the hotel and offered 24 hrs concierge service. One of the best elements was the service provided by the staff at the hotel. The two stand outs being Carlos who made sure we were well looked after while relaxing by the pool and Eric who was part of the concierge team. Both we're very consistent and had a great eye for detail.

The restaurants offer a fantastic variety and great quality. The favourites being BANA  excellent quality sushi & great setting and Mole which made sure we were well looked after with excellent classic Mexican cuisine and good wine. 

I would definitely recommend this resort if you are thinking of staying in Cancun, and interested to see other Melia resorts going forward. 

Nick B

reviews.author: Jessica R
reviews.title: Cancun
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel. Great customer service. Food and drinks are yummy. Will come back again!! I suggest bring oil free sunscreen if you want to go to any of the parks. I did Xaret which was a wonderful experience. Make sure to make reservations to the restaurants that you want to eat the night before. Room service was nice for the days I felt to lazy to get up.

reviews.author: Saquish15
reviews.title: Absolute paradise
reviews.text: My Husband & I just returned from 5 days at the Paradisus & loved it!!!. The afternoon we arrived we were able to get reservations for dinner for both that night & the next. Hearing a lot of complaints about reservations but was not our experience at all. Everyone was super nice & helpful. The restaurants were good, the rooms were nice & clean. The pool was lovely and the beach was absolutely beautiful!!! We got a Bali bed everyday & split our time between pool & ocean. The ocean definately had surf but we went in, just didn't go out very far.  It was absolute paradise, we cannot wait to go back:).

reviews.author: TERRESA P
reviews.title: Beautiful Lobby!
reviews.text:
We really enjoyed the lobby and the dining in this hotel.The beach is really nice but the pool was always out of loungers unless you got up very early to  get one.  We rented a cabana for the whole week to avoid this.  The best cabana is 105; it is between the two pools and near the swim up bar.  The pool is a little over five feet deep in most areas, it was not good to walk around in if you are not six feet tall!

Our concierge, Claudia was awesome.  Upon arrival there were no reservations to be had for dinner on the first night; only a 10 P.M. available on the second night. Claudia made us a reservation for the remaining nights, every night at a different restaurant,  the reservation was delivered on our door...what great service.  I strongly suggest that you set this up if this service is available to you.

Bana was our favorite restaurant, the service was awesome, the surrounding area was perfect and the food was excellent.

Vento was also good, they served Tapas and the waiter recommended to order a few of each group..everything we ordered was delicious.

The Market grill was also very good, the waiters were excellent in helping us choose our side dishes, followed by fresh cooked skewered meats brought to your table so you could choose which one you liked.

The buffet was expansive and very good; however often really crowded.

There is a grill near the pool for hamburgers, hot dogs, pizza, wings and guacamole.  The food there was awful; the hamburgers, hot dogs and wings were precooked and in bins to keep them warm.

There is a small buffet at La Perla for lunch; mostly ceviche and fish based dishes at the salad bar and a few choices of vegetables and fish that were warm.  They often put salad items on the salad bar but left the dressing on the counter...we never tried it...warm salad dressing is not a good  thing!

The bar in the lobby had excellent service; Rafael and Rogelio were awesome.  

The beds were a bit hard and the pillows lumpy.  Linens were nice, the shower is a rain forest overhead shower and also includes a hand-held shower.

There are a lot of stairs and a lot of walking for those with disabilities, luckily this trip I did not have knee issues.

The spa was nice but very pricey, there is a pool in the spa with several jets for different areas on your body; it is a hydrotherapy pool.

I would give this a 5 star but the grill food and the not refrigerated salad dressing along with the pool lounger problem bring it to 4 stars.  I would probably return, but there are so many other beautiful properties to see and discover first!

reviews.author: dk1172
reviews.title: Very Nice Stay!
reviews.text:
My wife and I just returned from our 5 day stay at the Paradisus Cancun and we enjoyed our visit. Check in time is three and we arrived at the hotel around Noon. We didn't count on our room being ready but they have a changing room that has a full shower that you can change into your beach gear while waiting for the room. Our room was very clean and the maid service did a very nice job daily. The mini frig was stocked daily and includes a bag of chips and oreo cookies for food. For drinks they had Coke, Diet Coke, Sprite, Sprite zero, and for Beers they had Sol and Tecante. We never ran out of drinks but with the service you get there I would imagine just a simple call to room service or concierge and they would bring you more drinks if you ran out. 

The restaurants were all very nice with good service and good food. Vento had very good steak, Mole had excellent sea bass, and the Market Grill brings your meal out Brazilian style so  they cut the meat off the skewer for you which was a fun experience. During the day the pool has a snack bar that includes chicken wings, hot dogs, burgers, nacho chips with pico, guacamole, and brick oven pizza's. We have been to many all inclusive's and most of the time the pool snack bars are picked over but that was never a problem at Paradisus. The only wait you have is waiting for your pizza to cook which is only 10-15 minutes tops. Lastly, make sure you make your dinner reservation one day before with the concierge. We never had a problem but we did see a few people complaining outside of restaurants saying they could see a empty table but they would not seat them because they did not have a reservation.   

Pool/Beach. The pool was kept very clean and was pretty deep. 5 feet in most places so if your short just pack some floaties :) The beach speaks for itself.. one of the best beaches in the world in my opinion. 
 
In closing this is not a 5 star resort but if you looking for a nice, clean, relaxing place to stay you can't go wrong with this place.

reviews.author: lisalisa46410
reviews.title: Dinner at the Market Grill
reviews.text: Just had a great dining experience at the Market Grill for dinner.  Our hostess Giovanna was waiting for us to arrive and greeted us with a friendly smile and warm welcome.  This was followed by awesome service from our waiters Margalli, Luis, and Jose.  They made great suggestions regarding appetizers and side dishes - even going to another restaurant to get the salad dressing that I wanted.  The food was delicious - the sausage was my favorite.  So far our favorite dining experience at the Paradisus!

reviews.author: Angie W
reviews.title: Great place, great food
reviews.text:
Just got back from the Paradisus.  First off, the place is beautiful, the food awesome, and a great beach.  We did get a bit frustrated trying to find our way from point A to point B indoors, as you can't go in a straight line.  Or even stay on the same floor.  We finally gave up and just walked around the pool, it was easier.  One thing I should mention about that, the paving stones are uneven, with the mortar higher in places, so ladies, leave the high heels home, as you will either hurt yourself, or ruin your shoes.  One thing that I didn't see in any other  reviews that I'd like to mention is the dress code for the restaurants.  Tempo is the only restaurant that requires pants for men, and this restaurant is NOT part of the all-inclusive.  All other restaurants allow shorts and require shirts with sleeves for the men.  They also allows sandals.  I had packed two pairs of pants and some loafers for my husband only to find out they weren't needed.  Wish I had known as I could've packed more shoes for me to replace the pair I broke!

Here come the cons about the place, which are mostly just minor annoyances: 
We had talked to our butler about getting our mini bar stocked with light beer and diet soda.  Apparently the word didn't make it to the staff actually stocking the mini-bar, so we started grabbing what we wanted on our way through the lobby and stocking it ourselves.  Several times we got back to our room early afternoon while housekeeping was still there. Didn't appear to have the same housekeeper every day, and they seemed to do the minimum required.  I have long black hair.  When walking into the bathroom, literally minutes after she left and seeing black hairballs in the corners of the room, it was obvious she only sweeps and mops the middle of the room.  After 4 days, we did find a broom and swept off the balcony ourselves. There was a lot of small concrete debris out there.   I guarantee the frowny face I drew in the salt residue on the window is still there.  Biggest annoyance about the room was the turn down service showing up between 5:30 and 6:30 every day to do the turn down stuff.  This was really inconvenient as most folks are just getting back to room and showering and changing for dinner and the evening out.  Didn't take us long to figure out to  put the Do Not Disturb sign on door.

We found only one small bar, Coco's, that is outdoors and open at night.  This is a huge Con in our book.  80 degrees outside at 10:00 PM in paradise - who wants to be indoors?  Please get a larger outdoor bar space, with plenty of seating and decent  music for night time!  The resort entertainment is a 30 minute dance routine in a tiny space with people crowded around, not really entertaining.  Based on the large number of folks hanging out outside every  night, we are not the only ones that felt this way.

Now the Pros:
A lot of different restaurants to choose from, with good food. For the most part, service was great (dinner in the buffet was a bit sketchy on getting service for beverages).  Breakfast and lunch in the buffet restaurant (Naos) was good, nice assortment of food, but nothing was hot unless you had an omelet made to order.  If you chose to sit outside in the Market Grill section for lunch, you get a choice between the buffet or an a la carte menu, which has some great food on it!  We very quickly met our favorite waiter at Naos,  Angel.  By our third day, he had coffee, juice and water for us almost as soon as we sat down for breakfast, and at lunchtime he had two Tecate lights, no lime, and two diet Cokes with lime ready for us before we even decided if we wanted a menu.  Thanks for the great service Angel, you are aptly named!

Few other comments:
We had an ocean front room, which was kind of a waste.  It was super windy almost every  day, so we couldn't leave the balcony door open.  The railing on the balcony is a solid concrete wall with a planter on top.  Really hard to see the water through the wall. The only furniture on the balcony was one lounge chair.  Not very useful.  We ended up taking the table and chairs from the room out onto the balcony every night so we could at least enjoy the warm weather and look at the sky.  The butler service is way over rates.  We seldom saw our butler, and ended up  going to the concierge desk and making our own dinner reservations every other day. We actually went 3 full days literally without seeing him.  He did mention the pillow menu once, but we never saw the menu. And I really didn't like the pillows!

reviews.author: justme60763
reviews.title: Great Bones, Great Service, Great Value, Poor Bathroom Design
reviews.text:
We celebrated our anniversary at Paradisus, Cancun.  In past years we stayed at Moon Palace, Live Aqua and Secrets Excellence.  

Comparatively speaking, Paradisus has a better layout and amenities hands down.  We booked with Royal Service, which was a great value, that included cabanas, normally $50 a day; and certain spa amenities.  In addition, golf on the par three course was also included.  The Royal Service 100ft pool was sufficiently deep for swimming and peaceful.  The poolside Lapalapa Restaurant, couldn't get it right.  Guac and chips should be simple, burnt thick chips, tasteless guac, sirloin burger was also tasteless. They should try putting out simple Mexican style like fare like Live Aqua's poolside restaurant.

It's easy to find good food on property, such as Mole and Vento, the Market Grille was just okay and the Naos Buffet was good as well.

While the guest rooms are certainly generous with seating areas, the bathrooms are small and poorly laid out.  Large amounts of caulking prove the point that water is going everywhere.   Getting in and out of tub could prove hazardous with controls that are hard to reach and figure out prior to getting blasted by hot or cold water.  The shower support/rail bar is not accessible when getting in the shower.  Shower curtain rod was falling off the wall and the curtain couldn't be closed properly due to proximity of vanity.  Ceiling access door had peeling paint/moisture issue.   The location of towels and floor mats is inconvenient when exiting the tub/shower onto a slippery stone floor.  There really isn't any room on the one sink vanity for cosmetics or other usable storage space.    Towels were...not bright in appearance or luxurious in texture.    If renovation is in the near future, start with the bathrooms by making them larger for the sake of guest safety.

The spa is nice because it's open air (no worries of chlorine odors).

I really enjoyed the resort and service.  

.

reviews.author: Lizjet
reviews.title: Family Friendly
reviews.text: Overall average. Except reservation needed to eat at the restaurants it was quite annoying specially when you are traveling for vacations and all you need is Relax!!! They claim Restaurants are "always" fully booked and you have no option than eat the buffet!  The truth is their Restaurants are not busy at all!

reviews.author: AngelaH22
reviews.title: Good value and service
reviews.text:
My best friend and I stayed 5 nights in early May for our annual girls' trip.  We booked a royal service lagoon view room through Cheap Caribbean. We were happy with our room, and since we were in it so little I don't think an oceanfront upgrade would have been worth it.  We both agreed that the Royal service upgrade was a must. We enjoyed the adults only pool and beach areas.  The Bali beds by the pool were wonderful (especially in the rain), and we were able to get a Bali bed after lunch even on the days we didn't have one reserved. 

I found the food to be well above average, but the setting of all the restaurants in the main building wasn't my favorite.  Sushi at Bana was our favorite and we had great service from Mauricio.  

The butler service was underwhelming, and after a brief tour the first day we didn't see our butler again until the day before we left.  He did make some of our dinner reservations, but since he didn't provide a confirmation we had to check with the concierge. Mayte, at the royal concierge desk, also provided outstanding service whenever we had a question.

We spent most days by the pool or on the beach and never had trouble getting a Bali bed or umbrella, but we are early risers.  There was one "miscommunication" about our reserved Bali bed when they changed our reservation to accommodate a bigger group.  An honest explanation (the whiteout was clearly visible) would have been better than trying to convince us we remembered it wrong, but this really didn't impact our enjoyment.  

One person that deserves special recognition is Francisco who serves poolside.  He is a stand out, and really made our time there enjoyable.   

I've stayed twice at Live Aqua and loved it, but it have to say that Paradisus Royal Service is a serious contender especially given the significant price difference when we travelled.

reviews.author: TimShivers
reviews.title: Extremely good value
reviews.text:
I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at the Paradisus Cancun, mostly because I kept reminding myself of the value.  The hotel is beautiful, clean, feature rich and should meet everyone's need for those who book.  We had the junior suite on the ocean side and the view was gorgeous.
The Good, and even Great:
There are several restaurants in addition to the excellent food on the buffet. So you never get bored with your options for dining.  The tapas restaurant was really really good, with lots of interesting creations in just the right portions so you can have everything.  The Market Grill is a churrascaria style steakhouse with pretty decent meats, you will get stuffed. The pool areas are well laid out and we never had any problems finding chairs in either there or the beach, but we went in May.  Staff is very friendly, and despite what others have said, nobody is pushing anything on you inside the resort.  Drinks flow freely, and are strong. Oscar and the guys at the swim up bar were very good. The rooms is spacious and well appointed, with satellite TV, stocked fridge and a great bathroom with a big rainfall shower.  We got great service from the cleaning staff, our room was cleaned every day, sheets changed every other day (as stated in the room card) and got turndown service every night.
  
The thing that prevents me from giving Paradisus 4 stars is the unpleasant surprises.

The Not so great:
The hotel seems understaffed in general, it was difficult to make reservations (until I found a trick), but whenever we were at that restaurant at least half the tables were empty. Front desk and concierge agents were always busy and pretty unhelpful. We needed to change money, and it was difficult to get their attention. I wanted to request more beer in the fridge, not effective.  As well as things like this -  when we needed to print our boarding passes for the return flight, they charged us $2, that's silly at an all inclusive.  They couldn't make change for us so that we could keep tipping the staff. 
The specialty restaurants are underwhelming
Bana was not good sushi, very uninteresting if you regularly eat sushi. We had trouble getting seated where we wanted, even though it was nearly empty.  Fuego had bugs on the first table we sat at. Not really a big deal as the next one was very clean and this is a tropical location, but it does sort of indicate the reason I gave 3 Stars instead of 4. One additional oddness was that the food was always cold on the buffet, I don't know why you can't keep food warm but it wasn't. Still good, but just cool.

And last negative, but it is a big one, we specifically requested Pyramid 4 when we booked to avoid the noise in Pyramid 3.  I could even see it on the paper the front desk had, but they told us no Junior suite ocean view was available other than in Pyramid 3.  They assured us that by putting us on the 7th floor (out of 8) it would be very quiet. It was not. Not at all, it was a thumping bass heavy disco until 2AM each night.  We had the AC fan set to always on to drown some of it out, but would still be woken from a drunken food coma each night.  Way too loud, it really is hard to believe until you hear it.

It sounds harsh, but I really think this is a solid 3, and I wanted to detail why. Again, we really had a great time, and I would recommend it to anyone, but you have to set your expectations right. Oh, and the trick for the restaurants is to download their app on your smartphone, use the great Wifi reception to make your bookings for dinner and you can do it more than one day in advance, never had any problems getting in where we wanted.

reviews.author: SantaClaus60_12
reviews.title: Paradisus--Not Paradise--but close!!!
reviews.text: Five days for destination wedding--(people from all over the world--groom was Mexican) and we stayed in the upgraded Bldg 5 with butler service in Royal Service. Room is tired with really crappy showers and tubs--dirty windows, but otherwise large, clean and comfortable--super daytime and evening maid service, the butler works like a dog for you with respect to reservations for dining, but too typical for all inclusive with food that can be described as mediocre at best, regardless of where you were--noting that service at Royal service's exclusive poolside dining was just flat out slow--like molasses (you cant even tip your way to speed!!) and a limited menu once you've been there a few days..but no complaints..royal service is a good deal overall...The entire resort is well kept generally with beautiful atria that must be the hallmark...and the pools are quite good and the beach cannot be described--beyond beautiful with the only minus occasional rough surf...but one of the best beaches anywhere when calm. We loved the sushi restaurant, even though the size of its bar is stupidly small (who ever designed this part of the facility--on the ground floor of the main building, was an idiot), but service was quick and impeccable, and the Mexican theme restaurant (Mole)was nothing short of terrific...my wife and I were overwhelmed with the amazing service by our waiter Angel, who made sure all of our needs were met with a good assist from Sonia, the hostess. This is as good as it gets when in an all-inclusive. Don't overlook the Market Grill if you're a meat lover...also with a great staff. also, the sommelier is one of the best we've met in such a place. Now, a few negatives...some of the staff is often unengaged---going through motions with sometimes feigned attempts to be friendly--and tipping seems to pick it up, but almost to the point of expecting it or worrying you'll be ignored. I never have a solution nor seen a solution for this dynamic...so it just kind of comes with the territory--with my hope that the workers there are paid a fair wage. so, please, if you go, please leave $5 or so for the maid each day..it's the least you can do. We enjoyed our stay overall. One note of caution--we traveled to/from the airport with Olympus tours, who spent every waking moment harassing us to do a side trip. when we said no the first time, they kept calling our room, when we said no a second time, they became rude--even nasty--hanging up on us when we pleaded with them nicely to accept we weren't going--no way should these people be given a desk at the hotel. We said no when the first day at $78 all in then changed the next day to $15 for this and $3 for that and $5 for that per person as add ons. Be careful..this is how they trick you.

reviews.author: Lhesterpo
reviews.title: Everything great except for the pool closing so early
reviews.text:
-poolbar closes early, only till 6pm
-swiming pools also close early, only till 7pm
-great service
-lots of restaurants to choose from
-food was great
-rooms were fine, not superb
-television was an old flat screen, we could not use usb videos to watch movies
-beach cabanas worth 50 usd for whole day use fits only 2-3 person. -beach chairs are free which is good
-if you are not a party person and just want to relax, never go on spring break season
-summertime is too hot
-there is some free shows at night, very entertaining
-beach was awesome, but we cant swim on it that time because it was strong wave season
-summertime the beach is calm and nice to swim on it, but no breeze and it is really hot 
-overall good vacation

reviews.author: Licia Freeman
reviews.title: Wonderful Spring Break
reviews.text: We went to Paradisus in April for a High School Senior Spring Break trip.  We were 12 parents with 22 teenagers, and we all had a great time.  This is an all inclusive resort, and to my surprise the food was actually really good.  They have a buffet restaurant open for all meals, which was very good, and so were all the other specialty restaurants. Reservations were easy to make, staff was very polite and friendly, the place was always so clean, and it was a very positive experience. They had three different pools attending to different levels of activity, which pleased all tastes.  The beach and setting were gorgeous.  Would go back in a heat beat.

reviews.author: AtlantaMike31
reviews.title: All about the people : )
reviews.text:
Brief review : ) 
This was my wife and my second stay and the Melia/Paradisus and all I can stay is staff staff staff!! They are wonderful. With exception of 1 person out of about 50 we had the pleasure of encountering at the resort, the staff at the Paradisus treated us like royalty. This was our first visit since the remodel and the resort is breathtaking, clean, and above expectation. Unfortunately my wife and I both became very sick a day after arriving and were pretty low key for the remainder of our stay. The hotel staff, and on site Dr. were very helpful and got us out of the woods enough to have the strength to fly home. The food was excellent, the grounds beautiful, and again the friendly helpful smile on the face staff is what makes this place a step above any other resort I have visited at home or abroad. We had one waitress at the upstairs lounge who acted as if we were a bother when my wife and I ordered a couple glasses of wine one evening – but she was the exception and aside from not smiling it was not big deal, just a noticeable contrast to the rest of the folks working at the resort. The concierge at the pool assigned to our cabana was fantastic and was at our service. He even went so far as to ask us if we needed anything before he ended his shift in the evening. We were sorry our trip was not as fun as others due to the serious bug we caught, but that’s life when you travel. Again, I cannot say enough about the friendly accommodating staff.

reviews.author: kaska1
reviews.title: Very relaxing and peaceful!
reviews.text: Great beach! If u want shade u need to wake up in am to get one of the palapas, umbrellas should be offered for those who sleep late. Restaurants are good, but so much trouble with reservations, plus they served as a cold and rare steak when we asked for medium-rare. Spa, don't waste ur money, u get better service for same money in USA. Overall great experience, not many activities at night, very peaceful and quiet.

reviews.author: Lexi S
reviews.title: Royal service suite
reviews.text: We stayed in the royal service one bedroom suite. If you stay here stay in a royal service suite it is worth it you definitely get special treatment including your own pool and bail beds, drink concierge around the pool. We tipped one of them $10 one day and told him to bring a drink every time he came past, and that's what he did (try a bob Marley).

reviews.author: KM A
reviews.title: Excellent Value!
reviews.text: We had a great time here! All inclusive really means all inclusive here, including wifi, endless drinks, a huge variety of food options (we didn't get to try everything!) and room service. My husband, daughter and myself came to Cancun for a friends wedding and many of us stayed at Paradisus. We had a really great time and found the all-inclusive package to be an excellent value. We were the only ones in our group to travel with a child and two others did the royal service, which seemed amazing and well worth it if you like the finer things in life. The food was great and varied, the service was amazing, there was always enough of everything and more and it was really just stress-free and relaxing. We used the babysitting service one night. Not cheap, but a great service if you want a little alone time. The only negatives were that you had to book 24 hours in advance for the restaraunts (but the buffet and the taco place required no bookings); they seemed to have a leaky water problem throughout the building, but this didn't really affect us in anyway and they seemed to be working on it; and the aircon in the room was quite noisy, but we just turned it off at night after getting the room nice and chilled and put the ceiling fan on.  We would definitely go here again and recommend it to anyone looking for a real all inclusive experience!

reviews.author: Amanda S
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Just returned from an out of this world experience at Paradisus Cancun. We upgraded to stay in Royal Service, which is worth the extra, just for the additional restaurants and upgraded experience alone. The staff were fantastic, nothing was too much trouble. The food is amazing all around the hotel and the pool/drinks service was brilliant. The whole experience was relaxing from start to finish

reviews.author: J T
reviews.title: Royal Service
reviews.text: Excellent stay.  The only downside was that we didnt really use our butler because he was off for a few days.  Drinks were top shelf and excellent.  Staff was very courteous.  Had a few bug issues due to the season but they were accomodating to killing them.  We booked pickup and drop off by grey line but they came to pick up two others out of our 6 passengers in our group and we waited for 45 minutes or more for the next van to pick us up.  although not related to the hotel, just be aware of this company in terms of punctuality.  Overall recommend this hotel to anyone with the royal service being a must.

reviews.author: Dchowlv
reviews.title: Great service, and location but food quality and rooms were lacking.
reviews.text: Stayed here from May 6 through the 11th at the Royal service area. The staff is beyond great. Each were very helpful and truly kind. I believe some of the issues lies in the hotel itself and not with the employees. Like Many have said the rooms are a bit dated. My shower head was way to strong it felt like the water was drilling through my head. The shower curtains is hung in such a way where you can not shut it all the way resulting in a flooded bathroom. My biggest concern was how myself and my wife got very ill on our last night there while eating at Vento. A couple hours after dining we both could not stop throwing up. Which continues to the next day where we had constant diarrea. We shared the duck french onion soup and Seabass.

reviews.author: DVK123
reviews.title: Amazing vacation in Paradise
reviews.text:
We stayed here for 7 days and had an amazing time! The hotel was beautiful and big enough to keep you entertained every day. We stayed in the Royal Service and chose a lagoon facing room. Royal Service is absolutely worth it for many reasons. The concierge desk was so helpful and easy to deal with when we arrived. We even were upgraded to a suite which was gorgeous and had multiple balconies. The lounge and lobby was very inviting and great to grab a quick snack or drink. The restaurant by the pool had a good selection but we really liked the room service for breakfast. It always showed up within a half hour and was great. It is also much quieter in the Royal Service area by the pool and beach which I really enjoyed. We didn't see our butler after the first day but anything we needed the concierge took care of easily.

All the restaurants we went to were good but we loved the sushi one, Bana where we had a very attentive and energetic server, Jesus. Market Grill and Vento were also two I would have gone back to if we had time to. There are also multiple bars in the hotel that always seemed to be empty, we never had to wait for drinks. Cocos is overlooking the beach and a great spot to get away from the sun during the day. On our first day we met Simon there, the best bartender at the resort. He was entertaining and always fun to talk to. We were upset the next day when he wasn't there but we found him the next night at Toji, the bar in the main lobby area. We returned there every night because we knew we'd get GREAT drinks, interesting conversation, and above and beyond service. Simon really was the best person we encountered at the resort. He told us they switch bars every 15 days so if you encounter him make sure you ask if he'll be there all week and order the Kelly shots! Amazing!

reviews.author: William G
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text: The resort itself is beautiful. Food was great also, the only complain that we had to make reservations  for dinner every morning and a lot of times all the restaurants were booked at 7am. We paid money for the all inclusive service and shouldn't worry about not having a place to have dinner. Also as far as activities you are pretty much on your own, not much going on a resort. Not at all activities for kids.

reviews.author: Blackie89
reviews.title: Stunning Hotel
reviews.text:
Despite reading all of the positive reviews on this hotel we were reluctant to book as on our last trip to cancun remembered this particular part of the hotel zone being quite windy.
What a great decision is was to book!!! Absolutely stunning hotel! 
The foyer is huge (easy to get lost in on the first day) and the rooms are of excellent size and condition also.
We had an ocean view and the all inclusive package (totally worth spending the extra $$$ on) 
The beach & ocean was simply beautiful and only had a light breeze.
Staff friendly. Great gym and spa facilities. The hydrotherapy rituals are a must and come included with any spa treatment.
The only negative was we travelled through Easter break and it was quite difficult to secure bookings for the dinner restaurants. As we were only able to book 1 day prior to our reservation we we required to wake up at 7am each day when then desk opens to secure a suitable time.
I expect this isn't the case for off peak seasons but a good tip if you are travelling during holidays.
Food and drinks galore!!!! Definitely recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: mikemike0221
reviews.title: Great Vacation with a Few Caveats
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun from May 4 - 9 and had booked a Royal Service Lagoon View room. After reading the reviews about the royal service, we were hesitant to add it, however, we found a great offer online for a royal service room. The bottom line up front on our experience is that this hotel offers a fantastic facility hat rivals or excels above most of the hotels that we've stayed (our last stay was at the JW Marriott), the food is above average for an all inclusive with a great variety to satisfy everyones tastes and the royal service package is well worth the discount prices offered occasionally, but needs some work to justify paying the full price asked on the hotel website.

The Facilities:
In a few words, stunning and beautiful! Everything was very clean and well maintained. Royal service area is by far the most beautiful, relaxing and serene environment I've ever encountered in a hotel. All the pool areas were beautiful and the setup was very accommodating. You never had to do much walking to get what you needed.

Food:
Excellent for all inclusive. The variety was large enough to satisfy any palette or diet. Our favorite restaurant for dinner was probably the Market Grill. The restaurant was a Brazilian style Rodizzio. Food was excellent and they kept the meat coming and the drinks flowing. For lunch, we really enjoyed the poolside bar and restaurant La Palapa, which is exclusive to the royal service guests. The main pool also had a poolside restaurant, however, I found La Palapa to have far superior food offerings, like homemade salsa and guacamole and grilled Mahi Mahi with salad greens and lime dressing, which was oh so delicious! There was also a 24/7 buffet, which we frequented in the mornings and had lunch and dinner there at least once. There was always a large selection of items across the spectrum and never had a problem finding something we liked. We did find one downfall however. The deserts at all the restaurants tended to be lacking in sweetness and sometimes flavor for the American palette.

Service:
The service was pretty stellar across the board. Room cleaning service was almost elusive. Our room was always clean before we returned from the beach and the bed turned down before we returned for the evening. We always had plenty of fresh towels, soap, shampoo and a fridge full of cold drinks. Food service was often quick in the restaurants and drinks were kept full. Almost everyone we dealt with was very friendly and seemed to bend over backwards to accommodate us.The poolside service in the royal service area was probably the best. We never felt the need to leave our chairs to go to the bar ourselves, because the poolside staff was constantly making sure we had all the food and drinks we needed. It really did make for a great vacation. What was a little confusing is the buffet service and table service at some of the sit down restaurants. In the buffet specifically, some days, there would be a hostess to seat you and other days it was a free for all. Sometimes, this made it a fight for a table. At most of the restaurants, service seemed to be disorganized. Sometimes 3 different people would ask you what you wanted to drink before you actually got one, but once you got one, everything was good to go.

Royal Service:
Like I said before, royal service is great, but maybe not worth the full price. Some of the promised services fell short, but many of the extras made it worth paying a little extra. The royal service building is adults only and by far the most relaxing and nicely decorated. The royal service area had 24/7 food, snacks and a self poor bar with more than enough seating, which was nice, but had the same offerings that could be found in the buffet. I think the benefit was in the relaxation factor and the availability of seating, since the buffet was ALWAYS so busy and crowded. The exclusive pool area was very similar to the main pool, but there are several added extras, such as premium quality food served poolside and the use of bali beds included. The only thing we found lacking is the availability of umbrellas on the beach, which were first come first serve. I counted somewhere around 18 umbrellas and 30-some total chairs that were available for the entire royal service building that had to have close to 50 rooms. The bali beds are also only guaranteed for 2 days of your stay. We were able to secure an umbrella or bali bed for every day of our stay, except day 1, where we were forced to grab beach chairs in the main beach resort area.

Everyone staying in a royal service room is provided a cell phone to contact their butlers for anything they need. We found that we never really needed it. We saw our butler often enough that we never needed to call him and service was good enough in the royal service areas that we didn't need him for anything. The one day we actually needed him, turned out to be his day off, so we contacted the royal service desk, which provided us no help. We asked for help booking services at the spa and were told that it would be best for us to call the spa directly, because that's what they would have to do. I imagine it would have been the same response for excursions as well, so I'm not sure what the concierge really provided, except an easier check-in and check-out. I'm sure it would have been different if our butler was available that day.

Club Melia:
Beware of the sales people! They prowl around the main building, asking if you've received your free welcome gift. Once they sit you down, they will tell you about all these great promotions they are offering for excursions and spa services. I was Leary of the offers and asked them about the catch. They told me there was none. Then after we showed interest in booking the deals, they tell us there really is a catch. In order to get the great prices, we have to participate in a "Welcome Breakfast", which is codename for a timeshare sales pitch. Just save yourself a lot of time talking by saying no thank you up front!!

reviews.author: rbsouto
reviews.title: Family Trip - Four Adults
reviews.text:
This resort is spectacular. Good location, very clean, excelent sleep and make sure you get a front view of the beach.

Pros:
- Location is 10 min by bus of Coco Bongo.
- Vento restaurant, just go there every night. Best. Food. Ever.
- Rooms, bars, pool, beach and overall service is superb.
- Bartenders are fun.
- Concierge, thanks Olga and Alfonso!

Cons (that did not ruin the experience, mind you):
- We we the first to arrive that day, but to check-in they asked me to come back periodically until 5 PM, after the 3rd time I took the line they got me a room. I got the room 5:30 PM.
- El Fuego restaurant, the food was the worst of all the ones we tried. Just go to the buffet or book Vento.

reviews.author: GrannyWhisperer
reviews.title: Paradisus truly is Paradise in Cancun
reviews.text:
We stayed for 8 days at Paradisus, and had our wedding on the property.  We had the Family Concierge package (Royal Concierge if no kids) and I would strongly recommend this as the way to go if you can swing it.  The Concierge staff (Carla, Reyes, Hervik, and Fernanda) were incredible, they went above and beyond my expectations to ensure that we had everything we needed.  We would return just to say hi to the staff.

The hotel itself is huge!!  There are 5 different towers (pyramids) and it can take a while to get from one end to the other.  But this allows for several restaurants (8 I think), different bars, and even an on-site night club.  As well as different shops and many, many, many travel/excursion representatives.  The spa was great, even though prices are as expected for resort services (high).

The beach is gorgeous, white sand, no rocks or shells to cut your feet when you go in the water.  Plus, as part of the family concierge you can get a palapas (umbrella) with drink/food service.  Or you can opt to get a Bali bed (cabana) by the pool, though you do have to pay for it, I think it was totally worth it. 

The restaurants are fantastic, most are reservation only, but you can often get reservations the day before (and if you go Family/Royal Concierge you are guaranteed to get a reservation).  The breakfast buffet is probably the best I've had, with tons of options including omelet station and juice station there is plenty to choose from.   I would, however, stay away from room service, the food was rather disappointing for me. 

Bottom line ---  if you stay here, you will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: Irritant
reviews.title: Nice Beaches, Good Rooms, Ok Food
reviews.text:
I spent a week at a business meeting in this hotel.  The rooms are modern and clean, most with balconies.  The beach is well tended and pleasant, with plenty of chairs.  I saw no problem with people trying to "reserve" spots, and they have a policy against it.  They have a nice pool, and reasonable entertainment.  The staff does go out of its way to make the day pleasant.

The food itself was sort of classic All-Inclusive fare.  In that location, you're better off with the package than not with it.  One caution: if you are a vegetarian, selections are quite limited.  I didn't see any activities team for children, but that doesn't mean there wasn't one.  There is also a "Wet and Wild" park not far away, but I didn't try it.

For those who are in business, the Internet service is a bit slow and not 100% reliable, but it was free.

reviews.author: Joel W
reviews.title: 6th Cancun Trip - Favorite So Far
reviews.text:
Beautiful Property with large beachfront so people are not crawling on each other.
Best all inclusive food we've experienced
Royal Service was great
To get beach shade when hotel is full, get up early:
6:15 latest Royal Side, 7am reg side - At least you get to see the sun rise!
Alberth Pech at the Naos buffet was great!

reviews.author: DMILLRN
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun-Superb!!!
reviews.text: Can't give the resort enough praise! From easy check-in, room comfort, pool and beach service, attentive staff, and restaurants!!! (could not decide which one was better, as all were great). And I can't thank Susan@BerwickTravel.com enough. She made the vacation effortless.

reviews.author: Kalle_Blomkvist
reviews.title: Very Nice
reviews.text: The hotel is quite big, with many dining options so you can try something new each night. As far as we can see, there is no drinks service at the beach unless you rent out palapas which are quite expensive. Instead you have to walk up the stairs, get another drink and walk back down. The food is very good, above -average quality. All the staff are extremely nice and welcoming.

reviews.author: Kenneth B
reviews.title: Fantastic vacation
reviews.text: Our first vacation in Mexico ,hopefully not our last. Hotel is beautiful and the staff were the most gracious and accommodating that I have ever encountered. Awesome beach ,would definitely recommend this resort to anyone looking for a fun in the sun vacation ! We also used USA transfer for airport transport, they are very reliable and the drivers courteous and dependable.

reviews.author: Maria P
reviews.title: Very relaxing!!
reviews.text: We are a family of 4, kids are 10 and 12, and had an excellent time!  Resort and food were great!!!  My only 2 cons: not enough activities for my kids and not enough Mexican culture.  I wish there were activities in the evening, like movies on the beach or pool area or live music to enjoy.  My kids had a blast in the pools, the ocean was too rough to swim in, but the beach/sand was beautiful!!!!  We used the bus to go downtown and felt very safe and was very easy to use.

reviews.author: coopstorm
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text:
This was my first trip to Mexico, but it will not be my last.  We used USA Transfers for travel from the airport to the hotel.  The check-in was quick and easy and then a quick overview of the hotel/facilities/restaurants/etc.  You will be asked if you want to do a 90 minutes presentation with breakfast.  We did it and it was beneficial to us, but I will let you decide if you want to go through that.  Our room had two double beds rather than a king.  When we requested a king, we were told there were none available (we ended up getting a room with a king bed two nights later).  Keep your AC running.  There were a couple nights it got a bit warm and humid but that was probably due to us coming and going from the balcony.

The hotel is clean, refreshing, and very neat.  The atrium is expansive with fish, floral, and many areas to sit.  We spent a lot of time in the Avenue Bar just hanging out.  They have entertainment each night for about an hour.  In terms of food, we ate at the buffet (Naos) for breakfast each day.  Not bad, but depending on when you get there will depend on the quality and quantity of the food.  Blue Agave (tacos) is worth a try and we really enjoyed the tacos.  Our best meals came from Vento and Bana (sushi).  You have to try Vento if you arrive.  We usually scheduled our reservations around 7 AM.  La Perla wasn’t the greatest, but if you go there, I would recommend the beef medallion.  Fuego was average.  

The beach and pools are great.  You can’t really go wrong with either one.  The chairs fill-up fast, but we were always able to find somewhere to lounge or sit.  

Overall, it was a great time.  The only downfall is the weather.  It rained one day and we spent it lounging around and walking around the hotel. 

I highly recommend the hotel/resort.

reviews.author: howisitgoing
reviews.title: great holiday
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time in the Paradisus Hotel in cancun .The service was excellent and the staff were very helpful and friendly .The food was delicious in all the restaurant s in the hotel .Over all it was excellent value for money .we would definitely go back again .

reviews.author: David S
reviews.title: PARADISUS IS A GREAT RESORT!
reviews.text: My wife and I had a great experience at the Paradisus Cancun.  Great food, drinks, and service!   This was our second trip to a Melia Resort and won't be our last.  We would also recommend checking out the ME Cancun as well.

reviews.author: Debbie G
reviews.title: An excellent choice - but a few suggestions
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus from 4/3-6 in Royal Service, Tower 5.  We found the resort to be simply amazing.  We were traveling without kids and very much enjoyed the adults only section.  For one, having a Bali bed every day was a treat (they guarantee 2 Bali Bed reservations per stay but because of the low occupancy, we used 4 days in a row!)  All the servers by the pool were tremendous, as was the Royal Service only restaurant (really the top 3 restaurants).  The beachfront is gorgeous and clean.  We enjoyed walks every morning.  Simply wonderful!

Our butler Hector couldn't have been kinder. I can't say enough wonderful things about him.  What a gem!!!

The top restaurants are the Royal Service (La Palapa), Vento, Mole, and the Taco Bar.   All extremely enjoyable (Vento our top pick).  The others - well, very, very disappointing.  We walked out of the Market Grill (rubbery meat and smallest salad I've ever seen) and Fuego.  The service at Fuego was downright offensive.  We talked to the manager and he brushed us off and focused on a table of 8.  Our chicken entrees were overcooked and cold (50 minutes to get our entree! in an empty restaurant).  We walked out and headed directly to the Taco Bar which we loved.  The reason why we tried Fuego; we were told that all the other restaurants were booked.   The resort was at 30% capacity; the restaurants were empty!  We had to create a bit of a stink to get our reservation at Vento.  Thank goodness we did.  It was our favorite.  We also loved the sushi making class - we didn't officially eat at Bano - but  enjoyed the class and maki we prepared.

The other hiccup.  I booked directly through Melia.com even though the rate was higher than other sites like bookit.com.  I justified it because of the room upgrade (subject to availability) and welcome amenity.  Upon check-in, we were told that no room upgrades were available.  We also did not receive a welcome amenity (not the end of the world but don't advertise it if you're not going to do it.)  After a long travel day, I did not push as hard as I should have.  Referenced above, on the second day, we discovered the resort was empty.  Why oh why wouldn't you upgrade?  This was the same woman who told us we couldn't get into Vento for our whole stay.  Another hotel guest told us that they had the same experience, talked to the manager and suddenly there was a room available.  Because we were only at the resort 3 nights, and for a birthday celebration (which was never acknowledged despite noting the reservation), I didn't want to cause a scene in front of her.  I contacted manager Sergio when we returned home.  He apologized, said he'd look into it, confirmed receipt of my email, and never followed up.  I sent another email and have not heard from him.

Would I stay again?  In a heartbeat!  But tips ...follow these restaurant suggestions above, book through any site you're comfortable with - go for the best price.  Book royal service if you're traveling without kids, and if you're "eligible for" a room upgrade, be prepared to push for it.

reviews.author: Cassie1129
reviews.title: LOVED it!
reviews.text:
Paradisus is incredibly beautiful. You walk into the atrium (more like a jungle) and see vines hanging everywhere and mature palms. The hotel pumps delicious scents all through out the hotel, it's a little strong at first but you get used to it. We stayed in tier 1 (there are 5) and our friends stayed in 3 (the main tier). At first, it seemed like they had the better area because they were near everything (all restaurants and bars) and it was such a short walk for them to get to the pools and beach. Our tier was the furthest away you could get from everything, which we ended up loving. The walk to our room never got old, you strolled passed fountains and jungle and more glorious scents. Our room was located above the "Club Melia" meeting area and it was always quiet and peaceful and the night time lighting was so nice. Our friends staying in the main tier liked the area minus the parties that would go on into the early morning hours. 
The staff could not have been better. Every one of them makes sure to greet you in the hallways and they call to verify you've received anything and everything you order from them (new towels, a sandwich, etc). Jesus in the Bana sushi restaurant (so delicious and BEAUTIFUL seating areas) and Roberto at Mole Y Tacos (yum) were exceptional servers. You don't have to tip but we like to. Especially at restaurants, when room service brings food, or when drinks are brought to you on the beach. 
The amenities were fabulous, I only have one complaint. My husband LOVES taking night swims in the beautifully lit pools and those close at 7 at Paradisus, definitely sad. On the positive side, the hotel is located right across the street from Aquaworld and you can walk over and get 30 minutes free in kayaking a day (in the lagoon) and you can rent wave runners and book snorkeling excursions and dolphin swims, etc, and it's simple because you don't need to have a taxi come get you to take you to your excursion, you just walk across the street and it leaves from there. The rooms were always really clean and comfortable. We had a lagoon view (cheaper than a beach view) and of course we'd rather face the ocean but our balconies overlooking the lagoon and golf course were beautiful as well. The only complaint about those I have is that sometimes our towels and sheets had stains on them (clean, but stained) and when we arrived, there were large black hairs stuck to the wall in the shower (hard to see but definitely there). The hotel staff was always cleaning every cranny in the lobby and hallway areas but I think it would be beneficial for them to bleach the towels and sheets and throw away stained materials if they're already bleaching. Also, clean the showers a little better. Other than that, it was all great.
 The beach was lovely. We got burnt the first day (yes, we wore sunscreen) so we always wanted to be under one of the grass umbrellas but they are hard to find unless you're out there at 730, so be quick and don't just leave towels there for an hour, they're probably get moved! If you don't care as much about the shade option, there were always chairs available on the beach (they were more rare around the pool) and the beach is huge so there's even the option of laying your towel on the sand. You can also rent the cabanas for between $40 and $50 a day for shade, which isn't bad. We LOVED our vacation, we went in early May and the weather was beautiful, not too hot. It only rained one day, although it was the WHOLE day. We spent $2500 for my husband and I to go (flight, hotel, all inclusive food AND alcohol). Only about 12 minutes from the airport. The restaurants were all very good and in pretty locations. Just make sure you get a reservation for each one 24 hours in advance! The buffet was hit or miss, depending on the day. The drinks were SO good. I've been to other resorts where you pay $7 for a drink and there's hardly any alcohol in it, these were delicious and not shy on the alcohol. The resort wasn't too busy and the whole location and vibe were exquisite. I will be booking a vacation at Paradisus the next time we visit Cancun!

reviews.author: Sally C
reviews.title: Girls Trip
reviews.text: Considering we weren't even supposed to stay at this hotel, I think we were blessed to have this as our second option.  The hotel is beautiful, the grounds are well kept, there is a different aroma in each building, the staff is friendly and courteous.  It definitely has a very Zen feeling throughout the property.  We upgraded to Royal Service as we all have kids and this is our "adult" getaway.  Francisco and Enrique were phenomenal by the pool, Hector in Fuego and Alejandro in Bana.  All superior exceptional staff.  Why 4 stars?  We were supposed to have our private butler who was going to make our stay memorable.  Many things contributed to our disappointment.  We asked for scented pillows every night and received them once.  Our friends asked for coathangers, never got them.  Our butler asked if he could bring wine to our room and we said yes.  We never got any.  We were never offered nor received a butler phone.  We were guaranteed Bali beds for 2 days of our 4 day stay.  They gave us Saturday and Sunday.  We left at 9:30 Sunday so we couldn't use it.  I had to work very hard with concierge to get it switched.  I thought the butler would take care of that, but he wasn't around.  Needless to say, our butler was non-existent.  He worked 7 am to 3 pm - so who would cover the other hours?  We had no idea.

reviews.author: Linda R
reviews.title: We Enoyed the visit!
reviews.text:
First I will start off with all the good stuff, the staff is amazing and are so very helpful.  The beach is the best beach I've stayed at and I've been to Cancun 7 times. The pool is amazing, it has 5 Pyramids, we stayed in Pyramid 3 which is where the swim up bar is and snack bar is as well. The rooms are much smaller than the other hotels I've stayed at but still very clean and nice. Every night they have turndown service with a mint on your pillow. The only thing I can really say bad about this place is the entertainment and food are really bad! If you go don't expect to find any bacon, sausage or biscuits and gravy on the breakfast bar, it's more like goat cheese and lunch like items for breakfast, they do have a place where they make you an omelets which was ok. We orderd the American Breakfast  from room service which takes 1 hour to deliver and they have bacon and sausage!
I hated that you have to have reservations for all but two restaurants. If you don't make them early in the morning for the NEXT day you have to eat buffet! The resort is beautiful but I wouldn't return for this reason, the food was really not good.  We ordered at one restaurant and the meal is bite size. I ordered shrimp and rice for my meal and I received 1 shrimp on 2 Tbl spoons of rice! I'm not kidding, so you need to order like at least three to make a meal, at this you will only have at least 3 shrimp to eat!!! The tacos in the forever restaurant is the same way. They are bite size Tacos so you have to order 7 to make a meal!  Also, for the entertainment they pack all the people in this tiny little room with very few seats!  It's the worst entertainment of any resort I've been to in Cancun... I was very disappointed.  Also, the other places we have stayed have activities at the pool all day, this one has nothing for adults or kids and it's way away from town so hard to go anywhere.

reviews.author: Nickole J
reviews.title: AMAZING!!!!
reviews.text:
First time in Cancun!!!! The paradises was great!!!! They were pushy like other hotel personal along beach or walking down the road!!! There there for their customers!!! Food was outstanding!!! So many choices!!!! Clean pools, beach, rooms.... 
We will DEFINATELY return!!!!

reviews.author: shahow
reviews.title: Beautiful resort with outstanding service
reviews.text: When you first walk in to the lobby, it's like wow! We had a beautiful room over looking pool and beach, gorgeous sunrises! Beach is absolutely beautiful not enough huts on the beach and even going down at 7 in the morning couldnt get any huts by the pool Service was great, buffet breakfast was very good, lunch was just ok.

reviews.author: Stacey R
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun vacation
reviews.text: This was our first time visiting Cancun and chose the Paradisus Resort.  We had an amazing stay at the hotel.  The resort was beautiful, the staff were very friendly and work extremely hard to make sure our stay was pleasant.  The food was very good, top shelf alcohol was available for drinks.  The workout facility was fairly large and well maintained.  The rooms looked exactly like what was pictured.  The beach was very clean and the ocean warm.  There were lifeguards on the beach also.  Around the pool there were daily activities.  The pool water was very nice, but fairly deep at 5ft at the swimup bar pool.  If you want a chair by the pool, get there early they fill up fast. The only time we left was to take long walks down the beach.  I only have a one item that was not so pleasant.  Check in was a bit hectic. We had reserved a Junior Deluxe Ocean View Suite and paid extra for early check in.  During check in we were told there were problems with the ocean view rooms & that the room assigned to us was not a good room.  They offered several things for us to move to another room overlooking the lagoon, but we really wanted an ocean view room and declined the offers.  At that point they told us our room wasn't ready, which I then asked for a refund on my early check in fee.   They found us a room that was ready but it overlooked the restaurants air conditioner.  With booking months in advance, this wasn't the room we were expecting or desired.  We had to call and complain to get moved to another room that was much better.  I am not sure why they didn't assign us that room from the start.   Even with the check in mishap, I would come back to Cancun in a heartbeat and recommend the hotel to others.

reviews.author: Alexandra G
reviews.title: Amazing Amazing Amazing
reviews.text: If I Can Write A Book About The Paradisus I Would Be Writing Forever I Loved EVERYTHING About The Hotel and What It Offered I Actually Can't Wait To Go Back I Wouldn't Stay Anywhere Else... AMAZING!!'

reviews.author: Angioletta L
reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text:
Amazing! I can't even come up with words to truly express how much I loved my vacation here. We were here during the second week of April with 28 other people for my wedding. We had an awesome time! It was honestly just a great experience. All the staff was so sweet, responsive and caring. Everyone goes out of their way for you! Pools are beautiful. They have a good DJ right by the pool and a swim up bar. Beach is beautiful!! Great for kids. They have a pool with kids activities all day and even have ceramic painting for the kids. Drinks are great and food is also good. There are a lot of restaurants to choose from & this is one of the few all inclusives that actually makes a good drink! 

Our wedding was amazing. The romance team we worked with at the hotel was so caring and attentive! Everything came out beautifully. All of our guests loved their stay and that made us very happy. 

I don't have one complaint. If you are thinking about doing a destination wedding this is the place to do it! We had an amazing time.

reviews.author: Beth A
reviews.title: Beth. Awesome!!!
reviews.text: Can't say enough about this hotel.  The food was first rate at the ones we chose.  Staff super, Simons drinks to die for(cocos bar) geraldo an Carlos at pool bar super people.  If u need something it's pretty much taken care of for u.  Cons:The burning of incense was a bit much.  The ave. bar needs more room to watch enertainment.  Go go go to this hotel if ya want a super time.

reviews.author: beachloverdeb13
reviews.title: Beautiful resort and the best service
reviews.text:
We were a group of 4 ladies having a girls trip.  We opted for the Royal Service and it was mostly worth it!  The seclusion of "our" area was great.  We were in pyramid 5 witch has an open center atrium type area with walkways, small ponds and fish.  In this area there is also a self serve bar and food area.  The area has breakfast in the mornings and snack type items the rest of the day on into the evening.  I believe this area is open until 11pm.  The Royal Service is supposed to include butler service, but our butler Juan, was unable to provide even the simplest of requests(a few more hangers for the closet).   Manuel was our server the first day at the La Palapa bar and grill and he was wonderful.  Almost all waiters, bar servers, concierge employees and house keepers were always smiling and saying hello.  Michael, one of the bar servers started out being attentive then his attentiveness slipped.  Enrique and Francisco(bar servers) were EXCELLENT.  All of our servers at the restaurants were attentive, even the buffet.  The buffet food was just that and nothing special.  Most other food we received was usually just barely warm.  Bana is sushi and pretty good.  Fuego was the best of the places we ate.  For some reason you must make reservations 24 hours in advance for the restaurants, which is fine.  But one all occasions when we dined, there were numerious tables available.  So I don't understand the big deal about reservations.  Felipe our porter was also great!  Also, the web site states transfers are included but they are NOT! 

With the Royal Service you get a private area of the pool with Bali beds that you also must reserve 24 hours in advance.  It is a great area with no kids and very friendly employees.  

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would stay there again if we are back in the area.

reviews.author: Lexvero
reviews.title: Probably the best resort in Cancun!
reviews.text:
Luxury, world class service, and high quality food and drinks! 
Spent 10 nights with my girlfriend at the resort and we couldn't get enough!

Beautiful and clean beach! Great and extremely clean facilities! Great selection of restaurants, some better than others, but overall great quality food! 

The staff was extremely friendly and service minded! 

Would have liked to have a selection of spirits and more snacks in the minibar, but still very good content. 

The lounge, avenue bar, has a great metropolitan vibe and suave feeling! Spent many evenings in that lounge! 

The coco's bar was fun but I wish it kept longer hours...they closed at 12:00 am. 
I also wished they had more night activities at the beach, with music, dancing, lightshows, etc.

The rooms are quite large and very comfortable. I wish they had larger bathtubs in the rooms...they do have hot tubs in certain rooms however!

Highly recommended resort!!!

reviews.author: Brian S
reviews.title: VT Crew
reviews.text: This was a 3rd time to Cancun and we have always wanted to stay at this resort. In comparison to the other places we stayed it was just ok. Our experience at the other places were better. The resort itself is very beautiful. The food was ok, i did not like the layout of the buffet and the food was not the hottest. I did not realize till the last day that there was a menu at the buffet that you could order from and have a steak cooked to order, they don't tell you that. There was 24 hr room service that was included as well but they don't tell you that either, you have to figure it out for yourself. We tried most of the restaurants and the steakhouse and market grill were the best. The entertainment was not great, not much going on during they day to keep guests entertained. The nightly shows were basically a joke, the area where they put them on had no good place to sit and watch, you were always in someones way, it was the worst set up for shows that i have seen, very disappointed with that part of it, expected much more. Our group had the most fun entertaining ourselves with beach volley ball and then enjoying the pool bar in the afternoon. The pool bar was great (Bartenders Enrigue, Samuel, and Gerardo were the best A+++). The only problem at the pool bar was there were too many young kids splashing pool water in your drinks, no parental supervision. They should have a small pool bar for kids in the kid pool area. To sum it up it was great vacation with friends but i would probably not go back unless it was just my wife and i and we upgraded to royal service. We could not upgrade at the time as our group had 16 year old children and you have to be 18 to upgrade.

reviews.author: Katherine M
reviews.title: Best Vacation Ever
reviews.text: 5 Star experience.  The hotel was extremely clean, always a staff member asking if there was something they could do for you, very friendly.  Beach was amazing, blue water, plenty of beach cabanas if you get there by 7:30.

reviews.author: LLJJ0526
reviews.title: Love this place!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun in February this year for 8 days.  It was my first all-inclusive resort and my first time to Mexico.  My husband and I went with 6 other friends and we had an awesome time.  The staff were friendly and the resort was clean and the food was great.  We liked the buffet and the food at The Marketplace the most.  We also went to the Michelin chef restaurant called Tempo on Valentine's Day (you need to pay for this restaurant).  The food was oookkk, but the presentation of the plating of the food was beautiful.  The weather was perfect, the beach was beatiful and the staff were all just so friendly.  Our rooms were clean, there were no bugs, geckos or lizards.  Would definitely recommend to friends and family and will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Heather H
reviews.title: Nice hotel, but not the room we wanted
reviews.text: The hotel was very nice and the food was good, but we had booked at ocean front room and when we arrived at the hotel, they said they were overbooked and only had a lagoon view. We paid extra for the ocean front room, but they said they had absolutely none left. They were not very apologetic about it either. We probably would not stay there again.

reviews.author: AMJ0715
reviews.title: Overall nice hotel, but.......
reviews.text:
5th day in to a 10 day vacation
Pros:
Beautiful beach and blue water, very walkable,too many big waves for swimming
Very romantic atriums
Hotel clean and maintained well
Loved Vento rest/tapas
Bars are nice, but very limited seating
Mole rest. Was just ok
Naos breakfast buffet good
Drinks were good
When we requested early housekeeping they complied
20 min. Taxi ride from airport
Brazilian rest. Ok
Royal service atrium nice

Cons:
Tiny dated bathroom for royal service room bldg. 5
Entire hotel heavenly scented, gave me headaches
Extremely warm, no air movement in common areas &restaurants
As soon as you arrive you will need to decide when &where you want to eat , you have to have reservations at most rest. You might get what you request
Pools are 5-6 ft deep, too deep for any pool activities or even walking unless you are over 6ft.
In 5days so far we saw pool activity staff 1x, rained all day , they only set up a Ping pong table in the Avenue Bar
There is no bar open in the hotel until 5pm
Fuego rest. Service extremely slow because staff has to walk far thru the extremely crowded buffet rest. To get food &drinks
Breakfast service at Royal service outside patio very poor
Unless you get up at 6 am and save chairs ,and hope the pool police don't remove your belongings,you will roast like a lobster; there is no available shade around the pool except for the very limited thatched table huts , which have all been saved, you have to go down to the beach and try to get shade there, maybe 
Balcony has a concrete front so unless you are standing , we had ocean view, you can't see the ocean &you get only 1lounger, you can't eat on the balcony, which we love to do
$1500resort credit is a joke , you have to spend a lot of $$,to get a small discount,then add tax &stipend, too.   Palace Resorts $1500 setup is much better, we always used a lot of it ie. wines, massages, tequila, manicures, pedicures .    I couldn't even get a $50 pedicure for free for staying 10days out of $1500 in coupons. Very disappointed.

To sum up
Royal service didn't help us at all really, not sure if we would have been just as happy without it
Staff works extremely hard , and we always tip generously
Most of these problems are the result of management policies, and some of it is just  an extremely
Inefficient way to do things ie. easy fix to stop people from fighting over shade is to put up portable umbrellas around the pools,they need to add a lot more waitstaff  everywhere too

For comparison we've traveled to Cancun 7x, 6 cruises, plus 3x Europe, and all over the states.
Couple in our early 60s, we usually stay at 4-5 star hotels

reviews.author: Mark C
reviews.title: Excellent for First-time all-inclusive experience
reviews.text: This is my brother and myself's first time at an all-inclusive resort, and we are thoroughly impressed with the experience. Service from front desk and restaurant, to the beach and pool is courteous, prompt, and friendly. The resort has amazing architecture, with special scent for each 'pyramid'. The beach and pool area are well kept and easy to navigate, with friendly towel and drinks service. For those interested in the spa, the hydrotherapy experience is great with guided service, and massage service is top-notch with quiet ambience. The food is amazing with enough variation in the buffet each day and between meals. The themed restaurants are a treat, with great service and top-notch food. There is something for everyone. Be sure to make dinner reservations at the concierge across from check-in when you arrive - they can be booked up fast! Definitely in consideration to return again with our sister when she is well!

reviews.author: Sabine P
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text: My husband and I spent a week at Paradisus, at the Royal Service.  The room was bright and spacious with beach view.  nice size balcony.  The Royal Service is truly excellent.  Our butler, Sergio, was extremely attentive and proactive. There is a lounge for Royal Service customers which is nicely appointed with snacks and drinks all day long. The property has nine restaurants to chose from for dinner but one needs to make reservations.  Sergio went ahead and make reservations for us ahead of time.  What we enjoyed the most was the pool and beach.  Very relaxing and beautiful.  We plan to go there again.

reviews.author: Ivy L
reviews.title: Second year in a row!!!
reviews.text:
