This is mine and my wife second year in a row to this resort. We weren't let down this time either.

Although we were disappointed our butler from last year was no longer available, we really did love Ibara (sp?). He was sure to find us with any updates he thought necessary!

We stayed in royal service both times and couldn't have been more pleased either time! We ended up getting a bali bed 3 times (2 times is promised per each room) and were relieved when we learned our beloved Octavio was still there! On any trip, be sure to meet him at least once during your stay! He makes you feel right at home and treats you as family. :)

This time around we had an opportunity to check out their 'Club Melia', which if you are current travelers, I highly recommend you check it out! Marta was so great at setting us up for the meeting, and also showed us great compassion through out the trip. Mily was the one who helped us the most in the process. AMAZING doesn't begin to cover her customer service. If you land at this resort, GO SEE HER!

The food, as always, was spectacular. Even in the buffet. I could have eaten there every night. Such a wide variety of food. However, our favorite, was the market grill. FABULOUS! Don't miss out on this gem!

The people that work here are some of the most amazing people I have had the pleasure of meeting. They all remember you, your name, and your faces... No matter the fact they see hundreds a day! I, honestly, cant see us going to any other resort in the Cancun area. Others will never measure up to the beauty and hospitality that Paradisus could! (we are very picky people)

There are many names of staff that I have left out, to be honest, I can't quote all of the fabulous people we met and came into contact with. I'd give this place a 20 star rating, if I could.

reviews.author: Isis O
reviews.title: I loved the people the most.
reviews.text: This place is amazing! Arturo is the best worker there! There is so many activities to do. It's a relaxing place that has great food and service. The beach is breathtaking and so close. You don't even have walk there. I would definitely come back. It was very hard to leave and I'm sure that everyone will enjoy this paradise.

reviews.author: Denise O
reviews.title: Nice place on the beach!
reviews.text: I just spend six nights here for a business meeting.  The architecture is stunning; the main lobby is full of lucious plants and trees.  Given that the property is on the beach and salt water can make upkeep a challenge, management does a great job.  We were on a resort plan which included most meals.  The restaurants were nice; the wait staff quite good.  However, there is only one breakfast buffet which was always very full.  The best tables in the Brazilian themed restaurant on out on the balcony.  Two areas of concern - all the floors are glossy tile or stone.  They can be a little fightening if damp / slick.  Also several of my colleagues agreed with me that the in-room A/C units are very loud making it hard to sleep.  Overall, if you want a beach resort experience, you should be happy at the Paradisus.

reviews.author: Anita W
reviews.title: Butler Service
reviews.text: The employees are usually very friendly and attentive. The Butler service is a joke, it's better to handle it on your own the first day you arrive. Make your own reservations for dinner and Bali beds. The pool employees are very nice and helpful. I still loved the Royal Service but the Butler was a huge disappointment. Although all inclusive means gratuities are included you will get better service if you tip.

reviews.author: PecanSandy
reviews.title: Nice, standard all-inclusive
reviews.text:
My mom, aunt, cousin, and I had a girls' getaway at Paradisus Cancun. I have stayed at 3 other resorts in Riviera Maya, and, though the resort was very nice, it was not my favorite. 

The positives: We stayed in the main tower (tower three), and our room was great. It was clean and spacious, though there was no balcony furniture in either of our rooms. The Thierry Mugler toiletries are a nice touch. Staying in the main tower was key! We had wanted to upgrade to Royal Service, but it wasn't available, and I'm glad we didn't as the primary reason we wanted to do that was to get guaranteed seats at the private pool. But the main pool with the swim up bar was so much fun that I wouldn't have wanted to be in the private area! The resort had a diverse clientele which I appreciated, and they were all really fun and cordial. There weren't a lot of kids at the time I went. The nightclub/bar that opened late at night was super fun with a good DJ and a fun crowd. I also loved the make your own Bloody Mary bar (we put them in "to go" cups and took them to the pool!) and the juice bar at breakfast. 

The constructives: Most of the issues I had were around the pool b/c that's what I was there to do (swim and relax!). The biggest issue (which other reviewers have said) is that you literally need to get to the pool by 6:30am to get a good seat. Thankfully the moms are early risers and would get there at sunrise to reserve the seats. The main pool is extremely deep. There are no shallow areas (except near the kids area), and after a few drinks at the swim up bar, that's a struggle! The Zumba and  water aerobics were fun, though they were sometimes not offered with no notification. The pool water turned the white parts of our suits green, and we are still struggling to get it out using RIT and other whiteners. The food was average but as expected for an all-inclusive. We ate at the buffet most of the time b/c you can only make reservations for all the other restaurants one day in advance, and when the line opens at 7am, it is busy and reservations are often gone shortly after that. 

Bottom line is if you can get a good deal through Expedia or somewhere else, this is a solid hotel to stay in (just pack your alarm clock and a non-white bathing suit!).

reviews.author: CatGal_10
reviews.title: Not recommended for young families
reviews.text:
This 3rd time back to Cancun, first time at the Paradisus.. Stayed at this resort with my spouse, toddler and 6 month old baby. I want to like this resort; as there is a lot to love: the beach, the pools, the indoor gardens, architecture of the building, the cleanliness and most of the service personnel. 

However I cannot recommend this resort to families with young children.

There is a consistent lack of accessibility and accommodation for young children, particularly if you require the use of a stroller. The beach is not wheelchair/stroller accessible, you have to walk down 25 plus stairs to get to it, there is no ramp. The few times I went to the beach without my spouse, some members of the staff saw me going up/down and offered NO assistance for carrying the stroller up/down the stairs. We stopped using our stroller after a couple days...

If you are not on the beach by 7 AM, to secure a shaded spot, you may as well forget it! There are no beach (portable) umbrellas, just straw roofed permanently installed umbrellas. And you have to keep an eye on your spot. Even if you leave your personal belongings under the umbrellas, staff will remove them to vacate for others. There are bali beds for rent, but they are for adults only (on the beach). Around the pool are dozens of bali bed huts, for rent, which take up the space of the umbrellas… not good if you have small children and you’re trying to shade them from the sun.

Stay away from tower 3 (the central tallest pyramid), it’s the noisiest especially in the evenings, as all the bars/lounges are located on the 1st floor. It’s also very hot and humid, as per the building design, it is a greenhouse, with palm trees growing on the ground floor.

Food choices on the buffet were good some days, others not much. Overall repetitive but there is was something there for everyone. I found the breads to be stale every day. Deserts were consistently good. However one thing they never had was ice cream which would have been welcome. Restaurants we tried were La Perla (recommend the flank steak), Market Grill (brazilian rodrizio style meat on a sword shaved onto your place, but not too many choices of meat, therefore do not recommend), Vento (delicious tapas, make sure you get 3 cold, 3 warm), and Ibana (Japanese sushi was okay). Many other restaurants at the resort, however some are adult only.

The Kidszone which is a large colourful room on the ground floor of the 2nd tower, lacks toys, bouncy castle rarely inflated. The staff seemed to be doing activities with the kids, however I noticed there was always a bunch of tweens at the far end just playing video games. We did get to watch a magic show that was put on for the kids, which was a pleasant surprise. We asked at the beginning of the week if there was a kiddy pool, and were told that there wasn’t… however there is a kids pool, at the far rightside of the adult pool, behind La Perla. There are no signs giving directions to kids pool, only found the pool on our 2nd last day of our stay…Kids pool has no slides, or splash pad, just happens to be shallow enough. 

The rooms are standard, nothing spectacular about them. We arrived around 11 AM, and had to waiting for our rooms until 2 PM, not practical when travelling with young children. The crib provided in our room was ridiculous low, with a very high railing. I am 5’8” (173 cm) tall, and had a hard time reaching/placing my baby in the crib. Housekeeping was not on a consistent schedule, first two days our room was done before lunch, the remaining in the afternoon/evening, which was challenging when I have a baby and toddler napping after lunch.

And then let’s talk about the odours/smells: The elevators smell very musty. Then the ground floor and lobby are overpowered with spa-like scents on steroids that just gave me a headache.

I have to say, the one positive thing, was most  staff were attentive and hard working.  I have to give praise and a Shout-out to the following staff: Gregorio, Guillermo, Jorge, Sandra, David.

reviews.author: Jenmilan
reviews.title: Loved Paradisus Cancun!
reviews.text:
We had an absolutely lovely vacation at this resort.

The food was spectacular at Tempo & Fuego in particular.  Our rooms were clean and the staff was always friendly and more than helpful and efficient.  Paradisus Cancun had plenty of staff outside catering to all of your drink or general service needs as well.

The ambiance of the hotel in the evening in particular was beautiful and it just created a relaxing atmosphere.

I had never been to an all-inclusive hotel before and I was delighted by my choice.  I would highly recommend this hotel.  

The only down side was that the current is particularly rough apparently this season, so swimmers beware.  All beach hotels on the water on this side of Cancun would be faced with the same situation and this is obviously out of Paradisus' control.  Just err on the side of cautious.

Truly I have never seen such a hard working, concientious staff.  The hotel was spotless and everyone seemed to be smiling.

I LOVED the gym & spa area and loved that they offered both chlorophyll & bottled water.  Again, the ambiance and cleanliness, organization and selection of services offered was top notch.

I would highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Dayna P
reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: The hotel was wonderful from the service to the amenities.  However, you NEED a reservation at one of the 10 restaurants FAR in advance or you cannot get in anywhere but the buffet. This information was never relayed to us and we found out the hard way.  They booked by 2pm Friday for Saturday night reservations.

reviews.author: Jose Adalberto F
reviews.title: Unforgetable
reviews.text: Nice atmosphere, excellent facilities, the employees at Royal services including the swimpool services are by far one the best that I have had so far. It is a resort that I would be back in the future with my family and friends.

reviews.author: Stacey M
reviews.title: Best Vacation of our Lives!!
reviews.text:
From check in to check out our stay was absolutely amazing!!! I had e-mailed the staff at Paradisus a week or so prior to arrival and they were super helpful in answering any questions we had, especially Natalia Acosta, assistant manager of Royal Service. Our butler, Ibarra, was always super helpful if we needed anything and always made sure to check on us whenever he saw us around. Leo, the bell boy, was super friendly and made our check out a pleasant experience. Every staff member we came across was so nice and the service we received during our entire stay was excellent. 

As far as the restaurants and food go, we didn't have any complaints!  Our favorite was Bana, which had amazing sushi and our waiter was the best. Our second favorite was Mole, which had fantastic Mexican cuisine along with live entertainment. All the restaurants and buffets had great food, especially considering the amount of people they have to accommodate. In the Royal Service section you have your own mini breakfast buffet that was super convenient when Naos, the main buffet, was a bit packed. In the Royal Service you also get your own pool, beach, and one restaurant, La Palapa. We were able to reserve a bali bed for two days and it was a very relaxing experience! Not to mention we had gorgeous views all around. 

We stayed on the 7th floor in pyramid 5 (Royal Service) and had the most gorgeous view of the blue waters. When our butler Ibarra walked us into the room the first day we were in awe. This resort definitely set high standards for any of our future trips - we may not even stay anywhere else and just come back to Paradisus! We loved it so much that we were even considering having a destination wedding and this resort.

reviews.author: Kristy G
reviews.title: Great pool waiter, good food and fun atmosphere!
reviews.text: I went to Paradisus Cancun with my mom and sister, celebrating our mom's 70th birthday!   The food and drinks were good, drinks not watered down at all!  Our best part was our pool waiter, Victor Chale, he was wonderful.  Brought water us, without even asking.  He would bring us fun fruity drinks to try and remembered what we were drinking the day before.  He was our pool waiter for 3 days... always smiling and happy!   He worked 8 hours in the hot sun and was wonderful, he made are pool days awesome!!!!  The atmosphere and shows were good, all ages can enjoy the resorts!

reviews.author: Tigerfan0_0_12
reviews.title: Great Vacation!
reviews.text: I took my mother to Paradisus Cancun for her Birthday!  It was wonderful!  Great food, people and beautiful accommodations.  The staff was especially wonderful and very friendly.  Our Pool Waiter named Victor Chale was very friendly, helpful and gave us great pool side service.  Victor was always smiling and took care of all our drink and food needs in a timely fashion!  He made  our trip!!! I would highly recommend this place if your looking for a relaxing and no hassle vacation!!

reviews.author: Robert S
reviews.title: Mackinac
reviews.text:
It is very clear that customer service is a top priority of the Paradisus.  From the moment you arrive at the front door until the moment you get into your taxi to leave, the entire staff truly appreciates you and the fact that you chose their resort for your vacation.  We have been on many family vacations and I have never encountered any place, other than the Paradisus, where the entire staff, from the maintenance staff to the General Manager, greeted you in such a pleasant way.
I would like to point out two individuals that went out of their way to make our stay very comfortable; Flora and Victor, at the beach and pool service area, were both unbelievably efficient and friendly.  
We spent our time mainly on the beach and used the 9 hole golf course every day, both areas were extremely well taken care of and made our vacation very relaxing.  The longest hole on the par 3 course is 117 yards so you only need to bring a few clubs to enjoy this course.

reviews.author: Serafin M
reviews.title: Dream Vacation in Cancun
reviews.text: This was without a doubt the most amazing vacation we've taken to date. Everything from the check in to the amenities were excellent. The staff remembered every detail and the staff at the restaurants even knew what we liked, drinks, etc. Will be returning in the near future.

reviews.author: Speavs
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: Paradisus was an awesome experience. Staff was very friendly and plan to go back soon! The beach and water was the most beautiful I have ever seen but the only thing it lacks is beach music by the pool.

reviews.author: Eva Z
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun is recommended for those looking for all inclusive resorts without sacrificing luxury. The place itself is beautiful and spacious with welcoming staff. My boyfriend and I came to relax and just get away so we were both blown by the experience here compared to other all inclusive resorts we've stayed in. We had an ocean view room so we woke up every morning to the blue Mexican sky and bluer water. The rooms were clean meticulously everyday and the girl that cleaned our room was so friendly! (We stayed in room 3610) 

Every morning when we went down to NAOS for breakfast, the waitstaff was super friendly and cheerful. Actually, I take that back, the waitstaff was super friendly 24/7. Might I add the numerous food possibilities from morning to night? Room service is included as well and they have a handful of restaurants and bars to choose from for dinner and late night drinks (these are all included as well) every night. Room service and the minibar in your room is included as well. 

The pool is sparkling clean, the entire resort is always kept pristine. The only problem I had was with the waitstaff in La Perla, I had asked for a rare steak but the waiter said it might be too soft for me and he'll make it taste better (language barrier? I don't know.) Anyway, my steak came out well done which was too overcooked for me. The guy restocking our room's mini-fridge also stopped restocking for us after the third day, for some odd reason. Room service was great, however. It's like a genie in a lamp, you say your wishes and BAM! All is well and fixed. 

Overall, I highly recommend this resort. I lived in a regular ocean view junior suite so I can't say much about family concierges or royal service although if our service was this great, it should be even better. Family concierges have their own private check in/out spot with a game room for kids and royal service has their own restaurant as well as more VIP perks. 

Paradisus, you've ruined the rest of Cancun's all-inclusive resorts for me. This spoiled NYC girl is definitely coming back again!

reviews.author: AmyF91764
reviews.title: Lots to recommend, great facility, wonderful service
reviews.text: Relied on reviews from trip advisor and booked 5 days for a getaway with my husband.  We got a great deal on Hotwire.  The best part is the beach, which is lovely.  If you are looking for a place to spend time relaxing by the water- either the ocean or one of 3 pools, this is a great optin.  The room was spacious, clean and well-appointed.  Note that this is a huge resort, and as such lacks the intimacy of a smaller facility.  Also, the food is ok, but predictable, and not the highlight.  However, the service is exceptional.  Friendly and willing to go the extra mile to guarantee comfort and satisfaction.  Overall, we were very pleased, and would return.

reviews.author: Mary G
reviews.title: Not all they seem to be
reviews.text:
Well, this is a normal basic 3 star hotel. I don't know where they get the nerve to call it 4 or some even 5 star hotel. I’m highly disappointed too at trypadvisor as they awarded an excellence award in 2013. Boy has trypadvisors standards gone down the drain. They give an award to anyone now days. I remember when this actually mean something but now, uff. 

Back to the hotel, Hotel is nice. Great location. A little outdated but so are most hotels in the hotel zone.  So the selling point if their outstanding service. Reading previous comments, I could not believe it that much till it happen to us. Wanting an A+ experience, we took the Royal Service package. For the high price plus additional cost for Royal Service - What a waste of money! Technically the only benefit you get is a butler, that if you’re lucky they answer their phone, then you’re in heaven. But not us. They will take care of all your reservations. BUT that doesn't mean you will get one or at a decent time. ESPECIALLY if the butler has an afternoon shift as all reservations for a good time slot are to be made before 8am. If your butler arrives for work in the afternoon, guess what? You are out of luck. And they say no one else can help you as he’s your butler. 

Furthermore, all the offerings on their website are not good / valid. Reserved Cabana beds while you’re there? You only get 2 per stay. If you want more, you need to get on a waiting list and then be on top of the people who assign them as if someone shows up with a large bank roll, you are out of luck. 

Service – waiters are almost nonexistent. If you want something, lots of times, you have go get it yourself.

Check in – almost 2 hours. Not because the room was not ready. But because our butler was not in to start his shift and no one else could help us according to them. Then only 2 people checking in patrons with a huge line. So much for Royal Service. 

Check out – at breeze. No issues here other than only 1 person doing check outs in the morning. So a little slow

Food – most of the food served is at room temperature or cold. Only hot meal we had was at the Market Grill. And good luck trying to get a reservation. Unless you want to have dinner at 6pm or past 10pm, you are out of luck. HOWEVER, all restaurants are half empty most of the time. Talking to several waiters and hotel staff, these actions are encouraged by the hotel management to push people to go out for food not using their restaurants, thus eating less thus increasing their bottom line. Which makes sense. It’s a business. BUT don't make it so obvious! Spoon feed us something to make us believe the restaurants are full because of the great food. They are just that dumb.  

Room service – good selection. Food is a C+ / B-. However the fastest we got our food was 1.5 hours! Least was 1.5 hours the most we waited was a hair under 3 hours. 

Mini- bar in room – if you drink / eat everything in there, good luck trying to get them to re-stock. They question you as if you were a criminal. 

So, in conclusion, this is a 3 star hotel with great location and not so good staff. For this money you can stay at any other location as this is one of the priciest places around. I highly recommend you opt out of Royal Service as you are practically giving them your money obtaining practically nothing (other than 2 Cabana reservations per stay) 

Maybe it was a fluke and my stay was horrible just for us. But I can tell you that while complaining, at least 5 other couples where there too doing the same. If you stay there, good luck. Maybe you’ll do better than us.

reviews.author: Jose C
reviews.title: Difficult place for business
reviews.text:
I visited this hotel for a business trip where I was presenting as a guest speaker for a business convention. The experience was dreadful , the first night they would not let me meet with the organizer since I was not staying at the hotel and I was forced to pay $85usd for a night pass in order to meet with him in one of the locations of the convention center. Instead of offering a solution like meeting at the lobby or business center I was pushed to buy the night pass (bracelet ).
Once in the service was slow the cafe (indoors) was awfully hot and my drink was made with cheap liquor ( after 85 entry fee I expected something better ). The day of the conference everything was just a sign that this hotel time had passed. Terrible coffee service ( and old coffee pot bowling all day ) almost no electrical outlets in the convention center and noisy AC on the conference rooms. This might be great for tourists but not for business travelers and conventions

reviews.author: Rachel P
reviews.title: beautiful beach, beautiful hotel
reviews.text:
Stayed in the Royal Service Building 5 for adults only. Was very pleased with the friendliness of the staff and cleanliness of the hotel. Mericio, the pool concierge, was very nice. Courtesy beach bag use during the stay and suntan lotion by the pool. 
Didnt really see a need for a personal butler. 
Reservations at the resturants are hard to get for prime time. Buffet was sufficient and had good food. 
Would book this hotel again for couples or family trip

reviews.author: NELLY_77
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun was a delight
reviews.text: Really enjoyed my stay at this hotel. They have an amazing beach, pool and staff. Thanks so much to Efrain in the lobby!  Can't wait to go back!!! The staff was truly wonderful, always polite and helpful. I enjoyed my food, drinks and night shows at the Avenue Bar.

reviews.author: Cheri H
reviews.title: Exceeded Expectations
reviews.text: I stayed with two other girlfriends at the Paradisus in late April 2014 for a short girls getaway.  The resort is beautiful!  There are several restaurants, shops, spa, beach club, etc.  It was wonderful.  We did not even leave the resort.  We spend all day relaxing on the beach in our cabana in the Cocos beach club area being cared for by Gorge and Luis.  These gentlemen were amazing, genuinely sweet, and took great care to ensure we relaxed and were pampered on our vacation.  The food in the restaurants was very good.  The buffet food was fine, but after a couple of days we were ready for a change.  Make reservations to the restaurants as early as allowed because they fill up fast.  FYI - sunscreen in the hotel is excessively expensive, so plan ahead and bring plenty from home.  We had an oceanview junior suite that three of us shared.  It was roomy, the beds were comfortable, the view was beautiful.  This is one of the best resorts I have stayed at in Cancun and we found it to be a terrific value.  The service was amazing, and everyone was very attentive.  I would return.  And I would ask for Gorge and Luis.

reviews.author: Randa S
reviews.title: Not worth the 4 1/2 stars it gets...
reviews.text:
The hotel itself is very clean and very close to the beach which I appreciated for sure.aside from that,the housekeeping sometimes didn't come in until 3 pm sometimes earlier too.at 8:00 am or 8:30 am don't remember the music and the waterfalls in the lobby comes on at the loudest setting waking people from their deepest slumber!! (Why don't they let people decide what time they want to wake up? We are on a vacation after all?) the food at the buffet sucks and the service is too slow,we had to wait in a long line for a piece of a tough tiny steak to be cook and so on,there is not a lot of variety.we made reservation at the other restaurants over there some were alright nothing extraordinary and again it takes too long.
There is only one 1 person at the concierge desk ,pretty much one person at every station,so god help you if you need to address an issue and there a person ahead of you,honesty I had to wait many half hours before someone addressed me.
The last straw came 2 days before we left,when as usual when my mom reserved our lounge chair by the pool by 7am ,and someone came by 10am and decide to sends our stuff to lost and found so she can take our reserved chairs because by then we are by the beach and pool and everywhere ( we're a family of 6) and we only reserve 3 chair to be reasonable. Of course I threw a fit because I've had enough of the bull.... Happening over there,I went to the supervisor in tears and vented about everything that happened (there is a lot more) but for the sake of writing I'm simplifying. What he offered me was a half an hour massage by an unlicensed massage therapist ,she didn't know what the heck she was doing.so my final point I will never pay again the 11000$ I paid to go there,because we took 2 rooms.

reviews.author: K P
reviews.title: Loved Cancun minus a couple of hiccups..
reviews.text:
My husband and another couple visited Cancun from April 24-28 and stayed at the Paradisus Cancun resort. This was our first time in Mexico so we didn't go with any sort of heightened expecatations and were just looking to relax and enjoy our vacation.

The resort we stayed was massive and had a beautiful ambience. The staff took special care of cleanliness and we were always acknowledged with a warm hello each time we passed any of them. We booked the Royal Service area which is adults only and came with a butler service. I would still recommend to go the Royal Service route however our experience with the butler wasn't all it's made up to be on their website.

We didn't get a cell phone to contact our butler and he was only on the resort after 3pm. Only 1 of our a la carte dinner's were actually reserved when they advertise all reservations are guaranteed when done through the butler. On top of that, he didn't bother letting us know that he wasn't able to get our confirmed reservation so we'd get ready and go to the restaurant to realized there was no reservation at all. At Bana, the sushi restaurant, the manager told us he came half an hour before our supposed reservation to try and get us one. So, for the 4 nights we stayed, we went to Vento (Tapas) and Bana (after arguing many times). It's also advertised that you are guaranteed 2 uses of the bali beds during your stay if you book with Royal Service--this is also untrue. Each time we'd approach the staff our our butler, they'd say the beds were fully booked but many of the beds were not being used the entire day. My cousin then tipped the butler $20 to get us a bed and magically one became available. I understand that tipping is the norm at all inclusive resorts however I tip if I feel it's deserved not because its required. 

Regardless of the issues with the butler, I did enjoy the Royal Service section just because it was quiet and relaxing. I enjoyed the private pool because it wasn't crowded and noisy and so I would recommend that section if you're considering this resort. My husband and cousin enjoyed the self-serve bar very much and they had top shelf liquor available at all times. The mini desserts set out in the evening were lovely and I liked that you could munch on snacks at any time.

The rooms were very clean and the daily cleaning service was excellent. Overall good experience but the butler wasn't on par.

reviews.author: Mark856
reviews.title: Had a great time
reviews.text:
We have stayed at three other all inclusive's in cancun and his was our favorite.  The food was great with lots of variety in the buffet -naos, and the market grill for dinner was very good albeit a bit slow.  We had a slightly hard time getting reservations at the other restaurants as the line was very busy, but were happy with the buffet.  We felt no need to eat at any other outside places.  Neither of us had any GI issues.   The wait staff was very friendly and helpful.  We both thought the food was the best of the places we've been to (the flamingo, riu caribe and riu cancun)
There were some kids around but we didn't see them messing with any food dishes at all.
We had no problems with check in or out, were able to check in immediately on arrival at about 2:30 pm
The bartenders were very friendly and skilled and we noticed the liquor was better than average.  
Our room with a lagoon view was very nice and clean and the maid service was very good.  We enjoyed the shower, had good water pressure and temp.  Tv was decent, beds were comfy.
The beach is beautiful, the palapas were large and fairly numerous.  I went down at 7:30 each morning to make sure we had one but could have waited till 9:00 and still had one.  
I played at the on site golf course, cost about 25$ for equipment and balls.  Is a 9 hole par three with every hole about 100-120.  Greens were shaggy and unevenly mowed, so not a great golfing experience but I've played worse places.
The lobby and central area of the pyramid were gorgeous. The pools were in good shape and clean.
The woman who checked us in pushed hard for us attend a time share meeting which was supposed to have been 90 minutes. Since we were only there for a few days, we didn't want to spend that amount of time, although they offered a free massage to go to it.  Found out from another couple we met it was actually over 2 hours and very pressured, so glad we didn't choose to do that.
We would be happy to make a return to the paradisus!!!

reviews.author: Gio B
reviews.title: Trip to cancan
reviews.text: I had a great experience in paradisus cancan, all restaurants have great food, but Bana sushi restaurant is a special place to eat, first of all it has a great service, and great food. I want mention one of the server who gave me and my girl a special service. He shared as Mexican traditions and offered special drink which I have never tried in my life. His name is Eric. Awesome service. I will come back again. It s really paradise.

reviews.author: RM D
reviews.title: Friendly & Happy workers
reviews.text: We arrived Sunday morning, they checked us in at the Family Concierge which was really nice, no line, treated like VIP. They provided all types of drinks, candys, cakes, cookies during the process. Told us we have a personal butler, gave us a cellphone so we can call the butler anytime. 24 hour room service is included, minibar was filled with sodas, water and can beers, nothing really special but it's nice to have. Bathroom is big, room is modern, all the workers from concierge, butler, waiters, pool attendants everyone there are very friendly, happy and have sense of humors. Food and drinks can use some improvement. Taste are okay not the best, drinks kind of watery. You need to make reservation for dinner which is not convenient, we are there to laid back, forget about scheduling like working days. Beach are BEAUTIFUL, equipped with all furnitures you might need.

reviews.author: Patty B
reviews.title: Paradise found!
reviews.text:
I was on a business/leisure trip and was just so very pleased with the Paradisus Cancun. It exceeded my expectations in every way!  Just a short and easy drive from Cancun Intl Airport, the hotel is Beautiful, on a most amazing stretch of white sand beach and the dining and meal/drinks service was impeccable.
I would like to personally commend Ms. Ivana at Restaurant Naos for her superb and friendly service.  She truly went to great lengths to see that everything was seamless. 
 I would also like to acknowledge Mr. Israel Ortiz, Regional Sales Manager, for his Excellence in representing his property and chain and making us feel like family!
I already have my next trip to the Paradisus Cancun planned! Hasta Pronto!

reviews.author: teresa8_10
reviews.title: GREAT TIME AT THIS HOTEL
reviews.text: We were a group of 6 ladies celebrating a birthday in Cancun, we stayed at this hotel for a week, it is a  very large hotel which was a bit disorientating at first , we were in pyramid 1 . Check in was very slow and staff didn't seem to know were we were supposed to be, after a 10 hour flight this was a bit of a pain. when we settled in everyone thought it was great. Swimming pools were a bit deep for non-swimmers but lovely , beach was beautiful with waiter service for drinks, lots of sun beds and umbrellas, staff were excellent very friendly especially breakfast staff, Orlando worked very hard too please.  restaurants very good but have too be booked in advance except the buffet which had plenty of choice,  bars good too .Paradisus is a ride away from Cancun which was fine for us, we got a taxi in twice. overall i would recommend this hotel as we had a great time there

reviews.author: Felipe
reviews.title: Good All Inclusive Experience
reviews.text: Formerly Gran Melia Cancun, this hotel is not on the top of the top of cancun, but it's right below that level. Went there for a conference/tradeshow. Group Check-in was a bit messy, but by the time I got to my room the bell staff had my bag in there already. Room was really nice, but not outstanding. Had a very nice view, a big balcony and a decent bathroom. Didn't like the shower that much, but the rest was nice. The pool was very nice, as was the service at the bar over there. Burgers for lunch were very good. The other restaurants were good for an all inclusive, but again, nothing outstanding. Breakfast buffet was very nice though. Fitness Center was very well equipped and always empty. Conferece facilities were great.

reviews.author: Tamika C
reviews.title: Close to Perfect Vacation!
reviews.text:
I have been to multiple all inclusive resorts and this is my first review and first time in Cancun, Mexico.
Myself along with my boyfriend stayed at the Paradisus Cancun for my birthday, arriving May 24 through May 29, 2013. 
We arrived at 12:30pm and our room was available to check in. Our bags were brought to our rooms by bellman. The room was very spacious (oceanfront suite) with king bed, sofa, dinette, and small fridge. I was expecting liquor in the room but only canned beer which was nice. The bathroom was a good size and the balcony had an amazing view of one of the pools and the ocean. Jacuzzi on the balcony although  it would have taken hours to fill the thing. (Water flow was horrible)
Overall very clean!
The lobby and sitting areas throughout the hotel were amazing and nicely decorated. Plenty of couches and lounge areas for a full resort. The WIFI throughout the resort was great as well except in the room itself. 
We did not do any of the restaurants requiring reservations and stuck with buffet, which was overall good. We returned to the resort around 330am from a night out and able to get delicious burgers and hotdogs at that time. 
There seemed to be 3 pools, one of which was mostly children and families. The pool with swim up bar was the most popular and the Sangria was perfecto! 
The hotel itself was very close to the downtown area. We walked right out to the main road and caught the bus to the local Mall which was about 10 min away. The area seemed to be safe and we didn't have any problems.
I did get sick the last day of our trip and had all the symptoms of Mantazumas's revenge:( 
The hotel/resort overall was VERY nice and I would book again. Staff was very friendly and even took the time out of their work day to entertain us in our attempt to learn Spanish :)

reviews.author: Azra B
reviews.title: Pretty good vacation, considering the circumstances!
reviews.text:
We stayed at this hotel for 7 days and we were satisfied with overall everything. The hotel offers a $1000 gift card to use at the hotel upon arrival, however, they dont tell you that it is coupons in certain denominations for specific things. We were hoping to use the "gift card" on massages, but once we got there, we realized we got 3 coupons for massages which were $50 each, yet the massages are $110 and up. Aside from this, everything else was fairly good. The rooms were clean and we didnt have any problems in there, although some patio furniture would be nice (there was only one chair). The restaurants are super easy to book, all you have to do is dial 0 from your room and you can book them right away. There was always availability when we phoned. The food was also very good; we quite enjoyed the Mexican restaurant and also the Tempo restaurant (the second one you have to pay for, but we ended up using the coupons I spoke of). The buffet is open until 11pm also and has a variety of foods and it was also delicious, so if you go for dinner at a restaurant and you dont enjoy it, you always have the option of going to the buffet. The Avenue Bar and the Red Lounge (the main bar and nightclub) were probably my favourite parts of this hotel. It is very modern and theres always good music and the service was impeccable! It is a great place to meet people as well. The beach and the pools are pretty nice, the staff brings you drinks AND food right to your chair regardless if you are royal service or not (I found the better you tip, the better the service...and its a good idea to tip first thing in the morning when you get to the pool so then they will take care of you). 

The one thing I must warn people about is: BE CAREFUL WHEN WASHING YOUR FEET OFF AT THE BEACH! When I said in the title "considering the circumstances', that is because I broke my ankle while I stayed at this hotel! On our second day here, I tripped and fell on the cement where you wash your feet before going into the hotel or the pool. It is usually covered in sand, and you cannot see there is a ledge so my foot ran into it and broke :( I ended up in a cast for the remainder of my trip. The life guards were very helpful once they saw me, but it was pretty difficult to get a wheelchair from the main desk for the rest of my trip. They wanted me to rent it, even though the accident happened at the hotel. I did end up getting it from them, but it was to the point where I had to cry in order for them to give it to me. They explained that they only had one wheelchair for the entire hotel, so if any other emergencies were to occur, they would need it for the other person. I understood this, but I also needed them to understand that it was difficult getting around the hotel with crutches all day everyday, especially with marble floors which were sometimes wet! (Very easy to break another leg!)

Despite all of this, I still had fun and I still came back with good memories. There were 4 staff members that I will never forget! They completely made this trip totally worth it and I cannot thank them anymore for their hospitality, amazing service, and their amazing personalities! German, Coral, Denisse and Antonio (who were all working at the Avenue Bar when I was there) were truly the reason that I enjoyed my trip as much as I did. We got to know each other on our first day here, they were extremely nice and entertaining! Everyday after that just kept getting better with them! Especially since I was in a cast, they were totally helpful and always paid attention to my needs. A special thank you goes out to them for everything they did and all the memories we shared. If I come back to this resort, it will definitely be because of these 4 people!

reviews.author: Emilio G
reviews.title: awesome
reviews.text:
just spent a week there, and didn't want to comeback actually..service was awesome, food was awesome, MARGARITAS a must, the only bad thing was that they tried to sell you the melia membership, and activities over and over, to many questions were asked...
but at the end i understand , they were just doing their job, its not their fault as their bosses fault
but overall GREAT 
not a fan of repeating vacations,places, but this one its on my list to consider for returning..

reviews.author: tom d
reviews.title: worst vacation ever
reviews.text: we had reservations for 22 may thru 28 may, at check in we were told we had no room!  That the air was out, this was an outright lie, they had a large tour group coming and were overbooked.  we were moved to paradisus resourt an hour from cancun in the jungle, this was not what we paid for, if this is the way paradisus treats guests never again, beware, lie No 2 promised a 4 night stay in the future which we did not get.  we did get moved back after the tour group left for a day and a half, in that time we move rooms twice beware of this hotel, they are dishonest.

reviews.author: Marla N
reviews.title: Wonderful Getaway
reviews.text:
We had an amazing time on our first couple getaway for our anniversary. We started with a wonderful welcome and cocktails in the Royal Service lounge area. The concierge staff was very helpful Lourdes and Idei, as well as the evening staff. Our butler Jaun was extremly polite, friendly, and at our service. He was very attentative and alway seeking how he could make our stay more enjoyable. They insisted to bring us anything we needed. The pool attendant staff were awesome Serigio and Vincente, they truly ran to make sure guests were comfortable, well supplied with sunscreen, got the bali beds they desired, herbal water, fruit, you name it. The pool serving staff were also amazing. We didn't need to leave our bali bed if we didn't want to. 

The grounds are beautiful and very well manicured. Everyone who worked there was warm and friendly, always a hello, smile, and "anything I can get for you."

The perfect place to relax, walk on the beach, hang out in the many beautiful pools, or in a bali bed. We stayed mostly in the adult only area. The swim up bar was nice, but crowded w/too many young smoking drunks after a while. We like to sip our fine cocktails.

The food was excellent, make sure to have reservations as we did. 
Tempo was a spectacular meal, and very good wait staff. We ordered off the menu instead of tasting and wine pairing which as great after a sunburnt day. 
Mole was delicious the service was a little slow, but we didn't mind.
Bana the sushi restaurant was a bit dissapointing for all the fresh fish in the area, but again didn't mind. The service was great. 
Palampa was great in the afternoon for ordering lunch at the pool. 
Naos was amazing for breakfast, and lunch. Huge selection, lots of fresh fish options. The morning made to order smoothies and juices were great. 
The Royal Service lounge was spectacular to relax w/a drink or cappuccino, and delicate snack. 
The Spa attendant were very friendly and helpful. We went in the evenings every day. 
We can't wait to plan our return trip, and may even consider the family concierge w/the kids. 
There is not much in evening entertaiment, especially at night, but we came to relax and be Sea and Pool side. Personally I was happier with out an evening show going on, and enjoyed the quiet after the hot sun. We were sad we missed the tequila tastings though, next time!

reviews.author: Mike M
reviews.title: Great vacation, Fantastic Hotel
reviews.text: We picked this hotel for a 3 night all-inclusive get away and we loved it.  Definitely go for the family concierge and you'll get a royal treatment.  We had a butler assigned to us and a cell phone that we could have used to call the butler or any of the other specialty staff for any assistance or service from anywhere in the hotel.  Just make sure you don't jump in the ocean with the phone in your pocket which would cost you $100.  That was probably the worst part of the stay....but I didn't care because everything else was great.  The other perk of the butler was that she would call us every day for our choice of dinner restaurant and make the necessary arrangements....we just had to show up.  We also had a cabana reserved for us with our name on it every day by the pool......loved it.  The hotel facilities are beautiful inside and out and ocean view rooms are fantastic.  The rooms were nice and clean with a private balcony and the best ocean view ever (we were on the 3rd floor....but I think all floors have a great view).  The hotel has 5 towers, with tower 3 being in the center with the lobby, all the restaurants, shops and other amenities.  You can stay in tower 3 if you don't mind a bit of noise or traffic.  I recommend either tower 4 or 2, for a bit more quiet and you're still close enough to everything.  Stay away from towers 1 and 5 if you want to avoid a lot of walking.   Restaurants were good but nothing to brag about.  We really enjoyed Ventos which was spanish tapas, and Fuegos which was latin fusion.  The beach was phonemonal, the pool was great with a decent kids pool.  The kids club seemed ok as well....nothing too exciting. They had planned a lot of activities throughout the day, however since it was a quite week there was not a lot of kids/boys that were my son's age in the club at that time.  So my son preferred to just hang out with us.  The kids club staff were really friendly though and they really tried to get my son interested in joining them.  He did go for the soccer tryout on the beach.  Thank you to Fernanda, Paty and Juan (the family concierge staff) we had a really great stay.  We would definitely go back to this hotel.

reviews.author: Jesse V
reviews.title: Not worth the $$
reviews.text: The waiter service was amazing (Note: I do provide nice tips)! Wonderful food and restaurants! The facility has lot's of potential but experienced many service outages. Was left with no running water for a day. Another day no hot water or power. These outages also caused the elevators to stop working for a few days. Very difficult to carry a stroller up and down 5 flights of stairs. Pretty major flaws for a so called 4-star, 4-diamond rating. All of this was communicated to management which did a horrible job in providing any resolution or compensation. Management also failed to communicate any of these problems to hotel guests. This resort has plenty of potential if you have the right staff running the place. I would not recommend this hotel especially at the prices they are asking due to the reasons stated. I paid twice as much as most other resorts only to be very disappointed.

reviews.author: zneh
reviews.title: Best resort in Cancun hands down!!!
reviews.text: I am in love with this resort and will be returning with friends and family again. This has to be one if not the best resort on the island. I have stayed in many resorts in Cancun and in other Caribbean locations and this has to be my best. The service is WOW.... and the décor of the lobby with its amazon look is just so relaxing. Andre, the waiter in the buffet restaurant is the best along with everyone else. The rooms are extremely clean. And the Ocean view is just heavenly. I will be returning with others.

reviews.author: lanzarotta
reviews.title: Mothers Day Vacation
reviews.text: This hotel was exactly what we wanted in a Mexican All Inclusive Vacation. The Hotel itself is beautiful - It is three Buildings that are all Pyramid Shape with beautiful Glass tops.  The main part of the Hotel is the middle building where all the restaurants, bars and shops are located. My review is based on the purchase of the Royal Service Package. The Royal Service was outstanding.  From the moment you arrive, you are greeted and wait in a special room and not on any line.  You are then brought by a golf car by your personal Butler (ours was Erik - outstanding) to the Royal Service Building.  The Royal Service Building is nice and peaceful, and very quiet as there are no kids allowed in this building.  We were then greeted by Victor who was an excellent Concierge in the Royal Concierge area - All of the crew in the Concierge were excellent, but Victor really assisted us the most.  The check in process is done while seated at a desk - with a cool cocktail in hand to give a great start to the vacation.  We were offered an upgrade to an Ocean View Suite for $25.00 extra per night - which we chose. Looking back, it really did not matter much, because the other side views the Lagoon, which is just as pretty - maybe not as blue as the Ocean, plus we spent so little time in the room that it was not necessary, but no regrets, as the ocean view is spectacular.  The rooms were extremely clean and well appointed. We had a fridge with sodas and bottled water that was cold, plus about four or five other bottles of water in the room.  They had a turndown service at night which was nice as the towels and toiletries were replaced and the bed all ready for a good nights sleep.  Your butler or the concierge will also get you the pillow type of your choice. The only thing I did not like in the room was that the toilet bowl lid was rusted away where it connected to the bowl and was un-sightly - otherwise, everything else was beautiful in the room.  The Royal Service Building has a private pool with Pool Concierge.  They are all excellent.  At the start of the week, we were basically able to choose a private Bali Bed that is covered by a Tiki Hut complete with two lounge chairs for the sun.  Our private "cabana" was waiting for us every day, complete with about 6 big towels and pillows - It was great.  The wait staff at the pool was also so nice and had new drinks for us as soon as our old ones were looking low.  Part of the Royal Service was a private lunch by the pool with a nice Ala-Carte Menu with very tasty choices.  The only other option for lunch was the buffet.  We usually had the buffet for breakfast.  The Royal Service Building also has a continental Buffet spread and drinks and snacks available all day for the taking.  The restaurants were all good.  Good food.  I liked the Mexican and the Tequileria Restaurants the best.  The Mexican had good Mexican Food that was more upscale and the tequileria had a great Margaritas and Tacos and Snacks.  We also had food at the Brazilian Style Steakhouse which was good.  We ate at the Japanese Restaurant and the Tapas Restaurant and they were just OK - Our last night we ate at the Latin Fusion restaurant and that was good as well.  Each Restaurant, as the Hotel is decorated so beautifully and offers a great ambience for each meal.  The Japanese Restaurant is in the middle of the main building in the Atrium and is surrounded by Coy Fish and fountains and is really beautiful, even if the food was not that great, just sitting their and having a drink was so nice. The Brazilian, Mexican, Tequileria and Latin Fusion are all with a beautiful view of the Ocean.  The Brazilian Restaurant is outside with tons of fans so you do not get too hot.  Their is also a huge buffet that is open every day for Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner.  We had breakfast their every day with plenty of great choices and nice Mimosas to start our day. The wait staff in every place we went were so accommodating.  I did not have one bad experience with any employee, and every single employee that I passed made sure to say hello!  I also used the Spa at the Hotel.  I had an excellent Reflexology treatment that I was able to use a coupon for as well as a discount that they offered that week. The Spa is decorated beautifully and is extremely peaceful. As part of the Royal Service, you have access to use the Spa every day for free.  Their is a pool that is called the Water Ritual that have Jacuzzi style jets to reach every part of an aching body.  Their are also steam and sauna rooms and rain showers.  I gave this hotel a Very Good rating for two reasons. 1 - As with the Water Ritual, every Hot Tub I went into was not "Hot" - Not even warm.  I was having such a nice time, that I did not complain, I was told in the Spa that the water ritual was designed to be just warm, not hot. It would have been great if that water was hot.  I am not sure why they do not think it should be hot, but I was disappointed.  The Second reason is for the food in the Tapas and Japanese Restaurant - could have been better, especially with the beautiful ambience offered in each place.  Especially the Japanese, the sushi offered was a selection that one would get at a supermarket - would have loved to have even seen some Asian-Mexican Fusion sushi offerings. Otherwise, I loved this vacation.  We never left the Hotel and just relaxed by the pool and Ocean every day and had a wonderful Mothers Day Vacation.  I travelled with my Mom as we try to do something every year for Mothers Day that is relaxing and recharging.  This Hotel Delivered.  I am curious to try the other Paradisus Hotels in Playa Del Carmen and the Dominican Republic next!

reviews.author: Tracy J
reviews.title: Great hotel experience
reviews.text: This hotel is close to downtown cancun, shopping, and activities. The rooms are large and very clean. There is a good variety of different restaurants, food is excellent and the staff is great. Everyone is always helpful and ready to serve you. The only thing missing is a hot tub and the pool was cool for being in the month of march. I would return and recommend this hotel to families and couples.

reviews.author: Nicole O
reviews.title: Amazing, Incredible Resort
reviews.text:
I've traveled quite a bit and stayed at a lot of resorts, this resort by far took the prize.
It is stunning,just beautiful..when you pull up to the resort, you would never imagine what the inside looks like..so unique. The lobby was like a mini paradise...
We stayed at the Royal Service side and I highly recommend it.. it was worth every penny, it's more serene, you have your own side of the resort, own pool and own beach area, where your drinks are brought to you...but you can visit the other side as well.. There were 2 employee's there that made the trip even better, Sergio and Consuela, they catered to our every need, made all our reservations and made sure we always had a drink and that we were not in need of anything. And Fred the operations manager is such a great guy as well.
 The pool area and beach was amazing, the water color was different from the other islands, such a bright and beautiful turquoise..My husband and I will definitely be going back there, it was one of the best vacations we have ever had. We would recommend this resort to anyone, you will not be sorry...can't wait to return again...

reviews.author: cookie10
reviews.title: love this hotel
reviews.text:
this hotel was wonderful, from the front security person(hector) to the royal service butler(Samuel) . quick check in, lovely rooms,. pool service with benson, Consuela,fransico, all made this trip one to remember. always ready to  assist you any way they could. beach cabana's were wonderful. food was great. this is from  four ladies that had a great 6 day vacation in paradise.

thank you to all of you again. wonderful people at this hotel.

reviews.author: TatiaBIZ
reviews.title: Fantastic vacation in Cancun
reviews.text: We spent 2 weeks in this hotel and were satisfied with everything ! large variation of food, high service, ocean view !! Beach is great with good service next to. Ocean is beautiful, with white sand. everywhere is cleaned and well organized. we have already planned to come there again this year!!

reviews.author: Donya T
reviews.title: AMAZING RESORT!!!
reviews.text:
Me & 2 of my girlfriends went to Paradisus in Cancun and I have nothing but good things to say about this place. It was my first time in Mexico and I absolutely loved it. ALL of the hotel staff were friendly and gave us great service each time. Our favourites though were German (bartender at Avenue Bar) and Coral & Denisse (waitresses at Avenue Bar & Red Lounge). These people truly made our vacation so special. They always gave us incredible service! My friend had a broken ankle while we were in Cancun and these 3 definitely did everything in their power to help her out. They are such wonderful people and I'm so glad I got a chance to meet them. I would come definitely come back to the resort just to be able to see these guys again. If you get a chance to meet German, get him to make you an Electric Lemonade! He made the best ones!! 

The food at the resort was very good. We went to Vento, Blue Agave, Naos, Mole, Tempo, Bana, & Market Grill. Tempo was my favourite! I wasn't a huge fan of Market Grill for dinner, but for lunch it was amazing. If you go to the pool, order the chicken wings. They're sooo delicious!

This resort is perfect for you if you are trying to go somewhere that isn't too rowdy like Oasis but isn't also dead. Me and my girlfriends are in our early 20s and we love to party but we don't like people screaming and getting out of hand, which is why this resort was perfect for us.

Thank you so much to all the staff at Paradisus for making our vacation truly special, and I especially want to thank German, Denisse, and Coral for everything they did for us and for making our vacation that much better.

reviews.author: Filcan101
reviews.title: Parents' review of a great family resort!
reviews.text:
This review is mostly for parents looking for a great family resort and I found it here at Paradisus Cancun.  You can read everything else about the hotel but not a lot of reviews regarding the family concierge.  I will try to give helpful details as much as I can, especially to parents who don't know what to expect or are looking for a family resort.

When we arrived, we were greeted at the lobby and taken to the family concierge check in right away.  The girls were given a Paradisus Cancun backpack.  15 minutes later and we are on our way to the room.

My girls, ages 2 and 5, immediately opened their backpacks and inside were sand toys and bucket, toothbrush and toothpaste, cap and t-shirt and their own sunscreen.  In the room, the girls had their own beach towels, robe, slippers, baby shampoo, lotion, baby cologne and bug spray.  There's free wi-fi with good reception so no complaints. There is also an activity schedule for adults and kids for the whole week so you should check it out.

Went to the swimming pool and if you're petite like me, the adult pool's depth goes from 5.5-5.9 ft.  I was on my tiptoes the whole time while the girls swam with their floaties.  There is a kids pool where the kids zone is also located.  You are entitled to use the bali beds 2x for your whole trip, however speak to Juan and if one is available, he will reserve it for you every day.  The hotel was not very busy so we were able to book the same one for the 11 days we were there.  

For your needs, the hotel will provide you almost anything, including babysitting services.  The family concierge really was at at disposal the whole time.  They asked where we wanted to have dinner every night so we booked all the restaurants (except for Mole and Tempo).  The girls had no problem with dinner at any of the restaurants, they ate what they could then conked out halfway through dinner.  There's always the buffet if you have picky eaters.  If you booked babysitting services, the ladies at the family concierge will look after your kids on their days off so it's good to get to know them well.

A special thank you to all the ladies at the Family Concierge, especially Paty.  Also to Juan who especially made our stay at the bali beds very comfortable and always took care of us by bringing us our towels and making sure we were settled in everyday.  We booked an additional 2 days because of them :)  All the staff we encountered were respectful and kind, Francisco from Naos greeted us every morning with an "Ola" and hand to heart, making it feel very sincere.

Take advantage of the Hydrotherapy if you're booked on a family concierge room.  You're entitled to use it everyday.  My hubby and I couldn't get away at all but when we did use it, it really was great!  Especially loved the body jet massage, tres cool!

For any parent who needs more info, send me a message and I'll try to help you as much as I can.  It really was a good trip for a family.  You can read the rest of the reviews from other people regarding food, service, etc.

reviews.author: dameron23
reviews.title: Wonderful!
reviews.text: The nicest staff we have encountered in a long time.  They catered to your every need.  The restaurants had a good wine selection.  The property was clean and beautiful. Excellent customer service!!!  Especially liked Zandra who served at the Naos restaurant!  Will come again!!!

reviews.author: lilin w
reviews.title: Excellent vacation and service
reviews.text:
We traveled May 15 through May 21th Our family had a wonderful time at the Paradisus Cancun specially at japanese restaurant we had excellent service with a waitress '' Veronica'' she gave us very good service and friendly.always kept our room very clean and stocked with fresh towels. 
The beach was beautiful and the pool was very refreshing. We always had great service at both. We preferred going to the swim up bar as we made friends with one of the bartenders.....

reviews.author: Elena M
reviews.title: Royal Service BEST option!
reviews.text:
My boyfriend and I stayed here for a week, we opted for the the Royal Service option when we booked in January.  If you are traveling as a couple do not even hesitate to spend the extra money for the Royal Service Package.  There were a few flaws to the package, but the pros definitely out weigh the cons!

The only problem we really experienced or thought needed some attention were that the butler aspect isn't that amazing. We saw our butler maybe twice, three is pushing it. We made our reservations through him 3 times for 3 different restaurants.  The 2nd night he screwed our reservation up as well as the 3rd (he actually never made it!).  We were also told at check in we were allowed one bottle of our choice of liquor and once again our butler told us they didn't have any and we would definitely have it before we left, in which we did not.  

The Bali beds are the best ever, just make sure to reserve them 1-2 days out. The Bali beds on the beach are the best but ALWAYS booked so reserve at least 2 days in advance.  We were told you are guaranteed 2 beds during your stay but we actually had one 3 days.  La Palapa the restaurant by the pool is yummy! We were never told no for anything.  

Go the extra mile and tip too because you get better treatment! 

We ate at Naos (buffet), Mole, Vento, & Bana. I am a very picky eater and ALWAYS found something to eat! We were not a fan of the buffet...there were always kids running around unsupervised and digging their hands into the foods without the use of utensils (YUCK!).
The other restaurants were great though! The drinks were so so. 

We both suffered stomach issues from the food & drinks & water from this resort though.

We have stayed at other resorts in Cancun, and this one is STILL the BEST!  Check-In was a bit LONG! No one helps you carry your bags to checkout so be prepared for a work out! 

Only other issue is....the thermostats don't go lower than 65 which is still to warm for me! The hot water also does not go hot enough.

Book a lagoon view...no one ever was on their balconies anyways!

reviews.author: Shanna804
reviews.title: Cancun Jump Off 2013
reviews.text: We arrived Sat May 18th and check- in went smooth with Maria Mora. I was a little concerned bc we made our reservation with skyauction for 1 bedroom suite in Club Melia and received resort certificate from RCI 2 weeks prior to trip. I had called several times and had trouble confirming my reservation but everything worked out. Upon check in 2000 pesos was held on my credit card which is about $165 USD. Room is a little outdated but for the price its worth the money. Staff are friendly but not everyone speaks English which is ok. We managed with little Spanish I know. We went to the pool two days which was nice. We opted out of the inclusive package which was $60 USD per person per day. So we had to pay $25 to use cabana bed. Hotel is far from the party zone of Cancun so you have to take a bus to get to places like CoCoBango and Senor Frog etc. Bus ride is 8.50 pesos which is about 80 cent. So make sure to bring lots of $1. I wouldnt recommend exchanging money at hotel cause they only give you 10.4 rate when actual rate is 12.4 right now. You will have lots of people asking you to take tours and do activites but I suggest you try to bargin to get best price. Most activities are all inclusive meaning bus to and from activity is included as well as food and alcohol. We rode ATVs, went ziplining, and to river for $124 for two people on one of the tours. Another day we rode speedboats which was $50 for two people. And another day we went to wet n wild for $49 a person again food and drinks included but be sure to check online before purchasing tickets bc they had  special for $36 a person. I suggest you dont take taxi to go to club (take a bus or tell the taxi you are going to restuarant). All of the taxi drivers get paid for bringing people to club..so they will suggest club then tell you admission is $50 pp then tell bouncer outside he told you $50 which is what they will charge when in actuality cover is free or $20.  We are here during Memorial Day Weekend which is Cancun Jump Off. We didnt purchase paty package online because it was $900 pp which is too much. However please know if you dont purchase package you wont be able to get in any of the Jump Off events but all of the clubs are close together and just as packed as the jumpoff events..so dont worry. Back to the hotel...if you are participating in jump off i dont suggest you stay here bc its far from the action. The food in the hotel is overprice & taste terrible..we ate at Naos one morning and room service serval times. I was happy we didnt get all inclusive bc we got to venture out and eat at lots of different. Please be aware if you order food from outside that you will have to walk outside to gate to get it which is very inconvient as the gate is a long walk from the hotel. If you have mobility issues I dont suggest you stay here bc u have to do alot of walking. We are in tower 1 and there are 5 towers. The main tower is tower 3 so if you arent a club member I suggest you stay there. Well we are still here as we dont check out until Sun May 26th so I will let you know how check out goes.

reviews.author: Nicole S
reviews.title: This place was OK
reviews.text:
I went here in January and forgot to review. The hotel itself was nice enough but I wouldnt call it 4 star. You have to walk half a mile to get to the lobby from your room if youre in any building other than the main building. At one point I slipped on the stairs and sprained my ankle because theres only 1 elevator per wing and countless floors. 
The buffet breakfast was good.Other than that the food was awful. I like to think of myself as a foodie, Im willing to try anything and there is no style food I will not eat.
The first night we went to the asian restaurant. We ordered tuna sushi and a curry dish. The tuna was warm, which if you eat sushi know that is kind of gross. The curry was by far the worst thing I ate there. It tasted like throw up. It was so bad we couldnt even eat it and had to order room service just for something somewhat decent.
The tapas restaurant they had wasnt the worst but anything that was fish related tasted fishy. The scallops were over cooked and reaked of fish to the point where I almost got sick at the table. 
The other two restaurants they have werent too bad, but they werent good. 
The pool was nice if a little cold. The beach was beautiful. We got yelled at for taking a late night stroll though, that wasnt very nice. 
Id say this was the worst part:
Check in time was at 3pm. I called before we left requesting early check in. By the time we got there we were told our room was almost ready and to just speak with a man and he will explain hte hotel to us and show us to our room. Well, this man was really telling us about a time share.There were excursions we wanted to take and he told us to go to the timeshare seminar and that it would take 2 hours and we would receive a discount. It took almost 4 hours, we lost an entire day of laying at the pool or doing anything and the guy that was speaking to us was annoyed that we werent really interested in the program that we just wanted the discounts. The worst part about this was that after spending the 4 hours to get a massage at half price, the massage was possibly the worst massage I ever had. I usually feel like passing out after a massage, after this one I felt like I was more tense. It was almost like they gave us a bad massage because we paid less.
I would definitely not recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Nancy P
reviews.title: Paradisus is Paradise
reviews.text: Have been to many Hotels in Cancun, Paradisus was just too great, beautiful place inside and out, installations, employees. Can't wait to return with the fam next year. The food was excellent and most definitely their purpose is to please the traveler. Alcoholic beverages of all kinds and not just national, also no problem with beach towels.

reviews.author: neversettle_travel_realestate
reviews.title: Paradisus Lives it up again! Read me!!! Friends even bought timeshare!!
reviews.text:
First of all, I cant believe the negative reviews of this place. Read my reviews and look at my map, I have been around the world. Also, please remember they just took over this place in November 2012!! Constantly improving.  Training is taking place every day so be patient. 

First time to Cancun.  Stayed 5 nights! Came to Paradisus because we went to Punta cana. Hands down didn't let me down!! 

We had three couples from all over the country to meet up this past week, without a single problem for any of the three couples. So good one of the couples bought a timeshare!!

There are timeshare people there, never pressured though! Once I told them no, never approached again. 

Food was excellent, my wife is very picky had no problems. It was truly all inclusive! Excellent choices, drinks and food. Room service is also included!!! Limited menu but after all day drinking a 2 am burger or pizza rocks!!  Enough places to eat for a whole week plus!! Didn't do Tempo just because we ran out of time. Vento and Fuego were amazing! Sushi place in the center of the resort was one of the best sushi places at a resort ever had. Biggest success is that my wife doesn't eat seafood/sushi and they had a chef there that made a full meal for her!! 

Drinks: They have premium drinks! Don't be surprised if Jonny walker blue isn't there. No kidding! That shouldn't even be expected but we met people who thought it should... must be the negative people on here.  The have your captain, walker black, margaritas etc...   Try the jellyfish shot or the SANDGRITA with Don Julio silver at the pool bar. ENRIQUE thank you for taking care of my friends for all 6 days!! 

Rooms: We upgrade to the club Melia room with a Jacuzzi on the balcony. There weren't any ocean views rooms available with a king bed for upgrade so they assisted us with a timeshare room with a ocean view at no price or credits! Clean, spacious. 

Our friends also stated that their Royal Service was amazing for room and service!  My wife and I didn't do it to make a budget for tours. 

Tours: The have multiple tour companies on site. We used Best day tours for our Whale shark tour, it was a once in a lifetime experience, and round trip from airport. Use them!! Thanks again Jorge Ortiz. 

Pool was warm, pool bar was fully stocked and staff was friendly.  Large enough so you didn't feel crowded. Royal service pool seemed to be relaxing! Our friends mostly utilized the cabanas and came to the general pool with us. Recommend that the resort gets a swim up bar at the royal service side for the snobby resorters! Family conceierge area looked great for families. 

Tons of activities and poolside entertainment. Fun beach volleyball games! 

The ladies loved the spa and also said it was worth every dime. One of the couples returned for another time slot! Staff was excellent. 

We didn't go during active spring break time for a reason, we aren't 18-24 trying to get drunk and puke our guts out. Party yes but wasn't looking for the white t shirt contest. Not a lot of singles hunting around...

TIPS: Not needed but lets be honest these guys aren't getting paid the big bucks, and they are working their butt off in the heat to make sure you have an enjoyable time. Tip them, not to mention you tend to have their attention after you do so. You wont be able to get half way thru your drink until another chilly adult beverage is in front of you!  Your choice!

**The only con or a recommendation for the resort**** Have some evening outside bar to enjoy the warm evening air on the ocean. Avenue bar and the room lounge is nice but us fellas would have enjoyed a cigar and a drink on a beach bar.   Not sure why La Perla was opened, but my guess is a renovation. 

Paradisus Cancun, see you again! I will recommend you to my friends and family.

reviews.author: Denyse_56
reviews.title: March Break
reviews.text:
Our family had a wonderful time at the Paradisus Cancun in March 2013.  From the time that we arrrived at the hotel until the sad moment we had to leave, the staff could not have been friendlier or more accomodating.

The beach is the nicest we have seen and we have extensively travelled throughout Mexico and the Caribbean.  As for the resort, the hotel pools and restaurants were first class.  The food was diverse from Mexican to Japanese and we enjoyed all restaurants as well as the buffet.

We plan on making this an annual excursion.

reviews.author: delreydick
reviews.title: Great beach, wonderful staff
reviews.text: Spent 7 great days at the Paradisus Cancun. The service could not have been better. It started with a call  two days before I arrived from my concierge Claudia asking if there was anything she could do before i arrived. I asked for a oceanfront room which was waiting when I arrived. Claudia met  me in the lobby to answer any questions I had. She was very helpful through out my stay with reservations for dinner. I live in South Florida, so the beach is important to me. Could not ask for better. The surf was great and it was nice to walk on sand that did not burn my feet. Also the beach and pool staff of Jona, Orlando, and Javier went out of their way to to make the guests have a great time. The food was very good, and the staff was was top notch. My only complaint is there are many stairs and only one place to get beach towels. This is a large resort and i have bad knees so it wasn't that easy getting around. I have been to many resorts and this resort is the best. i gladly recommend the Paradisus Cancun and look forward to going back next year.

reviews.author: J P
reviews.title: Absolutely amazing stay!!
reviews.text:
Everything from the beginning was incredibly positive! Having stayed at several other Paradisus properties (Paradisus Punta Cana, Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana and Paradisus Princesa del Mar in Varadero), this has definitely been the best experience.
We stayed at the resort for a full week, and would have extended for another week if possible. We booked one of the Royal Service rooms, so upon arrival we were escorted to a separate exclusive building for Royal Service guests, where we were greeted by our personal butler, Erik, who would help us throughout the stay in making reservations and anything else we desired (we were given a cellphone to contact him directly whenever we needed something). Lazaro, the Royal Service manager and Selena were extremely helpful and kind throughout our stay.

- Room: At check-in we were upgraded to the top category room (1bedroom suite). The room was huge, with two full bathrooms, two outside terraces, separate large living room and large bedroom. Although the hotel was built some time ago, all rooms have been fully renovated, not feeling tired at all. The minibar in the room was re-stocked daily with a great selection of drinks. Also features daily night turndown service. 

Royal service is clearly a must for added exclusivity and privacy. Only royal service guests could enter this area, which has its own dedicated concierge/front desk and lounge with continuous food and drink offerings. In the morning we almost always had breakfast there, because it felt much less crowded and more special than the main hotel buffet.
