Although it didnt have cooking stations, it did offer a great selection of food (fresh fruit, cold meats and cheeses, cereals, yogurt, bread and pastries, juice, scrambled eggs and french toast), much better than many urban 4star hotels. Karina the waitress was always trying to help and after a couple of days she already knew and prepared the table we liked and brought olive oil to our table especially for us.

- Pool area: Royal Service has a huge private pool with restricted access to Royal Service guests. This was clearly the best part of our experiece. Even if the hotel was full, it never felt crowded. It was also adults only, so no annoying noises at all. The area had many palapas (like cabanas) around the pool, which could be reserved with a nametag for your stay. this palapas were like heaven on earth. they were like covered kingsize beds which were covered with plenty of towels and made the day extremely comfortable. we also had two sunbeds by our palapas, so that we could sunbath at our convenience. Sergio and Vicente, were extremely helpful and attentive with us throughout our stay. F&B service at the palapas was continuous throughout the day. i have been to many many luxury resorts, but have never felt so well taken care of like at this pool. Consuelo and all the waiters were offering drinks non stop and always with a smile on their faces without exception.

- Restaurants. Food quality was top notch, and we didn't feel any cons from being all-inclusive. We had lunch half of the days at the Palapa restaurant in the royal service pool area, which had a very decent menu including flatbreads, burgers, grilled fish, etc. this food could also be served at your own palapa. The rest of the days we had lunch at the Market Grill, which is literally 1min away, where they offer pastas, pizzas and grilled food (bbq ribs, burger, flank steak, chicken, grouper, etc). This is located next to the main buffet so you could grab anything you wanted from there.

For dinner, we had dinner at Vento (mediterranean food with great tapas) we are from Spain, and the quality of the tapas was very good. We had dinner twice at Bana (asian-sushi), and it was great. Mole is the upscale Mexican restaurant and they also offer premium courses which are not included such as Lobster, T-bone steak, etc which were extremel good. Next to it, the Blue Agave serves amazing tacos in a more informal setting. There is another restaurant called el Fuego which we did not try, serving latin fusion food. On our last night we went to Tempo, by Martin Berasategui. We had a tasting menu which was worth it.

- Bars. There are several bars at the resort. The red lounge is more of a disco, and opens until 2am. Next to it there is a cool bar / lounge with balinese beds called avenue bar. Finally the coco bar looks over the beach and also has balinese beds.

- Beach. Great white sand beach, excellent for long walks. Despite the many hotels on the beach, it is not crowded at all. Sunbeds were always available and the access is extremely convenient from the hotel. Only downside (in all Cancun) is that it is not a calm sea like other parts of the caribbean.

- Spa. The Water Ritual was complimentary for RS, and was great and very relaxing. We also tried the massage service, which was extremely high quality, although having been to other spas in Luxury hotels, I believe the prices are well over the top. I would extremely encourage the hotel management to lower these prices, because they feel disproportionately too high.

- Surroundings. Very well located, less than 5 minute ride on the local bus R-2, that runs every 3mins by the hotel main entrance, to:
   + Two of the best restaurants in Cancun (Harry's Bar and Puerto Madero)
   + Two large malls: Kukulcan Plaza (more upscale) and La Isla

- Other: one huge plus was that there was free wi-fi throughout the hotel, and I mean it (rooms, common areas, restaurants, and even pool area).
 + If you want to rent a car, I recommend renting online (we used Budget) which offers much better rates than the hotel. We picked up the car at the budget office in La Isla shopping center, where there are many of the well known rental companies.
 + Important: do not exchange any currency at the airport on arrival, the rate is below 10pesos per usd. Even the hotel offers a much better rate at slightly above 11pesos. I personally went to a nearby Santander bank branch and exchanged at 11.85 pesos per usd. Banks usually open M-F until 4pm.
 + If you need to arrange transportation from/to the airport, I highly recommend USA Transfers. We got private round-trip transfers for much less than a taxi.

reviews.author: AtlanticTravelGroup
reviews.title: Excellent Service Royal Service Samuel Is Great and German Agular
reviews.text: The hotel is very nice, the restaurants service and food is great. We stayed in the Royal Service part of the hotel. This area has its own check in , bar area, beach area, and you are assigned a butler to your room. Our butler was Samuel , he spoke great English , was super friendly and willing to go above and beyond to provide great service. he had my laundry done in 2 hours, met me at the pool cabana and went off to buy me sun glasses. I recommend requesting Samuel as your butler. On a separate note I have to give thanks to German Agular who was the bartender in the main lobby from 3 p.m. to midnight. He makes great drinks, great conversations and he very professional .He also gave a great ideas for sites and tours. Both of these people my our stay enhanced. Be sure to visti both of them and please stay at the resort , you will not regret it. Take from me , I work in the travel industry !

reviews.author: TheHotelInspector1
reviews.title: A very nice Hotel with so much potential but poor room and lack of staff training in some areas let it down!
reviews.text:
Just returned from 9 nights at the Paradisus Hotel which sadly I could only rate as average. First impressions of the Hotel were excellent as the communal areas were spotlessly clean, well organised and maintained.

On arrival, we were met by a friendly member of staff who showed us to reception whilst the bell boy took care of our luggage. The reception is located on the left hand side behind a glass partition. The check-in was slow and haphazard - it was clear that there is a lack of training. I enquired as to whether we could upgrade to an ocean view room and was told that as the Hotel was barely half full that this would be fine and not a problem. After a colleague had a word with him, he then told me (in a very timid way) it would be $35 a night when he originally appeared to indicate it would be free. It really puzzled me as I had a resort room upgrade credit of $300 so it wouldn't be costing me anything anyway so it was a pointless exercise! Having sorted out the room, we were then passed on to another person who sat us in the reception area and gave an overview of the Hotel. This process went on forever and as we had been travelling for 18 hours, it was too much. Eventually she said she would show us to our room. In fact, she showed us to the lift and said have a nice stay.

Our first impressions of the room were underwhelming. The whole room was very dated and tatty. Most of the fixtures in the bathroom were held together with white filler, the glass mirror was very tarnished and it was clear that a refurb was well overdue. The room itself was spacious, although the sofa and seat fabrics were stained. Again the furniture needed replacing and the room given a facelift. A fridge was provided which stocked water, sodas and beer which was nice. Flatscreen TV provided with a wide range of channels. The balcony was full of broken plaster and on examination, it was clear that the whole facade of the building was crumbling. The flower planter was full of plaster debris/ litter and it was disappointing that there was only one sun lounger and no table.

As 30 minutes had passed, we were getting frustrated that no luggage had yet arrived but remained patient. A further 15 minutes later, the phone rang from bell services to say our luggage was on its way. This arrived a further 15 minutes later so we waited an hour which is a little off.

We took a tour of the main building (which our room was located in) and were really impressed with the Hotel and its facilities. All the staff we encountered on this tour were very charming - always smiling and very pleasant indeed. The restaurants/ bars were all very well appointed, really clean and impressive - as were the pool areas.

On arrival back at the room, we decided to take a shower and have an early night. Water temperature was lukewarm at best and the water took an eternity to drain away in the bath and sink which was disappointing. Beds were comfortable but pillows were of poor quality and really thin. Air conditioning was very loud and ineffectual so room never particularly cool. Our room was located right above the bar/club so it was hard to sleep but I chose not to switch rooms so can't make an issue of this.

The following represents a summary of pros/cons of the Hotel following the rest of our stay:

PROS:
Fantastic staff at pool and in all the restaurants/ bars. 
Food was of excellent quality - no complaints here (although the food served at Fuego was always on the cool side due to distance from kitchen)
Fridge replenished fully every day 
Housekeeping to a very good standard in room
A special mention of the poolside waiter LUIS. He looked after us nearly every day and was fantastic in every respect - a fine ambassador for the Hotel. On my birthday, he got the kitchen to make a "cake" with "Happy Birthday David" iced on to the plate. He also got his colleagues to sing Happy Birthday to me whilst tapping a tray with a spoon - it was a lovely touch and very much appreciated. We were only sad that we left on Luis's day off and could not thank him once again before we left - what a star!
Lovely location and brilliant 
facilities
A special thank you to EMMA who looks after customers in and around reception, she looked after us in the reception whilst we were waiting for our airport transport - an absolute credit to the Hotel and highly professional (see below)
CONS
Rooms in desperate need of a full refurbishment and freshen up - especially the bathrooms
Questionable "top shelf" branded spirits - very watered down or not the real thing
Reservation service appalling - we were always told restaurants were fully booked or given times such as 630pm for dinner. If you just visited the restaurant they allowed you to book at more or less anytime or turn up without reservations 
On one occasion we returned to the room as key card was not working. After queuing for nearly an hour at reception (as no one else could help) our card was replaced after the agent had checked the name against the room. On returning to the room, the card still did not work. After waiting again, the same agent checked the card and said it was fine so the problem must be the actual room lock. He told me someone from maintenance would be right up. After waiting a further 30 minutes at the room without anyone coming, I returned to reception. On arrival, the same agent was walking away from the desk so I approached him to outline my anger. He literally turned his back and ignored me so as a result, I tapped him on his shoulder and he returned behind the desk and I told him that nobody had come to help. I got no apology, no nothing and when I repeated my room number, it was then clear that he had replaced my card but used the incorrect number which he was giggling about with his colleagues. At this point, I was so angry, I asked for a supervisor who dealt with the situation well - apologised profusely and accompanied me to the room. He assured me he would deal with the agent but it wasn't very reassuring when I passed reception later that evening that the so called supervisor was sharing a giggle with the same agent. Staff on reception are very poor indeed and inadequate to deal with guests professionally. I might add that an employee who tries to look after guests in reception called Emma looked highly embarrassed throughout and tried so hard to help me from the start. When I initially arrived at reception to explain the problem, she attempted to get the issue to sort the key out straight away (rather than me queue for an hour) but was shunned by the same agent!
We never received one evening turndown service throughout our 9 night stay which was very disappointing 
On one day we received no housekeeping whatsoever even though we left the room at 9 and returned at 6!

In summary, this is a beautiful Hotel with so much potential to be excellent. The staff on the whole really are superb - outstanding in fact. The restaurants are well appointed and the food is excellent. The communal areas are well maintained and clean. Sadly, the rooms needs a full refurb and some of the reception staff need to be trained to a much more acceptable standard. I would recommend the Hotel but give realistic expectations.

reviews.author: Volleyjay
reviews.title: Awesome week
reviews.text:
I have traveled extensively throughout the Caribbean and have been to Cancun twice before however this resort's staff was the best I have come across.  I the past five years I have been several times to Punta Cana, also St Johns, Barbados, Cove Bahamas, P Rico,  St Thomas, Curacao, and Aruba to name a few.   This resort is finely designed and decorated throughout.
The crew of Jona, Orlando and Javier were exceptional at the beach and pool. The went out of their way to help the guests enjoy their time. We stayed at the Club section and the rooms was great. I asked for DVD player and it was hooked up 15 minutes later. My experience with the food has been very good to excellent ! I would recommend this hotel if you enjoy excellent service, great food and one beautiful beach.

reviews.author: CRPoore
reviews.title: Tremendous family vacation
reviews.text:
We just returned home from a family vacation at the Paradisus.  We could not have had a better time!  

The moment we arrived, we were escorted in to the Family Concierge lounge for a private check in.  There were books, toys, games, drinks and snacks available in the lounge.  Check in was a breeze.  There was a thorough presentation of the resort and the various amenities available including all of the restaurants.  

Even though we arrived quite early, 11:30AM, we were pleasantly surprised that our room was ready.  We had upgraded to a one bedroom ocean view suite, and it was money well spent.  The suite was spacious and having two full bathrooms came in quite handy on more than one occasion.  

I cannot say enough about the attentiveness and courtesy of the staff.  It seemed by the second day there everyone knew our name and went out of their way to assist us in any way that they could.  There have been a few negative reviews of this property, and I will simply say this.  Nowhere is perfect.  No eight day vacation can be without flaw, however, this was about as close as you can get.  

We found the food in the restaurants to be consistently very good to excellent.  The buffet that was available all day had a nice variety of items, it seemed everyone could always find something they really enjoyed.

The pool bar was amazing.  The service pool side, and especially from the Bali Beds was amazing.  Marisol was so attentive and her smile was amazing.  The bartender Adel was great, and Juan was always there with an extra towel whenever needed.

I could go on and on, however, to summarize, the hotel was incredibly clean, so beautiful it was like something from a movie, the staff was almost over the top in their service.  I am not sure what more one could ask for.

We cannot wait to return!

reviews.author: zaphod73
reviews.title: Excellent vacation
reviews.text:
We (wife and 5 year old) just got back from spending 4 excellent days at the Paradisus. This is a perfect resort to wind down, relax and have a great time. It's very rare that you get to stay in a resort whose decor, hospitality, food and service are all world class. From the moment we had our private check in with the family concierge we knew we made the right decision of choosing this resort. Our concierge Anna, our private butler Patty and our own Pool/beach help Juan took excellent care of ours. Our 5 year old was treated to a cool looking welcome kit with beach toys which was followed by a new surprise almost every day of our stay which included, scented pillows, bubble bath with balloons etc.
We ate in almost all restaurants except the adult only ones and the food just got better every day..Sushi, Brazilian  Churrascaria , Mediterranean tapas. We also got to treat ourselves to an included water treatment while our daughter watched a movies of her choice in the kid-zone. Our room was on the top floor of the third tower which was great because it was secluded and helped to be on the top floor when you have a jacuzzi in the patio :-). They also sent me bottle of scotch to the room which was a nice surprise for me

Overall, a great experience and I would highly recommend families with kids to get the family concierge service. It may not be called the 'Royal service' which they have for couples but nothing short of that for families with kids.

Thanks Anna, Patty and Juan for the excellent 4 days at Paradisus...we will be back soon.

reviews.author: v c
reviews.title: Great vacation, great service!
reviews.text:
We just returned from a week long vacation at the Paradisus.  It was one of our best, if not the best, vacations!  Cancun is beautiful and the resort was really nice.  If you are looking for a place with a nice pool, great beach and friendly service, this is the place for you.  The resort is nice and comfortable, we had no issues with the "aging" of the hotel since nothing was overtly old looking or breaking down.  Some knicks here and there but again, it wasn't like the furniture was from the 80's like some reviewers made it out to be (which made me nervous!).  I found the common areas very comfy, like the indoor cabanas at Avenue (our favorite after dinner hang out).  The food was surprisingly good.  We are from SF which has some of the most amazing food, so we try to be very fair about food when we decided to do the all-inclusive for this trip (our first all-inclusive) and when we go on cruises.  I found the food to be better than most cruises we go on.  The buffet was pretty good and we were happy with it for breakfast and lunch (the only place open for those meals).  There was good selection of restaurants for dinner.  Our favorites were Fuego and Vento (went to each place twice!).  Bana was a bust but they had our favorite dessert, so we stopped by just for dessert.  Again, it was our first all-inclusive and we loved not having to think about ordering anything.  The cruises always get you on the sodas and booze, so it was nice to have that as part of the package.  Also, loved having cappacino's every night and my BF had his Black Label Johnny Walker.  A tip, even though the room service is super limited, you can ask for things.  They don't have ice cream on the menu but they brought it to us and while they had no hot food for breakfast, we were able to get eggs, bacon and toast.  Wish we figured this out sooner, but maybe it worked out for the best since they cook things fresh for you at the buffet AND they make power fruit drinks for you on the spot!

Lastly, we have to mention the service...except for two mediocre staff and one rude one, everyone else is amazing and so accommodating!  While we wish we didn't encounter the three people who were not amazing, I don't want to take away from the others who really deserve to be praised.

Fuego - EDUARDO and RORY are very friendly.  They really made our first and last dinner in Cancun awesome!  

Vento - IGNACIO is a very sweet and accommodating manager.  He went out of his way to make our meal enjoyable.  

The Chef at the resort - I wish I caught the chef's name because he is the sweetest and most attentive person.  My daughter has severe food allergies and he was so accommodating...at Vento and Fuego, they were also super accommodating.  Everyone was at the resort but some more conscientious than others.  The chef was also very sweet when my daughter found a coconut and wanted it cut open.  He was willing to do it but told us it was not a good one (brown instead of green), so he told her to find a green one and he would open it for her.  He also offered to open the brown one but she passed.  My dad is a chef of a major hotel, and when you run 9+ restaurants, not including the conventions or room service, you're busy!  But he made time for my daughter which was so appreciated.

Olympus Tours - We booked all of our excursions through Olympus, which I guess is CheapCarribean.com in Mexico.  SERGIO was the rep at our hotel and he really took care of us.  On our last day, he saw that is was 9:40am and we had not come down to check-out for our 9:50am shuttle, so he called to make sure everything was fine. On top of taking care of every detail for our excursions and transportation, Sergio is just a super nice and friendly person.  No up selling, just giving us the options and letting us decide.

Again, we had the best time and while Cancun is very much a paradise, the service, hotel stay and food all helped to make paradise just that much better!

reviews.author: vagabondtraveler_13
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, beautiful people
reviews.text:
This resort is finely designed and decorated.  The hotel gives you the feeling of being in a botanical garden. The rooms are very clean and comfortable. Housekeeping works hard to keep the place spotless.  My experience with the food has been very good to excellent.  The beach is fantastic.  The spa is unique with water ritual therapy and I had a great massage during my stay.    
The staff at this enchanting hotel are warm, friendly and helpful.  Our recent stay was enhanced by the care and assistance given by Asuntion, Raul and Hermania. Many thanks to the great staff here who have made all my stays memorable.  We will be back!

reviews.author: don l
reviews.title: great building, beach and setting, service was spotty
reviews.text:
The building and facilities are first rate and the hotel has plenty of staff. The ocean views are very good. the pool is excellent. the atrium is impressive and well maintained. The beach is pleasant and if the wind is not up you can swim in the ocean. 

service-- most staff were friendly and smiled ,but you could tell that they were not all well trained. For example, I had to ask several times for a drink in the restaurant. A specific waiter, Victor, just ignored me and his supervisor in a black shirt and earpiece (v impressive--secret service?) just forgot.  I finally stopped a waiter and just took a drink off his tray. The minibar guy just barged into my room even though i told him to come back later. the front desk staff were slow. so they have some work to do.

reviews.author: RobertaF87
reviews.title: Excellent stay! One of my best vacations
reviews.text: I stayed with my mother and sister for mother's day weekend. It was our first time in Cancun and Paradisus made our getaway beyond perfect. Once you step inside the hotel you feel a sense of calmess and tranquility. Staff and service is perfect! The food and drinks are great. Our favorite was the sushi restaurant. I love how the pool and beach were steps away from each other. All the restaurant had the view towards the beach which I love. The airport its 15 mins away. We took the bus to downtown cancun which is only 20 mins away. I recommend this hotel to anyone who's taking a vacation in Cancun. I plan on returning.

reviews.author: Perspective Hospitality
reviews.title: VERY RUDE Reception/Bell Staff, Constant Smell of Mold....
reviews.text:
If you want to be treated like a second-class citizen, and you LOVE the smell of mold, this is the resort for you.

Also, it is AT LEAST a $20 USD cab ride to get anywhere. To get to the downtown area, its about $40 USD.

RECEPTION STAFF:
I was also in the group with the reviewer below. The hotel staff CLAIMS that they cannot not guarantee a room type, but this simply is not true. When we checked in, the hotel KNEW that they were being dishonest because when we entered the room, the extra bed was ALREADY SET IN THE ROOM!

This meant that the hotel was aware that they had sold the room type that we paid for. The front desk staff treated us like we were just trash. The Petrobras group that were at the hotel were great people, and very kind, and the hotel staff could have taken a lesson in courtesy and kindness from the Brazilians.

FOOD STAFF:
Amazingly helpful people. We always tipped them as much as we could because they gave us excellent service. One problem: they were always trying to sell us DRUGS AND PROSTITUTES! Invariably. I'm not joking. Maybe they were joking around with us, maybe not. Who knows. It was weird.

Food quality was excellent.

PUBLIC SPACE:
It was constantly being cleaned, which is excellent, because the hotel was always spotless. This however didn't seem to eliminate the constant smell of mold around the entire hotel. I have a very immediate and drastic reaction to mold, so I spent my entire stay with a swollen throat and inflamed sinuses.

BELL STAFF:
Bottom line: Petrobras was leaving at the same time as us, so needless to say, the front of the hotel was very crowded with people and bags. At one point I was standing on the sidewalk, minding my own business, and I got plowed down by a bell cart being pushed by a bellman. He didn't even ask me to get out of the way! He just rammed it straight into me!

Whoever responds to this review from the staff, if they even care to response, will probably respond with some stupid policy about the rooms, and some dishonest promise of their dedication to service. All of it is a farse.

STAY AWAY FROM THIS RESORT!

reviews.author: N C
reviews.title: Big and comfortable
reviews.text:
If you like a more intimate hotel then its not your place - everything in the hotel is huge and its not difficult to get lost in it. Also tourist groups (like CVC in Brazil) are common guest in Paradisus Cancun, so expect lines for check-in. 

Another downside is that you´ll need car or taxi or bus to get anywhere in Cancun - even if you want to walk from hotel lobby to the street, its a long walk. But they do have lots of restaurants inside the hotel (not cheap). 

Said that, the hotel is great and beautiful. The sea is as baby blue as it can be (actually, I stayed at Hyatt which is located at km 7.5 and sea there is not that blue as in km 16.5). 

I got a a junior suite with a terrace, so the room was quite big (dont know about the standard rooms). Bed is huge and comfortable. 

Stay here if you want to enjoy the hotel more than Cancun itself - or take the bus to get to know the shopping centers and the nightclubs and the restaurants.

reviews.author: Richard B
reviews.title: Price equals relaxation
reviews.text: this hotel shows well in the brochure, but even better in person.  Staff at the desk were always smiling and friendly,. The rooms were nice , large and comfy. The facilities were of higher quality then what I have seen in resorts. The staff for activities were funny and always planning something to get people involved. There is also plenty of space for just laying down and relaxing. The location is close to everything downtown and only a bus ride away. The beach all along the blvd area is clean of seaweed and rocks and just white sand and turquoise water. Please stop at the pool bar and get yourself many frozen drinks,,,talk of tasting! This resort at all inclusive isd certainly worth the stay.

reviews.author: Andrea D
reviews.title: Superb, Most Def Paradise!!!
reviews.text:
So much to say!! We (fiance and I) took a mini getaway from NYC...From the moment we stepped out of our taxi, we felt the great excellent customer service...Food was great, drinks awesome!!! Everyone was extremely nice.  We want to specially acknowledge some of the great employees we interacted with:
Javier was our welcome bellman-Great guy
Club Melia concierge (Gaby) she was helpful and very informative
Naos we always sat with Louis Orlando, he is great, funny and extremely attentive. People are so nice at Paradisus Cancun that it becomes a little overwhelming at times:) LOL, but we appreciate that. Must go to the bar and get your drinks done Salvador he is the best!!!

reviews.author: Felice F
reviews.title: Major relaxation!
reviews.text: We just returned from an all-inclusive stay at the Paradissus Cancun, Royal Service. As soon as you walk in, you are met by a friendly staff and wonderful aromas. The Royal Service gives you unsurpassed attention for a completely relaxing vacation. There is the butler service, top shelf alcohol, beautiful ocean view rooms, etc. It is truly your own slice of paradise. The beach was great with an attentive staff, bali beds, and palapas. The food was good, although the two best restaurants are closed on Saturday night. Plan accordingly and fit in a trip to the Great Mayan Reef and snorkel with vibrantly colored fish of all sizes. I will gladly return to the Paradissus Cancun, tomorrow if it were possible. Stay, relax, and enjoy!

reviews.author: Natalia T
reviews.title: Excellent service at Royal Service
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our visit last weekend staying at Royal Service, everyone is so kind and they help you with all your requests. Facilities are very nice, the beach is wonderful. The buffet for breakfast and lunch is not so good but you have other options to eat that are better. You have a breakfast option only for Royal Service customers and the pool restaurant offers good options for lunch. The pool area is very quiet so you can enjoy and rest the time you spend there.

reviews.author: Barbara K
reviews.title: Our Annual Winter Vacation
reviews.text:
As Melia Vacation Club members we have returned to the Gran Melia,now Paradisus, in Cancun Mexico for at least 15 years. We were and still are enchanted by the architecture and the lush tropical plants through out the hotel which gives it a charm rarely found in such a large hotel. Much of the hotel with its amenities has remained the same over the years. A very pleasant constant is the staff of the Melia Vacation Club with their able manager Ivette Sanchez. She skillfully solves problems when they arise and makes the guests truly feel at home.
 Some changes within the hotel have disadvantaged the long-time MVC members, especially those who have kitchen facilities in their unit and do not wish to purchase the all-inclusive package. The a la carte prices in the restaurants have gone up and the food selections in the cafeteria have been reduced as well as seating capacity.
  We will remain loyal to the Melia/Paradisus.The charm of the staff and the wonderful atmosphere will always bring us back to "our home" during the winter. Lastly, I would like to mention members of the beach service staff who have been there for many years and always greet us as family members while providing us with the most thoughtful service. Among them are Laura, Ascuncion and Antonio and many more.
  We wish the new management much success and we already look forward to our next vacation at the Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: Michele P
reviews.title: Paradise - Beyond Expectations
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Royal Service 4/20 - 4/27/13, room 5402,  and were beyond impressed with the resort, the staff, the food, and really everything! We loved it so much we didn't want to leave after 8 days! Here's some more details:

Resort:
The grounds are meticulously maintained, and the common areas are beautiful. The lobby is grand bringing a mix of outdoors in with vines hanging 8 stories from the balconies and coy ponds throughout. You'll also find little hidden seating/lounging areas if you just want to hang out. In the Royal Service section, which you can only access if staying in that part of the resort, you have another lobby/lounge area that is just as beautiful as the main hotel lobby. 
We did play golf at the par 3 and had a great time. Nothing fancy but very well maintained and no problem getting a tee time. 
The resort is close to town/shopping - just a 5 min bus ride.

Royal Service:
Without a doubt worth the upgrade. The rooms are spacious & beautiful, we had a lagoon view which gave us amazing sunset views everynight. Yes, you can see the road but you couldn't hear any road noise at all. Our butler, Jacobo, was so pleasant and helpful. He went above and beyond to get us additional information about golf courses outside of the resort and always seemed more than happy to help. 

The best part of Royal Service was the exclusivity at the pool. Every day we had a Bali Bed and lounge chairs waiting for us, right next to the pool with a view of the ocean (we chose that location, there's others to choose from). The pool attendant Vicete was such a pleasure to see each day. He was always so happy, so helpful, and really made our time at the pool perfect. He'd set up our bali beds and chairs each day, come around with fresh fruit a few times, he even came around with cool towels an Evian face spray. He worked so hard everyday but was always very happy to help!

The rest of the pool staff was fantastic as well - the wait staff would bring our drinks right to the edge of the pool so we could pick them up from our rafts. Octavio, Consuelo, and Diana were extremely friendly and very attentive with drink service and lunch at the pool as well. The royal service pool is definitely more quiet than the main pool but if you want a more lively crowd you can always walk over to the other area for that.

No one ever expects a tip however, they are extremely appreciative when you do tip & really deserve it for working so hard to make your stay so pleasant. We brought $100 in singles to make sure we'd be able to tip throughout the week.

Tip: In the mornings, have Diana prepare you a Cappuccino with Baileys in the Royal Service Red Lounge. Best way to start your day!

Restaurants:
Since we were there 8 days we were able to try everything, most often we were extremely impressed.

Naos (Buffet): We ate breakfast here daily. Great assortment from egg stations, to smoothies, pastries, fresh fruits, and Mexican specialties. Nothing over the top but very good. We also had lunch here a few times (when we didn't order direct to our Bali bed at the pool), it got a little redundant but there's always something to choose from. And, they always have fresh fruit which is really nice.

Market Grill: This is a Churrascaria (meat is cooked on skewers and carved table side) so if you don't like meat then this isn't for you. Everything was fantastic, the bbq chicken was the best! The location is great as it's completely open over looking the ocean.

Fuego: Latin Fusion - very good food. The menu is small but everything we had was great from seafood soup, grilled chicken skewers, to a shrimp dish - we enjoyed it all.

Mole: Mexican - OUTSTANDING! I guess you'd expect that! The decor is very nice, the service was great and food was superb. Definitely try the Duck appetizer!

Bana: Asian Fusion - Love the atmosphere - it's in the middle of the lobby but, you're surrounded by all the greenery & fountains so it actually feels very private. The food was very good, spring rolls were great and the Thai Beef was phenomenal.

Vento: Tapas Style - went here twice and had two TOTALLY different experiences. First experience was FABULOUS. Service was great, the food was all delicious especially the scallops, duck, shrimp/risotto. We actually liked it so much we decided that we'd repeat the meal for our last night. Second Experience (last night there): TERRIBLE. The service was horrible. We got one glass of wine (we ordered two) and it took 20 min for the second to come. Then when the food came (a repeat of what we previously got) it was COLD, underseasoned, undercooked, poorly presented, just downright AWFUL. We told the manager, he offered to try and make it up to us but we were just so disappointed that our last/special night turned out that way and we were so turned off by what was served that we just opted to leave. That was a very unfortunate way to end our trip.

Tempo: This restaurant has a surcharge unless you stay in Royal Service 7+ nights as we did so honestly we probably wouldn't have tried it unless we were comped...as we were. This restaurant absolutely blew us away. The decor was flawless. The service impeccable - it's an 8 course tasting menu and we were always served & cleared at the exact same time, with white glove service. The food was out of this world and we both decided it was the best dining experience we've EVER had! And we eat in NYC, Miami, and many other 'hot spots' often. YOU MUST EAT HERE! 

Overall, with the exception of dinner on our last night, we absolutely loved Paradisus Cancun and can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: Carmen L
reviews.title: Awesome hotel!
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time. We thought our two teens would be bored without all the crazy pool games we were used to, but were not. They really loved it.  The food was delicious in every restaurant.  Loved all the candles used for decorations at night, made it look magical.  Rooms were clean and comfortable.  Pool servers went above and beyond to keep us happy.  Miguel was such an amazing server. We spent time both at the pool and beach, same quality of service.  We would come back.

reviews.author: az95
reviews.title: Great Anniversary  celebration
reviews.text: Great hotel, inside and out. Very clean and well groomed. Staff was very friendly and helpful. We had upper floor lagoon view room and we loved! Spacious modern room , quality bed and linen, balcony, bar refrigerator, bathroom with plenty of towels and all amenities. The food in all restaurants and buffet   was always fresh, great quality and variety. Fuego restaurant especially good. Huge pools, great bars. Never felt crowded, plenty of space. Great beach, plenty of beach lounges and beach towels.The only negative experience we had, on 05/07/13 for the all nite and good part of the day  we lost all the water in the hotel, couldn't shower or flush the toilet, wasn't pleasant. We assume that was a rear and unusual  accident, so we just downgraded hotel just a bit for that. We will definitely consider to return.

reviews.author: PenneysParadise
reviews.title: Slice of Paradise!
reviews.text:
We stayed here from April 25th-May 5th of this year... I just finishing saying to my Dad, "we've only been home 5 days and I wish I could go back already"... 

First I want to say that we've been to several 5 star resorts in Jamaica, Cuba, DR and the Mayan Riviera, but this resort is the first I've felt a strong need to give a big thumbs up, primarily because of the staff and the superb level of service they give... 

8 of us booked this resort back in January, all my family members and all couples ranging from age 23 to 58 years... I'm 100% certain when I say that we all really enjoyed our experience here! Shortly after booking I emailed Aidee in the Royal Service Area to make a few requests, things like king beds in all the rooms, higher floors for the best views, ordering flowers for our rooms upon arrival, and my husband and I upgraded to the Imperial Suite, because we did that she offered us a free upgrade for my parents to the Luxury junior suite ocean view... She was so prompt in responding to my emails, always very detailed and professional... When we arrived, everything we had requested was exactly what we received! :) Thanks again Aidee for all your help in making our trip so special! :)

Our Butlers!... Jacobo (day shift) & Hector (evening shift), so friendly, kind and helpful... We were given a cell phone upon arrival to call them if we needed anything, and I mean anything! We used the phone a few times but Jacobo would come by our bali beds from time to time during the day to check on us and ask if everything was ok, always with a big smile and good conversation :)

Bali Beds... We reserved our beds by the Royal Service Pool for the first couple days and after that it was automatically reserved just for us by our butlers :) If we were going to be a little later getting to them in the morning, or if we had an excursion booked we would call and inform our butlers, that way they could either keep them for us or give them to another couple, we thought this was fair to everyone :) We spent a lot of our time around the pool and the bali beds, so relaxed and quiet, we basically had the whole pool to ourselves... Our servers, Consuelo and Gerardo mostly, also Diana and Ricardo never let our drinks go dry or left us hungry! We had a bucket of beer, coke and water everyday at our bali beds, they would never let it get warm, always refilling the ice to keep it nice and cold :) So friendly and prompt, excellent service again! I believe Francisco was their manager, everyday he would greet me with a big hug and a well wish for the day :) Great man and a major asset to the team! Eden at the pool bar always had a big smile and served us only the best liquors and beers :)

Beach... We didn't spend a lot of time on the beach, although when we did the service was great... There were quite a few waves while we were there so we didn't venture out in the ocean too much, we did go for a few strolls up and down the beach to check out other resorts... the beach area at the Paradisus is by far the biggest and most quiet :) One of the nicest beaches I've seen in my travels :)

Restaurants... I'm not much of a food critic so I'll have very little to say here ;) Naos (buffet) We went here almost every morning for breakfast, lots of choices for everyone's taste... We asked to be seated in Orlando's section every time! Such a friendly, happy person... He would see us coming and start getting our table ready before we even sat down, poured our tea and coffee, my husband's favourite "green juice", orange juice fruits that we liked, would all be waiting at our table without even asking before we got back with our meal :) Again, a major asset to the team! We ate here for dinner a few nights as well, we found there was more choices at the end of our stay then the first... but again, no problem to find something you like I'm sure... We reserved Bana, Vento and Mole also, and found them all to have tasty dishes, but Vento would have to be our favourite :)

Rooms... My husband and I had the Imperial Suite, Royal Service but not located in the Royal Service pyramid #5, it's in the main pyramid #3 on the top floor #3800... It had 3 balconies with an amazing ocean front view from every one! :) It had a full kitchen, dining room for 6, living room, two bathrooms, one being off the bedroom with a huge jacuzzi tub :) We loved it!!! Very clean and beautifully decorated, maid service was twice a day and always to perfection. Others in our party had the ocean view junior suite, ocean view luxury junior suite and ocean view one bedroom suite, all were very nicely decorated with stunning views of the ocean! We were all very pleased with the cleanliness of our rooms and maid service :)

Tipping... We tip very well, lets face it... If you can afford to stay in this amazing resort, you can also afford to tip for excellent service received by this amazing staff... They go above and beyond in so many ways to insure that you have the best vacation possible... They deserve to be rewarded for their constant attentiveness, superb customer service and just for those friendly smiles :)

I'm sorry for writing such a long review, but once I started writing I couldn't help but put as much detail as possible into it... There's so much to share that I could write a book :)

We will be back to Paradisus Cancun, I feel as though we left behind our friends... The staff! :)

Thanks again for making our trip so special...

Joy & Darren Penney

reviews.author: angiem79_13
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text: We had an amazing time. Staff was very friendly, and courteous. The inside and out was beautiful. The atrium inside was so amazing. The food was great. Our bartender by the pool Tano was amazing. great service, funny, and very friendly. He went above and beyond. Our room had an amazing view, and was cleaned very well daily. We will definitely be returning again very soon.

reviews.author: Darryl F
reviews.title: Wonderful hotel, exceptional service
reviews.text: Company award event at the hotel was stellar. Great room with a majestic view of the beach and ocean, perfect weather for snorkeling and scuba diving, and the welcoming people of Cancun made the trip worthwhile. The food in all of the restaurants at the hotel, along with the buffet, was fresh and varied each day, and the service welcoming and personal. Our waiter in the buffet, Carlos Lopez Garcia Naos, gave us his full attention, always making sure we had our drinks refilled and plates cleared in a timely manner. When we had our last meal the day we left, it was like leaving behind a new friend. Although this trip was on the company dime, it definitely would be a destination for us in the future.

reviews.author: mfarell
reviews.title: Great Anniversary!
reviews.text: I just came back from celebrating my anniversary at Paradisus and I couldn't be happier. The service was superb, my wife really loved the spa, and I really loved the hotel and the food. We had an amazing time and I really recommend this place, I am definitely returning hopefully after the summer.

reviews.author: hudiva
reviews.title: Great Pre-honeymoon
reviews.text: Most of the positive reviews mirror our experience.  It was weird because I was at the hotel reading the negative reviews of people who had just left and they were so different from ours! There was definitely a language barrier at check in.  But we were able to upgrade to the Royal Treatment for only an extra $50USD per night! This shocked me because I'd emailed the hotel the day before and they said it would be $160USD per night. So we were in the adults-only section, had an amazing butler (Hector), partial ocean view, access to Bali beds and food and beverage service on the beach. This was the perfect mini vacation for us.  Just note -- the food is just ok and the rooms are a little worn. But the service (I asked for a lot of extras/favors, and no one ever told me no -- including a beach front Bali bed every day with no reservation), beach, and overall experience made up for it.  One note about sleep quality -- the air never quite got cold enough for me. So on our last night, I asked for a fan.  Our butler had a maintenance dude come up at 10pm and he fixed the air! I only wish I'd have mentioned it sooner.  Like I said, excellent service.

reviews.author: BennyScotland
reviews.title: Amazing hotel
reviews.text: This hotel was amazing we had the butler service definitely worth the extra money service first class. Food and restaurants fantastic  with lots of options to choose from. The butler service was superb and the pool area fantastic loved the entertainment. We will be going back to this hotel.

reviews.author: ZIA H
reviews.title: Bad rooms added with bad service
reviews.text:
We got 3 rooms.  2 guys per room. 
We were supposed to get 2 beds in each room but they gave us 1 bed and a rollaway cot in each room.  They didn't even bother to tell us, they just sent us to the room after they made us wait 2 hours at the beach. 
They told us that a huge oil company from Brazil (petrobras) and that they reserved 650 room and they have to give them our rooms with 2 beds. 

This is not fair.  We booked months ago and even called and verified that our rooms were available,  then when we got there it was not. 

Restaurant staff is very nice and the food is pretty good.  Who ever the head of restaurants is,  is doing a great job. 
He/ she should train the front desk and reception staff. 

We paid about $650 pre person and we're very disappointed. 

The hotel is from from all the shopping and clubs. 

The Bell staff wouldn't even call a taxi for us.  They made us walk 5 mind to the street to catch a taxi. ..
But when anyone said taxi for AIRPORT. . They Bell staff would jump over backwards to get a taxi. . Kick backs / commission. .. It's sad really. 

I have been all over the place abs this was my worst hotel experience. 

I would not recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Linda H
reviews.title: .Paradisus - Cancun
reviews.text: From the minute we walked in the door we were on vacation.  The lobby was gorgeous and the staff was friendly and helpful.   We would definitely go back there.  They had 5 or 6 restaurants so they catered to everyone's tastes.  Our room was beautiful and very clean.  The whole place was well maintained.  When we were looking for a vacation and looked on tripadvisor we were a little nervous about booking because they talked about children.  We were trying to get away from kids and the noise.  There were children there but you never heard a peep out of them.  The vacation was everything we were looking for and more.  The weather was great and the beach was beautiful although most of the time we were there it was a little too rough to go in but that didn't stop us from hanging out at the pool.

reviews.author: BriN188
reviews.title: My room was old but...
reviews.text: We did not like our room at all...there was paper on our window; wooden blinds in the shower; headboard rattled against the wall with every move and the furniture was just out dated BUT who spends anytime in the room.  The food is great, the pools are great, the atmosphere was great, the common areas were great...we had a blast!  Bring small bills for tips if you want good service at the bars and every where else.  The people of Mexico are the nicest and best servers seems like no matter where you go!

reviews.author: NYCgrl23
reviews.title: Find a nicer hotel.
reviews.text: With so many hotels to choose from in Cancun, we chose this one based on a recommendation. What a mistake. It's simply not worth the money. Their idea of renovation is adding a few cool restaurants and some flat screen tvs in the rooms, but they really should've concentrated on the little details that people want more of.

reviews.author: Deborah M
reviews.title: Quiet, relaxing, romantic!
reviews.text: We stayed in royal service area which was nice and quiet with no kids (this was our first trip away from our kids so we didn't want to vacation with other families). Sometimes RS was a bit too quiet but you can always go to non RS pools for a bit of fun. Service was top notch with Ricardo and consuella being my favourites around the pool and lounge. Our room was perfect, clean, great view, private balcony, never had to ask for a thing. We were supposed to get a phone to keep in contact with our butler but never did get it, wasn't a big deal as I don't really like asking for things anyway, I'm ok to get stuff myself. Breakfast was great, loved the fresh fruit and omelette bar. I can not say enough about ORLANDO in the breakfast buffet, he is amazing and deserves big tips every day, love love love him! He always greeted us with a smile, was so pleasant and works so hard to make your day, he even gave me a small gift of mother Theresa on a key chain to watch over us on our way home. We tipped him well and asked for him every morning, request him, you won't be disappointed! We only tried the Asian place which was good and vento which I loved. The buffet did not have a lot of choices for our style of food (Canadian) I felt they tried to be too fancy and could take it down a notch especially in the RS lounge at night, didn't know what anything was i expected some fresh vegetables cut up. Food at the RS pool was just ok and we pretty much had a burger very day :( more choices would be good. Don't buy anything from the market downstairs, prices are ridiculous, a large bag of lays chips costs $12 us. The gift shop on main level has lots of nice trinkets and gifts which are reasonably priced. On our last night, there was a tropical storm which was nice but you could see the damage in the morning with towels all over the hallways and paint bubbling on the walls, a bit of wear and a musty smell all the time. Went to the gym one morning, it was small and crowded so I never went again but it does the job. All in all, a great trip, relaxing and fun, great service but might try another destination next time as this was our first trip we'd like to see what other places are like. If you want quiet go royal service, it was nice. Tip a few dollars a day and you will be well looked after.

reviews.author: lazygal
reviews.title: Paradisus Equals Paradise
reviews.text:
We spent a wonderful week here in the Club Melia Building (through an auction site) and though we are not members, we found this to be a wonderful hotel with excellent service, food, amenities and all at a fabulous price.  We prchased the all inclusive option upon arrival at a discounted price, and even though the one bedroom suite came with a fully stocked for cooking kitchen, we did not feel like shopping for food.  The refrigerator is small for actual cooking though it is possible.  Mini bar service was included with the all inclusive package.

We were upgraded to an ocean front suite with balcony jacuzzi and the concierge had done a wonderful job decorating the suite for my husband's birthday. (Thank You!!)  The room was immaculate and we had twice daily service.  Excellent, thick towels aplenty.  We were very happy with the room, though the king  bed was not as comfortable as some hotels.  

The breakfast and lunch buffets had plenty of food chices and we enjoyed the outdoor grill for lunches.  Service was spotty though at the buffets.  Dinner choices and service was excellent.  Our favorites were the Fuego, with Martin as our wonderful waiter.  We had thick, juicy filet mignon - only equaled by The Grand Velas and The Royal Hideaway from our trips to The Riviera Maya. We also loved the chicken skwer appetisers and seafood soup.  Delicious meal. Our next favorite restaurant was the Mexican (Mole), where Joel was our fabulous waiter and we enjoyed the breaded salmon.  Most all of our dinners were excellent.  Truly 5 star dining for a Mexico all inclusive.

Drink service on the beach and at the pool was also wonderful and quick and the servers also offer to bring appetizers and meals to your palapa.  Yolanda was our favorite, followed by Sophofina and Christian. When the large group moved in it was more difficult to get service, but I was lucky I had Yolanda to take care of us.  Our favorite palapa area was near the showers by the steps in front of building 3.  No towel cards are nice, but people did tend to leave there towels at the beach instead of turning them in and other people didn't know if the chairs were vacant.  At the beginning of our week, we had no trouble finding lounges, but a convention group came in at the end of the week and the towel game was in full force. All food portions increased at the buffets though and getting dinner reservations was not a problem.

With the all inclusive package, you can walk across the street to Aqua World and use the kayaks, hobiecat and paddleboats for free. We also made use of the public busses (the R2) and explored the Market in town and Walmart.  The bus was about 80 cents.  You can pay with $1 or pesos.  The front desk exchanges your dollars but you need to have your passport with you.

The resort is immaculate, with plenty of evening entertainment.  Live bands in the main attrium and a CoCoBongo show, fashion shows at the pool, etc. 

We have stayed at over 30 resorts in the Riviera Maya area.  This was our first time to Cancun and we were wowed by the beaches and colors of the ocean.  It's beautiful and we would definitely stay at this resort again. The resort did an excellent job of handling the convention so that it did not interfere with other guests.

This resort was listed on the Travel Channel's Top Ten Mexican Resorts a few years ago.  Though it is 20 years old, it is well maintained, has a wonderfully trained staff, and still is a prime resort.

reviews.author: scarpenter949
reviews.title: Frist Class Resort
reviews.text: Just returned from Paradisus Cancun: Frist class resort all the way from check in to check out. They are great, room clean and great view, everyone was there to make your vacation experince the best. When you walk in the smell was relaxing and clam, check in the staff was warm and welcoming.  The resturants great selection of food and different venues for every taste.  The staff neat clean and professional, pool staff Miquel, Juan aka " Johnny Cuba", Sara the hostess at the resturant.  The thing that impresses me was the customer service, if you ask how to get somewhere on the resort they would escort you there, they went out of their way to make sure that you had a great experince.  Hats off to the staff of Paradisus they have been trained well and take great pride in their jobs.  If you have a chance go here you will not be dissapointed. AAA++.  Thank you for making this a trip of a lifetime and memories that will be with me forever.

reviews.author: vgood2
reviews.title: Outstanding!
reviews.text: We spent a week at the Paradisus in April 2013.  Upon arrival we were ushered to a reception area and greeted with a cold drink and wet towel.  The hotel is stunning and has a very Balinese feel in it's design.  The grounds are also quite stunning.  There are quite a few choices in restaurants, and all are excellent. My favorites were the Brazillian steak restaurant, and the  I would highly recommend the Royal Service or Family Concierge if you are traveling with kids.  The views of the beach are breathtaking.  We were fortunate enough to meet Fred Boutaba, a manager, who was wonderful to our family and truly went out of his way to make our stay at the Paradisus special.  He introduced us to Amaris, who was so thoughtful and helpful and really made our stay amazing.  Each night there is a theme show, and all of them are quite good.  We loved it so much we plan to return this winter.  We have travelled all over the world, and I can tell you that the staff at this resort really know how to treat their guests!  Thanks again Fred, Amaris and all the staff at the Paradisus!
